HsapDv:0000253.def: aged stage that refers to an adult who is over 112 and under 113 years old.

HsapDv:0000254.name: 113-year-old stage
HsapDv:0000254.def: aged stage that refers to an adult who is over 113 and under 114 years old.

HsapDv:0000255.name: 114-year-old stage
HsapDv:0000255.def: aged stage that refers to an adult who is over 114 and under 115 years old.

HsapDv:0000235.name: first decade stage
HsapDv:0000235.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 0 and under 10 years old.

HsapDv:0000236.name: second decade stage
HsapDv:0000236.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 10 and under 20 years old.

HsapDv:0000237.name: third decade stage
HsapDv:0000237.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 20 and under 30 years old.

HsapDv:0000238.name: fourth decade stage
HsapDv:0000238.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 30 and under 40 years old.

HsapDv:0000239.name: fifth decade stage
HsapDv:0000239.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 40 and under 50 years old.

HsapDv:0000240.name: sixth decade stage
HsapDv:0000240.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 50 and under 60 years old.

HsapDv:0000241.name: seventh decade stage
HsapDv:0000241.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 60 and under 70 years old.

HsapDv:0000242.name: eighth decade stage
HsapDv:0000242.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 70 and under 80 years old.

HsapDv:0000243.name: ninth decade stage
HsapDv:0000243.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 80 and under 90 years old.

HsapDv:0000244.name: tenth decade stage
HsapDv:0000244.def: human stage that refers to an individual who is over 90 and under 100 years old.

HsapDv:0000245.name: eleventh decade stage
HsapDv:0000245.def: human stage that refers to a human who is over 100 and under 110 years old.

PATO:0000001.name: quality
PATO:0000001.def: a dependent entity that inheres in a bearer by virtue of how the bearer is related to other entities

PATO:0000004.name: mobility
PATO:0000004.def: a quality of inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to move freely.

PATO:0000008.name: speed
PATO:0000008.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's scalar absolute value of the rate of change of the bearer's position.

PATO:0000011.name: age
PATO:0000011.def: a time quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of how long the bearer has existed.

PATO:0000014.name: color
PATO:0000014.def: a composite chromatic quality composed of hue, saturation and intensity parts.

PATO:0000015.name: color hue
PATO:0000015.def: a chromatic scalar-circular quality inhering in an object that manifests in an observer by virtue of the dominant wavelength of the visible light; may be subject to fiat divisions, typically into 7 or 8 spectra.

PATO:0000016.name: color brightness
PATO:0000016.def: a scalar optical property that is the intensity, value or amount of perceived light.

PATO:0000017.name: color saturation
PATO:0000017.def: a scalar chromatic property that is the degree of purity of perceived light.

PATO:0000018.name: fluorescence
PATO:0000018.def: a luminous flux quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's emitting longer wavelength light following the absorption of shorter wavelength radiation; fluorescence is common with aromatic compounds with several rings joined together.

PATO:0000019.name: color pattern
PATO:0000019.def: a chromatic property that is the relative position of different hues or degrees of saturation.

PATO:0000021.name: compatibility
PATO:0000021.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to harmonious coexistence.

PATO:0000025.name: composition
PATO:0000025.def: a single physical entity inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's quantities or relative ratios of subparts.

PATO:0000033.name: concentration of
PATO:0000033.def: a quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the amount of the bearer's there is mixed with another substance.

PATO:0000037.name: consistency
PATO:0000037.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's density, firmness, or viscosity.

PATO:0000039.name: direction
PATO:0000039.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's orientation in space.

PATO:0000040.name: distance
PATO:0000040.def: a quality that is the extent of space between two entities.

PATO:0000043.name: flavor
PATO:0000043.def: a quality of a physical entity inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer's molecules are being perceived by a taste and odorant receptors.

PATO:0000044.name: frequency
PATO:0000044.def: a physical quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of the number of the bearer's repetitive actions in a particular time.

PATO:0000047.name: biological sex
PATO:0000047.def: an organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved.

PATO:0000048.name: hardness
PATO:0000048.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resistance to pressure, being broken, or pierced

PATO:0000049.name: intensity
PATO:0000049.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's possessing or displaying a distinctive feature in type or degree or effect or force.

PATO:0000050.name: life span
PATO:0000050.def: a time quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's expected maximum age.

PATO:0000051.name: morphology
PATO:0000051.def: a quality of a single physical entity inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's size or shape or structure.

PATO:0000052.name: shape
PATO:0000052.def: a morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ratios of distances between its features (points, edges, surfaces and also holes etc).

PATO:0000056.name: trophic quality
PATO:0000056.def: an organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to synthesize a particular organic compound required for its growth.

PATO:0000057.name: occurrence
PATO:0000057.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's occurrence.

PATO:0000058.name: odor
PATO:0000058.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's molecules being are aerially dispersed and perceived by an odorant receptor.

PATO:0000059.name: obsolete parental quality
PATO:0000059.def: a parental quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of exhibiting the characteristic of a parent.

PATO:0000060.name: spatial pattern
PATO:0000060.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting repetition of placement of its parts.

PATO:0000062.name: sleep pattern
PATO:0000062.def: a sleep quality defined by the mathematic properties of the relative time frames of the sleep cycle.

PATO:0000066.name: pilosity
PATO:0000066.def: a texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having hair or bristles.

PATO:0000069.name: deviation (from_normal)
PATO:0000069.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the whether the bearer differs from normal or average.

PATO:0000070.name: amount
PATO:0000070.def: the number of entities of this type that are part of the whole organism.

PATO:0000077.name: response to
PATO:0000077.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the whether the bearer's disposition to react to a stimulus or an agent.

PATO:0000078.name: rhythm quality
PATO:0000078.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's movement or variation characterized by the regular recurrence or alternation of different quantities or conditions.

PATO:0000080.name: amplitude
PATO:0000080.def: a physical quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the size of the bearer's maximum displacement from the 'normal' position, when periodic motion is taking place.

PATO:0000082.name: persistence
PATO:0000082.def: a rhythm quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the repetitiveness of bearer's rhythm.

PATO:0000083.name: phase
PATO:0000083.def: a quality that exists by virtue of being a particular point in the time of a cycle.

PATO:0000085.name: sensitivity toward
PATO:0000085.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to detect or perceive external stimulation.

PATO:0000117.name: size
PATO:0000117.def: a morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's physical magnitude.

PATO:0000119.name: height
PATO:0000119.def: a 1-d extent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's vertical dimension of extension.

PATO:0000122.name: length
PATO:0000122.def: a 1-d extent quality which is equal to the distance between two points.

PATO:0000125.name: mass
PATO:0000125.def: a physical quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of the proportion of the bearer's amount of matter.

PATO:0000128.name: weight
PATO:0000128.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer that has mass near a gravitational body. important usage note: note that this ontology has a class for a similar concept, mass (pato:0000125). mass and weight are not equivalent. for most use cases, the class mass is strongly preferred over weight.

PATO:0000133.name: orientation
PATO:0000133.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's placement which is defined by the angle between the bearer and an axis, or the angle between the bearer and another object.

PATO:0000136.name: closure
PATO:0000136.def: a morphological quality pertaining to the degree to which an object contains an opening, aperture, orifice or vent.

PATO:0000140.name: position
PATO:0000140.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's spatial location relative to other objects in the vicinity.

PATO:0000141.name: structure
PATO:0000141.def: a morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's relative position, shape, arrangements and connectivity of an organism's various parts; the pattern underlying its form.

PATO:0000146.name: temperature
PATO:0000146.def: a physical quality of the thermal energy of a system.

PATO:0000150.name: texture
PATO:0000150.def: a morphologic quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's relative size, organization and distribution of its surface elements or the representation or invention of the appearance of its surface; visual and tactile surface characteristics.

PATO:0000152.name: threshold
PATO:0000152.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's sensitivity towards a fixed location or value where a change is observed; upper limit.

PATO:0000161.name: rate
PATO:0000161.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's occurrence per unit time.

PATO:0000165.name: time
PATO:0000165.def: a quality in which events occur in sequence.

PATO:0000167.name: obsolete bouts
PATO:0000167.def: a limited, often assigned period of activity.

PATO:0000169.name: viability
PATO:0000169.def: an organismal quality inhering in a bearer or a population by virtue of the bearer's disposition to survive and develop normally or the number of surviving individuals in a given population.

PATO:0000185.name: balance
PATO:0000185.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of having physical steadiness.

PATO:0000186.name: behavioral quality
PATO:0000186.def: an organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's behavior aggregate of the responses or reactions or movements in a given situation.

PATO:0000187.name: obsolete consumption quality
PATO:0000187.def: a relational quality of occurrent inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to consume a resource.

PATO:0000188.name: coordination
PATO:0000188.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or lacking skillful and effective interaction of movement.

PATO:0000189.name: discrimination
PATO:0000189.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer's disposition to perceive differences between two or more stimuli.

PATO:0000261.name: maturity
PATO:0000261.def: a quality of a single physical entity which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits a state of growth, differentiation, or development.

PATO:0000273.name: fecundity
PATO:0000273.def: a reproductive quality inhering in an organism or population by virtue of the bearer's potential reproductive capacity ad measured by the number of gametes.

PATO:0000274.name: fertility
PATO:0000274.def: a reproductive quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's initiating, sustaining, or supporting reproduction.

PATO:0000276.name: brood size
PATO:0000276.def: a reproductive quality inhering in the young of an animal by virtue of their number.

PATO:0000277.name: female fertility
PATO:0000277.def: a fertility quality inhering in a female by virtue of the bearer's disposition to initiate, sustain, or support reproduction.

PATO:0000279.name: male fertility
PATO:0000279.def: a fertility quality of inhering in a male by virtue of the bearer's disposition to initiate, sustain, or support reproduction.

PATO:0000297.name: arrested
PATO:0000297.def: a quality of a process which ends earlier than the natural end time or reference process.

PATO:0000299.name: mobile
PATO:0000299.def: a mobility quality of inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to move freely.

PATO:0000300.name: immobile
PATO:0000300.def: a mobility quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being incapable to move freely.

PATO:0000303.name: increased speed
PATO:0000303.def: a speed which is relatively high.

PATO:0000304.name: decreased speed
PATO:0000304.def: a speed which is relatively low.

PATO:0000308.name: old
PATO:0000308.def: an age which is relatively high.

PATO:0000309.name: young
PATO:0000309.def: an age which is relatively low.

PATO:0000317.name: black
PATO:0000317.def: a color that lacks any hues as parts.

PATO:0000318.name: blue
PATO:0000318.def: a color hue with low wavelength of that portion of the visible spectrum lying between green and indigo, evoked in the human observer by radiant energy with wavelengths of approximately 420 to 490 nanometers.

PATO:0000319.name: cyan
PATO:0000319.def: a color consisting of green and blue hue.

PATO:0000320.name: green
PATO:0000320.def: a color hue with medium-low wavelength of that portion of the visible spectrum lying between yellow and blue, evoked in the human observer by radiant energy with wavelengths of approximately 490 to 570 nanometers.

PATO:0000321.name: magenta
PATO:0000321.def: a color consisting of red and blue hues.

PATO:0000322.name: red
PATO:0000322.def: a color hue with high wavelength of the long-wave end of the visible spectrum, evoked in the human observer by radiant energy with wavelengths of approximately 630 to 750 nanometers.

PATO:0000323.name: white
PATO:0000323.def: an achromatic color of maximum brightness; the color of objects that reflect nearly all light of all visible wavelengths.

PATO:0000324.name: yellow
PATO:0000324.def: a color hue with medium wavelength of that portion of the visible spectrum lying between orange and green, evoked in the human observer by radiant energy with wavelengths of approximately 570 to 590 nanometers.

PATO:0000327.name: low brightness
PATO:0000327.def: a color brightness which is relatively low.

PATO:0000328.name: low saturation
PATO:0000328.def: a color saturation which is of low purity.

PATO:0000329.name: blotchy
PATO:0000329.def: a color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's being marked with irregularly shaped spots or blots of a different hue or degree of saturation.

PATO:0000330.name: irregular spatial pattern
PATO:0000330.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's magnitude of or the relationships between its repeated parts lack consistency.

PATO:0000331.name: discolored
PATO:0000331.def: a color quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being altered or spoiled in color.

PATO:0000333.name: spotted
PATO:0000333.def: a color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's being marked with a round area of different hue or degree of saturation.

PATO:0000336.name: colored
PATO:0000336.def: a color quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having color.

PATO:0000337.name: colorless
PATO:0000337.def: a color quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking color.

PATO:0000344.name: compatible
PATO:0000344.def: a compatibility quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of harmonious coexistence.

PATO:0000345.name: incompatible
PATO:0000345.def: a compatibility quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being incapable of harmonious coexistence.

PATO:0000365.name: down
PATO:0000365.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction from a higher to a lower point.

PATO:0000366.name: left
PATO:0000366.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction that is similar to the direction of an object to the north when it faces east.

PATO:0000367.name: right
PATO:0000367.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction that is similar to the direction of an object to the north when it faces west.

PATO:0000370.name: up
PATO:0000370.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction from a lower to a higher point.

PATO:0000374.name: increased distance
PATO:0000374.def: a distance which is greater relative to the normal or average.

PATO:0000375.name: decreased distance
PATO:0000375.def: a distance which is lesser relative to the normal or average.

PATO:0000380.name: increased frequency
PATO:0000380.def: a frequency which is relatively high.

PATO:0000381.name: decreased frequency
PATO:0000381.def: a frequency which is relatively low.

PATO:0000383.name: female
PATO:0000383.def: a biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population that only produces gametes that can be fertilised by male gametes.

PATO:0000384.name: male
PATO:0000384.def: a biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population whose sex organs contain only male gametes.

PATO:0000386.name: hard
PATO:0000386.def: a hardness quality of being rigid and resistant to pressure.

PATO:0000387.name: soft
PATO:0000387.def: a hardness quality of giving little resistance to pressure.

PATO:0000389.name: acute
PATO:0000389.def: a quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a sudden onset, sharp rise, and short course.

PATO:0000394.name: mild intensity
PATO:0000394.def: an intensity which is less than moderate in type or degree or effect or force.

PATO:0000395.name: moderate intensity
PATO:0000395.def: an intensity which is less than extreme in type or degree or effect or force.

PATO:0000396.name: severe intensity
PATO:0000396.def: an intensity which is extremely bad or unpleasant in type or degree or effect or force.

PATO:0000402.name: branched
PATO:0000402.def: a branchiness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having branches.

PATO:0000403.name: cleft
PATO:0000403.def: a concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a groove or fissure.

PATO:0000404.name: coiled
PATO:0000404.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curled or wound (especially in concentric rings or spirals).

PATO:0000405.name: curled
PATO:0000405.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having parallel chains in undulate fashion on the border.

PATO:0000406.name: curved
PATO:0000406.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or being marked by a curve or smoothly rounded bend.

PATO:0000407.name: flat
PATO:0000407.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a horizontal surface without a slope, tilt, or curvature.

PATO:0000409.name: oblate
PATO:0000409.def: a spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting an equatorial diameter greater than its polar diameter.

PATO:0000410.name: pinnate
PATO:0000410.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having leaflets or leaflets-like structures on each side of a common axis.

PATO:0000411.name: circular
PATO:0000411.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being such that every part of the surface or the circumference is equidistant from the center.

PATO:0000413.name: square
PATO:0000413.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an equal-sided rectangular form.

PATO:0000414.name: unbranched
PATO:0000414.def: a branchiness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking branches.

PATO:0000415.name: uncoiled
PATO:0000415.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being not curled or wound (especially in concentric rings or spirals).

PATO:0000422.name: auxotrophic
PATO:0000422.def: a nutritional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability to synthesize a particular organic compound required for its growth.

PATO:0000423.name: prototrophic
PATO:0000423.def: a nutritional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to synthesize a particular organic compound required for its growth.

PATO:0000427.name: recurrent
PATO:0000427.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's occurring or appearing again or repeatedly.

PATO:0000428.name: sporadic
PATO:0000428.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's once or in or a few unpredictable instances.

PATO:0000433.name: obsolete paternal
PATO:0000433.def: a parental quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of exhibiting the characteristic of a father.

PATO:0000434.name: obsolete maternal
PATO:0000434.def: a parental quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of exhibiting the characteristic of a mother.

PATO:0000438.name: invariant
PATO:0000438.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation.

PATO:0000440.name: regular spatial pattern
PATO:0000440.def: a pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a repeatable or predictable placement.

PATO:0000441.name: repetitive
PATO:0000441.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's marked by tedious repetition.

PATO:0000442.name: obsolete insomnia
PATO:0000442.def: a sleep pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability to sleep.

PATO:0000443.name: obsolete narcolepsy
PATO:0000443.def: a sleep pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disrupted sleep during normal sleeping period; often accompanied by cataplexy, sleep paralysis.

PATO:0000453.name: glabrous
PATO:0000453.def: a pilosity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lack of hairs or bristles.

PATO:0000454.name: hairy
PATO:0000454.def: a pilosity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with hair or hairlike projections.

PATO:0000455.name: pubescent
PATO:0000455.def: a maturity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having arrived at the onset of puberty (the age at which sex glands become functional) but not yet fully mature.

PATO:0000460.name: abnormal
PATO:0000460.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's deviation from normal or average.

PATO:0000461.name: normal
PATO:0000461.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting no deviation from normal or average.

PATO:0000462.name: absent
PATO:0000462.def: a quality denoting the lack of an entity.

PATO:0000463.name: conspicuous
PATO:0000463.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being clearly visible.

PATO:0000464.name: inconspicuous
PATO:0000464.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of not being clearly visible.

PATO:0000467.name: present
PATO:0000467.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's existence.

PATO:0000470.name: increased amount
PATO:0000470.def: an amount which is relatively high.

PATO:0000487.name: responsive to
PATO:0000487.def: a response quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to react to a stimulus or an agent.

PATO:0000488.name: unresponsive to
PATO:0000488.def: a response quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lack of reaction to a stimulus or an agent.

PATO:0000498.name: increased duration
PATO:0000498.def: a duration quality of a process which is relatively high.

PATO:0000499.name: decreased duration
PATO:0000499.def: a duration quality of a process which is relatively low.

PATO:0000500.name: advanced phase
PATO:0000500.def: a phase which occurs earlier than the natural start time.

PATO:0000501.name: dark phase
PATO:0000501.def: a phase which occurs during dark cycle.

PATO:0000502.name: delayed
PATO:0000502.def: a quality of a process which starts later than the natural start time or the reference process.

PATO:0000503.name: light phase
PATO:0000503.def: a phase which occurs during the light cycle.

PATO:0000504.name: arrhythmic
PATO:0000504.def: a rhythm quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking rhythm.

PATO:0000505.name: rhythmic
PATO:0000505.def: a rhythm quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having rhythm.

PATO:0000513.name: insensitive toward
PATO:0000513.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking sensitivity toward an external stimulus.

PATO:0000515.name: tolerant to
PATO:0000515.def: a resistance quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its disposition to endure or being insensitive to a stimulus.

PATO:0000516.name: sensitive toward
PATO:0000516.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having sensitivity toward an external stimulus.

PATO:0000524.name: obsolete plant growth hormone sensitivity value

PATO:0000546.name: photoinsensitive
PATO:0000546.def: a photosensitivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking photosensitivity.

PATO:0000547.name: photosensitive
PATO:0000547.def: a photosensitivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting photosensitivity.

PATO:0000549.name: obsolete far red light sensitivity value

PATO:0000551.name: obsolete u v light sensitivity value

PATO:0000569.name: decreased height
PATO:0000569.def: a height which is relatively low.

PATO:0000570.name: increased height
PATO:0000570.def: a height which is relatively high.

PATO:0000573.name: increased length
PATO:0000573.def: a length quality which is relatively large.

PATO:0000574.name: decreased length
PATO:0000574.def: a length quality which is relatively small.

PATO:0000582.name: increased weight
PATO:0000582.def: a weight which is relatively high.

PATO:0000583.name: decreased weight
PATO:0000583.def: a weight which is relatively low.

PATO:0000584.name: hypertrophic
PATO:0000584.def: an increased size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting enlargement of a cell or constituent group of cells (for example, organ).

PATO:0000585.name: hypotrophic
PATO:0000585.def: a decreased size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting reduced size of a cell or constituent group of cells (for example, organ).

PATO:0000586.name: increased size
PATO:0000586.def: a size quality which is relatively high.

PATO:0000587.name: decreased size
PATO:0000587.def: a size quality which is relatively low.

PATO:0000588.name: vestigial
PATO:0000588.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being a remnant structure from earlier development or evolution.

PATO:0000591.name: increased thickness
PATO:0000591.def: a thickness which is relatively high.

PATO:0000592.name: decreased thickness
PATO:0000592.def: a thickness which is relatively low.

PATO:0000595.name: increased volume
PATO:0000595.def: a volume which is relatively high.

PATO:0000596.name: decreased volume
PATO:0000596.def: a volume which is relatively low.

PATO:0000599.name: decreased width
PATO:0000599.def: a width which is relatively small.

PATO:0000600.name: increased width
PATO:0000600.def: a width which is relatively large.

PATO:0000608.name: closed
PATO:0000608.def: a morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's affording blocked passage or view.

PATO:0000609.name: closure incomplete
PATO:0000609.def: a morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's affording not completed blocked passage or view.

PATO:0000610.name: open
PATO:0000610.def: a morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's affording unobstructed passage or view.

PATO:0000613.name: disoriented
PATO:0000613.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking orientation.

PATO:0000614.name: oriented
PATO:0000614.def: a pattern where all the repeated elements are oriented in the same direction.

PATO:0000615.name: wholly anteriorized
PATO:0000615.def: an anteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing only what are normally anterior structures.

PATO:0000616.name: asymmetrical
PATO:0000616.def: a symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking symmetry.

PATO:0000617.name: bent
PATO:0000617.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one or more angle(s) in its length.

PATO:0000618.name: bilateral
PATO:0000618.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two sides; two-sided.

PATO:0000619.name: crowded
PATO:0000619.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being overfilled.

PATO:0000620.name: wholly dorsalized
PATO:0000620.def: a dorsalized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing only what are normally dorsal structures.

PATO:0000622.name: erect
PATO:0000622.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being upright in position or posture.

PATO:0000623.name: exserted
PATO:0000623.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's protruding or projecting from the body.

PATO:0000624.name: inserted into
PATO:0000624.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's becoming joined together with an additional entity.

PATO:0000625.name: inverted
PATO:0000625.def: an oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being reversed in position, order, or condition.

PATO:0000626.name: lateralized
PATO:0000626.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being moved or displaced to one side so as to make lateral.

PATO:0000627.name: localized
PATO:0000627.def: a spatial pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being confined or restricted to a particular location.

PATO:0000628.name: mislocalised
PATO:0000628.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's being changed in abnormal position.

PATO:0000629.name: misrouted
PATO:0000629.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having mistakenly taken course, way, or passage; ill-routed.

PATO:0000630.name: wholly posteriorized
PATO:0000630.def: a posteriorized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing only what are normally posterior structures.

PATO:0000631.name: prostrate
PATO:0000631.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being stretched out and lying at full length along the ground.

PATO:0000632.name: symmetrical
PATO:0000632.def: a symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of division by a longitudinal plane into similar halves.

PATO:0000633.name: uncrowded
PATO:0000633.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being not overfilled.

PATO:0000634.name: unilateral
PATO:0000634.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's involvement of only one part or side.

PATO:0000635.name: unlocalised
PATO:0000635.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being confined or restricted to a particular location.

PATO:0000636.name: wholly ventralized
PATO:0000636.def: a ventralized quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gross morphology containing only what are normally ventral structures.

PATO:0000638.name: apoptotic
PATO:0000638.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of blebbing of the nucleus and dna fragmentation due to the cell undergoing a specific form of programmed cell death termed apoptosis.

PATO:0000639.name: degenerate
PATO:0000639.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer whose structure deteriorates or is lost over time due to an active pathological process.

PATO:0000640.name: dysplastic
PATO:0000640.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting an alteration in size, shape or organization of its constituent cells.

PATO:0000642.name: fused with
PATO:0000642.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being merged with another entity.

PATO:0000643.name: herniated
PATO:0000643.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bodily structure that has protruded through an abnormal opening in the wall that contains it.

PATO:0000644.name: hyperplastic
PATO:0000644.def: a physical quality inhering in an organ or tissue by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting an increased number of cells, typically associated with an increase in size.

PATO:0000645.name: hypoplastic
PATO:0000645.def: a physical quality inhering in an organ or tissue by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a decreased number of cells, typically associated with a decrease in size.

PATO:0000646.name: malformed
PATO:0000646.def: a morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being distorted during formation.

PATO:0000647.name: necrotic
PATO:0000647.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's undergoing unprogrammed cell death.

PATO:0000648.name: obstructed
PATO:0000648.def: a morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being blocked or filled with obstacles or an obstacle.

PATO:0000651.name: unfused from
PATO:0000651.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being no longer merged with another entity.

PATO:0000665.name: high brightness
PATO:0000665.def: a color brightness which is relatively high.

PATO:0000688.name: asynchronous
PATO:0000688.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not occurring or existing at the same time or having the same period or phase.

PATO:0000689.name: continuous
PATO:0000689.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being uninterrupted in time, sequence, substance, or extent.

PATO:0000690.name: discontinuous
PATO:0000690.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by breaks or interruptions.

PATO:0000692.name: heterochronic
PATO:0000692.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's origin or development at an unusual time or out of the regular sequence.

PATO:0000694.name: premature
PATO:0000694.def: a quality of a process which starts earlier than the natural start time or the reference process.

PATO:0000695.name: synchronous
PATO:0000695.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's occurring or existing at the same time or having the same period or phase.

PATO:0000700.name: rough
PATO:0000700.def: a texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's irregular surface.

PATO:0000701.name: smooth
PATO:0000701.def: a texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's processing a surface free of roughness or irregularities.

PATO:0000706.name: increased threshold
PATO:0000706.def: a threshold which is relatively high.

PATO:0000708.name: decreased threshold
PATO:0000708.def: a threshold which is relatively low.

PATO:0000718.name: lethal (sensu genetics)
PATO:0000718.def: a viability quality inhering in a population by virtue of the bearer's long term survival inability.

PATO:0000719.name: viable
PATO:0000719.def: a viability quality inhering in a bearer or a population by virtue of the bearer's ability to survive or the long term survival ability of a given population.

PATO:0000757.name: balanced
PATO:0000757.def: a balance quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having balance.

PATO:0000758.name: unbalanced
PATO:0000758.def: a balance quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking balance.

PATO:0000759.name: bang sensitive
PATO:0000759.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting paralytic behaviour when subjected to mechanical shock.

PATO:0000760.name: increased behavioural activity
PATO:0000760.def: a behavioral quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting increased activity.

PATO:0000761.name: decreased behavioural activity
PATO:0000761.def: a behavioral quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting reduced activity.

PATO:0000763.name: paralysed
PATO:0000763.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being affected by loss of the ability to move a body part.

PATO:0000764.name: passive
PATO:0000764.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's receiving or being subjected to an action without responding or initiating an action in return.

PATO:0000767.name: obsolete increased consumption
PATO:0000767.def: a consumption which is relatively high.

PATO:0000768.name: obsolete decreased consumption
PATO:0000768.def: a consumption which is relatively low.

PATO:0000769.name: coordinated
PATO:0000769.def: a coordination quality of inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having skillful and effective interaction of movement.

PATO:0000770.name: uncoordinated
PATO:0000770.def: a coordination quality of inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking skillful and effective interaction of movement.

PATO:0000771.name: aversion
PATO:0000771.def: a preference quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disliking a perceived stimulus.

PATO:0000772.name: indifference
PATO:0000772.def: a preference quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having no preference to a perceived stimulus.

PATO:0000773.name: preference
PATO:0000773.def: a discrimination quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's liking a perceived stimulus.

PATO:0000888.name: female fertile
PATO:0000888.def: a female fertility quality inhering in a female by virtue of the bearer's disposition to initiate, sustain, or support reproduction.

PATO:0000890.name: male sterile
PATO:0000890.def: a male fertility quality inhering in a male by virtue of the bearer's being incapable of initiating, sustaining, or supporting reproduction.

PATO:0000891.name: male fertile
PATO:0000891.def: a male fertility quality inhering in a male by virtue of the bearer's being capable of initiating, sustaining, or supporting reproduction.

PATO:0000892.name: female sterile
PATO:0000892.def: a female fertility quality inhering in a female by virtue of the bearer's being incapable of initiating, sustaining, or supporting reproduction.

PATO:0000911.name: decreased rate
PATO:0000911.def: a rate which is relatively low.

PATO:0000912.name: increased rate
PATO:0000912.def: a rate which is relatively high.

PATO:0000915.name: thickness
PATO:0000915.def: a 1-d extent quality which is equal to the dimension through an object as opposed to its length or width.

PATO:0000918.def: a 3-d extent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's amount of 3-dimensional space it occupies.

PATO:0000921.name: width

PATO:0000927.name: photosensitivity
PATO:0000927.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being sensitivity to the action of radiant energy.

PATO:0000937.name: disorganized
PATO:0000937.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking organisation.

PATO:0000938.name: organized
PATO:0000938.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting organisation.

PATO:0000941.name: vacuolated
PATO:0000941.def: a structural quality inhering in a cytoplasm that contains fluid filled cavities.

PATO:0000944.name: sharpness
PATO:0000944.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a sharp or tapered end or point.

PATO:0000945.name: epinastic
PATO:0000945.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a downward bending of its leaves or other plant parts.

PATO:0000946.name: oblong
PATO:0000946.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a somewhat elongated form with approximately parallel sides.

PATO:0000947.name: elliptic

PATO:0000948.name: heart shaped

PATO:0000949.name: fasciated
PATO:0000949.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormally flattened or coalesced.

PATO:0000950.name: grey

PATO:0000956.name: sterile

PATO:0000957.name: opacity
PATO:0000957.def: an optical quality which obtains by virtue of the ability of the bearer to absorb visible light.

PATO:0000963.name: opaque
PATO:0000963.def: a optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being clear; not transmitting or reflecting light or radiant energy.

PATO:0000964.name: transparent
PATO:0000964.def: a optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking opacity.

PATO:0000965.name: symmetry
PATO:0000965.def: a pattern quality of inhering in a bearer by virtue of the correspondence in size, shape, and relative position of the bearer's parts on opposite sides of a dividing line or median plane or about a center or axis.

PATO:0000967.name: undulate
PATO:0000967.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a sinuate margin and rippled surface.

PATO:0000969.name: dwarf-like
PATO:0000969.def: a size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormally small.

PATO:0000970.name: permeability
PATO:0000970.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being permeated or pervaded by a gas or liquid (as by osmosis or diffusion).

PATO:0000973.name: porosity
PATO:0000973.def: a structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to admit the passage of gas or liquid through pores or interstices.

PATO:0000982.name: permeable
PATO:0000982.def: a permeability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable to be permeated or pervaded by a gas or liquid (as by osmosis or diffusion).

PATO:0000983.name: impermeable
PATO:0000983.def: a permeability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being incapable of being permeated or pervaded by a gas or liquid (as by osmosis or diffusion).

PATO:0000984.name: porous
PATO:0000984.def: a porosity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of admitting the passage of gas or liquid through pores or interstices.

PATO:0000985.name: non-porous
PATO:0000985.def: a porosity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being incapable of admitting the passage of gas or liquid through pores or interstices.

PATO:0000992.name: viscosity
PATO:0000992.def: a physical quality of a fluid inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to internal resistance to flow.

PATO:0000998.name: viscous

PATO:0000999.name: alternation
PATO:0000999.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's successive change from one thing or state to another and back again.

PATO:0001005.name: latency
PATO:0001005.def: a time quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the time it elapses for the bearer to respond to a stimulus.

PATO:0001018.name: physical quality
PATO:0001018.def: a quality of a physical entity that exists through action of continuants at the physical level of organisation in relation to other entities.

PATO:0001019.name: mass density
PATO:0001019.def: a physical quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of some influence is exerted by the bearer's mass per unit size.

PATO:0001020.name: damage
PATO:0001020.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer has been harmed or injured or spoiled.

PATO:0001021.name: energy
PATO:0001021.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's capacity to do work.

PATO:0001022.name: impulse
PATO:0001022.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the amount of momentum caused a certain force will produce over time.

PATO:0001023.name: momentum
PATO:0001023.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's velocity multiplied by its mass.

PATO:0001024.name: power
PATO:0001024.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's rate of doing work.

PATO:0001025.name: pressure
PATO:0001025.def: a physical quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's amount of force per unit area it exerts.

PATO:0001026.name: work
PATO:0001026.def: a physical quality which is equal to the energy transferred by a force to a moving object.

PATO:0001028.name: acceleration
PATO:0001028.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the rate of change of the bearer's velocity in either speed or direction.

PATO:0001029.name: efficiency
PATO:0001029.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of ratio of the bearer's output to the bearer's input.

PATO:0001030.name: flux
PATO:0001030.def: a physical quality that exists by virtue of the rate of flow of the bearer across a given surface.

PATO:0001031.name: elasticity
PATO:0001031.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to recover its size and shape after deformation in any way.

PATO:0001035.name: force

PATO:0001046.name: resistance to

PATO:0001052.name: obtuse angle to
PATO:0001052.def: an angle which is between 90 degrees and 180 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001053.name: convex angle to
PATO:0001053.def: an angle which is less than 180 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001054.name: internal angle
PATO:0001054.def: a convex angle that is inside two adjacent sides of a polygon.

PATO:0001055.name: reflex angle to
PATO:0001055.def: an angular placement quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's placement at an angle that is greater than 180 degrees but less than 360 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001153.name: insusceptible toward

PATO:0001154.name: elongated

PATO:0001163.name: decreased concentration

PATO:0001164.name: dense

PATO:0001168.name: undamaged

PATO:0001171.name: elastic
PATO:0001171.def: an elasticity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to recover its size and shape after deformation in any way.

PATO:0001172.name: inelastic
PATO:0001172.def: an elasticity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability to recover its size and shape after deformation in any way.

PATO:0001190.name: juvenile

PATO:0001193.name: lateral to

PATO:0001194.name: hyporesponsive to
PATO:0001194.def: a response quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's limited reaction to a stimulus or an agent.

PATO:0001195.name: proximal to

PATO:0001196.name: ventral to

PATO:0001208.def: an odor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking odour.
