PATO:0001255.name: light orange
PATO:0001255.def: a color consisting of orange hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001256.name: dark orange
PATO:0001256.def: a color consisting of orange color and low brightness.

PATO:0001257.name: light deep pink
PATO:0001257.def: pink color having high brightness and moderate saturation.

PATO:0001258.name: deep pink
PATO:0001258.def: pink color having medium brightness and moderate saturation.

PATO:0001259.name: dark purple
PATO:0001259.def: a color consisting of purple color and low brightness.

PATO:0001260.name: light purple
PATO:0001260.def: a color consisting of purple color and high brightness.

PATO:0001261.name: dark red
PATO:0001261.def: a color consisting of red hue and low brightness.

PATO:0001262.name: light red
PATO:0001262.def: a color consisting of red hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001263.name: dark yellow
PATO:0001263.def: a color consisting of yellow hue and low brightness.

PATO:0001264.name: light yellow
PATO:0001264.def: a color consisting of yellow hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001265.name: saturated blue
PATO:0001265.def: a color consisting of blue hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001266.name: desaturated blue
PATO:0001266.def: a color consisting of blue hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001267.name: saturated brown
PATO:0001267.def: a color consisting of brown hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001268.name: desaturated brown
PATO:0001268.def: a color consisting of brown hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001269.name: saturated cyan
PATO:0001269.def: a color consisting of cyan colour and high saturation.

PATO:0001270.name: desaturated cyan
PATO:0001270.def: a color consisting of cyan colour and low saturation.

PATO:0001271.name: saturated green
PATO:0001271.def: a color consisting of green hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001272.name: desaturated green
PATO:0001272.def: a color consisting of green hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001273.name: obsolete bright grey
PATO:0001273.def: a color consisting of grey color and high saturation.

PATO:0001274.name: obsolete pale grey
PATO:0001274.def: a color consisting of grey color and low saturation.

PATO:0001275.name: saturated magenta
PATO:0001275.def: a color consisting of magenta color and high saturation.

PATO:0001276.name: desaturated magenta
PATO:0001276.def: a color consisting of magenta color and low saturation.

PATO:0001277.name: saturated orange
PATO:0001277.def: a color consisting of orange hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001278.name: desaturated orange
PATO:0001278.def: a color consisting of orange hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001280.name: dark pale pink
PATO:0001280.def: pink color having medium brightness and low saturation.

PATO:0001281.name: saturated purple
PATO:0001281.def: a color consisting of purple color and high saturation.

PATO:0001282.name: desaturated purple
PATO:0001282.def: a color consisting of purple color and low saturation.

PATO:0001283.name: saturated red
PATO:0001283.def: a color consisting of red hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001284.name: desaturated red
PATO:0001284.def: a color consisting of red hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001285.name: saturated yellow
PATO:0001285.def: a color consisting of yellow hue and high saturation.

PATO:0001286.name: desaturated yellow
PATO:0001286.def: a color consisting of yellow hue and low saturation.

PATO:0001287.name: red brown
PATO:0001287.def: a color consisting of red and brown hue.

PATO:0001288.name: dark red brown
PATO:0001288.def: a color consisting of red and brown hue and low brightness.

PATO:0001289.name: light red brown
PATO:0001289.def: a color consisting of red and brown hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001290.name: fluorescent
PATO:0001290.def: a fluorescence quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of emitting light during exposure to radiation from an external source.

PATO:0001291.name: obsolete electromagnetic (em) radiation quality
PATO:0001291.def: obsolete a radiation quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of how that bearer interacts with electromagnetic radiation.

PATO:0001292.name: full-spectrum em radiation quality
PATO:0001292.def: an em radiation quality that is independent of the em wavelength range.

PATO:0001293.name: absorption quality
PATO:0001293.def: a scalar em radiation quality which obtains by the capacity of the bearer to retain radiation.

PATO:0001294.name: radiation reflective quality
PATO:0001294.def: a scalar em radiation quality which obtains by the capacity of the bearer to scatter or reflect radiation.

PATO:0001295.name: albedo
PATO:0001295.def: a reflective quality restricted to a particular wavelength.

PATO:0001296.name: luminous flux
PATO:0001296.def: a scalar optical quality which obtains by the magnitude of the light emitted by the bearer.

PATO:0001297.name: reflectivity
PATO:0001297.def: a radiation reflective quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the ratio of the energy of a wave reflected from its surface to the energy possessed by the wave striking the bearer's surface.

PATO:0001298.name: phosphorescence
PATO:0001298.def: a fluorescence in which the emittence continues after the absorption has ceased.

PATO:0001299.name: radiation emitting quality
PATO:0001299.def: a scalar em radiation quality which obtains by the capacity of the bearer to emit radiation.

PATO:0001300.name: optical quality
PATO:0001300.def: an em radiation quality in which the em radiation is within the fiat range of the spectrum visible deemed to be light.

PATO:0001301.name: chromatic property
PATO:0001301.def: an optical quality that is the mixture, purity or pattern of wavelengths of light perceived by the observer.

PATO:0001302.name: vermilion
PATO:0001302.def: a color consisting of red and orange hue with a slight amount of gray.

PATO:0001303.name: variability
PATO:0001303.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to varying or changing.

PATO:0001304.name: variability of temperature
PATO:0001304.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits temperature variation or change.

PATO:0001305.name: increased temperature
PATO:0001305.def: a temperature which is relatively high.

PATO:0001306.name: decreased temperature
PATO:0001306.def: a temperature which is relatively low.

PATO:0001307.name: decreased variability of temperature
PATO:0001307.def: a variability of temperature which is relatively low.

PATO:0001308.name: increased variability of temperature
PATO:0001308.def: a variability of temperature which is relatively high.

PATO:0001309.name: duration
PATO:0001309.def: a process quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's magnitude of the temporal extent between the starting and ending point.

PATO:0001310.name: duration of temperature
PATO:0001310.def: a duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's duration of exhibition of thermal energy.

PATO:0001311.name: decreased duration of temperature
PATO:0001311.def: a duration of temperature which is lesser relative to the normal or average enduring or continuing in time.

PATO:0001312.name: increased duration of temperature
PATO:0001312.def: a duration of temperature which is greater relative to the normal or average in respect to the quality of temperature of enduring or continuing in time.

PATO:0001313.name: invariant temperature
PATO:0001313.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation of temperature.

PATO:0001314.name: variant temperature
PATO:0001314.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or exhibiting variation of temperature.

PATO:0001315.name: mild increased temperature
PATO:0001315.def: a temperature which is increased by a low degree.

PATO:0001316.name: moderate increased temperature
PATO:0001316.def: a temperature which is increased by a medium degree.

PATO:0001317.name: severe increased temperature
PATO:0001317.def: a temperature which is increased by a high degree.

PATO:0001318.name: indiscriminate
PATO:0001318.def: a discrimination quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being incapable perceiving differences between two or more stimuli.

PATO:0001319.name: discriminate
PATO:0001319.def: a discrimination quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of perceiving differences between two or more stimuli.

PATO:0001320.name: pubescent hair
PATO:0001320.def: a pilosity quality of being covered with short hairs or soft down.

PATO:0001321.name: right angle to
PATO:0001321.def: an angle which is 90 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001322.name: straight angle to
PATO:0001322.def: an angle which is 180 degrees to another entity.

PATO:0001323.name: area
PATO:0001323.def: a 2-d extent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's two dimensional extent.

PATO:0001324.name: bilateral symmetry
PATO:0001324.def: a symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being symmetric about a plane running from its frontal end to its caudal end (head to tail), and has nearly identical right and left halves.

PATO:0001325.name: radial symmetry
PATO:0001325.def: a symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having equal proportion around a central point or axis.

PATO:0001327.name: zygomorphic
PATO:0001327.def: a symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of division into symmetrical halves by only one longitudinal plane passing through the axis.

PATO:0001328.name: actinomorphic
PATO:0001328.def: a symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of division into symmetrical halves by any longitudinal plane passing through the axis.

PATO:0001329.name: flavourful
PATO:0001329.def: a flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having flavour.

PATO:0001330.name: flavourless
PATO:0001330.def: a flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking flavour.

PATO:0001331.name: odorous
PATO:0001331.def: an odor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having odour.

PATO:0001332.name: amorphous
PATO:0001332.def: a morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lack of distinct morphology.

PATO:0001333.name: temporally extended
PATO:0001333.def: a quality of a process which ends later than the natural end time.

PATO:0001334.name: diameter
PATO:0001334.def: a length quality which is equal to the length of any straight line segment that passes through the center of a circle and whose endpoints are on the circular boundary.

PATO:0001335.name: bacterial mating type
PATO:0001335.def: a mating type that indicates whether the f plasmid has integrated into the chromosome.

PATO:0001336.name: obsolete unknown sex
PATO:0001336.def: a biological sex quality inhering in an individual whose sex is unknown.

PATO:0001338.name: mixed sex
PATO:0001338.def: a biological sex quality inhering in a population of multiple sexes.

PATO:0001339.name: biomaterial purity
PATO:0001339.def: a composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's homogeneity of a biomaterial.

PATO:0001340.name: hermaphrodite
PATO:0001340.def: a biological sex quality inhering in an organism or a population with both male and female sexual organs in one individual.

PATO:0001341.name: a mating type (yeast)
PATO:0001341.def: a s. cerevisiae mating type cells that secrete a pheromone that in alpha haploids stimulates processes that lead to mating.

PATO:0001343.name: schizosaccharomyces pombe mating type
PATO:0001343.def: a s. pombe mating type determined by the gene configuration on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001344.name: alpha mating type (yeast)
PATO:0001344.def: a s. cerevisiae mating type cells that secrete a pheromone that stimulates a haploids.

PATO:0001345.name: h minus
PATO:0001345.def: a s. pombe mating type determined by the mat1-mc and mat1-mi on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001346.name: h plus
PATO:0001346.def: a s. pombe mating type determined by the mat1-pc and mat1-pi on the mat1 locus.

PATO:0001347.name: f mating type
PATO:0001347.def: a bacterial mating type indicating the presence of f plasmid in a bacterial cell.

PATO:0001348.name: f minus mating type
PATO:0001348.def: a bacterial mating type indicating the absence of f plasmid in a bacterial cell.

PATO:0001349.name: high frequency recombinant
PATO:0001349.def: a mating type that indicates that the f plasmid has integrated into the chromosome.

PATO:0001350.name: angular acceleration
PATO:0001350.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the rate of change of the bearer's angular velocity.

PATO:0001351.name: area density
PATO:0001351.def: a density quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of some influence exerted by the bearer's mass on a given area.

PATO:0001352.name: linear density
PATO:0001352.def: a density quality which is equal to the mass exerting an influence on a one-dimensional object.

PATO:0001353.name: volumetric density
PATO:0001353.def: a density quality which inheres in a bearer by virtue of some influence exerted by the bearer's mass on a given volume.

PATO:0001354.name: translucent
PATO:0001354.def: a optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting low opacity.

PATO:0001355.name: convex
PATO:0001355.def: a shape quality that obtains by virtue of the bearer having inward facing edges; having a surface or boundary that curves or bulges outward, as the exterior of a sphere.

PATO:0001356.name: pleomorphic
PATO:0001356.def: a shape quality inhering in a cell by virtue of the bearer's ability to take on two or more different shapes during its life cycle.

PATO:0001357.name: pulvinate
PATO:0001357.def: a convex 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a cushion or has a marked convex cushion-like form.

PATO:0001358.name: umbonate
PATO:0001358.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a knob or knoblike protuberance.

PATO:0001359.name: rugose
PATO:0001359.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having many wrinkles or creases on the surface.

PATO:0001360.name: filamentous
PATO:0001360.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having thin filamentous extensions at its edge.

PATO:0001361.name: warty
PATO:0001361.def: a texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being covered with warts or projections that resemble warts resulting in a hard rough surface.

PATO:0001362.name: fragile
PATO:0001362.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being easily damaged or destroyed.

PATO:0001364.name: rhizoidal
PATO:0001364.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having root like extensions radiating from its center.

PATO:0001365.name: spiny
PATO:0001365.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having spines, thorns or similar thin projections on its surface.

PATO:0001366.name: punctiform
PATO:0001366.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being small and resembling a point.

PATO:0001367.name: lobate
PATO:0001367.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having deeply undulating edges forming lobes.

PATO:0001368.name: erose
PATO:0001368.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an irregularly toothed edge.

PATO:0001369.name: raised
PATO:0001369.def: a shape quality inhering in a colony by virtue of the bearer's appearing above the medium surface with terraced edges.

PATO:0001370.name: viscid
PATO:0001370.def: a coating quality which is sticky or clammy.

PATO:0001371.name: mucoid
PATO:0001371.def: a composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's consistency of mucus.

PATO:0001372.name: refractivity
PATO:0001372.def: a physical quality that inheres in propagating wave (light or sound) virtue of the bearer's change in direction when passing from one medium to another.

PATO:0001373.name: glistening
PATO:0001373.def: a reflectivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's reflecting lots of light.

PATO:0001374.name: ploidy
PATO:0001374.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's number of homologous sets of chromosomes in the nucleus or primary chromosome-containing compartment of the cell, each set essentially coding for all the biological traits of the organism.

PATO:0001375.name: haploid
PATO:0001375.def: a ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing a single set of homologous chromosomes.

PATO:0001376.name: monoploid
PATO:0001376.def: a ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing a single set of unique homologous chromosomes.

PATO:0001377.name: polyploid
PATO:0001377.def: a ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing more than two homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001378.name: autopolyploid
PATO:0001378.def: a polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing chromosomes derived from a single species.

PATO:0001379.name: allopolyploidy
PATO:0001379.def: a polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing chromosomes derived from different species.

PATO:0001380.name: paleopolyploid
PATO:0001380.def: a polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an ancient polyploid ancestor.

PATO:0001381.name: triploid
PATO:0001381.def: a polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing three homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001382.name: tetraploid
PATO:0001382.def: a polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing four homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001383.name: pentaploid
PATO:0001383.def: a polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing five homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001384.name: hexaploid
PATO:0001384.def: a polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing six homologous sets of chromosomes.

PATO:0001385.name: aneuploid
PATO:0001385.def: a ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing a non-integral multiple of the monoploid number, due to extra or missing chromosomes.

PATO:0001386.name: monosomy
PATO:0001386.def: an aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing only one chromosome from a pair in a cell's nucleus.

PATO:0001387.name: disomy
PATO:0001387.def: an aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing only two chromosome from a pair in a cell's nucleus.

PATO:0001388.name: uniparental disomy
PATO:0001388.def: a disomy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing two copies of the chromosome from one of the parents (with no contribution from the other parent).

PATO:0001389.name: trisomy
PATO:0001389.def: an aneuploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing three, instead of two, chromosomes of a particular numbered type in an organism.

PATO:0001390.name: partial trisomy
PATO:0001390.def: a trisomy quality inhering in a bearer when part of the bearer's extra chromosome is attached to one of the other chromosomes, or if one of the bearer's chromosomes has two copies of part of its chromosome.

PATO:0001391.name: mosaic trisomy
PATO:0001391.def: a trisomy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having extra chromosomal material in only some of it's cells.

PATO:0001392.name: endopolyploid
PATO:0001392.def: a polyploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's chromosome number being increased by endomitosis and for which the degree of ploidy is proportional to the number of times that endomitosis has taken place.

PATO:0001393.name: euploid
PATO:0001393.def: a ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing an integral multiple of the monoploid number, possibly excluding the sex-determining chromosomes.

PATO:0001394.name: diploid
PATO:0001394.def: a ploidy quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two copies (homologs) of each chromosome, usually one from the mother and one from the father.

PATO:0001395.name: haplodiploid
PATO:0001395.def: a diploidy quality inhering in a bearer in by virtue of belonging in a species whose one of the sexes has haploid cells and the other has diploid cells.

PATO:0001396.name: cellular quality
PATO:0001396.def: a monadic quality of continuant that exists at the cellular level of organisation.

PATO:0001397.name: cellular potency
PATO:0001397.def: a cellular quality that arises by virtue of whether the bearer's disposition to differentiate into one or more mature cell types.

PATO:0001398.name: self-renewal
PATO:0001398.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the ability to go through numerous cycles of cell division while maintaining the undifferentiated state.

PATO:0001399.name: totipotent
PATO:0001399.def: a cellular potency that is the capacity to produce differentiated cell types of all three primary germ layers and extraembryonic cell types.

PATO:0001400.name: unipotent
PATO:0001400.def: a cellular potency that is the capacity to produce only one differentiated cell type.

PATO:0001401.name: oligopotent
PATO:0001401.def: a cellular potency that is the capacity to form multiple differentiated cell types of a specific lineage and lack self renewing capacity.

PATO:0001402.name: multipotent
PATO:0001402.def: a cellular potency that is the capacity to form multiple differentiated cell types.

PATO:0001403.name: pluripotent
PATO:0001403.def: a cellular potency that is the capacity to produce differentiated cell types of all three primary germ layers but not extraembryonic cell types.

PATO:0001404.name: nucleate quality
PATO:0001404.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's number of nuclei.

PATO:0001405.name: anucleate
PATO:0001405.def: a nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having no nucleus.

PATO:0001406.name: binucleate
PATO:0001406.def: a nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two nuclei.

PATO:0001407.name: mononucleate
PATO:0001407.def: a nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one nucleus.

PATO:0001408.name: ciliatedness
PATO:0001408.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having thin, tail-like projections extending outwards from the cell body.

PATO:0001409.name: spindle-shaped
PATO:0001409.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a long tapered rod.

PATO:0001410.name: striated
PATO:0001410.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines or grooves, usually parallel.

PATO:0001411.name: structured
PATO:0001411.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having distinct structure.

PATO:0001412.name: unstructured
PATO:0001412.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking distinct structure.

PATO:0001413.name: angular velocity
PATO:0001413.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the rate of the bearer's angular movement about an axis; the angle rotated in a given time.

PATO:0001414.name: catalytic activity
PATO:0001414.def: a physical quality inhering in a catalyst by virtue of the amount of the catalyst's action.

PATO:0001415.name: morbidity
PATO:0001415.def: a quality inhering in a population by virtue of the proportion of its members that are ill at a given time.

PATO:0001416.name: regular duration
PATO:0001416.def: a duration which has regular start and/or end times.

PATO:0001417.name: irregular duration
PATO:0001417.def: a duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's duration which has irregular start and/or end times.

PATO:0001418.name: lethargic
PATO:0001418.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being deficient in alertness or activity.

PATO:0001419.name: sharp
PATO:0001419.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating in a point or edge.

PATO:0001420.name: buoyancy
PATO:0001420.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to rise or float in a fluid medium such as water or air.

PATO:0001421.name: alive
PATO:0001421.def: a viability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's condition before death.

PATO:0001422.name: dead
PATO:0001422.def: a viability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the cessation of the bearer's life.

PATO:0001423.name: refractile
PATO:0001423.def: a reflectivity quality inhering in the bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to refract light.

PATO:0001424.name: violet
PATO:0001424.def: a color hue with very low wavelength of that portion of the visible spectrum lying between reddish blue or bluish purple, evoked in the human observer by radiant energy with wavelengths of approximately 420 to 380 nanometers.

PATO:0001425.name: rosy
PATO:0001425.def: a color hue consisting of red hue and yellow hue and high brightness.

PATO:0001426.name: maroon
PATO:0001426.def: a color consisting of purple and brown hue.

PATO:0001427.name: compound acidity
PATO:0001427.def: a concentration quality inhering in compound by virtue of the bearer's tendency to act as a hydron donor.

PATO:0001428.name: medium acidity
PATO:0001428.def: a concentration quality inhering in a medium by virtue of the bearer's tendency to hydronate a specific reference base.

PATO:0001429.name: acidic
PATO:0001429.def: an medium acidity quality inhering in a solution by virtue of the bearer's a high concentration of h+ ions.

PATO:0001430.name: alkaline
PATO:0001430.def: an medium acidity quality inhering in a solution by virtue of the bearer's a low concentration of h+ ions.

PATO:0001431.name: adhesivity
PATO:0001431.def: an emergent molecular quality that arises by virtue of the bearer's disposition to exhibit molecular attraction to another entity in contact.

PATO:0001432.name: decayed
PATO:0001432.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decomposition into component parts.

PATO:0001433.name: growth quality of occurrent
PATO:0001433.def: a quality of a single process which describes the growth of an organism, structure, or group of organisms.

PATO:0001434.name: reproductive quality
PATO:0001434.def: an organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to produce new life or offspring.

PATO:0001435.name: attachment quality
PATO:0001435.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having connection or association with another entity.

PATO:0001436.name: sessile (sensu botany)
PATO:0001436.def: an attachment quality inhering in a flower by virtue of the bearer's lacking a stalk, as in flowers or leaves that grow directly from the stem.

PATO:0001437.name: sessile (sensu zoology)
PATO:0001437.def: a attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability to move about.

PATO:0001438.name: pedicellate
PATO:0001438.def: a attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or being supported by a pedicel or pedicle.

PATO:0001439.name: tonicity
PATO:0001439.def: a contractile quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's elastic tension that facilitate response to stimuli.

PATO:0001440.name: homophilic
PATO:0001440.def: a cellular adhesivity quality inhering in a molecule in one cell by virtue of the bearer's attachment to an identical molecule in an adjacent cell.

PATO:0001441.name: heterophilic
PATO:0001441.def: a cellular adhesivity quality inhering in a molecule in one cell by virtue of the bearer's attachment to an nonidentical molecule in an adjacent cell.

PATO:0001442.name: wholeness
PATO:0001442.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer includes all its components.

PATO:0001444.name: broken
PATO:0001444.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's components no longer being in a single contiguous unit.

PATO:0001445.name: disassembled
PATO:0001445.def: a wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being taken apart into its constituent parts.

PATO:0001446.name: whole
PATO:0001446.def: a wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's including all its components.

PATO:0001447.name: calcified
PATO:0001447.def: a composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's being encrusted or impregnated with calcium carbonate (chebi:3311).

PATO:0001448.name: ossified
PATO:0001448.def: a composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's being hardened by the deposition of calcium into bone.

PATO:0001449.name: cartilaginous
PATO:0001449.def: a composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's cartilage quantities.

PATO:0001450.name: edematous
PATO:0001450.def: a structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits an excessive accumulation of extracellular fluid.

PATO:0001451.name: obsolete edematous (sensu botany)
PATO:0001451.def: an extended swelling in plant organs caused primarily by an excessive accumulation of water.

PATO:0001453.name: detached from
PATO:0001453.def: an attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking connection or association with another entity.

PATO:0001454.name: sensitivity to oxygen
PATO:0001454.def: a sensitivity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's dependence on oxygen.

PATO:0001455.name: aerobic
PATO:0001455.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's dependence on oxygen.

PATO:0001456.name: anaerobic
PATO:0001456.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's independence on oxygen.

PATO:0001457.name: sensitivity of a process
PATO:0001457.def: a quality of a process inhering in bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to respond to stimulation.

PATO:0001458.name: sensitivity of a process to oxygen
PATO:0001458.def: a sensitivity of a process quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's unfolding in a location with or without oxygen.

PATO:0001459.name: aerobic (for occurrence)
PATO:0001459.def: a sensitivity of a process inhering in a biological process by virtue of the process unfolding in a location with oxygen.

PATO:0001460.name: anaerobic (for occurrence)
PATO:0001460.def: a sensitivity of a process inhering in a biological process by virtue of the process unfolding in a location without oxygen.

PATO:0001461.name: surface tension
PATO:0001461.def: a physical quality inhering in a liquid by virtue of the bearer's ability to attraction of molecules at its surface as a result of unbalanced molecular cohesive forces.

PATO:0001462.name: membrane potential
PATO:0001462.def: a quality inhering in a cell's plasma membrane by virtue of the electrical potential difference across it.

PATO:0001463.name: action potential
PATO:0001463.def: a quality inhering in a cell's plasma membrane by virtue of a brief fluctuation in the bearer's potential caused by the rapid opening and closing of voltage-gated ion channels.

PATO:0001464.name: electric potential
PATO:0001464.def: a quality that is equal to the potential energy per unit charge associated with a static (time-invariant) electric field, also called the electrostatic potential.

PATO:0001465.name: monstrous
PATO:0001465.def: a malformed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's all-encompassing, grotesque morphological defects.

PATO:0001466.name: curved rostral
PATO:0001466.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the front of an organism.

PATO:0001467.name: curved caudal
PATO:0001467.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the part of the body from which the tail arises.

PATO:0001468.name: curved dorsal
PATO:0001468.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0001469.name: curved ventral
PATO:0001469.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0001470.name: proportionality to
PATO:0001470.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's magnitude in respect to a related entity.

PATO:0001472.name: decreased depth
PATO:0001472.def: a depth which is relatively low.

PATO:0001473.name: duplicated
PATO:0001473.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in two copies.

PATO:0001474.name: anteverted
PATO:0001474.def: an oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's axis being positioned forward.

PATO:0001475.name: increased position
PATO:0001475.def: a position which is relatively high.

PATO:0001476.name: decreased position
PATO:0001476.def: a positional which is relatively low.

PATO:0001477.name: retracted
PATO:0001477.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being drawn in or pulled back from any given point.

PATO:0001478.name: collapsed
PATO:0001478.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being broken down; caved in.

PATO:0001480.name: spongy
PATO:0001480.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a sponge in elasticity, absorbency, or porousness.

PATO:0001481.name: sloped
PATO:0001481.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an oblique or slanted direction.

PATO:0001482.name: prominent
PATO:0001482.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's standing out or projecting beyond a surface or line.

PATO:0001483.name: aplastic
PATO:0001483.def: absence of an organ, tissue or cell due to failure to develop from a primordium or precursor cell.

PATO:0001484.name: recent
PATO:0001484.def: a quality of a process which occurs near to or not long before the present.

PATO:0001485.name: condensed
PATO:0001485.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being thicker or more closely packed together; pressed tightly together.

PATO:0001486.name: chronological age
PATO:0001486.def: an age quality that exists by virtue of the time (years and months) that the bearer has existed.

PATO:0001487.name: senescent
PATO:0001487.def: a time quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's growing old; aging.

PATO:0001488.name: cellular motility
PATO:0001488.def: a cellular quality inhering in a cell by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability to move spontaneously.

PATO:0001490.name: heterochronic growth
PATO:0001490.def: a growth quality of a process inhering in an organism, structure, or group of organisms by virtue of the bearer's reduced or increased growth.

PATO:0001491.name: neotenous growth
PATO:0001491.def: a paedomorphic growth quality which is due to a reduced rate.

PATO:0001492.name: growth rate
PATO:0001492.def: the rate or speed of the change in size of an individual entity or change in number of a population.

PATO:0001495.name: notched
PATO:0001495.def: a concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape being a v-shaped cut.

PATO:0001496.name: brood quality
PATO:0001496.def: a reproductive quality inhering in the young of an animal by virtue of the bearer's being cared for at one time.

PATO:0001497.name: brood viability
PATO:0001497.def: a reproductive quality inhering in the young of an animal by virtue of the bearer's disposition to survive and develop normally.

PATO:0001499.name: spherical
PATO:0001499.def: a spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a ball (a sphere whose equatorial diameter is equal to the polar diameter).

PATO:0001500.name: tapered
PATO:0001500.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being gradually narrower or thinner toward one end.

PATO:0001501.name: immature
PATO:0001501.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking complete growth, differentiation, or development.

PATO:0001502.name: complexity
PATO:0001502.def: a monadic quality of continuant inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being intricate and compounded.

PATO:0001503.name: simple
PATO:0001503.def: a complexity quality in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having few parts or being complicated or compound.

PATO:0001504.name: complex
PATO:0001504.def: a complexity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being intricate and compounded.

PATO:0001505.name: separated from
PATO:0001505.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being in contact with another entity, or of no longer being connected or joined with another entity.

PATO:0001506.name: diastatic
PATO:0001506.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's separation of normally joined parts, such as the separation of adjacent bones without fracture or of certain abdominal muscles during pregnancy.

PATO:0001507.name: disrupted
PATO:0001507.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being interrupted of its normal course.

PATO:0001509.name: functionality
PATO:0001509.def: a quality of a single physical entity that arises by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001510.name: functional
PATO:0001510.def: a functionality quality held by the bearer when the latter is able to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001511.name: non-functional
PATO:0001511.def: a disfunctional quality held by the bearer when the latter is unable to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001512.name: punctate
PATO:0001512.def: a pattern inhering in a surface by virtue of the bearer's being marked by the presence of dots, punctures, points or pits.

PATO:0001514.name: delaminated
PATO:0001514.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking some outer layer.

PATO:0001515.name: variable color
PATO:0001515.def: a color quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being uneven in color.

PATO:0001516.name: focus
PATO:0001516.def: an optical quality where light rays originating from a point on the object converge.

PATO:0001517.name: focused
PATO:0001517.def: an optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having focus.

PATO:0001518.name: blurry
PATO:0001518.def: an optical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking focus.

PATO:0001519.name: sound quality
PATO:0001519.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of vibration, as perceived by the sense of hearing.

PATO:0001521.name: sound amplitude
PATO:0001521.def: a physical quality inhering in a sound wave by virtue of the maximum magnitude (value without regard to sign) of its disturbance.

PATO:0001522.name: sound speed
PATO:0001522.def: a physical quality inhering in sound by virtue of the bearer's travelling speed in a given medium under specified conditions.

PATO:0001523.name: sound wavelength
PATO:0001523.def: a physical quality which is equal to the quotient of the speed of a sound wave divided by its wavelength.

PATO:0001524.name: intrasonic
PATO:0001524.def: a sound frequency in the range of 0-20 hz.

PATO:0001525.name: sonic
PATO:0001525.def: a sound frequency in the range of 20 to 20.000 hz.

PATO:0001526.name: ultrasonic
PATO:0001526.def: a sound frequency in the range of 20 000 + hz.

PATO:0001527.name: quiet
PATO:0001527.def: a sound amplitude which is relatively low.

PATO:0001528.name: loud
PATO:0001528.def: a sound amplitude which is relatively high.

PATO:0001529.name: cellular spatiotemporal quality
PATO:0001529.def: a spatiotemporal quality inhering in a cell.

PATO:0001530.name: behavioral quality of a process
PATO:0001530.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's behavior.

PATO:0001531.name: cellular adhesivity
PATO:0001531.def: a cellular quality that exists by virtue of the disposition of the cell to adhere to other cells and molecules, through the emergent action of the molecular parts of the cell surface.

PATO:0001532.name: mono-colored
PATO:0001532.def: a color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one hue.

PATO:0001533.name: multi-colored
PATO:0001533.def: a color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's having two or more hues or degrees of saturation.

PATO:0001534.name: motley
PATO:0001534.def: a color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's having 3 or more hues or degrees of saturations.

PATO:0001535.name: dappled
PATO:0001535.def: a color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's being marked with small spots, patches, or specks of hue or degree of saturation differing from that of the background.

PATO:0001536.name: solubility
PATO:0001536.def: a molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the bearer's disposition to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001537.name: soluble in
PATO:0001537.def: a solubility quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the bearer's disposition to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001538.name: insoluble in
PATO:0001538.def: a solubility quality inhering in a substance by virtue of the bearer's inability of a substance to dissolve in a liquid.

PATO:0001539.name: amylose composition
PATO:0001539.def: a compositional quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's quantities or relative ratios of amylose of the inhering entity.

PATO:0001540.name: glutinous
PATO:0001540.def: an amylose composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's having negligible or no amylose content.

PATO:0001541.name: non-glutinous
PATO:0001541.def: an amylose composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's having high amount of amylose content.

PATO:0001542.name: delayed phase
PATO:0001542.def: a phase which starts later than natural start point.

PATO:0001543.name: flexibility
PATO:0001543.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

PATO:0001544.name: flexible
PATO:0001544.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability of being turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

PATO:0001545.name: inflexible
PATO:0001545.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's inability of being turned, bowed, or twisted without breaking.

PATO:0001546.name: quality of a solid
PATO:0001546.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the physical characteristics of an entity characterized by particles arranged such that their shape and volume are relatively stable.

PATO:0001547.name: quality of a gas
PATO:0001547.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the physical characteristics of an entity consisting of particles that have neither a defined volume nor defined shape.

PATO:0001548.name: quality of a liquid
PATO:0001548.def: a physical quality inhering in an entity exhibiting the physical characteristics of an amorphous (non-crystalline) form of matter between a gas and a solid that has a definite volume, but no definite shape.

PATO:0001549.name: increased sensitivity toward
PATO:0001549.def: a sensitivity toward an external stimulus which is higher than normal/average.

PATO:0001550.name: decreased sensitivity toward
PATO:0001550.def: a sensitivity toward an external stimulus which is lower than normal/average.

PATO:0001551.name: increased sensitivity of a process
PATO:0001551.def: a sensitivity of a process which is higher than normal or average.

PATO:0001552.name: decreased sensitivity of a process
PATO:0001552.def: a sensitivity of a process which is lower than normal or average.

PATO:0001553.name: increased sensitivity of a process to oxygen
PATO:0001553.def: a sensitivity of occurrent to oxygen which is higher than normal or average.
PATO:0001553.synonym: high sensitivity of occurrent to oxygen

PATO:0001554.name: decreased sensitivity of a process to oxygen
PATO:0001554.def: a sensitivity of a process to oxygen which is lower than normal or average.
PATO:0001554.synonym: low sensitivity of occurrent to oxygen

PATO:0001555.name: has number of
PATO:0001555.def: the number of parts of a particular type that the bearer entity has. this is a relational quality, and thus holds between two entities: the bearer of the quality, and the type of parts.

PATO:0001558.name: lacking processual parts
PATO:0001558.def: a quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a processual part as specified by the additional entity.

PATO:0001559.name: having extra function
PATO:0001559.def: a functionality quality which is held by the bearer when the latter is able to perform additional or different function(s).

PATO:0001561.name: having extra processual parts
PATO:0001561.def: a quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having additional processual parts.

PATO:0001562.name: decreased mass
PATO:0001562.def: a mass which is lower than normal or average.

PATO:0001563.name: increased mass
PATO:0001563.def: a mass which is higher than normal or average.

PATO:0001564.name: extra or missing processual parts
PATO:0001564.def: a quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's processual parts.

PATO:0001566.name: distributed
PATO:0001566.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being spread out or scattered about or divided up.

PATO:0001567.name: undistributed
PATO:0001567.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not being spread out or scattered about or divided up.

PATO:0001570.name: having decreased processual parts
PATO:0001570.def: a quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having fewer processual parts.

PATO:0001571.name: dilated
PATO:0001571.def: a size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being made wider or larger in all dimensions.

PATO:0001573.name: isometrical
PATO:0001573.def: a symmetry quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having equal dimensions or measurements.

PATO:0001574.name: flow rate
PATO:0001574.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's motion characteristic.

PATO:0001575.name: decreased pressure
PATO:0001575.def: a pressure which is relatively low.

PATO:0001576.name: increased pressure
PATO:0001576.def: a pressure which is relatively high.

PATO:0001577.name: increased permeability
PATO:0001577.def: a permeability which is relatively high.

PATO:0001578.name: decreased permeability
PATO:0001578.def: a permeability which is relatively low.

PATO:0001579.name: contractility
PATO:0001579.def: a physical quality that is the ability to contract or shrink.

PATO:0001580.name: increased contractility
PATO:0001580.def: a contractility which is relatively high.

PATO:0001581.name: decreased contractility
PATO:0001581.def: a contractility which is relatively low.

PATO:0001582.name: obsolete relaxational quality
PATO:0001582.def: a spatial quality inhering in an inactive muscle or muscle fibers by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting gradual lengthening.

PATO:0001583.name: decreased variability
PATO:0001583.def: a variability which is relatively low.

PATO:0001584.name: increased variability
PATO:0001584.def: a variability which is relatively high.

PATO:0001585.name: conductivity
PATO:0001585.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to transmit of an entity through a medium.

PATO:0001586.name: variability of rate
PATO:0001586.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits rate variation or change.

PATO:0001587.name: increased variability of rate
PATO:0001587.def: a variability of rate which is relatively high.

PATO:0001588.name: decreased variability of rate
PATO:0001588.def: a variability of rate which is relatively low.

PATO:0001590.name: overlap with
PATO:0001590.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's coinciding spatially, partially or wholly with another entity.

PATO:0001591.name: curvature
PATO:0001591.def: a surface shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a degree of bending.

PATO:0001592.name: increased curvature
PATO:0001592.def: a curvature which is relatively high.

PATO:0001593.name: decreased curvature
PATO:0001593.def: a curvature which is relatively low.

PATO:0001594.name: arched
PATO:0001594.def: a concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming or resembling an arch.

PATO:0001595.name: depth
PATO:0001595.def: a 1-d extent quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's downward or backward or inward dimension.

PATO:0001596.name: increased depth
PATO:0001596.def: a depth quality which is relatively high.

PATO:0001597.name: everted
PATO:0001597.def: an oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being turned outward in placement.

PATO:0001598.name: protruding
PATO:0001598.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's extending out above or beyond a surface or boundary.

PATO:0001599.name: rotated
PATO:0001599.def: an oriented quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being relocated around an axis.

PATO:0001600.name: posteriorly rotated
PATO:0001600.def: a rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the rear of organism.

PATO:0001601.name: anteriorly rotated
PATO:0001601.def: a rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the front of an organism.

PATO:0001602.name: distended
PATO:0001602.def: a size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormally expanded or increased in size.

PATO:0001603.name: increased life span
PATO:0001603.def: a life span which is relatively high.

PATO:0001604.name: decreased life span
PATO:0001604.def: a life span which is relatively low.

PATO:0001605.name: disheveled
PATO:0001605.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in disarray; extremely disorderly.

PATO:0001606.name: greasy
PATO:0001606.def: a coating which is oily and slippery.

PATO:0001607.name: matted
PATO:0001607.def: a tangled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being not possible to unravel.

PATO:0001608.name: patchy
PATO:0001608.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by, consisting of, or diversified with patches.

PATO:0001609.name: sparse
PATO:0001609.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being scattered; spread irregularly, and at a distance from each other.

PATO:0001611.name: variability of color
PATO:0001611.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits color variation or change.

PATO:0001612.name: increased variability of color
PATO:0001612.def: a variability of color which is relatively high.

PATO:0001613.name: decreased variability of color
PATO:0001613.def: a variability of color which is relatively low.

PATO:0001614.name: invariant color
PATO:0001614.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation of color.

PATO:0001615.name: variant color
PATO:0001615.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or exhibiting variation of colour.

PATO:0001617.name: deformed
PATO:0001617.def: a morphological quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being distorted in form.

PATO:0001618.name: increased tonicity
PATO:0001618.def: a tonicity which is relatively high.

PATO:0001619.name: decreased tonicity
PATO:0001619.def: a tonicity which is relatively low.

PATO:0001620.name: turgor
PATO:0001620.def: a structural quality inhering in a cell or blood vessel or capillary by virtue of the bearer's being in a rigid state of fullness resulting from pressure of the contents against the wall or membrane.

PATO:0001621.name: decreased turgor
PATO:0001621.def: a turgor which is relatively low.

PATO:0001622.name: increased turgor
PATO:0001622.def: a turgor which is relatively high.

PATO:0001623.name: atrophied
PATO:0001623.def: a size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of a part or parts of the bearer's being decreased in size due to reduction in tissue mass through wasting.

PATO:0001624.name: decreased functionality
PATO:0001624.def: a functionality quality held by the bearer when the latter exhibits decreased ability to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001625.name: increased functionality
PATO:0001625.def: a functional quality held by the bearer when the latter exhibits increased ability to perform a regular function(s).

PATO:0001626.name: sufficiency
PATO:0001626.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer has enough functionality.

PATO:0001627.name: sufficient
PATO:0001627.def: a wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's has enough functionality.

PATO:0001628.name: insufficient
PATO:0001628.def: a wholeness quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacks enough functionality.

PATO:0001629.name: aggregated
PATO:0001629.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being gathered or tending to gather into a mass or whole.

PATO:0001630.name: dispersed
PATO:0001630.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being distributed or spread over a considerable extent.

PATO:0001632.name: anterior to
PATO:0001632.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the front of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001633.name: posterior to
PATO:0001633.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001634.name: necessity (continuant)
PATO:0001634.def: a quality of a single physical entity inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer is essential or indispensable.

PATO:0001635.name: necessary (continuant)
PATO:0001635.def: a necessity quality (continuant) inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being essential or indispensable.

PATO:0001636.name: unnecessary (continuant)
PATO:0001636.def: a necessity quality (continuant) inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being non-essential or dispensable.

PATO:0001637.name: necessity of occurrent
PATO:0001637.def: a quality of single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer is essential or indispensable.

PATO:0001638.name: necessary (occurrent)
PATO:0001638.def: a necessity quality inhering in a process by virtue of the bearer's being essential or indispensable.

PATO:0001639.name: unnecessary (occurrent)
PATO:0001639.def: a necessity quality inhering in a process by virtue of the bearer's being non-essential or dispensable.

PATO:0001643.name: stubby
PATO:0001643.def: a size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a short, stocky build.

PATO:0001645.name: protruding into
PATO:0001645.def: a quality inhering into a bearer by virtue of the bearer's extending out above or beyond its surface or boundary into the surface or boundary of another entity.

PATO:0001646.name: protruding out of
PATO:0001646.def: a quality inhering into a bearer by virtue of the bearer's extending out above or beyond its surface or boundary and outwards in relation to the physical space occupied by another entity.

PATO:0001648.name: circumference
PATO:0001648.def: an 1-d extent quality which is equal to the length of the closed curve of a circle.

PATO:0001649.name: curved lateral
PATO:0001649.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the side.

PATO:0001650.name: increased resistance to
PATO:0001650.def: a resistance to a stimulus which is relatively high.

PATO:0001651.name: decreased resistance to
PATO:0001651.def: a resistance to a stimulus which is relatively low.

PATO:0001652.name: alignment
PATO:0001652.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's spatial positioning with respect to an additional entity.

PATO:0001653.name: aligned with
PATO:0001653.def: an alignment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in a proper spatial positioning with respect to an additional entity.

PATO:0001654.name: misaligned with
PATO:0001654.def: an alignment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in a improper spatial positioning with respect to an additional entity.

PATO:0001655.name: osmolarity
PATO:0001655.def: a concentration quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's amount of osmoles of solute per liter of solution.
