PATO:0001866.def: a spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a polar diameter longer than its equatorial diameter.

PATO:0001867.name: rectangular
PATO:0001867.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of it being a quadrilateral polygon in which all four angles are right angles.

PATO:0001868.name: autofluorescence
PATO:0001868.def: a fluorescence quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting fluorescence which is self-induced.

PATO:0001869.name: pathological
PATO:0001869.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being abnormal and having a destructive effect on living tissue.

PATO:0001870.name: crescent-shaped
PATO:0001870.def: a shape quality inhering in a circular disk by virtue of the bearer's having a segment of another circle removed from its edge, so that what remains is a shape enclosed by two circular arcs of different diameters which intersect at two points (usually in such a manner that the enclosed shape does not include the center of the original circle).

PATO:0001871.name: reniform
PATO:0001871.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the shape of a kidney.

PATO:0001872.name: cuboid
PATO:0001872.def: a convex 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resemblance to a cube (a 3-d shape with a square cross section).

PATO:0001873.name: cylindrical
PATO:0001873.def: a convex 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a consistently-sized round cross section.

PATO:0001874.name: discoid
PATO:0001874.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being cylindrical, in which the height is less than the diameter.

PATO:0001875.name: triangular
PATO:0001875.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three angles.

PATO:0001876.name: dumbbell-shaped
PATO:0001876.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two parts, roughly spherical and of equal size, connected by a bar.

PATO:0001877.name: lanceolate
PATO:0001877.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a lance-head, considerably longer than wide, tapering towards the tip from below the middle; attached at the broad end.

PATO:0001878.name: sigmoid
PATO:0001878.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of two curves, in opposite directions. s-shaped.

PATO:0001879.name: u-shaped
PATO:0001879.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter u.

PATO:0001880.name: caudate
PATO:0001880.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a tail or tail-like projection.

PATO:0001881.name: arrow-shaped
PATO:0001881.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming two equal obtuse triangles with a short side in common.

PATO:0001882.name: limaciform
PATO:0001882.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a slug.

PATO:0001883.name: clavate
PATO:0001883.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gradually becoming thicker towards the end.

PATO:0001884.name: hydrophobicity
PATO:0001884.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's disposition to being water-repellent; tending to repel and not absorb water.

PATO:0001885.name: hydrophobic
PATO:0001885.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking affinity for water; tending to repel and not absorb water; tending not to dissolve in or mix with or be wetted by water.

PATO:0001886.name: hydrophilicity
PATO:0001886.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's disposition to having an affinity for water; it is readily absorbing or dissolving in water.

PATO:0001887.name: hydrophilic
PATO:0001887.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to having a strong affinity for water; tending to dissolve in, mix with, or be wetted by water.

PATO:0001888.name: miscibility
PATO:0001888.def: a quality of a liquid inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to mix with (dissolve in) another liquid.

PATO:0001889.name: scalloped
PATO:0001889.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the border, edge, or outline cut into a series of segments of circles resembling a scallop-shell.

PATO:0001890.name: tripartite
PATO:0001890.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into three branches.

PATO:0001891.name: ovate
PATO:0001891.def: a spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a continuous convex surface with an axis of symmetry and one axis longer than the other; egg-shaped.

PATO:0001892.name: decreased odor
PATO:0001892.def: an odor quality of having decreased odor.

PATO:0001893.name: increased odor
PATO:0001893.def: an odor quality of having increased odor.

PATO:0001894.name: phenotypic sex
PATO:0001894.def: an organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's physical expression of sexual characteristics.

PATO:0001895.name: mating type
PATO:0001895.def: a biological sex quality inhering in an individual or a population that undergo sexual reproduction.

PATO:0001896.name: unlumenized
PATO:0001896.def: a structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking of a three dimensional space surrounded by one or more anatomical structures and containing one or more anatomical substances.

PATO:0001897.name: lumenized
PATO:0001897.def: a structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a three dimensional space surrounded by one or more anatomical structures and containing one or more anatomical substances.

PATO:0001898.name: increased circumference
PATO:0001898.def: a circumference which is relatively high.

PATO:0001899.name: decreased circumference
PATO:0001899.def: a circumference which is relatively low.

PATO:0001900.name: front
PATO:0001900.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction that is similar to the direction of an object to the south when it faces north.

PATO:0001901.name: back
PATO:0001901.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction that is similar to the direction of an object to the north when it faces south.

PATO:0001902.name: unidirectional
PATO:0001902.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having one direction only.

PATO:0001903.name: bi-directional
PATO:0001903.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two directions.

PATO:0001904.name: circling direction
PATO:0001904.def: a directional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's direction approximating the shape of a circle.

PATO:0001905.name: has normal numbers of parts of type
PATO:0001905.def: the bearer of this quality has_part = n, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part.

PATO:0001906.name: movement quality
PATO:0001906.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's participation in movement.

PATO:0001907.name: botryoidal
PATO:0001907.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being like the surface of a compact mass of grapes.

PATO:0001908.name: multinucleate
PATO:0001908.def: a nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having more than one nucleus.

PATO:0001909.name: trinucleate
PATO:0001909.def: a nucleate quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three nuclei.

PATO:0001910.name: folded
PATO:0001910.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's one part being layered over another connected part.

PATO:0001911.name: circling
PATO:0001911.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting movement in a circular course.

PATO:0001912.name: physiological state
PATO:0001912.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the state of bearer's mechanical, physical, and biochemical processes.

PATO:0001913.name: ictal
PATO:0001913.def: a physiological state which is characterized by periods of high-frequency high amplitude electrical activity in neuronal tissue.

PATO:0001914.name: non-ictal
PATO:0001914.def: a physiological state which is characterized by normal electrical activity in neuronal tissue.

PATO:0001915.name: anterodorsal to
PATO:0001915.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the front and upper surface of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001916.name: posterodorsal to
PATO:0001916.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear and upper surface of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001917.name: anteroventral to
PATO:0001917.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the front and abdomen of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001918.name: posteroventral to
PATO:0001918.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located toward the rear and abdomen of an organism relative to another entity.

PATO:0001919.name: mislocalised dorsally
PATO:0001919.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0001920.name: mislocalised ventrally
PATO:0001920.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0001921.name: mislocalised anteriorly
PATO:0001921.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the front of an organism.

PATO:0001922.name: mislocalised posteriorly
PATO:0001922.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the rear of an organism.

PATO:0001923.name: mislocalised laterally
PATO:0001923.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the side of an organism.

PATO:0001924.name: mislocalised medially
PATO:0001924.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards the middle of an organism.

PATO:0001925.name: surface feature shape
PATO:0001925.def: a surface shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape of features present on its surface or outer shell.

PATO:0001926.name: increased fluorescence
PATO:0001926.def: a fluorescence which is higher than normal.

PATO:0001927.name: decreased fluorescence
PATO:0001927.def: a fluorescence which is lower than normal.

PATO:0001928.name: blistered
PATO:0001928.def: a texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of a local accumulation of fluid underneath the surface of the bearer.

PATO:0001929.name: variability of shape
PATO:0001929.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits shape variation or change.

PATO:0001930.name: variant shape
PATO:0001930.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's having or exhibiting variation its shape.

PATO:0001931.name: invariant shape
PATO:0001931.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking or not exhibiting variation of shape.

PATO:0001932.name: alternate placement
PATO:0001932.def: a pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being placed alternately one above the other.

PATO:0001933.name: opposite
PATO:0001933.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned on opposite sides on the same plane.

PATO:0001934.name: orbicular
PATO:0001934.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being perfectly circular.

PATO:0001935.name: obtuse
PATO:0001935.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being roundish, a little inclining to be oblong.

PATO:0001936.name: obovate
PATO:0001936.def: a spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being egg-shaped and flat, with the narrow end attached to the base.

PATO:0001937.name: spatulate
PATO:0001937.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being oblong, with the lower end very much attenuated.

PATO:0001938.name: rhomboid
PATO:0001938.def: a spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being oval and a little angular in the middle.

PATO:0001940.name: gigantic
PATO:0001940.def: a size quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being many folds greater relative to the normal average.

PATO:0001941.name: yellow green
PATO:0001941.def: a color consisting of yellow and green hues.

PATO:0001942.name: brown green
PATO:0001942.def: a color consisting of brown and green hues.

PATO:0001943.name: lilac
PATO:0001943.def: a purple color which has low saturation and low brightness.

PATO:0001944.name: yellow orange
PATO:0001944.def: a color consisting of yellow and orange hue.

PATO:0001945.name: ochre
PATO:0001945.def: a moderate yellow-orange to orange color.

PATO:0001946.name: banded
PATO:0001946.def: a color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's exhibiting transverse stripes of one hue or degree of saturation crossing another.

PATO:0001947.name: netted
PATO:0001947.def: a color pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of bearer's being covered with reticulated lines of a different hue or degree of saturation.

PATO:0001948.name: furrowed
PATO:0001948.def: a grooved texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by two or more parallel channels.

PATO:0001949.name: pointleted
PATO:0001949.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating abruptly in a little point.

PATO:0001950.name: blunt
PATO:0001950.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating gradually in a rounded end.

PATO:0001951.name: whorled
PATO:0001951.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in opposition round a common axis.

PATO:0001952.name: distichous
PATO:0001952.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being arranged in two opposite rows (and hence in the same plane).

PATO:0001953.name: decussate
PATO:0001953.def: a pattern quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of paired parts that alternately cross each other.

PATO:0001954.name: subulate
PATO:0001954.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being linear, very narrow, tapering to a very fine point from a narrow base.

PATO:0001955.name: cuneate
PATO:0001955.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being narrowly triangular, wider at the apex and tapering toward the base.

PATO:0001956.name: variability of size
PATO:0001956.def: a variability quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits size variation or change.

PATO:0001957.name: decreased variability of size
PATO:0001957.def: a variability of size which is relatively low.

PATO:0001958.name: increased variability of size
PATO:0001958.def: a variability of size which is relatively high.

PATO:0001959.name: defasciculated
PATO:0001959.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's in which bundles of aligned anatomical fibers have become separated.

PATO:0001960.name: interdigitated
PATO:0001960.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's parts or projections being interlocked; for example, the fingers of two hands that are clasped.

PATO:0001961.name: in contact with
PATO:0001961.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's touching another entity.

PATO:0001962.name: involute
PATO:0001962.def: a curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled inwards spirally on each side.

PATO:0001963.name: revolute
PATO:0001963.def: a curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled backwards spirally on each side.

PATO:0001964.name: circinate
PATO:0001964.def: a curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being rolled spirally downwards.

PATO:0001965.name: reclinate
PATO:0001965.def: a curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's edges of its surface being bent down upon their stalk.

PATO:0001966.name: convolute
PATO:0001966.def: a curled quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's one edge of its surface being wholly rolled up in another.

PATO:0001967.name: actinodromous
PATO:0001967.def: a branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having three or more primary branches diverging radially from a single point.

PATO:0001968.name: parallelodromous
PATO:0001968.def: a branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two or more parallel primary branches originate beside each other and converge apically.

PATO:0001969.name: craspedodromous
PATO:0001969.def: a branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches terminating at the margin.

PATO:0001970.name: brochidodromous
PATO:0001970.def: a branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches joined together in a series of prominent arches.

PATO:0001971.name: cladodromous
PATO:0001971.def: a branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches freely branching toward the margin.

PATO:0001972.name: reticulodromous
PATO:0001972.def: a branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having secondary branches branching into a reticulum toward the margin.

PATO:0001973.name: cuspidate
PATO:0001973.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being tapering gradually into a rigid point.

PATO:0001974.name: retuse
PATO:0001974.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's terminating in a round end, the centre of which is depressed.

PATO:0001975.name: unserrated
PATO:0001975.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking sharp straight-edged teeth pointing to the apex.

PATO:0001976.name: serration
PATO:0001976.def: a surface feature shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having or lacking sharp straight-edged teeth pointing to the apex.

PATO:0001977.name: angular
PATO:0001977.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having at least one salient angle on the margin.

PATO:0001978.name: cut
PATO:0001978.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being regularly divided by deep incisions.

PATO:0001979.name: lobed
PATO:0001979.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being partly divided into a determinate number of regions.

PATO:0001980.name: digitate
PATO:0001980.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having distinct parts arising from a common point or center.

PATO:0001981.name: auriculate
PATO:0001981.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape resembling an ear.

PATO:0001982.name: attenuate
PATO:0001982.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's gradually tapering to a slender point.

PATO:0001983.name: perfoliate
PATO:0001983.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's two basal lobes being united together.

PATO:0001984.name: decurrent
PATO:0001984.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being prolonged below the point of insertion.

PATO:0001985.name: frozen
PATO:0001985.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being kept below its freezing point.

PATO:0001986.name: dissolved
PATO:0001986.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's passing into solution.

PATO:0001987.name: saccular
PATO:0001987.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a three dimensional cavity with a narrow or no opening, and often containing an anatomical substance.

PATO:0001988.name: quadrangular
PATO:0001988.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having four angles and four sides.

PATO:0001989.name: sinuous
PATO:0001989.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having many curves and turns.

PATO:0001990.name: duration of disease
PATO:0001990.def: a duration quality of a process inhering in a disease by virtue of the bearer's duration of an impairment of health or of a condition of abnormal functioning.

PATO:0001991.name: immortal
PATO:0001991.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being capable of indefinite growth or division.

PATO:0001992.name: cellularity
PATO:0001992.def: an organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting cells.

PATO:0001993.name: multicellular
PATO:0001993.def: a cellularity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of more than one cell.

PATO:0001994.name: unicellular
PATO:0001994.def: a cellularity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of exactly one cell.

PATO:0001995.name: organismal quality
PATO:0001995.def: a quality that inheres in an entire organism or part of an organism.

PATO:0001997.name: decreased amount
PATO:0001997.def: an amount which is relatively low.

PATO:0001998.name: conspicuousness
PATO:0001998.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its visibility.

PATO:0001999.name: lacks parts or has fewer parts of type
PATO:0001999.def: the bearer of this quality has_part < n of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part. formally: if a bearer entity e has fewer parts of type x at time t, then the number of instances x of x at t such that x part_of e is < n, where n is either the normal number for comparable entities, or n is stated explicitly. this case includes the limit case, where the bearer lacks all parts of the specified type.

PATO:0002000.name: lacks all parts of type
PATO:0002000.def: a quality of physical entities inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a physical part as specified by the additional entity.
PATO:0002000.synonym: lacks all physical parts of type

PATO:0002001.name: has fewer parts of type
PATO:0002001.def: the bearer of this quality has_part < n and has_part > 0 of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part. formally: if a bearer entity e has fewer parts of type x at time t, then the number of instances x of x at t such that x part_of e is < n, where n is either the normal number for comparable entities, or n is stated explicitly.
PATO:0002001.synonym: has fewer physical parts of type

PATO:0002002.name: has extra parts of type
PATO:0002002.def: the bearer of this quality has_part > n of the indicated entity type, where n is the normal amount for a comparable organism. note that the bearer of the quality is the whole, not the part.

PATO:0002003.name: population quality
PATO:0002003.def: a quality that inheres in an entire population or part of a population.

PATO:0002004.name: obsolete surface shape
PATO:0002004.def: a shape that inheres in a part of a surface. an object can have different surface shapes on different parts of its surface.

PATO:0002005.name: concavity
PATO:0002005.def: surface shape that refers to the inward or outward curvature of the surface.

PATO:0002006.name: 2-d shape
PATO:0002006.def: a shape that inheres in a 2 dimensional entity, such as a cross section or projection of a 3 dimensional entity.

PATO:0002007.name: convex 3-d shape
PATO:0002007.def: a complete three dimensional shape in which for every line connecting pair of points on the object is within the object. or: a shape lacking cavities. contrast: concave.

PATO:0002008.name: concave 3-d shape
PATO:0002008.def: a complete three dimensional shape in which there is a line connecting pair of points on the object that lies outside the object. or: a shape with cavities. contrast: concave.

PATO:0002009.name: branchiness
PATO:0002009.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the degree to which there are subdivisions or offshoots in a bearer entity.

PATO:0002010.name: looseness
PATO:0002010.def: a texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bing full of small openings or gaps.

PATO:0002011.name: neoplastic
PATO:0002011.def: a structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter's disposition the presence of abnormally proliferating masses of cells.

PATO:0002012.name: coating
PATO:0002012.def: a texture quality that exists through a liquid cover on the surface of the bearer.

PATO:0002013.name: fasciculation
PATO:0002013.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of whether the bearer forms a bundle of anatomical fibers, as of muscle or nerve.

PATO:0002014.name: structure, cavities
PATO:0002014.def: a structural quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing hollow areas.

PATO:0002019.name: aplastic growth
PATO:0002019.def: a growth quality of occurrent in which the growth of an organism, structure or group of organisms does not occur.

PATO:0002020.name: pale pink
PATO:0002020.def: pink color having high brightness and low saturation.

PATO:0002021.name: conical
PATO:0002021.def: a convex 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a cone (a 3-d shape with a round cross section that tapers).

PATO:0002022.name: villiform
PATO:0002022.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a minute projection (villus).

PATO:0002023.name: apical-basal polarity
PATO:0002023.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location of features or characteristics along an apical-basal axis.

PATO:0002024.name: anterior-posterior polarity
PATO:0002024.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's location of features or characteristics along the anterior-posterior axis.

PATO:0002025.name: external angle
PATO:0002025.def: a convex angle that is formed by one side of a polygon and a line extended from an adjacent side.

PATO:0002026.name: non-progressive
PATO:0002026.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's not increasing over time.

PATO:0002027.name: osmolality
PATO:0002027.def: a concentration quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's amount of osmoles of solute per kilogram of solvent.

PATO:0002028.name: decreased osmolality
PATO:0002028.def: an osmolality which is relatively low.

PATO:0002029.name: increased osmolality
PATO:0002029.def: an osmolality which is relatively high.

PATO:0002030.name: specificity to
PATO:0002030.def: a molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability of a probe to react precisely with a specific target molecule.

PATO:0002031.name: upturned
PATO:0002031.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved or tilted such that the tip points upwards.

PATO:0002032.name: forward scatter
PATO:0002032.def: a reflectivity quality inhering in light by virtue of the bearer's scattering occurring at small angle to the incident beam.

PATO:0002033.name: side scatter
PATO:0002033.def: a reflective quality that is the light scattering occurring at wide angle (around 90 degrees) to the incident beam.

PATO:0002034.name: undivided
PATO:0002034.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being unseparated into parts or divisions.

PATO:0002035.name: ipsilateral to
PATO:0002035.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being on the same side in relation to another structure.

PATO:0002036.name: axial to
PATO:0002036.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located towards the central axis of the organism or an extremity.

PATO:0002037.name: degeneration
PATO:0002037.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting deterioration of its structure.

PATO:0002038.name: non-degenerate
PATO:0002038.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer whose structure which does not deteriorate.

PATO:0002039.name: biconcave
PATO:0002039.def: a concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's curving inward on both sides or surfaces.

PATO:0002040.name: biconvex
PATO:0002040.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being convex on both sides or surface.

PATO:0002041.name: anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002041.def: a diameter that is along the anterior-posterior axis.

PATO:0002042.name: decreased anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002042.def: an anterior-posterior diameter quality which is relatively small.

PATO:0002043.name: increased anterior-posterior diameter
PATO:0002043.def: an anterior-posterior diameter quality which is relatively large.

PATO:0002044.name: trapezoid
PATO:0002044.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being a quadrilateral with two parallel sides.

PATO:0002045.name: dendritic
PATO:0002045.def: a branched quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having smaller branches arising from larger branches. resembling a tree in branching structure.

PATO:0002046.name: abaxial to
PATO:0002046.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being away from or on the opposite side of the central axis.

PATO:0002047.name: adaxial to
PATO:0002047.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located on the side nearest to the axis of an organ or organism.

PATO:0002048.name: mosaicism
PATO:0002048.def: an organismal quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having two or more cell populations that differ in genetic makeup. this situation can affect any type of cell, including blood cells, gametes (egg and sperm cells), and skin.

PATO:0002049.name: lateral and rotional curvature
PATO:0002049.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved around an axis and towards the side.

PATO:0002050.name: normal amount
PATO:0002050.synonym: present in normal numbers in organism

PATO:0002051.name: increased occurrence
PATO:0002051.def: an occurrence which is relatively high.

PATO:0002052.name: decreased occurrence
PATO:0002052.def: an occurrence which is relatively low.

PATO:0002053.name: dorso-ventrally flattened
PATO:0002053.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened along dorso-ventral axis.

PATO:0002054.name: laterally compressed
PATO:0002054.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being flattened along transverse axis.

PATO:0002055.name: increased fragility
PATO:0002055.def: a fragility which is relatively high.

PATO:0002056.name: decreased fragility
PATO:0002056.def: a fragility which is relatively low.

PATO:0002057.name: increased area
PATO:0002057.def: an area which is relatively high.

PATO:0002058.name: decreased area
PATO:0002058.def: an area which is relatively low.

PATO:0002059.name: emmision wavelength
PATO:0002059.def: the specific wavelength of light emitted by a fluorescent molecule, such as a labelled probe, upon absorption of light at the (higher) excitation wavelength.

PATO:0002060.name: absorption wavelength
PATO:0002060.def: the specific wavelength of radiation that can be retained by a bearer.

PATO:0002063.name: columnar
PATO:0002063.def: a shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being elongated and cylindrical.

PATO:0002064.name: fenestrated
PATO:0002064.def: a structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's delimited by a surface with holes.

PATO:0002065.name: star shaped
PATO:0002065.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being arranged like rays or radii; radiating from a common center.

PATO:0002066.name: crystal configuration
PATO:0002066.def: a solid configuration inhering in a material entity by virtue of its constituent atoms, molecules, or ions being arranged in an orderly repeating pattern extending in all three spatial dimensions.

PATO:0002067.name: stratification
PATO:0002067.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's layered configuration.

PATO:0002068.name: stratified
PATO:0002068.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a layered configuration.

PATO:0002069.name: unstratified
PATO:0002069.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking a layered configuration.

PATO:0002070.name: affinity
PATO:0002070.def: a molecular quality that arises from the molecular attraction exerted between two atoms or compounds.

PATO:0002071.name: increased affinity
PATO:0002071.def: an affinity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002072.name: decreased affinity
PATO:0002072.def: an affinity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002073.name: avidity
PATO:0002073.def: a molecular quality that arises from the synergistic strength of bond affinities between multiple bond interactions.

PATO:0002074.name: increased avidity
PATO:0002074.def: an avidity which is relatively high.

PATO:0002075.name: decreased avidity
PATO:0002075.def: an avidity which is relatively low.

PATO:0002076.name: movement behavioral quality
PATO:0002076.def: a behavioral quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's movement.

PATO:0002077.name: stacked
PATO:0002077.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned with multiple entities of the same type above and below.

PATO:0002078.name: hollow
PATO:0002078.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an empty space or cavity within.

PATO:0002080.name: broken into two pieces
PATO:0002080.def: a broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being separated into two contiguous wholes.

PATO:0002081.name: shattered
PATO:0002081.def: a broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being broken into multiple contiguous wholes.

PATO:0002082.name: partially broken
PATO:0002082.def: a broken quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being still one contiguous whole but structurally damaged such that in danger of become two or more.

PATO:0002084.name: obsolete post-mortem
PATO:0002084.def: the period after death of the organism.

PATO:0002085.name: obsolete pre-mortem
PATO:0002085.def: the period before death of the organism.

PATO:0002087.name: bullet-shaped
PATO:0002087.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being short and wide and tapered distally.

PATO:0002088.name: monocystic
PATO:0002088.def: a structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's body containing one cyst - a formation of a sac-like closed membranous structure not associated with neoplasia.

PATO:0002089.name: polycystic
PATO:0002089.def: a structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's body containing more than one cyst - formations of sac-like closed membranous structures not associated with neoplasia.

PATO:0002090.name: adenomatous
PATO:0002090.def: a morphology quality inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting the morphological characteristics of a glandular epithelial cell.

PATO:0002091.name: subacute
PATO:0002091.def: a quality of a single process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an onset and time course between acute and chronic.

PATO:0002092.name: anaplastic
PATO:0002092.def: a morphology quality inhering in a neoplastic cell by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting breakdown of cell-cell interaction maintaining tissue architecture, proliferative dysregulation and bizarre modification to nucleus size and shape.

PATO:0002093.name: ballooning
PATO:0002093.def: a volume quality inhering in a degenerating cell by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting an increase in volume associated with cytoplasmic abnormalities.

PATO:0002094.name: basophilic
PATO:0002094.def: an affinity inhering in an anatomical structure by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a molecular interaction for basic dyes under specific ph conditions.

PATO:0002095.name: obsolete neoplasm disposition
PATO:0002095.def: a disposition inhering in a tumour to progress or fail to progress during it's life time.

PATO:0002096.name: neoplastic, non-malignant
PATO:0002096.def: a disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition not to progress, invade surrounding tissues or metastasize.

PATO:0002097.name: neoplastic, malignant
PATO:0002097.def: a disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to progress, invade surrounding tissues or metastasize.

PATO:0002098.name: neoplastic, metastatic
PATO:0002098.def: a disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to spread and invade distant tissues.

PATO:0002099.name: differentiated
PATO:0002099.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its stable specialization to a particular cell type.

PATO:0002100.name: undifferentiated
PATO:0002100.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of having not yet acquired a special structure of function.

PATO:0002101.name: metaplastic
PATO:0002101.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of having changed from one fully differentiated state into another.

PATO:0002102.name: proliferative
PATO:0002102.def: a cellular quality inhering in a cell that arises by virtue of whether the bearer exhibits the ability to grow and proliferate in number through cell division.

PATO:0002103.name: infiltrative
PATO:0002103.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's penetrating or permeating another substance or area.

PATO:0002104.name: inflamed
PATO:0002104.def: a compositional quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's infiltration by leukocytes, local edema and accumulation of plasma proteins.

PATO:0002105.name: hemorrhagic
PATO:0002105.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting excessive discharge of blood from the blood vessels.

PATO:0002106.name: poorly differentiated
PATO:0002106.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its lacking most of the cellular characteristics which would allow it to be fully differentiated.

PATO:0002107.name: peripheral
PATO:0002107.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being at the edge or boundary of a related entity.

PATO:0002108.name: papillary
PATO:0002108.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling small nipple like projection.

PATO:0002109.name: caseous
PATO:0002109.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling cheese.

PATO:0002110.name: well differentiated
PATO:0002110.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its having most of the cellular characteristics of the tissue of origin.

PATO:0002111.name: moderately well differentiated
PATO:0002111.def: a cellular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its lacking few of the cellular characteristics which would allow it to be fully differentiated.

PATO:0002112.name: perforate
PATO:0002112.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a hole or holes, especially a row or array of small holes.

PATO:0002114.name: fatty
PATO:0002114.def: a composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing excess lipid.

PATO:0002115.name: fibrinoid
PATO:0002115.def: a composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing fibrin.

PATO:0002116.name: fibrinopurulent
PATO:0002116.def: a composition quality inhering in exudate by virtue of the bearer's containing fibrin.

PATO:0002117.name: glandular
PATO:0002117.def: a morphology quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhbiting the morphological characteristics of a gland.

PATO:0002118.name: multiple
PATO:0002118.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being present in more than two copies.

PATO:0002119.name: hydropic
PATO:0002119.def: a structural quality which is held by a bearer when the latter exhibits an excessive accumulation of intracellular fluid.

PATO:0002120.name: suppurative
PATO:0002120.def: a quality inhering a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to generate pus.

PATO:0002121.name: trabecular
PATO:0002121.def: a spatial pattern inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's structure resembling an irregular meshwork with cross-linking struts.

PATO:0002122.name: mixed
PATO:0002122.def: a composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being composed of more than one identifiable entities.

PATO:0002123.name: minimal
PATO:0002123.def: being smallest in amount, extent or degree.

PATO:0002124.name: laminar
PATO:0002124.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's processing the form of a thin plate sheet or layer.

PATO:0002125.name: nodular
PATO:0002125.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting a knot-like mass.

PATO:0002126.name: osseous
PATO:0002126.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing bone.

PATO:0002127.name: scirrhous
PATO:0002127.def: a hardness quality of being rigid and resistant to pressure and fibrous.

PATO:0002128.name: serous
PATO:0002128.def: a quality inhering a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing or resembling serum.

PATO:0002129.name: neoplastic, invasive
PATO:0002129.def: a disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to invade surrounding tissues.

PATO:0002130.name: neoplastic, deeply invasive
PATO:0002130.def: a disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to invade surrounding tissues to a large extend.

PATO:0002131.name: abduction
PATO:0002131.def: a displaced angular placement quality inhering in a body part by virtue of the bearer's movement away from the medial plane of the body.

PATO:0002132.name: neoplastic, non-invasive
PATO:0002132.def: a disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition not to invade surrounding tissues.

PATO:0002133.name: adduction
PATO:0002133.def: a displaced angular placement quality inhering in a body part by virtue of the bearer's movement closer the medial plane of the body.

PATO:0002134.name: fibrillary
PATO:0002134.def: a composition quaity inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's containing of or pertaining to fibrils, or nanoscale fibers.

PATO:0002135.name: delayed closure
PATO:0002135.def: a duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's delay to complete the closure of the opening of an anatomical entity.

PATO:0002136.name: radiopacity
PATO:0002136.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's relative inability of electromagnetism to pass through a particular material, particularly x-rays.

PATO:0002137.name: radiopaque
PATO:0002137.def: a radiopacity quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's prevention of the passage of electromagnetic radiation.

PATO:0002138.name: edibility
PATO:0002138.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to being fit to be eaten.

PATO:0002139.name: edible
PATO:0002139.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being suitable for use as food.

PATO:0002140.name: inedible
PATO:0002140.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer not being suitable for use as food.

PATO:0002141.name: irregular density
PATO:0002141.def: a density quality which lacks pattern.

PATO:0002144.name: increased radiopacity
PATO:0002144.def: a radiopacity that is relatively high.

PATO:0002145.name: decreased radiopacity
PATO:0002145.def: a radiopacity that is relatively low.

PATO:0002146.name: virulence
PATO:0002146.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the severity of infectious disease caused by the bearer in a target organism.

PATO:0002147.name: reduced virulence
PATO:0002147.def: a virulence that is relatively low.

PATO:0002148.name: increased virulence
PATO:0002148.def: a virulence that is relatively high.

PATO:0002149.name: ivory
PATO:0002149.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting increased density resulting in exhibiting increased degree of radiopacity (in x-rays).

PATO:0002150.name: splayed caudal
PATO:0002150.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the part of the body from which the tail arises.

PATO:0002151.name: splayed dorsal
PATO:0002151.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the back or upper surface of an organism.

PATO:0002152.name: splayed lateral
PATO:0002152.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards from the side.

PATO:0002153.name: splayed rostral
PATO:0002153.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards the front of an organism.

PATO:0002154.name: splayed ventral
PATO:0002154.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved outwards the abdomen of an organism.

PATO:0002155.name: medially rotated
PATO:0002155.def: a rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the middle of an organism.

PATO:0002156.name: laterally rotated
PATO:0002156.def: a rotation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of being rotated towards the side of an organism.

PATO:0002157.name: partially dislocated
PATO:0002157.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being slightly out of its usual or proper place, or position.

PATO:0002161.name: bicornuate
PATO:0002161.def: having two horns or horn-shaped branches.

PATO:0002162.name: high-arched
PATO:0002162.def: a concave quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming or resembling an arch of an increased apical height.

PATO:0002163.name: herniated into
PATO:0002163.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bodily structure that has protruded through an abnormal opening in the wall that contains it into the surface or boundary of another entity.

PATO:0002164.name: curved medial
PATO:0002164.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved towards the middle.

PATO:0002166.name: premature closure
PATO:0002166.def: a duration quality of a process inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's premature completion of the closure of the opening of an anatomical entity.

PATO:0002167.name: herniated out of
PATO:0002167.def: a protruding quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's bodily structure that has protruded out of the surface or boundary of another entity.

PATO:0002168.name: displaced to
PATO:0002168.def: an angular placement quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being changed in position in relation to another entity.

PATO:0002169.name: split medially
PATO:0002169.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split along the median axis.

PATO:0002170.name: split laterally
PATO:0002170.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split asymmetrically on one side.

PATO:0002171.name: split bilaterally
PATO:0002171.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split on two side.

PATO:0002172.name: split radially
PATO:0002172.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being split along the radial axis.

PATO:0002173.name: misaligned towards
PATO:0002173.def: an alignment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in a improper spatial positioning towards an additional entity.

PATO:0002174.name: misaligned away from
PATO:0002174.def: an alignment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being in a improper spatial positioning away from an additional entity.

PATO:0002175.name: spatial deviation
PATO:0002175.def: a spatial quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards another entity.

PATO:0002176.name: deviation towards the lateral side
PATO:0002176.def: a deviation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards the side.

PATO:0002177.name: deviation towards the medial side
PATO:0002177.def: a deviation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changed direction of position towards the middle.

PATO:0002178.name: mislocalised radially
PATO:0002178.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being out of its usual or proper place, or position around a central point or axis.

PATO:0002179.name: mislocalised proximally
PATO:0002179.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being positioned towards to point of attachment or origin.

PATO:0002180.name: straight
PATO:0002180.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being free of curves, bends, or angles.

PATO:0002181.name: displaced
PATO:0002181.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue the bearer's being changed in position.

PATO:0002182.name: molecular quality
PATO:0002182.def: a quality which inheres in a molecular entity, a single molecule, atom, ion, radical etc.

PATO:0002183.name: cyclicity
PATO:0002183.def: a molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether that there is a presence of cycles in the connection of the atoms within the molecular entity.

PATO:0002184.name: cyclic cyclicity
PATO:0002184.def: cyclic cyclicity inheres in a molecule when the atoms of the molecule do contain at least one cycle in the atom-atom connection paths (through bonds).

PATO:0002185.name: acyclic cyclicity
PATO:0002185.def: acyclic cyclicity inheres in a molecule when the atoms within the molecule do not contain at least one cycle in the atom-atom connection paths (through the bonds).

PATO:0002186.name: polarity
PATO:0002186.def: a molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of whether or not the molecular entity has a separation of electric charge which leads to the molecule having an electric dipole.

PATO:0002187.name: polar polarity
PATO:0002187.def: polar polarity is a quality that inheres in a molecular entity when the molecular entity is polar, i.e. does possess an electric dipole.

PATO:0002188.name: nonpolar polarity
PATO:0002188.def: a molecular quality which inheres in a molecular entity when the molecular entity does not possess an electrical dipole.

PATO:0002189.name: electric polarizability
PATO:0002189.def: the ease of distortion of the electron cloud of a molecular entity by an electric field.

PATO:0002190.name: aromaticity
PATO:0002190.def: a molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the presence of a conjugated ring of unsaturated bonds, lone pairs, or empty orbitals that exhibit a stabilization stronger than would be expected by the stabilization of conjugation alone.

PATO:0002191.name: aromatic
PATO:0002191.def: a molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity when it possesses at least one ring that is aromatic, i.e. a conjugated ring of unsaturated bonds, lone pairs, or empty orbitals that exhibit a stabilization stronger than would be expected by the stabilization of conjugation alone.

PATO:0002192.name: non-aromatic
PATO:0002192.def: a quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecule possessing no rings that are aromatic.

PATO:0002193.name: electric charge
PATO:0002193.def: a molecular quality that inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the overall electric charge of the molecule, which is due to a comparison between the total number of electrons and the total number of protons.

PATO:0002194.name: neutral charge
PATO:0002194.def: a quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing the same amount of electrons overall as protons, thus having an overall neutral charge.

PATO:0002195.name: positive charge
PATO:0002195.def: a quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing more protons overall than electrons, thus having an overall positive charge.

PATO:0002196.name: negative charge
PATO:0002196.def: a quality which inheres in a molecular entity by virtue of the molecular entity possessing more electrons overall than protons, thus having an overall negative charge.

PATO:0002197.name: electronegativity
PATO:0002197.def: a quality that describes the power of an atom to attract electrons to itself .

PATO:0002198.name: quality of a substance
PATO:0002198.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of its constitution.

PATO:0002199.name: meltability
PATO:0002199.def: a quality which inheres in a substance by virtue of the ease with which the substance can be changed from a solid to a liquid state especially by the application of heat.

PATO:0002200.name: vaporizability
PATO:0002200.def: a quality which inheres in a substance by virtue of the ease with which the substance can be changed into a gaseous state.

PATO:0002201.name: handedness
PATO:0002201.def: a behavioral quality inhering ina bearer by virtue of the bearer's unequal distribution of fine motor skill between its left and right hands or feet.

PATO:0002202.name: left handedness
PATO:0002202.def: handedness where the organism preferentially uses the left hand or foot for tasks requiring the use of a single hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002203.name: right handedness
PATO:0002203.def: handedness where the organism preferentially uses the right hand or foot for tasks requiring the use of a single hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002204.name: ambidextrous handedness
PATO:0002204.def: handedness where the organism exhibits no overall dominance in the use of right or left hand or foot in the performance of tasks that require one hand or foot or a dominant hand or foot.

PATO:0002205.name: capacitance
PATO:0002205.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to hold an electrical charge.

PATO:0002206.name: neonatal
PATO:0002206.def: a maturity quality inhering to a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being at the point or short after birth.

PATO:0002207.name: insertion depth
PATO:0002207.def: a quality that is the distance between the end of the inserted object and the surface of the object into which it penetrates.

PATO:0002208.name: spoon-shaped
PATO:0002208.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of a spoon.

PATO:0002209.name: incisiform
PATO:0002209.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the shape of an incisor tooth.

PATO:0002210.name: bulbous
PATO:0002210.def: a convex 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a teardrop.

PATO:0002211.name: recurved
PATO:0002211.def: a curvature quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being curved backward or inward.

PATO:0002212.name: slender
PATO:0002212.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being small or narrow in circumference or width in proportion to length or height.

PATO:0002213.name: obclavate
PATO:0002213.def: a concave 3-d shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's shape being inversely clavate.

PATO:0002214.name: bilobed
PATO:0002214.def: a lobed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being divided into or having two lobes.

PATO:0002215.name: falciform
PATO:0002215.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having the shape of a scythe or sickle.

PATO:0002216.name: ubiquinated
PATO:0002216.def: a molecular quality that pertains to the post-translational modification of a protein by the covalent attachment of one or more ubiquitin monomer.

PATO:0002217.name: nitrated
PATO:0002217.def: a molecular quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being combined, or impregnated, with nitric acid, or some of its compounds.

PATO:0002317.name: parallelogram
PATO:0002317.def:
a convex quadrilateral is a parallelogram if and only if any one of the following statements are true:
1. each diagonal divides the quadrilateral into two congruent triangles with the same orientation.
2. the opposite sides are congruent in pairs.
3. the diagonals bisect each other.
4. the opposite angles are congruent in pairs.
5. the sum of the squares of the sides equals the sum of the squares of the diagonals. (this is the parallelogram law)
6.it possesses rotational symmetry.
7.one pair of opposite sides are parallel and congruent.
8.two pairs of adjacent angles are supplementary.

PATO:0002396.name: mislocalized adaxially

PATO:0002397.name: subcircular

PATO:0002399.name: anteromedially rotated

PATO:0002400.name: fusiform

PATO:0002402.name: multifocal to coalescing

PATO:0002403.name: generalized

PATO:0002405.name: friability

PATO:0002406.name: friable

PATO:0002407.name: indurated
PATO:0002407.def: having become firm or hard especially by increase of fibrous elements.

PATO:0002410.name: beige
PATO:0002410.def: a colour that is very pale yellowish brown.

PATO:0002411.name: yellow brown

PATO:0002413.name: light yellow brown

PATO:0002414.name: chronic-active

PATO:0002415.name: focally extensive

PATO:0002416.name: sunken

PATO:0002417.name: transmural

PATO:0002421.name: cicatricial
PATO:0002421.def: having or resembling the characteristic of a cicatrix - a scar resulting from formation and contraction of fibrous tissue.

PATO:0002425.name: exposed
PATO:0002425.def: open to view or not covered by another entity.

PATO:0002426.name: scaphoid
PATO:0002426.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a boat.

PATO:0002427.name: knobbled

PATO:0002428.name: tripodal

PATO:0002429.name: x-shaped
PATO:0002429.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped in the form of the letter x.

PATO:0002430.name: strap-shaped
PATO:0002430.def: a shape quality in which the bearer is shaped like a narrow band; ligulate.

PATO:0002431.name: waisted
PATO:0002431.def: a shape quality in which the bearer possesses a gradual, yet distinct, thinning from a wide starting point.

PATO:0002432.name: spade-shaped
PATO:0002432.def: a shape that is in the form of a spade.

PATO:0002433.name: sculpted surface
PATO:0002433.def: a surface feature shape marked by large amounts of relief, often with multiple ridges and grooves in close association. topographically complex.

PATO:0002434.name: perpendicular to

PATO:0002435.name: abutting

PATO:0002436.name: offset
PATO:0002436.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's position being displaced from a reference point.

PATO:0002437.name: interlocked with

PATO:0002438.name: subdermal

PATO:0002439.name: w-shaped

PATO:0002440.name: ornamentation

PATO:0002441.name: ornamented

PATO:0002442.name: unornamented

PATO:0002445.name: torsioned

PATO:0002446.name: anchor-shaped
PATO:0002446.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape resembling an anchor.

PATO:0002447.name: quadripartite

PATO:0002448.name: oriented towards
PATO:0002448.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being aligned or positioned towards another entity.

PATO:0002449.name: posteromedial to

PATO:0002450.name: firm
PATO:0002450.def: a hardness quality of giving significant resistance to pressure.

PATO:0002451.name: sexually dimorphic
PATO:0002451.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a phenotypic difference between males and females of the same species.

PATO:0002452.name: decondensed

PATO:0002454.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a carpel.

PATO:0002456.name: inflorescence-like
PATO:0002456.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of an inflorescence.

PATO:0002457.name: leaf-like
PATO:0002457.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a leaf.

PATO:0002458.name: pin-like
PATO:0002458.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being thin and lacking outgrowths.

PATO:0002459.name: sepal-like
PATO:0002459.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a sepal,

PATO:0002460.name: shriveled
PATO:0002460.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being smaller and contracted, especially due to loss of moisture.

PATO:0002461.name: wilty
PATO:0002461.def: to bend or hang downwards due to loss of water

PATO:0002462.name: collagenous
PATO:0002462.def: a composition quality inhering in an bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of collagen.

PATO:0002463.name: extends to
PATO:0002463.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of some aspect of the bearer extending to the position of another entity.

PATO:0002465.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling a prism.

PATO:0002466.name: keyhole shaped

PATO:0002467.name: lathlike
PATO:0002467.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer resembling a thin narrow strip.

PATO:0002468.name: distensible
PATO:0002468.def: a structure quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being capable of swelling or stretching.

PATO:0002469.name: sutured to
PATO:0002469.def: structural quality inhering in a bearer in which a joint has apposed bony surfaces united by fibrous tissue, permitting no movement; found only between bones.

PATO:0002470.name: transformed to
PATO:0002470.def: a morphological quality between two bearers inhering that one bearer is subject to change the nature, function, or condition of itself to become the other.

PATO:0002471.name: increased velocity
PATO:0002471.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's increased rate of change of the position.

PATO:0002472.name: decreased velocity
PATO:0002472.def: a physical quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's decreased rate of change of the position.

PATO:0002473.def: a disposition inhering in a tumour by virtue of the bearer's disposition to spontaneously arise.

PATO:0002474.name: bitter
PATO:0002474.def: a flavor quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an acrid, sharp, or disagreeable flavor.

PATO:0002475.name: subterminal
PATO:0002475.def: a position quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's existing near the end of another entity.

PATO:0002476.name: terminal
PATO:0002476.def: a position quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's forming the end of another entity.

PATO:0002477.name: brittle
PATO:0002477.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's disposition to breaks without significant deformation (strain) when subjected to stress.

PATO:0002478.name: transversely striated
PATO:0002478.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines or grooves, usually parallel, that are oriented transversely relative to the long axis of the bearer.

PATO:0002479.name: obliquely striated
PATO:0002479.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being marked by narrow lines or grooves, usually parallel, that are oriented obliquely relative to the long axis of the bearer.

PATO:0002480.name: poorly ossified

PATO:0002481.name: oblique orientation
PATO:0002481.def: an orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a slanting direction or position : neither perpendicular nor parallel.

PATO:0002482.name: slit-like
PATO:0002482.def: shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer exhibiting a narrow and elongate opening.

PATO:0002483.name: external to

PATO:0002496.def: an orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed dorsolaterally.

PATO:0002504.def: an orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed posterodorsally.

PATO:0002507.name: keratinous
PATO:0002507.def: a composition quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's consisting of keratin.

PATO:0002508.name: concealed
PATO:0002508.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being hidden from view.

PATO:0002511.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a cane.

PATO:0002513.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a slanting direction (neither perpendicular nor parallel) relative to another entity.

PATO:0002514.def: an orientation quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer having a position that is directed anteromedially.

PATO:0002517.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a saddle.

PATO:0002518.name: flush
PATO:0002518.def: a positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being level or even with another surface.

PATO:0002519.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an open, latticed, or porous structure; used especially of bone.

PATO:0002520.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer being shaped like a scute or an osteoderm.

PATO:0002521.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's similarity to the appearance of a funnel.

PATO:0002536.def: a shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having a shape like a boomerang, with two arms connected at an angle.

PATO:0002537.def: a spheroid quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's exhibiting a shape not quite ovoid. approximately ovoid.

PATO:0002631.name: refractory
PATO:0002631.def: an occurrence of a process during which time there is an inability to change the course, extent, or repetition of the process.

PATO:0005003.def: a quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's resembling the form of a paddle.

PATO:0005004.def: a shape that is almost an ellipse.

PATO:0005007.def: a 3-d shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having dentition characterized by high-crowned teeth and enamel which extends far past the gum line, which provides extra material for wear and tear.

PATO:0005009.name: molariform
PATO:0005009.def: a 3-d shape inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's having an entity in the form of a molar tooth.

PATO:0005012.name: complete structure

PATO:0005013.name: incomplete structure
PATO:0005013.def: a structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's lacking parts or having a reduced form compared to fully formed entities.

PATO:0005014.name: subspherical
