UBERON:0003691.def: the outermost part of the spinal canal. it is the space within the canal (formed by the surrounding vertebrae) lying outside the dura mater.

UBERON:0003692.name: acromioclavicular joint
UBERON:0003692.def: any joint connecting the acromonion of the scapula and clavicle.

UBERON:0003693.name: retroperitoneal space
UBERON:0003693.def: anatomical space in the abdominal cavity behind (retro) the peritoneum. it has no specific delineating anatomical structures. organs are retroperitoneal if they only have peritoneum on their anterior side.

UBERON:0003694.name: atlanto-axial joint
UBERON:0003694.def: the atlanto-axial joint is of a complicated nature, comprising no fewer than four distinct joints. there is a pivot articulation between the odontoid process of the axis and the ring formed by the anterior arch and the transverse ligament of the atlas.

UBERON:0003695.name: metacarpophalangeal joint
UBERON:0003695.def: the metacarpophalangeal joints (mcp) are of the condyloid kind, formed by the reception of the rounded heads of the metacarpal bones into shallow cavities on the proximal ends of the first phalanges, with the exception of that of the thumb, which presents more of the characters of a ginglymoid joint. arthritis of the mcp is a distinguishing feature of rheumatoid arthritis, as opposed to the distal interphalangeal joint in osteoarthritis. [wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0003696.name: metatarsophalangeal joint
UBERON:0003696.def: the metatarsophalangeal articulations are the joints between the metatarsal bones of the foot and the proximal bones of the toes . they are condyloid joints meaning an elliptical or rounded surface (of the metatarsal bones) come close to the shallow cavities (of the proximal phalanges). the ligaments are the plantar and two collateral.

UBERON:0003697.name: abdominal wall
UBERON:0003697.def: the tissues that surround the organs that are present within the abdominal cavity. the abdominal wall tissue is composed of layers of fat, parietal peritoneum, fascia, and muscles.

UBERON:0003698.name: subtalar joint
UBERON:0003698.def: a joint of the pes that connects the talus and the calcaneus.

UBERON:0003699.name: pubic symphysis
UBERON:0003699.def: the firm fibrocartilaginous joint in the median plane between the two opposing surfaces of the pubic bones, which are united by an interpubic disc of fibrocartilage as well as the superior and arcuate pubic ligaments.

UBERON:0003700.name: temporomandibular joint
UBERON:0003700.def: a synovial joint of the jaw that connects the mandible to the temporal bone.

UBERON:0003701.name: calcaneal tendon
UBERON:0003701.def: the achilles tendon is a tendon of the posterior leg. it serves to attach the plantaris, gastrocnemius (calf) and soleus muscles to the calcaneus (heel) bone.

UBERON:0003702.name: inguinal canal
UBERON:0003702.def: the passage in the lower abdominal wall through which the spermatic cord in the male or the round ligament in the female, nerves and vessels pass from the pelvic cavity to the scrotum or labia majora, respectively.

UBERON:0003703.name: extrahepatic bile duct
UBERON:0003703.def: passages external to the liver for the conveyance of bile. these include the common bile duct and the common hepatic duct.

UBERON:0003704.name: intrahepatic bile duct
UBERON:0003704.def: passages within the liver for the conveyance of bile. includes right and left hepatic ducts even though these may join outside the liver to form the common hepatic duct.

UBERON:0003705.name: meckel's diverticulum
UBERON:0003705.def: a small bulge in the small intestine present at birth. it is a vestigial remnant of the omphalomesenteric duct.

UBERON:0003706.name: laryngeal vocal fold
UBERON:0003706.def: either of two pairs of folds of mucous membrane projecting into the larynx.

UBERON:0003707.name: sinus of valsalva
UBERON:0003707.def: one of the anatomic dilations of the ascending aorta, which occurs just above the aortic valve.

UBERON:0003708.name: carotid sinus
UBERON:0003708.def: a localized dilation of the internal carotid artery at its origin, the common carotid artery bifurcation.

UBERON:0003709.name: circle of willis
UBERON:0003709.def: a circle of arteries that supply blood to the brain. the circle of willis comprises the following arteries: anterior cerebral artery (left and right); anterior communicating artery; internal carotid artery (left and right); posterior cerebral artery (left and right); posterior communicating artery (left and right).the basilar artery and middle cerebral arteries, supplying the brain, are also considered part of the circle.

UBERON:0003710.name: vasa vasorum
UBERON:0003710.def: nutrient blood vessels which supply the walls of large arteries or veins.

UBERON:0003711.name: brachiocephalic vein
UBERON:0003711.def: the left and right brachiocephalic veins in the upper chest are formed by the union of each corresponding internal jugular vein and subclavian vein. this is at the level of the sternoclavicular joint. these great vessels merge to form the superior vena cava. the brachiocephalic veins are the major veins returning blood to the superior vena cava.

UBERON:0003712.name: cavernous sinus
UBERON:0003712.def: the cavernous sinus (or lateral sellar compartment), within the human head, is a large collection of thin-walled veins creating a cavity bordered by the temporal bone of the skull and the sphenoid bone, lateral to the sella turcica.

UBERON:0003713.name: splenic vein
UBERON:0003713.def: a vein arising from the splenic trabecular vein in the hilum of the spleen that drains into the portal vein.

UBERON:0003714.name: neural tissue
UBERON:0003714.def: portion of tissue in the nervous system which consists of neurons and glial cells, and may also contain parts of the vasculature.

UBERON:0003715.name: splanchnic nerve
UBERON:0003715.def: the major nerves supplying sympathetic innervation to the abdomen, including the greater, lesser, and lowest (or smallest) splanchnic nerves that are formed by preganglionic fibers from the spinal cord which pass through the paravertebral ganglia and then to the celiac ganglia and plexuses and the lumbar splanchnic nerves carry fibers which pass through the lumbar paravertebral ganglia to the mesenteric and hypogastric ganglia.

UBERON:0003716.name: recurrent laryngeal nerve
UBERON:0003716.def: a branch of the vagus nerve that supplies motor function and sensation to the larynx (voice box). it travels within the endoneurium. it is the nerve of the 6th branchial arch.
UBERON:0003716.synonym: vagus x nerve recurrent laryngeal branch

UBERON:0003718.name: muscle spindle
UBERON:0003718.def: the sensory organs in muscle that are involved in the stretch reflex.

UBERON:0003719.name: pacinian corpuscle
UBERON:0003719.def: any of the rapidly adapting mechanoreceptors found in subcutaneous tissue beneath both hairy and glabrous skin, and which normally contain an afferent nerve fiber surrounded by a capsule with multiple concentric layers.

UBERON:0003720.name: anterior cranial fossa
UBERON:0003720.def: the floor of the anterior fossa is formed by the orbital plates of the frontal, the cribriform plate of the ethmoid, and the small wings and front part of the body of the sphenoid; it is limited behind by the posterior borders of the small wings of the sphenoid and by the anterior margin of the chiasmatic groove. the lesser wings of the sphenoid separate the anterior and middle fossae.

UBERON:0003721.name: lingual nerve
UBERON:0003721.def: the lingual nerve is a branch of the mandibular nerve (cn v3), itself a branch of the trigeminal nerve, which supplies sensory innervation to the tongue. it also carries fibers from the facial nerve, which return taste information from the anterior two thirds of the tongue.

UBERON:0003722.name: middle cranial fossa
UBERON:0003722.def: the compartment containing the anterior extremities and half the inferior surface of the temporal lobes (temporal lobe) of the cerebral hemispheres. lying posterior and inferior to the anterior cranial fossa (cranial fossa, anterior), it is formed by part of the temporal bone and sphenoid bone. it is separated from the posterior cranial fossa (cranial fossa, posterior) by crests formed by the superior borders of the petrous parts of the temporal bones[mesh]. the middle fossa, deeper than the anterior cranial fossa, is narrow medially and widens laterally to the sides of the skull. it is separated from the posterior fossa by the clivus and the petrous crest. it is bounded in front by the posterior margins of the lesser wings of the sphenoid bone, the anterior clinoid processes, and the ridge forming the anterior margin of the chiasmatic groove; behind, by the superior angles of the petrous portions of the temporal bones and the dorsum sellc&; laterally by the temporal squamc&, sphenoidal angles of the parietals, and greater wings of the sphenoid. it is traversed by the squamosal, sphenoparietal, sphenosquamosal, and sphenopetrosal sutures[wp].

UBERON:0003723.name: vestibular nerve
UBERON:0003723.def: the vestibular nerve is one of the two branches of the vestibulocochlear nerve (the cochlear nerve being the other). it goes to the semicircular canals via the vestibular ganglion. it receives positional information. axons of the vestibular nerve synapse in the vestibular nucleus on the lateral floor and wall of the fourth ventricle in the pons and medulla. it arises from bipolar cells in the vestibular ganglion, ganglion of scarpa, which is situated in the upper part of the outer end of the internal auditory meatus. [wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0003724.name: musculocutaneous nerve
UBERON:0003724.def: a large branch of the brachial plexus supplying various parts of the upper arm (as flexor muscles) and forearm (as the skin).

UBERON:0003725.name: cervical nerve plexus
UBERON:0003725.def: an arrangement of nerve fibers, running from the spine that travels to the head and neck where it innervates skin and muscle.

UBERON:0003726.name: thoracic nerve
UBERON:0003726.def: the twelve spinal nerves on each side of the thorax. they include eleven intercostal nerves and one subcostal nerve. both sensory and motor, they supply the muscles and skin of the thoracic and abdominal walls.

UBERON:0003727.name: intercostal nerve
UBERON:0003727.def: the intercostal nerves are the anterior divisions (rami anteriores; ventral divisions) of the thoracic spinal nerves from t1 to t11. each nerve is connected with the adjoining ganglion of the sympathetic trunk by a gray and a white ramus communicans. the intercostal nerves are distributed chiefly to the thoracic pleura and abdominal peritoneum and differ from the anterior divisions of the other spinal nerves in that each pursues an independent course without plexus formation. the first two nerves supply fibers to the upper limb in addition to their thoracic branches; the next four are limited in their distribution to the parietes of the thorax; the lower five supply the parietes of the thorax and abdomen. the 7th intercostal nerve terminates at the xyphoid process, at the lower end of the sternum. the 10th intercostal nerve terminates at the umbilicus. the twelfth thoracic is distributed to the abdominal wall and groin. [wp,unvetted].
UBERON:0003727.synonym: ventral ramus of thoracic spinal nerve

UBERON:0003728.name: mediastinum
UBERON:0003728.def: the central part of the thoracic cavity enclosed by the left and right pleurae.

UBERON:0003729.name: mouth mucosa
UBERON:0003729.def: a mucous membrane that lines the mouth.

UBERON:0003820.name: prostate bud
UBERON:0003820.def: a region of the fetal urogenital sinus epithelium destined to become the prostate[go].

UBERON:0003821.name: metapodium bone
UBERON:0003821.def: a bone of the metapodial skeleton.

UBERON:0003822.name: forelimb stylopod
UBERON:0003822.def: the part of the forelimb between pectoral region and the elbow, corresponding to the humerus.

UBERON:0003823.name: hindlimb zeugopod
UBERON:0003823.def: the middle limb segment of the pelvic free limb, between the autopod and stylopod segments. includes as parts the hindlimb zeugopodial skeleton, which includes as parts the tibia and fibula, or their cartilage precursors, or evolutionary variants.

UBERON:0003824.name: nerve of thoracic segment
UBERON:0003824.def: a nerve that is part of a thorax [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003825.name: nerve of abdominal segment
UBERON:0003825.def: a nerve that is part of an abdominal segment of trunk [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003826.name: upper leg bone
UBERON:0003826.def: a bone that is part of a hindlimb stylopod [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003827.name: thoracic segment bone
UBERON:0003827.def: a bone that is part of a thorax [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003828.name: abdominal segment bone
UBERON:0003828.def: a bone that is part of an abdominal segment of trunk [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0003828.synonym: bone organ of abdominal segment of trunk

UBERON:0003829.name: urethra muscle tissue
UBERON:0003829.def: any muscle tissue that is part of the urethra.

UBERON:0003830.name: thoracic segment muscle
UBERON:0003830.def: any muscle organ that is part of a thorax [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003831.name: respiratory system muscle
UBERON:0003831.def: any muscle organ that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003832.name: esophagus muscle
UBERON:0003832.def: any muscle organ that is part of a esophagus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003833.name: abdominal segment muscle
UBERON:0003833.def: a muscle organ that is part of an abdominal segment of trunk [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0003833.synonym: muscle organ of abdominal segment of trunk

UBERON:0003834.name: thoracic segment blood vessel
UBERON:0003834.def: a blood vessel that is part of a thorax [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003835.name: abdominal segment blood vessel
UBERON:0003835.def: a blood vessel that is part of an abdominal segment of trunk [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0003835.synonym: blood vessel of abdominal segment of trunk

UBERON:0003836.name: abdominal segment skin
UBERON:0003836.def: a skin of body that is part of an abdominal segment of trunk [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0003836.synonym: skin of abdominal segment of trunk

UBERON:0003837.name: thoracic segment connective tissue
UBERON:0003837.def: a portion of connective tissue that is part of a thorax [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003838.name: abdominal segment connective tissue
UBERON:0003838.def: a portion of connective tissue that is part of an abdominal segment of trunk [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0003838.synonym: textus connectivus of abdominal segment of trunk

UBERON:0003839.name: forelimb joint
UBERON:0003839.def: a limb joint that is part of a forelimb [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003840.name: hindlimb joint
UBERON:0003840.def: a limb joint that is part of a hindlimb [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003841.name: autopod joint
UBERON:0003841.def: a limb joint that is part of an autopod [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003842.name: neural tube lumen
UBERON:0003842.def: an anatomical space that surrounded_by a neural tube.

UBERON:0003843.name: dental epithelium
UBERON:0003843.def: epithelium that is part of a developing tooth or dental organ.

UBERON:0003844.name: upper eyelid epithelium
UBERON:0003844.def: an epithelium that is part of an upper eyelid [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003845.name: lower eyelid epithelium
UBERON:0003845.def: an epithelium that is part of a lower eyelid [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003846.name: thymus epithelium
UBERON:0003846.def: an epithelium that is part of a thymus, forming a supporting framework[mp,modified].

UBERON:0003847.name: thyroid artery
UBERON:0003847.def: an artery that supplies a thyroid gland.

UBERON:0003848.name: gonadal vein
UBERON:0003848.def: in medicine, gonadal vein refers to the blood vessel that carrying blood away from the gonad (testis, ovary) toward the heart. females : ovarian vein males : testicular vein [wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0003849.name: mesencephalic neural crest
UBERON:0003849.def: a neural crest that has_potential_to_developmentally_contribute_to a midbrain.

UBERON:0003850.name: telencephalon neural crest
UBERON:0003850.def: a neural crest that has_potential_to_developmentally_contribute_to a telencephalon.

UBERON:0003851.name: diencephalon neural crest
UBERON:0003851.def: a neural crest that has_potential_to_developmentally_contribute_to a diencephalon.

UBERON:0003852.name: rhombencephalon neural crest
UBERON:0003852.def: a neural crest that has_potential_to_developmentally_contribute_to a hindbrain.

UBERON:0003853.name: spinal cord neural crest
UBERON:0003853.def: a neural crest that has_potential_to_developmentally_contribute_to a spinal cord.

UBERON:0003854.name: spinal cord neural plate
UBERON:0003854.def: a neural plate that develops_from a future spinal cord.

UBERON:0003855.name: gonad mesenchyme
UBERON:0003855.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing gonad [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003856.name: uncondensed odontogenic mesenchyme
UBERON:0003856.def: mesenchyme enclosed by a dental organ that gives rise to an odontogenic papilla.

UBERON:0003857.name: upper eyelid mesenchyme
UBERON:0003857.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing upper eyelid [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003858.name: lower eyelid mesenchyme
UBERON:0003858.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing lower eyelid [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003859.name: forelimb mesenchyme
UBERON:0003859.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing forelimb [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003860.name: hindlimb mesenchyme
UBERON:0003860.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing hindlimb [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003861.name: neural arch
UBERON:0003861.def: posterior part of a vertebra that consists of a pair of pedicles and a pair of laminae, and supports seven processes: four articular processes, two transverse processes one spinous process[wp]. zfa: a neural arch encloses the neural canal and typically meets its partner to form a neural spine.

UBERON:0003862.name: pedal digit 4 phalanx
UBERON:0003862.def: a phalanx that is part of a foot digit 4 [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003863.name: pedal digit 5 phalanx
UBERON:0003863.def: a phalanx that is part of a foot digit 5 [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003864.name: middle phalanx of manus
UBERON:0003864.def: a middle phalanx that is part of a finger [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003865.name: distal phalanx of manus
UBERON:0003865.def: a distal phalanx that is part of a finger [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003866.name: middle phalanx of pes
UBERON:0003866.def: a middle phalanx that is part of a toe [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003867.name: distal phalanx of pes
UBERON:0003867.def: a distal phalanx that is part of a pedal digit [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003868.name: proximal phalanx of pes
UBERON:0003868.def: a proximal phalanx that is part of a pedal digit [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003869.name: presumptive ganglion
UBERON:0003869.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a ganglion.

UBERON:0003876.name: hippocampal field
UBERON:0003876.def: a part or parts of the hippocampus that have a particular function.

UBERON:0003881.name: ca1 field of hippocampus
UBERON:0003881.def: part of hippocampus proper bounded by ca2 and the subiculum, characterized by pyramidal neurons that receive projections from pyramidal neurons of ca3 via the schaffer collaterals.

UBERON:0003882.name: ca2 field of hippocampus
UBERON:0003882.def: part of hippocampus proper bounded by areas ca3 and ca1, characterized by a narrow layer of large pyramidal cells, similar in size to ca3 pyramidal cells, but which lack the mossy fiber input from the dentate gyrus (adapted from paxinos, g. the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995, pg. 460).

UBERON:0003883.name: ca3 field of hippocampus
UBERON:0003883.def: part of hippocampus proper bounded by the hilus of the dentate gyrus and area ca2, characterized by large pyramidal cells and a dense projection from dentate gyrus granule cell mossy fibers.

UBERON:0003884.name: ca4 field of hippocampus
UBERON:0003884.def: the last of four regions in the cornu ammonis of the hippocampus and is also part of the hilus of the dentate gyrus. this area contains mostly mossy cells that receive inputs from the dentate gyrus and pyramidal cells in the ca3 region and also projects back to the dentate gyrus.

UBERON:0003885.name: mesometrium
UBERON:0003885.def: a mesentery that is part of a uterus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003886.name: future coelemic cavity lumen
UBERON:0003886.def: an anatomical cavity that has the potential to develop into a coelemic cavity lumen.

UBERON:0003887.name: intraembryonic coelom
UBERON:0003887.def: the part of the coelom in the embryo between the somatopleuric and splanchnopleuric mesoderm; the principal body cavities of the trunk (thoracic, abdominal, and pelvic) arise from this embryonic part of the coelom.

UBERON:0003888.name: extraembryonic coelomic cavity
UBERON:0003888.def: the fluid-filled spaces formed within the mass of extraembryonic mesoderm that later fuse to become a large extraembryonic cavity.

UBERON:0003889.name: fallopian tube
UBERON:0003889.def: initial section of the oviduct through which the ova pass from the ovary to the uterus.

UBERON:0003890.name: mullerian duct
UBERON:0003890.def: paired ducts of the embryo that run down the lateral sides of the urogenital ridge and terminate at the mullerian eminence in the primitive urogenital sinus. in the female, they will develop to form the fallopian tubes, uterus, and the upper portion of the vagina; in the male, they are lost. these ducts are made of tissue of mesodermal origin[wp]. develops either by lengthwise splitting of the archinephric duct (in chondrichthyans and some amphibians) or by a elongated invagination of the coelomic epithelium (other vertebrates) in males, the oviducts regress. the cranial end of the oviduct maintains an opening into the coelom (which primitively may have been the anteriormost coelomic funnels connecting the nephrocoel with the coelom). this opening is the ostium tubae[usm].

UBERON:0003891.name: stroma
UBERON:0003891.def: connective, non-functional supportive framework of a biological cell, tissue, or organ. contrast with parenchyma.

UBERON:0003893.name: capsule
UBERON:0003893.def: a cover or envelope partly or wholly surrounding a structure. examples: egg shell, articular capsules, renal capsules[wp].

UBERON:0003894.name: liver primordium
UBERON:0003894.def: a small endodermal thickening in the foregut adjacent to the transverse septum. invaginates forming the hepatic diverticulum.

UBERON:0003895.name: hypaxial myotome region
UBERON:0003895.def: portion of myotome that is ventral to the horizontal septum.

UBERON:0003896.name: obsolete muscle of body wall
UBERON:0003896.def: any muscle organ that is part of a body wall [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003897.name: axial muscle
UBERON:0003897.def: one of the skeletal muscles of the head and neck, spine, and ribs.

UBERON:0003898.name: skeletal muscle tissue of trunk
UBERON:0003898.def: a portion of skeletal muscle tissue in the trunk.

UBERON:0003900.name: epaxial myotome region
UBERON:0003900.def: portion of myotome that is dorsal to the horizontal septum.

UBERON:0003901.name: horizontal septum
UBERON:0003901.def: a logitudinal sheet of continuous connective tissue partition developing at the apex of the chevron-shaped myotome and separating dorsal (epaxial) and ventral (hypaxial) body wall muscle masses; each is destined to become, respectively, the epaxial and hyopaxial musculature.

UBERON:0003902.name: retinal neural layer
UBERON:0003902.def: the part of the retina that contains neurons and photoreceptor cells[go].

UBERON:0003903.name: bursa of fabricius
UBERON:0003903.def: an epithelial and lymphoid organ that develops as a dorsal diverticulum of the proctodeal region of the cloaca in birds. the luminal (interior) surface of the bursa is plicated with as many as 15 primary and 7 secondary plicae or folds. these plicae have hundreds of bursal follicles containing follicle-associated epithelial cells, lymphocytes, macrophages, and plasma cells. lymphoid stem cells migrate from the fetal liver to the bursa during ontogeny. in the bursa, these stem cells acquire the characteristics of mature, immunocompetent b cells[wp]. the bursa is an organ found in birds involved in b cell differentiation[go].

UBERON:0003904.name: bursal plica
UBERON:0003904.def: follicle containing part of bursa of fabricius. the luminal (interior) surface of the bursa is plicated with as many as 15 primary and 7 secondary plicae or folds. these plicae have hundreds of bursal follicles containing follicle-associated epithelial cells, lymphocytes, macrophages, and plasma cells. lymphoid stem cells migrate from the fetal liver to the bursa during ontogeny. in the bursa, these stem cells acquire the characteristics of mature, immunocompetent b cells[wp].

UBERON:0003905.name: bursal follicle
UBERON:0003905.def: follicle within the plicae of bursa of fabricius.

UBERON:0003906.name: cardiac jelly
UBERON:0003906.def: portion of extracellular matrix between the myocardium and the endocardium. the cardiac jelly plays a central role in the septation of the heart and comprises most of the thickness of the heart wall at early stages, but disappears as the heart differentiates.

UBERON:0003907.name: left atrioventricular canal
UBERON:0003907.def: an atrioventricular canal that is in the left side of a atrioventricular region.

UBERON:0003908.name: right atrioventricular canal
UBERON:0003908.def: an atrioventricular canal that is in the right side of a atrioventricular region.

UBERON:0003909.name: sinusoid
UBERON:0003909.def: small blood vessel similar to a capillary but with a fenestrated endothelium. sinusoids are found in the liver, lymphoid tissue, endocrine organs, and hematopoietic organs such as the bone marrow and the spleen. sinusoids found within terminal villi of the placenta are not comparable to these; they possess a continuous endothelium and complete basal lamina[wp].

UBERON:0003910.name: splenic sinusoid
UBERON:0003910.def: wide vessels in the spleen that drain into trabecular veins[wp].

UBERON:0003911.name: choroid plexus epithelium
UBERON:0003911.def: the epithelial component of the choroid plexus. consists of cuboidal epithelial cells surrounding a core of capillaries and loose connective tissue.

UBERON:0003913.name: tooth-like structure
UBERON:0003913.def: hard bony, calcareous, or chitinous organ found in the mouth or pharynx of an animal and used in procuring or masticating food.

UBERON:0003914.name: epithelial tube
UBERON:0003914.def: epithelial tubes transport gases, liquids and cells from one site to another and form the basic structure of many organs and tissues, with tube shape and organization varying from the single-celled excretory organ in caenorhabditis elegans to the branching trees of the mammalian kidney and insect tracheal system.

UBERON:0003915.name: endothelial tube
UBERON:0003915.def: any endothelium that has the quality of being cylindrical [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003916.name: fat pad
UBERON:0003916.def: a mass of closely packed fat cells (adipose tissue) surrounded by fibrous tissue septa[tmd].

UBERON:0003917.name: arthropod fat body
UBERON:0003917.def: an insect gland dorsal to the insect gut, with a function analogous to that of the vertebrate liver. it is a storage organ for fats, glycogen and protein and is a major site of intermediary metabolism.

UBERON:0003918.name: kidney mesenchyme
UBERON:0003918.def: kidney mesenchyme is the tissue made up of loosely connected mesenchymal cells in the kidney[go].

UBERON:0003920.name: venous blood vessel
UBERON:0003920.def: a blood vessel that carries blood from the capillaries toward the heart.

UBERON:0003921.name: pancreas primordium
UBERON:0003921.def: embryonic structure that develops into pancreatic bud.

UBERON:0003922.name: pancreatic epithelial bud
UBERON:0003922.def: the embryonic pancreas develops from two separate anlagen in the foregut epithelium, one dorsal and two ventral pancreatic buds[pmid].

UBERON:0003923.name: dorsal pancreatic bud
UBERON:0003923.def: pancreatic bud that gives rise to the accessory pancreatic duct.

UBERON:0003924.name: ventral pancreatic bud
UBERON:0003924.def: pancreatic bud that gives rise to the major pancreatic duct.

UBERON:0003925.name: photoreceptor inner segment layer
UBERON:0003925.def: layer of the retina composed of the inner segments of the photoreceptor cells.

UBERON:0003927.name: obsolete macula lagena
UBERON:0003927.def: this term was obsoleted as it was previously defined midleadingly as 'a macula that is part of a cochlea'.

UBERON:0003928.name: digestive system duct
UBERON:0003928.def: a duct that is part of a digestive system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003929.name: digestive tract epithelium
UBERON:0003929.def: an epithelium that lines the lumen of the digestive tract.

UBERON:0003930.name: atrioventricular canal endocardium
UBERON:0003930.def: endocardium that is part of the atrioventricular canal[zfa,vetted].

UBERON:0003931.name: diencephalic white matter
UBERON:0003931.def: white matter that is part of a diencephalon [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003932.name: cartilage element of chondrocranium
UBERON:0003932.def: a cartilage element of chondrocranium. example: neurocranial trabecula.

UBERON:0003933.name: cranial cartilage
UBERON:0003933.def: a cartilage element that is part of the cranial skeleton.

UBERON:0003934.name: mesenchyme pectoral fin
UBERON:0003934.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing pectoral fin [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003935.name: mesenchyme pelvic fin
UBERON:0003935.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing pelvic fin [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0003937.name: reproductive gland
UBERON:0003937.def: any of the organized aggregations of cells that function as secretory or excretory organs and are associated with reproduction.

UBERON:0003938.name: sensory dissociation area
UBERON:0003938.def: the area of the parietal lobe that integrates tactile and visual stimuli.

UBERON:0003939.name: transverse gyrus of heschl
UBERON:0003939.def: the area of the temporal lobe concerned with hearing[mp]. the transverse temporal gyri (also called heschl's gyri or heschl's convolutions) are found in the area of primary auditory cortex in the superior temporal gyrus of the human brain, occupying brodmann areas 41 and 42. it is the first cortical structure to process incoming auditory information. anatomically, the transverse temporal gyri are distinct in that they run mediolaterally (towards the center of the brain) rather than dorsiventrally (front to back) as all other temporal lobe gyri run. the heschl's gyri are named after richard l. heschl.

UBERON:0003941.name: cerebellum anterior vermis
UBERON:0003941.def: the anterior portion of the narrow middle zone between the two hemispheres of the cerebellum that is located anterior to the primary fissure.
UBERON:0003941.synonym: vermis of the anterior lobe of the cerebellum

UBERON:0003942.name: somatosensory system
UBERON:0003942.def: the sensory system for the sense of touch and pain.
UBERON:0003942.synonym: system for detection of somatic senses

UBERON:0003943.name: fourth lumbar dorsal root ganglion
UBERON:0003943.def: the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the fourth lumbar vertebra.

UBERON:0003945.name: somatic motor system
UBERON:0003945.def: the neural tissue involved in the transmission of motor signals.

UBERON:0003946.name: placenta labyrinth
UBERON:0003946.def: the placental layers where embryonic blood vessels are surrounded by trophoblast cells and maternal blood.

UBERON:0003947.name: brain ventricle/choroid plexus
UBERON:0003947.def: the brain ventricles or their associated choroid plexuses.

UBERON:0003948.name: blood-air barrier
UBERON:0003948.def: the membrane between the capillary blood and alveolar air, comprised of the alveolar epithelium and the capillary epithelium and their adherent basement membranes and epithelial cell cytoplasm.

UBERON:0003949.name: tubal tonsil
UBERON:0003949.def: the lymph tissue associated with the pharyngeal opening of the auditory tube.

UBERON:0003950.name: inner ear canal
UBERON:0003950.def: the tubular ducts of the inner ear.

UBERON:0003951.name: ocular fundus
UBERON:0003951.def: the posterior concave interior of the eye, consisting of the retina, the choroid, the posterior segment of the sclera, the optic disk, and blood vessels, visible by an ophthalmoscope.

UBERON:0003952.name: anterior stroma of cornea
UBERON:0003952.def: the anterior segment of the lamellated connective tissue layer of the cornea.

UBERON:0003953.name: posterior stroma of cornea
UBERON:0003953.def: the posterior segment of the lamellated connective tissue layer of the cornea.

UBERON:0003954.name: squamoparietal suture
UBERON:0003954.def: the articulation of the squamous portion of the temporal bones with the parietal bones[mp]. the squamosal suture arches backward from the pterion and connects the temporal squama with the lower border of the parietal: this suture is continuous behind with the short, nearly horizontal parietomastoid suture, which unites the mastoid process of the temporal with the region of the mastoid angle of the parietal[wp].

UBERON:0003955.name: molar crown
UBERON:0003955.def: the part of a molar that is covered by enamel.

UBERON:0003956.name: aqueous drainage system
UBERON:0003956.def: the structures associated with drainage of the aqueous humor from the eye, that include the trabecular meshwork, schlemm's canal, the uveoscleral network, and the aqueous veins.

UBERON:0003957.name: bruch's membrane
UBERON:0003957.def: a transparent, nearly structureless innermost layer of the choroid in contact with the pigmented layer of the retina.

UBERON:0003958.name: long bone epiphyseal ossification zone
UBERON:0003958.def: the layer of the epiphyseal plate where new bone matrix is deposited.

UBERON:0003959.name: rete testis
UBERON:0003959.def: an anastomosing network of delicate tubules located in the hilum of the testicle (mediastinum testis) that carries sperm from the seminiferous tubules to the vasa efferentia[wp].

UBERON:0003960.name: styloid process of temporal bone
UBERON:0003960.def: slender needle-like pointed projection that runs downward and slightly forward from the base of the inferior surface of the petrous portion of the temporal bone where it joins the tympanic portion; it gives attachment to the styloglossus, stylohyoid, and stylopharyngeus muscles and the stylohyoid and stylomandibular ligaments.

UBERON:0003961.name: cingulum of brain
UBERON:0003961.def: the white matter fiber bundle that projects from the cingulate gyrus to the entorhinal cortex in the brain.

UBERON:0003962.name: pterygopalatine ganglion
UBERON:0003962.def: the small parasympathetic ganglion that supplies nerve fibers to the lacrimal, nasal, palatine and pharyngeal glands.

UBERON:0003963.name: otic ganglion
UBERON:0003963.def: the ganglion that supplies nerve fibers to the parotid gland.

UBERON:0003964.name: prevertebral ganglion
UBERON:0003964.def: the sympathetic ganglia located in front of the vertebral column and are associated with the major branches of the abdominal aorta; these include the celiac, aorticorenal, superior and inferior mesenteric ganglia.

UBERON:0003965.name: sympathetic afferent fiber
UBERON:0003965.def: the fibers that conduct sensory nerve impulses from the viscera through the posterior dorsal roots into the spinal cord.

UBERON:0003966.name: gonial bone
UBERON:0003966.def: investing bone that lies on the surface of the malleus.

UBERON:0003967.name: cutaneous elastic tissue
UBERON:0003967.def: the slender connective tissue fiber in the extracellular matrix of skin tissue that is composed of microfibrils and amorphous elastin and is characterized by great elasticity.

UBERON:0003968.name: peripheral lymph node
UBERON:0003968.def: the lymph nodes located outside the thoracic and abdominal cavities, such as the submandibular, prescapular, axillary, inguinal and popliteal lymph nodes.

UBERON:0003970.name: placental labyrinth vasculature
UBERON:0003970.def: blood vessels of the layer of the placenta where embryonic and maternal blood vessels interdigitate.

UBERON:0003971.name: interfrontal bone
UBERON:0003971.def: a bone between the frontal bones in the skull; an extra bony plate within the anterior fontanelle that is not usually present.

UBERON:0003972.name: placenta junctional zone
UBERON:0003972.def: fetally derived placental region that separates the maternal uterine tissue from the placenta labyrinth.

UBERON:0003973.name: nasal concha of ethmoid bone
UBERON:0003973.def: one of the conchae of the ethmoid bone, which occupy the caudal part of the nasal fossae and form the lateral and superior portions of the turbinate bones in mammals[mp]. the ethmoturbinals are associated with the cribiform plate. they are covered with olfactory epithelium. primarily, they serve to increase the surface area over which olfactory receptor neurons can come in contact with respiratory air. these olfactory receptor nerves then synapse with the mitral cells of the olfactory lobes through the cribiform plate in the manner described above[palaeos].

UBERON:0003974.name: upper part of vagina
UBERON:0003974.def: the upper third of the vagina.

UBERON:0003975.name: internal female genitalia
UBERON:0003975.def: the internal feminine genital organs, including the ovaries, uterine tubes, uterus, uterine cervix, and vagina.

UBERON:0003976.name: saccule duct
UBERON:0003976.def: the saccular portion of the utriculosaccular duct that normally extends from the sacculus to the endolymphatic duct.

UBERON:0003977.name: utricle duct
UBERON:0003977.def: the utricular portion of the utriculosaccular duct that normally extends from the utriculus to the endolymphatic duct.

UBERON:0003979.name: utricle valve
UBERON:0003979.def: the utriculo-endolymphatic (ue) valve which is located in the antero-inferior wall of the utricle at the orifice of the utricular duct and serves to regulate endolymph volume in the endolymphatic sac, the utricle and the canals.

UBERON:0003980.name: cerebellum fissure
UBERON:0003980.def: one of a set of deep furrows which divide the lobules of the cerebellum. examples: postcentral, primary and secondary furrows.

UBERON:0003981.name: primordial ovarian follicle
UBERON:0003981.def: primordial follicles are indiscernible to the naked eye and develop to primary, secondary, and finally mature vesicular follicles.

UBERON:0003983.name: conus arteriosus
UBERON:0003983.def: a conical pouch formed from the upper and left angle of the right ventricle in the chordate heart, from which the pulmonary artery arises[wp]. the anteriosuperior, smooth-walled portion of the cavity of the right ventricle, beginning at the supraventricular crest and terminates in the pulmonary trunk[mp].

UBERON:0003984.name: uterine tube infundibulum
UBERON:0003984.def: the funnel-like expansion of the abdominal extremity of the uterine tube[mp].

UBERON:0003985.name: major sublingual duct
UBERON:0003985.def: the duct that drains the anterior portion of the sublingual gland and opens at the sublingual papilla.

UBERON:0003986.name: minor sublingual duct
UBERON:0003986.def: any of the 8-20 small ducts that open into the mouth on the surface of the sublingual fold.

UBERON:0003987.name: hassall's corpuscle
UBERON:0003987.def: the small spherical bodies of epithelial cells found in the medulla of the thymus, that are arranged in a concentric pattern around clusters of degenerating lymphocytes, eosinophils and macrophages.

UBERON:0003988.name: thymus corticomedullary boundary
UBERON:0003988.def: the dense region demarcating the thymus medulla from the surrounding cortex that is characterized by numerous blood vessels (predominantly arterioles) with some perivascular connective tissue, mature and immature t lymphocytes, dendritic cells, variable numbers of perivascular b-lymphocytes and plasma cells; site of entry of bone marrow stem cells and exit of mature, functional t cells.

UBERON:0003989.name: medulla oblongata anterior median fissure
UBERON:0003989.def: the longitudinal groove in the midline of the anterior aspect of the medulla oblongata.

UBERON:0003990.name: spinal cord motor column
UBERON:0003990.def: the subclasses of motor neurons which are organized into longitudinally oriented columns that occupy distinct and, in some cases, discontinuous domains along the rostrocaudal axis of the spinal cord; motor neurons within a single column send their axons to a common peripheral target.

UBERON:0003991.name: fourth ventricle median aperture
UBERON:0003991.def: the large midline opening of the posterior inferior part of the roof of the fourth ventricle that connects the fourth ventricle to the posterior cerebromedullary cistern and the spinal cord.

UBERON:0003992.name: fourth ventricle lateral aperture
UBERON:0003992.def: one of the two lateral openings of the fourth ventricle into the subarachnoid space at the cerebellopontine angle[mp].

UBERON:0003993.name: interventricular foramen of cns
UBERON:0003993.def: the paired channels that connect the lateral and third ventricles and allows cerebrospinal fluid produced in the lateral ventricles to flow into the third ventricles.

UBERON:0003994.name: pelvic ligament
UBERON:0003994.def: the dorsal sacroiliac, the sacrotuberal and/or the iliolumbar ligaments associated with the bony ring formed by the pair of hip bones fused at the symphysis and their firm articulation with the sacrum.

UBERON:0003995.name: subarcuate fossa
UBERON:0003995.def: the irregular depression found on the posterior inner surface of the petrous portion of the temporal bone just below its crest and above and lateral to the internal acoustic meatus[mp].

UBERON:0003996.name: cervical vertebra 1 arcus anterior
UBERON:0003996.def: the arch that connects the lateral masses of the atlas anteriorly and articulates with the anterior articular facet of the dens of the axis[mp].

UBERON:0003997.name: hyoid bone greater horn
UBERON:0003997.def: the larger and more lateral of the paired processes on either side of the hyoid bone[mp].

UBERON:0003998.name: hyoid bone lesser horn
UBERON:0003998.def: shorter and more medial of the paired processes on either side of the hyoid bone[mp].

UBERON:0003999.name: hyoid bone body
UBERON:0003999.def: the main curve of the hyoid bone, from which the horns extend.

UBERON:0004000.name: tarsal gland acinus
UBERON:0004000.def: a sac-like structure comprising a sebaceous gland.

UBERON:0004002.name: posterior lobe of cerebellum
UBERON:0004002.def: the region of the cerebellum that is posterior to the primary fissure and anterior to the posteriolateral fissure.

UBERON:0004003.name: cerebellum hemisphere lobule
UBERON:0004003.def: the region of a cerebellar lobule that resides in either of the lateral sections of the cerebellum outside the vermis; in mammals, the vermis portion of the cerebellum has a foliation pattern along the ap axis that is distinct from the lateral cerebellar hemispheres.

UBERON:0004004.name: cerebellum lobule
UBERON:0004004.def: one of the the ten gyri of the cerebellar cortex.
UBERON:0004004.synonym: lobular parts of the cerebellar cortex

UBERON:0004006.name: cerebellum intermediate zone
UBERON:0004006.def: the paired regions of the cerebellar hemisphere that lie adjacent to the vermis and are between the vermis and lateral regions of the hemispheres; it receives input from the corticopontocerebellar fibers that originate from the motor cortex, and also receives sensory feedback from the muscles; these signals are integrated by this region, to coordinate muscle activity with motor inputs.

UBERON:0004008.name: cerebellar plate
UBERON:0004008.def: the embryonic pseudostratified epithelium of the fourth cerebellar ventricle that eventually forms the vermis and ventral neuroepithelium.

UBERON:0004009.name: cerebellum posterior vermis
UBERON:0004009.def: the posterior portion of the narrow middle zone between the two hemispheres of the cerebellum that is located posterior to the primary fissure.
UBERON:0004009.synonym: vermis of the posterior lobe of the cerebellum

UBERON:0004010.name: primary muscle spindle
UBERON:0004010.def: the sensory organ in muscle; involved in the stretch reflex and sensitive to stretch velocity.

UBERON:0004011.name: secondary muscle spindle
UBERON:0004011.def: the sensory organ in muscle; involved in the stretch reflex and not sensitive to stretch velocity.

UBERON:0004012.name: golgi tendon organ
UBERON:0004012.def: the sensory organ in muscle that is involved in regulating muscle tension.

UBERON:0004013.name: egg cylinder
UBERON:0004013.def: the transient cup-like structure of the epiblast that consists of a single layer of embryonic cells.

UBERON:0004014.name: labium minora
UBERON:0004014.def: one of the folds of skin which form the inner lips on both sides of the vaginal opening.

UBERON:0004015.name: embryonic-extraembryonic boundary
UBERON:0004015.def: the connection between the embryo proper and extraembryonic tissues.

UBERON:0004016.name: dermatome
UBERON:0004016.def: a transitional population of migrating mesenchymal cells that derive from somites and that will become dermal cells.

UBERON:0004017.name: periocular mesenchyme
UBERON:0004017.def: the mesenchymal cells that give rise to the corneal endothelium, corneal stroma, sclera, iris stroma, ciliary muscle, ciliary stroma, and trabecular meshwork of the eye[mp].

UBERON:0004019.name: baroreceptor
UBERON:0004019.def: the sensory nerve endings in the wall of the atria of the heart, vena cava, aortic arch and carotid sinus that are sensitive to changes in blood pressure.

UBERON:0004020.name: obsolete embryonic cilium
UBERON:0004020.def: obsolete: the earliest cilia of the mouse embryo found on the cells of the embryonic node.

UBERON:0004021.name: spongiotrophoblast layer
UBERON:0004021.def: the structure of the outer structural layer of the rodent placenta[mp].

UBERON:0004022.name: germinal neuroepithelium
UBERON:0004022.def: the single layer of epithelial cells that lines the early neural tube and develops into the nervous system and into the neural crest cells.

UBERON:0004023.name: ganglionic eminence
UBERON:0004023.def: the transient proliferative population of neurons that expands exponentially during late prenatal development; it is a continuous germinal zone distinct from the ventricular zone that surrounds the brain ventricles[mp].

UBERON:0004024.name: medial ganglionic eminence
UBERON:0004024.def: a distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone; this mass contributes most of its cells to the neocortex; however, hippocampal neurons, thalamus, septum and olfactory bulb neurons are also partly derived from the mge.

UBERON:0004025.name: lateral ganglionic eminence
UBERON:0004025.def: a distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone; this mass contributes most of its cells to the striatum; however, neocortex, thalamus, septum and olfactory bulb neurons are also partly derived from the lge.

UBERON:0004026.name: caudal ganglionic eminence
UBERON:0004026.def: the caudally located, distinct elevation of a transient proliferating cell mass of the fetal subventricular zone, located adjacent to the lateral ventricle.

UBERON:0004027.name: chorionic plate
UBERON:0004027.def: that portion of the chorionic wall in the region of its uterine attachment, which gives rise to chorionic villi; it consists of the mesoderm that lines the chorionic vesicle and, on the maternal side, of the trophoblast that lines the intervillous spaces; in the last half of gestation, the mesodermal connective tissue is largely replaced by fibrinoid material, and the amnionic membrane is adherent to the fetal side of the plate.

UBERON:0004029.name: canal of schlemm
UBERON:0004029.def: the vascular structure encircling the anterior chamber of the eye, through which the aqueous humor is returned to the blood circulation.

UBERON:0004030.name: aqueous vein
UBERON:0004030.def: a vessel that receives aqueous humor from the sinus venosus sclerae (canal of schlemm).

UBERON:0004031.name: head ectomesenchyme
UBERON:0004031.def: mesenchymal cells derived from neural crest cells that contribute to development of the hard and soft tissue in the head and neck, including the branchial arches[mp].

UBERON:0004032.name: podocyte slit diaphragm
UBERON:0004032.def: the thin membrane that covers the podocyte filtration slit which allows small molecules such as water, glucose, and ionic salts to pass through while retaining larger macromolecules in the bloodstream.

UBERON:0004033.name: podocyte slit junction
UBERON:0004033.def: the gaps between the interdigitated foot processes of the podocyte.

UBERON:0004034.name: cutaneous microfibril
UBERON:0004034.def: the fiber-like strand of fibrillin that forms the scaffold of the cutaneous elastic fibers found in the extracellular matrix of the skin.

UBERON:0004035.name: cortical subplate
UBERON:0004035.def: the transient outer neural tube region that contains the first generated post-mitotic neurons that receive synaptic input from thalamic axons and in turn project axons to the developing cortical plate.

UBERON:0004036.name: obsolete retinal cone cell inner segment
UBERON:0004036.def: the retinal cone cell region which contains the machinery of the cell (mitochondria, golgi, endoplasmic reticulum, etc) and where opsin molecules are assembled and passed to be part of the outer segment region.

UBERON:0004037.name: obsolete retinal cone cell outer segment
UBERON:0004037.def: the retinal cone cell region in which the visual pigment rhodopsin is in invaginations of the cell membrane.

UBERON:0004038.name: obsolete retinal rod cell inner segment
UBERON:0004038.def: the retinal rod cell region which contains the machinery of the cell (mitochondria, golgi, endoplasmic reticulum, etc) and where opsin molecules are assembled and passed to be part of the outer segment region.

UBERON:0004039.name: obsolete retinal rod cell outer segment
UBERON:0004039.def: the retinal rod cell region which contains stacks of membranous discs separate from the outer cell membrane that are rich in the visual pigment rhodopsin.

UBERON:0004040.name: cortical intermediate zone
UBERON:0004040.def: the region of the developing mammalian cortex that extends between the ventricular zone and the cortical plate (cp); normally, the iz is a region of tangential migration of cells, and at midgestation, the lower part of the iz develops into the subventricular zone.

UBERON:0004041.name: spleen primary b follicle
UBERON:0004041.def: the nodules of small undifferentiated b lymphocytes and follicular dendritic cells located in the spleen white pulp.

UBERON:0004042.name: spleen secondary b follicle
UBERON:0004042.def: the nodules of antigen-activated, differentiating b cells, follicular dendritic cells, antigen-presenting t cells and macrophages in the spleen white pulp.

UBERON:0004043.name: semicircular canal ampulla
UBERON:0004043.def: the spherical enlargement at the base of each semicircular canal where they connect with the utricle, containing the crista ampullaris which detects movement of the fluid within the canals.

UBERON:0004044.name: anterior visceral endoderm
UBERON:0004044.def: the extraembryonic tissue that is responsible for the proper orientation of the anterior-posterior axis of the embryo and for appropriate patterning of adjacent embryonic tissue.

UBERON:0004045.name: tailgut
UBERON:0004045.def: the extension of the hindgut of the primitive digestive tube of the embryo, caudal to the location of the anal opening.

UBERON:0004046.name: anterior definitive endoderm
UBERON:0004046.def: the mesendoderm which first migrates from the node and which gives rise to the gut.

UBERON:0004047.name: basal cistern
UBERON:0004047.def: the enclosed space where the arachnoid membrane stretches between the two temporal lobes and encloses the cerebral peduncles including the structures contained in the interpeduncular fossa.

UBERON:0004048.name: pontine cistern
UBERON:0004048.def: the space located on lateral aspects of the pons at the junction with the celebellum.

UBERON:0004049.name: cerebellomedullary cistern
UBERON:0004049.def: the largest of the subarachnoid cisterns between the cerebellum and the medulla oblongata; it is divided into a posterior cerebellomedullary cistern located between the cerebellum and the posterior surface of the medulla (also called cisterna magna), and a lateral cerebellomedullary cistern located between the cerebellum and the lateral aspect of the medulla.

UBERON:0004050.name: subarachnoid cistern
UBERON:0004050.def: the widening portions of the subarachnoid space within the cranium where the arachnoid bridges over a depression on the surface of the brain.

UBERON:0004051.name: lateral cerebellomedullary cistern
UBERON:0004051.def: the space between the cerebellum and the lateral aspect of the medulla.

UBERON:0004052.name: quadrigeminal cistern
UBERON:0004052.def: the enclosed space extending forward between the corpus callosum and the thalamus that contains the internal cerebral veins.

UBERON:0004053.name: external male genitalia
UBERON:0004053.def: the external masculine genital organs, including the penis and scrotum.

UBERON:0004054.name: internal male genitalia
UBERON:0004054.def: the internal masculine genital organs, including the testes, epididymides, deferent ducts, seminal vesicles, prostate, ejaculatory ducts, and bulbourethral glands.

UBERON:0004055.name: primitive pit
UBERON:0004055.def: the small depression in the primitive streak that is caudal to the primitive node where the cells of the epiblast initially begin to invaginate during early embryogenesis.

UBERON:0004056.name: primitive groove
UBERON:0004056.def: the shallow valley that extends along the length of the primitive streak[mp].

UBERON:0004057.name: skeletal muscle fiber triad
UBERON:0004057.def: the skeletal muscle fiber structure comprised of the transverse tubule and the two associated terminal cisternae; each fiber normally has thousands of triads.

UBERON:0004058.name: biliary ductule
UBERON:0004058.def: one of the fine terminal elements of the bile duct system, leaving the portal canal, and pursuing a course at the periphery of a lobule of the liver[bto]. the excretory ducts of the liver that connect the interlobular ductules to the right or left hepatic duct[mp].

UBERON:0004059.name: spinal cord medial motor column
UBERON:0004059.def: the subclasses of motor neurons which project their axons to axial muscles that lie close to the vertebral column; motor neurons in the lateral subdivision of the mmc project their axons to body wall muscles.

UBERON:0004060.name: neural tube ventricular layer
UBERON:0004060.def: the layer of undifferentiated, proliferating cells that line the neural tube lumen that is the immediate transformation of the germinal neuroepithelium.

UBERON:0004061.name: neural tube mantle layer
UBERON:0004061.def: the layer of glia and differentiating neurons that forms as a second layer around the germinal neuroepithium; as this develops it comes to lie between the ventricular and marginal layers and includes the basal and alar plates. develops into neurons and glia forming a gray matter layer.

UBERON:0004062.name: neural tube marginal layer
UBERON:0004062.def: the outermost layer of the neural tube that consists of axons from the developing mantle layer and will form the white matter.

UBERON:0004063.name: spinal cord alar plate
UBERON:0004063.def: the region of the mantle layer of the neural tube that lies dorsal to the sulcus limitans and contains primarily sensory neurons and interneurons involved in communication of sensory impulses; the alar plate develops into the dorsal horn in the grey matter of the spinal cord.

UBERON:0004064.name: neural tube basal plate
UBERON:0004064.def: the region of the mantle layer of the neural tube that lies ventral to the sulcus limitans and contains primarily motor neurons and interneurons.

UBERON:0004066.name: frontonasal prominence
UBERON:0004066.def: the unpaired embryonic prominence that is formed by the tissues surrounding the forebrain vesicle and develops into the forehead and bridge of the nose/snout.

UBERON:0004067.name: lateral nasal prominence
UBERON:0004067.def: the lateral area of the two branches of a horseshoe-shaped mesenchymal swelling in the future nasal region of the embryo; it separates the olfactory pit from the developing eye and the ala of the nose/snout develops from it.

UBERON:0004068.name: medial nasal prominence
UBERON:0004068.def: the central area of the two limbs of a horseshoe-shaped mesenchymal swelling that lie medial to the olfactory placode or pit in the future nasal region of the embryo; it joins with the ipsilateral maxillary prominence in the formation of half of the upper jaw, and the nasal tip and philtrum of the upper lip develop from it.

UBERON:0004069.name: accessory olfactory bulb
UBERON:0004069.def: the forebrain region that coordinates sensory signaling arising from the vomeronasal organ; it is located on the dorsal-posterior portion of the main olfactory bulb, and the axons that leave the accessory olfactory bulb project to targets in the amygdala and hypothalamus.

UBERON:0004070.name: cerebellum vermis lobule
UBERON:0004070.def: the region of a cerebellar lobule that resides in the central section of the cerebellum between the two hemispheres.

UBERON:0004073.name: cerebellum interpositus nucleus
UBERON:0004073.def: the nucleus composed of the globose and emoliform nuclei of the cerebellum; in some mammalian species the globose nucleus is not distinguishable.

UBERON:0004078.name: cerebellum vermis lobule ix
UBERON:0004078.def: the uvula (uvular lobe) forms a considerable portion of the inferior vermis; it is separated on either side from the tonsil by the sulcus valleculc&, at the bottom of which it is connected to the tonsil by a ridge of gray matter, indented on its surface by shallow furrows, and hence called the furrowed band.

UBERON:0004084.name: genital labium
UBERON:0004084.def: one of the folds of skin which form the inner lips (labia minora) and outer lips (labia majora) on both sides of the vaginal opening.

UBERON:0004085.name: labium majora
UBERON:0004085.def: one of the folds of skin which form the outer lips on both sides of the vaginal opening.

UBERON:0004086.name: brain ventricle
UBERON:0004086.def: one of the system of communicating cavities in the brain that are continuous with the central canal of the spinal cord, that like it are derived from the medullary canal of the embryo, that are lined with an epithelial ependyma, and that contain a serous fluid.
UBERON:0004086.synonym: region of ventricular system of brain

UBERON:0004087.name: vena cava
UBERON:0004087.def: any of the veins that carries deoxygenated blood from a part of the body into the right atrium of the heart.

UBERON:0004088.name: orbital region
UBERON:0004088.def: the subdivision of the face that includes the eye (eyeball plus adnexa such as eyelids) and the orbit of the skull and associated parts of the face such as the eyebrows, if present.

UBERON:0004089.name: midface
UBERON:0004089.def: the middle of the face including the nose and its associated bony structures[mw].

UBERON:0004096.name: odontoid process of cervical vertebra 2
UBERON:0004096.def: the toothlike process on the upper surface of the axis, which articulates with the atlas above[gaid].

UBERON:0004099.name: joint space of elbow
UBERON:0004099.def: joint cavity shared by all the joints of the elbow. the elbow joint is a compound joint that actually comprises three separate joints: the joints connecting the upper and lower arm: 1) articulatio humero-ulnaris and 2) articulatio humero-radialis as well as the proximal joint connecting the forarm bones: 3) articulatio radio-ulnaris proximalis. all three share a joint cavity which is highly sinuated/scalloped/coved. joint spaces of the elbow summarizes the joint cavity shared by all three adjoining joints of the elbow joint.

UBERON:0004100.name: renal collecting system
UBERON:0004100.def: the collecting duct system of the kidney consists of a series of tubules and ducts that connect the nephrons to the ureter. it participates in electrolyte and fluid balance through reabsorption and excretion, processes regulated by the hormones aldosterone and antidiuretic hormone.

UBERON:0004103.name: alveolar ridge
UBERON:0004103.def: one of the two jaw ridges either on the roof of the mouth between the upper teeth and the hard palate or on the bottom of the mouth behind the lower teeth[wp]. the alveolar ridges contain the sockets (alveoli) of the teeth[hp].

UBERON:0004104.name: hairline
UBERON:0004104.def: anatomical line demarcating the boundary between forehead and scalp.

UBERON:0004105.name: subungual region
UBERON:0004105.def: region beneath a nail or claw.

UBERON:0004106.name: crus of ear
UBERON:0004106.def: horizontal piece of cartilage located outside the ear canal that divides the upper and lower parts of the ear.

UBERON:0004108.name: clivus of occipital bone
UBERON:0004108.def: part of the cranium, the clivus is a shallow depression behind the dorsum sellc& that slopes obliquely backward. it forms a gradual sloping process at the anterior most portion of the basilar occipital bone at its junction with the sphenoid bone. on axial planes, it sits just posterior to the sphenoid sinuses. just lateral to the clivus bilaterally is the foramen lacerum which contains the internal carotid artery, proximal to its anastamosis with the circle of willis. posterior to the clivus is the basilar artery. the clivus supports the upper part of the pons.

UBERON:0004109.name: cortex of humerus
UBERON:0004109.def: the outer or sperficial part of the humerus.

UBERON:0004110.name: midnasal cavity
UBERON:0004110.def: an anatomical cavity that is the combination of the cavity between the nares and the choanae[hp,modified].

UBERON:0004111.name: anatomical conduit
UBERON:0004111.def: any tube, opening or passage that connects two distinct anatomical spaces.

UBERON:0004113.name: muscle of auditory ossicle
UBERON:0004113.def: a muscle of the tympanic cavity that attaches to an auditory ossicle.

UBERON:0004114.name: tympanic cavity
UBERON:0004114.def: small cavity surrounding the bones of the middle ear.

UBERON:0004115.name: blood vessel of tympanic cavity
UBERON:0004115.def: a blood vessel that is part of a tympanic cavity [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004116.name: nerve of tympanic cavity
UBERON:0004116.def: a nerve that is part of a tympanic cavity [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004117.name: pharyngeal pouch
UBERON:0004117.def: an internal pocketing of pharyngeal endoderm that contacts a region of ectoderm (a pharyngeal cleft) and interdigitates in the anterior and posterior directions with the pharyngeal arches.

UBERON:0004118.name: vasculature of iris
UBERON:0004118.def: a vasculature that is part of a iris [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004119.name: endoderm-derived structure
UBERON:0004119.def: an anatomical structure that develops (entirely or partially) from the endoderm.

UBERON:0004120.name: mesoderm-derived structure
UBERON:0004120.def: an anatomical structure that develops (entirely or partially) from the mesoderm.

UBERON:0004121.name: ectoderm-derived structure
UBERON:0004121.def: an anatomical structure that develops (entirely or partially) from the ectoderm.

UBERON:0004122.name: genitourinary system
UBERON:0004122.def: anatomical system that has as its parts the organs concerned with the production and excretion of urine and those concerned with reproduction.

UBERON:0004123.name: myocardial layer
UBERON:0004123.def: any of the layers of the myocardium. example: compact layer, trabecular layer.

UBERON:0004124.name: myocardium trabecular layer
UBERON:0004124.def: the layer of the myocardium composed of projections of contractile myocytes. the trabecular layer is bounded internally by the endocardium. in zebrafish, unlike the trabeculations of higher vertebrates, both atrial and ventricular trabeculae have more strut-like character, and are more uniform without apparent regional differences[zfa].

UBERON:0004125.name: myocardial compact layer
UBERON:0004125.def: outer dense layer of the myocardium uniting the epicardium and myocardium[mp].

UBERON:0004126.name: trabecular layer of ventricle
UBERON:0004126.def: a myocardium trabecular layer that is part of a cardiac ventricle.

UBERON:0004127.name: compact layer of ventricle
UBERON:0004127.def: the outer layer the ventricular myocardium, muscle fibers are arranged in a compact form and involved the entire ventricle.

UBERON:0004128.name: optic vesicle
UBERON:0004128.def: the optic vesicle is the evagination of neurectoderm that precedes formation of the optic cup[go]. portion of tissue that is comprised of neuroepitheium which has pinched off from the anterior neural keel and will form the optic cup[zfa].

UBERON:0004129.name: growth plate cartilage
UBERON:0004129.def: cartilage that will provide a scaffold for mineralization of endochondral bones as they elongate or grow.

UBERON:0004130.name: cerebellar layer
UBERON:0004130.def: a cortical cell layer of the cerebellum. examples: the granular (inner+outer) layer, molecular layer, purkinje cell layer, and the ventricular layer of the embryo.

UBERON:0004132.name: trigeminal sensory nucleus
UBERON:0004132.def: the sensory trigeminal nerve nuclei are the largest of the cranial nerve nuclei, and extend through the whole of the midbrain, pons and medulla. the nucleus is divided into three parts, from rostral to caudal (top to bottom in humans): * the mesencephalic nucleus * the chief sensory nucleus (or pontine nucleus or main sensory nucleus or primary nucleus) * the spinal trigeminal nucleus[wp].

UBERON:0004134.name: proximal tubule
UBERON:0004134.def: in mammals, the proximal tubule is a nephron tubule that connects bowman's capsule to the loop of henle. it has a brush border epithelial morphology[go].

UBERON:0004135.name: distal tubule
UBERON:0004135.def: the distal tubule is a nephron tubule that consists of the distal convoluted tubule and distal straight tubule segments.

UBERON:0004136.name: intermediate tubule
UBERON:0004136.def: the intermediate tubule is a nephron tubule that lies between the proximal and distal tubules.

UBERON:0004138.name: somitomeric trunk muscle
UBERON:0004138.def: the somitomeric trunk muscle is derived from somitomeric mesoderm. the muscle begins its development with the differentiation of the muscle cells and ends with the mature muscle. an example of this process is found in mus musculus.[go].

UBERON:0004139.name: cardiogenic plate
UBERON:0004139.def: the first recognizable structure derived from the heart field.

UBERON:0004140.name: primary heart field
UBERON:0004140.def: a specific region of the lateral mesoderm that will form the primary beating heart tube. in mammals the primary heart field gives rise to the left ventricle.

UBERON:0004141.name: heart tube
UBERON:0004141.def: an epithelial tube that will give rise to the mature heart.

UBERON:0004142.name: outflow tract septum
UBERON:0004142.def: the outflow tract septum is a partition in the outflow tract.

UBERON:0004145.name: outflow tract
UBERON:0004145.def: the outflow tract is the portion of the heart through which blood flows into the arteries.

UBERON:0004146.name: his-purkinje system
UBERON:0004146.def: the his-purkinje system receives signals from the av node and is composed of the fibers that regulate cardiac muscle contraction in the ventricles.

UBERON:0004148.name: cardiac vein
UBERON:0004148.def: vein of heart that drains the myocardium.

UBERON:0004149.name: ventriculo bulbo valve
UBERON:0004149.def: a heart valve located between the ventricle and bulbus arteriosus.

UBERON:0004150.name: coronary sinus valve
UBERON:0004150.def: vestigial cardiac valve which is continuous with the valve of the inferior vena cava[fma].

UBERON:0004151.name: cardiac chamber
UBERON:0004151.def: a cardiac chamber surrounds an enclosed cavity within the heart.

UBERON:0004152.name: bulbus arteriosus
UBERON:0004152.def: the bulbus arteriosus is an elastic heart chamber[go]. multi-tissue structure that consists of three layers and through which the blood exits the heart. the bulbus arteriosus is a pear shaped chamber that functions as a capacitor, maintaining continuous blood flow into the gill arches[zfa].

UBERON:0004153.name: ventricular septum intermedium
UBERON:0004153.def: endocardial cushions project into the atrial canal, and, meeting in the middle line, unite to form the septum intermedium which divides the canal into two channels, the future right and left atrioventricular orifices[gray's via wp].

UBERON:0004154.name: atrial septum primum
UBERON:0004154.def: in the developing heart, the cavity of the primitive atrium becomes subdivided into right and left chambers by a septum, the septum primum, which grows downward into the cavity. the increasingly smaller gap below it (before it fuses with the endocardial cushion) is known as the ostium primum. the septum primum eventually fuses with the endocardial cushion, closing the ostium primum off completely. meanwhile, perforations appear in the superior part of the septum primum, forming the ostium secundum. this will eventually form part of the fossa ovalis.

UBERON:0004160.name: proepicardium
UBERON:0004160.def: an embryonic group of progenitor cells that forms from an outpouching of the septum transversum near the venous pole of the heart and gives rise to the epicardium.

UBERON:0004161.name: septum transversum
UBERON:0004161.def: a thick plate of mesodermal tissue that occupies the space between the thoracic cavity and yolk stalk in the early embryo, forming a transverse partition partially separating the coelomic cavity into thoracic and abdominal portions. it gives rise to the central tendon of the diaphragm[vhog].

UBERON:0004162.name: pulmonary myocardium
UBERON:0004162.def: the pulmonary myocardium is the myocardial tissue present in the pulmonary vein.

UBERON:0004163.name: anterior ectodermal midgut
UBERON:0004163.def: portions of the midgut that are derived from ectoderm.

UBERON:0004164.name: branchiomeric muscle
UBERON:0004164.def: a jaw muscle that arises from cranial mesenchyme and is innervated by cranial nerves.

UBERON:0004167.name: orbitofrontal cortex
UBERON:0004167.def: the region of the cerebral cortex covering the basal surface of the frontal lobes; this region normally controls emotion and decision making.
UBERON:0004167.synonym: segment of cortex of frontal lobe

UBERON:0004170.name: spinal cord ventral commissure
UBERON:0004170.def: the band of nerve fibers which cross the midline of the spinal cord ventral to the central canal and posterior grey commissure[mp]. the anterior (or ventral) white commissure, also known as the alba anterior medullae spinalis, is a bundle of nerve fibers which cross the midline of the spinal cord just anterior to the gray commissure. a n4 fibers and c fibers carrying pain sensation in the spinothalamic tract contribute to this commissure, as do fibers of the anterior corticospinal tract, which carry motor signals from the primary motor cortex[wp].

UBERON:0004171.name: trigeminothalamic tract
UBERON:0004171.def: the trigeminothalamic tract is one of the major routes of nociceptive and temperature signaling from the face.

UBERON:0004172.name: pons reticulospinal tract
UBERON:0004172.def: axon tract that carries efferent (outgoing) action potentials from the cell body in the pons towards target cells in the spinal cord.

UBERON:0004173.name: medulla reticulospinal tract
UBERON:0004173.def: axon tract that carries efferent (outgoing) action potentials from the cell body in the medulla towards target cells in the spinal cord[go].

UBERON:0004174.name: obsolete leg joint
UBERON:0004174.def: joint in the leg. for example the knee, which separates the leg tibia and femur.

UBERON:0004175.name: internal genitalia
UBERON:0004175.def: the internal genitalia are the internal sex organs such as the uterine tube, the uterus and the vagina in female mammals, and the testis, seminal vesicle, ejaculatory duct and prostate in male mammals.

UBERON:0004176.name: external genitalia
UBERON:0004176.def: the external genitalia are the outer sex organs, such as the penis or vulva in mammals.

UBERON:0004177.name: hemopoietic organ
UBERON:0004177.def: organ that is part of the hematopoietic system.

UBERON:0004178.name: aorta smooth muscle tissue
UBERON:0004178.def: the nonstriated, involuntary muscle tissue located in the wall of the aorta.

UBERON:0004179.name: prostate glandular acinus
UBERON:0004179.def: a saclike structure of the prostate gland, comprised of at least three cell layers: an innermost layer of secretory columnar luminal epithelium, a middle layer of squamous basal epithelium that also contains neuroendocrine cells, transit amplifying cells, and stem cells, and an outer layer of smooth muscle intermixed with other stromal cells.

UBERON:0004180.name: mammary gland fat
UBERON:0004180.def: the mammary fat is an adipose structure in the gland that is invaded by the mammary ducts.

UBERON:0004182.name: mammary gland cord
UBERON:0004182.def: the solid cord of epithelial cells that emerges from the mammary bud and grows down from the primary mammary mesenchyme and into a second stromal compartment, the fat pad precursor, beneath the dermis.

UBERON:0004183.name: placental labyrinth blood vessel
UBERON:0004183.def: the embryonic vessels grow through the layer to come in close contact with the maternal blood supply.

UBERON:0004184.name: prostate gland stroma
UBERON:0004184.def: the prostate gland stroma is made up of the mesenchymal or fibroblast cells of the prostate gland.

UBERON:0004185.name: endodermal part of digestive tract
UBERON:0004185.def: a portions of the gut that is derived from endoderm.

UBERON:0004186.name: olfactory bulb mitral cell layer
UBERON:0004186.def: the mitral cell layer is composed of pyramidal neurons whose cell bodies are located between the granule cell layer and the plexiform layer.
UBERON:0004186.synonym: olfactory bulb main mitral cell body layer

UBERON:0004187.name: harderian gland
UBERON:0004187.def: the harderian gland is an anterior orbital gland usually associated with the nictitating membrane, and produces and secretes a variety of substances to the eye, depending upon the species[go].

UBERON:0004188.name: glomerular epithelium
UBERON:0004188.def: the glomerular epithelium is an epithelial tissue that covers the outer surfaces of the glomerulus. the glomerular epithelium consists of both parietal and visceral epithelium. metanephric glomerular parietal epithelial cells are specialized epithelial cells that form tight junctions as a barrier to protein transport. a metanephric glomerular visceral epithelial cell is a specialized epithelial cell that contains 'feet' that interdigitate with the 'feet' of other glomerular epithelial cells in the metanephros.

UBERON:0004189.name: glomerular endothelium
UBERON:0004189.def: the glomerular endothelium is an epithelial tissue that covers the internal surfaces of the glomerulus.

UBERON:0004190.name: renal glomerulus vasculature
UBERON:0004190.def: the glomerulus vasculature is composed of the tubule structures that carry blood or lymph in the glomerulus.

UBERON:0004193.name: loop of henle ascending limb thin segment
UBERON:0004193.def: a sub-portion of the loop of henle in the nephron of the kidney that is permeable to ions but not to water.
UBERON:0004193.synonym: thin ascending limb of loop of henle

UBERON:0004194.name: long nephron
UBERON:0004194.def: long nephrons are associated with juxtamedullary glomeruli and extend to the inner medulla.

UBERON:0004195.name: short nephron
UBERON:0004195.def: short nephrons are associated with mid-cortical glomeruli, and have no short ascending limb, so the limb is situated in the outer medulla.

UBERON:0004196.name: proximal convoluted tubule segment 1
UBERON:0004196.def: the s1 portion is the initial portion of the proximal convoluted tubule and is responsible for avid reabsorption of water and solutes[go].

UBERON:0004197.name: proximal convoluted tubule segment 2
UBERON:0004197.def: the s2 portion of the tubule is involved in reabsorption of water and sodium chloride[go].

UBERON:0004198.name: comma-shaped body
UBERON:0004198.def: the comma-shaped body is the precursor structure to the s-shaped body that contributes to the morphogenesis of the nephron.

UBERON:0004199.name: s-shaped body
UBERON:0004199.def: the s-shaped body is the successor of the comma-shaped body that contributes to the morphogenesis of the nephron.

UBERON:0004200.name: kidney pyramid
UBERON:0004200.def: kidney pyramids are the conical arrangements of tubules that constitute the renal medulla in a multi-lobed mammalian kidney; they contain the loops of henle and the medullary collecting ducts.

UBERON:0004201.name: kidney outer medulla inner stripe
UBERON:0004201.def: the inner stripe is a deep, centrally located portion of the renal outer medulla and is traversed by thick and thin portions of nephron tubules.

UBERON:0004202.name: kidney outer medulla outer stripe
UBERON:0004202.def: the outer stripe is the region of the kidney that lies distal to the line of termination of the straight renal tubules.

UBERON:0004203.name: cortical collecting duct
UBERON:0004203.def: the cortical collecting duct is the portion of the collecting duct that resides in the renal cortex.

UBERON:0004204.name: outer medullary collecting duct
UBERON:0004204.def: the outer medullary collecting duct is the portion of the collecting duct that lies in the renal outer medulla.

UBERON:0004205.name: inner medullary collecting duct
UBERON:0004205.def: the inner medullary collecting duct is the portion of the collecting duct that lies in the renal inner medulla.

UBERON:0004206.name: long descending thin limb bend
UBERON:0004206.def: the long descending thin limb bend is a part of the descending thin limb of a long nephron that lies beyond the prebend segment.

UBERON:0004207.name: prebend segment of loop of henle
UBERON:0004207.def: the prebend segment is a part of the descending thin limb that lies before the bend and exhibits robust sodium chloride reabsorption.

UBERON:0004208.name: nephrogenic mesenchyme
UBERON:0004208.def: nephrogenic mesenchyme is the tissue made up of loosely connected mesenchymal cells in the nephron.

UBERON:0004209.name: renal vesicle
UBERON:0004209.def: the renal vesicle is the primordial structure of the nephron epithelium, and is formed by the condensation of mesenchymal cells.

UBERON:0004211.name: nephron epithelium
