UBERON:0004211.def: the nephron epithelium is a tissue that covers the surface of a nephron.

UBERON:0004212.name: glomerular capillary
UBERON:0004212.def: the small branching blood vessels in the kidney glomerulus that receives blood from the kidney afferent arterioles; these capillaries are under high pressure for filtering within the glomerulus.

UBERON:0004288.name: skeleton
UBERON:0004288.def: anatomical cluster that consists of all the skeletal elements (eg., bone, cartilage, and teeth) of the body.

UBERON:0004289.name: radula
UBERON:0004289.def: an anatomical structure found in mollusks and used for feeding. it is a minutely toothed, chitinous ribbon. it is typically used for scraping or cutting food before the food enters the esophagus. the radula is unique to the molluscs, and is found in all classes of mollusks except for the bivalves.

UBERON:0004290.name: dermomyotome
UBERON:0004290.def: the bilaminar epithelium formed from the myotome and dermatome.

UBERON:0004291.name: heart rudiment
UBERON:0004291.def: a cone-like structure that is formed when myocardial progenitor cells of the heart field fuse at the midline. the heart rudiment is the first structure of the heart tube.

UBERON:0004292.name: cardiac skeleton
UBERON:0004292.def: dense connective tissue that separates the atria from the ventricles and provides physical support for the heart.

UBERON:0004339.name: vault of skull
UBERON:0004339.def: upper part of skull, consisting of parietals, frontals, post-parietals, and in some species the squamosal and a portion of the alisphenoid.

UBERON:0004340.name: allantois
UBERON:0004340.def: a membranous sac that develops from the posterior part of the alimentary canal in the embryos of mammals, birds, and reptiles, and it is important in the formation of the umbilical cord and placenta in mammals[vhog].

UBERON:0004341.name: primitive streak
UBERON:0004341.def: the primitive streak is a structure that forms during the early stages of avian, reptilian and mammalian embryonic development[wp]. the midline ridge of the embryonic epiblast that later develops into mesoderm and endoderm[mp].

UBERON:0004344.name: cardinal vein
UBERON:0004344.def: any of the four veins in the developing vertebrate embryo which run along each side of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0004345.name: trophectoderm
UBERON:0004345.def: outermost layer of cells in the blastodermic vesicle, which will develop into the trophoblast layer and then contact the endometrium and take part in establishing the embryo's means of nutrition.

UBERON:0004346.name: gubernaculum (male or female)
UBERON:0004346.def: embryonic structures which begin as undifferentiated mesenchyme attaching to the caudal end of the gonads. the gubernaculum is present only during the development of the urinary and reproductive organs, being replaced by distinct vestiges in males and females[wp]. enitoinguinal ligaments that, in the male, connect the fetal testis to the developing scrotum, and, in the female, connect the ovaries to the uterus[mp].

UBERON:0004347.name: limb bud
UBERON:0004347.def: an outgrowth on the lateral trunk of the embryo that develops into a limb. the limb bud is divided into ectoderm and mesenchyme[cjm, modified from mp].

UBERON:0004348.name: optic eminence
UBERON:0004348.def: the embryonic structure that gives rise to the corneal ectoderm.

UBERON:0004353.name: female inguinal canal
UBERON:0004353.def: an inguinal canal that is part of a female organism. conveys the round ligament + the ilioinguinal nerve.[wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0004354.name: male inguinal canal
UBERON:0004354.def: an inguinal canal that is part of a male organism. conveys the spermatic cord and its coverings + the ilioinguinal nerve.[wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0004356.name: apical ectodermal ridge
UBERON:0004356.def: multilayered ectodermal region at the distal tip of a limb or fin bud necessary for the proper development of the underlying mesenchyme[mp,modified]. along with the zone of polarizing activity, it is a crucial organizing region during limb development[wp].

UBERON:0004357.name: paired limb/fin bud
UBERON:0004357.def: an outgrowth on the lateral trunk of the embryo that develops into a limb or paired fin. the limb/fin bud is divided into ectoderm and mesenchyme[cjm, modified from mp].

UBERON:0004361.name: stylohyoid ligament
UBERON:0004361.def: the fibrous cord that connects the tip of the styloid process of the temporal bone to the lesser horn of the hyoid bone.

UBERON:0004362.name: pharyngeal arch 1
UBERON:0004362.def: the first of the series of pharyngeal arches that develop into jaw bones or their homologs, and their associated nerves and arteries.

UBERON:0004363.name: pharyngeal arch artery
UBERON:0004363.def: one of a series of paired embryological vascular structures formed within a pharyngeal arch; in the adult, some of these vessels give rise to the great vessels[mp].

UBERON:0004364.name: ectoplacental cone
UBERON:0004364.def: thickened trophoblast of the blastocyst in rodents that becomes the fetal portion of the placenta.

UBERON:0004365.name: vitelline blood vessel
UBERON:0004365.def: blood vessel that is connected to the yolk sac.

UBERON:0004366.name: extraembryonic ectoderm
UBERON:0004366.def: layer of the endoderm of the extraembryonic tissue.

UBERON:0004367.name: descemet's membrane
UBERON:0004367.def: a transparent homogeneous acellular layer found between the substantia propria and the endothelial layer of the cornea[mp].

UBERON:0004368.name: reichert's cartilage
UBERON:0004368.def: a continuous cartilaginous formation in mesenchyme of the second pharyngeal arch in the embryo. the longer cranial or styloid segment is continuous with the otic capsule; its inferior end is angulated and is situated very close to the oropharynx. the smaller caudal segment is in contact with the body and greater horn of the hyoid cartilaginous structure.

UBERON:0004369.name: reichert's membrane
UBERON:0004369.def: an nonvascular extraembryonic basement membrane that forms on the inner surface of the trophectoderm during placenta morphogenesis and is secreted by the distal parietal endoderm; required for the maternofetal exchange of nutrients and is important for the postgastrulation development[mp]. a thick multilayered basement membrane between the parietal endoderm cells and the trophoblast cells.

UBERON:0004370.name: anterior limiting lamina of cornea
UBERON:0004370.def: a transparent homogeneous acellular layer, 6 to 9 um thick, lying between the basal lamina of the outer layer of stratified epithelium and the substantia propria of the cornea; it is considered to be a basement membrane.

UBERON:0004374.name: vitelline vasculature
UBERON:0004374.def: vascular network that is connected to the yolk sac.

UBERON:0004545.def: any of the series of white matter fiber tracts in the brain that run between the most lateral segment of the lentiform nucleus and the claustrum; the white matter of the external capsule contains fibers known as corticocortical association fibers which are responsible for connecting the cerebral cortex to another cortical area; the capsule appears as a thin white sheet of white matter and provides a route for cholinergic fibers from the basal forebrain to the cerebral cortex; it eventually joins the internal capsule around the lentiform nucleus.

UBERON:0004571.def: the part of the arterial system which carries oxygenated blood away from the heart to the body, and returns deoxygenated blood back to the heart.

UBERON:0004616.name: mammalian cervical vertebra 7
UBERON:0004616.def: vertebra prominens is the proper name for the seventh cervical vertebra. the most distinctive characteristic of this vertebra is the existence of a long and prominent spinous process which is palpable from the skin surface, hence the name. this spinous process is thick, nearly horizontal in direction, not bifurcated, but terminating in a tubercle to which the lower end of the ligamentum nuchae is attached. the seventh cervical vertebra (c7) has the most prominent spinous process only in about 70% of people; in the remainder, either c6 or t1 (the first thoracic vertebra) will be the most prominent. the transverse processes are of considerable size, their posterior roots are large and prominent, while the anterior are small and faintly marked; the upper surface of each has usually a shallow sulcus for the eighth spinal nerve, and its extremity seldom presents more than a trace of bifurcation. the foramen transversarium may be as large as that in the other cervical vertebrae, but is generally smaller on one or both sides; occasionally it is double, sometimes it is absent. on the left side it occasionally gives passage to the vertebral artery; more frequently the vertebral vein traverses it on both sides; but the usual arrangement is for both artery and vein to pass in front of the transverse process, and not through the foramen. sometimes the anterior root of the transverse process attains a large size and exists as a separate bone, which is known as a cervical rib.

UBERON:0004637.def: the capsule surrounding the inner ear mechanism.

UBERON:0004638.def: an endothelium that lines the blood vasculature. other endothelia may line lymph vessels, the heart.

UBERON:0004639.name: renal afferent arteriole
UBERON:0004639.def: the blood vessels that branch from the kidney interlobular artery, convey blood to the glomerular capillaries, and play an important role in the regulation of blood pressure as a part of the tubuloglomerular feedback mechanism.

UBERON:0004640.name: renal efferent arteriole
UBERON:0004640.def: the blood vessels that convey blood from the glomerulocapillary network to the capillary bed of the proximal convoluted tubule.

UBERON:0004643.def: an ependyma that is part of a lateral ventricle [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004646.name: infraorbital artery
UBERON:0004646.def: the infraorbital artery is an artery in the head that runs in the maxilla, emerging through the infraorbital foramen, just under the orbit of the eye. [wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0004647.name: liver lobule
UBERON:0004647.def: the polygonal structure of the liver that consists of hepatocytes radiating outward from a hepatic vein.

UBERON:0004648.name: esophagus muscularis mucosa
UBERON:0004648.def: a muscularis mucosa that is part of a esophagus.

UBERON:0004649.name: sphenoid bone pterygoid process
UBERON:0004649.def: the process projecting downward from either side of the sphenoid bone, in vertebrates divided into two plates, an inner and an outer (sometimes called the lateral and medial); the posterior nares pass through the space, called the pterygoid fossa, between the processes.

UBERON:0004650.name: tongue keratinized epithelium
UBERON:0004650.def: a keratinized stratified squamous epithelium that is part of a tongue.

UBERON:0004651.name: scapula spine
UBERON:0004651.def: the triangular ridge on the dorsal aspect of the scapula which separates the supra- from the infraspinatous fossa and where the trapezius and deltoid muscles are attached.

UBERON:0004652.name: humerus diaphysis
UBERON:0004652.def: the body or shaft of the humerus is almost cylindrical in the upper half of its extent, prismatic and flattened below, and has three borders and three surfaces.

UBERON:0004654.name: temporal process of zygomatic bone
UBERON:0004654.def: the temporal process of the zygomatic bone, directed backward and medialward, is concave, presenting medially a rough, triangular area, for articulation with the maxilla, and laterally a smooth, concave surface, the upper part of which forms the anterior boundary of the temporal fossa, the lower a part of the infratemporal fossa. near the center of this surface is the zygomaticotemporal foramen for the transmission of the zygomaticotemporal nerve.

UBERON:0004655.name: zygomatic process of temporal bone
UBERON:0004655.def: the zygomatic process of the temporal bone is a long, arched process projecting from the lower part of the squamous portion of the temporal bone. it articulates with the zygomatic bone. this process is at first directed lateralward, its two surfaces looking upward and downward; it then appears as if twisted inward upon itself, and runs forward, its surfaces now looking medialward and lateralward.

UBERON:0004657.name: mandible condylar process
UBERON:0004657.def: articular part of the mandible bone.

UBERON:0004660.name: mandible coronoid process
UBERON:0004660.def: a dorsal process on the lower jaw associated with muscle attachment. it may be formed by a separate coronoid bone or as a process of the dentary. in most living (and many extinct) mammals, the most dorsal of the three proximal processes of the jaw.

UBERON:0004662.name: vertebra lamina
UBERON:0004662.def: two broad plates directed dorsomedially from the pedicles; these fuse at the dorsal midline, and complete the dorsal wall of the vertebral foramen.

UBERON:0004663.name: aorta wall
UBERON:0004663.def: an anatomical wall that is part of an aorta, enclosing the luminal space.

UBERON:0004664.name: aorta tunica adventitia

UBERON:0004665.name: muscular coat of seminal vesicle

UBERON:0004666.name: interventricular septum membranous part

UBERON:0004667.name: interventricular septum muscular part
UBERON:0004667.def: the muscular portion of the wall between the two lower chambers of the heart.

UBERON:0004668.name: fourth ventricle aperture
UBERON:0004668.def: one of: the 4th ventricle median or lateral apertures.

UBERON:0004670.name: ependyma
UBERON:0004670.def: the thin epithelium-like membrane composed of ependymal cells that lines the ventricular system of the brain and the spinal cord.

UBERON:0004671.name: gyrus rectus
UBERON:0004671.def: the portion of the frontal lobe medial to the medial orbital gyrus is named the gyrus rectus (or straight gyrus), and is continuous with the superior frontal gyrus on the medial surface. a specific function for the gyrus rectus has not yet been elucidated.

UBERON:0004672.name: posterior horn lateral ventricle

UBERON:0004677.name: spinal cord gray commissure
UBERON:0004677.def: the band of grey substance spanning the midline of the spinal cord that surrounds the central canal.

UBERON:0004678.name: apex of spinal cord dorsal horn
UBERON:0004678.synonym: apex of spinal cord posterior horn

UBERON:0004679.name: dentate gyrus molecular layer
UBERON:0004679.def: the molecular layer of the dentate gyrus that is bounded by the pial surface superficially and the dentate gyrus granule cell layer deep. it is divided into 2 or more sublayers.

UBERON:0004680.name: body of fornix
UBERON:0004680.def: part of fornix adjacent to the crura where they join together at the midline underneath the corpus callosum.

UBERON:0004681.name: vestibular system
UBERON:0004681.def: the sensory system for the sense of balance.

UBERON:0004682.name: corona radiata of neuraxis
UBERON:0004682.def: fan shaped white matter mass comprised of afferent and efferent fibers from the cerebral cortex arranged in radially arrayed bundles, converging towards the internal capsule (carpenter, core text of neuroanatomy, 3rd ed, 1985, pg. 30; heimer, the human brain and spinal cord, 2nd ed., 1995, pg 84).

UBERON:0004683.name: parasubiculum
UBERON:0004683.def: a transitional zone between the presubiculum and the entorhinal area in the mouse (paxinos-2001), the rat (swanson-1998) and the primate (zilles-1990). defined on the basis of cytoarchitecture, it is more similar to the presubiculum than to the entorhinal area (zilles-1990). (from brain info).

UBERON:0004684.name: raphe nuclei
UBERON:0004684.def: the raphe nuclei are thin plates of cells in and immediately adjacent to the sagittal plane.

UBERON:0004685.name: obsolete middle temporal area
UBERON:0004685.def: the term 'middle temporal visual area' was first used by allman and kaas (1971) for a region of the owl monkey brain located on the 'caudal third of the middle temporal gyrus.' functionally, it contains 'a complete representation of the contralateral half of the visual field... this representation of the visual field (mt) corresponds to a histologically distinct area adjacent and rostral to area 19... the horizontal meridian divides mt into a lateral portion representing the upper visual quadrant and a medial portion representing the lower quadrant. the center of gaze is represented in the caudal portion of mt bordering area 19.'.

UBERON:0004686.name: gastro-splenic ligament
UBERON:0004686.def: peritoneum connecting the greater curvature of stomach with the hilum of the spleen[umich]. part of the greater omentum; derived from the dorsal mesogastrium in the embryo.

UBERON:0004687.name: lieno-renal ligament
UBERON:0004687.def: peritoneum that attaches the spleen to the posterior abdominal wall over the left kidney. develops from the dorsal mesogastrium of the embryo[umich].

UBERON:0004688.name: costo-cervical trunk
UBERON:0004688.def: the costocervical trunk arises from the upper and back part of the subclavian artery, behind the scalenus anterior on the right side, and medial to that muscle on the left side. passing backward, it splits into the deep cervical artery and the supreme intercostal artery (or the highest intercostal artery), which descends behind the pleura in front of the necks of the first and second ribs, and anastomoses with the first aortic intercostal (3rd posterior intercostal artery). as it crosses the neck of the first rib it lies medial to the anterior division of the first thoracic nerve, and lateral to the first thoracic ganglion of the sympathetic trunk. in the first intercostal space, it gives off a branch which is distributed in a manner similar to the distribution of the aortic intercostals. the branch for the second intercostal space usually joins with one from the highest aortic intercostal artery. this branch is not constant, but is more commonly found on the right side; when absent, its place is supplied by an intercostal branch from the aorta. each intercostal gives off a posterior branch which goes to the posterior vertebral muscles, and sends a small spinal branch through the corresponding intervertebral foramen to the medulla spinalis and its membranes. [wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0004689.name: naso-frontal vein
UBERON:0004689.def: the nasofrontal vein is a vein in the eye which drains to the superior ophthalmic vein.

UBERON:0004690.name: pancreaticoduodenal vein
UBERON:0004690.def: a vein running parallel to the superior and inferior pancreatico-duodenal arteries that drains blood from the pancreas and duodenum into the superior mesenteric or portal veins.

UBERON:0004691.name: bulbourethral gland secretion
UBERON:0004691.def: a bodily secretion that is produced by a bulbourethral gland.

UBERON:0004692.name: external naris epithelium
UBERON:0004692.def: an epithelium that is part of an external naris [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004693.name: peyer's patch epithelium
UBERON:0004693.def: the specialized epithelium of the peyer's patch.

UBERON:0004694.name: harderian gland epithelium
UBERON:0004694.def: an epithelium that is part of a harderian gland [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004695.name: arterial system smooth muscle
UBERON:0004695.def: a portion of smooth muscle tissue that is part of an arterial system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004696.name: venous system smooth muscle
UBERON:0004696.def: a portion of smooth muscle tissue that is part of a venous system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004697.name: peyer's patch germinal center
UBERON:0004697.def: area of the peyer's patch where b cells proliferate and differentiate into plasma cells.

UBERON:0004698.name: vena cava endothelium
UBERON:0004698.def: an endothelium that is part of a vena cava [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004699.name: outflow tract endothelium
UBERON:0004699.def: an endothelium that is part of a outflow tract [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004700.name: arterial system endothelium
UBERON:0004700.def: an endothelium that is part of an arterial system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004701.name: venous system endothelium
UBERON:0004701.def: an endothelium that is part of a venous system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004702.name: respiratory system blood vessel endothelium
UBERON:0004702.def: a blood vessel endothelium that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004704.name: bone fossa
UBERON:0004704.def: a depression or hollow in a bone[wp].

UBERON:0004705.name: fenestra
UBERON:0004705.def: an opening in the skull or other bones[wp].

UBERON:0004706.name: bulbus cordis
UBERON:0004706.def: a transient fetal dilation of the distal (or cranial) heart tube located where the arterial trunk joins the ventral roots of the aortic arches.

UBERON:0004707.name: pharyngula stage
UBERON:0004707.def: a stage that follows the blastula, gastrula and neurula stages. at the pharyngula stage, all vertebrate embryos show remarkable similarities.

UBERON:0004708.name: paired limb/fin
UBERON:0004708.def: an appendage that is part of an appendage girdle complex.

UBERON:0004709.name: pelvic appendage
UBERON:0004709.def: paired appendage that consists of the posterior appendicular skeleton and associated soft and hard tissues, but excludes the pelvic girdle and its associated soft and hard tissues.

UBERON:0004710.name: pectoral appendage
UBERON:0004710.def: paired appendage that consists of the anterior appendicular skeleton and associated soft and hard tissues, but excludes the pectoral girdle and its associated soft and hard tissues.

UBERON:0004711.name: jugular vein
UBERON:0004711.def: the jugular veins are veins that bring deoxygenated blood from the head back to the heart via the superior vena cava.

UBERON:0004713.name: corpus cavernosum penis
UBERON:0004713.def: one of the columns of erectile tissue forming the dorsum and sides of the penis.

UBERON:0004714.name: septum pellucidum
UBERON:0004714.def: a triangular double membrane, consisting of glial cells and fibers (heimer, 1996) separating the anterior horns of the lateral ventricles of the brain. it is situated in the median plane and bounded by the corpus callosum and the body and columns of the fornix.

UBERON:0004715.name: annulus fibrosus disci intervertebralis
UBERON:0004715.def: the ring of fibrocartilage and fibrous tissue forming the circumference of the intervertebral disc; surrounds the nucleus pulposus, which is prone to herniation when the annulus fibrosus is compromised.

UBERON:0004716.name: conceptus
UBERON:0004716.def: the embryo and its adnexa (appendages or adjunct parts) or associated membranes (i.e. the products of conception) the conceptus includes all structures that develop from the zygote, both embryonic and extraembryonic. it includes the embryo as well as the embryonic part of the placenta and its associated membranes - amnion, chorion (gestational sac), and yolk sac[wp].

UBERON:0004717.name: brodmann (1909) area 29
UBERON:0004717.def: brodmann area 29, also known as granular retrolimbic area 29 or granular retrosplenial cortex, is a cytoarchitecturally defined portion of the retrosplenial region of the cerebral cortex. in the human it is a narrow band located in the isthmus of cingulate gyrus. cytoarchitecturally it is bounded internally by the ectosplenial area 26 and externally by the agranular retrolimbic area 30 (brodmann-1909).

UBERON:0004719.name: kidney arcuate vein
UBERON:0004719.def: any of the veins that parallel the arcuate arteries, receive blood from the interlobular veins and straight venules, and terminate in the interlobar veins.

UBERON:0004720.name: cerebellar vermis
UBERON:0004720.def: a subregion of the cerebellar cortex, consisting of the most medial zone of the cerebellar cortex, stradding the midline. may be continuous with the lateral cerebellar hemispheres in some areas of the cerebellum, e.g., dorsally, or separated by deeper fissures in others (e.g., ventrally).

UBERON:0004721.name: crista ampullaris
UBERON:0004721.def: the crista ampullaris is the sensory organ of rotation located in the semicircular canal of the inner ear. the function of the crista ampullaris is to sense angular acceleration and deceleration.

UBERON:0004722.name: deep cervical lymph node
UBERON:0004722.def: the deep cervical lymph nodes are a group of cervical lymph nodes found near the internal jugular vein. they can be divided into upper and lower groups, or superior and inferior groups. alternatively, they can be divided into deep anterior cervical lymph nodes and deep lateral cervical lymph nodes. they can also be divided into three groups: superior deep jugular, middle deep jugular, and 'inferior deep jugular'.

UBERON:0004723.name: interlobular artery
UBERON:0004723.def: the branches of the arcuate arteries of the kidney that radiate outward throught the renal columns and supply the glomeruli[mp]. the first set of renal bloodvessels, the interlobular arteries (or cortical radiate arteries, or cortical radial arteries), are given off at right angles from the side of the arcuate arteries looking toward the cortical substance, and pass directly outward between the medullary rays to reach the fibrous tunic, where they end in the capillary network of this part. these vessels do not anastomose with each other, but form what are called end-arteries. in their outward course they give off lateral branches; these are the afferent vessels for the renal corpuscles; they enter the capsule, and end in the glomerulus. from each tuft the corresponding efferent vessel arises, and, having made its egress from the capsule near to the point where the afferent vessel enters, breaks up into a number of branches, which form a dense plexus within bowman's capsule.

UBERON:0004724.name: medial palpebral ligament
UBERON:0004724.def: the medial palpebral ligament (tendo oculi), about 4 mm. in length and 2 mm. in breadth, is attached to the frontal process of the maxilla in front of the lacrimal groove. crossing the lacrimal sac, it divides into two parts, upper and lower, each attached to the medial end of the corresponding tarsus. as the ligament crosses the lacrimal sac, a strong aponeurotic is given off from its posterior surface; this expands over the sac, and is attached to the posterior lacrimal crest.

UBERON:0004725.name: piriform cortex
UBERON:0004725.def: the subdivision of the laminated olfactory cortex with only three main layers that receive monosynaptic input from the olfactory bulb via the lateral olfactory tract; it is located bilaterally in the ventrolateral forebrain and is commonly divided into anterior and posterior regions.

UBERON:0004726.name: vasa recta
UBERON:0004726.def: in the blood supply of the kidney, the vasa recta renis (or straight arteries of kidney, or straight arterioles of kidney) form a series of straight capillaries in the medulla. they lie parallel to the loop of henle. these vessels branch off the efferent arterioles of juxtamedullary nephrons (those nephrons closest to the medulla), enter the medulla, and surround the loop of henle.

UBERON:0004727.name: cochlear nerve
UBERON:0004727.def: a nerve in the head that carries signals from the cochlea of the inner ear to the brain. it is part of the vestibulocochlear nerve, the 8th cranial nerve which is found in higher vertebrates; the other portion of the 8th cranial nerve is the vestibular nerve which carries spatial orientation information from the semicircular canals. the cochlear nerve is a sensory nerve, one which conducts to the brain information about the environment, in this case acoustic energy impinging on the tympanic membrane. the cochlear nerve arises from within the cochlea and extends to the brainstem, where its fibers make contact with the cochlear nucleus, the next stage of neural processing in the auditory system[wp].

UBERON:0004728.name: amphibian larval stage
UBERON:0004728.def: amphibian larvae, sometimes called pollywogs or tadpoles, hatch from eggs and begin to grow limbs and other adult physical features at various times, depending on the species, before they metamorphose into the adult form.

UBERON:0004729.name: nematode larval stage
UBERON:0004729.def: nematode larval development begins with the newly hatched first-stage larva (l1) and ends with the end of the last larval stage (for example the fourth larval stage (l4) in c. elegans). each stage of nematode larval development is characterized by proliferation of specific cell lineages and an increase in body size without alteration of the basic body plan. nematode larval stages are separated by molts in which each stage-specific exoskeleton, or cuticle, is shed and replaced anew.

UBERON:0004730.name: instar larval stage
UBERON:0004730.def: this begins with the newly hatched first-instar larva, through its maturation to the end of the last larval stage. an example of this process is found in drosophila melanogaster.

UBERON:0004731.name: neuromere
UBERON:0004731.def: a transverse unitary subdivision of the neural tube that shares a common dorsoventral structure (floor, basal, alar, and roof plates), but each having differential molecular identities and fates; they comprise the secondary prosencephalon, diencephalon (prosomeres), the midbrain (mesomeres), and the hindbrain (rhombomeres).

UBERON:0004732.name: segmental subdivision of nervous system
UBERON:0004732.def: any segmental subdivision of a nervous system. includes metameric developmental segments, such as vertebrates neuromeres.

UBERON:0004733.name: segmental subdivision of hindbrain
UBERON:0004733.def: an organ subunit that is part of a hindbrain [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004735.name: archenteron
UBERON:0004735.def: the cavity of a gastrula forming a primitive gut.

UBERON:0004736.name: metanephric glomerulus
UBERON:0004736.def: glomerulus of the mature vertebrate kidney, or metanephros.

UBERON:0004737.name: metanephric collecting duct
UBERON:0004737.def: a collecting duct of renal tubule that is part of a metanephros [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004738.name: metanephric juxtaglomerular apparatus
UBERON:0004738.def: juxtaglomerular apparatus of the mature vertebrate kidney, or metanephros.

UBERON:0004739.name: pronephric glomerulus
UBERON:0004739.def: the glomus forms from the splanchnic intermediate mesoderm and is the vascularized filtration unit, filtering the blood before it enters the tubules. the glomus is external to the nephron and extends over more than one body segment.

UBERON:0004740.name: basibranchial bone
UBERON:0004740.def: a basibranchial element that is bone. basibranchial elements are ventral, median, and associated with a single pharyngeal arch in the pharyngeal arch 3-7 skeleton.

UBERON:0004741.name: cleithrum
UBERON:0004741.def: dermal bone on the margin of the scapula. the cleithrum is attached to the skull in fishes, but free from the latter in amphibians and disappears early in the evolution of reptiles.

UBERON:0004742.name: dentary
UBERON:0004742.def: the dentary is a dermal bone that forms the antero-lateral part of the lower jaw in fishes and amphibians, extending to the whole lower jaw in mammals[vhog,modified].

UBERON:0004743.name: coracoid bone
UBERON:0004743.def: endochondral bone that is paired and forms part of the socket for the humerus in tetrapods and acts as base of the pectoral fin in fish.

UBERON:0004745.name: parasphenoid
UBERON:0004745.def: a tooth- or denticle-covered plate which is attached to the sphenoid stem[palaeos].

UBERON:0004746.name: prootic bone
UBERON:0004746.def: paired, endochondral bones forming the anterior, and lateral walls of the otic capsules.

UBERON:0004747.name: supraoccipital bone
UBERON:0004747.def: endochondral bone that is located at the dorsal part of the occipital region of the cranium or the dorso-posterior part of the skull[tap,modified].

UBERON:0004749.name: blastodisc
UBERON:0004749.def: a small, circular, white spot (approximately 2-3 mm across) on the surface of the yellow yolk of an egg that has been laid. the nucleus of the egg is in the germinal disc.

UBERON:0004750.name: blastoderm
UBERON:0004750.def: a layer of cells formed at one pole of macrolecithal eggs such as the yolky egg of birds. the yolk prevents the division from taking place through the egg, resulting in meroblastic cleavage during the many cleavage divisions. at the animal pole (containing less yolk than the vegetal pole), the zygote divides and subdivides, forming the blastoderm, which gradually spreads around the yolk and forms the embryo. the blastoderm is composed of two layers, the epiblast and the hypoblast, which enclose the fluid-filled blastocoel cavity.

UBERON:0004752.name: palatoquadrate cartilage
UBERON:0004752.def: the dorsal component of the mandibular arch.

UBERON:0004753.name: scapulocoracoid
UBERON:0004753.def: skeletal element that consists of the scapula and the coracoid[vsao, modified].

UBERON:0004754.name: foramen ovale of heart
UBERON:0004754.def: an anatomical space in the fetal heart that allows blood to enter the left atrium from the right atrium.

UBERON:0004755.name: skeletal tissue
UBERON:0004755.def: a specialized form of connective tissue in which the extracellular matrix is firm, providing the tissue with resilience, and/or mineralized and that functions in mechanical and structural support.[vsao].

UBERON:0004756.name: dermal skeletal element
UBERON:0004756.def: dermis-derived entity that is made of skeletal tissue.

UBERON:0004757.name: rectal salt gland
UBERON:0004757.def: an evagination of the terminal portion of the intestine that is capable of secreting high concentrations of excess sodium chloride.

UBERON:0004758.name: salt gland
UBERON:0004758.def: an organ for excreting excess salts. it is found in elasmobranchs, seabirds, and some reptiles.[wp].

UBERON:0004759.name: cranial salt gland
UBERON:0004759.def: a salt gland located in the cranium or head region.

UBERON:0004760.name: gland of anal canal
UBERON:0004760.def: a gland that is part of an anal canal [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004761.name: cartilaginous neurocranium
UBERON:0004761.def: the primitive cartilagionous skeletal structure of the fetal skull that grows to envelop the rapidly growing embyonic brain. in humans, the chondrocranium begins forming at 28 days from mesenchymal condensations and is fully formed between week 7 and 9 of fetal development. while the majority of the chondrocranium is succeeded by the bony skull in most higher vertebrates, some components do persist into adulthood.[1] in cartilagious fishes and agnathans, the chondrocranium persist throughout life.[2] embryologically, the chondrocranium represent the basal cranial structure, and lay the base for the formation of the endocranium in higher vertebrates[wp].

UBERON:0004763.name: endochondral bone tissue
UBERON:0004763.def: replacement bone tissue that forms within cartilage[vsao, modified].

UBERON:0004764.name: intramembranous bone tissue
UBERON:0004764.def: bone tissue that forms directly within mesenchyme, and does not replace other tissues[tao]. intramembranous ossification is the formation of bone in which osteoblasts secrete a collagen-proteoglycan matrix that binds calcium salts and becomes calcified[go]. intramembranous ossification is the way flat bones and the shell of a turtle are formed[go]. unlike endochondral ossification, cartilage is not present during intramembranous ossification[wp].

UBERON:0004765.name: skeletal element
UBERON:0004765.def: organ consisting of skeletal tissue. encompasses whole bones, fused bones, cartilaginious elements, teeth, dermal denticles.

UBERON:0004766.name: cranial bone
UBERON:0004766.def: a bone that is part of a cranium.

UBERON:0004767.name: vomerine tooth
UBERON:0004767.def: a tooth that is on the vomer.

UBERON:0004768.name: bone of lower jaw
UBERON:0004768.def: any bone that is part of the lower jaw skeleton. this includes (when present): the dentary/mandible, the articular, the splenial, the suprangular.

UBERON:0004769.name: diaphysis
UBERON:0004769.def: subdivision of long bone which forms the part of the bone between the two epiphyses, excluding the metaphyses[fma,modified].

UBERON:0004770.name: articular system
UBERON:0004770.def: anatomical system that consists of all the joints of the body.

UBERON:0004771.name: posterior nasal aperture
UBERON:0004771.def: opening/conduit between the nasal cavity and the nasopharynx[aao] the choanae are separated by the vomer[wp].

UBERON:0004772.name: eyelid tarsus
UBERON:0004772.def: the tarsi (tarsal plates) are two comparatively thick, elongated plates of dense connective tissue, about 2.5 cm. in length; one is found in each eyelid, and contributes to its form and support. they directly abut the lid margins.

UBERON:0004773.name: superior eyelid tarsus
UBERON:0004773.def: an eyelid tarsus that is part of a upper eyelid [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004774.name: inferior eyelid tarsus
UBERON:0004774.def: an eyelid tarsus that is part of a lower eyelid [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004775.name: outer renal medulla vasa recta
UBERON:0004775.def: a vasa recta that is part of a outer medulla of kidney [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004775.synonym: vasa recta of outer zone of renal medulla

UBERON:0004776.name: inner renal medulla vasa recta
UBERON:0004776.def: a vasa recta that is part of a inner medulla of kidney [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004776.synonym: vasa recta of set of inner region of renal pyramids

UBERON:0004777.name: respiratory system submucosa
UBERON:0004777.def: a submucosa that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004778.name: larynx submucosa
UBERON:0004778.def: a submucosa that is part of a larynx [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004779.name: respiratory system lamina propria
UBERON:0004779.def: a lamina propria that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004780.name: gastrointestinal system lamina propria
UBERON:0004780.def: a lamina propria that is part of a gastrointestinal system.

UBERON:0004781.name: gallbladder lamina propria
UBERON:0004781.def: a lamina propria that is part of a gallbladder [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004782.name: gastrointestinal system serosa
UBERON:0004782.def: a serous membrane that is part of a digestive system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004783.name: gallbladder serosa
UBERON:0004783.def: a serous membrane that is part of a gallbladder [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004784.name: heart ventricle wall
UBERON:0004784.def: an anatomical wall that is part of a cardiac ventricle [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004785.name: respiratory system mucosa
UBERON:0004785.def: the mucous membrane lining the respiratory tract.

UBERON:0004786.name: gastrointestinal system mucosa
UBERON:0004786.def: a mucosa that is part of a gastrointestinal system.

UBERON:0004787.name: urethra urothelium
UBERON:0004787.def: an urothelium that is part of a urethra [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004788.name: kidney pelvis urothelium
UBERON:0004788.def: the epithelial lining of the luminal space of the kidney pelvis.

UBERON:0004789.name: larynx mucous gland
UBERON:0004789.def: a mucous gland that is part of a larynx [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004790.name: skin mucous gland
UBERON:0004790.def: a mucous gland that is part of the skin.

UBERON:0004791.name: thymus trabecula
UBERON:0004791.def: the thymic connective tissue which extends into the parenchyma.

UBERON:0004792.name: secretion of endocrine pancreas
UBERON:0004792.def: a secretion that is part of a endocrine pancreas [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004793.name: secretion of exocrine pancreas
UBERON:0004793.def: a secretion that is part of a exocrine pancreas [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004794.name: esophagus secretion
UBERON:0004794.def: a secretion that is part of a esophagus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004795.name: pancreas secretion
UBERON:0004795.def: a secretion that is part of a pancreas [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004796.name: prostate gland secretion
UBERON:0004796.def: a bodily secretion that is produced by the prostate gland.

UBERON:0004797.name: blood vessel layer
UBERON:0004797.def: any of the tissue layers that comprise a blood vessel. examples: tunica media, tunica adventitia.

UBERON:0004798.name: respiratory system basal lamina
UBERON:0004798.def: a basal lamina that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004798.synonym: respiratory system basal lamina of connective tissue

UBERON:0004799.name: trachea basal lamina
UBERON:0004799.def: a basal lamina that is part of a respiratory airway [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004799.synonym: basal lamina of connective tissue of respiratory airway

UBERON:0004800.name: bronchus basal lamina
UBERON:0004800.def: a basal lamina that is part of a bronchus [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004800.synonym: bronchus basal lamina of connective tissue

UBERON:0004801.name: cervix epithelium
UBERON:0004801.def: an epithelium that is part of a uterine cervix [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004802.name: respiratory tract epithelium
UBERON:0004802.def: the pseudostratified ciliated epithelium that lines much of the conducting portion of the airway, including part of the nasal cavity and larynx, the trachea, and bronchi.

UBERON:0004803.name: penis epithelium
UBERON:0004803.def: an epithelium that is part of a penis [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004804.name: oviduct epithelium
UBERON:0004804.def: an epithelium that is part of a oviduct [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004805.name: seminal vesicle epithelium
UBERON:0004805.def: an epithelium that is part of a seminal vesicle [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004806.name: vas deferens epithelium
UBERON:0004806.def: an epithelium that is part of a vas deferens [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004807.name: respiratory system epithelium
UBERON:0004807.def: an epithelium that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004808.name: gastrointestinal system epithelium
UBERON:0004808.def: an epithelium that is part of a digestive system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004809.name: salivary gland epithelium
UBERON:0004809.def: an epithelium that is part of a salivary gland [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004810.name: nephron tubule epithelium
UBERON:0004810.def: the cellular avascular layer of the renal tubule luminar surfaces.

UBERON:0004811.name: endometrium epithelium
UBERON:0004811.def: an epithelium that is part of an endometrium [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004812.name: male prepuce epithelium
UBERON:0004812.def: an epithelium that is part of a prepuce of penis [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004813.name: seminiferous tubule epithelium
UBERON:0004813.def: the stratified epithelial lining of the seminiferous tubules, consisting of the developing spermatozoa and the supporting sertoli cells, which are tall, columnar type cells that line the tubule.

UBERON:0004814.name: upper respiratory tract epithelium
UBERON:0004814.def: an epithelium that is part of a upper respiratory tract [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004815.name: lower respiratory tract epithelium
UBERON:0004815.def: an epithelium that is part of a lower respiratory tract [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004816.name: larynx epithelium
UBERON:0004816.def: an epithelium that is part of a larynx [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004817.name: lacrimal gland epithelium
UBERON:0004817.def: an epithelium that is part of a lacrimal gland [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004818.name: terminal bronchus epithelium
UBERON:0004818.def: an epithelium that is part of a terminal bronchus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004819.name: kidney epithelium
UBERON:0004819.def: the cellular avascular layer of the kidney luminar surfaces.

UBERON:0004820.name: bile duct epithelium
UBERON:0004820.def: any epithelium that lines one of the bile ducts.

UBERON:0004821.name: pulmonary alveolus epithelium
UBERON:0004821.def: the epithelial layer of the alveoli[mp]. the layer of cells covering the lining of the tiny air sacs at the end of the bronchioles[bto].

UBERON:0004822.name: extrahepatic bile duct epithelium
UBERON:0004822.def: an epithelium that is part of a extrahepatic bile duct [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004823.name: intrahepatic bile duct epithelium
UBERON:0004823.def: an epithelium that is part of a intrahepatic bile duct [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004825.name: dental lamina
UBERON:0004825.def: a band of ectodermal cells growing from the epithelium of the embryonic jaws into the underlying mesenchyme and giving rise to the primordia of the enamel organs of the teeth.

UBERON:0004827.name: thyroid gland medulla
UBERON:0004827.def: a medulla that is part of a thyroid [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004829.name: urethra skeletal muscle tissue
UBERON:0004829.def: a portion of skeletal muscle tissue that is part of a urethra [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004830.name: respiratory system skeletal muscle
UBERON:0004830.def: a portion of skeletal muscle tissue that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004830.synonym: skeletal muscle tissue of respiratory system

UBERON:0004831.name: esophagus skeletal muscle
UBERON:0004831.def: a portion of skeletal muscle tissue that is part of a esophagus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004832.name: anal region skeletal muscle
UBERON:0004832.def: a portion of skeletal muscle tissue that is part of an anal region [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004832.synonym: skeletal muscle tissue of anal triangle

UBERON:0004833.name: lip skeletal muscle
UBERON:0004833.def: a portion of skeletal muscle tissue that is part of a lip [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004834.name: hepatic duct smooth muscle
UBERON:0004834.def: smooth muscle tissue in all or part of a hepatic duct.

UBERON:0004835.name: epididymis smooth muscle
UBERON:0004835.def: a portion of smooth muscle tissue that is part of a epididymis [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004848.name: respiratory system arterial endothelium
UBERON:0004848.def: an endothelium of artery that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004849.name: respiratory system venous endothelium
UBERON:0004849.def: an endothelium of vein that is part of a respiratory system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004850.name: lymph node endothelium
UBERON:0004850.def: an endothelium that is part of a lymph node [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004851.name: aorta endothelium
UBERON:0004851.def: the thin layer of flat cells that line the aorta and form a barrier between circulating blood in the lumen and the rest of the vessel wall.
UBERON:0004851.synonym: trunk of systemic arterial tree endothelium

UBERON:0004852.name: cardiovascular system endothelium
UBERON:0004852.def: an endothelium that is part of the cardiovascular system.

UBERON:0004854.name: gastrointestinal system mesentery
UBERON:0004854.def: a mesentery that is part of a digestive system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004857.name: skeletal muscle connective tissue
UBERON:0004857.def: a connective tissue that surrounds a skeletal muscle tissue.
UBERON:0004857.synonym: textus connectivus of skeletal muscle tissue

UBERON:0004859.name: eye gland
UBERON:0004859.def: a gland that is part of a eye. the eye is a compound unit which depending on the species may consist of an eyeballs plus associated ducts and integumentary structures. eye glands therefore include the various types of lacrimal gland, the various types of apocrine and sebaceous glands associated with the eyelid.

UBERON:0004861.name: right lung alveolus
UBERON:0004861.def: an alveolus that is part of a right lung [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004862.name: left lung alveolus
UBERON:0004862.def: an alveolus that is part of a left lung [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004862.synonym: alveolus of lobe of left lung

UBERON:0004863.name: thoracic sympathetic nerve trunk
UBERON:0004863.def: a sympathetic nerve trunk that is part of a thorax [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0004863.synonym: thorax sympathetic nervous system nerve trunk

UBERON:0004864.name: vasculature of retina
UBERON:0004864.def: a vasculature that is part of a retina [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004865.name: actinopterygian parietal bone
UBERON:0004865.def: dermal bone that covers the otic region and may articulate with its antimere medially, with the frontal bone anteriorly, the pterotic laterally, the supraoccipital medio-posteriorly, and the epiotic and extrascapula latero-posteriorly. the parietal is a paired bone.[tao].

UBERON:0004866.name: actinopterygian frontal bone
UBERON:0004866.def: dermal bone that bears part of the supraorbital canal and usually covers a large area of the neurocranium occupying part of the ethmoidal, orbitosphenoid, and otic regions. commonly, the frontal bone articulates with its antimere medially, with lateral ethmoid, orbitosphenoid and pterosphenoid ventrolaterally, with supraorbital bone(s), autosphenotic and pterotic laterally, and with parietal posteriorly.[tao].

UBERON:0004867.name: orbital cavity
UBERON:0004867.def: anatomical cavity bounded by the orbital region of the cranium and forming the location of some or all of the eye.

UBERON:0004868.name: tapetum lucidum of camera-type eye
UBERON:0004868.def: a layer of tissue in the eye of many vertebrate animals, that lies immediately behind or sometimes within the retina. it reflects visible light back through the retina, increasing the light available to the photoreceptors.

UBERON:0004869.name: parietal organ
UBERON:0004869.def: a part of the epithalamus present in some animal species. the eye may be photoreceptive and is usually associated with the pineal gland, regulating circadian rhythmicity and hormone production for thermoregulation. the parietal eye is a part of the epithalamus, which can be divided into two major parts; the epiphysis (the pineal organ, or pineal gland if mostly endocrine) and the parietal organ (often called the parietal eye, or third eye if it is photoreceptive). it arises as an anterior evagination of the pineal organ or as a separate outgrowth of the roof of the diencephalon. in some species, it protrudes through the skull.[4] the parietal eye uses a different biochemical method of detecting light than rod cells or cone cells in a normal vertebrate eye[wp].

UBERON:0004870.name: superficial cervical lymph node
UBERON:0004870.def: a group of nodes lying along the external jugular vein; they drain the skin and superficial structures over the region of the sternocleidomastoid muscle and anterior cervical regions. efferent vessels drain to the deep cervical lymph nodes. lymph nodes can be further subdivided into anterior and lateral groupings.

UBERON:0004871.name: somatic layer of lateral plate mesoderm
UBERON:0004871.def: layer of lateral plate mesoderm that forms the future body wall - underlies the ectoderm[wp].

UBERON:0004872.name: splanchnic layer of lateral plate mesoderm
UBERON:0004872.def: layer of lateral plate mesoderm that forms the circulatory system and future gut wall - overlies endoderm[wp].

UBERON:0004873.name: splanchnopleure
UBERON:0004873.def: a structure created during embryogenesis when the lateral mesoderm splits into two layers - the inner (or splanchnic) layer adheres to the endoderm, and with it forms the splanchnopleure[wp].

UBERON:0004874.name: somatopleure
UBERON:0004874.def: a structure created during embryogenesis when the lateral mesoderm splits into two layers - the outer (or somatic) layer becomes applied to the inner surface of the ectoderm, and with it forms the somatopleure.[wp].

UBERON:0004875.name: nephrogenic cord
UBERON:0004875.def: a portion of the urogenital ridge which is the source of much of the urinary system[wp].

UBERON:0004876.name: urogenital fold
UBERON:0004876.def: one of of the pair of folds derived from the cloacal folds which give rise to a portion of the external genitalia; in male embryos they close over the urethral plate and fuse to form the spongy (penile) urethra and ventral aspect of the penis, not including the glans; failure of fusion of the urethral folds leads to hypospadias; in female embryos they fuse only anterior to the anus and form the labia minora[mp].

UBERON:0004877.name: visceral endoderm
UBERON:0004877.def: visceral endoderm, a population of extraembyonic endoderm, is an extraembryonic tissue that functions in a regulatory capacity but does not contribute directly to the formation of any adult organs[pmid:15905405]. primitive endoderm-derived tissue which remains in contact with and surrounds the extra-embryonic ectoderm and the epiblast and provides signals for the differentiation and patterning of the epiblast; a small number of visceral endoderm cells also contribute to the endoderm of the embryonic gut[mp].

UBERON:0004878.name: distal visceral endoderm
UBERON:0004878.def: precursors of the anterior visceral endoderm that arises at the distal tip of the embryo[mp].

UBERON:0004879.name: marginal zone of embryo
UBERON:0004879.def: belt-like region of presumptive mesoderm at the equator of the late blastula.

UBERON:0004880.name: chordamesoderm
UBERON:0004880.def: the central region of trunk mesoderm. this tissue forms the notochord.

UBERON:0004882.name: eponychium
UBERON:0004882.def: thickened layer of skin surrounding fingernails and toenails. beneath the cuticle is a thin layer of a membrane known as the pterygium. the function is to protect the area between the nail and epidermis from exposure to harmful bacteria. the vascularization pattern is similar to that of perionychium. the eponychium is the end of the proximal fold that folds back upon itself to shed an epidermal layer of skin onto the newly formed nail plate. this layer of non-living, almost invisible skin is the cuticle that 'rides out' on the surface of the nail plate. together, the eponychium and the cuticle form a protective seal. the cuticle on the nail plate is dead cells and is often removed during manicure, but the eponychium is living cells and should not be touched.[6] the perionyx is the projecting edge of the eponychium covering the proximal strip of the lunula[wp].

UBERON:0004883.name: lung mesenchyme
UBERON:0004883.def: the mass of tissue made up of mesenchymal cells in the lung.

UBERON:0004884.name: lobar bronchus mesenchyme
UBERON:0004884.def: the mass of tissue composed of mesenchymal cells in the lobar bronchus..

UBERON:0004885.name: hilum
UBERON:0004885.def: an anatomical cavity, depression or pit where structures are attached.

UBERON:0004886.name: lung hilus
UBERON:0004886.def: a depression on the surface of the lung where the bronchus, blood vessels and nerves enter.

UBERON:0004887.name: left lung hilus
UBERON:0004887.def: a lung hilus that is part of the left lung.

UBERON:0004888.name: right lung hilus
UBERON:0004888.def: a lung hilus that is part of the right lung.

UBERON:0004889.name: lobar bronchus vasculature
UBERON:0004889.def: vasculature that is composed of the tubule structures that carry blood or lymph in the lungs.

UBERON:0004890.name: right lung accessory lobe
UBERON:0004890.def: a specialized lobe of the right lung that extends to the left side of the organism.

UBERON:0004892.name: lobar bronchus alveolar system
UBERON:0004892.def: the lobar bronchus alveolar system is where molecules of oxygen and carbon dioxide are passively exchanged, by diffusion, between the gaseous environment and the blood in the lobar bronchus.

UBERON:0004893.name: interalveolar septum
UBERON:0004893.def: a the thin septum that separates adjacent pulmonary alveoli, containing connective tissue constituents of the respiratory tissue and the capillary network of the blood supply of the lung.

UBERON:0004894.name: alveolar wall
UBERON:0004894.def: a wall that contains the alveoli.

UBERON:0004895.name: alveolar smooth muscle
UBERON:0004895.def: alveolar smooth muscle is a type of non-striated muscle, found within the walls of the alveolus.

UBERON:0004896.name: right lung accessory lobe lobar bronchus
UBERON:0004896.def: the right lung accessory lobe lobar bronchus is the major airway within the right lung accessory lobe that starts at the division of the bronchus on the right side and ends at the point of its own subdivision into tertiary or segmental bronchi.
UBERON:0004896.synonym: lobar bronchus of right lung accessory lobe

UBERON:0004897.name: right lung accessory lobe lobar bronchus mesenchyme
UBERON:0004897.def: the right lung accessory lobe lobar bronchus mesenchyme is a type of tissue made up of loosely-packed mesenchymal cells in the right lung accessory lobe lobar bronchus.

UBERON:0004898.name: obsolete right lung caudal lobe lobar bronchus mesenchyme

UBERON:0004899.name: right lung cranial lobe lobar bronchus mesenchyme
UBERON:0004899.def: the right lung cranial lobe lobar bronchus mesenchyme is a type of tissue made up of loosely-packed mesenchymal cells in the right lung cranial lobe lobar bronchus.

UBERON:0004900.name: right lung middle lobe lobar bronchus mesenchyme
UBERON:0004900.def: the right lung middle lobe lobar bronchus mesenchyme is a type of tissue made up of loosely-packed mesenchymal cells in the right lung middle lobe lobar bronchus.

UBERON:0004901.name: right lung lobar bronchus mesenchyme
UBERON:0004901.def: the right lung lobar bronchus mesenchyme is a type of tissue made up of loosely-packed mesenchymal cells in the right lung lobar bronchus.

UBERON:0004902.name: urogenital sinus epithelium
UBERON:0004902.def: the fetal urogenital sinus (from which the prostate derives) is a simple cylinder of stratified basal epithelium, surrounded by mesenchyme and positioned between the embryonic bladder and pelvic urethra.

UBERON:0004903.name: bronchoalveolar duct junction
UBERON:0004903.def: a branch point connecting the respiratory bronchioles to the alveolar ducts[mp].

UBERON:0004904.name: neuron projection bundle connecting eye with brain
UBERON:0004904.def: a neuron projection bundle that connects the retina or its analog in the eye with the brain. this includes the vertebrate optic nerve (not truly a nerve) as well as analogous structures such as the bolwig nerve in drosophila.

UBERON:0004905.name: articulation
UBERON:0004905.def: anatomical structure that connects two or more adjacent skeletal elements or hardened body parts.

UBERON:0004906.name: ectodermal part of digestive tract
UBERON:0004906.def: a portion of the gut that is derived from ectoderm.

UBERON:0004907.name: lower digestive tract
UBERON:0004907.def: the region of the digestive tract extending from the beginning of the intestines to the anus[go - gut definition].

UBERON:0004908.name: upper digestive tract
UBERON:0004908.def: the region of the digestive tract extending from the mouth cavity through pharynx esophagus stomach and duodenum.

UBERON:0004913.name: hepatopancreatic ampulla
UBERON:0004913.def: a dilation of the duodenal papilla that is the opening of the juncture of the common bile duct and the main pancreatic duct.

UBERON:0004914.name: duodenal papilla
UBERON:0004914.def: one of the two small elevations on the mucosa of the duodenum, the major at the entrance of the conjoined pancreatic and common bile ducts and the minor at the entrance of the accessory pancreatic duct.

UBERON:0004915.name: sphincter of hepatopancreatic ampulla
UBERON:0004915.def: muscular valve that controls the flow of digestive juices (bile and pancreatic juice) through the ampulla of vater into the second part of the duodenum. relaxed by the hormone cholecystokinin (cck) via vasoactive intestinal polypeptide (vip).[wp].

UBERON:0004916.name: anal sphincter
UBERON:0004916.def: a sphincter muscle that is part of a anal region.

UBERON:0004917.name: urethral sphincter
UBERON:0004917.def: a sphincter muscle surrounding the urethra.

UBERON:0004918.name: internal urethral sphincter
UBERON:0004918.def: a urethral sphincter muscle which constricts the internal urethral orifice. it is the junction of the urethra with the urinary bladder. the muscle is made of smooth muscle, so therefore it is under involuntary control. it is kept tonically contracted by the sympathetic nervous system and during micturition, is relaxed via the parasympathetic nervous system. this is the primary muscle for preventing the release of urine[wp].

UBERON:0004920.def: a mesoderm that is part of a gonad [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0004921.name: subdivision of digestive tract
UBERON:0004921.def: a proximal-distal subdivision of the digestive tract.

UBERON:0004922.name: postnatal subventricular zone
UBERON:0004922.def: a mitotically active layer of cells surrounding the brain ventricles in the adult that consists of migrating neuroblasts, astrocytes and transitory amplifying progenitor cells[mp].

UBERON:0005023.def: a mucosa that is part of a oropharynx [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005024.def: a mucosa that is part of a soft palate [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005025.name: mucosa of uvula
UBERON:0005025.def: a mucosa that is part of a uvula [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005026.name: mucosa of middle ear
UBERON:0005026.def: a mucosa that is part of a middle ear [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005027.name: mucosa of frontal sinus
UBERON:0005027.def: a mucosa that is part of a frontal sinus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005028.name: mucosa of maxillary sinus
UBERON:0005028.def: a mucosa that is part of a maxillary sinus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005029.name: mucosa of lacrimal canaliculus
UBERON:0005029.def: a mucosa that is part of a lacrimal canaliculus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005030.name: mucosa of paranasal sinus
UBERON:0005030.def: a mucosa that adjacent_to a paranasal sinus.

UBERON:0005031.name: mucosa of upper lip
UBERON:0005031.def: a mucosa that is part of a upper lip [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005032.name: mucosa of lower lip
UBERON:0005032.def: a mucosa that is part of a lower lip [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005033.name: mucosa of gallbladder
UBERON:0005033.def: a mucosa that is part of a gallbladder [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005034.name: mucosa of right main bronchus
UBERON:0005034.def: a mucosa that is part of a right main bronchus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005035.name: mucosa of left main bronchus
UBERON:0005035.def: a mucosa that is part of a left main bronchus [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0005035.synonym: organ mucosa of left principal bronchus

UBERON:0005036.name: mucosa of main bronchus
UBERON:0005036.def: a mucosa that is part of a main bronchus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005037.name: mucosa of lobar bronchus
UBERON:0005037.def: a mucosa that is part of a lobar bronchus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005038.name: mucosa of segmental bronchus
UBERON:0005038.def: a mucosa that is part of a segmental bronchus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005039.name: mucosa of bronchiole
UBERON:0005039.def: a mucosa that is part of a bronchiole [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005040.name: mucosa of terminal bronchiole
UBERON:0005040.def: a mucosa that is part of a terminal bronchiole [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005041.name: mucosa of respiratory bronchiole
UBERON:0005041.def: a mucosa that is part of a respiratory bronchiole [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005042.name: inner epithelial layer of tympanic membrane
UBERON:0005042.def: a portion of the tympanic cavity epithelium which makes up the outer (cuticular) layer of the tympanic membrane.

UBERON:0005043.name: mucosa of nasolacrimal duct
UBERON:0005043.def: a mucosa that is part of a nasolacrimal duct [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005044.name: mucosa of pharyngotympanic tube
UBERON:0005044.def: a mucosa that is part of a pharyngotympanic tube [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005045.name: mucosa of ethmoidal sinus
UBERON:0005045.def: a mucosa that is part of a ethmoid sinus [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005046.name: mucosa of hard palate
UBERON:0005046.def: a mucosa that is part of a hard palate [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005047.name: mucosa of vocal fold
UBERON:0005047.def: a mucosa that is part of a vocal cord [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005048.name: mucosa of uterine tube
UBERON:0005048.def: a mucosa that is part of a fallopian tube [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005049.name: mucosa of infundibulum of uterine tube
UBERON:0005049.def: a mucosa that is part of a uterine tube infundibulum [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005051.name: mediastinum testis
UBERON:0005051.def: the mediastinum testis is a network of fibrous connective tissue that extends from the upper to near the lower extremity of the testis, and is wider above than below. from its front and sides numerous imperfect septa (trabeculæ) are given off, which radiate toward the surface of the organ, and are attached to the tunica albuginea. they divide the interior of the organ into a number of incomplete spaces, called lobules. these are somewhat cone-shaped, being broad at their bases at the surface of the gland, and becoming narrower as they converge to the mediastinum. the mediastinum supports the rete testis and blood vessels of the testis in their passage to and from the substance of the gland[wp].

UBERON:0005052.name: gizzard
UBERON:0005052.def: the muscular enlargement of the alimentary canal that has usually thick muscular walls and a tough horny lining for grinding the food and when the crop is present follows it and the proventriculus.

UBERON:0005053.name: primary nerve cord
UBERON:0005053.def: a cluster of neurons that is the most prominent longitudinally extending condensed part of a nervous system.

UBERON:0005054.name: primary dorsal nerve cord
UBERON:0005054.def: a nerve cord in the dorsal mid-line that is the most prominent nerve cord.

UBERON:0005055.name: zone of long bone
UBERON:0005055.def: an organ part that is part of a long bone [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005056.name: external female genitalia
UBERON:0005056.def: an external genitalia that is part of a female reproductive system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005057.name: immune organ
UBERON:0005057.def: an organ that is part of a immune system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005058.name: hemolymphoid system gland
UBERON:0005058.def: a gland that is part of a hemolymphoid system [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005061.name: neural groove
UBERON:0005061.def: the median dorsal longitudinal groove formed in the embryo by the neural plate after the appearance of the neural folds.

UBERON:0005062.name: neural fold
UBERON:0005062.def: one of the two elevated edges of the neural groove[go,mp].

UBERON:0005067.name: amphid sensory organ
UBERON:0005067.def: amphid sensory organs are the sensory organs of nematodes[go].

UBERON:0005068.name: neural rod
UBERON:0005068.def: a solid rod of neurectoderm derived from the neural keel. the neural rod is roughly circular in cross section. neural rod formation occurs during primary neurulation in teleosts[go]. an intermediate stage in the development of the central nervous system present during the segmentation period; the neural rod is roughly cylindrical in shape, forms from the neural keel, and is not yet hollowed out into the neural tube[zfin].

UBERON:0005069.name: neural fold hinge point
UBERON:0005069.def: the median hinge point extends for the entire length of the neural tube, and the lateral hinge points do not form in the spinal cord region of the neural tube[go].

UBERON:0005070.name: anterior neuropore
UBERON:0005070.def: the neuropore at the anterior (rostral) end of the neural tube.

UBERON:0005071.name: posterior neuropore
UBERON:0005071.def: the neuropore at the posterior (caudal) end of the neural tube.

UBERON:0005075.name: forebrain-midbrain boundary
UBERON:0005075.def: an anatomical boundary that adjacent_to a forebrain and adjacent_to a midbrain.

UBERON:0005076.name: hindbrain-spinal cord boundary
UBERON:0005076.def: an anatomical boundary that adjacent_to a hindbrain and adjacent_to a spinal cord.

UBERON:0005077.name: neuropore
UBERON:0005077.def: a temporary opening leading from the central canal of the embryonic neural tube to the exterior.

UBERON:0005078.name: lamina terminalis of neural tube
UBERON:0005078.def: the anterior-most (rostral) portion of the wall of the neural tube, formed by closure of the anterior neuropore; the median strip of the anterior wall of the prosencephalon, which persists in a relatively unchanged state as the cerebral hemispheres grow out forward beyond the original anterior end of the prosencephalon.

UBERON:0005079.name: eggshell
UBERON:0005079.def: a product of the somatic follicle cell epithelium and a structure that supports the egg in a hostile environment, minimizing water loss whilst allowing gas exchanges essential for embryonic respiration[go].

UBERON:0005080.name: metanephric ureteric bud
UBERON:0005080.def: the portion of the ureteric bud tube that contributes to the morphogenesis of the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005081.name: ureter ureteric bud
UBERON:0005081.def: the portion of the ureteric bud that contributes to the morphogenesis of the ureter. the ureter ureteric bud is the initial structure that forms the ureter[go].

UBERON:0005083.name: nipple sheath
UBERON:0005083.def: a circular ingrowth of the epidermis around the region of the mammary sprout[go].

UBERON:0005085.name: ectodermal placode
UBERON:0005085.def: an ectodermal placode is a thickening of the ectoderm that is the primordium of many structures derived from the ectoderm[go].

UBERON:0005086.name: hair follicle placode
UBERON:0005086.def: a bud-like thickening in the epidermis consisting of elongated keratinocytes, which at the distal end are in touch with numerous aggregated specialized dermal fibroblasts, the dermal condensate.

UBERON:0005087.name: tooth placode
UBERON:0005087.def: an tooth placode is a thickening of the ectoderm that will give rise to the tooth bud[go].

UBERON:0005088.name: sebaceous gland placode
UBERON:0005088.def: a sebaceous gland placode is a thickening of the ectoderm that will give rise to the sebaceous gland bud[go].

UBERON:0005089.name: sweat gland placode
UBERON:0005089.def: an sweat gland placode is a thickening of the ectoderm that will give rise to the sweat gland bud[go].

UBERON:0005090.name: muscle structure
UBERON:0005090.def: muscle structures are contractile cells, tissues or organs that are found in multicellular organisms[go].

UBERON:0005093.name: embryonic cement gland
UBERON:0005093.def: a simple mucus-secreting structure that is positioned at the front of the embryo, attaches the newly hatched embryo to a support before the hatchling can swim well or feed, and marks the anterior-most dorsal ectoderm[xao].

UBERON:0005094.name: beak
UBERON:0005094.def: the avian beak is an external anatomical structure, in the head region, that is adapted for feeding self and young, catching prey, probing, etc. it encompasses, but is not restricted to, the maxilla, mandible, maxillary ramaphotheca, mandibular ramaphotheca, nostril, nasal fossa, nasal bones, egg tooth and rictus[go]. the beak, bill or rostrum is an external anatomical structure of birds which is used for eating and for grooming, manipulating objects, killing prey, probing for food, courtship and feeding young.

UBERON:0005096.name: descending thin limb
UBERON:0005096.def: the descending thin limb is a part of the loop of henle situated just after the proximal straight tubule (s3). it extends to the tip of the loop of henle[go].

UBERON:0005097.name: renal connecting tubule
UBERON:0005097.def: the connecting tubule is a tubular segment of the nephron; it connects the distal convoluted tubule to the collecting duct[go].

UBERON:0005099.name: short descending thin limb
UBERON:0005099.def: the short descending thin limb is the descending thin limb of a short nephron that has a squamous epithelial morphology[go].

UBERON:0005100.name: long descending thin limb
UBERON:0005100.def: the long descending limb starts in the inner stripe of the outer medulla and extends into the inner medulla[go].

UBERON:0005101.name: early distal convoluted tubule
UBERON:0005101.def: the early distal convoluted tubule contains dct cells and is vasopressin-insensitive[go].

UBERON:0005102.name: late distal convoluted tubule
UBERON:0005102.def: the late distal convoluted tubule contains dct cells and intercalated (ic) alpha and beta cells and is vasopressin-sensitive[go].

UBERON:0005103.name: mesonephric epithelium
UBERON:0005103.def: an epithelium that is part of a mesonephros [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005106.name: metanephric tubule
UBERON:0005106.def: a metanephric tubule is an epithelial tube that is part of the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005107.name: metanephric cap
UBERON:0005107.def: the metanephric cap is formed by the condensation of metanephric mesenchymal cells surrounding the ureteric bud tip[go]. mesenchyme closely apposed to the tips of the buds is called cap mesenchyme; it will later go on to form nephrons etc[gudmap].

UBERON:0005108.name: metanephric epithelium
UBERON:0005108.def: an epithelium is a tissue that covers the internal or external surfaces of an anatomical structure[go].

UBERON:0005109.name: metanephric smooth muscle tissue
UBERON:0005109.def: any smooth muscle tissue that is part of a metanephros.

UBERON:0005110.name: metanephric nephron
UBERON:0005110.def: a metanephric nephron is the functional unit of the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005111.name: metanephric pyramid
UBERON:0005111.def: metanephric pyramids are the conical masses that constitute the renal medulla in a metanephros; they contain the loops of henle and the medullary collecting ducts[go].

UBERON:0005114.name: metanephric ascending thin limb
UBERON:0005114.def: the metanephric ascending thin limb is a segment of a nephron tubule in the metanephros lying in the inner medulla that is permeable to ions but not to water and has a simple epithelium; active transepithelial solute transport is absent[go].

UBERON:0005115.name: metanephric cortical collecting duct
UBERON:0005115.def: the metanephric cortical collecting duct is the portion of the metanephric collecting duct that resides in the renal cortex[go].

UBERON:0005116.name: metanephric descending thin limb
UBERON:0005116.def: it extends to the tip of the metanephric loop of henle[go].

UBERON:0005117.name: metanephric distal convoluted tubule
UBERON:0005117.def: the metanephric distal convoluted tubule is a portion of the metanephric nephron tubule that connects the metanephric loop of henle to the collecting duct[go].

UBERON:0005118.name: metanephric early distal convoluted tubule
UBERON:0005118.def: the metanephric early distal convoluted tubule contains metanephric dct cells and is vasopressin-insensitive[go].

UBERON:0005119.name: metanephric glomerular mesangium
UBERON:0005119.def: the metanephric glomerular mesangium is the thin membrane connective tissue composed of mesangial cells in the metanephros, which helps to support the capillary loops in a renal glomerulus[go].

UBERON:0005120.name: metanephric late distal convoluted tubule
UBERON:0005120.def: the metanephric late distal convoluted tubule contains metanephric dct cells and intercalated (ic) alpha and beta cells and is vasopressin-sensitive[go].

UBERON:0005121.name: metanephric long descending thin limb bend
UBERON:0005121.def: the metanephric long descending thin limb bend is a part of the descending thin limb of a long nephron that lies beyond the prebend segment in the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005122.name: metanephric macula densa
UBERON:0005122.def: the metanephric macula densa is an area of specialized cells in the distal tubule of the metanephros that makes contact with the vascular pole of the glomerulus[go].

UBERON:0005123.name: metanephric prebend segment
UBERON:0005123.def: the metanephric prebend segment is a part of the metanephric descending thin limb that lies before the bend and exhibits permeabilities characteristic of the ascending limb, especially negligible water permeability[go].

UBERON:0005124.name: metanephric proximal convoluted tubule
UBERON:0005124.def: the metanephric proximal convoluted tubule is the most proximal portion of the metanephric proximal tubule and extends from the metanephric glomerular capsule to the metanephric proximal straight tubule[go].

UBERON:0005125.name: metanephric proximal straight tubule
UBERON:0005125.def: the metanephric proximal straight tubule is the part of the metanephric descending limb that extends from the metanephric proximal convoluted tubule to the metanephric descending thin tubule[go].

UBERON:0005126.name: metanephric s1
UBERON:0005126.def: the s1 portion is the initial portion of the metanephric proximal convoluted tubule and is responsible for avid reabsorption of water and solutes[go].

UBERON:0005127.name: metanephric thick ascending limb
UBERON:0005127.def: at the macula densa, the thick ascending limb connects to the distal convoluted tubule[go].

UBERON:0005129.name: metanephric distal tubule
UBERON:0005129.def: the metanephric distal tubule is a metanephric nephron tubule that begins at the metanephric macula densa and extends to the metanephric connecting tubule[go].

UBERON:0005130.name: metanephric loop of henle
UBERON:0005130.def: the metanephric loop of henle is a metanephric nephron tubule that connects the proximal convoluted tubule to the distal convoluted tubule in the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005132.name: metanephric long nephron
UBERON:0005132.def: long nephrons are associated with juxtamedullary glomeruli and extend into the inner medulla in the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005133.name: metanephric glomerulus vasculature
UBERON:0005133.def: the metanephric glomerulus vasculature is composed of the tubule structures that carry blood or lymph in the metanephric glomerulus[go].

UBERON:0005134.name: metanephric nephron epithelium
UBERON:0005134.def: the metanephric nephron epithelium is a tissue that covers the surface of a nephron in the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005135.name: metanephric glomerular epithelium
UBERON:0005135.def: a metanephric glomerular visceral epithelial cell is a specialized epithelial cell that contains 'feet' that interdigitate with the 'feet' of other glomerular epithelial cells in the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005136.name: metanephric glomerular endothelium
UBERON:0005136.def: the metanephric glomerular endothelium is an epithelial tissue that covers the internal surfaces of the glomerulus of the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005137.name: metanephric capsule
