UBERON:0005137.def: the metanephric capsule is the tough fibrous layer surrounding the metanephros, covered in a thick layer of perinephric adipose tissue. it provides some protection from trauma and damage[go].

UBERON:0005140.name: metanephric short nephron
UBERON:0005140.def: short nephrons are associated with mid-cortical and superficial glomeruli, are situated entirely in the outer medulla, and have no thin ascending limb[go].

UBERON:0005141.name: metanephric short descending thin limb
UBERON:0005141.def: the metanephric short descending thin limb is the descending thin limb of a short nephron in the metanephros that has a squamous epithelial morphology[go].

UBERON:0005144.name: metanephric glomerular capillary
UBERON:0005144.def: this process pertains to the initial formation of a structure from unspecified parts[go].

UBERON:0005145.name: metanephric comma-shaped body
UBERON:0005145.def: the metanephric comma-shaped body is the precursor structure to the metanephric s-shaped body that contributes to the morphogenesis of a nephron in the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005146.name: metanephric nephron tubule
UBERON:0005146.def: a metanephric nephron tubule is an epithelial tube that is part of the metanephric nephron, the functional part of the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005147.name: metanephric renal vesicle
UBERON:0005147.def: the renal vesicle is the primordial structure of the metanephric nephron epithelium, and is formed by the condensation of mesenchymal cells[go].

UBERON:0005148.name: metanephric s-shaped body
UBERON:0005148.def: the metanephric s-shaped body is the successor of the metanephric comma-shaped body that contributes to the morphogenesis of a nephron in the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005149.name: metanephric connecting tubule
UBERON:0005149.def: the metanephric connecting tubule is a tubular segment of the metanephric nephron; it connects the distal convoluted tubule to the collecting duct in the metanephros[go].

UBERON:0005151.name: metanephric proximal tubule
UBERON:0005151.def: the metanephric proximal tubule is a metanephric nephron tubule that connects bowman's capsule to the descending thin limb of the loop of henle in the metanephros. it has a brush border epithelial morphology[go].

UBERON:0005153.name: epithelial bud
UBERON:0005153.def: a bud is a protrusion that forms from an epithelial sheet by localized folding.

UBERON:0005154.name: epithelial cord
UBERON:0005154.def: a cord of epithelial cells without a lumen and usually several cells thick.

UBERON:0005155.name: open tracheal system
UBERON:0005155.def: an open tracheal system is a respiratory system, a branched network of epithelial tubes that supplies oxygen to target tissues via spiracles. an example of this is found in drosophila melanogaster.

UBERON:0005156.name: reproductive structure
UBERON:0005156.def: any anatomical structure that is part of the reproductive system.

UBERON:0005157.name: epithelial fold
UBERON:0005157.def: an epithelial sheet bent on a linear axis.

UBERON:0005158.name: parenchyma of central nervous system
UBERON:0005158.def: the functional tissue of the central nervous system consisting of neurons and glial cells.

UBERON:0005159.name: pyramid of medulla oblongata
UBERON:0005159.def: the anterior or ventral portion of the medulla oblongata is named the pyramid and lies between the anterior median fissure and the antero-lateral sulcus. its upper end is slightly constricted, and between it and the pons the fibers of the abducent nerve emerge; a little below the pons it becomes enlarged and prominent, and finally tapers into the anterior funiculus of the medulla spinalis, with which, at first sight, it appears to be directly continuous[wp].

UBERON:0005160.name: vestigial structure
UBERON:0005160.def: a remnant structure from earlier development or evolution.

UBERON:0005161.name: pelvic spur
UBERON:0005161.def: pelvic spurs are the externally visible portion of the vestigial remnants of legs found on each side of the vent in primitive snakes, such as boas and pythons. the remnants of a pelvis and femur, which have no connection with the spine, simply 'float' in the muscle mass. the femur protrudes from the snake's body and is covered by a corneal spur, which resembles a claw. males' spurs are generally longer and more pointed than females', and are used for clasping and tickling during courtship and mating, as well as combat with other males in some species.

UBERON:0005162.name: multi cell part structure
UBERON:0005162.def: a structure consisting of multiple cell components but which is not itself a cell and does not have (complete) cells as a part.

UBERON:0005164.name: ascending limb of loop of henle
UBERON:0005164.def: the distal part of the loop of henle that is impermeable to water and actively pumps sodium out of the filtrate to generate the hypertonic interstitium that drives countercurrent exchange; it consists of an initial very thin segment lined by simple squamous epithelium followed by a distal thick segment lined by simple cuboidal epithelium[mp].

UBERON:0005167.name: papillary duct
UBERON:0005167.def: the terminal portions of the medullary collecting ducts are the papillary ducts, which end at the renal papilla and empty into a minor calyx.

UBERON:0005168.name: renal interlobular vein
UBERON:0005168.def: any of the veins that parallel the interlobular arteries, receiving blood from the peritubular capillary plexus and empty into the arcuate veins.

UBERON:0005169.name: interstitial tissue
UBERON:0005169.def: connective tissue between the cellular elements of a structure.

UBERON:0005170.name: granulosa cell layer
UBERON:0005170.def: a layer of the ovarian follicle that consists of granulosa cells.

UBERON:0005171.name: hepatic duct
UBERON:0005171.def: any portion of the ducts that carry bile from the liver to the common bile duct. this may include both intrahapetic components (parts of left and right hepatic ducts) and extrahapetic components (common hepatic duct, plus hilar portion).

UBERON:0005172.name: abdomen element
UBERON:0005172.def: an organ or element that is in the abdomen. examples: spleen, intestine, kidney, abdominal mammary gland.

UBERON:0005173.name: abdominal segment element
UBERON:0005173.def: an organ or element that is part of the adbominal segment of the organism. this region can be further subdivided into the abdominal cavity and the pelvic region.

UBERON:0005174.name: dorsal region element
UBERON:0005174.def: an organ or element that part of the dorsum of the organism. examples: spinal cord, vertebrae, muscles of back.

UBERON:0005175.name: chest organ
UBERON:0005175.def: an organ that is part of a chest [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005176.name: tooth enamel organ
UBERON:0005176.def: a circumscribed mass of ectodermal cells which bud off from the dental lamina; it becomes cup-shaped and develops on its internal face the ameloblast layer of cells that produces the enamel cap of a developing tooth.

UBERON:0005177.name: trunk region element
UBERON:0005177.def: an organ or element that part of the trunk region. the trunk region can be further subdividied into thoracic (including chest and thoracic cavity) and abdominal (including abdomen and pelbis) regions.

UBERON:0005178.name: thoracic cavity element
UBERON:0005178.def: an organ or element that is in the thoracic cavity. examples: lung, heart, longus colli.

UBERON:0005179.name: pelvic region element
UBERON:0005179.def: an organ or element that is part of the pelvic region. examples: reproductive organs (in some organisms), urinary bladder, bones of the pelvis.

UBERON:0005181.name: thoracic segment organ
UBERON:0005181.def: an organ that part of the thoracic segment region. this region can be further subdividied chest and thoracic cavity regions.

UBERON:0005184.name: hair medulla
UBERON:0005184.def: innermost layer of the hair shaft.

UBERON:0005185.name: renal medulla collecting duct
UBERON:0005185.def: the portion of the collecting duct that resides in the renal medulla.

UBERON:0005191.name: obsolete cervical artery
UBERON:0005191.def: an artery that is part of a uterine cervix [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005192.name: deferent duct artery
UBERON:0005192.def: an artery in males that provides blood to the vas deferens. the artery usually arises from the anterior trunk of the superior vesical artery. it accompanies the vas deferens into the testis, where it anastomoses with the testicular artery. in this way it also supplies blood to the testis and epididymis. a small branch supplies the ureter[wp].

UBERON:0005193.name: ethmoidal artery
UBERON:0005193.def: one of: anterior or posterior ethmoidal arteries.

UBERON:0005194.name: thoracic vein
UBERON:0005194.def: a vein that is part of a thorax [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005195.name: deferent duct vein
UBERON:0005195.def: a vein that is part of a vas deferens [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005196.name: spleen germinal center
UBERON:0005196.def: a germinal center that is part of the spleen. the spleen germinal center is located in a secondary b follicle in the white pulp of the spleen.

UBERON:0005199.name: cervical mammary gland
UBERON:0005199.def: a mammary gland that is part of a cervical region.

UBERON:0005200.name: thoracic mammary gland
UBERON:0005200.def: a lactiferous gland that is located in the thoracic region/breast.

UBERON:0005202.name: distal straight tubule macula densa
UBERON:0005202.def: a macula densa that is part of an ascending limb of loop of henle [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005203.name: trachea gland
UBERON:0005203.def: a tubuloacinar seromucous gland that is located principally in the submucosa of the trachea. excretory ducts from this gland pass through the lamina propria to the tracheal lumen.

UBERON:0005204.name: larynx submucosa gland
UBERON:0005204.def: a gland that is part of a larynx submucosa [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005206.name: choroid plexus stroma
UBERON:0005206.def: stromal matrix surrounding blood vessels within the choroid plexus.

UBERON:0005207.name: tonsil capsule
UBERON:0005207.def: a capsule that is part of a tonsil [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005208.name: right atrium valve
UBERON:0005208.def: a valve that is part of a right atrium [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005211.name: renal medulla interstitium
UBERON:0005211.def: tissue surrounding the loop of henle in the renal medulla.

UBERON:0005212.name: leydig cell region of testis
UBERON:0005212.def: the male gonad containing two functional parts: the seminiferous tubules for the production and transport of male germ cells (spermatogenesis) and the interstitial compartment containing leydig cells that produce androgens..

UBERON:0005213.name: outer renal medulla interstitium
UBERON:0005213.def: a portion of interstitial tissue that is part of a outer medulla of kidney [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005214.name: inner renal medulla interstitium
UBERON:0005214.def: a portion of interstitial tissue that is part of a inner medulla of kidney [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005215.name: kidney interstitium
UBERON:0005215.def: the interstitial compartment of the kidney, comprising the extravascular intertubular spaces of the renal parenchyma, with their attendant cellular elements and extracellular substances, bounded on all sides by epithelial and vascular basement membranes.

UBERON:0005216.name: optic eminence surface ectoderm
UBERON:0005216.def: an external ectoderm that is part of a optic eminence [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005217.name: midbrain subarachnoid space
UBERON:0005217.def: a subarachnoid space that is part of a midbrain [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005218.name: diencephalon subarachnoid space
UBERON:0005218.def: a subarachnoid space that is part of a diencephalon [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005219.name: hindbrain subarachnoid space
UBERON:0005219.def: a subarachnoid space that is part of a hindbrain [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005220.name: pancreas head parenchyma
UBERON:0005220.def: a parenchyma that is part of a head of pancreas [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005221.name: liver right lobe parenchyma
UBERON:0005221.def: a parenchyma that is part of a right lobe of liver [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0005221.synonym: parenchyma of right lobe of liver

UBERON:0005222.name: liver left lobe parenchyma
UBERON:0005222.def: a parenchyma that is part of a left lobe of liver [automatically generated definition].
UBERON:0005222.synonym: parenchyma of left lobe of liver

UBERON:0005223.name: pancreas body parenchyma
UBERON:0005223.def: a parenchyma that is part of a body of pancreas [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005224.name: pancreas tail parenchyma
UBERON:0005224.def: a parenchyma that is part of a tail of pancreas [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005225.name: upper leg epithelium
UBERON:0005225.def: an epithelium that is part of a hindlimb stylopod [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005226.name: pedal digit epithelium
UBERON:0005226.def: an epithelium that is part of a toe [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005227.name: manual digit epithelium
UBERON:0005227.def: an epithelium that is part of a finger [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005228.name: upper arm epithelium
UBERON:0005228.def: an epithelium that is part of a forelimb stylopod [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005229.name: lower leg epithelium
UBERON:0005229.def: an epithelium that is part of a lower leg [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005233.name: medial-nasal process ectoderm
UBERON:0005233.def: an ectoderm that is part of a medial nasal prominence [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005234.name: optic eminence ectoderm
UBERON:0005234.def: an ectoderm that is part of a optic eminence [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005236.name: osseus labyrinth vestibule
UBERON:0005236.def: a small, oval, bony chamber of the labyrinth. the vestibule contains the utricle and saccule, organs which are part of the balancing apparatus of the ear.

UBERON:0005241.name: obsolete apical ectodermal ridge forelimb
UBERON:0005241.def: a forelimb that is part of an apical ectodermal ridge [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005242.name: obsolete apical ectodermal ridge hindlimb
UBERON:0005242.def: a hindlimb that is part of an apical ectodermal ridge [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005243.name: interventricular septum endocardium
UBERON:0005243.def: an endocardium that is part of a interventricular septum [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005244.name: lobar bronchus of right lung cranial lobe

UBERON:0005245.name: lobar bronchus of right lung caudal lobe
UBERON:0005245.def: a lobar bronchus that is part of a lower lobe of right lung [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005248.name: bulbus cordis myocardium
UBERON:0005248.def: a myocardium that is part of a bulbus cordis [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005249.name: metanephric renal pelvis
UBERON:0005249.def: a renal pelvis that is part of a metanephros.

UBERON:0005250.name: stomatodeum gland
UBERON:0005250.def: a gland that is part of a stomodeum.

UBERON:0005251.name: yolk sac cavity
UBERON:0005251.def: an anatomical cavity that is part of a yolk sac [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005252.name: lesser sac cavity
UBERON:0005252.def: an anatomical cavity that is part of a lesser sac [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005253.name: head mesenchyme
UBERON:0005253.def: portion of primordial embryonic connective tissue of the developing head, consisting of mesenchymal cells supported in interlaminar jelly, that derive mostly from the mesoderm and contribute to head connective tissue, bone and musculature in conjunction with cranial neural crest cells.

UBERON:0005254.name: upper leg mesenchyme
UBERON:0005254.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing hindlimb stylopod [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005255.name: pedal digit mesenchyme
UBERON:0005255.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing toe [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005256.name: trunk mesenchyme
UBERON:0005256.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing trunk.

UBERON:0005257.name: manual digit mesenchyme
UBERON:0005257.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing finger [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005258.name: upper arm mesenchyme
UBERON:0005258.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing forelimb stylopod [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005259.name: lower leg mesenchyme
UBERON:0005259.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing lower leg [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005261.name: atrium cardiac jelly
UBERON:0005261.def: a cardiac jelly that is part of an atrium [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005262.name: ventricle cardiac jelly
UBERON:0005262.def: a cardiac jelly that is part of a ventricle [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005263.name: outflow tract cardiac jelly
UBERON:0005263.def: a cardiac jelly that is part of a outflow tract [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005268.name: renal cortex artery
UBERON:0005268.def: an artery that supplies the renal cortex.

UBERON:0005269.name: renal cortex vein
UBERON:0005269.def: artery that receives blood from the renal cortex[mp, modified].

UBERON:0005270.name: renal cortex interstitium
UBERON:0005270.def: a compartment of the renal cortex situated between basement membranes of epithelia and vessels that contains two contiguous cellular networks in mutual contact, one formed by interstitial fibroblasts, the other by dendritic cells.

UBERON:0005271.name: juxtamedullary cortex
UBERON:0005271.def: the part of the renal cortex nearest to the medulla.

UBERON:0005272.name: peritubular capillary
UBERON:0005272.def: the tiny blood vessels that receive blood from the efferent arterioles of the glomerulus, and interact with superficial cortical nephrons allowing reabsorption and secretion between blood and the inner lumen of the nephron; peritubular capillaries are situated around the tubule and are at low pressure.

UBERON:0005273.name: nail bed
UBERON:0005273.def: region of skin beneath the nail plate[wp].

UBERON:0005275.name: dorsal skin of digit
UBERON:0005275.synonym: skin of dorsal part of digit

UBERON:0005276.name: dorsal skin of finger
UBERON:0005276.def: a dorsal skin of digit that is part of a manual digit.
UBERON:0005276.synonym: subdivision of skin of dorsal part of finger

UBERON:0005277.name: dorsal skin of toe
UBERON:0005277.def: a dorsal skin of digit that is part of a pedal digit.
UBERON:0005277.synonym: subdivision of skin of dorsal part of toe

UBERON:0005278.name: nail bed of finger
UBERON:0005278.def: a nail bed that is part of a manual digit.

UBERON:0005279.name: nail bed of toe
UBERON:0005279.def: a nail bed that is part of a pedal digit.

UBERON:0005281.name: ventricular system of central nervous system
UBERON:0005281.def: a set of structures containing cerebrospinal fluid in the brain. it is continuous with the central canal of the spinal cord[wp].

UBERON:0005283.name: tela choroidea
UBERON:0005283.def: a structure found in the walls of the ventricles of the brain, consisting of part of the meninges (pia mater in mammals) plus ependyma[cjm].

UBERON:0005286.name: tela choroidea of midbrain cerebral aqueduct
UBERON:0005286.def: tela choroidea that lines the tectal ventricle.

UBERON:0005287.name: tela choroidea of fourth ventricle
UBERON:0005287.def: tela chorioidea that lines the fourth ventricle[zfa]. the tela chorioidea of the fourth ventricle is the name applied to the triangular fold of pia mater which is carried upward between the cerebellum and the medulla oblongata. it consists of two layers, which are continuous with each other in front, and are more or less adherent throughout: the posterior layer covers the antero-inferior surface of the cerebellum. the anterior layer is applied to the structures which form the lower part of the roof of the ventricle, and is continuous inferiorly with the pia mater on the inferior peduncles and closed part of the medulla[wp].

UBERON:0005288.name: tela choroidea of third ventricle
UBERON:0005288.def: tela chorioidea that lines the third ventricle[zfa]. the part of the choroid plexus in relation to the body of the ventricle forms the vascular fringed margin of a triangular process of pia mater, named the tela chorioidea of the third ventricle, and projects from under cover of the lateral edge of the fornix. blood is supplied by branches from the superior cerebellar artery[wp].

UBERON:0005289.name: tela choroidea of telencephalic ventricle
UBERON:0005289.def: tela chorioidea that lines the telencephalic ventricle.

UBERON:0005290.name: myelencephalon
UBERON:0005290.def: the posterior part of the developing vertebrate hindbrain or the corresponding part of the adult brain composed of the medulla oblongata and a portion of the fourth ventricle; as well as the glossopharyngeal nerve (cn ix), vagus nerve (cn x), accessory nerve (cn xi), hypoglossal nerve (cn xii), and a portion of the vestibulocochlear nerve (cn viii).[bto,wp].

UBERON:0005291.name: embryonic tissue
UBERON:0005291.def: a portion of tissue that is part of an embryo.

UBERON:0005292.name: extraembryonic tissue
UBERON:0005292.def: portion of tissue that is contiguous with the embryo and is comprised of portions of tissue or cells that will not contribute to the embryo.

UBERON:0005293.name: cerebellum lobe
UBERON:0005293.def: a major subdivision of the cerebellum: anterior, posterior and flocculonodular.
UBERON:0005293.synonym: lobe parts of the cerebellar cortex

UBERON:0005294.name: gonadal ridge
UBERON:0005294.def: the elevation of thickened mesothelium and underlying mesenchyme found on the ventromedial border of the embryonic mesonephros in which the primordial germ cells become embedded, establishing it as the primordium of the testis or ovary.

UBERON:0005295.name: sex cord
UBERON:0005295.def: cordlike masses of epithelial tissue that invaginate from germinal epithelium of the gonad and give rise to seminiferous tubules and rete testes in the male, and primary ovarian follicles and rete ovarii in the female.

UBERON:0005296.name: ovary sex cord
UBERON:0005296.def: structures that develop from sex cords in the female. after further development they become the ovarian follicles.

UBERON:0005297.name: testis sex cord
UBERON:0005297.def: the testis cords are precursors to the rete testis. they play several different roles in the development of the male genitals[wp].

UBERON:0005298.name: skin of clitoris
UBERON:0005298.def: a zone of skin that is part of a clitoris [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005299.name: prepuce of clitoris
UBERON:0005299.def: a retractable double-layered fold of skin and mucous membrane that covers the clitoral glans.

UBERON:0005301.name: male preputial gland
UBERON:0005301.def: one of the sebaceous glands of the corona and neck of the glans penis.

UBERON:0005302.name: female preputial gland
UBERON:0005302.def: the paired, lobulated, modified sebaceous glands located on the side of the clitoris in female rodents; in contrast to the preputial glands in male rodents, clitoral glands are a minor source of olfactory stimuli contributing to sexual attractivity; unlike other sebaceous glands, they undergo progressive atrophy of the glandular portion with marked ductal ectasia as rodents age.

UBERON:0005303.name: hypogastric nerve
UBERON:0005303.def: the transition between the superior hypogastric plexus and the inferior hypogastric plexus.

UBERON:0005304.name: submucous nerve plexus
UBERON:0005304.def: the gangliated plexus of unmyelinated nerve fibers that ramify the stomach and intestinal submucosa.

UBERON:0005305.name: thyroid follicle
UBERON:0005305.def: discrete, cystlike units of the thyroid gland that are lined with cuboidal epithelium and are filled with a colloid substance, about 30 to each lobule[bto].

UBERON:0005306.name: blastema
UBERON:0005306.def: a blastema is a mass of cells capable of growth and regeneration into organs or body parts. historically blastema have been thought to be composed of undifferentiated pluripotent cells, but recent research indicates that in some organisms blastema may retain memory of tissue origin.[1] blastemata are typically found in the early stages of an organism's development such as in embryos, and in the regeneration of tissues, organs and bone[wp]. a regenerating tissue composed of a proliferative mass of undifferentiated progenitor cells from which new differentiated structures arise[zfa].

UBERON:0005307.name: chorion-containing eggshell
UBERON:0005307.def: an eggshell that contains chorion. an example of this is found in drosophila melanogaster.

UBERON:0005308.name: nephrostome
UBERON:0005308.def: the nephrostome is the opening of the pronephros into the body cavity[go].

UBERON:0005309.name: pronephric nephron
UBERON:0005309.def: a pronephric nephron is the functional unit of the pronephros[go].

UBERON:0005310.name: pronephric nephron tubule
UBERON:0005310.def: the pronephric nephron tubule is an epithelial tube that is part of the pronephric nephron and connects the filtration unit (glomerulus or glomus) of the pronephros to the pronephric duct[go].

UBERON:0005311.name: mammary placode
UBERON:0005311.def: the mammary placode is a transient lens shaped structure that will give rise to the mammary bud proper[go].

UBERON:0005313.name: mammary duct terminal end bud
UBERON:0005313.def: a unique club-shaped epithelial structure that develops at the tip of the mammary duct at the onset of puberty under the action of circulating hormones.

UBERON:0005314.name: alveolar primary septum
UBERON:0005314.def: a primary alveolar septum is a specialized epithelium that surrounds the saccule as it forms[go].

UBERON:0005315.name: alveolar secondary septum
UBERON:0005315.def: a secondary alveolar septum is a specialized epithelium that subdivides the initial saccule[go].

UBERON:0005316.name: endocardial endothelium
UBERON:0005316.def: the endothelial lining of the endocardium.

UBERON:0005317.name: pulmonary artery endothelium
UBERON:0005317.def: an pulmonary artery endothelium is an epithelium that lines the pulmonary artery[go].

UBERON:0005319.name: mesonephric collecting duct
UBERON:0005319.def: the collecting duct is the final common path through which urine flows before entering the ureter and then emptying into the bladder[go].

UBERON:0005320.name: mesonephric juxtaglomerular apparatus
UBERON:0005320.def: the juxtaglomerular apparatus lies adjacent to the glomerulus and regulates kidney function by maintaining the blood flow to the kidney and the filtration rate[go].

UBERON:0005322.name: mesonephric nephron
UBERON:0005322.def: a nephron that is part of a mesonephros.

UBERON:0005323.name: mesonephric mesenchyme
UBERON:0005323.def: mesonephric mesenchyme is the tissue made up of loosely connected mesenchymal cells in the mesonephros[go].

UBERON:0005324.name: mesonephric macula densa
UBERON:0005324.def: the mesonephric macula densa is an area of specialized cells in the distal tubule of the mesonephros that makes contact with the vascular pole of the glomerulus[go].

UBERON:0005325.name: mesonephric glomerulus
UBERON:0005325.def: the mesonephric glomerulus is a capillary tuft which forms a close network with the visceral epithelium (podocytes) and the mesangium to form the filtration barrier and is surrounded by bowman's capsule in nephrons of the mature vertebrate kidney, or mesonephros[go].

UBERON:0005326.name: mesonephric glomerulus vasculature
UBERON:0005326.def: the mesonephric glomerulus vasculature is composed of the tubule structures that carry blood or lymph in the mesonephric glomerulus[go].

UBERON:0005327.name: mesonephric glomerular epithelium
UBERON:0005327.def: a mesonephric glomerular visceral epithelial cell is a specialized epithelial cell that contains 'feet' that interdigitate with the 'feet' of other glomerular epithelial cells in the mesonephros[go].

UBERON:0005328.name: mesonephric comma-shaped body
UBERON:0005328.def: the mesonephric comma-shaped body is the precursor structure to the mesonephric s-shaped body that contributes to the morphogenesis of a nephron in the mesonephros[go].

UBERON:0005329.name: mesonephric nephron tubule
UBERON:0005329.def: a mesonephric nephron tubule is an epithelial tube that is part of the mesonephric nephron, the functional part of the mesonephros[go].

UBERON:0005330.name: mesonephric nephron epithelium
UBERON:0005330.def: the mesonephric nephron epithelium is a tissue that covers the surface of a nephron in the mesonephros[go].

UBERON:0005331.name: mesonephric renal vesicle
UBERON:0005331.def: the renal vesicle is the primordial structure of the mesonephric nephron epithelium, and is formed by the condensation of mesenchymal cells[go].

UBERON:0005332.name: mesonephric s-shaped body
UBERON:0005332.def: the mesonephric s-shaped body is the successor of the mesonephric comma-shaped body that contributes to the morphogenesis of a nephron in the mesonephros[go].

UBERON:0005333.name: mammary bud
UBERON:0005333.def: a bulb of epithelial cells that forms from the mammary placode that develops into the mammary gland.

UBERON:0005334.name: oral lamina propria
UBERON:0005334.def: a lamina propria that is part of a mucosa of oral region.

UBERON:0005335.name: chorioallantoic membrane
UBERON:0005335.def: the chorioallantoic membrane is a vascular membrane found in eggs of some amniotes, such as birds and reptiles. it is formed by the fusion of the mesodermal layers of two developmental structures: the allantois and the chorion. three different layers compose the chorioallantoic membrane; these are called the chorionic epithelium, the mesenchyme and the allantoic epithelium. blood capillaries and sinuses are found between epithelial cells of the chorionic layer, allowing close contact (within 0.2 n<m) with air found in pores of the shell membrane of the egg. as a result, the chorioallantoic membrane allows exchange of gases, such as oxygen, to developing embryos. during embryonic development of birds, the chorioallantoic membrane also plays an essential role in bone formation by transporting calcium into the embryo from the eggshell. chorioalloantoic membranes from developing chicken eggs are routinely used in biological and biomedical research to investigate development, angiogenesis, tumors, and to propagate and investigate viruses or helminths.

UBERON:0005336.name: capillary layer of choroid
UBERON:0005336.def: the capillary lamina of choroid or choriocapillaris is a layer of capillaries that is immediately adjacent to bruch's membrane in the choroid.

UBERON:0005337.name: outflow tract of ventricle
UBERON:0005337.def: a ventricular outflow tract is a portion of either the left ventricle or right ventricle of the heart through which blood passes in order to enter the great arteries. the right ventricular outflow tract (rvot) is an infundibular extension of the ventricular cavity which connects to the pulmonary artery. the left ventricular outflow tract (lvot), which connects to the aorta, is nearly indistinguishable from the rest of the ventricle[wp].

UBERON:0005338.name: outflow tract aortic component
UBERON:0005338.def: an outflow tract that is part of a aorta.

UBERON:0005340.name: dorsal telencephalic commissure
UBERON:0005340.def: a fiber tracts that connect the dorsal region of the two cerebral hemispheres and span the longitudinal fissure, including the corpus callosum and hippocampal commissure[mp].

UBERON:0005341.name: ventral commissure
UBERON:0005341.def: the fiber tracts that connect the ventral region of the two cerebral hemispheres and span the longitudinal fissure, including the anterior and the habenular commissures[mp].

UBERON:0005342.name: malleus head
UBERON:0005342.def: rounded portion of the malleus that articulates with the body of the incus[mp].

UBERON:0005343.name: cortical plate
UBERON:0005343.def: the outer neural tube region in which post-mitotic neuroblasts migrate along radial glia to form the adult cortical layers[mp].

UBERON:0005344.name: peritoneal vaginal process
UBERON:0005344.def: a peritoneal diverticulum in the embryonic lower anterior abdominal wall that traverses the inguinal canal. in the male it forms the tunica vaginalis testis and normally loses its connection with the peritoneal cavity; a persistent processus vaginalis in the female is known as the canal of nuck[mp].

UBERON:0005345.name: cerebellum vermis lobule viia
UBERON:0005345.def: the folium vermis is a short, narrow, concealed band at the posterior extremity of the vermis, consisting apparently of a single folium, but in reality marked on its upper and under surfaces by secondary fissures. laterally, it expands in either hemisphere into a considerable lobule, the superior semilunar lobule (lobulus semilunaris superior; postero-superior lobules), which occupies the posterior third of the upper surface of the hemisphere, and is bounded below by the horizontal sulcus. the superior semilunar lobules and the folium vermis form the lobus semilunaris.

UBERON:0005348.name: ansiform lobule
UBERON:0005348.def: a lobule comprising the greater part of the hemisphere of the cerebellum; its superior and inferior surfaces are separated by the horizontal fissure into major parts known as crus i (superior semilunar lobule) and crus ii (inferior semilunar lobule).

UBERON:0005349.name: paramedian lobule
UBERON:0005349.def: the anterior portion of the posteroinferior lobule of the cerebellum, the posterior portion being the semilunar lobule inferior; the two are continuous with the tuber of the vermis.

UBERON:0005352.name: spermatic cord
UBERON:0005352.def: the cord-like structure in males comprising the vas deferens and associated tissue that runs from the abdomen down to each testis[mp].

UBERON:0005353.name: spleen perifollicular zone
UBERON:0005353.def: the compartment located between the marginal zone and the red pulp harboring scattered b and t lymphocytes[mp].

UBERON:0005354.name: malleus processus brevis
UBERON:0005354.def: the projection extending from the base of the manubrium of the malleus which contacts the upper part of the tympanic membrane where the tympanic cavity makes a deep pocket (epitympanic pocket) surrounding the cartilaginous nodule[mp].

UBERON:0005355.name: malleus neck
UBERON:0005355.def: the narrow contracted section of the malleus located between the head and the manubrium[mp].

UBERON:0005356.name: rathke's pouch
UBERON:0005356.def: a pouch of ectoderm that grows out from the upper surface of the embryonic stomodeum and gives rise to the anterior and intermediate lobes of the pituitary gland[mp]. in embryogenesis, rathke's pouch is a depression in the roof of the developing mouth in front of the buccopharyngeal membrane. it gives rise to the anterior pituitary (adenohypophysis), a part of the endocrine system[wp].

UBERON:0005357.name: brain ependyma
UBERON:0005357.def: the ependymal cell layer that lines the brain ventricles.
UBERON:0005357.synonym: ependyma of ventricular system of brain

UBERON:0005358.name: ventricle of nervous system
UBERON:0005358.def: a layer in the central nervous system that lines system of communicating cavities in the brain and spinal cord.

UBERON:0005359.name: spinal cord ependyma
UBERON:0005359.def: the ependymal cell layer that lines the spinal cord.

UBERON:0005360.name: inferior glossopharyngeal ix ganglion
UBERON:0005360.def: the lower group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the glossopharyngeal nerve[mp]. it is situated in a depression in the lower border of the petrous portion of the temporal bone[wp].

UBERON:0005361.name: superior glossopharyngeal ix ganglion
UBERON:0005361.def: the upper ganglion of the glossopharyngeal nerve[mp]. is situated in the upper part of the groove in which the glossopharyngeal nerve is lodged during its passage through the jugular foramen. it is very small, and is usually regarded as a detached portion of the inferior ganglion.

UBERON:0005362.name: vagus x ganglion
UBERON:0005362.def: the group of sensory neuron cell bodies associated with the vagus nerve.

UBERON:0005363.name: inferior vagus x ganglion
UBERON:0005363.def: the large group of sensory neuron cell bodies, anterior to the jugular vein, associated with the vagus nerve (tenth cranial nerve).

UBERON:0005364.name: superior vagus x ganglion
UBERON:0005364.def: the upper ganglion of the vagus nerve located at the jugular foramen.

UBERON:0005366.name: olfactory lobe
UBERON:0005366.def: the lobe at the anterior part of each cerebral hemisphere, responsible for olfactory functions.

UBERON:0005368.name: hippocampus molecular layer
UBERON:0005368.def: the most superficial stratum in the hippocampus. here the perforant path fibers form synapses onto the distal, apical dendrites of pyramidal cells.

UBERON:0005370.name: hippocampus stratum lacunosum
UBERON:0005370.def: a thin stratum in the hippocampus that is immediately deep to the molecular layer, and is superficial to the stratum radiatum.

UBERON:0005371.name: hippocampus stratum oriens
UBERON:0005371.def: layer that is part of the ca fields of the hippocampus consisting of a narrow relatively cell free layer located deep to the pyramidal cell layer extending through areas ca1, ca2 and ca3. (adapted from paxinos the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995).

UBERON:0005372.name: hippocampus stratum radiatum
UBERON:0005372.def: the layer located immediately above the pyramidal cell layer in ca2 and ca1 and superficial to the stratum lucidum in ca3. suprapyramidal region in which ca3 to ca3 associational connections and ca3 to ca1 schaffer collateral connections are located.

UBERON:0005373.name: spinal cord dorsal column
UBERON:0005373.def: the wedge-shaped fiber bundle of white matter in the dorsomedial side of the spinal cord that is made up of the fasciculus gracilis and fasciculus cuneatus; it is part of the ascending posterior column-medial lemniscus pathway that is important for well-localized fine touch and conscious proprioception.

UBERON:0005374.name: spinal cord lateral column
UBERON:0005374.def: the region of white matter of the spinal cord that is located between the dorsal and ventral spinal roots.

UBERON:0005375.name: spinal cord ventral column
UBERON:0005375.def: the area of white matter of the spinal cord located on either side of the ventral (anterior) medial fissure.

UBERON:0005376.name: olfactory bulb external plexiform layer
UBERON:0005376.def: cytoarchitectural part of the olfactory bulb, lying superior to the mitral cell layer and inferior to the glomerular layer. the epl is mostly neuropil composed almost entirely of mitral and tulfted cell dendrites and granule cell dendrites and their synaptic inputs.
UBERON:0005376.synonym: olfactory bulb main external plexiform layer

UBERON:0005377.name: olfactory bulb glomerular layer
UBERON:0005377.def: the glomerular layer is the most superficial layer, consisting of mitral cell dendritic arborizations (glomeruli), olfactory nerve fibers, and periglomerular cells. periglomerular cells contact multiple mitral cell dendrites within the glomeruli and provide lateral inhibition of neighboring glomeruli while allowing excitation of a specific mitral cell dendritic tree. each mitral cell is contacted by at least 1000 olfactory nerve fibers[bto]. portion of tissue which is located in between the primary olfactory fiber layer and the external cellular layer of the olfactory bulb[zfa].

UBERON:0005378.name: olfactory bulb granule cell layer
UBERON:0005378.def: the granule cell layer contains multiple small round neurons that lack axons. long dendritic processes of the neurons reach the more superficial layers and inhibit mitral cells and tufted cells. small distal processes make contacts with the exiting mitral cell axons.
UBERON:0005378.synonym: olfactory bulb main granule cell layer

UBERON:0005379.name: olfactory bulb internal plexiform layer
UBERON:0005379.synonym: main olfactory bulb, inner plexiform layer

UBERON:0005380.name: olfactory bulb subependymal zone
UBERON:0005380.def: the region of mitotically active layer of cells surrounding the lateral brain ventricles that consists of migrating neuroblasts, astrocytes and transitory amplifying progenitor cells, that produce neurons that migrate to the olfactory bulb.

UBERON:0005381.name: dentate gyrus granule cell layer
UBERON:0005381.def: granule cell layer is also called the dg principal cell layer. this one of the three layers of dentate gyrus that lies deep to the molecular layer and is made of densely packed layer that is four to eight granule cells thick.

UBERON:0005382.name: dorsal striatum
UBERON:0005382.def: dorsal components of the striatum comprising the caudate nucleus and the putamen, in species that have distinct nuclei; the caudoputamen in species which don't.

UBERON:0005383.name: caudate-putamen
UBERON:0005383.def: regional part of telencephalon in some species, e.g., rodent, equivalent to the dorsal striatum (caudate nucleus and putamen). unlike the dorsal striatum of primates, for example, the caudoputamen is not split into separate nuclei by the fibers of the internal capsule. rather, the internal capsule splits into fiber bundles which course through the structure.

UBERON:0005384.name: nasal cavity epithelium
UBERON:0005384.def: an epithelium that lines the nasal cavity.

UBERON:0005385.name: nasal cavity respiratory epithelium
UBERON:0005385.def: an epithelium that is part of the respiratory segment of the nasal mucosa [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0005386.name: olfactory segment of nasal mucosa
UBERON:0005386.def: that portion of the nasal mucosa containing the sensory endings for olfaction; the organ of smell[mesh].

UBERON:0005387.name: olfactory glomerulus
UBERON:0005387.def: one of the small globular masses of dense neuropil in the olfactory bulb, containing the first synapse in the olfactory pathway[bto].

UBERON:0005388.name: photoreceptor array
UBERON:0005388.def: an array of photoreceptors and any supporting cells found in an eye.

UBERON:0005389.name: transparent eye structure
UBERON:0005389.def: a transparent structure that is part of a visual sense organ, the function of which is to direct or focus light onto a photoreceptor array.

UBERON:0005390.name: cortical layer i
UBERON:0005390.def: the most superficial layer of the neocortex characterized by a paucity of cell bodies.

UBERON:0005391.name: cortical layer ii
UBERON:0005391.def: layer of neocortex lying just deep to molecular layer characterized by numerous small cell bodies.

UBERON:0005392.name: cortical layer iii
UBERON:0005392.def: layer of neocortex lying deep to the external granule cell layer defined cytoarchitecturally by numerous small pyramidal neurons.

UBERON:0005393.name: cortical layer iv
UBERON:0005393.def: layer of neocortex lying deep to the external pyramidal cell layer defined cytoarchitecturally by the presence of numerous small cells.

UBERON:0005394.name: cortical layer v
UBERON:0005394.def: layer of neocortex lying deep to the internal granule cell layer (layer 4) defined cytoarchitecturally by the predominance of large pyramidal cell bodies.

UBERON:0005395.name: cortical layer vi
UBERON:0005395.def: innermost layer of neocortex lying deep to the internal pyramidal cell layer defined cytoarchitecturally by cells of varying size.

UBERON:0005396.name: carotid artery segment
UBERON:0005396.def: one of: the common carotid artery, or its branches, the external and internal carotid arteries.

UBERON:0005397.name: brain arachnoid mater
UBERON:0005397.def: an arachnoid mater that surrounds a brain.

UBERON:0005398.name: female reproductive gland
UBERON:0005398.def: a sex gland that is part of a female reproductive system.

UBERON:0005399.name: male reproductive gland
UBERON:0005399.def: a sex gland that is part of a male reproductive system.

UBERON:0005400.name: telencephalon arachnoid mater
UBERON:0005400.def: an arachnoid mater that is part of a telencephalon.

UBERON:0005401.name: cerebral hemisphere gray matter
UBERON:0005401.def: a gray matter that is part of a cerebral hemisphere.

UBERON:0005402.name: philtrum
UBERON:0005402.def: the vertical groove found on the median line of the upper lip, extending to the nose.

UBERON:0005403.name: ventral striatum
UBERON:0005403.def: a composite structure of the telencephalon that is defined in the striatopallidal system by connectivity and neurochemical staining. it includes the nucleus accumbens, the most ventral portions of the caudate nucleus and the putamen, the rostrolateral portion of the anterior perforated substance, the islands of calleja and a rostral subcommissural portion of substantia innominata. the boundary between the ventral striatum and dorsal striatum is indistinct in sections stained for nissl substance (heimer-1995; adapted from brain info).

UBERON:0005404.name: frontonasal suture
UBERON:0005404.def: a suture between frontal and nasal bones.

UBERON:0005405.name: pararenal fat
UBERON:0005405.def: the paranephric body (or paranephric fat or pararenal fat) is collection of adipose tissue located superficial to the renal fascia. the perirenal fat, or adipose capsule of kidney, is deep to the renal fascia but superficial to the renal capsule.

UBERON:0005406.name: perirenal fat
UBERON:0005406.def: the adipose capsule of kidney (or perinephric fat or perirenal fat) is a structure between the renal fascia and renal capsule, and may be regarded as a part of the latter. a different structure, the pararenal fat, is the adipose tissue superficial to the renal fascia.

UBERON:0005407.name: sublingual ganglion
UBERON:0005407.def: the small parasympathetic ganglion found anterior to the submandibular gland that provides postsynaptic fibers to the sublingual gland.

UBERON:0005408.name: circumventricular organ
UBERON:0005408.def: any of any of the secretory or sensory organs located in the brain region around or in relation to the ventricular system that are characterized by extensive vasculature and a lack of a normal blood brain barrier (bbb) and allow for the linkage between the central nervous system and peripheral blood flow.

UBERON:0005409.name: alimentary part of gastrointestinal system
UBERON:0005409.def: the part of the digestive system that excludes the hepatobiliary system.

UBERON:0005410.name: cartilaginous otic capsule
UBERON:0005410.def: an otic capsule endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0005411.name: bony otic capsule
UBERON:0005411.def: the cartilage or bony capsule surrounding the inner ear mechanism.

UBERON:0005412.name: optic fissure
UBERON:0005412.def: groove that is in the developing ventral optic cup and through which blood vessels pass to the enclosed mesenchyme[zfa]. a ventral fissure in the developing optic cup through which blood vessels pass to the enclosed mesenchyme[free online medical dictionary].

UBERON:0005413.name: spinocerebellar tract
UBERON:0005413.def: this tract conveys interoceptive, proprioceptive, and exteroceptive information from the body's internal organs, and from the trunk, extremities, and neck region to the cerebellum.

UBERON:0005414.name: zone of polarizing activity
UBERON:0005414.def: an area of mesenchymal cells that contains signals which instruct the developing limb or fin bud to form along the anterior/posterior axis.

UBERON:0005415.name: zone of polarizing activity of pectoral appendage
UBERON:0005415.def: a zone of polarizing activity that is part of a pectoral appendage bud mesenchyme.
UBERON:0005415.synonym: zone of polarizing activity pectoral fin bud

UBERON:0005416.name: zone of polarizing activity of pelvic appendage
UBERON:0005416.def: a zone of polarizing activity that is part of a pelvic appendage bud mesenchyme.
UBERON:0005416.synonym: zone of polarizing activity pelvic fin bud

UBERON:0005417.name: forelimb bud
UBERON:0005417.def: a limb bud that develops into a forelimb.

UBERON:0005418.name: hindlimb bud
UBERON:0005418.def: a limb bud that develops into a hindlimb.

UBERON:0005419.name: pectoral appendage bud
UBERON:0005419.def: a limb bud that develops into a forelimb or pectoral fin.

UBERON:0005420.name: pelvic appendage bud
UBERON:0005420.def: a limb bud that develops into a hindlimb or pelvic fin.

UBERON:0005421.name: pectoral appendage apical ectodermal ridge
UBERON:0005421.def: an apical ectodermal ridge that is part of a pectoral appendage bud.

UBERON:0005422.name: pelvic appendage apical ectodermal ridge
UBERON:0005422.def: an apical ectodermal ridge that is part of a pelvic appendage bud.
UBERON:0005422.synonym: lower lmb bud apical ectodermal ridge

UBERON:0005424.name: presumptive retinal pigmented epithelium
UBERON:0005424.def: portion of tissue that is the outer layer of the optic cup and will become the retinal pigmented epithelium.

UBERON:0005425.name: presumptive neural retina
UBERON:0005425.def: portion of tissue that is the inner layer of the optic cup and will become the neural retina.

UBERON:0005426.name: lens vesicle
UBERON:0005426.def: portion of tissue that gives rise to the lens.

UBERON:0005427.name: corneal primordium
UBERON:0005427.def: portion of tissue that is part of the eye and gives rise to the mature, fully layered cornea.

UBERON:0005428.name: vagal neural crest
UBERON:0005428.def: vagal neural crest is adjacent to the first seven somites gives rise to both ganglionic and ectomesenchymal derivatives[zfa].

UBERON:0005429.name: dorsal pancreatic duct
UBERON:0005429.def: a pancreatic duct that develops from the dorsal pancreatic bud.

UBERON:0005430.name: ansa cervicalis
UBERON:0005430.def: a loop of nerves that are part of the cervical plexus that lies superficial to the internal jugular vein in the carotid sheath. branches from the ansa cervicalis innervate three of the four infrahyoid muscles, including the sternohyoid muscle, the sternothyroid muscle, and the omohyoid muscle.

UBERON:0005431.name: anterior spinal artery
UBERON:0005431.def: a blood vessel that supplies the anterior portion of the spinal cord. it arises from branches of the vertebral arteries and is supplied by the anterior segmental medullary arteries, including the artery of adamkiewicz, and courses along the anterior aspect of the spinal cord.

UBERON:0005432.name: aortic sac
UBERON:0005432.def: the dilated structure that is lined by endothelial cells and located at the arterial pole of the heart just above (distal to) the truncus arteriosus in mammalian embryos; it is the primordial vascular channel from which the aortic arches (and eventually the dorsal aortae) arise; the aortic sac is homologous to the ventral aorta of gill-bearing vertebrates.

UBERON:0005433.name: obsolete peripheral part of autonomous nervous system
UBERON:0005433.synonym: peripheral part of autonomic nervous system

UBERON:0005435.name: upper part of cisterna chyli
UBERON:0005435.def: a dilated sac at the lower end of the thoracic duct into which lymph from the intestinal trunk and two lumbar lymphatic trunks flow.

UBERON:0005436.name: common hepatic artery
UBERON:0005436.def: in anatomy, the common hepatic artery is a short blood vessel that supplies oxygenated blood to the liver, pylorus (a part of the stomach), duodenum (a part of the small intestine) and pancreas. it arises from the celiac artery and has the following branches:.

UBERON:0005437.name: conus medullaris
UBERON:0005437.def: the conus medullaris is the terminal end of the spinal cord. it occurs near lumbar vertebral levels 1 (l1) and 2 (l2). after the spinal cord tapers out, the spinal nerves continue as dangling nerve roots called cauda equina. this terminal nerve root tail is referred to as the filum terminale. the upper end of the conus medullaris is usually not well defined.

UBERON:0005438.name: coronary sinus
UBERON:0005438.def: the short trunk that recieves most of the cardiac veins carrying the blood from the myocardium and delivers it to the right atrium, with the sinoatrial connection occurring between the inferior vena cava and the atrioventricular orifice.

UBERON:0005440.name: ductus arteriosus
UBERON:0005440.def: a fetal blood vessel connecting the pulmonary artery with the descending aorta[mesh]. in the developing fetus, the ductus arteriosus is a shunt connecting the pulmonary artery to the aortic arch. it allows most of the blood from the right ventricle to bypass the fetus' fluid-filled lungs, protecting the lungs from being overworked and allowing the left ventricle to strengthen. there are two other fetal shunts, the ductus venosus and the foramen ovale[mp]. the fetal vessel that connects the left pulmonary artery with the descending aorta; the ductus arteriosus normally regresses into a fibrous cord, the ligamentum arteriousum after birth[mp].

UBERON:0005441.name: external intercostal muscle
UBERON:0005441.def: an intercostal muscle that aids in quiet and forced inhalation via elevation of the ribs, and expanding the transverse dimensions of the thoracic cavity.

UBERON:0005442.name: abdominal external oblique muscle
UBERON:0005442.def: the lateral abdominal wall muscle that is the most superficial, immediately superficial to the internal oblique.

UBERON:0005443.name: filum terminale
UBERON:0005443.def: a strand of fibrous tissue in the spinal cord consisting of the filum terminale internum and the filum terminale externum.

UBERON:0005445.name: segment of pes
UBERON:0005445.def: a segment of autopod that is part of a pes.

UBERON:0005446.name: foramen rotundum
UBERON:0005446.def: the foramen rotundum is a circular hole in the sphenoid bone that connects the middle cranial fossa and the pterygopalatine fossa.

UBERON:0005448.name: greater omentum
UBERON:0005448.def: the greater omentum (also the great omentum, omentum majus, gastrocolic omentum, epiploön, or, especially in animals, caul) is a large fold of peritoneum that hangs down from the stomach, and extends from the stomach to the posterior abdominal wall after associating with the transverse colon.

UBERON:0005449.name: greater sac
UBERON:0005449.synonym: peritoneum of the peritoneal cavity proper

UBERON:0005450.name: greater sac cavity
UBERON:0005450.def: the cavity in the abdomen that is inside the peritoneum but outside of the lesser sac. [wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0005451.name: segment of manus
UBERON:0005451.def: a segment of autopod that is part of a manus.

UBERON:0005452.name: hepatic cord
UBERON:0005452.def: a three-dimensional arrangement formed by plates of hepatocytes, usually one cell thick, that radiates from the center of the liver lobule; hepatic laminae are highly branched, irregular structures bordered by endothelial lined vascular spaces called hepatic sinusoids.

UBERON:0005453.name: inferior mesenteric ganglion
UBERON:0005453.def: a ganglion located near where the inferior mesenteric artery branches from the abdominal aorta[wp].

UBERON:0005454.name: abdominal internal oblique muscle
UBERON:0005454.def: the lateral abdominal wall muscle that is deep to the external oblique and superficial to the transversus.

UBERON:0005455.name: interventricular groove
UBERON:0005455.def: either of the anterior and posterior grooves on the surface of the heart that lie over the interventricular septum and join at the apex.

UBERON:0005456.name: jugular foramen
UBERON:0005456.def: the jugular foramen is a large aperture in the base of the skull. it is located behind the carotid canal and is formed in front by the petrous portion of the temporal, and behind by the occipital; it is generally larger on the right than on the left side.

UBERON:0005457.name: left thymus lobe
UBERON:0005457.def: a thymus lobe that is in the left side of a thymus.

UBERON:0005459.name: left umbilical vein
UBERON:0005459.def: an umbilical vein that is in the left side of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0005460.name: left vitelline vein
UBERON:0005460.def: a vitelline vein that is in the left side of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0005461.name: levator scapulae muscle
UBERON:0005461.def: an axial muscle that originates in the cervical vertebraae inserts on the scapula.

UBERON:0005462.name: lower back
UBERON:0005462.def: subdivision of abdominal segment of trunk which in humans is demarcated from the front of the abdomen by the posterior surface of the anterior layer of the thoracolumbar fascia and the anterior surface of the lumbar vertebral column; together with the front of the abdomen, it constitutes the abdomen[modified from fma].

UBERON:0005463.name: subcapsular sinus of lymph node
UBERON:0005463.def: a space between the capsule and the cortex which allows the free movement of lymphatic fluid and so contains a sparsity of lymphocytes. it is continuous with the similar lymph sinuses that flank the trabeculae.

UBERON:0005464.name: median sacral artery
UBERON:0005464.def: the median sacral artery (or middle sacral artery) is a small vessel, which arises from the back of the aorta, a little above its bifurcation. it descends in the middle line in front of the fourth and fifth lumbar vertebræ, the sacrum and coccyx, and ends in the glomus coccygeum (coccygeal gland). from it, minute branches are said to pass to the posterior surface of the rectum. on the last lumbar vertebra it anastomoses with the lumbar branch of the iliolumbar artery; in front of the sacrum it anastomoses with the lateral sacral arteries, and sends offsets into the anterior sacral foramina. it is crossed by the left common iliac vein, and is accompanied by a pair of venæ comitantes; these unite to form a single vessel, which opens into the left common iliac vein.

UBERON:0005465.name: obturator nerve
UBERON:0005465.def: the obturator nerve arises from the ventral divisions of the second, third, and fourth lumbar nerves; the branch from the third is the largest, while that from the second is often very small.

UBERON:0005467.name: platysma
UBERON:0005467.def: the platysma is a pharyngeal arch 2 muscle and a superficial facial muscle that participates in oral/pharyngeal behaviors and is innervated by the cervical branch of the facial nerve. it attaches to the mandible and it attaches to the skin of the head, neck, and thoracic region where it is found superficial to the clavicle. burrows et al. (2011) argue that in hylobatids (and, presumably, other primates) the platysma in the region of the modiolus represents both the cervicale and myoides muscles.

UBERON:0005469.name: right thymus lobe
UBERON:0005469.def: a thymus lobe that is in the right side of a thymus.

UBERON:0005471.name: right umbilical vein
UBERON:0005471.def: an umbilical vein that is in the right side of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0005472.name: right vitelline vein
UBERON:0005472.def: a vitelline vein that is in the right side of a multicellular organism.

UBERON:0005473.name: sacral region
UBERON:0005473.def: a subdivision of an organism along the anterior-posterior axis in the pelvic region immediately posterior to the lumbar region and anterior to the caudal region. sometimes an intermediate region is defined between the sacral and caudal.

UBERON:0005475.name: sigmoid sinus
UBERON:0005475.def: a portion of the lateral venous sinus, bulging prominently into the mastoid cavity, that serves as a principal conduit by which blood leaves the cranium[epic]. the sigmoid is drained by the internal jugular vein.

UBERON:0005476.name: spinal nerve trunk
UBERON:0005476.def: trunk part of spinal nerve, where dorsal and ventral roots meet to form the spinal nerve, before branching off to dorsal and ventral rami.

UBERON:0005477.name: stomach fundus epithelium
UBERON:0005477.def: a simple columnar epithelium that is part of a fundus of stomach.

UBERON:0005478.name: sulcus limitans of neural tube
UBERON:0005478.def: a longitudinal groove in the neural tube wall that divides the neural tube into dorsal (alar) and ventral (basal) halves (dorsal receives input from sensory neurons, ventral effects motor functions); stretches from the mesencephalon caudad[tmd].

UBERON:0005479.name: superior mesenteric ganglion
UBERON:0005479.def: a ganglion in the upper part of the superior mesenteric plexus that is the synapsing point for one of the pre- and post-synaptic nerves of the sympathetic division of the autonomous nervous system.

UBERON:0005480.name: superior orbital fissure
UBERON:0005480.def: the orbital fissure that is situated superiorly between the greater wing and the lesser wing of the sphenoid bone.

UBERON:0005481.name: tentorial sinus
UBERON:0005481.def: an unpaired venous dural sinus that receives blood from the superior cerebellar veins and inferior sagittal sinus and drains into the confluence of sinuses.

UBERON:0005483.name: thymus lobe
UBERON:0005483.def: either of the two lateral lobes that constitute the thymus.

UBERON:0005484.name: tricuspid valve leaflet
UBERON:0005484.def: a valve leaflet that is part of a tricuspid valve.

UBERON:0005485.name: valve of inferior vena cava
UBERON:0005485.def: the semicircular fold of endocardium located on the right atrium at the point of attachment of the inferior vena cava; during development this valve helps direct the flow of oxygen-rich blood through the right atrium into the left cardiac atrium via the foramen ovale (preventing blood flowing into the right ventricle).

UBERON:0005486.name: venous dural sinus
UBERON:0005486.def: a venous channel found between layers of dura mater in the brain. receives blood from internal and external veins of the brain, receive cerebrospinal fluid (csf) from the subarachnoid space, and ultimately empty into the internal jugular vein.

UBERON:0005487.name: vitelline vein
UBERON:0005487.def: the paired veins that carry blood from the yolk sac back to the embryo.

UBERON:0005488.name: superior mesenteric plexus
UBERON:0005488.def: the superior mesenteric plexus is a continuation of the lower part of the celiac plexus, receiving a branch from the junction of the right vagus nerve with the plexus. it surrounds the superior mesenteric artery, accompanies it into the mesentery, and divides into a number of secondary plexuses, which are distributed to all the parts supplied by the artery, viz. , pancreatic branches to the pancreas; intestinal branches to the small intestine; and ileocolic, right colic, and middle colic branches, which supply the corresponding parts of the great intestine. the nerves composing this plexus are white in color and firm in texture; in the upper part of the plexus close to the origin of the superior mesenteric artery is the superior mesenteric ganglion.

UBERON:0005489.name: anterior interventricular sulcus
UBERON:0005489.def: the ventricles of the heart are separated by two grooves, one of which, the anterior longitudinal sulcus (or anterior interventricular sulcus), is situated on the sternocostal surface of the heart, close to its left margin. the other groove separating the ventricles is the posterior interventricular sulcus.

UBERON:0005490.name: posterior interventricular sulcus
UBERON:0005490.def: the ventricles are separated by two grooves, one of which, the anterior longitudinal sulcus, is situated on the sternocostal surface of the heart, close to its left margin, the other posterior longitudinal sulcus (posterior interventricular sulcus, inferior interventricular groove), on the diaphragmatic surface near the right margin. in it run the posterior interventricular artery and middle cardiac vein.

UBERON:0005491.name: glossopharyngeal neural crest
UBERON:0005491.def: cranial neural crest which gives rise to the glossopharyngeal ganglion.

UBERON:0005492.name: hyaloid vessel
UBERON:0005492.def: a blood vessel that is associated with the lens. in mammals, this is transient and normally nourishes the retina, immature lens and primary vitreous of the developing eye.

UBERON:0005493.name: hyoid muscle
UBERON:0005493.def: one of a group of muscles used in mastication and swallowing. these muscles are attached to the hyoid bone, which is suspended in the neck and forms the base of the tongue and larynx. the muscles are divided into suprahyoid (superior) or infrahyoid (inferior) groups relative to the bone[wp, generalized].

UBERON:0005496.name: neural tube lateral wall
UBERON:0005496.def: portion of tissue on the side of the lumen of the neural tube.

UBERON:0005498.name: primitive heart tube
UBERON:0005498.def: multi-tissue structure that arises from the heart rudiment and will become the heart tube.

UBERON:0005501.name: rhombomere lateral wall
UBERON:0005501.def: a neural tube lateral wall that is part of a rhombomere.

UBERON:0005507.name: rhombomere 3
UBERON:0005507.def: the third transiently divided segment of the developing rhombencephalon; rhombomeres are lineage restricted, express different genes from one another, and adopt different developmental fates; rhombomeres are numbered in caudal to rostral order.

UBERON:0005511.name: rhombomere 4
UBERON:0005511.def: the fourth transiently divided segment of the developing rhombencephalon; rhombomeres are lineage restricted, express different genes from one another, and adopt different developmental fates; rhombomeres are numbered in caudal to rostral order.

UBERON:0005515.name: rhombomere 5
UBERON:0005515.def: the fifth transiently divided segment of the developing rhombencephalon; rhombomeres are lineage restricted, express different genes from one another, and adopt different developmental fates; rhombomeres are numbered in caudal to rostral order.

UBERON:0005519.name: rhombomere 6
UBERON:0005519.def: the sixth transiently divided segment of the developing rhombencephalon; rhombomeres are lineage restricted, express different genes from one another, and adopt different developmental fates; rhombomeres are numbered in caudal to rostral order.

UBERON:0005523.name: rhombomere 7
UBERON:0005523.def: the seventh transiently divided segment of the developing rhombencephalon; rhombomeres are lineage restricted, express different genes from one another, and adopt different developmental fates; rhombomeres are numbered in caudal to rostral order.

UBERON:0005527.name: rhombomere 8
UBERON:0005527.def: the eighth transiently divided segment of the developing rhombencephalon; rhombomeres are lineage restricted, express different genes from one another, and adopt different developmental fates; rhombomeres are numbered in caudal to rostral order.

UBERON:0005562.name: thymus primordium
UBERON:0005562.def: a small outgrowth of the pharyngeal epithelium that is the site of lymphocyte cell production[zfa]. [pmid].

UBERON:0005563.name: trigeminal neural crest
UBERON:0005563.def: cranial neural crest which gives rise to the trigeminal ganglion.

UBERON:0005564.name: gonad primordium
UBERON:0005564.def: portion of tissue that gives rise to the immature gonad.

UBERON:0005565.name: facio-acoustic neural crest
UBERON:0005565.def: cranial neural crest that gives rise to the facio-acoustic ganglion.

UBERON:0005567.name: rhombomere 1 lateral wall
UBERON:0005567.def: a rhombomere lateral wall that is part of a rhombomere 1.

UBERON:0005568.name: rhombomere 1 roof plate
UBERON:0005568.def: a rhombomere roof plate that is part of a rhombomere 1.

UBERON:0005569.name: rhombomere 2
UBERON:0005569.def: the second transiently divided segment of the developing rhombencephalon; rhombomeres are lineage restricted, express different genes from one another, and adopt different developmental fates; rhombomeres are numbered in caudal to rostral order.

UBERON:0005570.name: rhombomere 2 floor plate
UBERON:0005570.def: a rhombomere floor plate that is part of a rhombomere 2.

UBERON:0005571.name: rhombomere 2 lateral wall
UBERON:0005571.def: a rhombomere lateral wall that is part of a rhombomere 2.

UBERON:0005572.name: rhombomere 2 roof plate
UBERON:0005572.def: a rhombomere roof plate that is part of a rhombomere 2.

UBERON:0005573.name: rhombomere 3 floor plate
UBERON:0005573.def: a rhombomere floor plate that is part of a rhombomere 3.

UBERON:0005574.name: rhombomere 3 lateral wall
UBERON:0005574.def: a rhombomere lateral wall that is part of a rhombomere 3.

UBERON:0005575.name: rhombomere 3 roof plate
UBERON:0005575.def: a rhombomere roof plate that is part of a rhombomere 3.

UBERON:0005576.name: rhombomere 4 floor plate
UBERON:0005576.def: a rhombomere floor plate that is part of a rhombomere 4.

UBERON:0005601.name: dorsal mesocardium
UBERON:0005601.def: the part of the mesocardium dorsal to the embryonic heart; it breaks down to form the transverse sinus of the pericardium.

UBERON:0005602.name: dorsal mesogastrium
UBERON:0005602.def: the portion of mesentery attached to the greater curvature of the stomach is named the dorsal mesentery (or dorsal mesogastrium, when referring to the portion at the stomach), and the part which suspends the colon is termed the mesocolon. the dorsal mesogastrium develops into the greater omentum.

UBERON:0005608.name: hyoid artery
UBERON:0005608.def: the second arch becomes the hyoid artery, which is prominent in early development and normally persists as the caroticotympanic branch of the ica[padget].

UBERON:0005609.name: iliac artery
UBERON:0005609.def: any of the arteries that arise from a bifurcation of the aorta supplying the pelvic or abdomen. examples: common iliac artery, external iliac artery, internal iliac artery.

UBERON:0005610.name: iliac vein
UBERON:0005610.def: any of the three veins including the common, external and internal iliac veins.

UBERON:0005611.name: inner canthus
UBERON:0005611.def: a corner of the medial (inner) part of an eye.

UBERON:0005612.name: intercostal artery
UBERON:0005612.def: one of a group of arteries that supply the area between the ribs ('costae'), called the intercostal space.

UBERON:0005614.name: lens anterior epithelium
UBERON:0005614.def: a layer of cuboidal epithelial cells bounded anteriorly by the capsule of the lens and posteriorly by the lens cortex.

UBERON:0005616.name: mesenteric artery
UBERON:0005616.def: arteries which arise from the abdominal aorta and distribute to most of the intestines.

UBERON:0005617.name: mesenteric vein
UBERON:0005617.def: a vein that returns blood from the intestines.

UBERON:0005619.name: secondary palatal shelf
UBERON:0005619.def: the outgrowths of the embryonic maxillary prominences that come together during prenatal development to form the secondary palate.

UBERON:0005620.name: primary palate
UBERON:0005620.def: the part of the palate formed from the intermaxillary segment.

UBERON:0005621.name: rhomboid
UBERON:0005621.def: a rhombus-shaped muscle associated with the scapula and chiefly responsible for its retraction. there are two rhomboid muscles.

UBERON:0005623.name: semi-lunar valve
UBERON:0005623.def: the valves that gate the flow of blood from the ventricles into the aorta and pulmonary trunk.

UBERON:0005624.name: suprarenal artery
UBERON:0005624.def: artery that supplies blood to the adrenal glands.

UBERON:0005625.name: tubotympanic recess lumen
UBERON:0005625.def: the cavity formed by the tubotympanic recess epithelium.

UBERON:0005626.name: ventral mesogastrium
UBERON:0005626.def: portion of ventral mesentery closest to the stomach.

UBERON:0005628.name: ileal artery
UBERON:0005628.def: the ileal arteries feed oxygenated blood into the ileum, a portion of the small intestine in mammals, reptiles, and birds. they are branches of the superior mesenteric artery.

UBERON:0005629.name: vascular plexus

UBERON:0005631.name: extraembryonic membrane

UBERON:0005721.name: pronephric mesoderm
UBERON:0005721.def: a mesoderm that has the potential to develop into a pronephros.

UBERON:0005722.name: obsolete nephrotome
UBERON:0005722.def: the nephrotome is a section of the mesoderm. it gives rise to the pronephros and eventually to the rest of the kidney. a nephrotome is an obsolete term used to describe rounded mesodermal portions of the forming pronephros. in old texts the pronephros is described as forming through the fusion of multiple nephrotomes. modern visualization methods such as scanning electron microscopy, in situ hybridization and confocal microscopy, combined with the simple approach of peeling off the epidermis to see the forming kidney, have shown that this is not the case. nephric mesenchyme separates from the intermediate mesoderm as a single elongated primordia. as this primordia begins to undergo epithelialization the anterior portions of the pronephros form rounded protrusions, which then later become the dorsal branches of the pronephros that link to nephrostomes (distinct from nephrotomes). these rounded bumps are probably the structures observed in histological sections that are referred to as nephrotomes. nephrostomes are thin ciliated funnels that link pronephric nephrons to the ceolom, and are not related to nephrotomes.

UBERON:0005723.name: floor plate spinal cord region
UBERON:0005723.def: a multi-tissue structure that is part of a spinal cord and is part of a floor plate.

UBERON:0005724.name: roof plate spinal cord region
UBERON:0005724.def: a tissue that is part of a spinal cord and is part of a roof plate.

UBERON:0005725.name: olfactory system
UBERON:0005725.def: a sensory system that is capable of olfaction (the sensory perception of smell).

UBERON:0005727.name: obsolete somitomere
UBERON:0005727.def: obsoleted definition: in the developing vertebrate embryo, the somitomeres are loose masses of paraxial mesoderm derived cells that form along each side of the neural tube towards the end of the third gestational week. the approximately 50 pairs of somitomeres begin developing in the cranial (head) region, continuing in a caudal (tail) direction until the end of week four[wp].

UBERON:0005729.name: pectoral appendage field
UBERON:0005729.def: a limb/fin field that has the potential to develop into a pectoral appendage bud mesenchyme.

UBERON:0005730.name: pelvic appendage field
UBERON:0005730.def: a limb/fin field that has the potential to develop into a pelvic appendage bud mesenchyme.

UBERON:0005731.name: fin field
UBERON:0005731.def: a limb/fin field that has_potential_to_developmentally_contribute_to a paired fin bud.
UBERON:0005731.synonym: fin field of lateral plate mesoderm

UBERON:0005732.name: paired limb/fin field
UBERON:0005732.def: a ring of cells capable of forming a limb or paired fin[gilbert,modified].

UBERON:0005733.name: limb field
UBERON:0005733.def: a ring of cells capable of forming a limb.
UBERON:0005733.synonym: limb field of lateral plate mesoderm

UBERON:0005734.name: tunica adventitia of blood vessel
UBERON:0005734.def: the outermost layer of a blood vessel, composed mainly of fibrous tissue.

UBERON:0005737.name: swim bladder tunica externa
UBERON:0005737.def: multi-tissue structure that is the external layer of the swim bladder that is covered by the peritoneum, and made of elastic fibres and ichthyocol (short needles of collagen).

UBERON:0005738.name: swim bladder tunica interna
UBERON:0005738.def: multi-tissue structure that is the internal layer of the swim bladder and is comprised of thin endoderm and a smooth muscle layer called the muscularis mucosa with longitudinal and circular fibres with some collagen.

UBERON:0005740.name: tunica intima of artery
UBERON:0005740.def: a tunica intima that is part of a artery.

UBERON:0005742.name: adventitia
UBERON:0005742.def: an outermost connective tissue covering of an organ, vessel, or other structure[wp].

UBERON:0005743.name: obsolete central nervous system plus retina

UBERON:0005744.name: bone foramen
UBERON:0005744.def: anatomical space that is an opening in a bone, usually for passage of blood vessels or nerves.

UBERON:0005745.name: optic foramen
UBERON:0005745.def: an opening in the skull through which cranial nerve ii passes.[mp].

UBERON:0005746.name: primary vitreous
UBERON:0005746.def: embryonic fibrovascular mesodermal tissue located between the optic cup and lens vesicle that normally regresses during the development of the vitreous body[mp].

UBERON:0005749.name: glomerular tuft
UBERON:0005749.def: the capillary loops of the kidney that normally function as a filtration unit[mp].

UBERON:0005750.name: glomerular parietal epithelium
UBERON:0005750.def: a single layer of simple squamous epithelium in the glomerular capsule. does not function in filtration[uberon]. outer layer of the glomerular capsule composed of a single layer of simple squamous epithelium[mp].

UBERON:0005751.name: glomerular visceral epithelium
UBERON:0005751.def: the inner (visceral) layer of the renal glomerular capsule, overlying the capillaries, composed of podocytes, and separated from the outer (parietal) layer by the capsular (bowman's) space[bto]. this epithelial layer is superficially adjacent to the thickened glomerular basement membrane and is made of podocytes. beneath the visceral layer lie the glomerular capillaries[wp]. this inner epithelial layer of the glomerular capsule surrounds the capillary endothelial cells and is composed of highly specialized epithelial cells (podocytes) that are separated by filtration slits; the inner visceral layer is separated from the outer parietal layer by the urinary space (also known as the bowman's or capsular space)[mp].

UBERON:0005753.name: caudal part of nephrogenic cord
UBERON:0005753.def: the metanephros develops from the most caudal part of the nephrogenic cord that is itself derived from the intermediate plate mesoderm.

UBERON:0005754.name: rostral part of nephrogenic cord
UBERON:0005754.def: the initial renal anlage that develops from the most rostral part of the nephrogenic cord is termed the pronephros.

UBERON:0005760.name: urorectal septum
UBERON:0005760.def: the ridge of mesoderm covered with endoderm that in the early developing embryo partitions the endodermal cloaca into the primary urogenital sinus (ventrally) and the anorectal canal of the hindgut (dorsally); the urorectal septum eventually fuses with the cloacal membrane, dividing it into a dorsal anal membrane and a larger ventral urogenital membrane - this area of fusion is represented in the adult by the perineal body[mp].

UBERON:0005764.name: acellular membrane
UBERON:0005764.def: an acellular anatomical structure that is the bounding layer of a anatomical structure.

UBERON:0005769.name: basement membrane of epithelium
UBERON:0005769.def: an acellular membrane that is part of the epithelium, lies adjacent to the epithelial cells, and is the fusion of the the basal lamina and the reticular lamina.

UBERON:0005777.name: glomerular basement membrane
UBERON:0005777.def: the layer of extracellular matrix that lies between the endothelium of the glomerular capillaries and the podocytes of the inner or visceral layer of the bowman capsule; it is a fusion of the endothelial cell and podocyte basal laminas and acts as a physical barrier and an ion-selective filter.

UBERON:0005787.name: lamina densa of glomerular basement membrane
UBERON:0005787.def: middle layer of the glomerular basement membrane.
UBERON:0005787.synonym: middle layer of glomerular basement membrane

UBERON:0005788.name: lamina rara interna
UBERON:0005788.def: layer of the glomerular basement membrane adjacent to the glomerular capillary.
UBERON:0005788.synonym: lamina interna of glomerular basement membrane

UBERON:0005789.name: lamina rara externa
UBERON:0005789.def: layer of the glomerular basement membrane adjacent to the podocytes and capsular space.
