UBERON:0006960.def: the stroma of the ovary is a peculiar soft tissue, abundantly supplied with blood vessels, consisting for the most part of spindle-shaped cells with a small amount of ordinary connective tissue. these cells have been regarded by some anatomists as unstriped muscle cells, which, indeed, they most resemble; by others as connective-tissue cells. on the surface of the organ this tissue is much condensed, and forms a layer composed of short connective-tissue fibers, with fusiform cells between them. the stroma of the ovary may contain interstitial cells resembling those of the testis.

UBERON:0006964.name: pars distalis of adenohypophysis
UBERON:0006964.def: the distal part of adenohypophysis: the part that makes up the main body of the gland.

UBERON:0006965.name: vascular cord
UBERON:0006965.def: the vascular cord is the primordial vasculature that will develop into blood vessels by the process of tubulogenesis[go]. the vascular cord is composed of angioblast or vascular endothelial cells in a solid linear mass called a cord. the cord then undergoes tubulogenesis to form the lumen of the vessels[zfa].

UBERON:0006966.name: coronary capillary
UBERON:0006966.def: a capillary that is part of the coronary system.

UBERON:0006967.name: horn
UBERON:0006967.def: a pointed projection of the skin on the head of various animals, consisting of a covering of horn (keratin and other proteins) surrounding a core of living bone.

UBERON:0006969.name: cranial appendage
UBERON:0006969.def: an anatomical projection that is part of and protrudes from the head.

UBERON:0006971.name: antler
UBERON:0006971.def: antlers are the usually large, branching bony appendages on the heads of most deer species.

UBERON:0006972.name: nephridium
UBERON:0006972.def: an exceretory tubule that usually opens to the exterior by a nephridiopore. the inner end of the tubule may be blind, ending in flame cells (protonephridium) or may open into the coelom through a ciliated funnel (metanephridium).

UBERON:0006973.name: protonephridium
UBERON:0006973.def: a network of dead-end tubules lacking internal openings found in the phylums platyhelminthes, kinorhyncha and rotifera.

UBERON:0006974.name: metanephridium
UBERON:0006974.def: a type of excretory gland or nephridium found in many types of invertebrates such as annelids, arthropods and molluscs. it typically consists of a ciliated funnel opening into the body cavity or coelom connected to a duct which may be variously glandularized, folded or expanded (vesiculate) and which typically opens to the organism's exterior. these ciliated tubules pump water carrying surplus ions, metabolic waste, toxins from food, and useless hormones out of the organism through openings known as nephrostomes. this waste is passed out of the body at the nephridiopore. the primary urine produced by filtration of blood (or a similar functioning fluid) is modified into secondary urine through selective reabsorption by the cells lining the metanephridium. in many earthworms the nephridial ducts open into the digestive tract instead, a condition known as enteronephry.

UBERON:0006976.name: peptonephridium
UBERON:0006976.def: organs opening into the buccal cavity of pharynx (supposedly modified nephridia) of invertebrates.

UBERON:0006983.name: anatomical point
UBERON:0006983.def: non-material anatomical entity of zero dimension, which forms a boundary of an anatomical line or surface.

UBERON:0006984.name: anatomical surface
UBERON:0006984.def: a two dimensional anatomical structure that is the boundary between an anatomical structure and an anatomical substance, an anatomical space or the organism's environment. examples include the surface of your skin, the surface of the lining of your gut; the surface of the endothelium of you aorta that is in contact with blood.n.

UBERON:0007005.name: cardiogenic splanchnic mesoderm
UBERON:0007005.def: the splanchnic mesoderm in the cardiogenic region where the heart develops; it gives rise to endocardial heart tubes that fuse to form the primordial cardiac tube, the heart primordium[web]. two migratory heart primordia that move ventrally during the course of neurulation, and then fuse[xao].

UBERON:0007006.name: obsolete blastomere
UBERON:0007006.def: a type of cell produced by division of the egg after fertilization.

UBERON:0007021.name: sexually immature organism
UBERON:0007021.def: a multicellular organism that is at the juvenile stage.

UBERON:0007023.name: adult organism
UBERON:0007023.def: a multicellular organism that existence_ends_with a post-juvenile adult stage and existence_starts_with a post-juvenile adult stage.

UBERON:0007097.name: chordo neural hinge
UBERON:0007097.def: portion of tissue that is posterior to the developing notochord during tail bud extension.

UBERON:0007098.name: mandibular neural crest
UBERON:0007098.def: cranial neural crest that migrates into the mandibular arch.

UBERON:0007099.name: hyoid neural crest
UBERON:0007099.def: cranial neural crest that migrates into the hyoid arch.

UBERON:0007100.name: primary circulatory organ
UBERON:0007100.def: a hollow, muscular organ, which, by contracting rhythmically, keeps up the circulation of the blood or analogs[go,modified].

UBERON:0007105.name: vitelline duct
UBERON:0007105.def: a long narrow tube that joins the yolk-sac to the midgut lumen of the developing fetus.

UBERON:0007106.name: chorionic villus
UBERON:0007106.def: one of the minute vascular projections of the fetal chorion that combines with maternal uterine tissue to form the placenta.

UBERON:0007108.name: vernix caseosa
UBERON:0007108.def: an unctuous substance composed of sebum and desquamated epithelial cells, which covers the skin of the fetus.

UBERON:0007109.name: meconium
UBERON:0007109.def: a dark greenish mass that accumulates in the bowel during fetal life and is discharged shortly after birth.

UBERON:0007111.name: douglas' pouch
UBERON:0007111.def: the rectouterine pouch (or rectouterine excavation, rectovaginal, ehrhardt-cole recess or pouch of douglas) is the extension of the peritoneal cavity between the rectum and back wall of the uterus in the female human body. the rectouterine pouch is used in the treatment of end-stage renal failure in patients who are treated by peritoneal dialysis. the tip of the dialysis catheter is placed into the deepest point of the pouch. in women it is the deepest point of the peritoneal cavity, posterior to (behind) the uterus and anterior to (in front of) rectum. (the pouch on the other side of the uterus is the vesicouterine excavation. ) it is near the posterior fornix of the vagina. in men, the region corresponding to the rectouterine pouch is the rectovesical excavation, which lies between the urinary bladder and rectum. (there is no equivalent to the vesicouterine excavation.).

UBERON:0007113.name: venom
UBERON:0007113.def: poisonous animal secretions forming fluid mixtures of many different enzymes, toxins, and other substances. these substances are produced in specialized glands and secreted through specialized delivery systems (nematocysts, spines, fangs, etc.) for disabling prey or predator.

UBERON:0007115.name: deciduous tooth
UBERON:0007115.def: one of the first set of teeth in the growth development of humans and many other mammals[wp].

UBERON:0007116.name: primary dentition
UBERON:0007116.def: the set of teeth first in order or time of development that will be replaced by permanent dentition upon their loss.

UBERON:0007118.name: umbilicus
UBERON:0007118.def: the pit in the center of the abdominal wall marking the point where the umbilical cord entered in the fetus.

UBERON:0007119.name: neck of femur
UBERON:0007119.def: the femur neck or neck of the femur is a flattened pyramidal process of bone, connecting the femoral head with the femoral shaft, and forming with the latter a wide angle opening medialward.

UBERON:0007120.name: premolar tooth
UBERON:0007120.def: the premolar teeth or bicuspids are transitional teeth located between the canine and molar teeth.

UBERON:0007121.name: skin nerve field
UBERON:0007121.def: a zone of skin that is mainly innervated by a single sensory nerve. a nerve field innervated by exactly one dorsal root is called a dermatome.

UBERON:0007122.name: pharyngeal pouch 1
UBERON:0007122.def: a pharyngeal pouch that is between pharyngeal arches 1 and 2.

UBERON:0007123.name: pharyngeal pouch 2
UBERON:0007123.def: a pharyngeal puch that is between the pharyngeal arches 2 and 3.

UBERON:0007124.name: pharyngeal pouch 3
UBERON:0007124.def: a pharyngeal pouch that between pharyngeal arches 3 and 4.

UBERON:0007125.name: pharyngeal pouch 4
UBERON:0007125.def: a pharyngeal pouch between pharyngeal arch 4 and arch 5 or 6 (a fifth arch never establishes in amniotes).

UBERON:0007126.name: pharyngeal pouch 5
UBERON:0007126.def: a pharyngeal pouch between pharyngeal arches 5 and 6.

UBERON:0007127.name: pharyngeal pouch 6
UBERON:0007127.def: a pharyngeal pouch between pharyngeal arches 6 and 7.

UBERON:0007128.name: glomeral mesenchyme
UBERON:0007128.def: portion of tissue that consists of the precursors of the pronephric glomus or glomerulus; derived from the medial portion of the pronephric intermediate mesoderm.

UBERON:0007132.name: head kidney
UBERON:0007132.def: teleost head kidney consists of fused bilateral lobes located in the anterior part of the kidney. it is analogous to the mammalian bone marrow and the primary site of definitive hematopoiesis[zfa,modified].

UBERON:0007134.name: trunk ganglion
UBERON:0007134.def: ganglion which is located in the trunk.

UBERON:0007135.name: neural keel
UBERON:0007135.def: an intermediate stage (between the neural plate and neural rod) during the early segmentation period in the morphogenesis of the central nervous system primordium; the keel is roughly triangular shaped in cross section.

UBERON:0007136.name: rectouterine fold
UBERON:0007136.def: these folds of the rectouterine excavation are named the sacrogenital or rectouterine folds. they contain a considerable amount of fibrous tissue and non-striped muscular fibers which are attached to the front of the sacrum and constitute the uterosacral ligaments.

UBERON:0007140.name: parietal mesothelium
UBERON:0007140.def: mesothelium overs the body walls is called the parietal mesothelium.

UBERON:0007141.name: visceral mesothelium
UBERON:0007141.def: mesothelium that covers the internal organs is called visceral mesothelium.

UBERON:0007142.name: left internal carotid artery
UBERON:0007142.def: an internal carotid artery that branching_part_of a left common carotid artery plus branches.

UBERON:0007143.name: right internal carotid artery
UBERON:0007143.def: an internal carotid artery that branching_part_of a right common carotid artery plus branches.

UBERON:0007144.name: embryonic post-anal tail
UBERON:0007144.def: an embryonic structure that will either develop into a post-anal tail or recede into a vestigial remnant of the tail.

UBERON:0007146.name: posterior spinal artery
UBERON:0007146.def: a spinal artery that arises from the vertebral artery, adjacent to the medulla oblongata[wp,modified].

UBERON:0007147.name: lumen of midgut
UBERON:0007147.def: an anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a midgut.

UBERON:0007148.name: lumen of hindgut
UBERON:0007148.def: an anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a hindgut.

UBERON:0007149.name: inferior thyroid artery
UBERON:0007149.def: one of the three branches of the thyroid axis that supplies the thyroid gland and branches to form the ascending cervical, esophageal, inferior laryngeal, muscular and tracheal arteries.

UBERON:0007150.name: superior thyroid artery
UBERON:0007150.def: the superior thyroid artery arises from the external carotid artery just below the level of the greater cornu of the hyoid bone and ends in the thyroid gland.

UBERON:0007151.name: mitral valve leaflet
UBERON:0007151.def: a valve leafleft that is part of a mitral valve.

UBERON:0007152.name: inferior sagittal sinus
UBERON:0007152.def: an intracranial venous sinus that lies in a midline location along the lower free border of the falx cerebri of the brain. the sinus receives blood from the great cerebral vein and joins the superior sagittal sinus posteriorly.

UBERON:0007153.name: superior epigastric artery
UBERON:0007153.def: an artery that arises from the internal thoracic arteryand anastomoses with the inferior epigastric artery at the umbilicus and supplies the anterior part of the abdominal wall and some of the diaphragm.

UBERON:0007154.name: inferior epigastric vein
UBERON:0007154.def: the blood vessel carrying deoxygenated blood that arises from the superior epigastric vein and empties into the external iliac vein.

UBERON:0007155.name: superior epigastric vein
UBERON:0007155.def: a vein that drains into the internal thoracic vein, anastomosing with the inferior epigastric vein at the level of the umbilicus and drains the anterior part of the abdominal wall and some of the diaphragm. along its course, it is accompanied by a similarly named artery, the superior epigastric artery.

UBERON:0007156.name: inferior thyroid vein
UBERON:0007156.def: the inferior thyroid veins two, frequently three or four, in number, arise in the venous plexus on the thyroid gland, communicating with the middle and superior thyroid veins. they form a plexus in front of the trachea, behind the sternothyreoidei. from this plexus, a left vein descends and joins the left innominate trunk, and a right vein passes obliquely downward and to the right across the innominate artery to open into the right innominate vein, just at its junction with the superior vena cava; sometimes the right and left veins open by a common trunk in the latter situation. these veins receive esophageal tracheal, and inferior laryngeal veins, and are provided with valves at their terminations in the innominate veins.

UBERON:0007157.name: superior thyroid vein
UBERON:0007157.def: the superior thyroid vein begins in the substance and on the surface of the thyroid gland, by tributaries corresponding with the branches of the superior thyroid artery, and ends in the upper part of the internal jugular vein. it receives the superior laryngeal and cricothyroid veins.

UBERON:0007158.name: lumen of anal canal
UBERON:0007158.def: an anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a anal canal.

UBERON:0007159.name: lumen of colon
UBERON:0007159.def: an anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a colon.

UBERON:0007160.name: inferior petrosal sinus
UBERON:0007160.def: the inferior petrosal sinus, within the human head, is an area beneath the brain, which allows blood veins to span the area, from the center of the head downward. it drains from the cavernous sinus (beneath the brain) to the sigmoid sinuses above the internal jugular vein.

UBERON:0007161.name: medial arcuate ligament
UBERON:0007161.def: the medial arcuate ligament (also medial lumbocostal arch) is tendinous fascia that arches over the psoas major muscle as it passes through the diaphragm.

UBERON:0007162.name: lateral arcuate ligament
UBERON:0007162.def: the lateral arcuate ligament (also lateral lumbocostal arch) is a ligament under the diaphragm that arches across the upper part of the quadratus lumborum. it is traversed by the subcostal nerve, artery and vein.

UBERON:0007163.name: superior nasal meatus
UBERON:0007163.def: the superior meatus, the smallest of the three meatuses of the nose, occupies the middle third of the lateral wall of the nasal cavity. it lies between the superior nasal conchc& and middle nasal conchc&; the sphenopalatine foramen opens into it behind, and the posterior ethmoidal cells in front. the sphenoidal sinus opens into a recess, the sphenoethmoidal recess, which is placed above and behind the superior concha.

UBERON:0007164.name: distal radio-ulnar joint
UBERON:0007164.def: the distal radioulnar articulation (inferior radioulnar joint) is a pivot-joint formed between the head of the ulna and the ulnar notch on the distal radius.

UBERON:0007165.name: proximal radio-ulnar joint
UBERON:0007165.def: the proximal radioulnar articulation (superior radioulnar joint) is a trochoid or pivot joint between the circumference of the head of the radius and the ring formed by the radial notch of the ulna and the annular ligament.

UBERON:0007166.name: left dome of diaphragm
UBERON:0007166.synonym: left dome of diaphragm viewed radiologically

UBERON:0007167.name: right dome of diaphragm
UBERON:0007167.synonym: right dome of diaphragm viewed radiologically

UBERON:0007168.name: long head of biceps brachii
UBERON:0007168.def: the long head originates on the supraglenoid tubercle just above the shoulder joint from where its tendon passes down along the intertubercular groove of the humerus into the joint capsule of the shoulder joint. [1] when the humerus is in motion, the tendon of the long head is held firmly in place in the intertubercular groove by the greater and lesser tubercles and the overlying transverse humeral ligament. during the motion from external to internal rotation, the tendon is forced medially against the lesser tubercle and superiorly against the transverse ligament.
UBERON:0007168.synonym: long head of biceps brachii muscle

UBERON:0007169.name: short head of biceps brachii
UBERON:0007169.def: proximally (towards the body), the short head of the biceps attaches to (originates from) the coracoid process at the top of the scapula.
UBERON:0007169.synonym: short head of biceps brachii muscle

UBERON:0007170.name: squamous part of occipital bone
UBERON:0007170.def: the squama of the occipital bone, situated above and behind the foramen magnum, is curved from above downward and from side to side.

UBERON:0007173.name: lateral border of scapula
UBERON:0007173.def: the lateral border (or axillary border, or margin) is the thickest of the three borders of the scapula. it begins above at the lower margin of the glenoid cavity, and inclines obliquely downward and backward to the inferior angle. immediately below the glenoid cavity is a rough impression, the infraglenoid tuberosity, about 2.5 cm. in length, which gives origin to the long head of the triceps brachii; in front of this is a longitudinal groove, which extends as far as the lower third of this border, and affords origin to part of the subscapularis. the inferior third is thin and sharp, and serves for the attachment of a few fibers of the teres major behind, and of the subscapularis in front.

UBERON:0007174.name: medial border of scapula
UBERON:0007174.def: the medial border of the scapula (vertebral border, medial margin) is the longest of the three borders, and extends from the medial to the inferior angle. it is arched, intermediate in thickness between the superior and the axillary borders, and the portion of it above the spine forms an obtuse angle with the part below. this border presents an anterior and a posterior lip, and an intermediate narrow area. the anterior lip affords attachment to the serratus anterior; the posterior lip, to the supraspinatus above the spine, the infraspinatus below; the area between the two lips, to the levator scapulc& above the triangular surface at the commencement of the spine, to the rhomboideus minor on the edge of that surface, and to the rhomboideus major below it; this last is attached by means of a fibrous arch, connected above to the lower part of the triangular surface at the base of the spine, and below to the lower part of the border.

UBERON:0007175.name: inferior angle of scapula
UBERON:0007175.def: an angle of the scapula formed by the union of the vertebral and axillary borders; its dorsal surface affords attachment to the teres major and frequently to a few fibers of the latissimus dorsi.[wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0007176.name: superior angle of scapula
UBERON:0007176.def: an angle of the scapula formed by the junction of the superior and vertebral borders. it is thin, smooth, rounded, inclined somewhat lateralward, and gives attachment to a few fibers of the levator scapulae[wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0007177.name: lamina propria of mucosa of colon
UBERON:0007177.def: a lamina propria that is part of a colonic mucosa.
UBERON:0007177.synonym: lamina propria of colonic mucous membrane

UBERON:0007178.name: muscularis mucosae of colon
UBERON:0007178.def: a muscularis mucosa that is part of a colonic mucosa.

UBERON:0007181.name: serosa of infundibulum of uterine tube
UBERON:0007181.def: a serous membrane that is part of a uterine tube infundibulum.

UBERON:0007182.name: muscle layer of infundibulum of uterine tube
UBERON:0007182.def: a muscle layer that is part of a uterine tube infundibulum.
UBERON:0007182.synonym: muscularis of infundibulum of uterine tube

UBERON:0007185.name: pericardio-peritoneal canal mesothelium
UBERON:0007185.def: a mesothelium that is part of a pericardio-peritoneal canal.

UBERON:0007186.name: pericardial visceral mesothelium
UBERON:0007186.def: a visceral mesothelium that is part of a pericardium.

UBERON:0007187.name: pericardial parietal mesothelium
UBERON:0007187.def: a parietal mesothelium that is part of a pericardium.

UBERON:0007188.name: mesothelium of serous pericardium
UBERON:0007188.def: a mesothelium that is part of a serous pericardium.

UBERON:0007193.name: orbital gyrus
UBERON:0007193.def: the inferior or orbital surface of the frontal lobe is concave, and rests on the orbital plate of the frontal bone. it is divided into four orbital gyri by a well-marked h-shaped orbital sulcus. these are named, from their position, the medial, anterior, lateral, and posterior orbital gyri. the medial orbital gyrus presents a well-marked antero-posterior sulcus, the olfactory sulcus, for the olfactory tract; the portion medial to this is named the straight gyrus, and is continuous with the superior frontal gyrus on the medial surface.

UBERON:0007194.name: vesicular gland
UBERON:0007194.def: the vesicular gland is part of the male reproductive system. the vesicular gland contributes fluids, energy substrates, and buffers to semen. it can be found near the coagulating gland, which also belongs to the reproductive system.

UBERON:0007195.name: stroma of bone marrow
UBERON:0007195.def: the stroma of the bone marrow is all tissue not directly involved in the primary function of hematopoiesis. the yellow bone marrow belongs here, and makes the majority of the bone marrow stroma, in addition to stromal cells located in the red bone marrow. yellow bone marrow is found in the medullary cavity. still, the stroma is indirectly involved in hematopoiesis, since it provides the hematopoietic microenvironment that facilitates hematopoiesis by the parenchymal cells. for instance, they generate colony stimulating factors, affecting hematopoiesis.

UBERON:0007196.name: tracheobronchial tree
UBERON:0007196.def: the structure from the trachea, bronchi, and bronchioles that forms the airways that supply air to the lungs. the lining of the tracheobronchial tree consists of ciliated columnar epithelial cells.

UBERON:0007197.name: hermaphroditic organism
UBERON:0007197.def: multicellular organism that can produce both male and female gametes.

UBERON:0007198.name: hermaphrodite anatomical structure
UBERON:0007198.def: an anatomical structure present only in hermaphrodites.

UBERON:0007204.name: brachiocephalic vasculature
UBERON:0007204.def: the vasculature consisting of brachiocephalic arteries and veins.

UBERON:0007213.name: mesenchyme derived from head neural crest
UBERON:0007213.def: mesenchyme that develops_from a cranial neural crest.

UBERON:0007214.name: mesenchyme derived from trunk neural crest
UBERON:0007214.def: mesenchyme that develops_from a trunk neural crest.

UBERON:0007215.name: trabecula cranii
UBERON:0007215.def: paired thin medially aligned bar of cartilage that extends from the anterior end of the chondrocranium to just anterior to the anterior end of the notochord. the posterior ends of the trabeculae cranii are continuous with the parachordal cartilages, and they enclose the hypophyseal fenestra.

UBERON:0007220.name: late embryonic stage
UBERON:0007220.def: an embryo stage that covers late steps of the embryogenesis with a fully formed embryo still developing before birth or egg hatching.

UBERON:0007221.name: neonate stage
UBERON:0007221.def: of or pertaining to the period of time immediately following birth, or to the newborn.

UBERON:0007223.name: osseus cochlea
UBERON:0007223.def: the osseous cochlea is the bony foundation that forms the small shell arrangement for the cochlear nerve.

UBERON:0007224.name: medial entorhinal cortex
UBERON:0007224.def: one of two subdivisions of the entorhinal cortex, located medially.

UBERON:0007225.name: lateral entorhinal cortex
UBERON:0007225.def: one of two subdivisions of the entorhinal cortex, located laterally.

UBERON:0007227.name: superior vestibular nucleus
UBERON:0007227.def: the superior vestibular nucleus is the dorso-lateral part of the vestibular nucleus and receives collaterals and terminals from the ascending branches of the vestibular nerve. its axons terminate in much the same manner as do those from the lateral nucleus.

UBERON:0007228.name: vestibular nucleus
UBERON:0007228.def: a cranial nucleus for the vestibular nerve. [wp,unvetted].

UBERON:0007230.name: lateral vestibular nucleus
UBERON:0007230.def: one of the nuclei comprising the vestibular nuclear complex. in some mammals, e.g., primates, it is further subdivided into subnuclei. it therefore differs in appearance and topology in different mammals.

UBERON:0007239.name: tunica media of artery
UBERON:0007239.def: a tunica media that is part of a artery.

UBERON:0007240.name: tunica adventitia of artery
UBERON:0007240.def: a tunica adventitia that is part of a artery.

UBERON:0007241.name: tunica adventitia of vein
UBERON:0007241.def: a tunica adventitia that is part of a vein.

UBERON:0007242.name: tunica intima of vein
UBERON:0007242.def: a tunica intima that is part of a vein.

UBERON:0007243.name: tunica media of vein
UBERON:0007243.def: a tunica media that is part of a vein.

UBERON:0007244.name: inferior olivary nucleus
UBERON:0007244.def: the inferior olivary nucleus is the largest nucleus situated in the olivary body, part of the medulla oblongata.

UBERON:0007245.name: nuclear complex of neuraxis
UBERON:0007245.def: gray matter of the central nervous system which is a collection of clustered nuclei.

UBERON:0007247.name: nucleus of superior olivary complex
UBERON:0007247.def: any of the nuclei that comprise the superior olivary complex (superior olive). this includes both the primary nuclei such as the lateral and medial nuclei, as well as periolivary nuclei.

UBERON:0007249.name: dorsal accessory inferior olivary nucleus
UBERON:0007249.def: the inferior olivary nucleus that is the smallest, and appears on transverse section as a curved lamina behind the primary olivary nucleus.

UBERON:0007250.name: lingual tonsil
UBERON:0007250.def: the lymph tissue on the floor of the oropharyngeal passage, near the root of the tongue.

UBERON:0007251.name: preoptic nucleus
UBERON:0007251.def: a nucleus of brain that is part of a preoptic area.

UBERON:0007252.name: intervertebral disk of cervical vertebra
UBERON:0007252.def: an intervertebral disk that is part of a cervical region of vertebral column. a cervical intervertebral disk connects at least one cervical vertebra, either to another cervical vertebra, or at one point on the vertebral colummn, to a thoracic vertebra.

UBERON:0007254.name: intervertebral disk of thoracic vertebra
UBERON:0007254.def: an intervertebral disk that is part of a thoracic region of vertebral column. a thoracic intervertebral disk connects at least one thoracic vertebra, either to another thoracic vertebra, or at one point on the vertebral colummn, to a lumbar vertebra.

UBERON:0007255.name: intervertebral disk of lumbar vertebra
UBERON:0007255.def: an intervertebral disk that is part of a lumbar region of vertebral column. a lumbar intervertebral disk connects at least one lumbar vertebra, either to another thoracic vertebra, or at one point on the vertebral colummn, to a sacral vertebra.

UBERON:0007257.name: intervertebral disk of sacral vertebra
UBERON:0007257.def: an intervertebral disk that is part of a sacral region of vertebral column. a sacral intervertebral disk connects at least one sacral vertebra, either to another thoracic vertebra, or at one point on the vertebral colummn, to a sacral vertebra.

UBERON:0007260.name: intervertebral disk of third cervical vertebra
UBERON:0007260.def: an intervertebral disk that connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 3 and connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 4.

UBERON:0007261.name: intervertebral disk of fourth cervical vertebra
UBERON:0007261.def: an intervertebral disk that connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 4 and connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 5.

UBERON:0007262.name: intervertebral disk of fifth cervical vertebra
UBERON:0007262.def: an intervertebral disk that connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 5 and connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 6.

UBERON:0007263.name: intervertebral disk of sixth cervical vertebra
UBERON:0007263.def: an intervertebral disk that connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 6 and connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 7.

UBERON:0007264.name: intervertebral disk of seventh cervical vertebra
UBERON:0007264.def: an intervertebral disk that connects a thoracic vertebra and connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 7.

UBERON:0007265.name: intervertebral disk of axis
UBERON:0007265.def: an intervertebral disk that connects a vertebral bone 2 and connects a mammalian cervical vertebra 3.

UBERON:0007266.name: intervertebral disk of atlas
UBERON:0007266.def: an intervertebral disk that connects a vertebral bone 1 and connects a vertebral bone 2.

UBERON:0007267.name: trachea pre-cartilage rings
UBERON:0007267.def: a pre-cartilage condensation that is part of a trachea.

UBERON:0007268.name: upper esophageal sphincter
UBERON:0007268.def: the upper esophageal sphincter (ues) (also called the pharyngoesophageal sphincter) refers to the superior portion of the esophagus. unlike the lower esophageal sphincter, it consists of striated muscle and is under conscious control. the primary muscle of the ues is the cricopharyngeus portion of the inferior pharyngeal constrictor. during swallowing the upper esophageal sphincter opens so the bolus can pass into the esophagus. a secondary role of the ues is to reduce backflow from the esophagus into the pharynx.

UBERON:0007269.name: pectoral appendage musculature
UBERON:0007269.def: any collection of muscles that is part of a pectoral appendage.

UBERON:0007270.name: pelvic appendage musculature
UBERON:0007270.def: any collection of muscles that is part of a pelvic appendage.

UBERON:0007271.name: appendage musculature
UBERON:0007271.def: any collection of muscles that is part of an appendage.

UBERON:0007272.name: pectoral appendage skeleton
UBERON:0007272.def: skeletal subdivision consisting of the anterior appendicular limb skeleton, excluding the pectoral girdle.

UBERON:0007273.name: pelvic appendage skeleton
UBERON:0007273.def: the collection of all skeletal elements in a pelvic appendage region.

UBERON:0007274.name: crista of ampulla of anterior semicircular duct of membranous laybrinth
UBERON:0007274.def: a crista ampullaris neuroepithelium that is part of a anterior semicircular duct.

UBERON:0007275.name: crista of ampulla of posterior semicircular duct of membranous laybrinth
UBERON:0007275.def: a crista ampullaris neuroepithelium that is part of a posterior semicircular duct.

UBERON:0007276.name: crista of ampulla of lateral semicircular duct of membranous laybrinth
UBERON:0007276.def: a crista ampullaris neuroepithelium that is part of a lateral semicircular duct.

UBERON:0007277.name: presumptive hindbrain
UBERON:0007277.def: the rhombencephalon (or hindbrain) is a developmental categorization of portions of the central nervous system in vertebrates. the rhombencephalon can be subdivided in a variable number of transversal swellings called rhombomeres. in the human embryo eight rhombomeres can be distinguished, from caudal to rostral: rh7-rh1 and the isthmus (the most rostral rhombomere). a rare disease of the rhombencephalon, 'rhombencephalosynapsis' is characterized by a missing vermis resulting in a fused cerebellum. patients generally present with cerebellar ataxia. the caudal rhombencephalon has been generally considered as the initiation site for neural tube closure.

UBERON:0007278.name: presumptive sinus venosus
UBERON:0007278.def: portion of tissue that is part of the heart tube and will become the sinus venosus.

UBERON:0007279.name: presumptive atrioventricular canal
UBERON:0007279.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a atrioventricular canal.

UBERON:0007280.name: presumptive endocardium
UBERON:0007280.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a endocardium.

UBERON:0007281.name: presumptive midbrain hindbrain boundary
UBERON:0007281.def: embryonic structure that gives rise to the midbrain hindbrain boundary.

UBERON:0007282.name: presumptive segmental plate
UBERON:0007282.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a presomitic mesoderm.

UBERON:0007283.name: presumptive shield
UBERON:0007283.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a primitive knot.

UBERON:0007284.name: presumptive neural plate
UBERON:0007284.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a neural plate.

UBERON:0007285.name: presumptive paraxial mesoderm
UBERON:0007285.def: the part of the blastula that has the potential to develop into a paraxial mesoderm.

UBERON:0007286.name: presumptive floor plate
UBERON:0007286.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a floor plate.

UBERON:0007287.name: presumptive bulbus arteriosus
UBERON:0007287.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a bulbus arteriosus.

UBERON:0007288.name: presumptive forebrain midbrain boundary
UBERON:0007288.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a forebrain-midbrain boundary.

UBERON:0007289.name: presumptive rhombomere 1
UBERON:0007289.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a rhombomere 1.

UBERON:0007290.name: presumptive rhombomere 3
UBERON:0007290.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a rhombomere 3.

UBERON:0007291.name: presumptive rhombomere 4
UBERON:0007291.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a rhombomere 4.

UBERON:0007292.name: presumptive rhombomere 5
UBERON:0007292.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a rhombomere 5.

UBERON:0007293.name: presumptive rhombomere 6
UBERON:0007293.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a rhombomere 6.

UBERON:0007294.name: presumptive rhombomere 7
UBERON:0007294.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a rhombomere 7.

UBERON:0007295.name: presumptive rhombomere 8
UBERON:0007295.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a rhombomere 8.

UBERON:0007296.name: presumptive rhombomere 2
UBERON:0007296.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a rhombomere 2.

UBERON:0007297.name: presumptive pronephric mesoderm
UBERON:0007297.def: a presumptive structure that has the potential to develop into a pronephric mesoderm.

UBERON:0007298.name: pronephric proximal convoluted tubule
UBERON:0007298.def: a proximal convoluted tubule that is part of a pronephros.

UBERON:0007299.name: choroid plexus of tectal ventricle
UBERON:0007299.def: a choroid plexus that is part of a cerebral aqueduct.

UBERON:0007300.name: pectoral appendage blood vessel
UBERON:0007300.def: a blood vessel that is part of a pectoral appendage.

UBERON:0007301.name: appendage blood vessel
UBERON:0007301.def: a blood vessel that is part of a limb/fin.

UBERON:0007302.name: pectoral appendage vasculature
UBERON:0007302.def: a vasculature that is part of a pectoral appendage.

UBERON:0007303.name: pharyngeal vasculature
UBERON:0007303.def: a vasculature that is part of a chordate pharynx.

UBERON:0007304.name: appendage vasculature
UBERON:0007304.def: a vasculature that is part of a limb/fin.

UBERON:0007306.name: pronephric glomerular capillary
UBERON:0007306.def: a glomerular capillary that is part of a pronephros.

UBERON:0007307.name: pronephric glomerular basement membrane
UBERON:0007307.def: a glomerular basement membrane that is part of a pronephros.

UBERON:0007308.name: pronephric distal early tubule
UBERON:0007308.def: a distal early tubule that is part of a pronephros.

UBERON:0007311.name: sputum
UBERON:0007311.def: matter ejected from the lungs, bronchi, and trachea, through the mouth.

UBERON:0007312.name: pudendal artery
UBERON:0007312.def: either the internal or external pudendal arteries.

UBERON:0007315.name: internal pudendal artery
UBERON:0007315.def: the internal pudendal artery is an artery that branches off the internal iliac artery, providing blood to the external genitalia. the internal pudendal artery is the terminal branch of the anterior trunk of the internal iliac artery. it is smaller in the female than in the male.

UBERON:0007316.name: deep external pudendal artery
UBERON:0007316.def: the deep external pudendal artery (deep external pudic artery), more deeply seated than the superficial external pudendal artery, passes medialward across the pectineus and the adductor longus muscles; it is covered by the fascia lata, which it pierces at the medial side of the thigh, and is distributed, in the male, to the integument of the scrotum and perineum, in the female to the labium majus; its branches anastomose with the scrotal (or labial) branches of the perineal artery.

UBERON:0007317.name: superficial external pudendal artery
UBERON:0007317.def: an artery that arises from the medial side of the femoral artery, close to the superficial epigastric artery and superficial iliac circumflex artery.

UBERON:0007318.name: saphenous vein
UBERON:0007318.def: either of two main superficial veins of the leg, one larger than the other, that begin at the foot.

UBERON:0007324.name: pancreatic lobule
UBERON:0007324.def: a dense accumulation of exocrine glands in the pancreas often surrounding islets of langerhans.

UBERON:0007329.name: pancreatic duct
UBERON:0007329.def: a duct that collects and carries secretions of the exocrine pancreas to the intestine.

UBERON:0007330.name: rhamphotheca
UBERON:0007330.def: thin keratinized layer of epidermis projecting from outer surface of beak[wp].

UBERON:0007331.name: maxillary rhamphotheca
UBERON:0007331.def: a rhamphotheca that is part of a upper beak.

UBERON:0007332.name: mandibular rhamphotheca
UBERON:0007332.def: a rhamphotheca that is part of a lower beak.

UBERON:0007334.name: nidopallium
UBERON:0007334.def: the nidopallium, meaning nested pallium, is the region of the avian brain that is used mostly for some types of executive functions but also other higher cognitive tasks.

UBERON:0007347.name: hyperpallium
UBERON:0007347.def: a pallial structure unique to avians.

UBERON:0007350.name: arcopallium
UBERON:0007350.def: a pallial region found in avias that partially overlap regions homologous to the amygdala of mammals.

UBERON:0007352.name: stria vascularis vasculature
UBERON:0007352.def: blood vessels supplying the stria vascularis in the cochlea of the inner ear.

UBERON:0007354.name: cartilage of pharyngotympanic tube
UBERON:0007354.def: a triangular plate of elastic fibrocartilage that forms the cartilage component of the pharyngotympanic tube.

UBERON:0007355.name: bony part of pharyngotympanic tube
UBERON:0007355.def: the bony part of pharyngotympanic tube is about 12 mm. in length. it begins in the carotid wall of the tympanic cavity, below the septum canalis musculotubarii, and, gradually narrowing, ends at the angle of junction of the squama and the petrous portion of the temporal bone, its extremity presenting a jagged margin which serves for the attachment of the cartilaginous portion.

UBERON:0007356.name: crop
UBERON:0007356.def: a pouched enlargement of the gullet of many birds that serves as a receptacle for food and for its preliminary maceration.

UBERON:0007357.name: proventriculus
UBERON:0007357.def: the glandular or true stomach of a bird that is situated between the crop and gizzard.

UBERON:0007358.name: abomasum
UBERON:0007358.def: the fourth stomach of ruminating animals, which is an elongated pear-shaped sac lying on the floor of the abdomen, on the right-hand side, and roughly between the seventh and twelfth ribs. it leads to the beginning of the small intestine. (adapted from black's veterinary dictionary, 17th ed).

UBERON:0007359.name: ruminant forestomach
UBERON:0007359.def: any of the first three stomachs of a ruminant, i.e., the rumen, reticulum, or omasum.

UBERON:0007361.name: ruminant reticulum
UBERON:0007361.def: the second stomach of ruminants. it lies almost in the midline in the front of the abdomen, in contact with the liver and diaphragm and communicates freely with the rumen via the ruminoreticular orifice. the lining of the reticulum is raised into folds forming a honeycomb pattern over the surface. (from concise veterinary dictionary, 1988).

UBERON:0007362.name: omasum
UBERON:0007362.def: the third stomach of ruminants, situated on the right side of the abdomen at a higher level than the fourth stomach and between this latter and the second stomach, with both of which it communicates. from its inner surface project large numbers of leaves or folia, each of which possesses roughened surfaces. in the center of each folium is a band of muscle fibers which produces a rasping movement of the leaf when it contracts. one leaf rubs against those on either side of it, and large particles of food material are ground down between the rough surfaces, preparatory to further digestion in the succeeeding parts of the alimentary canal. (black's veterinary dictionary, 17th ed).

UBERON:0007364.name: reticulorumen
UBERON:0007364.def: the first chamber in the alimentary canal of a ruminant stomach, composed of the rumen and reticulum.

UBERON:0007365.name: rumen
UBERON:0007365.def: the first compartment of the ruminant stomach. it lies on the left side of the body, occupying the whole of the left side of the abdomen and even stretching across the median plane of the body to the right side. it is capacious, divided into an upper and a lower sac, each of which has a blind sac at its posterior extremity.

UBERON:0007366.name: ruminant stomach
UBERON:0007366.def: the ruminants' stomach consists of four compartments: rumen, reticulum, omasum and abomasum. the first three compartments comprise the forestomach (proventriculus). they are lined with nonglandular membrane. the fourth compartment, the abomasum comprises the true stomach of the ruminants. it is lined with glandular mucous membrane. the rumen lies on the left of the abdominal cavity, the reticulum cranially and the omasum on the right. the abomasum lies ventrally, its proximal end lies ventral to the rumen, reticulum and omasum.

UBERON:0007367.name: surface of tongue
UBERON:0007367.def: an anatomical surface that is part of a tongue.

UBERON:0007371.name: superior surface of tongue
UBERON:0007371.def: the upper (superior) side of the tongue.

UBERON:0007373.name: inferior surface of tongue
UBERON:0007373.def: the lower (inferior) side of the tongue.

UBERON:0007374.name: incus cartilage element
UBERON:0007374.def: an incus endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0007375.name: roof of mouth
UBERON:0007375.def: a multi-tissue structure consisting of bone and soft tissue that forms a part of the roof of the oral cavity. in mammals this is the combination of the primary palate (premaxilla) and the secondary palate. in early tetrapods it consists of the vomer, pterygoid, parasphenoid, palatine and ectopterygoid bones.

UBERON:0007376.name: outer epithelium
UBERON:0007376.def: the epidermis is the entire outer epithelial layer of an animal, it may be a single layer that produces an extracellular material (e.g. the cuticle of arthropods) or a complex stratified squamous epithelium, as in the case of many vertebrate species[go].

UBERON:0007377.name: stratum compactum of dermis
UBERON:0007377.def: portion of the dermis characterized by a well-arranged, plywood-like, collagenous network.

UBERON:0007378.name: egg yolk
UBERON:0007378.def: the yellow spheroidal mass of stored food that forms the inner portion of the egg of a bird or reptile and is surrounded by the white.

UBERON:0007379.name: shelled egg
UBERON:0007379.def: the hard-shelled reproductive body produced by a bird (especially by the common domestic chicken) or a reptile; also: its contents used as food.

UBERON:0007380.name: dermal scale
UBERON:0007380.def: dermal bone that is thin, flexible, and platelike, and that develops in overlapping skinfolds that cover the body and often the head of fish and the bases of the fins.

UBERON:0007381.name: epidermal scale
UBERON:0007381.def: a fold in the surface epidermis composed of keratin[kardong].

UBERON:0007383.name: enveloping layer of ectoderm
UBERON:0007383.def: outermost layer of cells surrounding the embryo.

UBERON:0007384.name: appendage lymph vessel
UBERON:0007384.def: a lymphatic vessel that is part of a limb/fin.

UBERON:0007385.name: pectoral appendage lymph vessel
UBERON:0007385.def: a lymphatic vessel that is part of a pectoral appendage.

UBERON:0007386.name: pelvic appendage lymph vessel
UBERON:0007386.def: a lymphatic vessel that is part of a pelvic appendage.

UBERON:0007389.name: paired limb/fin cartilage
UBERON:0007389.def: a cartilage tissue that is part of a paired limb or fin.

UBERON:0007390.name: pectoral appendage cartilage tissue
UBERON:0007390.def: a cartilage tissue that is part of a pectoral appendage.

UBERON:0007391.name: pelvic appendage cartilage tissue
UBERON:0007391.def: a cartilage tissue that is part of a pelvic appendage.

UBERON:0007412.name: midbrain raphe nuclei
UBERON:0007412.def: midline nuclei found in the midbrain, includes the dorsal raphe nucleus and the rostral linear nucleus of raphe.
UBERON:0007412.synonym: set of raphe nuclei of tegmentum of midbrain

UBERON:0007413.name: nucleus of pontine reticular formation
UBERON:0007413.def: a nucleus of brain that is part of a pontine reticular formation.

UBERON:0007414.name: nucleus of midbrain tegmentum
UBERON:0007414.def: a nucleus of brain that spans a midbrain tegmentum.

UBERON:0007415.name: nucleus of midbrain reticular formation
UBERON:0007415.def: a nucleus of midbrain tegmentum that is part of a midbrain reticular formation.

UBERON:0007416.name: cerebellar peduncle
UBERON:0007416.def: any of the three large paired bundles of nerve fibers that connect the cerebellum to the brain stem.

UBERON:0007418.name: neural decussation
UBERON:0007418.def: nerve fibers crossing the midline of the neuraxis relative to their point of origin, on a course to from one level of the nervous system to another. (cumbo, heimer, l. the human brain, 2nd ed., 1995, pg 6).

UBERON:0007425.name: decussation of diencephalon
UBERON:0007425.def: a neural decussation that is part of a diencephalon.

UBERON:0007440.name: stratum intermedium of tooth
UBERON:0007440.def: the stratum intermedium in a developing tooth is a layer of two or three cells between the inner enamel epithelium and the newly forming cells of the stellate reticulum. it first appears during the early bell stage of tooth development, at around the 14th week of intrauterine life (in humans). the stratum intermedium has a notably high alkaline phosphatase activity. this layer, along with the inner enamel epithelium, is responsible for the tooth enamel formation. it is a part of the dental (enamel) organ.

UBERON:0007473.name: lumen of epithelial sac
UBERON:0007473.def: the space within an epithelial sphere.

UBERON:0007475.name: matrix-based tissue
UBERON:0007475.def: a tissue whose predominant feature is extracellular matrix which may or may not be highly hydrated or calcified.

UBERON:0007490.name: keratin-based acellular structure
UBERON:0007490.def: acellular anatomical structure whose predominant constituent is keratin.

UBERON:0007491.name: chitin-based acellular structure
UBERON:0007491.def: acellular anatomical structure whose predominant constituent is chitin.

UBERON:0007497.name: obsolete developing epithelial placode
UBERON:0007497.def: obsolete: a domain of columnar epithelium in an embryo that represents the early stage of the development of the epithelial component of a new anatomical structure.

UBERON:0007499.name: epithelial sac
UBERON:0007499.def: an epithelial tube that is open at one end only.

UBERON:0007500.name: epithelial tube open at both ends
UBERON:0007500.def: an epithelial tube open at both ends that allows fluid flow.

UBERON:0007501.name: arborizing epithelial duct system
UBERON:0007501.def: a collection of connected epithelial tubes with a single portal.

UBERON:0007502.name: epithelial plexus
UBERON:0007502.def: a complex of interlinking epithelial tubules.

UBERON:0007503.name: epithelial vesicle
UBERON:0007503.def: a closed epithelium with a lumen.

UBERON:0007521.name: smooth muscle sphincter
UBERON:0007521.def: a ring of smooth muscle cells whose contraction closes the opening of the ring.

UBERON:0007522.name: striated muscle sphincter
UBERON:0007522.def: a ring of striated muscle cells whose contraction closes the opening of the ring.

UBERON:0007529.name: loose mesenchyme tissue
UBERON:0007529.def: mesenchyme whose cells are embedded in obvious amounts of extracellular matrix.

UBERON:0007567.name: regenerating anatomical structure
UBERON:0007567.def: an anatomical structure that is undergoing regeneration.

UBERON:0007573.name: migrating epithelium
UBERON:0007573.def: an epithelium that extends its surface area by peripheral movement.

UBERON:0007589.name: ciliated columnar oviduct epithelium
UBERON:0007589.def: a ciliated columnar epithelium that is part of a oviduct.

UBERON:0007590.name: cuboidal oviduct epithelium
UBERON:0007590.def: a cuboidal epithelium that is part of a oviduct.

UBERON:0007592.name: ciliated columnar epithelium
UBERON:0007592.def: simple columnar epithelium in which the luminal side of the cells bears cilia. examples: epithelium of trachea, epithelium of uterine tube.[fma].

UBERON:0007601.name: ciliated epithelium
UBERON:0007601.def: epithelium bearing vibratile cilia on the free surface.

UBERON:0007602.name: stratified columnar epithelium
UBERON:0007602.def: stratified columnar epithelia is a rare type of epithelial tissue composed of column shaped cells arranged in multiple layers. stratified columnar epithelia are found in the ocular conjunctiva of the eye, in parts of the pharynx and anus, the female's uterus, the male urethra and vas deferens. also found in intralobular ducts in salivary glands.[wp].

UBERON:0007603.name: stratified cuboidal epithelium
UBERON:0007603.def: stratified cuboidal epithelia is a rare type of epithelial tissue composed of cuboidally shaped cells arranged in multiple layers. they protect areas such as ducts of sweat glands, mammary glands, and salivary glands.

UBERON:0007610.name: tibial artery
UBERON:0007610.def: the anterior and posterior arteries created at the bifurcation of the popliteal artery. the anterior tibial artery begins at the lower border of the popliteus muscle and lies along the tibia at the distal part of the leg to surface superficially anterior to the ankle joint. its branches are distributed throughout the leg, ankle, and pes. the posterior tibial artery begins at the lower border of the popliteus muscle, lies behind the tibia in the lower part of its course, and is found situated between the medial malleolus and the medial process of the calcaneal tuberosity. its branches are distributed throughout the leg and foot.

UBERON:0007612.name: extensor digitorum communis
UBERON:0007612.def: a muscle on the back of the forearm that extends the fingers and wrist.

UBERON:0007614.name: extensor digiti minimi muscle
UBERON:0007614.def: the extensor minimi digiti (extensor digiti quinti proprius) is a slender muscle of the forearm, placed on the ulnar side of the extensor digitorum communis, with which it is generally connected. it arises from the common extensor tendon by a thin tendinous slip, from the intermuscular septa between it and the adjacent muscles. its tendon runs through a compartment of the dorsal carpal ligament behind the distal radio-ulnar joint, then divides into two as it crosses the manus, and finally joins the expansion of the extensor digitorum communis tendon on the dorsum of the first phalanx of the little finger[wp].

UBERON:0007615.name: prostate gland ventral lobe
UBERON:0007615.def: prostate gland lobe that in the mouse has the following characteristics: grossly, clear, gelatinous, and leaf-like; originates ventrally and wraps incompletely around the urethra dorsally, bilaterally. simple columnar epithelium with the least amount of infolding. secretory cells are oval and have slightly foamy cytoplasm; nuclei and basal nucleoli are inconspicuous. the secretion is pale and homogeneous. the stroma is thin.

UBERON:0007616.name: layer of synovial tissue
UBERON:0007616.def: a thin, loose vascular connective tissue that makes up the membranes surrounding joints and the sheaths protecting tendons (particularly flexor tendons in the hands and feet) where they pass over bony prominences. synovial tissue contains synovial cells, which secrete a viscous liquid called synovial fluid; this liquid contains protein and hyaluronic acid and serves as a lubricant and nutrient for the joint cartilage surfaces[bto]. synovial tissue can be found in tendons (tissues that connect muscle to bone), bursae (fluid-filled, cushioning sacs found in spaces between tendons, ligaments, and bones), and the cavity (hollow enclosed area) that separates the bones of a freely movable joint, such as the knee or elbow[bto].

UBERON:0007617.name: synovial cavity of joint
UBERON:0007617.def: an anatomical cavity that surrounded_by a synovial joint.

UBERON:0007618.name: synovial cavity of hip joint
UBERON:0007618.def: a synovial cavity of joint that is part of a hip joint.

UBERON:0007622.name: pecten oculi
UBERON:0007622.def: a comb-like structure of blood vessels belonging to the choroid in the eye of a bird or reptile. it is non-sensory and is a pigmented structure that projects into the vitreous body from the point where the optic nerve enters the eyeball. the pecten is believed to both nourish the retina and control the ph of the vitreous body.

UBERON:0007623.name: comb and wattle
UBERON:0007623.def: a wattle is a fleshy dewlap or caruncle hanging from various parts of the head or neck in several groups of birds, goats and other animals. in some birds the caruncle is erectile tissue.

UBERON:0007625.name: pigment epithelium of eye
UBERON:0007625.def: epithelial layer of the retina, ciliary body, or iris composed of cells containing pigment granules.

UBERON:0007628.name: lateral septal complex
UBERON:0007628.def: the lateral septal area; largest nuclear mass in this region, plays a pivotal role in various physiological processes, such as aggression, emotion, thermoregulation, water and food intake and sexual behaviour.

UBERON:0007629.name: medial septal complex
UBERON:0007629.def: a septal nuclear complex that consists of the nucleus of the diagonal bands and the septal medial nuclei.

UBERON:0007630.name: septohippocampal nucleus
UBERON:0007630.def: part of septal nuclear complex. in the human, it refers to the most caudal of scattered clusters of neurons in the septum pellucidum that extend, on the underside of the corpus callosum, from the level of the medial septal nucleus to the ca fields ( crosby-1962 ). in the rat it is associated with the lateral septal nucleus throughout its rostro-caudal course toward the ca fields ( swanson-1998. adapted from brain info.

UBERON:0007631.name: accessory olfactory bulb glomerular layer
UBERON:0007631.synonym: glomerular layer of the accessory olfactory bulb

UBERON:0007633.name: nucleus of trapezoid body
UBERON:0007633.def: a nucleus embedded within the fibers of the trapezoid body.

UBERON:0007634.name: parabrachial nucleus
UBERON:0007634.def: a nucleus of the parabrachial area, which in the human brain is a horseshoe-shaped strip of gray matter comprising the kölliker-fuse nucleus, the lateral parabrachial nucleus and the medial parabrachial nucleus.

UBERON:0007635.name: nucleus of medulla oblongata
UBERON:0007635.def: a neural nucleus that is part of a medulla oblongata.

UBERON:0007637.name: hippocampus stratum lucidum
UBERON:0007637.def: layer of hippocampus area ca3 lying superficial to the pyramidal cell layer that contains mossy fiber axons projecting from the dentate gyrus. a slight thickening in this layer marks the border in some species between areas ca2 and ca3. dapted from paxinos, g. the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995, pg. 460).

UBERON:0007639.name: hippocampus alveus
UBERON:0007639.def: regional part of fornix consisting of a thin layer of white matter on the surface of the hippocampal formation, bordering the wall of the lateral ventricle and composed of white, myelinated fibers. the alveus arises from cell bodies in the subiculum and hippocampus, and eventually merges with the fimbria of the hippocampus. the fimbria goes on to become the fornix (mm: 2006-10-26).

UBERON:0007640.name: hippocampus stratum lacunosum moleculare
UBERON:0007640.def: layer of the hippocampus lying just superficial to the stratum radiatum and bounded by the pial surface of the hippocampus. the fibers of the perforant pathway fibers from entorhinal cortex and several other brain areas terminate in this layer. adapted from paxinos, g. the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995, pg. 460).

UBERON:0007641.name: trigeminal nuclear complex
UBERON:0007641.def: the sensory trigeminal nerve nuclei are the largest of the cranial nerve nuclei, and extend through the whole of the midbrain, pons and medulla. there is also a distinct trigeminal motor nucleus that is medial to the chief sensory nucleus[wp].

UBERON:0007642.name: ligamentum arteriosum
UBERON:0007642.def: a small ligament attached to the superior surface of the pulmonary trunk and the inferior surface of the aortic arch. it is a nonfunctional vestige of the ductus arteriosus, and is formed within three weeks of birth. the ligamentum arteriosum is closely related to the left recurrent laryngeal nerve, a branch of the left vagus nerve. after splitting from the left vagus nerve, the left recurrent laryngeal loops around the aortic arch posterior to the ligamentum arteriosum, after which it ascends to the larynx[wp].

UBERON:0007643.name: node of ligamentum arteriosum
UBERON:0007643.def: an inconstant lymph node of the anterior mediastinal group located adjacent to the ligamentum arteriosum.

UBERON:0007644.name: thoracic lymph node
UBERON:0007644.def: a lymph node that is part of a thorax. includes lymph nodes of the lungs and mediastinal lymph nodes.

UBERON:0007645.name: future meninx
UBERON:0007645.def: a developing mesenchymal capsule that covers the developing brain and spinal cord and is the precursor of the meningeal cluster. in mammals this gives rise to the arachnoid mater, pia mater and dura mater. in cyclostomes and fishes, the future meninx gives rise to a single meningeal layer, the primitive meninx.

UBERON:0007646.name: endomeninx
UBERON:0007646.def: the innermost layer of the mesenchymal capsule that surrounds the developing brain, primarily of neural crest origin. the endomeninx forms the leptomeninx.

UBERON:0007647.name: ectomeninx
UBERON:0007647.def: the outermost layer of the mesenchymal capsule that surrounds the developing brain, of mixed paraxial mesoderm and neural crest origin. the ectomeninx forms the dura mater (both inner layer and outer chondrogenic layer).

UBERON:0007650.name: esophagogastric junction
UBERON:0007650.def: the junction between the esophagus and the stomach epithelium.
UBERON:0007650.synonym: squamocolumnar junction between esophagus and stomach

UBERON:0007651.name: anatomical junction
UBERON:0007651.def: an anatomical structure that connects two structures.

UBERON:0007652.name: esophageal sphincter
UBERON:0007652.def: a sphincter that is part of an esophagus.

UBERON:0007653.name: capillary loop nephron
UBERON:0007653.def: developing nephron where the developing glomerular capsule has been invaded by a glomerular capillary loop called the glomerular tuft.

UBERON:0007656.name: lateral recess of fourth ventricle
UBERON:0007656.def: the lateral recess is a projection of the fourth ventricle which extends into the inferior cerebellar peduncle of the brainstem. the lateral aperture, an opening in each extremity of the lateral recess, provides a conduit for cerebrospinal fluid to flow from the brain's ventricular system into the subarachnoid space.

UBERON:0007657.name: anular ligament of radius
UBERON:0007657.def: the anular ligament (orbicular ligament) is a strong band of fibers, which encircles the head of the radius (bone), and retains it in contact with the radial notch of the ulna.

UBERON:0007679.name: intersomitic vein
UBERON:0007679.def: the vein that sprouts from the posterior cardinal vein, growing dorsally between the somites, and then joining, and draining the dorsal longitudinal anastomosing vessel.

UBERON:0007681.name: facial neural crest
UBERON:0007681.def: cranial neural crest that is part of the facial region.

UBERON:0007684.name: uriniferous tubule
UBERON:0007684.def: functional unit of the kidney that forms urine, consisting of two parts, the nephron and the collecting tubule.

UBERON:0007687.name: kidney field
UBERON:0007687.def: region of the embryo into the area in which the kidney rudiment will develop.

UBERON:0007688.name: anlage
UBERON:0007688.def: anlagen are populations of contiguous cells, typically arranged in one plane, that are morphologically indistinct, but that already correspond in extent to a later organ/tissue.

UBERON:0007689.name: thyroid diverticulum
UBERON:0007689.def: endodermal bud derived from the endodermal epithelium of the embryonic pharyngeal floor[mp]. the thyroid diverticulum is the embryological structure from which thyroid follicular cells derive. it grows from the floor of the pharnyx[wp].

UBERON:0007691.name: gustatory pore
UBERON:0007691.def: the minute opening of a taste bud on the surface of the oral mucosa through which the gustatory hairs of the specialised neuroepithelial gustatory cells project.

UBERON:0007692.name: nucleus of thalamus
UBERON:0007692.def: a nucleus of brain that is part of a thalamus.

UBERON:0007693.name: caroticotympanic artery
UBERON:0007693.def: the caroticotympanic branch (tympanic branch) is small; it enters the tympanic cavity through a minute foramen in the carotid canal, and anastomoses with the anterior tympanic branch of the internal maxillary, and with the stylomastoid artery.

UBERON:0007699.name: tract of spinal cord
UBERON:0007699.def: an axon tract that is part of a spinal cord.

UBERON:0007702.name: tract of brain
UBERON:0007702.def: an axon tract that is part of a brain.

UBERON:0007703.name: spinothalamic tract
UBERON:0007703.def: a tract that originates from neurons in the spinal central gray and projects to various somatosensory nuclei of the thalamus. it is formed in the medulla by merger of the anterior spinothalamic tract and lateral spinothalamic tract (adapted from braininfo.org).

UBERON:0007707.name: superior cerebellar peduncle of midbrain
UBERON:0007707.def: regional part of superior cerebellar peduncle, located in the midbrain, consisting of a large bundle of fibers largely projecting from the deep cerebellar nuclei to the midbrain and thalamus. it is continuous with the superior cerebellar peduncle of the pons. (mm).
UBERON:0007707.synonym: superior cerebellar peduncle of the midbrain

UBERON:0007709.name: superior cerebellar peduncle of pons
UBERON:0007709.synonym: superior cerebellar peduncle of the pons

UBERON:0007710.name: intermediate nucleus of lateral lemniscus
UBERON:0007710.synonym: nucleus of the lateral lemniscus, horizontal part

UBERON:0007714.name: cervical subsegment of spinal cord
UBERON:0007714.synonym: segment part of cervical spinal cord

UBERON:0007715.name: thoracic subsegment of spinal cord
UBERON:0007715.synonym: segment part of thoracic spinal cord

UBERON:0007716.name: lumbar subsegment of spinal cord
UBERON:0007716.synonym: segment part of lumbar spinal cord

UBERON:0007717.name: sacral subsegment of spinal cord
UBERON:0007717.synonym: segment part of sacral spinal cord

UBERON:0007719.name: bone of reproductive organ
UBERON:0007719.def: a bone that is part of a reproductive organ.

UBERON:0007721.name: interphalangeal joint of pes
UBERON:0007721.def: the interphalangeal articulations of the foot (articulations of the phalanges) are ginglymoid joints, and each has a plantar and two collateral ligaments. the arrangement of these ligaments is similar to that in the metatarsophalangeal articulations: the extensor tendons supply the places of dorsal ligaments.

UBERON:0007722.name: interphalangeal joint of manus
UBERON:0007722.def: the interphalangeal articulations of hand are hinge-joints of the phalanges of the hand. there are two sets (except in the thumb): 'proximal interphalangeal joints' (pip), those between the first (also called proximal) and second (intermediate) phalanges 'distal interphalangeal joints' (dip), those between the second and third (distal) phalanges a similar group of articulations also function in the toes.

UBERON:0007723.name: interphalangeal joint of manual digit 1
UBERON:0007723.def: an interphalangeal joint of manus that is part of a manual digit 1.

UBERON:0007724.name: interphalangeal joint of pedal digit 1
UBERON:0007724.def: an interphalangeal joint of pes that is part of a pedal digit 1.
UBERON:0007724.synonym: interphalangeal joint of pedal digit i

UBERON:0007725.name: interphalangeal joint of pedal digit 2
UBERON:0007725.def: an interphalangeal joint of pes that is part of a pedal digit 2.

UBERON:0007726.name: interphalangeal joint of pedal digit 3
UBERON:0007726.def: an interphalangeal joint of pes that is part of a pedal digit 3.

UBERON:0007727.name: interphalangeal joint of pedal digit 4
UBERON:0007727.def: an interphalangeal joint of pes that is part of a pedal digit 4.
UBERON:0007727.synonym: interphalangeal joint of pedal digit iv

UBERON:0007728.name: interphalangeal joint of pedal digit 5
UBERON:0007728.def: an interphalangeal joint of pes that is part of a pedal digit 5.
UBERON:0007728.synonym: interphalangeal joint of pedal digit v

UBERON:0007729.name: interphalangeal joint of manual digit 2
UBERON:0007729.def: an interphalangeal joint of manus that is part of a manual digit 2.

UBERON:0007730.name: interphalangeal joint of manual digit 3
UBERON:0007730.def: an interphalangeal joint of manus that is part of a manual digit 3.

UBERON:0007731.name: interphalangeal joint of manual digit 4
UBERON:0007731.def: an interphalangeal joint of manus that is part of a manual digit 4.

UBERON:0007732.name: interphalangeal joint of manual digit 5
UBERON:0007732.def: an interphalangeal joint of manus that is part of a manual digit 5.
UBERON:0007732.synonym: interphalangeal joint of manual digit v

UBERON:0007735.name: metacarpophalangeal joint of manual digit 1
UBERON:0007735.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metacarpal bone and connects a proximal phalanx of manual digit 1.

UBERON:0007738.name: metacarpophalangeal joint of manual digit 2
UBERON:0007738.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metacarpal bone and connects a proximal phalanx of manual digit 2.

UBERON:0007741.name: metacarpophalangeal joint of manual digit 3
UBERON:0007741.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metacarpal bone and connects a proximal phalanx of manual digit 3.

UBERON:0007744.name: metacarpophalangeal joint of manual digit 4
UBERON:0007744.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metacarpal bone and connects a proximal phalanx of manual digit 4.

UBERON:0007747.name: metacarpophalangeal joint of manual digit 5
UBERON:0007747.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metacarpal bone and connects a proximal phalanx of manual digit 5.
UBERON:0007747.synonym: metacarpophalangeal joint of manual digit v

UBERON:0007750.name: metatarsophalangeal joint of pedal digit 1
UBERON:0007750.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metatarsal bone and connects a distal phalanx of pedal digit 1.
UBERON:0007750.synonym: metatarsophalangeal joint of pedal digit i

UBERON:0007753.name: metatarsophalangeal joint of pedal digit 2
UBERON:0007753.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metatarsal bone and connects a distal phalanx of pedal digit 2.

UBERON:0007756.name: metatarsophalangeal joint of pedal digit 3
UBERON:0007756.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metatarsal bone and connects a distal phalanx of pedal digit 3.

UBERON:0007759.name: metatarsophalangeal joint of pedal digit 4
UBERON:0007759.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metatarsal bone and connects a distal phalanx of pedal digit 4.
UBERON:0007759.synonym: metatarsophalangeal joint of pedal digit iv

UBERON:0007762.name: metatarsophalangeal joint of pedal digit 5
UBERON:0007762.def: a skeletal joint that connects a metatarsal bone and connects a distal phalanx of pedal digit 5.
UBERON:0007762.synonym: metatarsophalangeal joint of pedal digit v

UBERON:0007763.name: cerebellum vermis culmen
UBERON:0007763.def: the culmen is the portion of the anterior vermis adjacent to the primary fissure of cerebellum. the culmen and the anterior parts of the quadrangular lobules form the lobus culminis[wp].

UBERON:0007764.name: paramedian reticular nucleus
UBERON:0007764.def: a medullary nucleus that sends its connections to the spinal cord in a mostly ipsilateral manner.

UBERON:0007770.name: osphradium
UBERON:0007770.def: the osphradium is the olfactory organ in certain molluscs, linked with the respiration organ. the main function of this is to test incoming water for silt and other possible food particles. it is used by all members of the genus conus.

UBERON:0007771.name: epidermis gland
UBERON:0007771.def: a gland that is part of a epidermis.

UBERON:0007772.name: scrotal sweat
UBERON:0007772.def: any portion of sweat that is produced by a sweat gland of the scrotum.

UBERON:0007773.name: scrotal sweat gland
UBERON:0007773.def: any sweat gland that is part of a scrotum.

UBERON:0007774.name: secondary dentition
UBERON:0007774.def: the teeth of adulthood that either replace or are added to the complement of deciduous teeth. (boucher's clinical dental terminology, 4th ed).

UBERON:0007775.name: secondary tooth
UBERON:0007775.def: a tooth that forms after a primary tooth.

UBERON:0007776.name: unerupted tooth
UBERON:0007776.def: a normal developing tooth which has not yet perforated the oral mucosa or one that fails to erupt in the normal sequence or time interval expected for the type of tooth in a given gender, age, or population group.

UBERON:0007777.name: umbilical vein endothelium
UBERON:0007777.def: an endothelium that is part of a umbilical vein.

UBERON:0007778.name: umbilical artery endothelium
UBERON:0007778.def: an endothelium that is part of a umbilical artery.

UBERON:0007779.name: transudate
UBERON:0007779.def: any bodily fluid that has passed through a membrane such as the capillary wall, as a result of unbalanced hydrostatic and osmotic forces.

UBERON:0007780.name: exudate
UBERON:0007780.def: fluids that is discharged from blood vessels usually arising from inflammation or injury.

UBERON:0007794.name: secretion of serous gland
UBERON:0007794.def: any fluid produced by a serous gland.

UBERON:0007795.name: ascitic fluid
UBERON:0007795.def: the serous fluid which accumulates in the peritoneal cavity in ascites.

UBERON:0007798.name: vascular system
UBERON:0007798.def: anatomical system that consists of all blood and lymph vessels.

UBERON:0007799.name: mixed dentition
UBERON:0007799.def: the complement of teeth in the jaws after the eruption of some of the permanent teeth but before all the deciduous teeth are absent. (boucher's clinical dental terminology, 4th ed).

UBERON:0007800.name: proatlas
UBERON:0007800.def: a small, paired bony element (more rarely, having fused parts) located between the skull and the atlas in tuataras, crocodiles, chameleons, and many fossil reptiles; it is uncommon in turtles and mammals (hedgehog). the proatlas apparently develops from the ossified neural part of the sclerotome. externally it resembles the neural arch of the vertebra, since it articulates anteriorly with the lateral occipital bone and posteriorly with the anterior articular process of the atlas.

UBERON:0007801.name: pygostyle
UBERON:0007801.def: pygostyle refers to a number of the final few caudal vertebrae fused into a single ossification, supporting the tail feathers and musculature. in modern birds, the rectrices attach to these[wp].

UBERON:0007802.name: uropygial gland
UBERON:0007802.def: a large gland at the base of a bird's tail dorsal to the cloaca at the end of the pygostyle that secretes an oil used in preening. it opens through a caudally directed nipple.

UBERON:0007804.name: sclerotic ring
UBERON:0007804.def: sclerotic rings are rings of bone found in the eyes of several groups of vertebrate animals, except for mammals and crocodilians. they can be made up of single bones or small bones together. they are believed to have a role in supporting the eye, especially in animals whose eyes are not spherical, or which live underwater. fossil sclerotic rings are known for a variety of extinct animals, including ichthyosaurs, pterosaurs, and dinosaurs, but are often not preserved[wp].

UBERON:0007805.name: synsacrum
UBERON:0007805.def: a region of the lower vertebral column formed from the fusion of vertebrae.

UBERON:0007806.name: connecting stalk
UBERON:0007806.def: a bridge of mesoderm connecting the caudal end of the young embryo with the trophoblastic tissues; the precursor of the umbilical cord.

UBERON:0007807.name: connecting stalk vasculature
UBERON:0007807.def: a vasculature that is part of a connecting stalk.

UBERON:0007808.name: adipose tissue of abdominal region
UBERON:0007808.def: adipose tissue that is located in the abdominal region. this includes any subcutaneous fat, visceral fat or encapsulated adipose tissue depots.

UBERON:0007809.name: fascia of camper
UBERON:0007809.def: the superficial layer (fascia of camper) is a thick superficial layer of the anterior abdominal wall. it is areolar in texture, and contains in its meshes a varying quantity of adipose tissue. it is found superficial to scarpa's fascia.
UBERON:0007809.synonym: superficial layer of superficial fascia of abdomen

UBERON:0007811.name: craniocervical region
UBERON:0007811.def: the anteriormost subdivision of the body that includes the head, jaws, pharyngeal region and the neck (if present). in vertebrates this is the subdivision that includes the cervical vertebrae.

UBERON:0007812.name: post-anal tail
UBERON:0007812.def: a tail that extends from the posterior tip of the organism to the anus, contains muscle and skeleton.

UBERON:0007818.name: major alar cartilage
UBERON:0007818.def: the greater alar cartilage (lower lateral cartilage) is a thin, flexible plate, situated immediately below the preceding, and bent upon itself in such a manner as to form the medial wall and lateral wall of the naris of its own side. the portion which forms the medial wall (crus mediale) is loosely connected with the corresponding portion of the opposite cartilage, the two forming, together with the thickened integument and subjacent tissue, the septum mobile nasi. the part which forms the lateral wall (crus laterale) is curved to correspond with the ala of the nose; it is oval and flattened, narrow behind, where it is connected with the frontal process of the maxilla by a tough fibrous membrane, in which are found three or four small cartilaginous plates, the lesser alar cartilages (cartilagines alares minores; sesamoid cartilages). above, it is connected by fibrous tissue to the lateral cartilage and front part of the cartilage of the septum; below, it falls short of the margin of the naris, the ala being completed by fatty and fibrous tissue covered by skin. in front, the greater alar cartilages are separated by a notch which corresponds with the apex of the nose.

UBERON:0007819.name: minor alar cartilage
UBERON:0007819.def: the part which forms the lateral wall is curved to correspond with the ala of the nose; it is oval and flattened, narrow behind, where it is connected with the frontal process of the maxilla by a tough fibrous membrane, in which are found three or four small cartilaginous plates, the lesser alar cartilages.

UBERON:0007820.name: accessory nasal cartilage
UBERON:0007820.def: small cartilages of the nose connecting the greater alar cartilage and lateral nasal cartilage.

UBERON:0007821.name: lateral nasal cartilage
UBERON:0007821.def: the lateral cartilage (upper lateral cartilage) is situated below the inferior margin of the nasal bone, and is flattened, and triangular in shape.[wp].

UBERON:0007822.name: vomeronasal cartilage
UBERON:0007822.def: the vomeronasal cartilage (or jacobson's cartilage) is a narrow strip of cartilage, low on the medial wall of the nasal cavity. it lies between the cartilaginous nasal septum and the vomer. the cartilage lies below, but is not connected to, the rudimentary vomeronasal organ of jacobson[wp].

UBERON:0007823.name: appendage girdle region
UBERON:0007823.def: an organism subdivision that encompasses the region containing the pectoral or pelvic girdle. note that this includes both the skeletal elements and associated tissues (integument, muscle, etc).

UBERON:0007825.name: reticular membrane of spiral organ
UBERON:0007825.def: a reticular lamina of epithelium that is part of a spiral organ of cochlea.
UBERON:0007825.synonym: reticular lamina of spiral organ of cochlea

UBERON:0007826.name: peritoneal mesentery
UBERON:0007826.def: mesentery that is located in the peritoneum.

UBERON:0007827.name: external nose
UBERON:0007827.def: external part of the nose containing the external nares.

UBERON:0007828.name: girdle bone/zone
UBERON:0007828.def: a bone that is part of a appendage girdle region.

UBERON:0007829.name: pectoral girdle bone
UBERON:0007829.def: a bone that is part of a pectoral girdle region.

UBERON:0007830.name: pelvic girdle bone/zone
UBERON:0007830.def: a bone element or fused bone that is part of pelvic girdle.

UBERON:0007831.name: pectoral girdle skeleton
