UBERON:0016553.def: any mucus produced by a mucosae of the respiratory system. this includes the mucus produced in the nasal cavity (nasal mucus) and mucus produced in the respiratory tract (phlegm).

UBERON:0016554.name: white matter of midbrain
UBERON:0016554.def: a white matter that is part of the midbrain.

UBERON:0016555.name: stria of telencephalon
UBERON:0016555.def: a stria of neuraxis that is part of a telencephalon.

UBERON:0016559.name: superficial cerebral vein
UBERON:0016559.def: the superficial cerebral veins are a group of veins in the head. this group includes the superior cerebral veins.

UBERON:0016564.name: deep cerebral vein
UBERON:0016564.def: the deep cerebral veins are a group of veins in the head. this group includes the superior thalamostriate vein.

UBERON:0016565.name: cerebral blood vessel
UBERON:0016565.def: a blood vessel that is part of a cerebellum.

UBERON:0016566.name: pit
UBERON:0016566.def: an roughly circular indentation in a surface.

UBERON:0016567.name: statoconial membrane
UBERON:0016567.def: an acellular membrane in the vestibular labyrinth that is composed of the otoconial layer, gelatinous layer, and a subcupular meshwork.

UBERON:0016569.name: subcupular meshwork of statoconial membrane
UBERON:0016569.def: an acellular membrane in the inner ear that is part of the statoconial membrane and consists of long branching filaments cross-bridged to one another. the filaments are continuous with those of the otolithic membrane on one side and with the surface of the epithelium on the other.

UBERON:0016570.name: lamina of gray matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0016573.name: obsolete lamina ii of gray matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0016574.name: lamina iii of gray matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0016575.name: lamina iv of gray matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0016576.name: lamina v of gray matter of spinal cord
UBERON:0016576.def: spinal lamina v is a lamina of the spinal cord. it is also known as the neck of the posterior horn.

UBERON:0016577.name: lamina vi of gray matter of spinal cord
UBERON:0016577.def: spinal lamina vi is a lamina of the spinal cord. it is also known as the base of the posterior horn.

UBERON:0016578.name: lamina vii of gray matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0016579.name: lamina viii of gray matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0016580.name: lamina ix of gray matter of spinal cord

UBERON:0016610.name: nucleus proprius of spinal cord
UBERON:0016610.def: the nucleus proprius is a layer of the spinal cord adjacent to the substantia gelatinosa. nucleus proprius constitutes the bulk of the dorsal horn and receives inputs from the dorsal root ganglions that carry sensory information, such as light touch, as well as pain and temperature information. cells in this nucleus project to deeper laminae of the spinal cord, to the posterior column nuclei, and to other supraspinal relay centers including the midbrain, thalamus, and hypothalamus. rexed laminae iii, iv, and v make up the nucleus propius nucleus proprius (np), along with nucleus dorsalis (nd) are involved in sensing fine touch and proprioception.

UBERON:0016611.name: auditory hillocks, pharyngeal arch 1 derived
UBERON:0016611.def: a collection of protruberances derived from pharyngeal arch 1 that develop into the tragus, crus of the helix, and helix.

UBERON:0016612.name: auditory hillocks, pharyngeal arch 2 derived
UBERON:0016612.def: a collection of protruberances derived from pharyngeal arch 2 that develop into the concha, antihelix and antitragus.

UBERON:0016619.name: y-shaped fibrocartilage skeleton of ventral pouch
UBERON:0016619.def: a y-shaped fibrocartilage structure that lies in the substance of the muscular ventral pouch of rorqual whales.

UBERON:0016621.name: lunge feeding organ
UBERON:0016621.def: a fibrous capsule located between the jaws of rorqual whales that contains a gelatinous substance and papillae bearing mechanorecaptors.

UBERON:0016624.name: lunge feeding vibrissa
UBERON:0016624.def: a vibrissa on the lower jaw of rorqual whales that is hypothesized to form part of the lung feeding system.

UBERON:0016628.name: stem of y-shaped fibrocartilage skeleton of ventral pouch

UBERON:0016629.name: branch of y-shaped fibrocartilage skeleton of ventral pouch

UBERON:0016630.name: neurovascular bundle
UBERON:0016630.def: a body structure consisting of nerves traveling together with arteries, veins, and/or lymphatics.

UBERON:0016631.name: actinopterygian frontal-parietal joint
UBERON:0016631.def: fibrous joint connecting the actinopterygian frontal bone to the actinopterygian parietal bone.

UBERON:0016633.name: parvocellular reticular nucleus
UBERON:0016633.def: the parvocellular reticular nucleus is part of the brain located dorsolateral to the nucleus reticularis pontis caudalis. the dorsal portion of the reticular nucleus has been shown to innervate the mesencephalic trigeminal nucleus and its surrounding area. also, it projects to the facial nucleus, hypoglossal nucleus and parabrachial nucleus along with parts of the caudal parvocellular reticular formation. this nucleus is also involved in expiration with a part of the gigantocellular nucleus.

UBERON:0016634.name: premotor cortex
UBERON:0016634.def: the premotor cortex is an area of motor cortex lying within the frontal lobe of the brain. it extends 3 mm anterior to the primary motor cortex, near the sylvian fissure, before narrowing to approximately 1 mm near the medial longitudinal fissure, which serves as the posterior border for the prefrontal cortex. the premotor cortex is largely equivalent to brodmann area 6. activity within this region is critical to the sensory guidance of movement and control of proximal and trunk muscles of the body.

UBERON:0016636.name: supplemental motor cortex
UBERON:0016636.def: the supplementary motor area (sma) is a part of the sensorimotor cerebral cortex (perirolandic, i.e. on each side of the rolando or central sulcus). it was included, on purely cytoarchitectonic arguments, in area 6 of brodmann and the vogts. it is located on the medial face of the hemisphere, just in front of primary motor cortex. this is an element that appeared late in evolution, in monkeys, linked to the appearance of a true medial pallidum.

UBERON:0016637.name: lateral periolivary nucleus
UBERON:0016637.def: lateral component of the periolivary nucleus.

UBERON:0016641.name: subparafascicular nucleus
UBERON:0016641.def: the term subparafascicular nucleus refers to a cell group located ventral to the parafascicular nucleus in the thalamus. identified by internal structure, it is present in the human ( mai-1997 ), the macaque ( paxinos-2009a ), the rat ( swanson-1998 ), and the mouse ( hof-2000 ).

UBERON:0016827.name: dorsal paramedian reticular nucleus
UBERON:0016827.def: small nucleus in the brainstem of human, located adjacent and medial to the nucleus prepositus in the dorsal medulla, described in several atlases of human brain stem. in transverse sections, it is oval with its long axis aligned with the dorsal border of the brainstem. it begins at about the same a-p level as the nucleus prepositus, just rostral to the hypoglossal nucleus. it includes calretinin immunoreactive large cells with oval or polygonal cell bodies. cells are not immunoreactive for either calbindin or parvalbumin, but a few fibers immunoreactive to each protein are found within its central region. cells in pmd are also immunoreactive to nnos, and immunoreactivity to a neurofilament protein shows many labeled cells and fibers. according to baizer et al., no equivalent structure was observed in the cat, rat, mouse or monkey atlas although they did not look at the brains of the great apes.

UBERON:0016832.name: paratrigeminal nucleus
UBERON:0016832.def: the term paratrigeminal nucleus refers to a group of cells located lateral to the spinal trigeminal tract of the medulla and medial to the spinocerebellar tracts at the level of the spinal trigeminal nucleus. the cells, identified by nissl stain, are partially embedded in the adjacent tracts; their distribution varies by species. the paratrigeminal nucleus may represent an extension of the lateral cervical nucleus into the medulla ( swanson-2004 ). it is found in the human ( carpenter-1983 ), the macaque ( paxinos-2009a ), the rat ( swanson-2004 ) and the mouse ( paxinos-2001 ). in the functional model of central nervous system organization it is classified as part of the subcortical somatosensory system ( swanson-2004 ).

UBERON:0016843.name: lateral nucleus of trapezoid body
UBERON:0016843.def: one of two potential parts of the trapezoid nucleus. separated by an indistinct boundary, the other is the medial trapezoid nucleus ( crosby-1962 ). the existence of the trapezoid nucleus in the human is disputed ( bazwinsky-2003 ).

UBERON:0016848.name: retroambiguus nucleus
UBERON:0016848.def: the term retroambiguus nucleus refers to a group of neurons in the medulla at the caudal end of the nucleus ambiguus, from which the cranial part of the accessory nerve originates ( crosby-1962 ).

UBERON:0016849.name: obsolete subparabrachial nucleus
UBERON:0016849.def: a cell group located ventral to the brachium conjunctivum in the general area where the medial and lateral parabrachial nuclei abut, shifting to the slightly more lateral position rostrally.

UBERON:0016850.name: nucleus of phrenic nerve
UBERON:0016850.def: neuron cell bodies located in the more medial portions of the anterior horn at cervical levels c3-c7 that innervate the diaphragm via the phrenic nerve.
UBERON:0016850.synonym: phrenic nucleus of anterior column of spinal cord

UBERON:0016851.name: renal fascia
UBERON:0016851.def: a fascial pouch derived from extraperitoneal connective tissue that contains the kidneys, the suprarenal glands, the renal vessels and perirenal fat.

UBERON:0016852.name: skin scent gland
UBERON:0016852.def: a scent gland that is part of the skin.

UBERON:0016853.name: interdigital gland
UBERON:0016853.def: a skin gland found in the interdigital region of some mammals.

UBERON:0016854.name: dorsal part of optic cup
UBERON:0016854.def: the dorsal region of the optic cup that gives rise to the dorsal part of the retina.

UBERON:0016855.name: ventral part of optic cup
UBERON:0016855.def: the ventral region of the optic cup that gives rise to the ventral part of the retina.

UBERON:0016856.name: digit 6
UBERON:0016856.def: a digit that is part of a digit 6 plus metapodial segment.

UBERON:0016857.name: digit 7
UBERON:0016857.def: a digit that is part of a digit 7 plus metapodial segment.

UBERON:0016858.name: digit 8
UBERON:0016858.def: a digit that is part of a digit 8 plus metapodial segment.

UBERON:0016866.name: digit 6 plus metapodial segment
UBERON:0016866.def: a subdivision of the autopod consisting of digit 6 plus the region incorporating a single metapodial element. these segments are typically repeated along the pre-axiom to post-axial axis.

UBERON:0016867.name: digit 7 plus metapodial segment
UBERON:0016867.def: a subdivision of the autopod consisting of digit 7 plus the region incorporating a single metapodial element. these segments are typically repeated along the pre-axiom to post-axial axis.

UBERON:0016868.name: digit 8 plus metapodial segment
UBERON:0016868.def: a subdivision of the autopod consisting of digit 8 plus the region incorporating a single metapodial element. these segments are typically repeated along the pre-axiom to post-axial axis.

UBERON:0016876.name: digit 6 digitopodial skeleton
UBERON:0016876.def: a subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of digit 6 plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:0016877.name: digit 7 digitopodial skeleton
UBERON:0016877.def: a subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of digit 7 plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:0016878.name: digit 8 digitopodial skeleton
UBERON:0016878.def: a subdivision of the skeleton of the autopod consisting of the phalanges of digit 8 plus the associated metapodial element.

UBERON:0016879.name: future central nervous system
UBERON:0016879.def: primordium that develops into the central nervous system.

UBERON:0016880.name: future nervous system
UBERON:0016880.def: primordium that develops into the nervous system.

UBERON:0016881.name: craniopharyngeal canal
UBERON:0016881.def: the craniopharyngeal canal, is an anatomical feature sometimes found in the sphenoid bone opening to the sella turcica. it is a canal (a passage or channel) sometimes found extending from the anterior part of the fossa hypophyseos of the sphenoid bone to the under surface of the skull, and marks the original position of rathke's pouch; while at the junction of the septum of the nose with the palate traces of the stomodeal end are occasionally present.

UBERON:0016882.name: intertarsal-type crurotarsal joint
UBERON:0016882.def: an ankle joint that passes between the astragalus and calcaneum.

UBERON:0016883.name: ovarian fossa
UBERON:0016883.def: a shallow depression on the lateral wall of the pelvis, wherein the ovary lies. this fossa has the following boundaries: superiorly: by the external iliac vessels anteriorly and inferiorly: by the broad ligament of the uterus posteriorly: by the ureter and internal iliac vessels.

UBERON:0016884.name: shoulder joint
UBERON:0016884.def: the joint that is formed by the union of the humerus, the scapula (or shoulder blade), and the clavicle (or collarbone). commonly thought of as a single joint, the shoulder is actually made up of two separate joints - the glenohumeral and acromioclavicular joints.

UBERON:0016885.name: epithelium of terminal part of digestive tract
UBERON:0016885.def: epithelium lining the distalmost portion of the digestive tract.

UBERON:0016886.name: muscle tissue of terminal part of digestive tract
UBERON:0016886.def: any muscle tissue of the distalmost portion of the digestive tract.

UBERON:0016887.name: entire extraembryonic component
UBERON:0016887.def: the part of the conceptus that may be lost before birth or will be discarded at birth, or when the embryo becomes an independent organism.

UBERON:0016888.name: transitional anatomical structure
UBERON:0016888.def: an embryonic anatomical entity that will turn into one or more other anatomical entities, perhaps with other anatomical entities, later in development.

UBERON:0016896.name: periosteum of long bone
UBERON:0016896.def: a periosteum that is part of a long bone.

UBERON:0016912.name: frenulum of upper lip
UBERON:0016912.def: a frenulum of lip that is part of a upper lip.

UBERON:0016913.name: frenulum of lower lip
UBERON:0016913.def: a frenulum of lip that is part of a lower lip.

UBERON:0016915.name: vermilion
UBERON:0016915.def: the zone of the skin that surrounds a lip and is colored red due to thin epithelium and presence of eleidin.

UBERON:0016918.name: upper vermilion
UBERON:0016918.def: a vermilion that is part of a upper lip.

UBERON:0016919.name: lower vermilion
UBERON:0016919.def: a vermilion that is part of a lower lip.

UBERON:0016920.name: descending trunk of arch of aorta

UBERON:0016923.name: preductal region of aortic arch
UBERON:0016923.def: area of aorta proximal to the ductus arteriosus.

UBERON:0016924.name: postductal region of aortic arch
UBERON:0016924.def: area of aorta distal to the ductus arteriosus.

UBERON:0016925.name: juxtaductal region of aortic arch
UBERON:0016925.def: area of aorta at the area of insertion to the ductus arteriosus.

UBERON:0016926.name: mucus body coating
UBERON:0016926.def: a coating of mucus that is produced by the skin and covers all or most of the body of an animal.

UBERON:0016927.name: mucus cocoon
UBERON:0016927.def: a mucous covering produced nocturnally by some fish that is used to envelope the whole animal.

UBERON:0016928.name: metaphysis of fibula
UBERON:0016928.def: a metaphysis that is part of a fibula.

UBERON:0016929.name: lingual cusp of tooth
UBERON:0016929.def: a medially (towards the tongue)) raised feature found on crown of a tooth.

UBERON:0016930.name: ridge of tooth
UBERON:0016930.def: a linear flat evelation on a tooth.

UBERON:0016931.name: transverse ridge of tooth
UBERON:0016931.def: triangular ridges facing each other and crossing at transverse angle, forming a transverse ridge on posterior teeth.
UBERON:0016931.synonym: transverse ridge of crown of tooth

UBERON:0016932.name: triangular ridge of tooth
UBERON:0016932.synonym: triangular ridge of crown of tooth

UBERON:0016933.name: oblique ridge of tooth
UBERON:0016933.synonym: oblique ridge of crown of tooth

UBERON:0017102.name: flexor cruris lateralis pars accessoria muscle
UBERON:0017102.synonym: pars accessoria of m. flexor cruris lateralis

UBERON:0017157.name: exoccipital-atlas joint
UBERON:0017157.def: a synovial joint that connects a vertebral bone 1 and connects a exoccipital bone.

UBERON:0017160.name: lumen of hemipenial sheath
UBERON:0017160.def: an anatomical space that is enclosed by a hemipenal sheath.

UBERON:0017161.name: hemipenial mucuous gland
UBERON:0017161.def: a gland within the hemipenial sheath that provides lubrication for the hemipenis.

UBERON:0017162.name: hemipenial holocrine gland
UBERON:0017162.def: a holocrine gland that is part of a hemipenis.

UBERON:0017163.name: skin bony tubercle
UBERON:0017163.def: a bony structure embedded in skin, roughly equivalent to osteoderms.

UBERON:0017164.name: dorsal cloacal gland
UBERON:0017164.def: cloacal gland in female salamanders that secrete into the dorsal walls of the cloaca, anterior and / or posterior to the spermathecae or near the spermathecal common tube.

UBERON:0017180.name: hemipenis keratinized epithelium
UBERON:0017180.def: a keratinized stratified squamous epithelium that is part of a hemipenis.

UBERON:0017249.name: incisive process of premaxilla
UBERON:0017249.def: a small protuberence on the lingual surface of the premaxilla, immediately posterior to the teeth.

UBERON:0017258.name: placentome of cotyledonary placenta
UBERON:0017258.def: an anatomical group consisting of a placental caruncle and a placental cotyldeon, a placental unit in some mammals such as ruminants.

UBERON:0017259.name: placental caruncle
UBERON:0017259.def: an oval or round thickening in the uterine mucosa resulting from proliferation of subepithelial connective tissue, in the maternal side of the placentome.

UBERON:0017261.name: intertarsal sesamoid
UBERON:0017261.def: a sesamoid element that is part of a tarsal skeleton.

UBERON:0017295.name: cingulum of tooth
UBERON:0017295.def: the portion of the teeth, occurring on the lingual or palatal aspects, that forms a convex protuberance at the cervical third of the anatomic crown. it represents the lingual or palatal developmental lobe of these teeth.

UBERON:0017612.name: cingulum of lower jaw molar
UBERON:0017612.def: a ridge that girdles the base of a lower molar tooth.

UBERON:0017613.name: cingulum of upper jaw molar
UBERON:0017613.def: a ridge that girdles the base of a upper molar tooth.

UBERON:0017615.name: vomerine dentition
UBERON:0017615.def: a set of teeth in which each tooth that attaches to a vomer.

UBERON:0017616.name: afferent spiracular artery
UBERON:0017616.def: a section of a pharyngeal arch artery that carries blood away from the spiracle.

UBERON:0017617.name: efferent spiracular artery
UBERON:0017617.def: a section of a pharyngeal arch artery that drains the spiracle.

UBERON:0017618.name: extensor pollicis brevis muscle
UBERON:0017618.def: the extensor pollicis brevis lies on the medial side of, and is closely connected with, the abductor pollicis longus.

UBERON:0017620.name: spine appendage of head
UBERON:0017620.def: a spine appendage that is part of a head.

UBERON:0017621.name: cephalic spine
UBERON:0017621.def: one of the spines, probably denticle derivatives, occurring singly or in pairs just behind the orbit on the cheek area in some fossil sharks. may have occurred only in males and may have served to hold the female during copulation, e.g. in the jurassic genera hybodus, asteracanthus and acrodus.

UBERON:0017623.name: prepelvic clasper
UBERON:0017623.def: a supplemental clasper in holocephali, in front of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:0017624.name: pseudoclasper
UBERON:0017624.def: one or more pairs of stiff ossified lobes or prongs found in the tip of the intromittent organ of bythitoidei.

UBERON:0017625.name: pterygopodial gland
UBERON:0017625.def: a gland of uncertain function at the base of the clasper in skates and rays, occupying the position of the siphon of other elasmobranchii.

UBERON:0017626.name: transverse folds of rectum
UBERON:0017626.def: houston's valves (or transverse folds of rectum) are semi-lunar transverse folds of the rectal wall that protrude into the anal canal. their use seems to be to support the weight of fecal matter, and prevent its urging toward the anus, which would produce a strong urge to defecate. although the term rectum means straight, these transverse folds overlap each other during the empty state of the intestine to such an extent that, as houston remarked, they require considerable maneuvering to conduct an instrument along the canal, as often occurs in sigmoidoscopy and colonoscopy. these folds are about 12 mm. in width and are composed of the circular muscle coat of the rectum. they are usually three in number; sometimes a fourth is found, and occasionally only two are present. one is situated near the commencement of the rectum, on the right side. a second extends inward from the left side of the tube, opposite the middle of the sacrum. a third, the largest and most constant, projects backward from the forepart of the rectum, opposite the fundus of the urinary bladder. when a fourth is present, it is situated nearly 2.5 cm above the anus on the left and posterior wall of the tube.

UBERON:0017627.name: rectal valve
UBERON:0017627.def: a thin diaphragm located in the posterior fifth of the intestine of some centrolophidae, e.g. seriolella punctata, schedophilus huttoni and psenes pellucidus, or in others a sphincter-like constriction, e.g. seriolella brama. a deep purple fluid was confined to the valve in s. punctata, but was found throughout the intestine in the other two species referred to. the fluid might be used to void a coloured cloud to distract or deter a predator.

UBERON:0017628.name: swim bladder gas gland
UBERON:0017628.def: a structure with numerous blood vessels (retia mirabilia) in the gas bladder that secretes gases from the blood.

UBERON:0017629.name: mormyromast organ
UBERON:0017629.def: an innervated group of cells in a round capsule at the end of a jelly-filled tube opening to the skin surface of gymnarchidae and mormyridae.

UBERON:0017632.name: pineal corpora arenacea
UBERON:0017632.def: a calcified structure of brain that is part of a pineal body.

UBERON:0017633.name: choroid plexus corpora arenacea
UBERON:0017633.def: a calcified structure of brain that is part of a choroid plexus.

UBERON:0017634.name: xenarthrale
UBERON:0017634.def: a supplementary intervertebral articulation found in xenarthrans characterized by two sets of zygapophyseal facets in the postdiaphragmatic vertebrae, one medial and one lateral to the met apophysis.

UBERON:0017637.name: marginal venous sinus
UBERON:0017637.def: a paired dural venous sinus at the rim of the foramen magnum.

UBERON:0017638.name: primitive marginal sinus
UBERON:0017638.def: the primitive marginal sinuses (pms) are embryonic sinuses forming the later superior sagittal sinus.

UBERON:0017639.name: sinus of von szily
UBERON:0017639.def: a circular gap in the iris near the pupil between the layers of the optic cup (von szily, 1902).

UBERON:0017641.name: meningeal branch of spinal nerve
UBERON:0017641.def: branch of spinal nerve that innervates the structures of the vertebral column.

UBERON:0017642.name: communicating branch of spinal nerve
UBERON:0017642.def: rami communicans (plural rami communicantes) is the term used for a nerve which connects two other nerves. when used without further definition, it almost always refers to a communicating branch between a spinal nerve and the sympathetic trunk. more specifically, it usually refers to one of the following: gray ramus communicans white ramus communicans.

UBERON:0017643.name: external thoracic vein
UBERON:0017643.def: extension of the long thoracic vein that collects blood from the mammary glands.

UBERON:0017646.name: internal mammary vein
UBERON:0017646.def: one of two veins running parallel to their corresponding internal mammary arteries that unite forming one vessel. these veins drain the chest wall into the innominate vein.

UBERON:0017647.name: prevertebral muscle of neck
UBERON:0017647.def: a prevertebral muscle that is part of a neck.

UBERON:0017648.name: ventral body wall
UBERON:0017648.def: the ventral part of the body wall.

UBERON:0017649.name: dorsal body wall
UBERON:0017649.def: the dorsal part of the body wall.

UBERON:0017650.name: developing mesenchymal structure
UBERON:0017650.def: a mesenchyme-derived anatomical entity undergoing a transtion to become another structure.

UBERON:0017651.name: salivary gland primordium
UBERON:0017651.def: a primordium that has the potential to develop into a saliva-secreting gland.

UBERON:0017652.name: intermaxillary gland (sensu osteolepiformes)
UBERON:0017652.def: a gland lodged in a fossa formed mainly of dermal bones, situated wholly in front of the nasal capsules of osteolepiformes.

UBERON:0017653.name: intermaxillary salivary gland
UBERON:0017653.def: a gland located at the pre-nasal area being divided anteriorly by the ascendent processes of the intermaxillary bone.

UBERON:0017654.name: buccal gland
UBERON:0017654.def: any of the small racemose mucous glands in the mucous membrane lining the cheeks.

UBERON:0017670.name: bony part of cervical vertebral arch
UBERON:0017670.def: a bony part of vertebral arch that is part of a cervical vertebral arch.
UBERON:0017670.synonym: bony part of arch of cervical vertebra

UBERON:0017671.name: bony part of vertebral arch of first sacral vertebra
UBERON:0017671.def: a bony part of vertebral arch that is part of a sacral vertebra 1.
UBERON:0017671.synonym: bony part of vertebral arch of first sacral segment

UBERON:0017672.name: abdominal viscera
UBERON:0017672.def: a viscus that is part of a abdomen.

UBERON:0017692.name: internal surface of cranial base
UBERON:0017692.def: internal (endosteal) surface of the base of skull.

UBERON:0017716.name: thenar eminence
UBERON:0017716.def: a raised fleshy area on the palm of the hand near the base of the thumb.

UBERON:0017717.name: hypothenar eminence
UBERON:0017717.def: hypothenar refers to a group of three muscles of the palm that control the motion of the little finger. the three muscles are: abductor digiti minimi flexor digiti minimi opponens digiti minimi.

UBERON:0017732.name: raphe of scrotum
UBERON:0017732.def: a ridge of tissue that extends along the midline of the scrotum.

UBERON:0017748.name: lower primary incisor tooth
UBERON:0017748.def: a primary incisor tooth that is part of a lower jaw region.

UBERON:0017749.name: withers
UBERON:0017749.def: the ridge between the shoulder blades of a four-legged mammal.

UBERON:0017750.name: proximal mesopodial endochondral element
UBERON:0017750.def: a mesopodial endochondral element that is in the most proximal part of the mesopodial skeleton, connected to the zeugopodial skeleton.

UBERON:0017751.name: proximal mesopodial cartilage element
UBERON:0017751.def: a proximal mesopodial endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0018099.name: distal mesopodial endochondral element
UBERON:0018099.def: an endochondral element in the distal portion of the mesopodial skeleton, between the central mesopodial skeleton and the metapodial skeleton.

UBERON:0018100.name: distal mesopodial cartilage element
UBERON:0018100.def: a distal mesopodial endochondral element that is composed primarily of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:0018101.name: distal mesopodial pre-cartilage condensation
UBERON:0018101.def: a distal mesopodial endochondral element that is composed primarily of a pre-cartilage condensation.

UBERON:0018102.name: distal mesopodial bone
UBERON:0018102.def: a distal mesopodial endochondral element that is composed primarily of a bone tissue.

UBERON:0018103.name: posterior fascicle of palatopharyngeus
UBERON:0018103.def: the thinner portion of the muscle of the palatopharyngeal arch, originating in the region of the midline where its fibers interdigitate with the contralateral partner, then passing posterior to the levator veli palatini muscle to join the longitudinal layer of pharyngeal musculature; acts as a sort of sphincter, reducing the caliber of the isthmus of fauces at the palatopharyngeal arch.

UBERON:0018104.name: parafoveal part of retina
UBERON:0018104.def: the intermediate belt surrounding the fovea centralis.

UBERON:0018105.name: perifoveal part of retina
UBERON:0018105.def: the outermost region surrounding the fovea centralis.

UBERON:0018107.name: foveola of retina
UBERON:0018107.def: a region of the fovea centralis that lies in the center of the fovea and contains only cone cells, and a cone-shaped zone of müller cells.

UBERON:0018108.name: superior auricular muscle
UBERON:0018108.def: the superior auricular muscle, the largest of the three auriculares muscles, is also thin and fan-shaped. its fibers arise from the galea aponeurotica, and converge to be inserted by a thin, flattened tendon into the upper part of the cranial surface of the auricula.

UBERON:0018109.name: anterior auricular muscle
UBERON:0018109.def: the anterior auricular muscle, the smallest of the three auriculares muscles, is thin and fan-shaped, and its fibers are pale and indistinct. it arises from the lateral edge of the galea aponeurotica, and its fibers converge to be inserted into a projection on the front of the helix.

UBERON:0018110.name: posterior auricular muscle
UBERON:0018110.def: the posterior auricular muscle consists of two or three fleshy fasciculi, which arise from the mastoid portion of the temporal bone by short aponeurotic fibers. they are inserted into the lower part of the cranial surface of the concha.

UBERON:0018111.name: muscle layer of rectum
UBERON:0018111.def: a muscle layer that is part of the rectum.

UBERON:0018112.name: rectum smooth muscle tissue
UBERON:0018112.def: any portion of smooth muscle tissue that is part of the rectum.

UBERON:0018113.name: left kidney interstitium
UBERON:0018113.def: a kidney interstitium that is part of a left kidney.

UBERON:0018114.name: right kidney interstitium
UBERON:0018114.def: a kidney interstitium that is part of a right kidney.

UBERON:0018115.name: left renal pelvis
UBERON:0018115.def: a renal pelvis that is part of a left ureter.

UBERON:0018116.name: right renal pelvis
UBERON:0018116.def: a renal pelvis that is part of a right ureter.

UBERON:0018117.name: left renal cortex interstitium
UBERON:0018117.def: a renal cortex interstitium that is part of a left kidney.
UBERON:0018117.synonym: cortical interstitial tissue of left kidney

UBERON:0018118.name: right renal cortex interstitium
UBERON:0018118.def: a renal cortex interstitium that is part of a right kidney.
UBERON:0018118.synonym: cortical interstitial tissue of right kidney

UBERON:0018119.name: left renal medulla interstitium
UBERON:0018119.def: a renal medulla interstitium that is part of a left kidney.
UBERON:0018119.synonym: medullary interstitial tissue of left kidney

UBERON:0018120.name: right renal medulla interstitium
UBERON:0018120.def: a renal medulla interstitium that is part of a right kidney.
UBERON:0018120.synonym: medullary interstitial tissue of right kidney

UBERON:0018131.name: periovarian fat pad
UBERON:0018131.def: the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the ovaries.

UBERON:0018132.name: tail fat pad
UBERON:0018132.def: encapsulated adipose tissue that is part of a tail.

UBERON:0018133.name: monotreme bill
UBERON:0018133.def: an elongated snout found in monotremes.

UBERON:0018134.name: rugal fold of scrotum
UBERON:0018134.def: a folded ridge of skin that is part of a scrotum superficial to the dartos muscle.

UBERON:0018136.name: maxillary fenestra
UBERON:0018136.def: a fenestra or hole which pierces the maxilla anterior to the antorbital fenestra.

UBERON:0018137.name: premaxillary fenestra
UBERON:0018137.def: a fenestra that is part of a premaxilla.

UBERON:0018140.name: mammary lobe
UBERON:0018140.def: a cluster of mammary gland lobules. in humans this is a distinct lobe and located in the breast region.

UBERON:0018141.name: anterior perforated substance
UBERON:0018141.def: regional part of telencephalon lying on the basal surface and bounded by the olfactory trigone rostrally, the diagonal band medially and caudally and the prepiriform cortex laterally. it is characterized by many perforations caused by small blood vessels entering the gray matter (meyer et al., j. comp. neurol 284: 405, 1989).

UBERON:0018142.name: caudal vertebra endochondral element
UBERON:0018142.def: any vertebra endochondral element that is part of the caudal region of the vertebral column (tail or coccyx).

UBERON:0018143.name: transverse process of cervical vertebra
UBERON:0018143.def: a transverse process that is part of a cervical vertebra.

UBERON:0018144.name: cervical rib
UBERON:0018144.def: a rib that is attached to a cervical vertebra.

UBERON:0018145.name: lumbar rib
UBERON:0018145.def: a rib that is attached to a lumbar vertebra.

UBERON:0018146.name: transverse process of lumbar vertebra
UBERON:0018146.def: a transverse process that is part of a lumbar vertebra.

UBERON:0018148.name: ampullary gland secretion
UBERON:0018148.def: a bodily secretion that produced_by a ampullary gland.

UBERON:0018149.name: angle of oral opening
UBERON:0018149.def: the lateral limit of each lateral part of the oral fissure.

UBERON:0018150.name: skin of lower lip
UBERON:0018150.def: a zone of skin that is part of a lower lip.

UBERON:0018151.name: skin of upper lip
UBERON:0018151.def: a zone of skin that is part of a upper lip.

UBERON:0018152.name: pars flaccida of tympanic membrane
UBERON:0018152.def: a small, triangular, flaccid portion of the tympanic membrane, or eardrum, lying above the malleolar folds, attached directly to the petrous bone at the notch of rivinus.

UBERON:0018154.name: ligament of middle ear
UBERON:0018154.def: a ligament that is part of a middle ear.

UBERON:0018155.name: posterior incudal ligament
UBERON:0018155.def: a fold of mucous membrane that runs from the fossa incudus to the incus.

UBERON:0018156.name: malleal ligament
UBERON:0018156.def: a skeletal ligament that attaches to the malleus.

UBERON:0018157.name: lateral malleal ligament
UBERON:0018157.def: a malleal ligament that extends from the bony margin of the notch of rivinus to the neck of the malleus.

UBERON:0018158.name: superior malleal ligament
UBERON:0018158.def: a malleal ligament that extends from the tempen tympani to the head of the malleus.

UBERON:0018159.name: anterior malleal ligament
UBERON:0018159.def: a malleal ligament that extends from the anterior tympanic wall to the anterior process of the malleus.

UBERON:0018161.name: annular ligament of stapes
UBERON:0018161.def: a ring of fibrous tissue that connects the base of the stapes to the oval window of the inner ear.

UBERON:0018226.name: pulmonary part of lymphatic system
UBERON:0018226.def: an organ system subdivision that is the part of the lymphoid system that includes the pulmonary lymphatic vessels.

UBERON:0018227.name: pulmonary lymphatic vessel
UBERON:0018227.def: a lymphatic vessel that is part of a lung.

UBERON:0018229.name: renin-angiotensin system
UBERON:0018229.def: a system consisting of renin, angiotensin-converting enzyme, and angiotensin ii. renin, an enzyme produced in the kidney, acts on angiotensinogen, an alpha-2 globulin produced by the liver, forming angiotensin i. the converting enzyme contained in the lung acts on angiotensin i in the plasma converting it to angiotensin ii, the most powerful directly pressor substance known. it causes contraction of the arteriolar smooth muscle and has other indirect actions mediated through the adrenal cortex.

UBERON:0018230.name: femoral canal
UBERON:0018230.def: the compartment of the femoral sheath that contains efferent lymphatic vessels and a lymph node embedded in a small amount of areolar tissue. it is conical in shape and is about 2 cm long. the femoral canal is bordered: anteriorly by the inguinal ligament posteriorly by the pectineal ligament medially by the lacunar ligament laterally by the femoral vein it contains the lymph nodes of cloquet or rosenmuller. it should not be confused with the nearby adductor canal.

UBERON:0018231.name: labyrinthine artery
UBERON:0018231.def: a long slender branch of the anterior inferior cerebellar artery (85%-100% cases) or basilar artery (<15% cases), arises from near the middle of the artery; it accompanies the vestibulocochlear nerve through the internal acoustic meatus, and is distributed to the internal ear.

UBERON:0018232.name: axillary sweat gland
UBERON:0018232.def: a sweat gland that is part of a axilla.

UBERON:0018233.name: gland of zeis
UBERON:0018233.def: glands of zeis are unilobar sebaceous glands located on the margin of the eyelid. the glands of zeis service the eyelash. these glands produce an oily substance that is issued through the excretory ducts of the sebaceous lobule into the middle portion of the hair follicle.

UBERON:0018234.name: stroma of pancreas
UBERON:0018234.def: a stroma that is part of a pancreas.

UBERON:0018235.name: capsule of pancreas
UBERON:0018235.def: a capsule that divides the parenchyma of the pancreas into lobes and lobules.

UBERON:0018236.name: nucleus of bischoff
UBERON:0018236.def: a midline nucleus of the dorsal motor column found in animals with a prominent tail, including alligator, some birds, kangaroo, rat, shrew, great anteater.

UBERON:0018237.name: dorsal column-medial lemniscus pathway
UBERON:0018237.def: a sensory tract originating in the spinal cord responsible for transmitting fine touch, vibration and conscious proprioceptive information from the body to the cerebral cortex. the components include the fasciculus gracilis and fasciculus cuneatus.

UBERON:0018238.name: dorsal column nucleus
UBERON:0018238.def: a nucleus that contain secondary neurons of the dorsal column-medial lemniscus pathway, which carries fine touch and proprioceptive information from the body to the brain. examples: gracile nucleus, cuneat nucleus, nucleus of bishoff.

UBERON:0018240.name: panniculus carnosus muscle
UBERON:0018240.def: the skeletal muscle layer in the superficial fascia deep to the panniculus adiposus.

UBERON:0018241.name: prime adult stage
UBERON:0018241.def: a life cycle stage that starts at completion of development and growth of the sexually mature adult animal, and ends before senescence.

UBERON:0018242.name: palatine bone horizontal plate
UBERON:0018242.def: the part of the palatine bone that forms the posterior part (approximately one third) of the bony palate.(stedmans).

UBERON:0018243.name: thymic artery
UBERON:0018243.def: a vein that supplies blood to the thymus.
UBERON:0018243.synonym: thymic branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0018244.name: superficial cervical thymus
UBERON:0018244.def: a cervical thymus that is located directly beneath the skin.

UBERON:0018245.name: deep cervical thymus
UBERON:0018245.def: a cervical thymus that is located deep in the ventral cervical region, superficial to hyoid, sternomastoid, and depressor neck muscles.

UBERON:0018246.name: thyroid vein
UBERON:0018246.def: a vein that drains a thyroid gland.

UBERON:0018247.name: cervical thymic artery
UBERON:0018247.def: an artery that supplies a cervical thymus.

UBERON:0018251.name: meningeal vein
UBERON:0018251.def: one of the veins draining a meninix.

UBERON:0018252.name: internal pudendal vein
UBERON:0018252.def: accompanying vein of internal pudendal artery.

UBERON:0018253.name: external pudendal vein
UBERON:0018253.def: one of the veins of the pelvis which drain into the great saphenous vein.

UBERON:0018255.name: jejunal artery
UBERON:0018255.def: a branch of the superior mesenteric artery that supplies the jejunum.
UBERON:0018255.synonym: jejunal branch of superior mesenteric artery

UBERON:0018256.name: lacrimal vein
UBERON:0018256.def: a vein that drains a lacrimal gland.

UBERON:0018257.name: submucosa of digestive tract
UBERON:0018257.def: any portion of submucosa that lines the digestive tract.

UBERON:0018260.name: layer of muscle tissue
UBERON:0018260.def: any organ component layer that consists of muscle tissue.

UBERON:0018261.name: muscular coat of digestive tract
UBERON:0018261.def: a muscular coat that is part of a digestive tract.

UBERON:0018262.name: dorsal zone of medial entorhinal cortex
UBERON:0018262.synonym: entorhinal area, medial part, dorsal zone, layers 1-6

UBERON:0018263.name: ventral zone of medial entorhinal cortex
UBERON:0018263.synonym: ventral zone of the medial part of the entorhinal area

UBERON:0018264.name: dorsal lateral ganglionic eminence
UBERON:0018264.def: the dorsal region of the lateral ganglionic eminence. the cells in this area give rise to embryonic interneuron precursors that will migrate tangentially to the olfactory bulb.

UBERON:0018265.name: anterior root of zygomatic arch
UBERON:0018265.def: the anterior or rostral end of the zygomatic arch, which includes the temporal process of the zygomatic bone, but also including some of the body of the zygomatic bone. it may also include the zygomatico-temporal suture and the most rostral portion of the zygomatic process of the temporal bone.

UBERON:0018266.name: third phalanx
UBERON:0018266.def: the third phalangeal bone in a digit ray.

UBERON:0018267.name: atlantal spinal nerve foramen
UBERON:0018267.def: foramen housing the root of the spinal nerve seen in the neural arch of the first vertebrae (atlas). (see edwards 1976).

UBERON:0018268.name: type 1 adrenal tissue
UBERON:0018268.def: adrenal tissue dispersed in clusters, found in periphery and center of adrenal gland in turtles (yadav, 2008).

UBERON:0018269.name: type 2 adrenal tissue
UBERON:0018269.def: adrenal tissue aggregated in a dorsal layer covering internal cords, found in lepidosaur adrenal glands. islets of adrenal tissue found on ventral surface of gland (barely present in squamates). see yadav, 2008.

UBERON:0018270.name: type 3 adrenal tissue
UBERON:0018270.def: adrenal tissue found in archosaurs - tissue arranged in bands, alternating with interrenal cords (yadav, 2008).

UBERON:0018271.name: type 4 adrenal tissue
UBERON:0018271.def: in mammals, adrenal tissue has a cortex and medulla creating a composite adrenal gland (kardong 2012).

UBERON:0018272.name: apex of paracone
UBERON:0018272.def: the highest elevation of the paracone on a molariform tooth.

UBERON:0018273.name: caniniform region
UBERON:0018273.def: the anterior region of the maxillary tooth row, if that tooth row contains teeth that are substantially over the premaxillary teeth (see laurin and reisz 1995).

UBERON:0018274.name: postcingulum of deciduous premolar 5
UBERON:0018274.def: a postcingulum found on deciduous premolar 5.

UBERON:0018275.name: posthypocrista of deciduous premolar 5
UBERON:0018275.def: a posthypocrista found on deciduous premolar 5.

UBERON:0018276.name: egg tooth
UBERON:0018276.def: a protuberence or true tooth that is used during hatching to break the eggshell.

UBERON:0018277.name: calcareous egg tooth
UBERON:0018277.def: tooth used to break the eggshell, that is shed soon after hatching. in lepidosaurs, a true tooth that is shed soon after hatching.

UBERON:0018278.name: epidermal egg tooth
UBERON:0018278.def: epidermal outgrowth that facilitates breaking of the eggshell in archosaurs and monotremes.

UBERON:0018279.name: hypoconid
UBERON:0018279.def: the labial most of three cusps on the talonoid (posterior) end of lower molariform teeth. (modified from http://animaldiversity.ummz.umich.edu/collections/mammal_anatomy/cheek_teeth_structure/).

UBERON:0018281.name: lower deciduous premolar 5
UBERON:0018281.def: fifth premolar (counting anteroposteriorly ) in the lower jaw.

UBERON:0018282.name: lower molar 3
UBERON:0018282.def: third molar (counting anteroposteriorly) in the lower jaw.

UBERON:0018283.name: lower pharyngobranchial toothplate
UBERON:0018283.def: pharyngeal toothplate of the lower jaw region; typically associated with ceratobranchial 5 element.

UBERON:0018284.name: lower premolar 1
UBERON:0018284.def: first premolar (counting anteroposteriorly ) in the lower jaw.

UBERON:0018285.name: lower premolar 2
UBERON:0018285.def: second premolar (counting anteroposteriorly ) in the lower jaw.

UBERON:0018286.name: molar 1 posteroloph
UBERON:0018286.def: posteroloph found on the first molar tooth.

UBERON:0018287.name: premolar 1 hypoconoid
UBERON:0018287.def: hypoconid found on the first premolar tooth.

UBERON:0018288.name: paracone
UBERON:0018288.def: the anterior cusp along the labial margin seen in the molar or premolar teeth of mammals. (modified from http://animaldiversity.ummz.umich.edu/collections/mammal_anatomy/cheek_teeth_structure/).

UBERON:0018289.name: paracristid
UBERON:0018289.def: a crest running along the labial margin of molarifomr teeth of mammals. (modified from http://animaldiversity.ummz.umich.edu/collections/mammal_anatomy/cheek_teeth_structure/).

UBERON:0018290.name: postcingulum
UBERON:0018290.def: a shelf like ridge on the posterior (distal) outside edge of the upper molariform teeth. (modified from http://animaldiversity.ummz.umich.edu/collections/mammal_anatomy/cheek_teeth_structure/).

UBERON:0018291.name: posteroloph
UBERON:0018291.def: a shelf like ridge on the outside of the upper molariform teeth. (modified from http://animaldiversity.ummz.umich.edu/collections/mammal_anatomy/cheek_teeth_structure/).

UBERON:0018292.name: posthypocrista
UBERON:0018292.def: a crest on the hypoconid of molariform teeth. (modified from http://animaldiversity.ummz.umich.edu/collections/mammal_anatomy/cheek_teeth_structure/).

UBERON:0018293.name: precingulum
UBERON:0018293.def: a shelf like ridge on the proximal (mesial) outside edge of the upper molariform teeth. (modified from http://animaldiversity.ummz.umich.edu/collections/mammal_anatomy/cheek_teeth_structure/).

UBERON:0018294.name: premolar 1
UBERON:0018294.def: first premolar (counting anteroposteriorly) in the jaw.

UBERON:0018295.name: preprotocrista
UBERON:0018295.def: an enamel ridge joining the protocone and the paracone on the occlusal surface of a maxillary molar.

UBERON:0018296.name: replacement tooth
UBERON:0018296.def: tooth (often obscured from view) in a 'waiting' position that will replace an existing tooth (i.e. a tooth that is well visible in the jaw).

UBERON:0018297.name: resorption pit
UBERON:0018297.def: a pit formed in an existing functional tooth, causing resorption of the surrounding dentine and periodontal tissues. (modified from leblanc and reisz 2013, see figures 8, 10 for more details).

UBERON:0018298.name: stylocone
UBERON:0018298.def: cusp found on a platform that is buccaal and mesial to the meta and paracones. modified from kermack 1967. molar evolution in mesozoic mammals.

UBERON:0018299.name: mandibular symphyseal tooth
UBERON:0018299.def: tooth of the lower jaw that is adjacent to the mandibular symphysis.

UBERON:0018300.name: upper canine 1
UBERON:0018300.def: first canine (counting anteroposteriorly) in the upper jaw.

UBERON:0018301.name: upper deciduous premolar 5
UBERON:0018301.def: fifth premolar (counting anteroposteriorly ) in the upper jaw.

UBERON:0018302.name: upper molar 1
UBERON:0018302.def: first molar (counting anteroposteriorly) in the upper jaw.

UBERON:0018303.name: adrenal tissue
UBERON:0018303.def: tissue that is part of some adrenal gland.

UBERON:0018304.name: post-axial region of pectoral appendage
UBERON:0018304.def: anatomical region lying to the posteiror or ventral side of the metapterygial axis.

UBERON:0018305.name: bicipital surface
UBERON:0018305.def: region of the humerus associated with the biceps attachment areas.

UBERON:0018306.name: obsolete bulge
UBERON:0018306.def: obsolete expanded and swollen region of a surface that is otherwise relatively flat

UBERON:0018307.name: keel
UBERON:0018307.def: ridge shaped projection, similar to the keel of a boat.

UBERON:0018308.name: caudal melanophore spot
UBERON:0018308.def: distinct colored area on the caudal region of an organism, similar in shape to a spot, i.e. circular.

UBERON:0018309.name: central figure of scute
UBERON:0018309.def: anatomical structure consisting of a pattern of ridges on an osteoderm.

UBERON:0018310.name: cephalic dermal scale
UBERON:0018310.def: a dermal scale that is found in the head region.

UBERON:0018311.name: obsolete cervical rib
UBERON:0018311.def: rib attached to the cervical vertebrae.

UBERON:0018312.name: cheek scale
UBERON:0018312.def: a scale part of the cheek scale row.

UBERON:0018313.name: cheek scale row
UBERON:0018313.def: a row of scales foudn in the cheek region of the head of an organism.

UBERON:0018314.name: choanal groove
UBERON:0018314.def: grooves on the palatine bone which denote the passage of the choana or internal naris.

UBERON:0018315.name: clasper plate
UBERON:0018315.def: pelvic clasper organs that have been modified into a flattened structure.

UBERON:0018316.name: cuboid facet of calcaneum
UBERON:0018316.def: facet on the anterior surface of the calcaneus (as called calcaneum) for the articulation of the cuboid bone.

UBERON:0018317.name: dorsal osteoderm
UBERON:0018317.def: osteoderm found on the dorsal surface of an organisms.

UBERON:0018318.name: entocarotid fossa
UBERON:0018318.def: a depression on the lateral surface of the braincase posterior to the vidian canal (conrad 2008).

UBERON:0018319.name: extramural oviduct
UBERON:0018319.def: section of the oviduct external to the uterine wall.

UBERON:0018320.name: flexor sesamoid
UBERON:0018320.def: a sesamoid bone located near or in the flexor musculature of a joint.

UBERON:0018321.name: foramen for glossopharyngeal nerve
UBERON:0018321.def: foramen that allows the passge of the glossopharyngeal nerve (cranial nerve ix).

UBERON:0018322.name: fourth phalanx
UBERON:0018322.def: fourth most proximal phalanx in manual or pedal digits.

UBERON:0018323.name: hyoid articular area
UBERON:0018323.def: area on the otic capsule for the articulation of the hyoid.

UBERON:0018324.name: hypochordal radial
UBERON:0018324.def: caudal fin radial element located ventral to the notochord.

UBERON:0018325.name: caudal fin radial element
UBERON:0018325.def: radial element that is part of the caudal fin.

UBERON:0018326.name: ilioischiadic foramen
UBERON:0018326.def: situated just caudal to the acetabulum, the foramen is bound dorsally by the illium and ventrally by the ischium. the foramen transmitts the ischiadic nerves and vessels (baumel et al. 1993).

UBERON:0018328.name: incisura fossa
UBERON:0018328.def: the condyloid fossa on the cranial aspect of the atlas my be perforated (foramen fossa) or have an open dorsal notch (incisura fossa) in which the apex of the dens rides. (from baumel et al. 1993).

UBERON:0018329.name: interpterygoid region
UBERON:0018329.def: the region on the palate corresponding to the location of the pterygoid bone, if present and between the palatine bones and the parasphenoid if not.

UBERON:0018330.name: interpterygoid vacuity
UBERON:0018330.def: open space between on the palate between the pteryogoid bone and the parasphenoid.

UBERON:0018331.name: intraramal joint
UBERON:0018331.def: a joint in the lower jaw that enhances kinesis and for swallowing prey. allows enhanced mobility and intraramal bending to increase gape.

UBERON:0018332.name: jugal bar
UBERON:0018332.def: elongate bar consisting of fused quadratojugal and jugal and connecting the maxilla to the quadrate.

UBERON:0018333.name: labial cartilage
UBERON:0018333.def: distinct cartilage around the jaws of elasmobranchs.

UBERON:0018334.name: lateral condyle of quadrate
UBERON:0018334.def: condyle on the lateral side of the quadrate.

UBERON:0018335.name: lateral dorsal aorta canal
UBERON:0018335.def: one of the branches of the dorsal aorta, after it enters the aortic canal.

UBERON:0018336.name: maxillary shank
UBERON:0018336.def: the triangular shaped posterior fold at the angle of the mouth. from chakrabarty 2006.

UBERON:0018337.name: medial condyle of quadrate
UBERON:0018337.def: the medialmost condyle on the distal region of the quadrate, in contact with the pterygoid.

UBERON:0018338.name: medial cotyla
UBERON:0018338.def: the medialmost of the cotyla of the lower jaw, for articulation with the cranium.

UBERON:0018339.name: metotic fissure
UBERON:0018339.def: an embryonic fissure between the otic capsule and the arches which develop into the occipital bones. the fissure may persist into adulthood. it is also referred to as the 'lateral otic fissure' the metotic fissure opens into the vestibular fontanelle, if the fontanelle is present. (johanson et al. (2003)). otherwise it opens to the metotic foramen.

UBERON:0018340.name: midbody melanophore spot
UBERON:0018340.def: distinct colored area on the midbody region of an organism, similar in shape to a spot, i.e. circular.

UBERON:0018341.name: nasal process of premaxilla
UBERON:0018341.def: a bony projection of the premaxilla that extends cadually and separates the nasal bones.

UBERON:0018342.name: nuchal hump
UBERON:0018342.def: dorsal swelling on the head. found in cichlid fish. often only in males and during breeding season, but not exclusively so.

UBERON:0018343.name: oviduct mucosal fold
UBERON:0018343.def: the wall of the fallopian tube includes an elaborately folded mucosa (endosalpinx) surrounded by a muscularis (myosalpinx). the mucosa is lined by a ciliated columnar epithelium with secretory cells, and is folded out into the lumen so that an ovum in the lumen will always be close to the cilia for transport to the uterus.

UBERON:0018344.name: parastyle
UBERON:0018344.def: an anterior cusp on the stylar shelf of the tooth.

UBERON:0018345.name: stylar shelf
UBERON:0018345.def: the stylar shelf is an an expansion of the cingulum; it often bears small cusps (each with its own name...).

UBERON:0018346.name: parietal notch
UBERON:0018346.def: a pronounced notch or cavity in the lateral face of the parietal.

UBERON:0018349.name: pharyngeal apophysis
UBERON:0018349.def: ventral process on the neurocranium for the articulation of upper pharyngeal bones. it is variably composed of the parasphenoid, basioccipital, and prootic depending on the species. from: greenwood, ph (1978). a review of the pharyngeal hypophysis and its significance in the classification of african cichlid fishes. bull. br. mus. nat. hist. (zool.) 33: 297-323.

UBERON:0018351.name: precerebral fontanelle
UBERON:0018351.def: the lack of chondrification of the anterior wall of the cranial cavity in front of the pineal foramen.....(hanken and hall).

UBERON:0018352.name: prismatic cartilage
UBERON:0018352.def: cartilage arranged into tesserae, blocks of calcified cartilage that fit together as tiles on a floor form a mosaic. found only in chondrichthyans. reference: a. peter klimley. 2013. the biology of sharks and rays. university of chicago press.

UBERON:0018353.name: quadrate condyle
UBERON:0018353.def: the convex articular surface on the qudrate, part of the craniomandibular joint.

UBERON:0018354.name: recessus vena jugularis
UBERON:0018354.def: as defined here, this refers to a depression on the lateral surface of the braincase posterior to the vidian canal as opposed to the carotid fossa...(conrad 2008).

UBERON:0018355.name: rictal bristle
UBERON:0018355.def: rictal bristles project from the beak of many insect-eating birds, including flycatchers, nightjars and even the american robin. they are believed to provide protection for the bird's eyes as it consumes its wriggly prey. the bristles may also provide tactile feedback, like the whiskers on a dog or cat. from http://www.birds.cornell.edu/allaboutbirds/studying/feathers/feathers/document_view.

UBERON:0018356.name: rostral entotympanic element
UBERON:0018356.def: an entotympanic that arises in forward part of tympanic floor. it may be intimately fused wita cartilage of tube during development(macphee (1981: 62)) in contrast to a caudal entotympanic arising in the rear tympanic floor. from o'leary et al. 2012.

UBERON:0018358.name: spina externa
UBERON:0018358.def: a median bony point projecting from the anterior and ventral margin of the sternum of a bird. from http://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/spina%20externa.

UBERON:0018359.name: subolfactory process
UBERON:0018359.def: the ventral portion of the frontals which forms part of the lateral wall of the braincase. modified from lee and caldwell 1998.

UBERON:0018360.name: suborbital foramen
UBERON:0018360.def: foramen located below the orbit and forming a passageway for nerves (eg fifth cranial nerve).

UBERON:0018361.name: suborbital shelf
UBERON:0018361.def: on the neurocranium, a horizontal plate arising on the ventral junction of the orbital wall and basal plate on each side which extends from the nasal capsule to the otic capsule; it forms the floor of the orbit.

UBERON:0018362.name: supracondylar tubercle
UBERON:0018362.def: anatomical projection on the distal region of the femur or humerus and close to the condyles.

UBERON:0018363.name: obsolete supracoracoid nerve foramen
UBERON:0018363.def: opening for the supracoracoid nerve in the supracoracoid.

UBERON:0018364.name: suprameatal foramen
UBERON:0018364.def: foramen in the temporal bone, adjacent to the base of the zygomatic process.

UBERON:0018366.name: supratendinal bridge
UBERON:0018366.def: ossified bridge over a tendon; particularly, the bridge over the extensor canal at the distal end of the tibiotarsus of certain birds. the presence of the bridge and the position of the canal opening relative to the condyles may have phylogenetic significance. ericson (1997). http://palaeos.com/vertebrates/glossary/glossarysq.html.

UBERON:0018367.name: processus ventralis of thoracic vertebra
UBERON:0018367.def: the crest is present on the ventral side of the bodies of the thoracic vertebra (modified from baumel et al. 1993).

UBERON:0018368.name: processus ventrolateralis of thoracic vertebra
UBERON:0018368.def: ventrolaerally oriented, paired projections atttached to the ventrolateral border of the body of certain thoracic vertebra; the ventrolateral crest flank the crista ventralis on each side. from baumel et al. 1993.

UBERON:0018369.name: upper lateral line
UBERON:0018369.def: dorsal sensory canal line in fish, dorsal to ventral lateral lane.

UBERON:0018370.name: ventral lateral line
UBERON:0018370.def: ventral sensory canal line in fish, ventral to dorsal lateral lane.

UBERON:0018371.name: ventral supracondylar tubercle
UBERON:0018371.def: tubercle on the distal humerus for the origin of the lig. collaterale ventral of the elbow joint. modified from baumel et al. 1993.

UBERON:0018372.name: dorsal supracondylar tubercle
UBERON:0018372.def: tubercle on the dorsal border of the distal humerus, a short distance from the dorsal epicondyle, for the origin of the m extensor carpe radialis modifeid from baumel et al. 1993.

UBERON:0018374.name: sallet
UBERON:0018374.def: a unit of the tectoral membrane that is shaped like string of flat, pearls. modified from manley, fey and popper 2008 .

UBERON:0018376.name: molar tooth 1
UBERON:0018376.def: the molar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 1.

UBERON:0018377.name: molar tooth 3
UBERON:0018377.def: the molar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 3.

UBERON:0018378.name: crustacean larval stage
UBERON:0018378.def: the larval stage of a crustacean, the stages of which are separated my moults. typically this goes through a nauplius - zoea - post-larval cycle.

UBERON:0018379.name: metacestode
UBERON:0018379.def: the larval (metacestode) stage of the tapeworm echinococcus multilocularis.

UBERON:0018382.name: second instar larva
UBERON:0018382.def: instar: a stage in the life of an arthropod (as an insect) between two successive molts.

UBERON:0018385.name: metacercaria
UBERON:0018385.def: a tailless encysted late larva of a trematode parasite that is usually the form which is infective for the definitive host.

UBERON:0018387.name: obsolete cestode
UBERON:0018387.def: obsolete any of a class (cestoda) of bilaterally symmetrical flatworms parasitic especially in the intestines of vertebrates.

UBERON:0018388.name: cercaria
UBERON:0018388.def: a usually tadpole-shaped larval trematode worm that develops in a molluscan host from a redia.

UBERON:0018389.name: interoceptor
UBERON:0018389.def: a sensory receptor that detects stimulus within the body. examples of stimuli that would be detected by interoceptors include blood pressure and blood oxygen level.

UBERON:0018391.name: chemoreceptor
UBERON:0018391.def: a sensory receptor that detects chemical stimulus within the body.

UBERON:0018392.name: arterial baroreceptor
UBERON:0018392.def: arterial baroreceptors are stretch receptors that are stimulated by distortion of the arterial wall when pressure changes.

UBERON:0018393.name: low-pressure baroreceptor
UBERON:0018393.def: found in large systemic veins, in pulmonary vessels, and in the walls of the right atrium and ventricles of the heart (the atrial volume receptors).

UBERON:0018394.name: vein baroreceptor
UBERON:0018394.def: a baroreceptor that located_in a vein.

UBERON:0018395.name: cardiac baroreceptor
UBERON:0018395.def: a baroreceptor that located_in a heart.

UBERON:0018396.name: pulmonary baroreceptor
UBERON:0018396.def: a baroreceptor that located_in a pulmonary vascular system.

UBERON:0018397.name: posterior superior alveolar artery
UBERON:0018397.def: the posterior superior alveolar artery (posterior dental artery) is given off from the maxillary, frequently in conjunction with the infraorbital just as the trunk of the vessel is passing into the pterygopalatine fossa.

UBERON:0018401.name: posterior superior alveolar nerve
UBERON:0018401.def: the posterior superior alveolar branches (posterior superior dental branches) arise from the trunk of the maxillary nerve just before it enters the infraorbital groove; they are generally two in number, but sometimes arise by a single trunk. they descend on the tuberosity of the maxilla and give off several twigs to the gums and neighboring parts of the mucous membrane of the cheek. they then enter the posterior alveolar canals on the infratemporal surface of the maxilla, and, passing from behind forward in the substance of the bone, communicate with the middle superior alveolar nerve, and give off branches to the lining membrane of the maxillary sinus and gingival and dental branches to each molar tooth from a superior dental plexus; these branches enter the apical foramina at the roots of the teeth. the posterior superior alveolar nerve innervates the second and third maxillary molars, and two of the three roots of the maxillary first molar (all but the mesiobuccal root). when giving a posterior superior alveolar nerve block, it will anesthetize the mesialbuccal root of the maxillary first molar approximately 72% of the time.

UBERON:0018406.name: mental nerve
UBERON:0018406.def: mental nerve is a general somatic afferent (sensory) nerve which provides sensation to the anterior aspects of the chin and lower lip as well as the buccal gingivae of the mandibular anterior teeth and the premolars. it is a branch of the posterior trunk of the inferior alveolar nerve, which is itself a branch of the mandibular division of the trigeminal nerve (cn v). the nerve emerges at the mental foramen in the mandibula, and divides beneath the depressor anguli oris muscle into three branches: one descends to the skin of the chin. two ascend to the skin and mucous membrane of the lower lip. these branches communicate freely with the facial nerve.

UBERON:0018407.name: infra-orbital foramen of maxilla
UBERON:0018407.def: a foramen on the exterior of the maxilla that is continuous with the infra-orbital canal and is the conduit for the passage of the infraorbital nerve and artery.

UBERON:0018408.name: infra-orbital nerve
UBERON:0018408.def: a branch of the maxillary nerve that enters the infraorbital canal and innervates the lower eyelid, upper lip, the nasal vestibule, the upper incisors, canines, premolars, upper gums, lower eyelid and conjunctiva, and part of the nose.

UBERON:0018409.name: infra-orbital groove of maxilla
UBERON:0018409.def: a groove on the interior of the maxilla that is continuous with the infra-orbital canal and is the conduit for the passage of the infraorbital nerve and artery.

UBERON:0018410.name: lacteal
UBERON:0018410.def: a lymphatic capillary that absorbs dietary fats in the villi of the small intestine.

UBERON:0018411.name: ligament of hip joint
UBERON:0018411.def: a skeletal ligament that is part of a hip joint.

UBERON:0018412.name: vidian nerve
UBERON:0018412.def: a nerve that is formed by the junction of the great petrosal nerve and the deep petrosal nerve and continues on to innervate the palate, nose and lacrimal gland.

UBERON:0018413.name: facial nerve canal
UBERON:0018413.def: a z-shaped canal running through the temporal bone from the internal acoustic meatus to the stylomastoid foramen. it is located within the middle ear region, according to its shape it is divided into three main segments: the labyrinthine, the tympanic, and the mastoidal segment .

UBERON:0018415.name: ethmoid foramen
UBERON:0018415.def: an bone foramen in the ethmoid bone.

UBERON:0018424.name: petrosal foramen
UBERON:0018424.def: a foramen of skull that is part of a petrosal bone.

UBERON:0018508.name: foramen of nasal bone
UBERON:0018508.def: a vascular foramen opening on the outer surface of a nasal bone.

UBERON:0018529.name: female inguinal ring
UBERON:0018529.def: an inguinal ring that is part of a female reproductive system.

UBERON:0018530.name: male inguinal ring
UBERON:0018530.def: an inguinal ring that is part of a male reproductive system.

UBERON:0018531.name: female superficial inguinal ring
UBERON:0018531.def: a deep inguinal ring that is part of a female reproductive system.

UBERON:0018532.name: female deep inguinal ring
UBERON:0018532.def: a deep inguinal ring that is part of a male reproductive system.

UBERON:0018533.name: crus of penis or clitoris
UBERON:0018533.def: the continuation of each corpus cavernosum of the penis or clitoris, diverging posteriorly to be attached to the pubic arch.

UBERON:0018535.name: forelimb feather
UBERON:0018535.def: a feather that is part of a forelimb.

UBERON:0018536.name: wing feather
UBERON:0018536.def: a feather that is part of a forelimb wing.

UBERON:0018537.name: tail feather
UBERON:0018537.def: a feather that is part of a tail.

UBERON:0018538.name: breast feather
UBERON:0018538.def: a feather that is part of a the upper ventral region of an animal's torso.

UBERON:0018539.name: dorsal feather
UBERON:0018539.def: a feather that is part of a the dorsal region of an animal's torso.

UBERON:0018540.name: breast feather tract
UBERON:0018540.def: a feather tract that is part of a the upper ventral region of an animal's torso.
UBERON:0018540.synonym: row of feathers on upper ventral region

UBERON:0018542.name: mandibular symphyseal region
UBERON:0018542.def: the region of the mandible on or near the midline (near the mandiblular symphysis).

UBERON:0018543.name: lumen of intestine
UBERON:0018543.def: the anatomical space within the intestine.

UBERON:0018544.name: trigeminal nerve muscle
UBERON:0018544.def: muscle innervated by the trigeminal nerve (cranial nerve v).
UBERON:0018544.synonym: muscles innervated by the trigeminal nerve

UBERON:0018545.name: nucleus of the bulbocavernosus
UBERON:0018545.def: a cluster of motoneurons located in the anterior gray column of lumbar segments 5 and 6 of the spinal cord in the rat. functionally it belongs to the somatic motoneuron pools of the subcortical motor system ( swanson-2004 ).

UBERON:0018549.name: ventral wall of dorsal aorta
UBERON:0018549.def: region where blood progenitor markers are expressed. probable site of definitive hematopoiesis between 36hpf and 4dpf.

UBERON:0018561.name: upper secondary canine tooth
UBERON:0018561.def: a secondary canine tooth that is part of a upper jaw region.

UBERON:0018562.name: lower secondary canine tooth
UBERON:0018562.def: a secondary canine tooth that is part of a lower jaw region.

UBERON:0018568.name: lower central secondary incisor tooth
UBERON:0018568.def: a lower jaw incisor that is in_the_central_side_of a dentition.

UBERON:0018570.name: lower lateral secondary incisor tooth
UBERON:0018570.def: a lower jaw incisor that is in_the_lateral_side_of a dentition.

UBERON:0018591.name: upper primary incisor tooth
UBERON:0018591.def: a primary incisor tooth that is part of a upper jaw region.

UBERON:0018593.name: upper central primary incisor tooth
UBERON:0018593.def: a upper primary canine tooth that is in_the_central_side_of a dentition.

UBERON:0018594.name: upper lateral primary incisor tooth
UBERON:0018594.def: a upper primary canine tooth that is in_the_lateral_side_of a dentition.

UBERON:0018595.name: lower central primary incisor tooth
UBERON:0018595.def: a lower primary incisor tooth that is in_the_central_side_of a dentition.

UBERON:0018596.name: lower lateral primary incisor tooth
UBERON:0018596.def: a lower primary incisor tooth that is in_the_lateral_side_of a dentition.

UBERON:0018597.name: upper primary canine tooth
UBERON:0018597.def: a primary canine tooth that is part of a upper jaw region.

UBERON:0018598.name: lower primary canine tooth
UBERON:0018598.def: a primary canine tooth that is part of a lower jaw region.

UBERON:0018601.name: lower central incisor tooth
UBERON:0018601.def: an incisor tooth that is in_the_central_side_of a dentition and is part of a lower jaw region.

UBERON:0018602.name: lower lateral incisor tooth
UBERON:0018602.def: an incisor tooth that is in_the_lateral_side_of a dentition and is part of a lower jaw region.

UBERON:0018603.name: upper central incisor tooth
UBERON:0018603.def: an incisor tooth that is in_the_central_side_of a dentition and is part of a upper jaw region.

UBERON:0018604.name: upper lateral incisor tooth
UBERON:0018604.def: an incisor tooth that is in_the_lateral_side_of a dentition and is part of a upper jaw region.

UBERON:0018606.name: molar tooth 2
UBERON:0018606.def: the molar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 2.

UBERON:0018645.name: incisor region of dentition
UBERON:0018645.def: the subdivision of the dentition that consists entire of incisor teeth.

UBERON:0018646.name: premolar tooth 5
UBERON:0018646.def: the premolar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 5.

UBERON:0018647.name: premolar tooth 4
UBERON:0018647.def: the premolar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 4.

UBERON:0018650.name: annelid peristomium
UBERON:0018650.def: the peristomium is the second body segment in an annelid worm's body in the anterior end. it is directly behind the prostomium and contains the mouth, tentacular cirri, and sometimes feeding palps, which may instead occur on the prostomium. if an eversible pharynx is present, it is contained in this segment as well, and can fill up to 20 segments when inverted, depending on the species.

UBERON:0018651.name: foramen lacerum
UBERON:0018651.def: a triangular hole in the base of the skull located at the base of the medial pterygoid plate.

UBERON:0018652.name: maxillary recess
UBERON:0018652.def: a hollow space in the skull of carnivores, which do not exhibit a maxillary sinus.

UBERON:0018653.name: anterior ethmoidal foramen
UBERON:0018653.def: the anterior ethmoidal foramen, situated about the middle of the lateral margin of the olfactory groove, transmits the anterior ethmoidal vessels and the anterior ethmoidal nerve; the nerve runs in a groove along the lateral edge of the cribriform plate to the slit-like opening above mentioned.

UBERON:0018654.name: posterior ethmoidal foramen
UBERON:0018654.def: the posterior ethmoidal foramen opens at the back part of this margin under cover of the projecting lamina of the sphenoid, and transmits the posterior ethmoidal vessels and nerve.

UBERON:0018655.name: pars endotympanica
UBERON:0018655.def: this is present in the cat and forms the large medial part of the bulla tympanica. it is not to be regarded as a part of the pars tympanica, which ossifies directly from connective tissue, whereas the pars endotympanica is preformed in cartilage. the septum bullae in the cat is formed by the pars tympanica as well as by the pars endotympanica(nomina anatomica veterinaria (2005)).

UBERON:0018656.name: puparium
UBERON:0018656.def: a chitin-based cuticular shell derived from the cuticle of the final larval instar that surrounds the pupal form of the organism.

UBERON:0018657.name: pupal case
UBERON:0018657.def: any acellular shell or covering that surrounds the pupal form of an insect.

UBERON:0018663.name: recessus basilaris
UBERON:0018663.def: an opening of the otic duct within the inner ear. the recessus basilaris can open to the saccule (in frogs) or the lagena (in salamanders and caecilians). the sensory epithelium of the recessus basilaris is the basilar papilla (or papilla basilaris). reference: lewis, e.r. and r.e. lombard. 1988. the amphibian inner ear. pp. 93-123 in fritszch, b., et al. (eds.), the evolution of the amphibian auditory system. wiley & sons. [curated by d. blackburn].

UBERON:0018664.name: neck of bone element
UBERON:0018664.def: the neck region of a bone organ.

UBERON:0018674.name: heart vasculature
UBERON:0018674.def: an interconnected tubular multi-tissue structure that contains fluid that is actively transported around the heart.

UBERON:0018675.name: pelvic splanchnic nerve
UBERON:0018675.def: a splanchnic nerves that arises from sacral spinal nerves s2, s3, s4 to provide parasympathetic innervation to the hindgut.

UBERON:0018676.name: renal nerve plexus
UBERON:0018676.def: the renal plexus is formed by filaments from the celiac plexus, the aorticorenal ganglion, and the aortic plexus . it is joined also by the least splanchnic nerve. the nerves from these sources, fifteen or twenty in number, have a few ganglia developed upon them. they accompany the branches of the renal artery into the kidney; some filaments are distributed to the spermatic plexus and, on the right side, to the inferior vena cava.

UBERON:0018679.name: thoracic splanchnic nerve
UBERON:0018679.def: thoracic splanchnic nerves are splanchnic nerves that arise from the sympathetic trunk in the thorax and travel inferiorly to provide sympathetic innervation to the abdomen. the nerves contain preganglionic sympathetic and general visceral afferent fibers.

UBERON:0018683.name: lumbar splanchnic nerve
UBERON:0018683.def: the lumbar splanchnic nerves are splanchnic nerves that arise from the lumbar part of the sympathetic trunk and travel to an adjacent plexus near the aorta. they are originated from l1 and l2. these nerves contain preganglionic sympathetic and visceral afferent fibers. the site of synapse is found in the prevertebral ganglia and innervate the smooth muscle and glands of the pelvic viscera and hindgut.

UBERON:0018684.name: sacral splanchnic nerve
UBERON:0018684.def: a splanchnic nerve that connects the inferior hypogastric plexus to the sympathetic trunk in the pelvis.

UBERON:0018685.name: nursing stage
UBERON:0018685.def: a mammalian developmental stage that covers the period from birth until weaning.

UBERON:0018687.name: glial limiting membrane
UBERON:0018687.def: the meshwork of astrocytic foot processes (glial end feet) covered by a basal lamina adjacent to the inner pial surface of the central nervous system.

UBERON:0018688.name: hindlimb feather
UBERON:0018688.def: a feather that is part of a hindlimb.

UBERON:0018689.name: crural feather
UBERON:0018689.def: a feather that is part of a hindlimb zeugopod.

UBERON:0018690.name: feather covering of ventral part of tail

UBERON:0018707.name: bladder organ
UBERON:0018707.def: a membranous sac in animals that serves as the receptacle of a liquid or contains gas.

UBERON:0019143.name: intramuscular adipose tissue
UBERON:0019143.def: adipose tissue which is located throughout skeletal muscle and is responsible for the marbling seen in certain cuts of beef. in humans, excess accumulation of intramuscular fat is associated with insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes.

UBERON:0019197.name: dorsal nerve of penis
UBERON:0019197.def: the deep terminal division of the pudendal nerve that runs along the dorsum of the penis and innervates the the corpus cavernosum penis, the prepuce and the glans penis.

UBERON:0019198.name: dorsal nerve of clitoris
UBERON:0019198.def: the deep terminal division of the pudendal nerve that runs along the dorsum of the clitoral shaft and innervates the the glans clitoris.

UBERON:0019200.name: skin of anterior chest
UBERON:0019200.def: zone of skin that is part of the anterior region of the chest.

UBERON:0019201.name: gemellus muscle
UBERON:0019201.def: one of the two small muscular fasciculi, accessories to the tendon of the obturator internus which is received into a groove between them.

UBERON:0019202.name: inferior gemellus muscle
UBERON:0019202.def: gemellus muscle that arises from the upper part of the tuberosity of the ischium, immediately below the groove for the obturator internus tendon. it blends with the lower part of the tendon of the obturator internus, and is inserted with it into the medial surface of the greater trochanter.

UBERON:0019203.name: superior gemellus muscle
UBERON:0019203.def: the smaller of the two gemellus muscles that arises from the outer surface of the spine of the ischium, blends with the upper part of the tendon of the obturator internus, and is inserted with it into the medial surface of the greater trochanter[wp].

UBERON:0019204.name: skin epithelium
UBERON:0019204.def: any region of epithelium that is part of a skin region.

UBERON:0019207.name: chorioretinal region
UBERON:0019207.def: the part of the eye that consists of both the retina and the optic choroid.

UBERON:0019208.name: anterior pole of lens
UBERON:0019208.def: the central point on the anterior surface of the lens.

UBERON:0019210.name: pole of lens
UBERON:0019210.def: a central point or region on the anterior or posterior surface of the lens.

UBERON:0019211.name: supcapsular region of anterior region of lens

UBERON:0019212.name: supcapsular region of posterior region of lens

UBERON:0019221.name: digit 1 or 5
UBERON:0019221.def: either of the outermost digits in a five-digit autopod, or their phylogenetic equivalent.

UBERON:0019222.name: digit 2, 3 or 4
UBERON:0019222.def: any of the three medial digits in a five-digit autopod, or their phylogenetic equivalent.

UBERON:0019246.name: palmar skin crease
UBERON:0019246.synonym: skin crease of palmar part of manus

UBERON:0019247.name: plantar skin crease
UBERON:0019247.synonym: skin crease of plantar part of pes

UBERON:0019258.name: white matter of hindbrain
UBERON:0019258.def: a white matter that is part of the hindbrain.

UBERON:0019261.name: white matter of forebrain
UBERON:0019261.def: a white matter that is part of the forebrain.

UBERON:0019262.name: white matter of myelencephalon
