UBERON:0019262.def: a white matter that is part of the myelencephalon.

UBERON:0019275.name: uncinate fasciculus of the forebrain
UBERON:0019275.def: a fiber pathway in the cerebral white matter that connects anterior portions of the temporal lobe with the inferior frontal gyrus and the middle frontal gyrus. it is not readily distinguished in myelin-stained cross-sections (adapted from brain info).

UBERON:0019289.name: accessory olfactory bulb external plexiform layer

UBERON:0019290.name: accessory olfactory bulb internal plexiform layer

UBERON:0019307.name: epithelium of external nose
UBERON:0019307.def: epithelial layer that is part of the external part of the nose.
UBERON:0019307.synonym: epithelium of skin of external nose

UBERON:0019308.name: septohypothalamic nucleus
UBERON:0019308.def: a group of cells located between the lateral septal nucleus and the anterior commissure in the mouse ( paxinos-2001 ). some authors regard it as part of the lateral septal nucleus ( swanson-1998 ).

UBERON:0019311.name: root of olfactory nerve
UBERON:0019311.def: the initial segment of an olfactory nerve, leaving the central nervous system.

UBERON:0019312.name: ventrolateral nucleus of solitary tract
UBERON:0019312.synonym: ventrolateral subnucleus of solitary tract, left

UBERON:0019315.name: meibum
UBERON:0019315.def: an oily substance that prevents evaporation of the eye's tear film.

UBERON:0019319.name: exocrine gland of integumental system
UBERON:0019319.def: an exocrine gland that is part of a integumental system.

UBERON:0019320.name: precordial region
UBERON:0019320.def: a subdivision of the trunk that is comprised of the epigastrium and the anterior lower thorax.

UBERON:0019324.name: intraorbital lacrimal gland
UBERON:0019324.def: a lacrimal gland located superficially at the lateral canthus, where both the lacrimal gland and harderian gland ducts open.

UBERON:0019325.name: exorbital lacrimal gland
UBERON:0019325.def: a lacrimal gland located subcutaneously at the anteroventral base of the ear adjacent to the parotid gland.

UBERON:0019326.name: lobe of lacrimal gland
UBERON:0019326.def: an anatomical lobe that is part of a lacrimal gland.

UBERON:0019327.name: orbital lobe of lacrimal gland
UBERON:0019327.def: larger of the two lacrimal gland lobes located superficially.

UBERON:0019328.name: palpebral lobe of lacrimal gland
UBERON:0019328.def: smaller of the two lacrimal gland lobes located at the eyelid.

UBERON:0020358.name: accessory xi nerve nucleus
UBERON:0020358.def: the spinal accessory nucleus lies within the cervical spinal cord (c1-c5) in the ventral horn. the nucleus ambiguus is classically said to provide the 'cranial component' of the accessory nerve. however, the very existence of this cranial component has been recently questioned and seen as contributing exclusively to the vagus nerve. the terminology continues to be used in describing both human anatomy, and that of other animals.

UBERON:0020550.name: auricular blood vessel
UBERON:0020550.def: a blood vessel that supplies or drains an ear.

UBERON:0022246.name: superior longitudinal fasciculus
UBERON:0022246.def: the superior longitudinal fasciculus (also called the superior longitudinal fascicle or slf) is a pair of long bi-directional bundles of neurons connecting the front and the back of the cerebrum. each association fiber bundle is lateral to the centrum ovale of a cerebral hemisphere and connects the frontal, occipital, parietal, and temporal lobes. the neurons pass from the frontal lobe through the operculum to the posterior end of the lateral sulcus where numerous neurons radiate into the occipital lobe and other neurons turn downward and forward around the putamen and radiate to anterior portions of the temporal lobe.

UBERON:0022252.name: precentral sulcus
UBERON:0022252.def: the precentral sulcus lies parallel to, and in front of, the central sulcus. (a sulcus is one of the prominent grooves on the surface of the human brain. ) the precentral sulcus divides the inferior, middle, and superior frontal gyri from the precentral gyrus. in the majority of brains, the precentral sulcus is divided into two parts: the inferior precentral sulcus and the superior precentral sulcus. however, the precentral sulcus may also be divided into three parts or form one continuous sulcus.

UBERON:0022254.name: ventral thalamic fasciculus
UBERON:0022254.def: the thalamic fasciculus is a component of the subthalamus. it is sometimes considered synonymous with 'field h1 of forel'. nerve fibres forming a composite bundle containing cerebellothalamic (crossed) and pallidothalamic (uncrossed) fibres that is insinuated between the thalamus and zona incerta. the thalamic fasciculus consists of the joint fibers of the ansa lenticularis and the lenticular fasciculus, coming from different portions of the medial globus pallidus, before they jointly enter the ventral lateral nucleus of the thalamus.

UBERON:0022256.name: subthalamic fasciculus
UBERON:0022256.def: the subthalamic fasciculus is a tract which connects the subthalamic nucleus and the globus pallidus. it is a bidirectional connection between the gp and the subthalamic nucleus, including (1) fibers running from the gpe to the subthalamic nucleus, and (2) fibers running from the stn back to the gp.

UBERON:0022262.name: auditory radiation
UBERON:0022262.def: the acoustic radiations or auditory radiations are structures found in the brain, in the ventral cochlear pathway, a part of the auditory system. lesions to the auditory radiations could be a cause of cortical deafness.

UBERON:0022264.name: optic radiation
UBERON:0022264.def: the optic radiation (also known as the geniculo-calcarine tract or as the geniculostriate pathway) is a collection of axons from relay neurons in the lateral geniculate nucleus of the thalamus carrying visual information to the visual cortex (also called striate cortex) along the calcarine fissure. there is one such tract on each side of the brain.

UBERON:0022268.name: planum temporale
UBERON:0022268.def: the planum temporale is the cortical area just posterior to the auditory cortex within the sylvian fissure. it is a triangular region which forms the heart of wernicke's area, one of the most important functional areas for language. the planum temporale shows a significant asymmetry. in 65% of all individuals the left planum temporale appears to be more developed, while the right planum temporale is more developed in only 10%. in some peoplebs brains, the planum temporale is more than five times larger on the left than on the right, making it the most asymmetrical structure in the brain. this greater size of the left planum temporale compared with the right is already present in the foetus, where it can be observed starting from the 31st week of gestation. this observation strengthens the hypothesis of a genetic predisposition for brain asymmetry.

UBERON:0022271.name: corticopontine fibers
UBERON:0022271.def: corticopontine fibers, commonly referred to as corticobulbar fibers, are projections from the cerebral cortex to the pontine nuclei. depending upon the lobe of origin, they can be classified as frontopontine fibers, parietopontine fibers, temporopontine fibers and occipitopontine fibers. they are motor fibers that stretch from the precentral gyrus (motor strip) to the nuclei of cranial nerves v (trigenimal), vii (facial) and xii (hypoglossal). these fibers run alongside the corticospinal fibers.

UBERON:0022272.name: corticobulbar tract
UBERON:0022272.def: the corticobulbar (or corticonuclear) tract is a white matter pathway connecting the cerebral cortex to the brainstem. the term 'bulbar' refers to the brainstem, as 'bulb' was a historical term meaning the area currently called the brainstem. the 'bulb' is an archaic term for the medulla oblongata. in clinical usage, it includes the pons as well.

UBERON:0022273.name: lacrimal lake
UBERON:0022273.def: a small cistern-like area of the conjunctiva at the medial angle of the eye, in which the tears collect after bathing the front surface of the eyeball and the conjunctival sac.

UBERON:0022274.name: lacrimal papilla
UBERON:0022274.def: a small conical elevation at the basal angle of the lacrimal lake.

UBERON:0022275.name: colic flexure
UBERON:0022275.def: a sharp bend between consecutive segments of the colon.

UBERON:0022276.name: splenic flexure of colon
UBERON:0022276.def: the splenic (or left colic) flexure is a sharp bend between the transverse and the descending colon in the left upper quadrant of humans. the left colic flexure is near the spleen, and hence called the splenic flexure. there are two colic flexures in the transverse colon — the other being the hepatic flexure in the right upper quadrant.

UBERON:0022277.name: hepatic flexure of colon
UBERON:0022277.def: hepatic (or the right colic) flexure is the sharp bend between the ascending and the transverse colon. the right colic flexure is adjacent to the liver, and is therefore also known as the hepatic flexure. thus, the left colic flexure is also known as the splenic flexure (as it is close to the spleen). the hepatic flexure lies in the right upper quadrant of the abdomen in humans.

UBERON:0022278.name: nucleus of pudendal nerve
UBERON:0022278.def: a nucleus in the ventral part of the anterior horn of the sacral region of the spinal cord that is the origin of the pudendal nerve.

UBERON:0022279.name: strand of hair on external ear

UBERON:0022280.name: epithelium of crypt of lieberkuhn of small intestine
UBERON:0022280.synonym: wall of small intestinal crypt of lieberkuhn

UBERON:0022281.name: epithelium of crypt of lieberkuhn of large intestine

UBERON:0022282.name: secretion of harderian gland
UBERON:0022282.def: a merocrine secretion that is produced by a harderian gland, containing lipids.

UBERON:0022283.name: pineal recess of third ventricle
UBERON:0022283.def: the diverticulum of the thin roof of the dorsocaudal third ventricle that projects into the stalk of the pineal gland.

UBERON:0022284.name: lacrimal gland bud
UBERON:0022284.def: the single bud-like invagination of the conjunctival fornix epithelium at the temporal aspect of the eye that signals lacrimal gland formation (int rev cytol. 1996;168:1-80. cell biology of the harderian gland).

UBERON:0022285.name: strand of tylotrich hair
UBERON:0022285.def: a single large hair, surrounded by neurovascular tissue at the level of the sebaceous gland, with a hair follicle innervated by a hair-tylotrich neuron (cl:1001436), a rapidly acting mechanoreceptor.

UBERON:0022286.name: secretion of nictitans gland
UBERON:0022286.def: a secretion that is produced by a nictitans gland, containing glycoprotein.

UBERON:0022287.name: tear film
UBERON:0022287.def: an aqueous substance that covers the anterior surface of the eyeball, keeping the cornea wet.

UBERON:0022288.name: surface of eyeball
UBERON:0022288.synonym: surface of region of wall of eyeball

UBERON:0022293.name: reproductive gland secretion
UBERON:0022293.def: a portion of organism substance that is secreted by a reproductive gland.

UBERON:0022294.name: morphological boundary
UBERON:0022294.def: a two dimensional anatomical structure that corresponds to some structural discontinuity.

UBERON:0022295.name: integumental surface
UBERON:0022295.def: the outer surface of an organism or its integumental system.

UBERON:0022296.name: inferior palpebral branch of infra-orbital nerve
UBERON:0022296.def: a nerve that innervates a lower eyelid and is a branch of the infra-orbital branch of the maxillary nerve.

UBERON:0022297.name: palpebral branch of infra-orbital nerve
UBERON:0022297.def: a nerve that innervates an eyelid and is a branch of the infra-orbital branch of the maxillary nerve.

UBERON:0022298.name: lower eyelid nerve
UBERON:0022298.def: a nerve that innervates a lower eyelid.

UBERON:0022299.name: upper eyelid nerve
UBERON:0022299.def: a nerve that innervates an upper eyelid.

UBERON:0022300.name: nasociliary nerve
UBERON:0022300.def: a branch of the ophthalmic nerve that serves to supply the mucous membrane of the nose, the tip of the nose, and the conjunctiva.

UBERON:0022301.name: long ciliary nerve
UBERON:0022301.def: a branch of the nasociliary nerve that innervates the ciliary muscles, the iris, and the cornea.

UBERON:0022302.name: short ciliary nerve
UBERON:0022302.def: a branch of the ciliary ganglion that innervates the ciliary muscles, the iris, and the tunics of the eyeball.

UBERON:0022303.name: nervous system cell part layer
UBERON:0022303.def: single layer of a laminar structure, identified by different density, arrangement or size of cells and processes arranged in flattened layers or lamina[cumbo].

UBERON:0022314.name: superior colliculus stratum zonale
UBERON:0022314.def: most superficial layer of the superior colliculus consisting primarily of thin fibers derived primarily from the occipital cortex (brodal, neurological anatomy, 2nd 3d, 1981, pg. 544).

UBERON:0022317.name: olfactory cortex layer 1
UBERON:0022317.def: surface layer of the olfactory cortex that contains dendrites, fiber systems and a small number of neurons. it has been divided into a superficial part and a deep part.

UBERON:0022318.name: olfactory cortex layer 2
UBERON:0022318.def: middle layer of olfactory cortex lying deep to layer 1 and superficial to layer 3, characterized by a compact layer of cell bodies. it can be divided into a superficial part and a deep part.

UBERON:0022319.name: lateral geniculate nucleus parvocellular layer
UBERON:0022319.def: layer of the lateral geniculate nucleus characterized by small cells (adapted from wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/lateral_geniculate_nucleus).
UBERON:0022319.synonym: parvocellular layer of lateral geniculate nucleus

UBERON:0022320.name: dorsal cochlear nucleus pyramidal cell layer

UBERON:0022323.name: entorhinal cortex layer 4
UBERON:0022323.def: layer of entorhinal cortex lying superficial to layer 5 and deep to layer 3, that is relatively acellular. (paxinos, the rat nervous system, academic press, 1995, pg 473-474).

UBERON:0022325.name: entorhinal cortex layer 5
UBERON:0022325.def: layer of entorhinal cortex lying superficial to layer 6 and deep to layer 4 characterized by large pyramidal neurons that are darkly stained in nissl preparations (adapted from paxinos, g. the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995, pg. 474).

UBERON:0022326.name: molecular layer of dorsal cochlear nucleus

UBERON:0022327.name: entorhinal cortex layer 3
UBERON:0022327.def: layer of the entorhinal cortex lying superficial to layer 4and deep to layer 2. it is characterized by cells of various sizes and shapes with a predominance of pyramidal cells (adapted from paxinos, g. the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995, pg. 474).

UBERON:0022329.name: entorhinal cortex layer 6
UBERON:0022329.def: layer of entorhinal cortex lying superficial to the cerebral white matter and deep to layer 5 characterized by cells of various shapes and sizes (adapted from paxinos, g. the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995, pg. 474).

UBERON:0022336.name: entorhinal cortex layer 1
UBERON:0022336.def: layer of the entorhinal cortex that is most superficial, continuous with layer 1 of adjacent neocortex and the molecular layer of the subiculum, lying deep to the pial layer and superficial to layer 2. it is relatively acellular consisting mostly of fibers running transversely relative to the cortical surface (adapted from paxinos, g. the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995, pg. 474).
UBERON:0022336.synonym: superficial plexiform layer of entorhinal cortex

UBERON:0022337.name: entorhinal cortex layer 2
UBERON:0022337.def: layer of the entorhinal cortex lying superficial to layer 3 and deep to layer 1. it is characterized by medium-to large sized stellate cells that are grouped into prominent clusters, particularly in the rostral entorhinal cortex (adapted from paxinos, g. the rat central nervous system, 2nd ed, academic press, san diego, 1995, pg. 474).
UBERON:0022337.synonym: outermost cell layer of entorhinal cortex

UBERON:0022340.name: piriform cortex layer 2a
UBERON:0022340.def: superficial region of layer 2 of the piriform cortex characterized by a less dense packing of cells and a concentration of semilunar cell bodies.

UBERON:0022341.name: piriform cortex layer 2b
UBERON:0022341.def: deeper of two subdivisions of piriform layer 2 characterized by more densely packed cell bodies dominated by pyramidal cell bodies.

UBERON:0022346.name: dentate gyrus molecular layer middle
UBERON:0022346.synonym: middle layer of dentate gyrus molecular layer

UBERON:0022347.name: dentate gyrus molecular layer inner
UBERON:0022347.def: inner third of the dentate gyrus.
UBERON:0022347.synonym: inner layer of dentate gyrus molecular layer

UBERON:0022348.name: dentate gyrus granule cell layer inner blade

UBERON:0022349.name: dentate gyrus granule cell layer outer blade

UBERON:0022350.name: visceral serous membrane
UBERON:0022350.def: serous membrane layer that is adjacent to and lines an organ.

UBERON:0022351.name: parietal serous membrane
UBERON:0022351.def: serous membrane layer that lines to a body cavity.

UBERON:0022352.name: medial orbital frontal cortex
UBERON:0022352.def: component of the orbtial frontal cortex. the rostral boundary is the first slice where the medial orbital gyrus became visible whereas the caudal boundary is the disappearance of the medial orbital gyrus/gyrus rectus. the medial and lateral boundaries are the cingulate cortex on the u2018inflatedu2019 surface and the medial bank of the superior frontal gyrus (or the cingulate gyrus when visible) respectively (christine fennema-notestine).

UBERON:0022353.name: posterior cingulate cortex
UBERON:0022353.def: component of the cingulate cortex. the rostral and caudal extent were the caudal anterior and the isthmus divisions of the cingulate cortex respectively. the medial and lateral boundaries were the corpus callosum and as the superior frontal gyrus and/or paracentral lobule respectively (christine fennema-notestine).

UBERON:0022355.name: basal layer of endometrium
UBERON:0022355.def: the layer of endometrial epithelium adjacent to the uterine cavity.

UBERON:0022356.name: outer layer of endometrium
UBERON:0022356.def: the layer of endometrial epithelium adjacent to the myometrium.

UBERON:0022358.name: placenta blood vessel
UBERON:0022358.def: a blood vessel of the placenta.

UBERON:0022360.name: male mammary gland duct
UBERON:0022360.def: a mammary gland duct that is part of a male organism. this structure typically regresses.

UBERON:0022361.name: lung field
UBERON:0022361.def: a specific region of the foregut into the area in which the lung will develop.

UBERON:0022383.name: anterior parahippocampal gyrus
UBERON:0022383.def: the part of the parahippocampal gyrus that includes the perirhinal and entorhinal cortices.

UBERON:0022420.name: temporal part of superior longitudinal fasciculus

UBERON:0022421.name: pontocerebellar tract
UBERON:0022421.def: the second order neuron fibers of the corticopontocerebellar tracts that cross to the other side of the pons and run within the middle cerebellar peduncles, from the pons to the contralateral cerebellum.

UBERON:0022423.name: sagulum nucleus
UBERON:0022423.def: a collection of principally small and medium-sized cells in the midbrain tegmentum lying at the margin of the midbrain adjacent to the nuclei of the lateral lemniscus.

UBERON:0022424.name: supragenual nucleus of pontine tegmentum
UBERON:0022424.def: a group of neurons embedded in the pontine central gray of the pontine tegmentum. located dorsal to the internal genu of the facial nerve, it is found in the human ( paxinos-2012 ), the macaque ( paxinos-2009a ), the rat ( swanson-2004 ), and the mouse ( franklin-2008 ). functionally it is part of the dorsal pontine gray of the subcortical motor system ( swanson-2004 ).

UBERON:0022434.name: primary superior olive
UBERON:0022434.def: part of the superior olivary complex of nuclei in the caudal pontine tegmentum, situated within the trapezoid body in humans. (brodal, neurological anatomy, 3rd edition, 1981, pg 617). in many species, it comprises a medial superior olivary nucleus and a lateral superior olivary nucleus.

UBERON:0022438.name: rostral anterior cingulate cortex
UBERON:0022438.def: component of the cingulate cortex. the rostral boundary was the first appearance of the cingulate sulcus (inferior to the superior frontal sulcus) whereas the caudal boundary was the first appearance of the genu of the corpus callosum. the medial boundary was the medial aspect of the cortex. the supero-lateral boundary was the superior frontal gyrus whereas the infero-lateral boundary was defined as the medial division of the orbitofrontal gyrus (christine fennema-notestine).

UBERON:0022453.name: olfactory entorhinal cortex
UBERON:0022453.def: a part of the entorhinal area defined on the basis of connectivity. it is the rostral portion, which receives a projection from the olfactory bulb (price-90)-adapted from brain info.

UBERON:0022469.name: primary olfactory cortex
UBERON:0022469.def: a group of structures defined by connectivity, namely, structures that receive axons from the olfactory bulb. they include the anterior olfactory nucleus, the anterior perforated substance, the rostral part of the medial amygdaloid nucleus (anterior cortical nucleus of amygdala), and structures in the anterior part of the parahippocampal gyrus, namely, the prepyriform area, most of the periamygdaloid area, and the rostral part of the entorhinal area (price-90). note that some authors have regarded the olfactory bulb itself as the primary olfactory area and the areas to which it projects as secondary (anthoney-94). in the mouse (dong-2004) and the rat (swanson-2004), olfactory areas include the olfactory bulb, accessory olfactory bulb, anterior olfactory nucleus, tenia tecta, prepyriform area, postpiriform transition area, piriform amygdaloid area, nucleus of lateral olfactory tract, and cortical amygdaloid area.

UBERON:0022480.synonym: predominantly gray regional part of pretectal region

UBERON:0022515.name: obsolete regional part of organ cavity

UBERON:0022534.name: pericalcarine cortex
UBERON:0022534.def: component of the parietal lobe. the rostral boundary of the pericalcarine cortex was the first appearance of the calcarine sulcus whereas the caudal boundary was the most posterior coronal slice where the calcarine sulcus was visualized. the medial and lateral boundaries were the medial portion of the temporal and occipital cortices and the inferomedial end of the calcarine sulcus respectively (christine fennema-notestine).

UBERON:0023861.name: planum polare
UBERON:0023861.def: a portion of the superior temporal gyrus near the temporal pole in the human.

UBERON:0023862.name: hippocampal formation of gp94
UBERON:0023862.def: the combined region of ammonõs horn, subicular complex and dentate gyrus; only fields ca1-ca3 of the hippocampus were considered to be part of the hf, field ca4 being included in the hilus of the dentate gyrus[1].

UBERON:0023867.name: islands of calleja of olfactory tubercle
UBERON:0023867.def: part of olfactory tubercle defined by dense aggregations of granule cells.

UBERON:0023868.name: isla magna of calleja
UBERON:0023868.def: regional part of telencephalon; the most prominent of the islands of calleja located medially in the nucleus accumbens (adapted from braininfo.org).

UBERON:0023869.name: obsolete body membrane
UBERON:0023869.def: part of body that takes the form of a thin sheet of cells or fibrous material, e.g., the meningeal coverings of the brain[nifstd].

UBERON:0023879.name: neural system
UBERON:0023879.def: a set of neural structures that subserve a specific function, e.g., visual system.

UBERON:0023900.name: piriform cortex layer 1a
UBERON:0023900.def: superficial part of plexiform layer (layer 1) of piriform cortex that receives afferents from the olfactory bulb by way of the lateral olfactory tract.

UBERON:0023901.name: piriform cortex layer 1b
UBERON:0023901.def: deeper part of the plexiform (layer 1) of piriform cortex characterized by projection of association fibers from other parts of the piriform cortex and other olfactory areas.

UBERON:0023920.name: basal ganglia of rodent
UBERON:0023920.def: the basal ganglia of the rodent.

UBERON:0023927.name: subbrachial nucleus of mouse of franklin and paxinos 2008
UBERON:0023927.synonym: subbrachial nucleus of mouse of franklin and paxinos 2008

UBERON:0023928.name: postrhinal cortex of rodent of burwell et al 1995
UBERON:0023928.def: cortical region lying caudal to the perirhinal cortex in the rat. it encompasses the caudal levels of area 35 and the caudal portion of area 36 (ectorhinal cortex). it is bordered medially by agranular retrosplenial cortex and ventrally by the entorhinal cortex (with the exception of the caudomedial portion). the authors note that the ventral portion of the postrhinal cortex in rat may by homologous with the parahippocampal cortex in the monkey.

UBERON:0023932.name: sommer's sector
UBERON:0023932.def: part of hippocampal formation comprising area ca1 and the subiculum (pg 425, heimer, l. the human brain and spinal cord, springer-verlag, 1995).

UBERON:0023934.name: olfactory bulb main glomerular layer
UBERON:0023934.def: the glomerular layer of the main olfactory bulb, lying deep to the olfactory nerve layer. it contains the glomeruli, neuropil rich spheroid structures surrounded by a distinctive shell of small neuros and glial cells (paxinos, the rat nervous system, 2nd ed., academic press, 1995).

UBERON:0023936.name: perirhinal cortex of burwell et al 1995
UBERON:0023936.def: rostral portion of the parahippocampal cortex.
UBERON:0023936.synonym: perirhinal cortex of burwell et al 1995

UBERON:0023942.name: obsolete olfactory bulb main of rodent

UBERON:0023958.name: bed nuclei of the stria terminalis oval nucleus
UBERON:0023958.def: part of bed nucleus of stria terminalis, comprising a distinct, large, egg-shaped collection of neurons that, together with the juxtacapsular (ju) and rhomboid (rh) nuclei, encompass the anterolateral area of the bst (ju and swanson, 1989).
UBERON:0023958.synonym: bed nuclei of the stria terminalis oval nucleus

UBERON:0023984.name: rostral spinocerebellar tract
UBERON:0023984.def: originates from cells rostral to clarke's column and sends uncrossed axons through the lateral funiculus to the cerebellum. it reaches the cerebellum partly through the brachium conjunctivum and partly through the restiform body, terminating bilaterally in the anterior lobe of the cerebellum.

UBERON:0024045.name: white matter of the cerebellar cortex

UBERON:0024078.name: principal anterior division of supraoptic nucleus
UBERON:0024078.def: one of two divisions of the supraoptic nucleus observed in mammals, formed by the ascension of the optic chiasm to split the nucleus in two. the principal anterior division consists of a dense cluster of large cells that stain darkly in nissl preparations adjacent to the optic chiasm, extending as far rostrally to the organum vasculosum of the lamina terminalis and caudally into the posterior hypothalamus.
UBERON:0024078.synonym: principal anterior division of supraoptic nucleus

UBERON:0024079.name: tuberal supraoptic nucleus
UBERON:0024079.def: posterior division of the supraoptic nucleus, formed by the ascension of the optic tract splitting the nucleus into two regions. the tuberal son lies along the posterior tuber cinereum of the hypothalamus. in some species, some neurons lie under the optic chiasm.

UBERON:0024110.def: the basis pontis is the anterior portion of the pons.

UBERON:0024151.name: tegmentum
UBERON:0024151.def: the ventral topographic division of the midbrain; the dorsal topographic division is the tectum. meckel (1817; see english translation, 1832, vol. 2, p. 467) apparently introduced the term and roughly its definition here for macrodissected adult humans, except he excluded the cerebral peduncle (tarin, 1753), a white matter tract at the base of the midbrain, which is still common today but is included here. as defined here, tegmentum refers to the whole of the midbrain (baer, 1837) excluding the tectum but including the pretectal region (scalia, 1972); see swanson (2000, pp. 522, 526). usage of this term is very complex, inconsistent, and illogical; see for example crosby et al. UBERON:0034671.def: composite sulcus of the frontal lobe of the macaque. located on the dorsolateral surface, it consists of the superior ramus of the arcuate sulcus (macaque), the inferior ramus of the arcuate sulcus and the spur of the arcuate sulcus (macaque) (neuronames:2379).

UBERON:0034680.name: laryngeal prominence

UBERON:0034681.name: vocal organ
UBERON:0034681.def: any organ that is the primary organ of vocalization behavior. examples: the laryngeal vocal cord (humans), the syrinx (birds).

UBERON:0034690.name: external spermatic fascia
UBERON:0034690.def: a thin membrane, prolonged downward around the surface of the spermatic cord and testis. it is separated from the dartos tunic by loose areolar tissue. it is derived from the aponeurosis of the abdominal external oblique muscle.

UBERON:0034693.name: cremasteric artery
UBERON:0034693.def: the cremasteric artery (external spermatic artery) is a branch of the inferior epigastric artery which accompanies the spermatic cord, and supplies the cremaster and other coverings of the cord, anastomosing with the testicular artery (internal spermatic artery in older texts). (in the female, the cremesteric artery is very small and accompanies the round ligament.).

UBERON:0034694.def: the portion of the gubernacular bulb that is located within the abdomen.

UBERON:0034695.name: gubernacular bulb, extra-abdominal part
UBERON:0034695.def: the portion of the gubernacular bulb that is located external to the abdomen.

UBERON:0034705.name: developing neuroepithelium
UBERON:0034705.def: an embryonic or larval epithelium that is committed to form part of the nervous system.

UBERON:0034706.name: proliferating neuroepithelium
UBERON:0034706.def: an epithelium that is undergoing proliferation to provide large numbers of neuronal cells.

UBERON:0034707.name: differentiating neuroepithelium
UBERON:0034707.def: a neuroepithelium some of whose cells are undergoing terminal differentiation to become neuronal cells.

UBERON:0034710.name: spinal cord ventricular layer
UBERON:0034710.synonym: spinal cord lateral wall ventricular layer

UBERON:0034711.name: cortical preplate
UBERON:0034711.def: the layer of the developing cerebral cortex that is formed from the first cohort of neurons to migrate out of the cortical ventricular zone; split by the second wave into marginal zone and subplate.

UBERON:0034712.name: yellow fibrocartilage
UBERON:0034712.def: fibrocartilage containing bundles of yellow elastic fibers but with little or no white fibrous tissue.

UBERON:0034713.name: cranial neuron projection bundle
UBERON:0034713.def: any of the cranial nerves, or their central nervous system analogs (the optic tract, the epiphyseal tract). these analogs are not true nerves, and are instead evaginated sensory afferents emanating from the brain.

UBERON:0034714.name: epiphyseal tract
UBERON:0034714.def: a cranial nerve fiber tract that innervates the parietal eye.

UBERON:0034715.name: pineal tract
UBERON:0034715.def: a cranial nerve fiber tract that innervates the pineal body.

UBERON:0034716.name: rostral epiphyseal tract
UBERON:0034716.def: the more rostral of the two branches of the epiphyseal tract.

UBERON:0034717.name: integumental taste bud
UBERON:0034717.def: a taste bud that is located external to the digestive tube, on the head or body, as found in species such as goldfish.

UBERON:0034718.name: barbel taste bud
UBERON:0034718.def: a taste bud that is located on a barbel.

UBERON:0034719.name: lip taste bud
UBERON:0034719.def: a taste bud that is located on a lip.

UBERON:0034720.name: head taste bud
UBERON:0034720.def: a taste bud that is located on the skin of the head.

UBERON:0034721.name: pharyngeal taste bud
UBERON:0034721.def: a taste bud that is located in the pharynx.

UBERON:0034722.name: mouth roof taste bud
UBERON:0034722.def: a taste bud that is located on the roof of the mouth.

UBERON:0034723.name: fin taste bud
UBERON:0034723.def: a taste bud that is located on a fin.

UBERON:0034724.name: esophageal taste bud
UBERON:0034724.def: a taste bud that is located in the esophagus.

UBERON:0034725.name: pterygopalatine nerve
UBERON:0034725.def: the pharyngeal nerve (pterygopalatine nerve) is a small branch arising from the posterior part of the pterygopalatine ganglion. it passes through the pharyngeal canal with the pharyngeal branch of the maxillary artery, and is distributed to the mucous membrane of the nasal part of the pharynx, behind the auditory tube.

UBERON:0034726.name: trunk taste bud
UBERON:0034726.def: a taste bud that is located on the skin of the trunk.

UBERON:0034727.name: vestibular bulb artery
UBERON:0034727.def: the artery of bulb of vestibule is a branch of the internal pudendal artery.

UBERON:0034728.name: autonomic nerve
UBERON:0034728.def: the autonomic nerve is a small nerve which carries postganglionic sympathetic and parasympathetic neurons from the zygomaticotemporal nerve; a branch of the maxillary nerve, to the lacrimal nerve; a branch of the ophthalmic nerve. these neurons derive from the superior cervical ganglion and the pterygopalatine ganglion respectively. they will travel to the lacrimal gland via the lacrimal nerve. parasympathetic will induce lacrimation and vice versa.

UBERON:0034730.name: olfactory tract linking bulb to ipsilateral dorsal telencephalon

UBERON:0034734.name: medial olfactory stria
UBERON:0034734.def: the medial olfactory stria turns medialward behind the parolfactory area and ends in the subcallosal gyrus; in some cases a small intermediate stria is seen running backward to the anterior perforated substance.

UBERON:0034735.name: oviduct albumen gland
UBERON:0034735.def: a gland in the glandular region of the oviduct that secretes albumen over the ovum. in birds there are two regions of the oviduct, the first secretes a thin chalaziferous albumen layer, the second secretes a thicker albumen layer.

UBERON:0034736.name: coracoclavicular ligament
UBERON:0034736.def: any ligament that connects the coracoid process with the clavicle.

UBERON:0034743.name: inferior longitudinal fasciculus
UBERON:0034743.def: the inferior longitudinal fasciculus connects the temporal lobe and occipital lobe, running along the lateral walls of the inferior and posterior cornua of the lateral ventricle. the existence of this fasciculus independent from the occipitotemporal fasciculus has been questioned for the human being, such that it has been proposed that the term inferior longitudinal fasciculus be replaced by the term 'occipitotemporal projection'.

UBERON:0034750.name: visual association cortex
UBERON:0034750.def: part of cortex considered to function in higher level visual functions.

UBERON:0034751.name: primary auditory cortex
UBERON:0034751.def: the part of the auditory cortex that is located on the superior temporal gyrus in the temporal lobe and receives point-to-point input from the ventral division of the medial geniculate complex.

UBERON:0034752.name: secondary auditory cortex
UBERON:0034752.def: the part of the auditory cortex that receive more diffuse input from the belt areas of the medial geniculate complex.

UBERON:0034754.name: occipitofrontal fasciculus
UBERON:0034754.def: the occipitofrontal fasciculus passes backward from the frontal lobe, along the lateral border of the caudate nucleus, and on the medial aspect of the corona radiata; its fibers radiate in a fan-like manner and pass into the occipital and temporal lobes lateral to the posterior and inferior cornua.

UBERON:0034762.name: areolar sweat gland
UBERON:0034762.def: any sweat gland that is part of an areola.

UBERON:0034765.name: glabella skin
UBERON:0034765.def: the zone of skin that overlaps with the glabella region.

UBERON:0034766.name: glabella region
UBERON:0034766.def: a region of the forehead corresponding to the space between the eyebrows and above the nose.

UBERON:0034767.name: buccal vestibule
UBERON:0034767.def: the buccal vestibule is the space external to teeth and gums and internal to lips and cheeks. the proportion of its walls formed by the lips varies according to species depending upon their feeding action. the horse like most herbivores has a relatively small opening. the buccal vestibule opens to the outside rostrally via a u shaped slit the oral fissure. when the mouth is closed the buccal vestibule and the mouth cavity proper connect via spaces between and behind the teeth. these allow free communication between the two sides of the vestibule. several salivary ducts open into the dorso caudal part of the vestibule: parotid gland - opens into the cheek on the small parotid papilla, opposite to the caudal part of upper 4 th premolar teeth. zygomatic gland - the main duct opens in the caudal part of the upper 1 st molar tooth on a small papilla near the vestibular fornix. submucous glands - minimal in number, confined to the lower lip and adjacent part of the cheek. secretion occurs through about 10 openings located near the fornix of the vestibule.

UBERON:0034768.name: morphological feature
UBERON:0034768.def: a part of an organism or organ that is continuous with its surroundings and distinguished from its surroundings based on morphology.

UBERON:0034770.name: bulbourethral gland epithelium
UBERON:0034770.synonym: epithelium of bulbourethral gland of male

UBERON:0034771.name: ventral commissural nucleus of spinal cord
UBERON:0034771.def: the term commissural nucleus of the spinal cord refers to a group of cells in the medial portion of the anterior gray column; it corresponds roughly to lamina viii.

UBERON:0034772.name: margin of eyelid
UBERON:0034772.def: the confluence of the mucosal surface of the conjunctiva, the edge of the orbicularis, and the cutaneous epithelium.

UBERON:0034773.name: uncus of parahippocampal gyrus
UBERON:0034773.def: the anterior extremity of the parahippocampal gyrus is recurved in the form of a hook, the uncus, which is separated from the apex of the temporal lobe by a slight fissure, the incisura temporalis. although superficially continuous with the hippocampal gyrus, the uncus forms morphologically a part of the rhinencephalon. the term uncus was coined by felix vicq dbazyr (1748b1794).

UBERON:0034873.name: bodily gas
UBERON:0034873.def: any substance in the body or expelled from the body that is in a gaseous state.
UBERON:0034873.synonym: portion of gas in anatomical space

UBERON:0034874.name: air in respiratory system
UBERON:0034874.def: any portion of gas located in a part of the respiratory system that is composed primarily of air.

UBERON:0034876.name: future neurohypophysis
UBERON:0034876.def: the outgrowth of neuroectoderm located on the floor of the embryonic hypothalamus that gives rise to the neurohypophysis (posterior lobe) of the pituitary gland.

UBERON:0034877.name: angioblastic cord
UBERON:0034877.def: the cordlike masses of splanchnic mesenchymal cells ventral to the primordial pericardial coelom that arrange themselves side by side to form the primordia of the endocardial heart tubes.

UBERON:0034878.name: prechordal mesoderm
UBERON:0034878.def: the area of axial mesoderm that develops into the prechordal plate.

UBERON:0034885.name: viscerocranial mucosa
UBERON:0034885.def: nonparenchymatous organ which consists of mucosae of the nose, mouth, pharyngotympanic tube, pharynx and larynx. examples: there is only one viscerocranial mucosa.

UBERON:0034889.name: posterior parietal cortex
UBERON:0034889.def: the posterior parietal cortex is a portion of the parietal lobe which manipulates mental images, and integrates sensory and motor portions of the brain. some sources say that it consists of brodmann area 5 and brodmann area 7. other sources say it is only area 7.

UBERON:0034892.name: granular insular cortex
UBERON:0034892.def: granular region of the insular cortex.

UBERON:0034893.name: agranular insular cortex
UBERON:0034893.def: agranular region of the insular cortex.

UBERON:0034898.name: alveolar ridge of premaxilla
UBERON:0034898.def: the thickened ridge of bone that contains the tooth sockets on the premaxilla.

UBERON:0034900.name: palatine process of premaxilla
UBERON:0034900.def: lingual ledge on the inner surface of the premaxilla.

UBERON:0034901.name: cervical sympathetic nerve trunk
UBERON:0034901.def: the cervical ganglia are paravertebral ganglia of the sympathetic nervous system. these emerging postganglionic nerves synapse with preganglionic nerves from the thoracic spinal cord. they consist of three paravertebral ganglia: superior cervical ganglion middle cervical ganglion inferior cervical ganglion. the inferior ganglion may be fused with the first thoracic ganglion to form a single structure, the stellate ganglion. nerves emerging from cervical sympathetic ganglia contribute to the cardiac plexus, among other things.

UBERON:0034903.name: left atrium endocardium
UBERON:0034903.def: endocardium that is part of the left atrium.

UBERON:0034907.name: pineal parenchyma
UBERON:0034907.def: parenchymal tissue that forms the pineal gland.

UBERON:0034908.name: scapular muscle
UBERON:0034908.def: any of the muscles that are responsible for moving the scapula. in humans these are the levator scapulae, the infraspinatus muscle, the teres major, the teres minor, and the supraspinatus muscle.

UBERON:0034909.name: intermaxillary suture
UBERON:0034909.def: a cranial suture in the midline of the skull that connects the left and right maxilla bones.

UBERON:0034919.name: juvenile stage
UBERON:0034919.def: the stage of being no more dependent of the nest and/or from caregivers for subsistence while having not reach sexual maturity.

UBERON:0034920.name: infant stage
UBERON:0034920.def: nursing stage that follows the neonate stage in mammals and ends at weaning.

UBERON:0034921.name: multi organ part structure
UBERON:0034921.def: an multicellular anatomical structure that has subparts of multiple organs as a part.

UBERON:0034922.name: cell cluster
UBERON:0034922.def: a cluster of cells, largely surrounded by a morphological boundary.

UBERON:0034923.name: disconnected anatomical group
UBERON:0034923.def: material anatomical entity consisting of multiple anatomical structures that are not connected to each other.

UBERON:0034924.name: aligned anatomical group
UBERON:0034924.def: an anatomical group whose members are arranged in a line.

UBERON:0034925.name: anatomical collection
UBERON:0034925.def: a collection of anatomical structures that are alike in terms of their morphology or developmental origin.

UBERON:0034926.name: anatomical row
UBERON:0034926.def: an anatomical collection that is arranged in a line.

UBERON:0034927.name: arcuate artery of foot
UBERON:0034927.def: the arcuate artery of the foot (metatarsal artery) arises a little anterior to the lateral tarsal artery; it passes lateralward, over the bases of the metatarsal bones, beneath the tendons of the extensor digitorum brevis, its direction being influenced by its point of origin; and its anastomoses with the lateral tarsal and lateral plantar arteries. this vessel gives off the second, third, and fourth dorsal metatarsal arteries. it is not present in all individuals.

UBERON:0034929.name: external soft tissue zone
UBERON:0034929.def: a region or zone on the surface of an organism that encompasses skin and any adnexa, down through muscles and bounded by underlying skeletal support structures.

UBERON:0034931.name: perforant path
UBERON:0034931.def: a pathway of fibers originating in the lateral part of the entorhinal area, perforating the subiculum of the hippocampus, and running into the stratum moleculare of the hippocampus, where these fibers synapse with others that go to the dentate gyrus. (dorland, 28th ed).

UBERON:0034932.name: epithelium of biliary system
UBERON:0034932.def: the epithelial layer covering the biliary system. this includes the epithelium of the gallbladder (when present) as well as the intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts.

UBERON:0034933.name: layer of smooth muscle tissue
UBERON:0034933.def: any organ component layer that consists of smooth muscle tissue.

UBERON:0034934.name: weber's gland
UBERON:0034934.def: one of the lingual glands located on the lateral margins of the tongue, at the level of the foliate papillae and in the root of the tongue behind the circumvallate papillae.

UBERON:0034935.name: pars plicata of ciliary body
UBERON:0034935.def: corrugated anterior region of ciliary body where ciliary processes arise.

UBERON:0034936.name: pars plana of ciliary body
UBERON:0034936.def: flattened posterior region of ciliary body.

UBERON:0034938.name: mucocartilage tissue
UBERON:0034938.def: a temporary avascular cartilage found in the heads of ammocoete larvae and surrounded by perichondrium. contains a few fibroblasts scattered throughout ecm containing elastic-like microfibrils.

UBERON:0034940.name: venous sinus cavity
UBERON:0034940.def: an enlarged chamber in the blood sinus capable of accumulating a large volume of blood.

UBERON:0034941.name: blood sinus of vibrissa
UBERON:0034941.def: the sinuses of vibrissae are the walls of blood spaces surrounding the roots of vibrissae.

UBERON:0034942.name: vibrissal follicle-sinus complex
UBERON:0034942.def: a sensory receptor of the mammalian integument system that consist of a blood sinus plus follicle, and sometimes concentric rings of epidermal tissue.

UBERON:0034943.name: saccus vasculosus
UBERON:0034943.def: a circumventricular organ of the hypothalamus of many jawed fishes, protruding from the caudal infundibular wall. it is a vascularized neuroepithelium that consists of coronet cells, cerebrospinal fluid-contacting neurons and supporting cells.

UBERON:0034945.name: excreted gas
UBERON:0034945.def: any gaseous product of an excretory process.

UBERON:0034946.name: gas excreted from digestive tract
UBERON:0034946.def: any excreted gas that is produced by the digestive tract.

UBERON:0034947.name: gas in respiratory system
UBERON:0034947.def: any portion of gas located in a part of the respiratory system.

UBERON:0034948.name: carbon dioxide in respiratory system
UBERON:0034948.def: any portion of gas located in a part of the respiratory system that is composed primarily of carbon dioxide.

UBERON:0034950.name: lymph sac of lymph heart
UBERON:0034950.def: an extensive dorsal subcutaneous sac that opens into a lymph heart.

UBERON:0034953.name: embryonic lymph sac
UBERON:0034953.def: a population of lymphatic endothelial cell precursors that will form the lymph vessels.

UBERON:0034958.name: retroperitoneal embryonic lymph sac
UBERON:0034958.def: an embryonic lymph sac that forms in the root of the mesentery on the posterior abdominal wall.

UBERON:0034961.name: embryonic lymph heart
UBERON:0034961.def: a lymph heart that is part of an embryo.

UBERON:0034962.name: copulatory lymph heart
UBERON:0034962.def: a lymph heart that assists in the return of lymph from the penis to the venous system.

UBERON:0034963.name: lateral fornix of vagina
UBERON:0034963.def: the vaginal fornix that is to the side of the cervix.

UBERON:0034964.name: superficial epigastric artery
UBERON:0034964.def: an artery that arises from the femoral artery and supplies the abdominal wall. it distributes branches to the superficial subinguinal lymph glands, the superficial fascia, and the integument; it anastomoses with branches of the inferior epigastric, and with its fellow of the opposite side.

UBERON:0034965.name: middle thyroid vein
UBERON:0034965.def: the middle thyroid vein collects the blood from the lower part of the thyroid gland, and after being joined by some veins from the larynx and trachea, ends in the lower part of the internal jugular vein.

UBERON:0034968.name: sagittal sulcus
UBERON:0034968.def: a sulcus that lies within the longitudinal fissure.

UBERON:0034971.name: aortic body
UBERON:0034971.def: one of several small clusters of chemoreceptors, baroreceptors, and supporting cells located along the aortic arch.

UBERON:0034972.name: jugular body
UBERON:0034972.def: a nonchromaffin paraganglion located in the wall of the jugular bulb.

UBERON:0034978.name: paraganglion (generic)
UBERON:0034978.def: a cluster of neuroendocrine cells derived from neural crest. paraganglia may be chromaffin or nonchromaffin.

UBERON:0034979.name: nonchromaffin paraganglion
UBERON:0034979.def: a cluster of chemoreceptive and support cells associated with blood vessels and nerves.

UBERON:0034981.name: superior bulb of internal jugular vein

UBERON:0034982.name: inferior bulb of internal jugular vein

UBERON:0034983.name: ischial tuberosity
UBERON:0034983.def: a horizontal thickening onto which the muscles of the femur, such as the quadriceps and hamstring, attach.

UBERON:0034984.name: nerve to quadratus femoris
UBERON:0034984.def: the nerve to quadratus femoris is a nerve that provides innervation to the quadratus femoris and gemellus inferior muscles.
UBERON:0034984.synonym: nerve to the quadratus femoris muscle

UBERON:0034986.name: sacral nerve plexus
UBERON:0034986.def: a nerve plexus which provides motor and sensory nerves for the posterior thigh, most of the lower leg, the entire foot, and part of the pelvis.

UBERON:0034987.name: lumbar nerve plexus
UBERON:0034987.def: a nervous plexus in the lumbar region of the body which forms part of the lumbosacral plexus.

UBERON:0034993.name: basal ventral medial nucleus of thalamus

UBERON:0034995.name: jaw mesenchyme
UBERON:0034995.def: mesenchyme that is part of a developing jaw [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0034996.name: outer renal medulla loop of henle
UBERON:0034996.synonym: loop of henle, outer medullary portion

UBERON:0034999.name: posterolateral cortical amygdaloid nucleus
UBERON:0034999.synonym: posterolateral part of the cortical nucleus

UBERON:0035001.name: posteromedial cortical amygdaloid nucleus
UBERON:0035001.synonym: posteromedial part of the cortical nucleus

UBERON:0035014.name: functional part of brain
UBERON:0035014.def: a brain region defined by functional criteria, e.g. auditory cortex, rather than by structural or histological criteria.

UBERON:0035015.name: association cortex
UBERON:0035015.def: region of the cerebral cortex that integrates diverse sensory or motor information for purposeful action.

UBERON:0035017.name: nociceptor
UBERON:0035017.def: peripheral receptors for pain. nociceptors include receptors which are sensitive to painful mechanical stimuli, extreme heat or cold, and chemical stimuli. all nociceptors are free nerve endings.

UBERON:0035018.name: thermoreceptor
UBERON:0035018.def: cellular receptors which mediate the sense of temperature. thermoreceptors in vertebrates are mostly located under the skin. in mammals there are separate types of thermoreceptors for cold and for warmth and nociceptors which detect cold or heat extreme enough to cause pain.

UBERON:0035032.name: abdominal oblique muscle
UBERON:0035032.def: either the external or internal abdominal oblique muscles.

UBERON:0035034.name: eyelid epithelium
UBERON:0035034.def: an epithelium that is part of an eyelid [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0035036.name: naris epithelium
UBERON:0035036.def: an epithelium that is part of a naris [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0035038.name: carpal tunnel
UBERON:0035038.def: the fibro-osseous passageway on the palmar side of the wrist that connects the distal forearm to the middle compartment of the deep plane of the palm.

UBERON:0035040.name: superior rectal artery
UBERON:0035040.def: the superior rectal artery (superior hemorrhoidal artery) is an artery that descends into the pelvis to supply blood to the rectum.

UBERON:0035041.name: deep temporal artery
UBERON:0035041.def: the deep temporal arteries, two in number, anterior and posterior, ascend between the temporalis and the pericranium. they supply the muscle, and anastomose with the middle temporal artery. the anterior communicates with the lacrimal artery by means of small branches which perforate the zygomatic bone and great wing of the sphenoid.

UBERON:0035042.name: middle temporal artery
UBERON:0035042.def: the middle temporal artery arises immediately above the zygomatic arch, and, perforating the temporal fascia, gives branches to the temporalis, anastomosing with the deep temporal branches of the internal maxillary. it occasionally gives off a zygomaticoc6rbital branch, which runs along the upper border of the zygomatic arch, between the two layers of the temporal fascia, to the lateral angle of the orbit.

UBERON:0035043.name: temporal branch of lateral pretrosal artery
UBERON:0035043.def: part of lateral pretrosal artery which supplies blood to the eyelids.

UBERON:0035045.name: parotid gland intralobular duct
UBERON:0035045.def: any of the tubular canals of the parotid gland located within the parenchymal (secretory) tissue i.e. within lobules; both intercalated and striated (secretory) ducts are intralobular ducts.

UBERON:0035046.name: parotid gland intercalated duct
UBERON:0035046.def: any of the small intralobular tubular canal that leads directly from the serous acinus of the parotid gland to a striated (secretory) duct; in mouse, the intercalated ducts are short and narrow and are lined by low cuboidal epithelial cells with large central nuclei; they secrete bicarbonate ion into and absorb chloride ion from the acinar product.

UBERON:0035047.name: parotid gland striated duct
UBERON:0035047.def: any of the intralobular secretory duct of the parotid gland which connects an intercalated duct to an interlobular excretory duct; striated ducts are lined by cuboidal to columnar acidophilic cells and are so-named because of characteristic striations in the basal portions of the cells which are due to the alignment of mitochondria between deep infoldings of the basal cell membrane; the nucleus is in the central part of the cell above the striations; as they approach the excretory ducts, their diameter may exceed that of the acini; striated ducts reabsorb sodium and secrete potassium.

UBERON:0035048.name: parotid gland excretory duct
UBERON:0035048.def: any of the interlobular excretory ducts of the parotid gland which are found in the connective tissue septa and formed by the union of several intralobular striated (secretory) ducts; ultimately, the excretory ducts of the parotid gland coalesce and form a single main excretory duct (stensen's duct) that opens into the oral cavity; excretory ducts do not change the secretory product.

UBERON:0035049.name: excretory duct of salivary gland
UBERON:0035049.def: any of the interlobular excretory ducts of a salivary gland which are found in the connective tissue septa and formed by the union of several intralobular striated (secretory) ducts[mp,generalized].

UBERON:0035073.name: duct of eccrine sweat gland
UBERON:0035073.synonym: ductal part of eccrine sweat gland

UBERON:0035074.name: duct of apocrine sweat gland
UBERON:0035074.synonym: ductal part of apocrine sweat gland

UBERON:0035076.name: parotid gland myoepithelium
UBERON:0035076.def: epithelium that consists of stellate-shaped contractile cells with long dendritic processes that surround the secretory acini and intercalated ducts of the parotid gland, usually found in the glandular epithelium as a thin layer above the basement membrane but generally beneath the luminal cells; they display features of both smooth muscle and epithelium, such as numerous microfilaments with focal densities in the cytoplasmic processes, and desmosomes which attach them to the epithelial cells; their functions include contraction when the gland is stimulated to secrete, compressing or reinforcing the underlying parenchymal cells, thus aiding in the expulsion of saliva and preventing damage to the other cells.

UBERON:0035077.name: lateral nasal gland
UBERON:0035077.def: any of the lateral nasal glands (the largest nasal secretory glands in rodents) which surround the maxillary sinus located in the lateral wall adjacent to each nasal passage and are characterized by cytologic features similar to those described for the major serous salivary glands; secretory contents of the lng drain into the nasal vestibule; the lng is a major site for the synthesis and secretion of odorant-binding proteins that serve as odorant carriers in nasal mucus; it also, synthesizes large amounts of immunoglobulin a, which is important for immune defense of the upper respiratory tract, and testosterone and salivary androgen-binding proteins, which are likely important in olfaction and reproductive behavior.

UBERON:0035078.name: parotid gland interlobular duct
UBERON:0035078.def: any of the excretory ducts of the parotid gland which are found in the connective tissue septa i.e. between lobules.

UBERON:0035079.name: deep intraparotid lymph node
UBERON:0035079.def: the intraglandular deep parotid lymph nodes are a group of lymph nodes found inside the parotid gland.

UBERON:0035083.name: transverse process-bearing vertebra
UBERON:0035083.def: a vertebra that has a transverse process.

UBERON:0035084.name: non-transverse process-bearing vertebra
UBERON:0035084.def: a vertebra that does not have a transverse process.

UBERON:0035085.name: anatomical plane
UBERON:0035085.def: a flat anatomical 2d surface that bisects an anatomical structure or an anatomical space.

UBERON:0035086.name: plane of autotomy
UBERON:0035086.def: an anatomical plane that bisects a zone of weakness in an appendage. when autotamy occurs, the appendage divides along this plane.

UBERON:0035087.name: fracture plane
UBERON:0035087.def: a plane of autotomy that divides an appendage through a bone.

UBERON:0035088.name: vertebral fracture plane
UBERON:0035088.def: a plane of autotomy that divides an appendage through a vertebral bone.
UBERON:0035088.synonym: plane of autotomy bisecting vertebral bone

UBERON:0035089.name: plane of autotomy bisecting joint
UBERON:0035089.def: a plane of autotomy that divides an appendage in the space between appendage bones.

UBERON:0035090.name: plane of autotomy bisecting intervertebral joint
UBERON:0035090.def: a plane of autotomy that divides an appendage in the space between vertebrae.

UBERON:0035091.name: extrinsic post-anal tail muscle
UBERON:0035091.def: a post-anal tail that attaches outside the tail.

UBERON:0035092.name: spinalis caudalis muscle
UBERON:0035092.def: a muscle that originates via thin tendons from the proximal and dorsal aspects of the neural spines and inserts via fleshy fibers onto the lateral aspect of the base of the neural arch.

UBERON:0035094.name: extensor caudae medialis muscle
UBERON:0035094.def: a muscle that originates via thin tendons from the distal and dorsal aspects of the neural spines. the tendons course proximomedially to distolaterally and give rise to fleshy fibers that insert onto the lateral aspect of the neural arches of each of the vertebrae it crosses. the m. extensor caudae medialis is a continuation of m. semispinalis dorsi into the tail.

UBERON:0035095.name: extensor caudae lateralis muscle
UBERON:0035095.def: a muscle that originates via a robust tendon from a tuberosity on the cranial aspect of the iliac crest and via fleshy fibers from the caudoventral aspect of the pelvis, the lateral aspects of the transverse processes of ca2-8 or 9, and the horizontal intramuscular septum.

UBERON:0035097.name: iliocaudalis muscle
UBERON:0035097.def: a muscle that attaches to the iliac crest and to a caudal vertebra.

UBERON:0035098.name: hemipenis transversus muscle
UBERON:0035098.def: a muscle that overlies the hemipenis.

UBERON:0035099.name: transversus perinei muscle
UBERON:0035099.def: a muscle in females that overlies the soft tissue related to the cloaca, where the hemipenes are located in males.

UBERON:0035100.name: retractor penis magnus muscle
UBERON:0035100.def: a tube-like muscle attaches to the distal tip of the hemipenis and inserts onto the transverse processes of a caudal vertebra.

UBERON:0035102.name: transverse process of caudal vertebra
UBERON:0035102.def: a transverse process that is part of a caudal vertebra.

UBERON:0035103.name: perineal body smooth muscle muscle tissue

UBERON:0035105.name: sac of scrotum
UBERON:0035105.def: any of the two testis-carrying compartments of the scrotum.

UBERON:0035106.name: raphe of perineum
UBERON:0035106.def: the perineal raphe extends from the anus, through the mid-line of the scrotum (scrotal raphe) and upwards through the posterior mid-line aspect of the penis (penile raphe).

UBERON:0035108.name: temporalis fascia
UBERON:0035108.def: the temporal fascia covers the temporalis muscle. it is a strong, fibrous investment, covered, laterally, by the auricularis anterior and superior, by the galea aponeurotica, and by part of the orbicularis oculi. the superficial temporal vessels and the auriculotemporal nerve cross it from below upward. above, it is a single layer, attached to the entire extent of the superior temporal line; but below, where it is fixed to the zygomatic arch, it consists of two layers, one of which is inserted into the lateral, and the other into the medial border of the arch. a small quantity of fat, the orbital branch of the superficial temporal artery, and a filament from the zygomatic branch of the maxillary nerve, are contained between these two layers. it affords attachment by its deep surface to the superficial fibers of the temporalis.

UBERON:0035109.name: plantar nerve
UBERON:0035109.def: a nerve that innervates the sole of the foot. planar nerves arise from the posterior branch of the tibial nerve.

UBERON:0035110.name: lateral plantar nerve
UBERON:0035110.def: a plantar nerve that supplies the lateral side of the plantar part of the foot, including pedal digit 5.

UBERON:0035111.name: medial plantar nerve
UBERON:0035111.def: a plantar nerve that supplies the medial side of the plantar part of the foot, including pedal digit 1.

UBERON:0035112.name: intrinsic muscle
UBERON:0035112.def: any of the muscles that are entirely within the body part or segment moved by them.

UBERON:0035113.name: central part of mediodorsal nucleus of the thalamus
UBERON:0035113.synonym: mediodorsal nucleus of the thalamus, central part

UBERON:0035114.name: lateral part of mediodorsal nucleus of the thalamus
UBERON:0035114.synonym: mediodorsal nucleus of the thalamus, lateral part

UBERON:0035115.name: diastema between central incisors
UBERON:0035115.def: a space or gap between the left and right central incisors, on either the upper or lower jaw.

UBERON:0035116.name: diastema between upper central incisors
UBERON:0035116.def: a space or gap between the left and right central incisors on the upper jaw.

UBERON:0035117.name: diastema between lower central incisors
UBERON:0035117.def: a space or gap between the left and right central incisors on the lower jaw.

UBERON:0035118.name: material entity in digestive tract
UBERON:0035118.def: any material entity that is located in the digestive tract. this includes undigested food and liquid as well as unexcreted waste products. it also includes other entities such as ingested stones used to aid digestion. any microbial cells or cell populations are also included.

UBERON:0035119.name: diastema between incisors
UBERON:0035119.def: a space or gap any two incisors. this may be a midline diastema between central incisors, or a diastema located entirely in a single jaw quadrant between lateral incisors.

UBERON:0035120.name: fauces
UBERON:0035120.def: lateral walls of the oropharynx that are located medial to the palatoglossal folds.

UBERON:0035122.name: interincisive suture
UBERON:0035122.def: median palatine suture of the palatine processes of the maxillary bones, and the median suture of the palatine bones.

UBERON:0035123.name: palatomaxillary suture
UBERON:0035123.def: line of union, in the floor of the orbit, between the orbital process of the palatine bone and the orbital surface of the maxilla.

UBERON:0035124.name: palatoethmoidal suture
UBERON:0035124.def: a line of junction of the orbital process of the palatine bone and the orbital plate of the ethmoid.

UBERON:0035126.name: transverse palatine suture
UBERON:0035126.def: the line of junction between the processes of the maxilla and the horizontal parts of the palatine bones that form the hard palate.

UBERON:0035127.name: suture of hard palate
UBERON:0035127.def: any of the sutures of the hard palate.

UBERON:0035133.name: longitudinal arch of pes
UBERON:0035133.def: a curved region of the skeleton of the pes (foot) formed by the tarsal and metatarsal bones.

UBERON:0035139.name: anterior nasal spine of maxilla
UBERON:0035139.def: a pointed projection at the front extremity of the intermaxillary suture.

UBERON:0035144.name: preputial space
UBERON:0035144.def: space between the prepuce and glans penis or clitoris.

UBERON:0035147.name: axochord
UBERON:0035147.def: a medial muscle found in the ventral midline of annelid embryos.

UBERON:0035148.name: presumptive axochord
UBERON:0035148.def: contractile mesodermal midline cells in the ventral midline of annelid embryos that give rise to the axochord.

UBERON:0035150.name: superior cerebral vein
UBERON:0035150.def: the superior cerebral veins, eight to twelve in number, drain the superior, lateral, and medial surfaces of the hemispheres, and are mainly lodged in the sulci between the gyri, but some run across the gyri. they open into the superior sagittal sinus; the anterior veins runs nearly at right angles to the sinus; the posterior and larger veins are directed obliquely forward and open into the sinus in a direction more or less opposed to the current of the blood contained within it.

UBERON:0035152.name: internal cerebral vein
UBERON:0035152.def: the internal cerebral veins (veins of galen; deep cerebral veins) drain the deep parts of the hemisphere and are two in number; each is formed near the interventricular foramen by the union of the terminal and choroid veins. they run backward parallel with one another, between the layers of the tela chorioidea of the third ventricle, and beneath the splenium of the corpus callosum, where they unite to form a short trunk, the great cerebral vein; just before their union each receives the corresponding basal vein.

UBERON:0035153.name: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex layer 1
UBERON:0035153.def: most superficial layer of the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlpfc).
UBERON:0035153.synonym: layer i of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex

UBERON:0035154.name: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex layer 2
UBERON:0035154.def: layer 2 of neocortex lying just deep to superficial layer 1 of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
UBERON:0035154.synonym: layer ii of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex

UBERON:0035155.name: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex layer 3
UBERON:0035155.def: layer 3 of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex lying deep to the layer 2 and cytoarchitectonically defined by numerous small pyramidal neurons.
UBERON:0035155.synonym: layer iii of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex

UBERON:0035156.name: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex layer 4
UBERON:0035156.def: layer 4 of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex lying deep to the external pyramidal layer and cytoarchitectonically defined by presence of small cells.
UBERON:0035156.synonym: granular layer iv of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex

UBERON:0035157.name: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex layer 5
UBERON:0035157.def: layer 5 of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex lying deep to the internal granule cell layer 4 and cytoarchitectonically divisible into layers 5a and 5b. layer 5a is characterized by the predominance of large pyramidal cell bodies. layer 5b is pale in comparison.
UBERON:0035157.synonym: layer v of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex

UBERON:0035158.name: dorsolateral prefrontal cortex layer 6
UBERON:0035158.def: innermost layer of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex lying deep to the internal pyramidal cell layer 5. it is cytoarchitectonically defined in the dlpfc by cells of varying sizes. dlpfc layer 6a is characterized by more neurons and layer 6b has comparatively more glia.
UBERON:0035158.synonym: layer vi of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex

UBERON:0035159.name: entire surface of organism
UBERON:0035159.def: anatomical surface, which is the external surface of the whole body. examples: there is only one body surface.

UBERON:0035162.name: infraclavicular lymph node
UBERON:0035162.def: a lymph node located in the area below the clavicle.

UBERON:0035165.name: posterior surface of prostate
UBERON:0035165.def: the flattened aspect of the prostate with a slight furrow facing the rectum and anus.

UBERON:0035174.name: right ear
UBERON:0035174.def: the organ of hearing located on the right side of the head.

UBERON:0035177.name: abdominal part of esophagus
UBERON:0035177.def: clinical esophageal segment composed of smooth muscle. it corresponds to the inferior part of the lower third topographic segment of the esophagus.

UBERON:0035180.name: sigmoid artery
UBERON:0035180.def: the sigmoid arteries, two or three in number, run obliquely downward and to the left behind the peritoneum and in front of the psoas major, ureter, and internal spermatic vessels. their branches supply the lower part of the descending colon, the iliac colon, and the sigmoid or pelvic colon; anastomosing above with the left colic, and below with the superior hemorrhoidal artery.

UBERON:0035183.name: calcarine artery
UBERON:0035183.def: an artery that branches from the medial occipital artery that aligns with the calcarine sulcus.

UBERON:0035195.name: plantar metatarsal artery
UBERON:0035195.def: the plantar metatarsal arteries (digital branches) are four in number, and run forward between the metatarsal bones and in contact with the interossei. each divides into a pair of plantar digital arteries which supply the adjacent sides of the toes. near their points of division each sends upward an anterior perforating branch to join the corresponding dorsal metatarsal artery. the first plantar metatarsal artery (arteria princeps hallucis) springs from the junction between the lateral plantar and deep plantar arteries and sends a digital branch to the medial side of the first toe. the digital branch for the lateral side of the fifth toe arise from the lateral plantar artery near the base of the fifth metatarsal bone.
UBERON:0035195.synonym: plantar metatarsal branch of plantar arch

UBERON:0035198.name: superficial lymphatic vessel
UBERON:0035198.def: the tubules that carry lymph throughout the body that are just beneath the surface of the skin.

UBERON:0035201.name: gastrocolic ligament
UBERON:0035201.def: a major portion of the greater omentum between the stomach and the transverse colon.

UBERON:0035204.name: occipital lymph node
UBERON:0035204.def: a lymph node located in the back of the head adjacent to the trapezius muscle.

UBERON:0035207.name: deep fibular nerve
UBERON:0035207.def: a branch of the common peroneal nerve. it innervates the ankle and toes.

UBERON:0035210.name: paracolic gutter
UBERON:0035210.def: the paracolic gutters (paracolic sulci, paracolic recesses) are spaces between the colon and the abdominal wall. there are two paracolic gutters: the right lateral paracolic gutter. the left lateral paracolic gutter. these gutters are clinically important because they allow a passage for infectious fluids from different compartments of the abdomen. for example; fluid from an infected appendix can track up the right paracolic gutter to the hepatorenal recess.

UBERON:0035213.name: basal zone of heart
UBERON:0035213.def: the superior portion of the heart located opposite to the apical portion. it is formed mainly by the left atrium.

UBERON:0035216.name: thoracic part of esophagus
UBERON:0035216.def: zone of esophagus located in the thorax.

UBERON:0035219.name: parasternal lymph node
UBERON:0035219.def: any of the lymph nodes of the breast located under the ribcage, near the sternum.

UBERON:0035225.name: anterior temporal artery
UBERON:0035225.def: a branch of the middle cerebral artery that supplies blood to the anterior part of the temporal lobe.

UBERON:0035228.name: tonsillar fossa
UBERON:0035228.def: between the plica triangularis and the surface of the palatine tonsils is a space known as the tonsillar fossa (or tonsillar sinus); in many cases, however, this sinus is obliterated by its walls becoming adherent.

UBERON:0035231.name: superficial middle cerebral vein
UBERON:0035231.def: a vein that runs along the fissure of sylvius to the cavernous sinus on the lateral surface of the brain and connects to the superior sagittal and transverse sinuses.

UBERON:0035234.name: medial circumflex femoral vein
UBERON:0035234.def: a circumflex femoral vein that accompanies the medial circumflex femoral artery.

UBERON:0035243.name: anal sinus
UBERON:0035243.def: furrows, with pouchlike recesses at the lower end, separating the rectal columns.

UBERON:0035249.name: posterior external jugular vein
UBERON:0035249.def: a vein that drains the superficial muscles and integument of the upper back portion of the neck into the external jugular vein.

UBERON:0035252.name: left subcostal vein
UBERON:0035252.def: a vein that extends along the bottom of the twelfth rib on the left side of the body.

UBERON:0035258.name: mons pubis
UBERON:0035258.def: a structure composed of adipose tissue lying above the pubic bone of adult women, anterior to the symphysis pubis. the mons pubis forms the anterior portion of the vulva, and limits the perineal region proximally and anteriorly.

UBERON:0035267.name: neck of gallbladder
UBERON:0035267.def: the narrowest portion of the gallbladder and distal to the cystic duct.

UBERON:0035273.name: superior thoracic artery
UBERON:0035273.def: the superior thoracic artery (highest thoracic artery) is a small vessel normally arising from the first division of the axillary artery, but may arise from the thoracoacromial artery, itself a branch of the second division of the axillary artery. running forward and medialward along the upper border of the pectoralis minor, the superior thoracic artery passes between it and the pectoralis major to the side of the chest. it supplies branches to the first and second intercostal spaces as well as to the superior portion of serratus anterior. it anastomoses with the internal mammary and intercostal arteries.

UBERON:0035276.name: epigastrium
UBERON:0035276.def: the upper central region of the abdomen between the costal margins and the subcostal plane.

UBERON:0035279.name: supraclavicular lymph node
UBERON:0035279.def: a lymph node which is located above the clavicle.

UBERON:0035289.name: axillary tail of breast
UBERON:0035289.def: an extension of the tissue of the breast which extends into the axilla.

UBERON:0035295.name: left ear
UBERON:0035295.def: the organ of hearing located on the left side of the head[ncit,modified].

UBERON:0035298.name: tuberculum sellae
UBERON:0035298.def: an elevated zone of the sella turcica behind the chiasmatic groove[wp,modified].

UBERON:0035310.name: inferolateral surface of prostate
UBERON:0035310.def: the aspect of the prostate facing the pelvic diaphragm and pubis.

UBERON:0035316.name: prostatic capsule
UBERON:0035316.def: the membrane the surrounds the prostate gland.

UBERON:0035319.name: anterior median fissure of spinal cord
UBERON:0035319.def: a fissure in the midline of the anterior surface of the spinal cord.
UBERON:0035319.synonym: ventral median fissure of spinal cord

UBERON:0035322.name: right common iliac artery
UBERON:0035322.synonym: trunk of right common iliac arterial tree

UBERON:0035328.name: upper outer quadrant of breast
UBERON:0035328.def: the quarter of the breast which is superior and lateral.
UBERON:0035328.synonym: upper outer quadrant of female breast

UBERON:0035331.name: base of prostate
UBERON:0035331.def: the uppermost part of the prostate gland adjacent to the bladder wall.

UBERON:0035338.name: sphenoparietal sinus
UBERON:0035338.def: the cavernous sinus receives the superior ophthalmic vein through the superior orbital fissure, some of the cerebral veins, and also the small sphenoparietal sinus, which courses along the under surface of the small wing of the sphenoid.

UBERON:0035341.name: posterior lobe of prostate
UBERON:0035341.def: the prostate gland lobe that is located on the posterior side of the organ.

UBERON:0035365.name: lower outer quadrant of breast
UBERON:0035365.def: the quarter of the breast which is inferior and lateral.
UBERON:0035365.synonym: lower outer quadrant of female breast

UBERON:0035368.name: anterior surface of kidney
UBERON:0035368.def: the aspect of the kidney facing the abdominal cavity.

UBERON:0035371.name: retroperitoneal lymph node
UBERON:0035371.def: a lymph node located in the retroperitoneal space.

UBERON:0035374.name: small cardiac vein
UBERON:0035374.def: a vein running parallel to the right coronary artery in the coronary sulcus that drains into the right extremity of the coronary sinus.

UBERON:0035377.name: transverse fold of rectum
UBERON:0035377.def: one of the semi-lunar transverse folds of the rectal wall that protrude into the anal canal.

UBERON:0035380.name: branch of anterior cerebral artery
UBERON:0035380.def: an arterial branch arising from the anterior cerebral artery. it includes the callosomarginal artery, frontopolar artery, medial orbitofrontal artery, pericallosal artery, and recurrent artery of heubner.

UBERON:0035392.name: cystic vein
UBERON:0035392.def: a blood vessel carrying deoxygenated blood from the gallbladder and the cystic duct into the right branch of the portal vein.

UBERON:0035403.name: hypophysial artery
UBERON:0035403.def: an artery that supplies the pituitary gland.

UBERON:0035404.name: superior hypophysial artery
UBERON:0035404.def: the superior hypophysial artery is an artery supplying the pars tuberalis,the infundibulum of the pituitary gland and the median eminence. it is a branch of the posterior communicating artery which branches from the internal carotid artery in the circle of willis..

UBERON:0035416.name: diaphragma sellae
UBERON:0035416.def: the diaphragma sellae or sellar diaphragm is the circular fold of dura mater that almost completely roofs the fossa hypophyseos in the sphenoid bone of the skull. it retains the pituitary gland in the fossa hypophyseos, with only the infundibulum of the pituitary gland passing through it.

UBERON:0035419.name: anterior longitudinal ligament
UBERON:0035419.def: a ligament running the length of the anterior surface of the spinal column and thereby interconnects all the vertebral bodies.

UBERON:0035422.name: circumflex branch of left coronary artery
UBERON:0035422.def: branch of left coronary artery which runs perpendicular to the anterior interventricular branch of the left coronary artery on the left side of the interventricular sulcus and supplies the left side of the heart.

UBERON:0035425.name: falx cerebelli
UBERON:0035425.def: a small triangular process of dura matter beginning at the internal occipital crest just beneath the tentorium and projecting forward.

UBERON:0035431.name: mediastinal pleura
UBERON:0035431.def: the parietal pleura that lines the mediastinum.

UBERON:0035435.name: right suprarenal vein
UBERON:0035435.def: a vein that drains blood from the right adrenal gland into the inferior vena cava.
