UBERON:0035438.name: mucoid tissue
UBERON:0035438.def: loose connective tissue, the intercellular matrix of which consists predominantly of mucoid ground substance. examples: mucoid tissue of umbilical cord, mucoid tissue of vitreous body, mucoid tissue of nucleus pulposus.

UBERON:0035441.name: apex of prostate
UBERON:0035441.def: the lowest part of the prostate gland adjacent to the superior fascia of the urogenital diaphragm.

UBERON:0035445.name: urogenital diaphragm
UBERON:0035445.def: muscular components of the deep perineal pouch.

UBERON:0035450.name: cervical part of esophagus
UBERON:0035450.def: clinical esophageal segment composed of skeletal muscle. it corresponds to the superior part of the upper third topographic segment of the esophagus.

UBERON:0035462.name: anterior parietal artery
UBERON:0035462.def: the artery that delivers blood to the anterior portion of the parietal lobe.

UBERON:0035465.name: endometrial cavity
UBERON:0035465.def: a space inside the uterus lined by a layer of mucus membranes called the endometrium.

UBERON:0035468.name: costodiaphragmatic recess
UBERON:0035468.def: the angled junction where the diaphragm meets the chest wall.

UBERON:0035474.name: right subcostal vein
UBERON:0035474.def: a vein that extends along the bottom of the twelfth rib on the right side of the body.

UBERON:0035477.name: lower inner quadrant of breast
UBERON:0035477.def: the quarter of the breast which is inferior and medial.
UBERON:0035477.synonym: lower inner quadrant of female breast

UBERON:0035480.name: surface of prostate
UBERON:0035480.def: the external portion of the prostate including the anterior, inferolateral, lateral and posterior surfaces.

UBERON:0035483.name: left suprarenal vein
UBERON:0035483.def: a vein that drains blood from the left adrenal gland into the left renal artery.

UBERON:0035492.name: inferior hypophysial artery
UBERON:0035492.def: the inferior hypophysial artery is an artery supplying the pituitary gland. it is a branch of the cavernous carotid artery (internal carotid artery).

UBERON:0035495.name: hilum of lymph node
UBERON:0035495.def: the concave side of the lymph node.

UBERON:0035498.name: gastrophrenic ligament
UBERON:0035498.def: the portion of the greater omentum that extends from the greater curvature of the stomach to the inferior surface of the diaphragm.

UBERON:0035501.name: unencapsulated tactile receptor
UBERON:0035501.def: free nerve endings are widely distributed throughout the body, and are found as branches of unmyelinated, or lightly myelinated fibres grouped in bundles beneath the epithelium. as they penetrate the epithelium, they lose their myelin, and branch among the epithelial cells. branches of one nerve may cover a wide area and overlap the territories of other nerves. the free nerve endings detect pain, touch, pressure and temperature, and are associated with c fibres.

UBERON:0035520.name: anterior mediastinal lymph node
UBERON:0035520.def: a lymph node located in the superior mediastinum that collects lymph from the thymus, the pericardium, and the right side of the heart.

UBERON:0035523.name: anterior surface of prostate
UBERON:0035523.def: the aspect of the prostate facing the pubic symphysis.

UBERON:0035526.name: superficial fibular nerve
UBERON:0035526.def: a branch of the common fibular nerve that innervates the fibularis longus and brevis muscles, and via branches innervates parts of the dorsal part of the pes.

UBERON:0035529.name: left common iliac artery
UBERON:0035529.synonym: trunk of left common iliac arterial tree

UBERON:0035530.name: basal vein
UBERON:0035530.def: the basal vein is formed at the anterior perforated substance by the union of (a) a small anterior cerebral vein which accompanies the anterior cerebral artery and supplies the medial surface of the frontal lobe by the fronto-basal vein. (b) the deep middle cerebral vein (deep sylvian vein), which receives tributaries from the insula and neighboring gyri, and runs in the lower part of the lateral cerebral fissure, and (c) the inferior striate veins, which leave the corpus striatum through the anterior perforated substance. the basal vein passes backward around the cerebral peduncle, and ends in the internal cerebral vein; it receives tributaries from the interpeduncular fossa, the inferior horn of the lateral ventricle, the hippocampal gyrus, and the mid-brain.

UBERON:0035532.name: deep middle cerebral vein
UBERON:0035532.def: the blood vessel that receives deoxygenated blood from the insula and gyri and drains into the basal vein of rosenthal deep in the lateral sulcus.

UBERON:0035536.name: body of gallbladder
UBERON:0035536.def: the middle portion of the gallbladder which is distal to the gallbladder neck and proximal to the gallbladder fundus.

UBERON:0035539.name: esophageal artery
UBERON:0035539.def: any of several arteries that arise from the aorta and supply blood to the esophagus.

UBERON:0035542.name: upper inner quadrant of breast
UBERON:0035542.def: the quarter of the breast which is superior and medial.
UBERON:0035542.synonym: upper inner quadrant of female breast

UBERON:0035545.name: deep lymphatic vessel
UBERON:0035545.def: the tubules that carry lymph throughout the body that are in the interior of the body or limbs.

UBERON:0035547.name: posterior ciliary vein
UBERON:0035547.def: the outer layer of the choroid (lamina vasculosa) consists, in part, of the larger branches of the short ciliary arteries which run forward between the veins, before they bend inward to end in the capillaries, but is formed principally of veins, named, from their arrangement, the vorticose veins. they converge to four or five equidistant trunks, which pierce the sclera about midway between the sclero-corneal junction and the entrance of the optic nerve. they drain uveal tract.

UBERON:0035549.name: vasculature of integument
UBERON:0035549.def: the part of the circulatory system that lies within the subcutaneous tissue layers close to the surface of the skin.

UBERON:0035550.name: superficial vein
UBERON:0035550.def: any of the veins carrying deoxygenated blood from the subcutaneous tissue layers.

UBERON:0035551.name: deep vasculature
UBERON:0035551.def: the part of the circulatory system that lies deep beneath the subcutaneous tissue layers away from the surface of the skin.

UBERON:0035552.name: deep vein
UBERON:0035552.def: a blood vessel carrying deoxygenated blood far beneath the skin usually accompanying an artery.

UBERON:0035553.name: left cardiac chamber
UBERON:0035553.def: any chamber of the left side of the heart.

UBERON:0035554.name: right cardiac chamber
UBERON:0035554.def: any chamber of the right side of the heart.

UBERON:0035560.name: obsolete fascia dentata
UBERON:0035560.def: obsolete: the fascia dentata is the earliest stage of the hippocampal circuit. its primary input is the perforant path from the superficial layers of entorhinal cortex. its principal neurons are tiny granule cells which give rise to unmyelinated axons called the mossy fibers which project to the hilus and ca3. the fascia dentata of the rat contains approximately 1,000,000 granule cells. it receives feedback connections from mossy cells in the hilus at distant levels in the septal and temporal directions. the fascia dentata and the hilus together make up the dentate gyrus. as with all regions of the hippocampus, the dentate gyrus also receives gabaergic and cholinergic input from the medial septum and the diagonal band of broca.

UBERON:0035561.name: styliform element
UBERON:0035561.def: an unjointed, rod-like bony or cartilaginous structures that extend from distal limb joints in tetrapods.

UBERON:0035563.name: magnocellular superficial pretectal nucleus
UBERON:0035563.def: a nucleus that is part of the superficial pretectum and is characterized by large widely scattered cells.

UBERON:0035564.name: parvocellular superficial pretectal nucleus
UBERON:0035564.def: a nucleus that is part of the superficial pretectum and is characterized by small cells.

UBERON:0035565.name: caudal pretectal nucleus
UBERON:0035565.def: diencephalic nucleus that is part of the superficial pretectum and is rostrally contiguous with the magnocellular superficial pretectal nucleus. cells of the caudal pretectal nucleus are slightly smaller and less orderly around a central neuropil than those of the magnocellular superficial pretectal nucleus. from neuroanatomy of the zebrafish brain.

UBERON:0035566.name: central pretectal nucleus
UBERON:0035566.def: any nucleus found in the central pretectum.

UBERON:0035567.name: accessory pretectal nucleus
UBERON:0035567.def: diencephalic nucleus that is part of the central pretectum and lies dorsolateral to the caudal pretectal nucleus. from neuroanatomy of the zebrafish brain.

UBERON:0035568.name: superficial pretectal nucleus
UBERON:0035568.def: any nucleus found in the superficial pretectum.

UBERON:0035569.name: periventricular pretectal nucleus
UBERON:0035569.def: a nucleus medial to the central pretectal nucleus in the periventricular zone.

UBERON:0035572.name: nucleus praetectalis profundus
UBERON:0035572.def: a neural nucleus of the pretectal region that lies lateral to the posterior commissure and gives rise to widespread projections.

UBERON:0035586.name: nucleus lentiformis mesencephali (aves)
UBERON:0035586.def: a pretectal nucleus in aves that receives heavy retinal input and is hypothesized to be homologous to the nucleus of the optic tract of mammals.

UBERON:0035588.name: subpretectal complex of aves
UBERON:0035588.def: a nuclear complex in the ventral pretectal region.

UBERON:0035594.name: accessory optic system
UBERON:0035594.def: subdivision of visual system that processes movements of images across retina and regulates the movement of eyes to keep the image stable.

UBERON:0035596.name: circular nucleus of antherior hypothalamic nucleus
UBERON:0035596.def: a group of cells located in the central part of the anterior hypothalamic nucleus in the anterior hypothalamic region of the rat ( swanson-2004 ) and the mouse ( paxinos-2001 ). functionally it belongs to the magnocellular neuroendocrine cell groups of the subcortical motor system ( swanson-2004 ).

UBERON:0035597.name: profundal placode
UBERON:0035597.def: an embryonic structure positioned halfway between the prospective eye and ear, adjacent to the future midbrain-hindbrain boundary. the profundal and the trigeminal ganglia are separate distally but fused at their proximal end as they condense around nf stage 24.

UBERON:0035599.name: profundal part of trigeminal ganglion complex

UBERON:0035601.name: maxillomandibular part of trigeminal ganglion complex

UBERON:0035602.name: collar nerve cord
UBERON:0035602.def: a nerve tract found in marine worms that is located in the collar body region (three body regions in marine worms: proboscis, collar (extending into tentacle-fringed arms) and trunk).

UBERON:0035603.name: enteropneust proboscis
UBERON:0035603.def: anteriormost of the three body regions of an enteropneust.

UBERON:0035604.name: enteropneust collar
UBERON:0035604.def: middle of the three body regions of an enteropneust.

UBERON:0035605.name: enteropneust trunk
UBERON:0035605.def: posteriormost of the three body regions of an enteropneust.

UBERON:0035607.name: accessory nerve cord of dorsal region
UBERON:0035607.def: any longitudinally extending condensed cluster of neurons and processes that runs along the dorsal mid-line of the animal that is not the most prominent nerve cord.

UBERON:0035608.name: dura mater lymph vessel
UBERON:0035608.def: any lymph vessel that is located in the dura mater of the brain.

UBERON:0035609.name: outer root sheath companion layer
UBERON:0035609.def: the innermost layer of the outer root sheath.

UBERON:0035610.name: hair canal
UBERON:0035610.def: tubular connection between the epidermal surface and the most distal part of the inner root sheath. contains the hair shaft.

UBERON:0035611.name: hair peg
UBERON:0035611.def: column of keratinocytes growing into the dermis during embryonic hair follicle development. the concave proximal end starts to encase the dermal condensate, the future dermal papilla.

UBERON:0035612.name: nasal turbinal
UBERON:0035612.def: a skeletal element of the ethmoid region with complex morphology that are lined with mucuous membranes involved in either olfaction or air conditioning.

UBERON:0035617.name: peripharyngeal space
UBERON:0035617.def: the space filled with loose areolar tissue surrounding the pharynx; it is divided into two major divisions, the parapharyngeal space and the retropharyngeal space.

UBERON:0035618.name: parapharyngeal space
UBERON:0035618.def: the portion of the peripharyngeal space limited by the lateral wall of the pharynx, the cervical vertebrae and medial pterygoid muscle.

UBERON:0035619.name: retropharyngeal space
UBERON:0035619.def: the portion of the peripharyngeal space that is located posterior to the pharynx.

UBERON:0035634.name: quadrant of breast
UBERON:0035634.def: the part of the breast that is bordered by the intermammary line and a perpendicular line bisecting the nipple.

UBERON:0035639.name: ocular adnexa
UBERON:0035639.def: the parts of the orbital region that are outside of the the eyeball, including the lacrimal apparatus, the extraocular muscles and the eyelids, eyelashes, eyebrows and the conjunctiva.

UBERON:0035640.name: middle vesical artery
UBERON:0035640.def: the middle vesical artery, usually a branch of the superior vesical artery, is distributed to the fundus of the bladder and the seminal vesicles.

UBERON:0035642.name: laryngeal nerve
UBERON:0035642.def: any nerve that innervates the larynx.

UBERON:0035646.name: anterior superior alveolar nerve
UBERON:0035646.def: the anterior superior alveolar branch (anterior superior dental branch), of considerable size, is given off from the maxillary nerve just before its exit from the infraorbital foramen; it descends in a canal in the anterior wall of the maxillary sinus, and divides into branches which supply the incisor and canine teeth. it communicates with the middle superior alveolar branch, and gives off a nasal branch, which passes through a minute canal in the lateral wall of the inferior meatus, and supplies the mucous membrane of the anterior part of the inferior meatus and the floor of the nasal cavity, communicating with the nasal branches from the sphenopalatine ganglion.

UBERON:0035647.name: posterior auricular nerve
UBERON:0035647.def: a branch of the facial nerve that innervates the posterior auricular and intrinsic muscles of the auricle and, through its occipital branch, innervates the occipital belly of the occipitofrontal muscle.
UBERON:0035647.synonym: posterior auricular branch of the facial

UBERON:0035648.name: nerve innervating pinna
UBERON:0035648.def: any nerve that innervates the pinna.

UBERON:0035649.name: nerve of penis
UBERON:0035649.def: any nerve that innervates the penis.

UBERON:0035650.name: nerve of clitoris
UBERON:0035650.def: any nerve that innervates the clitoris.

UBERON:0035652.name: fibular nerve
UBERON:0035652.def: any nerve that innervates the fibularis. includes the common fibular nerve, and its branches.

UBERON:0035655.name: paraumbilical vein
UBERON:0035655.def: the small superficial veins that arise from the cutaneous veins, and run from the umbilicus along the round ligament of the liver; these terminate as accessory portal veins in the liver.

UBERON:0035659.name: deep facial vein
UBERON:0035659.def: the anterior facial vein receives a branch of considerable size, the deep facial vein, from the pterygoid venous plexus.

UBERON:0035675.name: anterior facial vein
UBERON:0035675.def: a vein that represents a continuation of the angular vein and lies behind the facial artery.

UBERON:0035765.name: subsegmental lymph node
UBERON:0035765.def: the lymph nodes around the subsegmental bronchi.

UBERON:0035766.name: median lobe of prostate
UBERON:0035766.def: the upper, smaller part of the prostate between the ejaculatory ducts and the urethra.

UBERON:0035768.name: coccygeal nerve plexus
UBERON:0035768.def: the coccygeal plexus is a plexus of nerves near the coccyx bone.

UBERON:0035770.name: inferior mesenteric nerve plexus
UBERON:0035770.def: the inferior mesenteric plexus is derived chiefly from the aortic plexus. it surrounds the inferior mesenteric artery, and divides into a number of secondary plexuses, which are distributed to all the parts supplied by the artery, viz. , the left colic and sigmoid plexuses, which supply the descending and sigmoid parts of the colon; and the superior hemorrhoidal plexus, which supplies the rectum and joins in the pelvis with branches from the pelvic plexuses.

UBERON:0035773.name: abdominal nerve plexus
UBERON:0035773.def: the abdominal aortic plexus (aortic plexus) is formed by branches derived, on either side, from the celiac plexus and ganglia, and receives filaments from some of the lumbar ganglia. it is situated upon the sides and front of the aorta, between the origins of the superior and inferior mesenteric arteries. from this plexus arise part of the spermatic, the inferior mesenteric, and the hypogastric plexuses; it also distributes filaments to the inferior vena cava.

UBERON:0035774.name: thoracic aortic plexus
UBERON:0035774.def: the thoracic aortic plexus is a sympathetic plexus in the region of the thoracic aorta.

UBERON:0035775.name: submandibular region
UBERON:0035775.def: the region between the mandible and the hyoid bone that contains the submandibular and sublingual glands, suprahyoid muscles, submandibular ganglion, and lingual artery.

UBERON:0035776.name: accessory ciliary ganglion
UBERON:0035776.def: a parasympathetic ganglion located on the short ciliary nerve differentiated from the main ciliary ganglion by virtue of the fact that it had no root derived directly from the inferior trunk of the oculomotor nerve and it never attaches to this nerve.

UBERON:0035783.name: ganglion of ciliary nerve
UBERON:0035783.def: any parasympathetic ganglion that extends fibers into the short ciliary nerve. includes both the main and acccessory ciliary ganglia.

UBERON:0035784.name: seminal clot
UBERON:0035784.def: a portion of semen in a coagulated state.

UBERON:0035785.name: telencephalic song nucleus hvc
UBERON:0035785.def: a nucleus in the brain of songbirds located in the caudal nidopallium, projecting to the song motor pathway via the robust nucleus of the arcopallium and to the anterior forebrain pathway via the basal ganglia nucleus area x.

UBERON:0035802.name: alveus of ca2 field
UBERON:0035802.def: part of alveus lying within hippocampal sector ca2.

UBERON:0035803.name: extrapyramidal tract system
UBERON:0035803.def: a neural network located in the brain that is part of the motor system involved in the coordination of movement that is distinct from the pyramidal tract.

UBERON:0035804.name: future mouth
UBERON:0035804.def: the primordial mouth region of the developing head.

UBERON:0035805.name: muscle layer of sigmoid colon
UBERON:0035805.def: a muscle layer that is part of the sigmoid colon.

UBERON:0035806.name: hensen stripe
UBERON:0035806.def: the dark, nonstriated, v-shaped band (ridge) found on the underside of the tectorial membrane in the basal region of the cochlea, from which fine gelatinous trabeculae extend to fix the tm to the border cells, i.e. cells directly adjacent to the inner phalangeal cells.

UBERON:0035807.name: area x of basal ganglion
UBERON:0035807.def: a nucleus in the basal ganglion of songbirds.

UBERON:0035808.name: robust nucleus of arcopallium
UBERON:0035808.def: a specialized nucleus within the intermediate archistriatum of songbirds, required for and active during the production of learned song.

UBERON:0035814.name: pericardial fat
UBERON:0035814.def: the sum of epicardial and paracardial fat deposits.

UBERON:0035815.name: paracardial fat
UBERON:0035815.def: fat deposits in the mediastinum outside the parietal pericardium .

UBERON:0035818.name: visceral fat
UBERON:0035818.def: any fat deposit surrounding a visceral organ.

UBERON:0035819.name: abdominopelvic cavity
UBERON:0035819.def: the part of the ventral body cavity that is within the abdominal segment of the trunk, which encompasses the abdomen proper plus pelvic cavity.

UBERON:0035820.name: peritoneal sac
UBERON:0035820.def: a serous sac that is the aggregate of the peritoneum and the peritoneal cavity, located in the abdominal cavity.

UBERON:0035825.name: left adrenal gland cortex
UBERON:0035825.def: the thick outer layer of the adrenal gland that is in the left side of the abdomen.

UBERON:0035826.name: left adrenal gland medulla
UBERON:0035826.def: the adrenal gland medulla that is in the left side of the abdomen.

UBERON:0035827.name: right adrenal gland cortex
UBERON:0035827.def: the thick outer layer of the adrenal gland that is in the right side of the abdomen.

UBERON:0035828.name: right adrenal gland medulla
UBERON:0035828.def: the adrenal gland medulla that is in the right side of the abdomen.

UBERON:0035829.name: right gastroepiploic artery
UBERON:0035829.def: artery that runs from right to left along the greater curvature of the stomach, between the layers of the greater omentum, anastomosing with the left gastroepiploic branch of the splenic artery.

UBERON:0035830.name: left gastroepiploic artery
UBERON:0035830.def: artery that runs from left to right along the greater curvature of the stomach, between the layers of the greater omentum, and anastomoses with the right gastroepiploic.

UBERON:0035831.name: costal diaphragm
UBERON:0035831.def: the domain of the diaphragm that is a thin domed sheet of muscle composed of a radial array of myofibers extending laterally from the ribs and medially to a central tendon.

UBERON:0035832.name: caval sphincter
UBERON:0035832.def: a striated muscle sphincter that is an extension of the diaphragm and surrounds the vena cava.

UBERON:0035835.name: apical region of left ventricle
UBERON:0035835.def: region around the apex of the cardiac left ventricle located at the bottom of the left ventricle inferior to both the mitral and aortic valve.

UBERON:0035838.name: esophagogastric junction mucosa
UBERON:0035838.def: mucosa from the lowest portion of the esophagus, just proximal to the stomach.

UBERON:0035839.name: esophagogastric junction submucosa
UBERON:0035839.def: submucosa from the lowest portion of the esophagus, just proximal to the stomach.

UBERON:0035840.name: esophagogastric junction muscularis mucosa
UBERON:0035840.def: muscularis mucosa from the lowest portion of the esophagus, just proximal to the stomach.

UBERON:0035841.name: esophagogastric junction muscularis propria
UBERON:0035841.def: muscularis propria from the lowest portion of the esophagus, just proximal to the stomach.

UBERON:0035842.name: extensor digitorum brevis manus
UBERON:0035842.def: an accessory extensor muscle of the hand found in some humans and other animals.

UBERON:0035845.name: enthesis
UBERON:0035845.def: the connective tissue between tendon and bone insertion sites, which acts to transmit tensile load from soft tissues to bone. they may be of the dense fibrous connective tissue or fibrocartilage type; fibrous entheses attach directly to bone or periosteum primarily via fibrous tissue, and fibrocartilaginous entheses attach to bone through a transitional layer of fibrocartilage from the fibrous tendon tissue the sites where tendons or ligaments insert into the bone. recurring stress or inflammatory autoimmune disease can cause inflammation or occasionally fibrosis and calcification of the enthesis.

UBERON:0035848.name: infraorbital margin
UBERON:0035848.def: the infraorbital margin is the lower margin of the orbita.

UBERON:0035849.name: orbital margin
UBERON:0035849.def: the mostly sharp edge of the orbital opening that is the peripheral border of the base of the pyramidal orbit.

UBERON:0035850.name: infraorbital bridge
UBERON:0035850.def: a ridge of bone connecting left and right orbital margins located beneath the eye sockets.

UBERON:0035872.name: primary somatosensory area barrel field layer 5

UBERON:0035873.name: primary somatosensory area barrel field layer 1

UBERON:0035874.name: primary somatosensory area barrel field layer 2/3

UBERON:0035875.name: primary somatosensory area barrel field layer 6b

UBERON:0035876.name: primary somatosensory area barrel field layer 6a

UBERON:0035877.name: primary somatosensory area barrel field layer 4

UBERON:0035878.name: subchondral region of epiphysis
UBERON:0035878.def: the bone region of the epiphysis that provides underlying mechanical and physiological support for the cartilage of joint articular surfaces.

UBERON:0035879.name: frontomaxillary suture
UBERON:0035879.def: a suture between the frontal bone and the frontal process of the maxilla.

UBERON:0035880.name: zygomaticomaxillary suture
UBERON:0035880.def: a suture between the zygomatic bone and the zygomatic process of the maxilla.

UBERON:0035881.name: ethmoidomaxillary suture
UBERON:0035881.def: a suture between the orbital surface of the body of the maxilla with the orbital plate of the ethmoid bone.

UBERON:0035882.name: sphenomaxillary suture
UBERON:0035882.def: an inconstant suture between the pterygoid process of the sphenoid bone and the body of the maxilla.

UBERON:0035883.name: lacrimomaxillary suture
UBERON:0035883.def: a suture between the lacrimal bone and the maxilla.

UBERON:0035884.name: maxillary-premaxillary suture
UBERON:0035884.def: a suture between the maxilla and premaxilla.

UBERON:0035922.name: intraculminate fissure of cerebellum
UBERON:0035922.def: a fissure that divides the culmen lobule (lobules iv and v).

UBERON:0035924.name: radiation of corpus callosum
UBERON:0035924.def: the spreading out of the fibers of the corpus callosum in the centrum semiovale of each cerebral hemisphere.

UBERON:0035933.name: paracentral lobule
UBERON:0035933.def: the junction of the precentral gyrus and postcentral gyrus on the medial surface of the cerebral cortex. it lies across the boundary between the frontal lobe and the parietal lobe.

UBERON:0035935.name: meyer's loop of optic radiation
UBERON:0035935.def: part of the optic radiation which sweeps back on itself into the temporal lobe, just lateral to the temporal horn of the lateral ventricle.

UBERON:0035937.name: arcuate fasciculus
UBERON:0035937.def: the arcuate fasciculus (latin, curved bundle) is the neural pathway connecting the posterior part of the temporoparietal junction with the frontal cortex in the brain and is now considered as part of the superior longitudinal fasciculus.

UBERON:0035939.name: amiculum
UBERON:0035939.def: a dense surrounding coat of white fibers, as the sheath of the inferior olive and of the dentate nucleus.

UBERON:0035941.name: kimura membrane
UBERON:0035941.def: the thickening of the lower surface of the tectorial membrane into which the hair bundles of the outer hair cells are embedded.

UBERON:0035942.name: space between upper and lower jaws
UBERON:0035942.def: the space between the upper jaw skeleton and lower jaw skeleton (including teeth) that is formed when when biting.

UBERON:0035943.name: life cycle temporal boundary
UBERON:0035943.def: a temporal boundary connecting two life cycle stages that follow in immediate succession. a temporal boundary is an abstract, instantaneous entity.

UBERON:0035944.name: life-death temporal boundary
UBERON:0035944.def: a life cycle temporal boundary that marks the end of the life cycle of the organism.

UBERON:0035945.name: start of life cycle
UBERON:0035945.def: a life cycle temporal boundary that marks the start of the life cycle of the organism.

UBERON:0035946.name: start of neonate stage
UBERON:0035946.def: a life cycle temporal boundary that marks the start of the neonate stage of the organism.

UBERON:0035955.name: obsolete cerebrum
UBERON:0035955.def: historically the term cerebrum has been used for several different parts of the cns including the whole brain, the cerebral hemispheres and the sum of cerebral cortex and adjacent cerebral white matter. a thorough discussion of the definitional history is to be found in anthoney-1994.

UBERON:0035957.name: antotic pillar
UBERON:0035957.def: the posteriormost orbital pillar, in front of the otic capsule.

UBERON:0035958.name: preoptic pillar
UBERON:0035958.def: the anteriormost orbital pillar, in front of the otic capsule.

UBERON:0035959.name: orbital pillar
UBERON:0035959.def: a skeletal projection in the chondrocranium that developmentally connects the orbital cartilage and may develop into bone regions.

UBERON:0035960.name: velum feeding organ
UBERON:0035960.def: the locomotory and feeding organ, found in the larval veliger stage of bivalves.

UBERON:0035961.name: obsolete proboscis
UBERON:0035961.def: 1: the trunk of an elephant; also: any long flexible snout. 2: any of various elongated or extensible tubular processes as the sucking organ of a butterfly of the oral region of an invertebrate.

UBERON:0035962.name: supravaginal part of cervix
UBERON:0035962.def: supravaginal portion of cervix: the part of the cervix uteri that does not protrude into the vagina.

UBERON:0035963.name: epithelial lining fluid
UBERON:0035963.def: epithelial lining fluid forms a thin fluid layer that covers the mucosa of the alveoli, the small airways, and the large airways.

UBERON:0035964.name: promontory of tympanic cavity
UBERON:0035964.def: the promontory of the tympanic cavity, better known as the cochlear promontory is a rounded hollow prominence, formed by the projection outward of the first turn of the cochlea. it is placed between the fenestrae, and is furrowed on its surface by small grooves, for the lodgement of branches of the tympanic plexus. a minute spicule of bone frequently connects the promontory to the pyramidal eminence.

UBERON:0035966.name: scleral lamina cribrosa
UBERON:0035966.def: the perforated part of the sclera through which pass the axons of the retinal ganglion cells.

UBERON:0035967.name: alveolar mucosa
UBERON:0035967.def: the mucous membrane apical to the attached gingiva.

UBERON:0035968.name: bulboid corpuscle
UBERON:0035968.def: a receptor in the transitional zone between mucous membrane and skin.

UBERON:0035969.name: encapsulated tactile receptor
UBERON:0035969.def: a tacile mechanoreceptor that lacks a capsule.

UBERON:0035970.name: calcar avis of the lateral ventricle
UBERON:0035970.def: on the medial wall of the posterior cornu of the lateral ventricle is a longitudinal eminence, the calcar avis (hippocampus minor), which is an involution of the ventricular wall produced by the calcarine fissure. it is sometimes visible on ultrasonogram.

UBERON:0035971.name: postsubiculum
UBERON:0035971.def: division of subicular cortex characterized by projections from the anterodorsal thalamic nucleus and to a lesser extent the anteroventral nucleus, bordered ventrally and laterally by the presubiculum and dorsally and medially by the retrosplenial granular a cortex.. the border is characterized by an abrupt change in the cyto- and chemoarchitecture.

UBERON:0035972.name: interanterodorsal nucleus of the thalamus
UBERON:0035972.def: a group of nerve cells that bridges the midline of the thalamus between the anterodorsal nucleus of the thalamus of the left and right sides. according to crosby (1962), it is more developed and consistently present in rodents than in primates (adapted from brain info).

UBERON:0035973.name: nucleus incertus
UBERON:0035973.def: distinct cell group in caudoventral regions of the pontine periventricular gray, adjacent to the ventromedial border of the caudal dorsal tegmental nucleus.

UBERON:0035975.name: intergeniculate leaflet of the lateral geniculate complex

UBERON:0035976.name: accessory abducens nucleus
UBERON:0035976.def: a small cluster of neurons in the pontine reticular formation in some mammals, containing the majority of motoneurons innervating thenretractor bulbi muscles of the eye.

UBERON:0035977.name: bed nucleus of the accessory olfactory tract
UBERON:0035977.def: a group of cells near the surface of the brain between the supraoptic nucleus and the cortical amygdalar nucleus in the rat ( swanson-1998 ) and the mouse ( paxinos-2001 ). it is one of five subdivisions of the medial amygdalar nucleus.
UBERON:0035977.synonym: nucleus of the accessory olfactory tract

UBERON:0035999.name: dopaminergic cell groups
UBERON:0035999.def: collections of neurons in the central nervous system that have been demonstrated by histochemical fluorescence to contain the neurotransmitter dopamine ( fuxe-1970 ).

UBERON:0036000.name: a8 dopaminergic cell group
UBERON:0036000.synonym: lateral midbrain reticular formation a8 group

UBERON:0036007.name: a13 dopaminergic cell group
UBERON:0036007.def: a group of cells that fluoresce for dopamine and are distributed in clusters that, in the primate, are ventral and medial to the mammillothalamic tract of the hypothalamus; a few extend into the reuniens nucleus of the thalamus (felten-1983). in the mouse a13 is located ventral to the mammillothalamic tract of the thalamus in the zona incerta (adapted from brain info).

UBERON:0036012.name: nucleus of the brachium of the inferior colliculus
UBERON:0036012.synonym: nucleus of the brachium of the inferior colliculus

UBERON:0036013.name: intergluteal cleft
UBERON:0036013.def: the line that divided the gluteal regions of the body.

UBERON:0036014.name: gluteal sulcus
UBERON:0036014.def: a horizontal crease formed by the inferior aspect of the buttocks and the posterior upper leg.

UBERON:0036015.name: castoreum
UBERON:0036015.def: a yellowish pungent liquid that is a mixture of the castor sacs (an anal gland in the taxon castoreum) and urine.

UBERON:0036016.name: honey
UBERON:0036016.def: a sweet viscid material elaborated out of the nectar of flowers in the honey sac of various bees.

UBERON:0036017.name: regurgitated substance
UBERON:0036017.def: a bodily fluid consisting of the contents of the digestive tract expulsed through the anterior portion of the digestive tract.

UBERON:0036018.name: regurgitated pellet
UBERON:0036018.def: a mass of undigested parts of a bird's food that some bird species occasionally regurgitate from their proventriculus.

UBERON:0036019.name: castor sac
UBERON:0036019.def: a non-glandular region of the anal wall in which castoreum is produced.

UBERON:0036066.name: inferior endocardial cushion
UBERON:0036066.def: the endocardial cushion that forms on the ventral surface of the av canal.

UBERON:0036067.name: superior endocardial cushion
UBERON:0036067.def: the endocardial cushion that forms on the dorsal surface of the av canal.

UBERON:0036068.name: subglottis
UBERON:0036068.def: the lower portion of the larynx, extending from just beneath the vocal cords down to the top of the trachea.

UBERON:0036069.name: tracheoesophageal fold
UBERON:0036069.def: one of two longitudinal ridges that develop caudal to the pharynx and fuses to give rise to the tracheoesophageal septum.

UBERON:0036070.name: tracheoesophageal septum
UBERON:0036070.def: the tracheoesophageal septum is formed from the tracheoesophageal folds which fuse in the midline to form a structure called tracheoesophageal septum. it divides the esophagus from the trachea. it divides the foregut tube into the laryngotracheal tube ventrally and esophagus dorsally. developmental abnormalities can lead to a tracheoesophageal fistula.

UBERON:0036071.name: diaphragmaticus muscle
UBERON:0036071.def: a skeletal muscle found in crocodilians that is analogous to the diaphragm of mammals.

UBERON:0036074.name: vein of vestibular aqueduct
UBERON:0036074.def: a vein that leaves the vestibule through an individual bone canal running parallel to the vestibular aqueduct up to the dura of the posterior side of the petrosa in the area of the endolymphatic sac. it then opens in the inferior petrosal sinus or the jugular bulb. the vein receives other branches from the bone, dura and sac.

UBERON:0036143.name: meningeal branch of mandibular nerve
UBERON:0036143.def: the meningeal branch of the mandibular nerve (recurrent branch, nervus spinosus) is a branch of the mandibular nerve that supplies the dura mater.

UBERON:0036144.name: incisive duct
UBERON:0036144.def: an infrequent rudimentary duct, or protrusion of the mucous membrane into the incisive canal, on either side of the anterior extremity of the nasal crest.

UBERON:0036145.name: glymphatic system
UBERON:0036145.def: macroscopic waste clearance system that utilizes a unique system of perivascular tunnels, formed by astroglial cells, to promote efficient elimination of soluble proteins and metabolites from the central nervous system.

UBERON:0036146.name: cardiopharyngeal field
UBERON:0036146.def: an region of the mesoderm that includes anterior lateral mesoderm of the first heart field plus contiguous pharyngeal mesoderm that gives rise to second-heart-field-derived regions of the heart and branchiomeric muscles.

UBERON:0036147.name: oral siphon muscle
UBERON:0036147.def: a muscle that is part of an oral siphon.

UBERON:0036149.name: suprapubic skin
UBERON:0036149.def: area of skin in the hypoastric region of the abdomen.

UBERON:0036150.name: skin appendage follicle
UBERON:0036150.def: an organ subunit in the skin that gives rise to cutaneous appendage.

UBERON:0036151.name: diffuse placenta
UBERON:0036151.def: a placenta in which the chorionic sac meets the uterine endometrium over its entire surface. the villi of the chorion are distributed evenly throughout the surface of the chorion, and they extend into processes in the uterine endometrium.

UBERON:0036152.name: cotyledonary placenta
UBERON:0036152.def: a placenta in which the villi clumped together into circular patches called cotyledons. the fetal cotyledon meets with maternal regions called caruncles to form the placentome where maternal-fetal exchanges take place.

UBERON:0036153.name: zonary placenta
UBERON:0036153.def: a placenta in which the chorionic villi have aggregated to form a broad band that circles about the center of the chorion. such zones may be complete circles (such as those in dogs and cats) or incomplete (such as those in bears and seals). it is thought that zonary placentae form from diffuse placentae in which the villi at the ends regress, leaving only those in the center to function. at the edges of the zonary placenta is the hemophagous organ, which is green. the color is due to the degradation of hemoglobin into bilivirdin. this green organ provides iron for the developing fetus.

UBERON:0036154.name: discoid placenta
UBERON:0036154.def: a placenta in which part of the chorion remains smooth, while the other part interacts with the endometrium to form the placenta. the maternal blood cells are in direct contact with the fetal chorion.

UBERON:0036161.name: epitheliochorial placenta
UBERON:0036161.def: a placenta in which all three maternal layers are retained.

UBERON:0036162.name: endotheliochorial placenta
UBERON:0036162.def: a placenta in which the only maternal layer retained is the uterine endothelium.

UBERON:0036163.name: hemochorial placenta
UBERON:0036163.def: a placenta in which no maternal layers are retained.

UBERON:0036164.name: ambient gyrus
UBERON:0036164.def: a rostral part of the parahippocampal gyrus.

UBERON:0036167.name: sattler's layer
UBERON:0036167.def: sattler's layer is layer of medium diameter blood vessels of the choroid.

UBERON:0036172.name: palmaris brevis
UBERON:0036172.def: the palmaris brevis is a thin, quadrilateral muscle, placed beneath the integument of the ulnar side of the hand. it arises by tendinous fasciculi from the transverse carpal ligament and palmar aponeurosis; the fleshy fibers are inserted into the skin on the ulnar border of the palm of the hand. the muscle is innervated by the superficial branch of the ulnar nerve, containing fibers from the eighth cervical and first thoracic nerves.

UBERON:0036173.name: abductor digiti minimi of hand
UBERON:0036173.def: the abductor minimi digiti (abductor digiti quinti) is situated on the ulnar border of the palm of the hand. it arises from the pisiform bone and from the tendon of the flexor carpi ulnaris, and ends in a flat tendon, which divides into two slips; one is inserted into the ulnar side of the base of the first phalanx of the little finger; the other into the ulnar border of the aponeurosis of the extensor digiti quinti proprius. in case of polydactyly it may insert to the sixth finger instead, if there is one.

UBERON:0036174.name: flexor digiti minimi brevis of hand
UBERON:0036174.def: the flexor digiti minimi brevis is a muscle in the hand that flexes the little finger. it lies in the same plane as the abductor digiti minimi, on its radial side.

UBERON:0036176.name: opponens digiti minimi of hand
UBERON:0036176.def: the opponens minimi digiti (opponens digiti quinti in older texts) is a muscle in the hand. it is of a triangular form, and placed immediately beneath the palmaris brevis, abductor minimi digiti, and flexor brevis minimi digiti. it arises from the convexity of the hamulus of the hamate bone, and contiguous portion of the transverse carpal ligament; it is inserted into the whole length of the metacarpal bone of the little finger, along its ulnar margin.

UBERON:0036177.name: nucleus recessus
UBERON:0036177.def: the fish catecholamines originate in two large aggregations of neurons: the nucleus recessus lateralis (nrl) and the nucleus recessus posterioris (nrp). the nuclei were found in the hypothalamus of numerous species, e.g., the gold fish, eel, and roach.

UBERON:0036185.name: sertoli cell barrier
UBERON:0036185.def: the blood-testis barrier (abbreviated as btb) is a physical barrier between the blood vessels and the seminiferous tubules of the animal testes. the barrier is formed by tight connections between the sertoli cells, which are sustentacular cells (supporting cells) of the seminiferous tubules, and nourish the spermatogonia. the barrier prevents passage of cytotoxic agents (bodies or substances that are toxic to cells) into the seminiferous tubules.

UBERON:0036212.name: intertragic incisure
UBERON:0036212.def: a surface structure that is the narrowed downward continuation of the conchal space bounded anteriorly by the borders of the tragus, posteriorly by theantitragus, and along its lower lateral margins and inferior boundary by the connection between the first two.

UBERON:0036214.name: rectosigmoid junction
UBERON:0036214.def: an anatomical junction that is between the sigmoid colon and rectum.

UBERON:0036215.name: anatomical surface region
UBERON:0036215.def: material anatomical entity that forms the outermost boundary of an anatomical structure.

UBERON:0036216.name: tympanic nerve
UBERON:0036216.def: the tympanic nerve (nerve of jacobson) is a branch of the glossopharyngeal nerve found near the ear.

UBERON:0036217.name: coelomic fluid
UBERON:0036217.def: a bodily fluid that is located in the coelom.

UBERON:0036218.name: secondary prosencephalon
UBERON:0036218.def: the most anterior region of the forebrain including both the telencephalon and the hypothalamus in the prosomeric model.

UBERON:0036219.name: ungulate coronary band
UBERON:0036219.def: a region of the pododerm above the hoof where hair growth ends.

UBERON:0036224.name: corticobulbar and corticospinal tracts
UBERON:0036224.def: the corticobulbar and corticospinal tracts combined.

UBERON:0036225.name: respiratory system gland
UBERON:0036225.def: any gland that is part os the respiratory system.

UBERON:0036242.name: post-embryonic notochord
UBERON:0036242.def: a notochord that has persisted beyond the embryonic stage.

UBERON:0036243.name: vaginal fluid
UBERON:0036243.def: fluid that lines the vaginal walls that consists of multiple secretions that collect in the vagina from different glands.

UBERON:0036244.name: secretion of serous membrane
UBERON:0036244.def: a transudate found in the serous sac.

UBERON:0036245.name: parenchyma of mammary gland
UBERON:0036245.def: parenchymal tissue that consists of the alveoli, grape-like clusters where milk is stored, and branching ducts, which are tubular canals carrying gladular secretions.

UBERON:0036246.name: incudostapedial joint
UBERON:0036246.def: the small synovial joint connecting the inclus and the stapes, located between the lenticular process on the long crus of the incus and the head of the stapes.

UBERON:0036247.name: incudomallear joint
UBERON:0036247.def: the saddle-shaped synovial joint connecting the incus and the malleus.

UBERON:0036248.name: joint of auditory ossicle
UBERON:0036248.def: any synovial joint that connects auditory ossicles.

UBERON:0036249.name: zona pectinata of basilar membrane of cochlea
UBERON:0036249.def: the acellular membrane that forms the outer two thirds of the basilar membrane of the conchlea.

UBERON:0036250.name: zone of basilar membrane of cochlea

UBERON:0036252.name: interdigital space
UBERON:0036252.def: the space between the digits of the hand or foot.

UBERON:0036254.name: piriform aperture
UBERON:0036254.def: a pear-shaped bony inlet comprising the most anterior and narrowest bony portion of the nasal airway.

UBERON:0036255.name: interoceptive system
UBERON:0036255.def: the system that is responsible for sensing the internal state of the body.

UBERON:0036256.name: iliac lymph sac
UBERON:0036256.def: an embryonic lymph sac that forms near the junction of the iliac veins with the posterior cardinal veins.

UBERON:0036259.name: cardial lymph propulsor
UBERON:0036259.def: a lymphatic propulsor that lies tightly against the truncus arteriosus, the major outflow tract of the amphibian heart.

UBERON:0036260.name: embryonic cisterna chyli
UBERON:0036260.def: an embryonic lymph sac that is dorsal to the retroperitoneal lymph sac, at the level of the adrenal glands.
UBERON:0036260.synonym: future upper portion of the cisterna chyli

UBERON:0036261.name: accessory lymph sac
UBERON:0036261.def: an extracoelomic lateral abdominal space that accumulates body fluid.

UBERON:0036262.name: uterine ligament
UBERON:0036262.def: any of the eight ligaments pertaining to the uterus including the anterior, posterior, lateral, sacro-uterine and round ligaments.

UBERON:0036263.name: supraglottic part of larynx
UBERON:0036263.def: the upper part of the larynx, including the epiglottis; the area above the vocal cords.

UBERON:0036264.name: zygomaticotemporal nerve
UBERON:0036264.def: the zygomaticotemporal nerve or zygomaticotemporal branch (temporal branch) is derived from the maxillary branch of the trigeminal nerve (cranial nerve v). it runs along the lateral wall of the orbit in a groove in the zygomatic bone, receives a branch of communication from the lacrimal, and passes through zygomaticotemporal foramen in the zygomatic bone to enter the temporal fossa. it ascends between the bone, and substance of the temporalis muscle, pierces the temporal fascia about 2.5 cm. above the zygomatic arch, and is distributed to the skin of the side of the forehead, and communicates with the facial nerve and with the auriculotemporal branch of the mandibular nerve. as it pierces the temporal fascia, it gives off a slender twig, which runs between the two layers of the fascia to the lateral angle of the orbit.

UBERON:0036266.name: pars interarticularis of vertebra
UBERON:0036266.def: the part of vertebra located between the inferior and superior articular processes of the facet joint.

UBERON:0036270.name: epihyoideum
UBERON:0036270.def: an elastic ligament lying between the lateral pharyngeal muscles and the thyroglossus muscle.

UBERON:0036271.name: omphalopleure
UBERON:0036271.def: a fetal membrane, part of the yolk sac, that appears during some placentation processes.

UBERON:0036272.name: bilaminar omphalopleure
UBERON:0036272.def: a non-vascular omphalopleure that supports uptake and metabolism of nutrients.

UBERON:0036273.name: trilaminar omphalopleure
UBERON:0036273.def: a vascular omphalopleure that is important for respiration.

UBERON:0036274.name: tonsillar pillar
UBERON:0036274.def: the anterior and posterior borders of the tonsillar fossa. they are composed of muscle tissue.

UBERON:0036285.name: wall of left ventricle
UBERON:0036285.def: wall of ventricle which is continuous with the wall of aorta.

UBERON:0036286.name: wall of right ventricle
UBERON:0036286.def: wall of ventricle which is continuous with the wall of pulmonary trunk.

UBERON:0036289.name: anterior wall of right ventricle
UBERON:0036289.def: region of wall of right ventricle which is continuous with the lateral and septal walls of right ventricle.

UBERON:0036290.name: myocardium of anterior wall of left ventricle

UBERON:0036291.name: myocardium of anterior wall of right ventricle

UBERON:0036293.name: oral frenulum
UBERON:0036293.def: a small fold of mucous membrane in the mouth, connecting either the tongue or the lip to the mouth mucosa.

UBERON:0036294.name: mucosa of lip
UBERON:0036294.def: a mucosa that is part of a lip region [automatically generated definition].

UBERON:0036295.name: renal pelvis/ureter
UBERON:0036295.def: the upper tract of the renal system. the renal pelvis is the large cavity in the middle of each kidney. urine drains from each kidney through a long tube called the ureter, into the bladder, where it is stored until it is passed from the body through the urethra.

UBERON:0036302.name: vasculature of central nervous system plus retina

UBERON:0036304.name: anatomical border
UBERON:0036304.def: an anatomical structure that is located along the line dividing two regions of an anatomical structure.

UBERON:0036658.name: wall of central canal of spinal cord

UBERON:0036661.name: wall of ventricular system of brain

UBERON:0037144.name: wall of heart
UBERON:0037144.def: wall of organ which has as its parts the endocardium, myocardium , epicardium, and the cardiac septum, surrounded by the pericardial sac proper and is continuous with the walls of the systemic and pulmonary arterial and venous trees.

UBERON:0037461.name: primary hair
UBERON:0037461.def: very thin, soft, usually unpigmented, downy hair that is sometimes found on the body of a fetal or new-born human.

UBERON:0037462.name: vellus hair
UBERON:0037462.def: short, thin, slight-colored, and barely noticeable hair that develops on most of a person's body during childhood.

UBERON:0037463.name: terminal hair
UBERON:0037463.def: thick and long hair, as compared with vellus hair growing elsewhere.

UBERON:0037464.name: androgenic hair
UBERON:0037464.def: the terminal hair that develops on the human body during and after puberty. it is differentiated from the head hair and less visible vellus hair, which is much finer and lighter in color.

UBERON:0037468.name: waist
UBERON:0037468.def: the part of the human abdomen below the ribs and above the hips, often narrower than the areas above and below.

UBERON:0037494.name: paracardial gastric lymph node
UBERON:0037494.def: gastric lymph node located around the cardia of stomach.

UBERON:0037500.name: subscapular axillary lymph node
UBERON:0037500.def: an axillary lymph node that is placed along the lower margin of the posterior wall of the axilla in the course of the subscapular artery.

UBERON:0037501.name: pectoral axillary lymph node
UBERON:0037501.def: an axiallary lymph node along the lower border of the pectoralis minor, in relation with the lateral thoracic artery. their afferents drain the skin and muscles of the anterior and lateral thoracic walls, and the central and lateral parts of the mamma; their efferents pass partly to the central and partly to the subclavicular groups of axillary glands.

UBERON:0037502.name: central axillary lymph node
UBERON:0037502.def: an axillary lymph node that is imbedded in the adipose tissue near the base of the axilla.

UBERON:0037503.name: apical axillary lymph node
UBERON:0037503.def: an axillary lymph node that is situated partly posterior to the upper portion of the pectoralis minor and partly above the upper border of this muscle.

UBERON:0037530.name: inferior pancreatic lymph node
UBERON:0037530.def: pancreaticosplenioc lymph node located along the inferior margin of pancreas.

UBERON:0037580.name: left gastric lymph node
UBERON:0037580.def: gastric lymph node located along the lesser curvature of stomach.

UBERON:0037763.name: lateral superior deep cervical lymph node

UBERON:0037764.name: anterior superior deep cervical lymph node

UBERON:0037765.name: lateral inferior deep cervical lymph node

UBERON:0037766.name: anterior inferior deep cervical lymph node

UBERON:0038647.name: lymph node of inferior pulmonary ligament

UBERON:0038684.name: superior left gastric lymph node
UBERON:0038684.def: left gastric lymph node located along the left gastric artery.

UBERON:0038685.name: inferior left gastric lymph node
UBERON:0038685.def: left gastric lymph node located along the cardiac half of the lesser curvature of stomach in the lesser omentum.

UBERON:0038691.name: common hepatic lymph node
UBERON:0038691.def: hepatic lymph node located along the common hepatic artery.

UBERON:0038694.name: hepatoportal lymph node
UBERON:0038694.def: hepatic lymph node located along the portal vein.

UBERON:0038695.name: proximal superior pancreatic lymph node
UBERON:0038695.def: superior pancreatic lymph node located along the proximal segment of splenic artery.

UBERON:0038696.name: distal superior pancreatic lymph node
UBERON:0038696.def: superior pancreatic lymph node located along the distal segment of splenic artery.

UBERON:0038697.name: anterior superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node
UBERON:0038697.def: superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node located on the anterior anterior of superior region of head of pancreas.

UBERON:0038698.name: posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node
UBERON:0038698.def: superior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node located on the posterior aspect of superior portion of head of pancreas.

UBERON:0038699.name: anterior inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node
UBERON:0038699.def: inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node located on the anterior aspect of inferior region of head of pancreas.

UBERON:0038700.name: posterior inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node
UBERON:0038700.def: inferior pancreaticoduodenal lymph node located on the posterior aspect of inferior region of head of pancreas.

UBERON:0038734.name: visceral pre-aortic lymph node
UBERON:0038734.def: intestinal lymph node located anterior to aorta.

UBERON:0038746.name: gastro-epiploic lymph node
UBERON:0038746.def: gastric lymph node located along the greater curvature of stomach.
UBERON:0038746.synonym: lymph node of greater curvature of stomach

UBERON:0038849.name: craniocervical lymph node
UBERON:0038849.def: lymph node located in either head and neck region.
UBERON:0038849.synonym: lymph node of head and neck

UBERON:0038934.name: superior deep lateral cervical lymph node

UBERON:0038935.name: inferior deep lateral cervical lymph node

UBERON:0038951.name: suprapyloric lymph node
UBERON:0038951.def: pylorioc lymph node located near the bifurcation of gastroduodenal artery and superior to the pylorus.

UBERON:0038952.name: subpyloric lymph node
UBERON:0038952.def: pylorioc lymph node located in the angle between the superior and descending parts of duodenum.

UBERON:0039167.name: bronchopulmonary lymph node
UBERON:0039167.def: a tracheobronchial lymph node situated in the hilum of a lung.

UBERON:0039169.name: anterior intercostal artery
UBERON:0039169.def: the anterior intercostal branches of internal thoracic artery supply the upper five or six intercostal spaces.
UBERON:0039169.synonym: intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0039170.name: mammary branch of internal thoracic artery
UBERON:0039170.synonym: medial mammary branch of perforating branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0039185.name: accessory vertebral vein
UBERON:0039185.def: a lower continuation of the vertebral vein and vertebral venous plexus that passes through the foramen of the transverse process of the 7th cervical vertebra and empties into the brachiocephalic vein.

UBERON:0039186.name: anterior vertebral vein
UBERON:0039186.def: a vein that commences in a plexus around the transverse processes of the upper cervical vertebræ, descends in company with the ascending cervical artery between the scalenus anterior and longus capitis muscles, and opens into the terminal part of the vertebral vein.

UBERON:0039187.name: suprascapular vein
UBERON:0039187.def: the suprascapular vein is a vein running above the scapula. it empties into the external jugular vein.

UBERON:0039188.name: superior laryngeal vein
UBERON:0039188.def: the superior laryngeal vein is a vein which drains the larynx into the superior thyroid vein.

UBERON:0039215.name: appendicular artery
UBERON:0039215.def: an artery that commonly arises from the terminal branch of the ileocolic artery, or less commonly from the posterior cecal artery or an ileal artery.[1][2] it descends behind the termination of the ileum and enters the mesoappendix of the vermiform appendix. it runs near the free margin of the mesoappendix and ends in branches which supply the appendix.

UBERON:0039222.name: cystic artery
UBERON:0039222.def: an artery that supplies oxygenated blood to the cystic duct.

UBERON:0039230.name: prepyloric vein
UBERON:0039230.def: the prepyloric vein is the last connecting branch onto the right gastric vein, marking the end of the stomach, and draining the proximal part of the duodenum

UBERON:0039232.name: conus artery
UBERON:0039232.def: the conus artery is generally considered to be the first branch of the right coronary artery (rca) in the right sinus of valsalva. however, one study has shown that in approximately 50% of humans, the conus artery arises from a discrete ostium in the right sinus of valsalva.

UBERON:0039256.name: pubic vein
UBERON:0039256.def: vein ascending the posterior aspect of the body of the pubis to drain into the inferior epigastric vein; this vein frequently (about 20% of patients) serves as an accessory or replaced obturator vein.
UBERON:0039256.synonym: pubic branch of inferior epigastric vein

UBERON:0039288.name: rima vulvae
UBERON:0039288.def: the fissure between the labia majora

UBERON:0039351.name: posterior labial artery
UBERON:0039351.synonym: posterior labial branch of internal pudendal artery

UBERON:0039377.name: urethral vein
UBERON:0039377.def: a vein that drains the urethra.

UBERON:0039418.name: alcock's canal
UBERON:0039418.def: an anatomical conduit in the pelvis through which the internal pudendal artery, internal pudendal veins, and the pudendal nerve pass.

UBERON:0039421.name: superficial dorsal vein of penis
UBERON:0039421.def: a vein that drains the prepuce and skin of the penis, and, running backward in the subcutaneous tissue, inclines to the right or left, and opens into the corresponding superficial external pudendal vein, a tributary of the great saphenous vein..

UBERON:0039422.name: dorsal vein of penis
UBERON:0039422.def: one of the superficial dorsal vein of the penis or the deep dorsal vein of the penis.

UBERON:0039841.name: first anterior intercostal artery
UBERON:0039841.synonym: first intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0039842.name: second anterior intercostal artery
UBERON:0039842.synonym: second intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0039843.name: third anterior intercostal artery
UBERON:0039843.synonym: third intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0039844.name: fourth anterior intercostal artery
UBERON:0039844.synonym: fourth intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0039845.name: fifth anterior intercostal artery
UBERON:0039845.synonym: fifth intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0039846.name: sixth anterior intercostal artery
UBERON:0039846.synonym: sixth intercostal branch of internal thoracic artery

UBERON:0039850.name: left anterior segmental artery
UBERON:0039850.synonym: anterior segmental artery of left upper lobe

UBERON:0039856.name: right ovarian vein
UBERON:0039856.def: ovarian vein, each instance of which is a tributary  of some inferior vena cava that drains the right pampiniform plexus of some broad ligament.

UBERON:0039857.name: left ovarian vein
UBERON:0039857.def: ovarian vein, each instance of which is a tributary  of some left renal vein that drains the left pampiniform plexus of some broad ligament.

UBERON:0700019.name: parallel fiber
UBERON:0700019.def: a parallel fiber results from the axon of a cerebellar granule cell ascending through the molecular layer where it synapses on the dendritic branches of purkinje cells and stellate cells.

UBERON:0700020.name: parallel fiber, bifurcated
UBERON:0700020.def: a parallel fiber that results from the bifurcation of a cerebellar granule cell axon in the molecular layer into two diametrically opposed branches, that are oriented parallel to the long axis of the folium.

UBERON:1000000.name: chin ventral margin
UBERON:1000000.def: subdivision of the head consisting of the area along the lower edge of the chin.

UBERON:1000001.name: collection of hairs on vertex
UBERON:1000001.def: a collection of hairs that grows on the vertex (top of head).

UBERON:1000002.name: cranial midline area
UBERON:1000002.def: the middle part of the head, located approximately equidistant from the left and the right sides of the head.

UBERON:1000003.name: dewlap
UBERON:1000003.def: a longitudinal flap of skin that hangs beneath the lower jaw or neck.

UBERON:1000004.name: collection of hair on external ear
UBERON:1000004.def: a collection of hairs that grows on the external ear.

UBERON:1000005.name: external ear margin
UBERON:1000005.def: area along the edge of the external ear.

UBERON:1000006.name: collection of hair on forehead
UBERON:1000006.def: a collection of hairs that grows on the forehead.

UBERON:1000007.name: forehead protuberance
UBERON:1000007.def: a bulge, knob, or swelling that protrudes from the forehead.

UBERON:1000008.name: left part of face
UBERON:1000008.def: subdivision of the head consisting of the left half of the face, vertically divided.

UBERON:1000009.name: midline crest
UBERON:1000009.def: a ridge or peak located along the middle part of the head, located approximately equidistant from the left and the right sides of the head.

UBERON:1000010.name: mole
UBERON:1000010.def: a benign tumor on the skin, usually with darker pigment.

UBERON:1000011.name: labial commissure
UBERON:1000011.def: anatomical structure consisting of either corner of the mouth.

UBERON:1000012.name: nose anterior margin
UBERON:1000012.def: subdivision of the head consisting of the area along the front edge of the external nose.

UBERON:1000013.name: nose vertex
UBERON:1000013.def: the extreme point of curvature of the external nose.

UBERON:1000014.name: right part of face
UBERON:1000014.def: subdivision of the head consisting of the right half of the face, vertically divided.

UBERON:1000015.name: skin of snout
UBERON:1000015.def: a zone of skin that is part of the snout.

UBERON:1000016.name: tip of snout
UBERON:1000016.def: subdivision of the head consisting of the pointed or rounded end or extremity of the snout.

UBERON:1000017.name: tip of external ear
UBERON:1000017.def: subdivision of the head consisting of the pointed or rounded end or extremity of the external ear.

UBERON:1000018.name: cluster of hairs
UBERON:1000018.def: a small collection or tuft of hairs.

UBERON:1000020.name: collection of hair on snout
UBERON:1000020.def: a collection of hairs that grows on the snout.

UBERON:1000021.name: skin of face
UBERON:1000021.def: a zone of skin that is part of the face.

UBERON:1000022.name: zymbal's gland
UBERON:1000022.def: a multilobulated modified sebaceous gland that is located at the base of the external ear, lined by stratified squamous epithelium, and secretes into the auditory canal.

UBERON:1000023.name: spleen pulp
UBERON:1000023.def: the parenchyma of the spleen, consisting of lymphocytes and macrophages. it lies between the splenic trabecula. red pulp is the part suffused with blood and white pulp consists of areas of lymphatic tissue where there are sleeves of lymphocytes and macrophages.

UBERON:1000024.name: parenchyma of spleen
UBERON:1000024.def: a parenchyma that is part of a spleen.

UBERON:1100000.name: digestive tract junction
UBERON:1100000.def: an anatomical junction between two parts of the digestive tract.

UBERON:1500000.name: scapular blade
UBERON:1500000.def: enlarged and broad extension of the scapula distal to the glenoid region that conforms to the contour of the ribs. origin for the major shoulder muscles including the deltoid group.

UBERON:1500003.name: lateral line canal lumen
UBERON:1500003.def: anatomical space that contains a portion of the lateral line system.

UBERON:1500005.name: ischial cartilage
UBERON:1500005.def: paired cartilaginous element forming the posterior portion of the pelvic girdle [d.f. markle, bulletin of marine science. 30(1): 45-53. 1980].

UBERON:1500006.name: paired fin radial bone
UBERON:1500006.def: paired fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:1500007.name: mesopterygium cartilage
UBERON:1500007.def: the median, elongated basal cartilage of the pectoral fin.

UBERON:1500008.name: pelvic fin distal radial bone
UBERON:1500008.def: pelvic fin radial that develops from the pelvic fin endoskeletal disc. pelvic fin distal radials are paired.

UBERON:1500009.name: pelvic fin basipterygial radial
UBERON:1500009.def: pelvic fin radial that is an endochondral fused radials or pterygiophores at the base of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:1500010.name: pelvic fin middle radial bone
UBERON:1500010.def: pelvic fin radial in the middle of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:1600006.name: paired fin radial element
UBERON:1600006.def: radial element that is part of a paired fin.

UBERON:1600008.name: pelvic fin distal radial element
UBERON:1600008.def: pelvic fin radial element that develops from the pelvic fin endoskeletal disc. pelvic fin distal radial elements are paired.

UBERON:1600009.name: obsolete pelvic fin basipterygial radial element
UBERON:1600009.def: pelvic fin radial element that is an endochondral fused radial elements or pterygiophores at the base of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:1600010.name: pelvic fin middle radial element
UBERON:1600010.def: pelvic fin radial element in the middle of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:1700006.name: paired fin radial cartilage
UBERON:1700006.def: paired fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2000000.name: brachet's cleft
UBERON:2000000.def: the visible division between epiblast and hypoblast in the gastrula. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000001.name: kupffer's vesicle
UBERON:2000001.def: small but distinctive epithelial sac containing fluid, located midventrally posterior to the yolk cell or its extension, and transiently present during most of the segmentation period. kimmel et al, 1995. kupffer's vesicle has been compared to the mouse embryonic node. drummond et al, 2005.

UBERON:2000006.name: ball
UBERON:2000006.def: the anterior round region of the yolk cell present after the yolk extension forms during the segmentation period. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000023.name: obsolete forerunner cell group
UBERON:2000023.def: a group of cells that migrate at the leading edge of shield during gastrulation but do not involute. at the end of gastrulation, forerunner cells migrate deep into the embryo and organize to form kuppfer's vesicle. cooper and d'amico, 1996.

UBERON:2000040.name: median fin fold
UBERON:2000040.def: surface structure that will develop into one of the median fins. extends from dorsal surface of fish, caudal to the 8th somite, to the ventral surface ending at the caudal side of the vent.

UBERON:2000044.name: myotome somite 14
UBERON:2000044.def: portion of somite 14 that gives rise to body wall muscle masses. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000052.name: dorsal actinotrichium
UBERON:2000052.def: actinotrichium which is part of the dorsal fin fold.

UBERON:2000058.name: polster
UBERON:2000058.def: the hatching gland rudiment at the time it underlies the forebrain during the early segmentation period. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000072.name: somite 1
UBERON:2000072.def: anteriormost undifferentiated mesodermal component of early trunk segment or metamere, derived from paraxial mesoderm; forms the myotome, sclerotome and perhaps dermatome. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000073.name: somite 5
UBERON:2000073.def: undifferentiated mesodermal component of early trunk segment 5 or metamere, derived from paraxial mesoderm; forms the myotome, sclerotome and perhaps dermatome. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000074.name: somite 26
UBERON:2000074.def: undifferentiated mesodermal component of early tail segment 26 or metamere, derived from paraxial mesoderm; forms the myotome, sclerotome and perhaps dermatome. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000078.name: ventral actinotrichium
UBERON:2000078.def: actinotrichium which is part of the ventral fin fold.

UBERON:2000084.name: yolk
UBERON:2000084.def: nutrient store for embryonic development in the form of semicrystalline phospholipoprotein and contained within yolk granules. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000088.name: yolk syncytial layer
UBERON:2000088.def: peripheral layer of the yolk cell including nuclei and non-yolky cytoplasm. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000089.name: actinotrichium
UBERON:2000089.def: elastoidin fin ray that is slender, sometimes branched distally and present in the embryonic fin fold. actinotrichia are translucent and exhibit birefringence.

UBERON:2000090.name: apical ectodermal ridge dorsal fin
UBERON:2000090.def: apical ectodermal ridge that is part of the dorsal fin.

UBERON:2000093.name: obsolete blastomere
UBERON:2000093.def: a cell arising during cleavage; the term encompasses the partially cleaved, incomplete cells at the blastodisc margin before they collectively form the yolk syncytial layer (ysl) in the midblastula. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000102.name: dorsal fin fold
UBERON:2000102.def: region of the median fin fold that develops into the dorsal fin.

UBERON:2000103.name: supramaxilla
UBERON:2000103.def: dermal bone that is located on the dorsal margin of the maxilla, usually at the dorso-posterior region of maxilla. the supramaxilla is a paired bone.

UBERON:2000104.name: suprapreopercle
UBERON:2000104.def: dermal bone that is located dorsal to the preopercle or lies on the antero-dorsal corner of the opercle, and encloses the upper section of the preopercular canal. the suprapreopercle is paired.

UBERON:2000106.name: extension
UBERON:2000106.def: the posterior elongated region of the yolk cell that forms during the segmentation period. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000120.name: lateral line ganglion
UBERON:2000120.def: ganglion that develops from a cranial ectodermal placode and contains sensory neurons that innervate a lateral line.

UBERON:2000125.name: mandibular lateral line neuromast
UBERON:2000125.def: neuromast that is part of the mandibular lateral line. kimmel et al, 1995. (also see anatomical atlas entry for lateral line by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000127.name: antorbital
UBERON:2000127.def: dermal bone positioned as the first bone of the infraorbital series. the antorbital articulates with the lacrimal or infraorbital 1 anteroventrally and the supraorbital posterodorsally. the antorbital is a paired bone.

UBERON:2000136.name: otic lateral line neuromast
UBERON:2000136.def: neuromast that is part of the otic lateral line. kimmel et al, 1995. (also see anatomical atlas entry for lateral line by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000139.name: immature otolith
UBERON:2000139.def: brightly refractile stone-like organ within the otic vesicle and positioned over a sensory macula; two form in each vesicle during the late segmentation period. kimmel et al, 1995. (also see anatomical atlas entry for otolith by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000156.name: somite 20
UBERON:2000156.def: undifferentiated mesodermal component of early trunk or tail segment 20 or metamere, derived from paraxial mesoderm; forms the myotome, sclerotome and perhaps dermatome. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000157.name: somite 30
UBERON:2000157.def: posteriormost undifferentiated mesodermal component of early tail segment or metamere, derived from paraxial mesoderm; forms the myotome, sclerotome and perhaps dermatome. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000167.name: obsolete anal fin skeleton
UBERON:2000167.def: median fin skeleton that is located posterior to the anus.

UBERON:2000168.name: anterior macula
UBERON:2000168.def: macula that is located in the developing anterior inner ear, and gives rise to the macula utricle. (see anatomical atlas entry for sensory patches of the ear by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000171.name: interhyal bone
UBERON:2000171.def: replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates dorsally with the hyosymplectic cartilage or the articulation of the hyomandibula and symplectic.

UBERON:2000175.name: posterior lateral line nerve
UBERON:2000175.def: cranial nerve which enters the brain between cranial nerves viii and ix; contains afferents and sensory efferents to the posterior lateral line ganglion and middle ganglion. fibers from the posterior lateral line ganglion innervate the occipital dorsal lateral line and trunk lateral lines.

UBERON:2000181.name: obsolete caudal zone of d
UBERON:2000181.synonym: posterior zone of dorsal telencephalic area

UBERON:2000185.name: commissura rostral, pars ventralis
UBERON:2000185.def: part of the anterior commissure which abuts the preoptic region dorsally.

UBERON:2000196.name: dorsal hypohyal bone
UBERON:2000196.def: replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with the anterior ceratohyal posteriorly and the ventral hypohyal bone ventrally.

UBERON:2000202.name: efferent portion of pharyngeal arch artery
UBERON:2000202.def: a section of a pharyngeal arch artery that carries blood away from the gills.

UBERON:2000203.name: rhinosphenoid
UBERON:2000203.def: an endochondral bone which is located anterior to the orbitosphenoid and medial to the paired lateral ethmoid. rhinosphenoid is a median bone.

UBERON:2000210.name: gigantocellular part of magnocellular preoptic nucleus

UBERON:2000223.name: infraorbital 1
UBERON:2000223.def: infraorbital in fishes that is the first (anteriormost) bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2000224.name: quadrate ventral process
UBERON:2000224.def: process that is the ventral, posteriorly-oriented bony extension of the quadrate.

UBERON:2000226.name: lateral ethmoid bone
UBERON:2000226.def: endochondral bone that separates the olfactory region from the orbit, extends medially to meet its fellow medially below the frontal bones and is bordered by the mesethmoid anteriorly. it may articulate with the autopalatine and infraorbital 1 laterally. the lateral ethmoid is paired.

UBERON:2000234.name: macula neglecta
UBERON:2000234.def: macula positioned on the floor of the utricle adjacent to the utriculosaccular foramen at the base of the common crus.

UBERON:2000238.name: olfactory tract linking bulb to ipsilateral ventral telencephalon

UBERON:2000239.name: mesocoracoid bone
UBERON:2000239.def: endochondral bone that articulates laterally with the medial surface of the cleithrum and ventro-medially with the scapula and coracoid. meoscoracoid bone is a small, arch-like bone that develops from the mesocoracoid cartilage. mesocoracoid bone is paired.

UBERON:2000240.name: metapterygoid
UBERON:2000240.def: endochondral bone that forms the posteriormost element of the palatal complex. it overlies the quadrate and symplectic, posteriorly it articulates with the hyomandibula and anteriorly with the entopterygoid and ectopterygoid. it curves dorsally to form the posteroventral surface of the orbit. the metapterygoid is paired.

UBERON:2000250.name: opercle
UBERON:2000250.def: dermal bone that forms the postero-dorsal part of the opercular series. the opercle articulates with the hyomandibula antero-dorsally and with the subopercle ventrally. the opercle is a paired bone.

UBERON:2000251.name: adipose fin
UBERON:2000251.def: a fin that is fleshy, lacks supporting rays, and is located posterior to the dorsal fin.

UBERON:2000259.name: mandibular lateral line
UBERON:2000259.def: one of eight distinct lateral lines in the 4-day larva consisting of 2 neuromast. one neuromast is positioned at the front edge of the jaw the second posteriorly on the mandible. a sensory system on the surface of the fish, consisting of small sensory patches (neuromasts) distributed in discrete lines over the body surface. the lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance. (see anatomical atlas entry for lateral line by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000264.name: preopercle
UBERON:2000264.def: dermal bone that is part of the opercular series and bears the preopercular sensory canal. the preopercle is a paired bone and typically l-shaped, with the horizontal limb overlying the interopercle and the vertical limb overlying the opercle.

UBERON:2000265.name: obsolete presumptive dorsal mesoderm
UBERON:2000265.def: portion of presumptive mesoderm fated to become dorsal mesoderm.

UBERON:2000268.name: anal fin proximal radial bone
UBERON:2000268.def: anal fin proximal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2000271.name: radial bone
UBERON:2000271.def: radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2000276.name: rostrolateral thalamic nucleus of butler & saidel

UBERON:2000281.name: obsolete hair cell posterior macula
UBERON:2000281.def: specialized neuronal receptor cells of the lateral line and acoustico-vestibular systems. kimmel et al, 1995. (also see anatomical atlas entry for hair cells by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000284.name: subopercle
UBERON:2000284.def: dermal bone that is part of the opercular series, lying below the opercle. the subopercle is paired and is typically a thin bone.

UBERON:2000289.name: preopercle horizontal limb
UBERON:2000289.def: a dermal bone that is the lower, horizontal portion of the preopercle bone.

UBERON:2000291.name: medial octavolateralis nucleus
UBERON:2000291.def: lateral line sensory nucleus located in the cerebellum that processes sensory input from the lateral line.

UBERON:2000300.name: ventral hypohyal bone
UBERON:2000300.def: replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with the ceratohyal bone posteriorly and the dorsal hypohyal bone dorsally.

UBERON:2000309.name: external yolk syncytial layer
UBERON:2000309.def: the portion of the ysl that is outside of the blastoderm margin during epiboly. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000318.name: brainstem and spinal white matter
UBERON:2000318.def: cns white matter that is part of the brain stem or spinal cord.

UBERON:2000336.name: preopercle vertical limb
UBERON:2000336.def: a dermal bone that is the upper, vertical portion of the preopercle bone.

UBERON:2000337.name: basioccipital posterodorsal region
UBERON:2000337.def: endochondral bone which is the posterodorsal region of the basioccipital bone.

UBERON:2000347.name: dorsal zone of median tuberal portion of hypothalamus

UBERON:2000348.name: exoccipital posteroventral region
UBERON:2000348.def: endochondral bone which is the posterodorsal region of the exoccipital bone.

UBERON:2000350.name: epipleural
