UBERON:2000350.def: epipleurals lie below the horizontal septum and are posteroventrally directed. there are ossified epipleurals in certain ostariophysans. in many lower elopocephalan teleosts including ostariophysans the epipleural bones develop an anterodorsal branch so that they are forked proximally.

UBERON:2000356.name: gill raker
UBERON:2000356.def: dermal bone that is a projection present on the inner surface of a branchial arch.

UBERON:2000363.name: hypobranchial bone
UBERON:2000363.def: replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2000364.name: hypural
UBERON:2000364.def: laterally flattened haemal spine of an ural vertebra that lacks its arch and supports a few principal caudal lepidotrichia distally. a hypural may articulate or fuse with its ural centrum proximally or may lie ventral to the notochord. a hypural is an unpaired median bone that ossifies perichondrally. (modified from monod, 1968 and arratia and schultze, 1992).

UBERON:2000373.name: dorsal fin actinotrichium
UBERON:2000373.def: actinotrichium that is part of the dorsal fin skeleton.

UBERON:2000375.name: anal fin actinotrichium
UBERON:2000375.def: actinotrichium that is part of the anal fin skeleton.

UBERON:2000376.name: infraorbital
UBERON:2000376.def: dermal bone that is located anterior, ventral or posterior to the eye. infraorbital bones may or may not contain the infraorbital sensory canal. infraorbital bones are numbered starting with the anteriormost element of the series.

UBERON:2000384.name: levator arcus palatini
UBERON:2000384.def: jaw muscle that connects the sphenotic to the metapterygoid and hyomandibula and promotes the elevation/abduction of the suspensorium.

UBERON:2000387.name: obsolete nucleus motorius of nervi vagi

UBERON:2000392.name: median tuberal portion
UBERON:2000392.def: multi-tissue structure which is part of the hypothalamus and consists of caudal and ventral zones, and is separated from the dorsal hypothalamic zone by a deep ventral sulcus. from neuroanatomy of the zebrafish brain.

UBERON:2000410.name: postcleithrum
UBERON:2000410.def: dermal bone placed postero-medially to the supracleithrum and/or cleithrum.

UBERON:2000419.name: pterosphenoid
UBERON:2000419.def: endochondral bone that sutures with the orbitosphenoid anteriorly, the frontal bone dorsally and the sphenotic and prootic posteriorly. the pterosphenoid forms part of the orbitosphenoid region. the pterosphenoid bears foramina that accommodate branches of the trigeminal and facial nerves. the pterosphenoid is a paired bone.

UBERON:2000422.name: retroarticular
UBERON:2000422.def: the retroarticular is a cartilage bone that forms at the posteroventral tip of meckel's cartilage where the interoperculomandibular ligament attaches (5.1 mm nl). in the adult it is basically triangular in shape. the retroarticular is ligamentously connected to the interopercle and preopercle posteriorly and abuts the ventral shelf of the dentary anteriorly.

UBERON:2000424.name: opercular lateral line
UBERON:2000424.def: one of eight distinct lateral lines in the 4-day larva positioned posteriorly to the second arch skeletal element. a sensory system on the surface of the fish, consisting of small sensory patches (neuromasts) distributed in discrete lines over the body surface. the lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance. (see anatomical atlas entry for lateral line by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000425.name: anterior lateral line nerve
UBERON:2000425.def: cranial nerve which enters the brain between cranial nerves vi and vii; contains afferents and sensory efferents to the anterior lateral line ganglia.

UBERON:2000429.name: scaphium
UBERON:2000429.def: neural arch and weberian ossicle that is reduced in size relative to other neural arches. scaphium has a process which articulates with the first centrum.

UBERON:2000437.name: caudal fin actinotrichium
UBERON:2000437.def: actinotrichium that is part of the caudal fin skeleton.

UBERON:2000438.name: parhypural
UBERON:2000438.def: haemal spine of last hemal arch that is pierced by the haemal canal through which the caudal vessels pass or haemal arch of preural centrum 1. its distal part commonly supports lepidotrichia. the parhypural is an unpaired median haemal spine.

UBERON:2000442.name: supraneural bone
UBERON:2000442.def: endochondral bone that is median and located in the dorsal skeletogenous septum between the cranium and the dorsal fin.

UBERON:2000452.name: urohyal
UBERON:2000452.def: tendon bone that forms in the tendon of the sternohyoid muscles ventral to the anterior end of copula 1. the urohyal associates by ligaments to the ventral hypohyals or it articulates with the ventral hypohyals. the urohyal is an unpaired bone.

UBERON:2000460.name: adipose fin actinotrichium
UBERON:2000460.def: actinotrichium that is part of the adipose fin.

UBERON:2000461.name: weberian ossicle
UBERON:2000461.def: bone that is an element associated with a weberian vertebra.

UBERON:2000464.name: otic lateral line
UBERON:2000464.def: one of eight distinct lateral lines in the 4-day larva positioned anterior to the ear. a sensory system on the surface of the fish, consisting of small sensory patches (neuromasts) distributed in discrete lines over the body surface. the lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance. (see anatomical atlas entry for lateral line by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000474.name: intercalar
UBERON:2000474.def: small membrane bone homologous with a cartilage bone in more basal fishes (patterson, 1977). situated between the exoccipital and the pterotic at point of attachment of short ligament that originates on the ventral arm of the posttemporal.

UBERON:2000476.name: branchiostegal ray
UBERON:2000476.def: dermal bone that is a flattened element that supports the branchiostegal membrane. branchiostegal rays are generally present in a series articulating ventrally or ventro-medially with the anterior and posterior ceratobranchials whereas the most posterior ray articulates with the subopercle. the branchiostegal ray is paired.

UBERON:2000480.name: caudal octavolateralis nucleus
UBERON:2000480.def: hindbrain nucleus which is part of the medulla oblongata and is a mechanoreceptive area along with the medial octavolateralis nucleus. it is smaller than the medial octavolateralis nucleus and is located lateral to the facial and vagal lobes of the medulla oblongata. from neuroanatomy of the zebrafish brain.

UBERON:2000488.name: ceratobranchial bone
UBERON:2000488.def: endochondral bone that is bilaterally paired and forms part of the ventral branchial arches.

UBERON:2000491.name: obsolete commissure of the caudal tuberculum

UBERON:2000493.name: obsolete decussation of medial funicular nucleus

UBERON:2000495.name: infraorbital 5
UBERON:2000495.def: infraorbital that is the fifth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2000498.name: dilatator operculi
UBERON:2000498.def: mandibular muscle that inserts along the dorsolateral faces of the opercles. responsible for opercular abduction.

UBERON:2000507.name: epineural
UBERON:2000507.def: some or all epineural bones ossify free from the neural arches in most teleosts. in some lower teleosts, e.g., leptolepis, hiodon, elopiforms and albuliforms, ossification proceeds from the attachment point of the ligament to the arch, and the epineural is a process of the neural arch. in many lower teleosts epineurals are forked proximally.

UBERON:2000508.name: pelvic fin radial bone
UBERON:2000508.def: pelvic fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2000525.name: intercalarium
UBERON:2000525.def: neural arch and weberian ossicle that has been modified in shape relative to other neural arches. intercalarium includes three parts: an anterolateral process (the manubrium) which is embedded in the interossicular ligament and the ascending and articulating processes.

UBERON:2000526.name: intermuscular bone
UBERON:2000526.def: axial bone which is a segmental ossification that forms in the myoseptum.

UBERON:2000527.name: pharyngobranchial bone
UBERON:2000527.def: endochondral bone of the branchial arches located medial to the epibranchials.

UBERON:2000541.name: obsolete marginal blastomere
UBERON:2000541.def: cells (incompletely cleaved before the ysl forms), located at the surface just at the rim of the blastodisc, external to the deep blastomeres. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000544.name: pectoral fin actinotrichium
UBERON:2000544.def: actinotrichium that is part of the pectoral fin.

UBERON:2000549.name: posttemporal
UBERON:2000549.def: dermal bone of the secondary pectoral girdle that attaches the girdle to the skull. its dorsal process attaches to the epiotic or epioccipital, the ventral process to the intercalar and the body articulates with the supracleithrum. the postotic sensory canal or lateral line runs within or lateral to bone.

UBERON:2000551.name: nucleus lateralis valvulae
UBERON:2000551.def: hindbrain nucleus in the tegmental region of rhombomere 1. the cells of the nucleus are granular and lie at the ventral border of the cerebellum and brain stem.

UBERON:2000557.name: preural 1 vertebra
UBERON:2000557.def: last caudal vertebra identified as the point at which the caudal vessels bifurcate, leaving the protection of the haemal arches of the caudal vertebrae and running laterally to the hypurals. this vertebra bears, commonly, a well-developed haemal arch and its spine (parhypural).

UBERON:2000558.name: posterior macula
UBERON:2000558.def: macula that is located in the developing posterior inner ear, and gives rise to the macula neglecta and the macula saccule. (see anatomical atlas entry for sensory patches of the ear by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000576.name: pterotic
UBERON:2000576.def: endochondral bone that articulates with the autosphenotic anteriorly, the parietal dorsomedially, the prootic ventrally (and the intercalar occasionally), and the epiotic and exoccipital posteriorly. the pterotic encloses the horizontal semicircular canal of the inner ear. the lower edge of the pterotic contributes to the hyomandibular facet. the pterotic is paired.

UBERON:2000585.name: kinethmoid cartilage
UBERON:2000585.def: cranial cartilage which is a small median cartilage located between the premaxillae and anterodorsal to the ethmoid.

UBERON:2000586.name: preural 2 vertebra
UBERON:2000586.def: vertebra anterior to preural centrum 1; sometimes termed the 'antepenultimate' vertebra. mabee and bird, 2001.

UBERON:2000587.name: sphenotic
UBERON:2000587.def: endochondral bone that sutures with the pterosphenoid anteriorly, the prootic ventrally, the frontal bone dorso-medially, and the pterotic dorso-posteriorly. occasionally the sphenotic sutures with the parietal bone. the sphenotic separates the orbital from the otic region. the sphenotic bears a large antero-lateral or lateral or ventro-lateral process that borders the postero-dorsal margin of the orbit. the sphenotic is a paired bone.

UBERON:2000594.name: supracleithrum
UBERON:2000594.def: dermal bone that articulates dorsally with the posttemporal and ventrally with the cleithrum. supracleithrum is part of the secondary pectoral girdle and commonly, carries part of the lateral line canal.

UBERON:2000596.name: pelvic fin actinotrichium
UBERON:2000596.def: actinotrichium that is part of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:2000602.name: uroneural
UBERON:2000602.def: neural arch that extends along the dorso-lateral surface of the last preural centra and/or ural centra and the notochord (arratia & schultze, 1992). an uroneural develops as a modification of the neural arch of an ural centrum (patterson, 1968). the series of uroneurals may include from 7 to 1 elements that are numbered from rostrad to caudad. an uroneural is a paired membrane bone.

UBERON:2000603.name: valvula cerebelli
UBERON:2000603.def: brain structure which is caudally attached to the rostral medulla oblongata and extends into the tectal ventricle. the valvula cerebelli consists of a granular and a molecular layer along with aggregations of large purkinje and eurydendroid cells and is uniquely present in ray-finned fishes. from neuroanatomy of the zebrafish brain.

UBERON:2000607.name: obsolete ventral rhombencephalic commissure brain stem

UBERON:2000610.name: vertical myoseptum
UBERON:2000610.def: connective tissue partitions developing between the myotomes. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000618.name: obsolete ansulate commissure
UBERON:2000618.def: a brainstem commissure that contains major crossed descending projections from both tectal lobes.

UBERON:2000620.name: autopalatine
UBERON:2000620.def: endochondral bone that is part of the antero-lateral region of the palate. commonly, it articulates with the maxilla anterolaterally and with the ethmoidal region medially. it may also articulate with the dermopalatine ventro-laterally and with the entopterygoid posteriorly. the autopalatine is paired.

UBERON:2000622.name: barbel
UBERON:2000622.def: surface structure which is a tactile structure found in the branchial region. barbels are covered with epidermis rich in taste buds, and are innervated by branches of the cranial nerves.

UBERON:2000623.name: basipterygium bone
UBERON:2000623.def: basipterygium element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2000627.name: posterior ceratohyal
UBERON:2000627.def: replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates anteriorly with the anterior ceratohyal.

UBERON:2000629.name: caudal motor nucleus of abducens
UBERON:2000629.def: caudal part of the abducens nucleus that mediates motor function.

UBERON:2000634.name: caudal zone of median tuberal portion of hypothalamus

UBERON:2000637.name: claustrum cartilage
UBERON:2000637.def: postcranial axial cartilage and weberian ossicle that is located dorsal to the scaphium. the claustrum cartilage is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2000638.name: commissura rostral, pars dorsalis
UBERON:2000638.def: part of the anterior commissure which is located immediately ventral to the supracommissural nucleus of area ventralis telencephali.

UBERON:2000639.name: commissure of the secondary gustatory nuclei

UBERON:2000646.name: anal fin distal radial bone
UBERON:2000646.def: anal fin distal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2000648.name: dorsal fin musculature
UBERON:2000648.def: musculature that is part of the dorsal fin.

UBERON:2000654.name: rostral motor nucleus of abducens
UBERON:2000654.def: rostral part of the abducens nucleus that mediates motor function.

UBERON:2000657.name: entopterygoid
UBERON:2000657.def: dermal bone that forms the ventro-medial part of the palate and the antero-ventral and ventral wall of the orbit. the entopterygoid is a paired bone.

UBERON:2000658.name: epibranchial bone
UBERON:2000658.def: dorsal branchial arch bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2000660.name: epural
UBERON:2000660.def: a free, modified neural spine of a preural or a ural vertebra that is placed between the last developed neural spine of a preural centrum and the dorsal axis (= anterior margin of first uroneural) of the caudal skeleton . an epural commonly supports one or more dorsal procurrent rays. an epural is an unpaired median perichondrally ossified bone.

UBERON:2000663.name: extrascapula
UBERON:2000663.def: dermal canal-bearing bone placed at the dorso-posterior region of the skull roof, lying on the posterior region of the pterotic and parietals, or the pterotic and epioccipital, or on the pterotic, epioccipital and occipital bones.

UBERON:2000673.name: hypobranchial artery
UBERON:2000673.def: a pair of ha are connect one to each aa1. they run rostromedially until at the extreme rostro-ventral midline the two vessels merge and then run straight caudally along the ventral midline until they reach the cranial end of the ventral aorta (va). there, the single ha passes just dorsal to the rostral end of the va and then immediately splits again into a pair of ha. the paired ha continue caudally just to either side of the ventral midline. the ha provide blood supply to the ventral branchial region and the heart.sogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2000674.name: interopercle
UBERON:2000674.def: dermal bone that is part of the opercular series. it is located ventro-medially to the preopercle and anterior to the subopercle. it is joined to the posterior part of the lower jaw (retroarticular) by a ligament. the interopercle is paired.

UBERON:2000678.name: obsolete hair cell anterior macula
UBERON:2000678.def: specialized neuronal receptor cells of the lateral line and acoustico-vestibular systems. kimmel et al, 1995. (also see anatomical atlas entry for hair cells by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2000691.name: supraorbital bone
UBERON:2000691.def: dermal bone that is part of the dorsal or upper border or antero-dorsal border of the orbit. the supraorbital bone may contact the orbital margin of the frontal bone medially, the antorbital antero-ventrally and the dermosphenotic posteriorly. the supraorbital bone does not carry sensory canals. the supraorbital bone is paired.

UBERON:2000692.name: symplectic
UBERON:2000692.def: replacement bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with the hyomandibula and the quadrate.

UBERON:2000694.name: ceratobranchial 5 tooth
UBERON:2000694.def: tooth that forms on ceratobranchial 5 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2000698.name: tripus
UBERON:2000698.def: endochondral bone, membrane bone, and weberian ossicle that is an element of third vertebra. anteriorly it attaches to the interosseus ligament and posteriorly it extends as a transformator process embedded in the tunica externa of the swimbladder.

UBERON:2000699.name: entopterygoid vertical strut
UBERON:2000699.def: process that is the dorsally directed, vertical process of the entopterygoid. the strut sometimes articulates with the orbitosphenoid.

UBERON:2000711.name: deep cell layer (gastrulation)
UBERON:2000711.def: a multilayer of deep cells of fairly uniform thickness that forms during early epiboly (at dome stage; upon conversion of the blastodisc to the blastoderm); during gastrulation the del (deep cell layer) gives rise to the epiblast and hypoblast. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000712.name: internal yolk syncytial layer
UBERON:2000712.def: the portion of the ysl that lies deep to the blastoderm during epiboly. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2000716.name: afferent portion of pharyngeal arch artery

UBERON:2001025.name: occipital lateral line neuromast
UBERON:2001025.def: a neuromast that is part of the occipital lateral line.

UBERON:2001026.name: supraorbital lateral line neuromast
UBERON:2001026.def: a neuromast that is part of the supraorbital lateral line.

UBERON:2001028.name: hypurapophysis
UBERON:2001028.def: lateral process, spine-like or crest-like, at the lateral wall of the haemal arch of the parhypural that serves for insertion of the hypochordal longitudinal muscle. the process may contribute to the lateral protection of the parhypural foramen (where the caudal blood vessels exit the hemal arch) and the hypural foramen (where a caudal heart may be present). the hypurapophysis is paired.

UBERON:2001051.name: caudal division of the internal carotid artery

UBERON:2001052.name: primordial hindbrain channel
UBERON:2001052.def: the paired vessels that run along the lateral walls of the hindbrain and drain into the anterior cardinal veins. isogai et al. (2002).

UBERON:2001054.name: lateral dorsal aorta
UBERON:2001054.def: connect the outflow of the aortic arches to the dorsal aorta. the place where the lateral dorsal aorta fuse is is called the radiax of the aorta. isogai et al. 2001.

UBERON:2001058.name: obsolete caudal fin
UBERON:2001058.def: the caudal fin is the most posterior median fin. it is composed of a complex of three modified centra and modified neural and hemal arches and spines. mabee and bird, 2001.

UBERON:2001059.name: cranial division of the internal carotid artery
UBERON:2001059.synonym: rostral division of the internal carotid artery

UBERON:2001060.name: basidorsal
UBERON:2001060.def: basidorsals are bilaterally paired cartilages on the dorsolateral side of the notochord which are replaced by ossified neural arches or dorsal arcocentra. in otophysan fishes, basidorsal 1, bd2, bd3, and bd4 give rise to parts of the weberian apparatus.

UBERON:2001076.name: intestinal bulb
UBERON:2001076.def: this anteriormost portion of the intestine has the most digestive enzymes and the greatest epithelial surface area. wallace et al, 2005.

UBERON:2001093.name: obsolete unspecified
UBERON:2001093.def: annotation with this anatomy term indicates that a structure was not specified by the author.

UBERON:2001095.name: immature macula
UBERON:2001095.def: an otic sensory epithelium that will develop into the mature macula.

UBERON:2001098.name: obsolete immature hair cell anterior macula
UBERON:2001098.synonym: immature sensory hair cells anterior macula

UBERON:2001099.name: obsolete immature hair cell posterior macula
UBERON:2001099.synonym: immature sensory hair cells posterior macula

UBERON:2001118.name: urogenital papilla
UBERON:2001118.def: a protuberance in front of the gential pore and behind the vent. mature females have a well developed urogenital papillae whilst in mature males it is poorly developed. brion et al, 2004.

UBERON:2001123.name: obsolete median fin skeleton
UBERON:2001123.def: postcranial axial skeleton that is unpaired and located on the sagittal plane of the organism.

UBERON:2001124.name: obsolete dorsal fin skeleton
UBERON:2001124.def: median fin skeleton located on the dorsal surface of the organism.

UBERON:2001125.name: organizer inducing center
UBERON:2001125.def: the dorsal marginal region of the ysl where maternal dorsal determinants localize. participates in positioning the shield. ho et al, 1999.

UBERON:2001126.name: noninvoluting endocytic marginal cell cluster
UBERON:2001126.def: the nem cell cluster lies in a superficial position of the dorsal blastoderm margin encompassing evl cells and one or two layers of underlying deep cells. unlike other marginal blastomeres, cells in this cluster do not participate in involution. cooper et al, 1996.

UBERON:2001137.name: ventral tooth row
UBERON:2001137.def: tooth row that is the ventralmost row of teeth on ceratobranchial 5 bone.

UBERON:2001139.name: mediodorsal tooth row
UBERON:2001139.def: tooth row that is the mediodorsal row of teeth on ceratobranchial 5 bone, located between the dorsal tooth row and ventral tooth row.

UBERON:2001140.name: dorsal tooth row
UBERON:2001140.def: tooth row that is the dorsalmost row of teeth on ceratobranchial 5 bone.

UBERON:2001141.name: tooth 1v
UBERON:2001141.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the anteriormost tooth in the ventral tooth row.

UBERON:2001142.name: tooth 5v
UBERON:2001142.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the posteriormost tooth in the ventral tooth row.

UBERON:2001143.name: tooth 4v
UBERON:2001143.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 3v and anterior to tooth 5v in the ventral tooth row.

UBERON:2001144.name: tooth 2v
UBERON:2001144.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 1v and anterior to tooth 3v in the ventral tooth row.

UBERON:2001145.name: tooth 3v
UBERON:2001145.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 2v and anterior to tooth 4v in the ventral tooth row.

UBERON:2001146.name: tooth 1md
UBERON:2001146.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the anteriormost tooth in the mediodorsal tooth row.

UBERON:2001147.name: tooth 2md
UBERON:2001147.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 1md and anterior to tooth 3md in the mediodorsal tooth row.

UBERON:2001148.name: tooth 1d
UBERON:2001148.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the anteriormost tooth in the dorsal tooth row.

UBERON:2001150.name: tooth 2d
UBERON:2001150.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the posteriormost tooth in the dorsal tooth row.

UBERON:2001151.name: tooth 4md
UBERON:2001151.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is the posteriormost tooth in the mediodorsal tooth row.

UBERON:2001152.name: tooth 3md
UBERON:2001152.def: ceratobranchial 5 tooth which is posterior to tooth 2md and anterior to tooth 4md in the mediodorsal tooth row.

UBERON:2001157.name: posterior lateral line primordium
UBERON:2001157.def: a migrating group of cells originating from the posterior lateral line placode. the primordium deposits seven to nine neuromasts and interneuromasts between them during its posterior migration to the tail. gompel et al, 2001.

UBERON:2001160.name: dorsal scute
UBERON:2001160.def: scute that is a bony plate that forms in dorsal midline of body margin between the skull and dorsal fin.

UBERON:2001162.name: obsolete anal fin
UBERON:2001162.def: median fin that is located posterior to the anus.

UBERON:2001168.name: vertebral element 2
UBERON:2001168.def: vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 1.

UBERON:2001169.name: vertebral element 3
UBERON:2001169.def: vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 2.

UBERON:2001170.name: vertebral element 4
UBERON:2001170.def: vertebra that is anteriorly adjacent to vertebra 5.

UBERON:2001171.name: os suspensorium
UBERON:2001171.def: endochondral bone and weberian ossicle that is an element of the fourth vertebra that curves ventrally around the anterior head of the swim bladder.

UBERON:2001172.name: roofing cartilage
UBERON:2001172.def: cartilaginous larval structure dorsal to the four anterior-most vertebrae, which forms the connection between neural arches and supraneurals in the weberian apparatus. bird and mabee, 2003.

UBERON:2001186.name: collagenous dermal stroma
UBERON:2001186.def: a layer of collagen fibrils present in the imature integument in an acellular subepidermal space. at first, the fibrils are all oriented in the same direction, later they form the complex plywood-like structure that is characteristic of the dermal deep region. le guellec et al, 2004.

UBERON:2001188.name: weberian apparatus
UBERON:2001188.def: anatomical cluster that consists of the anteriormost vertebrae and associated structures that connect the swim bladder to the inner ear.

UBERON:2001190.name: weberian vertebra
UBERON:2001190.def: vertebra that is part of the weberian apparatus.

UBERON:2001191.name: supraneural 2 bone
UBERON:2001191.def: supraneural bone located dorsal to vertebra 2.

UBERON:2001192.name: supraneural 3 bone
UBERON:2001192.def: supraneural bone that is located dorsal to vertebrae 3 and 4.

UBERON:2001200.name: corpuscles of stannius
UBERON:2001200.def: islands of eosinic cells found on the lateroventral surface of the kidney. function is thought to be that of the parathyroid gland in other vertebrates, which are lacking in fishes. these cells secrete hypocalcin (teleocalcin) to regulate calcium metabolism.

UBERON:2001220.name: basibranchial copula
UBERON:2001220.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage that is ventral, median, and associated with more than one pharyngeal arch in the pharyngeal arch 3-7 skeleton.

UBERON:2001221.name: anterior copula
UBERON:2001221.def: copula that is ventral, median, and associated with pharyngeal arches 3-5.

UBERON:2001222.name: posterior copula
UBERON:2001222.def: copula that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arches 4 and 5 (pharyngeal arches 6-7).

UBERON:2001223.name: basibranchial 1 bone
UBERON:2001223.def: basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 1 (pharyngeal arch 3). typically develops in the anterior copula cartilage.

UBERON:2001224.name: basibranchial 2 bone
UBERON:2001224.def: basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 2 (pharyngeal arch 4). typically develops in the anterior copula cartilage.

UBERON:2001225.name: basibranchial 3 bone
UBERON:2001225.def: basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 3 (pharyngeal arch 5). typically develops in the anterior copula cartilage.

UBERON:2001226.name: basibranchial 4 bone
UBERON:2001226.def: basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 4 (pharyngeal arch 6). develops in posterior copula cartilage or basibranchial 4 cartilage.

UBERON:2001233.name: hypobranchial 1 bone
UBERON:2001233.def: hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 1 element laterally. develops in hypobranchial 1 cartilage.

UBERON:2001234.name: hypobranchial 4 bone
UBERON:2001234.def: hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 4 element laterally. develops in hypobranchial 4 cartilage.

UBERON:2001235.name: hypobranchial 3 bone
UBERON:2001235.def: hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 3 element laterally. develops in hypobranchial 3 cartilage.

UBERON:2001236.name: hypobranchial 2 bone
UBERON:2001236.def: hypobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates with a median skeletal element medially and with a ceratobranchial 2 element laterally. develops in hypobranchial 2 cartilage.

UBERON:2001237.name: ceratobranchial 1 bone
UBERON:2001237.def: ceratobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001239.name: ceratobranchial 5 bone
UBERON:2001239.def: ceratobranchial bone that is the most posterior, bilaterally paired ventral pharyngeal arch bone.

UBERON:2001240.name: ceratobranchial 4 bone
UBERON:2001240.def: ceratobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001241.name: ceratobranchial 3 bone
UBERON:2001241.def: ceratobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001242.name: ceratobranchial 2 bone
UBERON:2001242.def: ceratobranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001243.name: epibranchial 1 bone
UBERON:2001243.def: epibranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 1 cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001244.name: epibranchial 5 cartilage
UBERON:2001244.def: epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and located at the articulation of epibranchial 4 cartilage or bone and the posterior tip of ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001245.name: epibranchial 4 bone
UBERON:2001245.def: epibranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001246.name: epibranchial 2 bone
UBERON:2001246.def: epibranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 2 cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001247.name: epibranchial 3 bone
UBERON:2001247.def: epibranchial bone that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 3 cartilage or bone and medially with pharyngobranchial cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001250.name: pharyngobranchial 2 bone
UBERON:2001250.def: pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 1 element.

UBERON:2001251.name: pharyngobranchial 4 cartilage
UBERON:2001251.def: most posterior pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials.

UBERON:2001252.name: pharyngobranchial 3 bone
UBERON:2001252.def: pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 2 element.

UBERON:2001253.name: neural arch 2
UBERON:2001253.def: neural arch that is the second after the neurocranium.

UBERON:2001257.name: medial floor plate
UBERON:2001257.def: the medial portion of the spinal cord floor plate, located adjacent to the notochord.

UBERON:2001263.name: ovarian follicle stage i
UBERON:2001263.def: stage i follicles (less than 140 microns) are primary growth stage. selman et al, 1993.

UBERON:2001265.name: ovarian follicle stage ii
UBERON:2001265.def: stage ii follicles (140-340 microns) are cortical alveolus stage. selman et al, 1993.

UBERON:2001266.name: ovarian follicle stage iii
UBERON:2001266.def: stage iii (340-690 microns) are vitellogenesis. selman et al, 1993.

UBERON:2001269.name: regenerating fin/limb
UBERON:2001269.def: fin or limb undergoing the process of regeneration.

UBERON:2001274.name: coronomeckelian
UBERON:2001274.def: tendon bone located on the median side of the lower jaw, dorsal to meckel's cartilage and medial to the angular. the coronomeckelian forms as an ossification of the tendon of the adductor mandibulae muscle. the coronomeckelian is a paired bone.

UBERON:2001275.name: sublingual bone
UBERON:2001275.def: endochondral bone that is the median element of the ventral hyoid arch, generally lying between the paired ventral hypohyals.

UBERON:2001277.name: anterior chamber swim bladder
UBERON:2001277.def: the anterior compartment of the swim bladder is thought to have acoustic resonance properties that play a key role in audition. it is connected to the posterior chamber via the dusctus communicans. finney et al, 2006.

UBERON:2001278.name: posterior chamber swim bladder
UBERON:2001278.def: the posterior compartment of the swim bladder plays a key role in buoyancy control. it is connected to the anterior chamber via the dusctus communicans. finney et al, 2006.

UBERON:2001279.name: branchiostegal ray 1
UBERON:2001279.def: branchiostegal ray that is the anterior-most ray in the adult.

UBERON:2001280.name: branchiostegal ray 3
UBERON:2001280.def: branchiostegal ray that is the third anterior-most ray in the adult.

UBERON:2001281.name: branchiostegal ray 2
UBERON:2001281.def: branchiostegal ray that is the second anterior-most ray in the adult.

UBERON:2001314.name: posterior lateral line ganglion
UBERON:2001314.def: the posterior lateral line ganglion develops from a cranial ectodermal placode and contains sensory neurons that innervate the posterior lateral line system.

UBERON:2001316.name: anterior lateral line placode
UBERON:2001316.def: dorsolateral placode that gives rise to the anterior lateral line.

UBERON:2001322.name: obsolete dorsoventral diencephalic tract
UBERON:2001322.def: a tract originating in the epiphysis and fasiculating with the tract of the postoptic commissure. ross et al, 1992.

UBERON:2001333.name: sublingual dorsal and ventral fused
UBERON:2001333.def: sublingual that is the single element resulting from the fusion of the sublingual dorsal ossification and sublingual ventral ossification.

UBERON:2001335.name: supradorsal
UBERON:2001335.def: supradorsals are small paired nodules of cartilage positioned at the distal ends of neural arches and the proximal end of neural spines (arratia et al., 2001).

UBERON:2001339.name: obsolete nucleus of the tract of the anterior commissure
UBERON:2001339.def: telencephalic nucleus containing the cell bodies of neurons whose axons form the anterior commissure.

UBERON:2001340.name: nucleus of the tract of the postoptic commissure
UBERON:2001340.def: the nucleus containing the cell bodies of neurons whose axons form the postoptic commissure.

UBERON:2001341.name: intervening zone
UBERON:2001341.def: a zone of delayed differentiation at the midbrainhindbrain boundary. the iz separates midbrain from anterior hindbrain neuronal clusters and has been described in all vertebrates. geling et al, 2003.

UBERON:2001360.name: obsolete parapineal organ
UBERON:2001360.def: an unpaired left-sided accessory organ which plays a role in establishing lateral brain left right asymmetry. gamse et al, 2003.

UBERON:2001361.name: basiventral
UBERON:2001361.def: basiventrals are bilaterally paired cartilages lateral to the notochord which are replaced by ossified parapophyses or hemal arches.

UBERON:2001363.name: neural complex of weberian apparatus
UBERON:2001363.def: anatomical cluster that consists of supraneural 2 bone and supraneural 3 bone and their extensions, and which is part of the weberian apparatus.

UBERON:2001364.name: hemal spine
UBERON:2001364.def: hemal spines are extensions of hemal arches in the ventral skeletogenous septum of the caudal region.

UBERON:2001373.name: obsolete migratory slow muscle precursor cell
UBERON:2001373.def: cells that initially are located adjacent to the spinal cord and notochord along that migrate from their initial medial position radially through the myotome to the lateral surface of the somites.

UBERON:2001382.name: epibranchial bone uncinate process
UBERON:2001382.def: epibranchials 1-3 in adults are compound elements formed by the fusion of epibranchial cartilages and the so-called uncinate processes. posteromedially directed uncinate processes develop on the posterior edge of epibranchials 1-3. these appear as separate centers of chondrification (6.2 mm) that later fuse laterally to the posterior edges of the epibranchial cartilages (6.8 mm).

UBERON:2001388.name: epithelial mesenchymal boundary of regenerating fin/limb
UBERON:2001388.def: an epithelial-mesenchymal boundary that is part of a regenerating fin/limb.

UBERON:2001389.name: regeneration epithelium of fin/limb
UBERON:2001389.def: an epithelium that is part of a regenerating fin/limb.

UBERON:2001391.name: anterior lateral line ganglion
UBERON:2001391.def: the anteror lateral line ganglia develops from cranial ectodermal placodes and contain sensory neurons that innervate the anterior lateral line system.

UBERON:2001392.name: parapophysis 1
UBERON:2001392.def: parapophysis that is the lateral projections from the first centrum in cyprinids, absent in catostomids, and absent in characiphysans (fink and fink, 1996).

UBERON:2001393.name: parapophysis 2
UBERON:2001393.def: parapophysis that is lateral projection from the second centrum, absent in siluriformes (fink and fink, 1996).

UBERON:2001394.name: neural arch 3
UBERON:2001394.def: neural arch 3 is expanded and fused to supraneural 3 as part of a neural complex roofing and protecting the neural canal.

UBERON:2001395.name: neural arch 4
UBERON:2001395.def: neural arch 4 is expanded and fused to supraneural 3 as part of the neural complex. a reduced neural spine projects from the posterior margin of the neural complex.

UBERON:2001396.name: parapophysis + rib of vertebra 4
UBERON:2001396.def: the parapophysis + rib, fused to the centrum, extends laterally then angles anteroventrally. a thin plate, the os suspensorium fuses to its median surface.

UBERON:2001397.name: post-weberian supraneural
UBERON:2001397.def: posterior to the weberian apparatus, otophysan supraneurals form as median, unpaired, rod- or platelike elements, as in other actinopterygians.

UBERON:2001403.name: supraethmoid
UBERON:2001403.def: dermal bone that first appears as paired ossifications in the membrane (dermis) dorsolateral to the ethmoid cartilage and anterolateral to the lateral ethmoids, later having the appearance of one butterfly-shaped element. fused to the anterodorsal margin of the mesethmoid. bordered anteriorly by the kinethmoid and posteriorly by the frontal.

UBERON:2001404.name: preethmoid bone
UBERON:2001404.def: small rounded to egg-shaped cartilage bone that sits in an anterolateral depression on the prevomer. articulates with the autopalatine in all cypriniforms.

UBERON:2001406.name: kinethmoid bone
UBERON:2001406.def: sesamoid bone located in the premaxillary-ethmoid ligament, between the mesethmoid and the premaxilla. the kinethmoid is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2001407.name: infraorbital 2
UBERON:2001407.def: infraorbital that is the second bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001408.name: infraorbital 3
UBERON:2001408.def: infraorbital that is the third bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001409.name: infraorbital 4
UBERON:2001409.def: infraorbital that is the fourth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001412.name: epiotic
UBERON:2001412.def: endochondral bone that borders that medial edge of the posttemporal fossa. the epiotics are sutured to parietals and supraoccipital dorsally, the exoccipitals ventrally and the pterotics laterally. the epiotic is a paired bone.

UBERON:2001415.name: pelvic fin distal radial bone 2
UBERON:2001415.def: pelvic fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001416.name: pelvic fin distal radial bone 3
UBERON:2001416.def: pelvic fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001417.name: pelvic fin distal radial bone 1
UBERON:2001417.def: pelvic fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001418.name: obsolete dorsal fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:2001418.def: lepidotrichium which is part of the dorsal fin.

UBERON:2001419.name: dorsal fin pterygiophore
UBERON:2001419.def: a range of seven to nine rod-like internal median skeletal support structures of the dorsal fin, comprised of both bone and cartilage and found between vertebrae 11 and 18.

UBERON:2001420.name: anal fin pterygiophore
UBERON:2001420.def: a range of twelve to fourteen rod-like internal median skeletal support structures of the anal fin, comprised of both bone and cartilage and found between vertebrae 14 and 21.

UBERON:2001421.name: obsolete anal fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:2001421.def: lepidotrichium which is part of the anal fin.

UBERON:2001430.name: pneumatic duct
UBERON:2001430.def: a duct connecting the esophagus to the posterior chamber of the swim bladder. finney et al, 2006.

UBERON:2001432.name: anterior sclerotic bone
UBERON:2001432.def: sclerotic bone that is located anterior to the eye.

UBERON:2001433.name: posterior sclerotic bone
UBERON:2001433.def: sclerotic bone that is located posterior to the eye.

UBERON:2001437.name: ductus communicans
UBERON:2001437.def: the constriction between the anterior and posterior chambers of the swim bladder. there does not appear to be an identifiable sphincter in the ductus, and therefore other musculature may regulate its opening. finney et al, 2006.

UBERON:2001450.name: apical ectodermal ridge pelvic fin
UBERON:2001450.def: apical ectodermal ridge that is part of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:2001456.name: pectoral fin endoskeletal disc
UBERON:2001456.def: a plate-like chondrogenic condensation within the pectoral fin, which subdivides into individual radials by decomposition of extracellular matrix in the inter-radial mesenchyme (grandel and schulte-merker, 1998).

UBERON:2001457.name: postcranial axial cartilage
UBERON:2001457.def: cartilage which is part of the axial skeleton.

UBERON:2001468.name: anterior lateral line system
UBERON:2001468.def: the anterior lateral line system develops from cranial ectodermal placodes, situated between the eye and the ear, that give rise to both the neuromasts and the anterior lateral line sensory nerves that innervate the neuromasts. the anterior lateral line system consists of small sensory patches (neuromasts) located superficially on the skin or just under the skin in fluid-filled canals on the head of all fishes and most amphibians and are innervated by several lateral line nerves, which project to the hindbrain. the anterior lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance.

UBERON:2001470.name: anterior lateral line
UBERON:2001470.def: the anterior lateral line consists of small sensory patches (neuromasts) located superficially on the skin or just under the skin in fluid-filled canals on the head of all fishes and most amphibians. the anterior lateral line develops from cranial ectodermal placodes situated between the eye and ear.

UBERON:2001471.name: posterior lateral line system
UBERON:2001471.def: the posterior lateral line system develops from cranial ectodermal placodes, situated behind the ear, that give rise to both the neuromasts and the posterior lateral line sensory nerves that innervate the neuromasts. the posterior lateral line system consists of small sensory patches (neuromasts) located superficially on the skin or just under the skin in fluid-filled canals on the head of all fishes and most amphibians. the neuromasts are innervated by several lateral line nerves, which project primarily to the hindbrain. the posterior mechanosensory lateral line system is stimulated by local water displacements and vibrations, and detects propulsion of the fish through the water, as well as facilitating shoaling, prey capture, and predator and obstacle avoidance.

UBERON:2001472.name: anterior lateral line neuromast
UBERON:2001472.def: neuromast that is part of the anterior lateral line. kimmel et al, 1995. (also see anatomical atlas entry for lateral line by t. whitfield.).

UBERON:2001473.name: obsolete deep blastomere
UBERON:2001473.def: cells (completely cleaved), located underneath the superficial blastomeres and internal to the marginal blastomeres. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2001474.name: sublingual dorsal and ventral separate
UBERON:2001474.def: anatomical cluster consisting of the paired sublingual dorsal ossification and sublingual ventral ossification.

UBERON:2001475.name: sublingual dorsal ossification
UBERON:2001475.def: sublingual that is the dorsal element paired with the sublingual ventral ossification.

UBERON:2001476.name: sublingual ventral ossification
UBERON:2001476.def: sublingual that is the ventral element paired with the sublingual dorsal ossification.

UBERON:2001480.name: dorsal anterior lateral line nerve
UBERON:2001480.def: nerve fibers originating from the dorsal anterior lateral line ganglion. these rami innervate the otic, supraorbital, and infraorbital neuromasts.

UBERON:2001481.name: ventral anterior lateral line nerve
UBERON:2001481.def: nerve fibers originating from the ventral anterior lateral line ganglion. these rami innervate the mandibular and opercular neuromasts.

UBERON:2001482.name: middle lateral line nerve
UBERON:2001482.def: nerve fibers originating from the middle lateral line ganglion. these fibers innervate the middle lateral line.

UBERON:2001483.name: middle lateral line ganglion
UBERON:2001483.def: the middle lateral line ganglion develops from a cranial ectodermal placode and contains sensory neurons that innervate the middle lateral line.

UBERON:2001484.name: obsolete superficial blastomere
UBERON:2001484.def: cells (completely cleaved), located at the surface of the blastodisc, above the deep blastomeres. kimmel et al, 1995.

UBERON:2001502.name: epiphyseal bar
UBERON:2001502.def: bilaterally paired medial bar of cartilage formed at midorbit through medial chondrification from triangles of cartilage that later form the junction of the taeniae marginales anterior, taeniae marginales posterior and the epiphyseal bar.

UBERON:2001504.name: occipital arch cartilage
UBERON:2001504.def: cranial cartilage which is a paired anterodorsal projection of the posterior end of the parachordal cartilage. it lies lateral to the notochord, just anterior to the posterior tip of the otic capsule. the bilaterally paired occipital arch cartilages fuse anterodorsally to the posterior edges of the auditory capsules and meet medially as the tectum synoticum (by 12 dpf).

UBERON:2001505.name: taenia marginalis anterior
UBERON:2001505.def: cartilage bar (bilaterally paired) that grows anteroventrally from the epiphyseal bar to join the anterolatera1 edge of the ethmoid plate.

UBERON:2001508.name: trabecula communis
UBERON:2001508.def: cartilage formed via medial fusion between bilaterally paired trabecula crani.

UBERON:2001511.name: interhyal cartilage
UBERON:2001511.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates dorsally with the hyosymplectic cartilage or the articulation of the hyomandibula and symplectic.

UBERON:2001515.name: taenia marginalis posterior
UBERON:2001515.def: cartilage bar (bilaterally paired) that is first visible as an anterior extension of the auditory capsule. it grows anteriorly toward the middle of the orbit where it is connected to its mate on the other side by the epiphyseal bar.

UBERON:2001516.name: ceratobranchial cartilage
UBERON:2001516.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage that forms the largest skeletal element of the ventral branchial arches.

UBERON:2001517.name: ceratobranchial 2 cartilage
UBERON:2001517.def: ceratobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001518.name: ceratobranchial 3 cartilage
UBERON:2001518.def: ceratobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001519.name: ceratobranchial 4 cartilage
UBERON:2001519.def: ceratobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001520.name: ceratobranchial 1 cartilage
UBERON:2001520.def: ceratobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with epibranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001521.name: ceratobranchial 5 cartilage
UBERON:2001521.def: ceratobranchial cartilage that is the most posterior, bilaterally paired ventral pharyngeal arch cartilage.

UBERON:2001522.name: hypobranchial cartilage
UBERON:2001522.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates medially with a median skeletal element and laterally with a ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001523.name: hypobranchial 4 cartilage
UBERON:2001523.def: hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001524.name: hypobranchial 1 cartilage
UBERON:2001524.def: hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001525.name: hypobranchial 2 cartilage
UBERON:2001525.def: hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001526.name: hypobranchial 3 cartilage
UBERON:2001526.def: hypobranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001527.name: epibranchial cartilage
UBERON:2001527.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001528.name: epibranchial 1 cartilage
UBERON:2001528.def: epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 1 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001529.name: epibranchial 3 cartilage
UBERON:2001529.def: epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 3 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001530.name: epibranchial 2 cartilage
UBERON:2001530.def: epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 2 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001531.name: epibranchial 4 cartilage
UBERON:2001531.def: epibranchial cartilage that is bilaterally paired and articulates laterally with ceratobranchial 4 cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001532.name: sublingual dorsal cartilage
UBERON:2001532.def: sublingual cartilage that is the dorsal element paired with the sublingual ventral cartilage.

UBERON:2001533.name: pharyngobranchial cartilage
UBERON:2001533.def: paired cartilages that project medially from the medial tips of epibranchials.

UBERON:2001534.name: pharyngobranchial 3 cartilage
UBERON:2001534.def: pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 2 element.

UBERON:2001536.name: pharyngobranchial 2 cartilage
UBERON:2001536.def: pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials and posteriorly adjacent to pharyngobranchial 1 element.

UBERON:2001537.name: mesocoracoid cartilage
UBERON:2001537.def: pectoral fin cartilage that is part of the embryonic primary pectoral girdle from which the mesocoracoid bone will ossify endochondrally.

UBERON:2001538.name: pelvic radial cartilage
UBERON:2001538.def: small cartilage that forms at the posterior edge of the basipterygium.

UBERON:2001539.name: basipterygium cartilage
UBERON:2001539.def: bilaterally paired small, rodlike cartilages on the ventral surface of the abdomen (present at 7.9 mm). their posterior tips expand laterally, forming l-shaped cartilages. medially, a posterior spur of cartilage develops, which will later ossify as the ischiac process (weitzman 1962).

UBERON:2001540.name: pelvic radial 3 cartilage
UBERON:2001540.def: small cartilage that forms at the posterior and medial edge of the basipterygium.

UBERON:2001541.name: pelvic radial 2 cartilage
UBERON:2001541.def: small cartilage with a long posterior process and a shorter lateral one that forms at the posterior edge of the basipterygium, between radial cartilages 1 and 2.

UBERON:2001542.name: pelvic radial 1 cartilage
UBERON:2001542.def: small cartilage that forms at the posterior and lateral edge of the basipterygium.

UBERON:2001544.name: sublingual cartilage
UBERON:2001544.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage that is the median cartilage of the ventral hyoid arch, generally lying between the paired ventral hypohyals.

UBERON:2001545.name: sublingual ventral cartilage
UBERON:2001545.def: sublingual cartilage that is the ventral element paired with the sublingual dorsal cartilage.

UBERON:2001546.name: neural spine 4
UBERON:2001546.def: neural spine that is associated with the fourth vertebra.

UBERON:2001547.name: abdominal scute
UBERON:2001547.def: scute that is a bony plate that forms in the midline of ventral body margin between pectoral girdle and anal fin. abdominal scutes may be present both anterior to and posterior to the pelvic girdle and fin.

UBERON:2001550.name: obsolete caudal fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:2001550.def: lepidotrichium which is part of the caudal fin.

UBERON:2001551.name: obsolete pectoral fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:2001551.def: lepidotrichium which is part of the pectoral fin, forming the pectoral fin skeleton and articulating with the pectoral radials. a pectoral lepidotrichium is composed of two hemitrichia that surround bundles of actinotrichia distally.

UBERON:2001552.name: obsolete pelvic fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:2001552.def: lepidotrichium which is part of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:2001554.name: obsolete lepidotrichium
UBERON:2001554.def: dermal bone that is rod-like, formed and usually contained in a fin membrane, and jointed to or adjacent to distal radials. lepidotrichia are formed from paired hemitrichia surrounding actinotrichia. there are usually two more lepidotrichia than distal radials.

UBERON:2001577.name: premaxilla ascending process
UBERON:2001577.def: process of the premaxilla that extends posteriorly and overlays the mesethmoid.

UBERON:2001578.name: anterior dorsomedial process of autopalatine
UBERON:2001578.def: in cypriniforms the anterior portion of the palatine has a dorsomedial process which abuts against the mesethmoid. such a process is not present in other ostariophysans or in other primitive teleosts.

UBERON:2001579.name: ural vertebra 2
UBERON:2001579.def: ural vertebra that is the second vertebra posterior to preural centrum 1. it may bear a rudimentary neural arch and sometimes a rudimentary spine or the neural arch and spine are completely absent and it may articulate or fuse with hypural 2 (polyural terminology). ural vertebra 2 is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2001581.name: ural centrum 2
UBERON:2001581.def: a vertebral centrum that is located immediately posterior to ural centrum 1. ural centrum 2 is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2001583.name: preural centrum 1+ ural centrum 1
UBERON:2001583.def: urostyle that is the result of fusion of preural centrum 1 with the first ural centrum (of polyural terminology).

UBERON:2001584.name: caudal procurrent ray
UBERON:2001584.def: caudal fin lepidotrichium that form part of the anterior dorsal and ventral series of lepidotrichia of the caudal fin that may be associated with a neural spine or an epural or an uroneural (dorsal series) and with a haemal spine of a preural vertebra (ventral series). caudal procurrent rays are shorter than the caudal principal rays. a caudal procurrent ray is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2001585.name: caudal principal ray
UBERON:2001585.def: caudal fin lepidotrichium that is adjacent to a branched ray. caudal principal rays may be segmented but unbranched and the main element forming the dorsal or ventral leading margin of the caudal fin or a ray that may be only segmented-and-branched and forms part of the middle-posterior region of the fin. a caudal principal ray is an unpaired median bone.

UBERON:2001586.name: pectoral fin radial bone
UBERON:2001586.def: pectoral fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001587.name: pectoral fin proximal radial bone
UBERON:2001587.def: pectoral fin proximal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001588.name: pectoral fin distal radial bone
UBERON:2001588.def: pectoral fin distal radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001589.name: propterygium cartilage
UBERON:2001589.def: the propterygium is the lateralmost or anteriormost basal cartilage that originates from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc. the bases of the pectoral lepidotrichium 1 plus the propterygium articulates with the scapula.

UBERON:2001592.name: claustrum bone
UBERON:2001592.def: endochondral bone, membrane bone, and weberian ossicle that is located dorsal to the scaphium. the claustrum bone is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2001593.name: caudal fin upper lobe
UBERON:2001593.def: surface structure that is the dorsal portion of the caudal fin.

UBERON:2001594.name: caudal fin lower lobe
UBERON:2001594.def: surface structure that is the ventral portion of the caudal fin.

UBERON:2001603.name: maxilla ascending process
UBERON:2001603.def: process that is the upper portion of the maxilla that rests on the posterior surface of the lateral portion of the premaxilla.

UBERON:2001604.name: lateral ethmoid palatine process
UBERON:2001604.def: lateral bony projection proximal to lateral ethmoid-palatine joint, and located anterior to orbital region and posterior to olfactory region.

UBERON:2001606.name: caudal scute
UBERON:2001606.def: scute that is a median bony plate forming anterior to procurrent caudal fin rays.

UBERON:2001607.name: basipterygoid process of parasphenoid
UBERON:2001607.def: process that is the paired process of the parasphenoid that articulates with the suspensorium.

UBERON:2001608.name: autopalatine-lateral ethmoid joint
UBERON:2001608.def: joint that articulates the autopalatine and lateral ethmoid and bones. autopalatine-lateral ethmoid joint is paired.

UBERON:2001609.name: pharyngobranchial 2 bone uncinate process
UBERON:2001609.def: bony projection that is part of the pharyngobranchial 2 bone.

UBERON:2001610.name: quadrate dorsal process
UBERON:2001610.def: an endochondral bone that is the dorsally-oriented bony extension of the quadrate, extending from the anterior portion of the bone.

UBERON:2001611.name: quadrate posterodorsal process
UBERON:2001611.def: process that is the posterior extension of the quadrate and located dorsal to the quadrate ventral process.

UBERON:2001612.name: sensory canal
UBERON:2001612.def: multi-tissue structure that is a fluid-filled canal in the integument and usually dermal bones, and contains one or more neuromast organs.

UBERON:2001613.name: dorsal fin middle radial bone
UBERON:2001613.def: dorsal fin middle radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001614.name: anal fin middle radial bone
UBERON:2001614.def: anal fin middle radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001615.name: sphenotic spine
UBERON:2001615.def: process of the sphenotic. the process may project antero-laterally or laterally or ventro-laterally and it has different development in different fish groups. the sphenotic spine is paired.

UBERON:2001616.name: lateral ethmoid wing
UBERON:2001616.def: superficial and lateral bony projection anterior to orbital region. sometimes with superficial ornamentation where in direct contact with skin.

UBERON:2001617.name: trunk sensory canal
UBERON:2001617.def: sensory canal on trunk which is posterior to the pectoral girdle and often reaching to or onto the caudal fin. the trunk sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2001619.name: post-otic sensory canal
UBERON:2001619.def: sensory canal between and in close proximity to the trunk sensory canal and anteriorly with the otic and preoperculo-mandibular sensory canals. the post-otic sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2001620.name: lagenar capsule
UBERON:2001620.def: anatomical cluster that consists of a bulla formed by the exoccipital and basioccipital bones, and surrounds the lagena.

UBERON:2001622.name: odontode
UBERON:2001622.def: multi-tissue structure composed of enameloid and dentine surrounding a pulp cavity, and found either attached to dermal bone or freely in the skin.

UBERON:2001623.name: type 1 odontode
UBERON:2001623.def: odontode that is attached to dermal bone.

UBERON:2001624.name: type 2 odontode
UBERON:2001624.def: odontode that is attached to the skin and without association to dermal bone.

UBERON:2001626.name: premaxillary tooth
UBERON:2001626.def: tooth that is attached to the premaxilla.

UBERON:2001629.name: otic sensory canal
UBERON:2001629.def: sensory canal between and in close proximity posteriorly with the post-otic and preoperculo-mandibular sensory canals, and anteriorly with the supraorbital and infraorbital sensory canals. the otic sensory canal is bilaterally paired.

UBERON:2001630.name: supratemporal sensory canal
UBERON:2001630.def: sensory canal that crosses over the dorsal midline and in close proximity to the contralateral post-otic sensory canals. the supratemporal sensory canal is unpaired.

UBERON:2001632.name: ectopterygoid tooth
UBERON:2001632.def: tooth that is attached to the ectopterygoid bone.

UBERON:2001633.name: entopterygoid tooth
UBERON:2001633.def: tooth that is attached to the entopterygoid bone.

UBERON:2001634.name: pharyngobranchial 1 cartilage
UBERON:2001634.def: most anterior pharyngobranchial cartilage, located medial to the epibranchials.

UBERON:2001635.name: pharyngobranchial 1 bone
UBERON:2001635.def: most anterior pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials.

UBERON:2001636.name: pharyngobranchial 4 bone
UBERON:2001636.def: most posterior pharyngobranchial bone, located medial to the epibranchials.

UBERON:2001640.name: notochordal ossification
UBERON:2001640.def: perichordal bone that surrounds the anterior tip of the notochord.

UBERON:2001647.name: pharyngeal tooth plate
UBERON:2001647.def: dermal bone of the pharyngeal arches usually bearing teeth.

UBERON:2001648.name: basihyal tooth plate
UBERON:2001648.def: pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to the basihyal cartilage or bone.

UBERON:2001649.name: basihyal tooth
UBERON:2001649.def: tooth that is attached to the basihyal tooth plate.

UBERON:2001650.name: pharyngobranchial 2 tooth plate
UBERON:2001650.def: pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 2 bone.

UBERON:2001651.name: pharyngobranchial 2 tooth
UBERON:2001651.def: tooth that is attached to the pharyngobranchial 2 tooth plate.

UBERON:2001652.name: pharyngobranchial 3 tooth plate
UBERON:2001652.def: pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 3 bone.

UBERON:2001653.name: pharyngobranchial 3 tooth
UBERON:2001653.def: tooth that is part of the pharyngobranchial 3 tooth plate.

UBERON:2001654.name: upper pharyngeal 4 tooth plate
UBERON:2001654.def: pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4, and located anterior to upper pharyngeal 5 tooth plate.

UBERON:2001655.name: upper pharyngeal 4 tooth
UBERON:2001655.def: tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal 4 tooth plate.

UBERON:2001656.name: upper pharyngeal 5 tooth plate
UBERON:2001656.def: pharyngeal toothplate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchial 4, and located posterior to upper pharyngeal 4 tooth plate.

UBERON:2001657.name: upper pharyngeal 5 tooth
UBERON:2001657.def: tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal 5 tooth plate.

UBERON:2001658.name: upper pharyngeal tooth plate
UBERON:2001658.def: pharyngeal tooth plate that lies ventral to pharyngobranchials 3 and 4.

UBERON:2001659.name: upper pharyngeal tooth
UBERON:2001659.def: tooth that is attached to the upper pharyngeal tooth plate.

UBERON:2001660.name: basibranchial tooth
UBERON:2001660.def: tooth that is part of the basibranchial tooth plate.

UBERON:2001661.name: basibranchial tooth plate
UBERON:2001661.def: pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchials 1-3.

UBERON:2001662.name: basibranchial 4 tooth plate
UBERON:2001662.def: pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchial 4 bone.

UBERON:2001663.name: basibranchial 4 tooth
UBERON:2001663.def: tooth that is attached to the basibranchial 4 tooth plate.

UBERON:2001664.name: basibranchial 2 tooth plate
UBERON:2001664.def: pharyngeal tooth plate that lies dorsal to basibranchial 2 bone.

UBERON:2001665.name: basibranchial 2 tooth
UBERON:2001665.def: tooth that is attached to the basibranchial 2 tooth plate.

UBERON:2001666.name: rudimentary neural arch
UBERON:2001666.def: neural arch on the urostyle. it does not support a neural spine. sanger and mccune 2002.

UBERON:2001671.name: anal fin radial bone
UBERON:2001671.def: anal fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001672.name: dorsal fin radial bone
UBERON:2001672.def: dorsal fin radial element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2001674.name: infraorbital 6
UBERON:2001674.def: infraorbital that is the sixth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001675.name: mesethmoid cornu
UBERON:2001675.def: bony projection that extends from the mesethmoid anteriorly. mesethmoid cornua are paired processes each articulating with its ipsilateral premaxilla and both cornua bounding a median mesethmoid cleft.

UBERON:2001676.name: mesethmoid-premaxillary joint
UBERON:2001676.def: joint that articulates the mesethmoid and premaxilla. mesethmoid-premaxillary joint is paired.

UBERON:2001677.name: mesethmoid-nasal joint
UBERON:2001677.def: joint that articulates the mesethmoid and nasal. mesethmoid-nasal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001678.name: mesethmoid-frontal joint
UBERON:2001678.def: joint that articulates the mesethmoid and frontal. mesethmoid-frontal joint is paired.

UBERON:2001679.name: mesethmoid-lateral ethmoid joint
UBERON:2001679.def: joint that articulates the mesethmoid and lateral ethmoid. mesethmoid-lateral ethmoid joint is paired.

UBERON:2001680.name: mesethmoid-vomer joint
UBERON:2001680.def: joint that articulates the mesethmoid and vomer. mesethmoid-vomer joint is unpaired.

UBERON:2001681.name: cornu mesial process
UBERON:2001681.def: bony projection that is mesially-directed and off the anteromedial corner of each mesethmoid cornu.

UBERON:2001683.name: transcapular ligament
UBERON:2001683.def: ligament that is attached to supracleithrum and basioccipital.

UBERON:2001684.name: ossified transcapular ligament
UBERON:2001684.def: membrane bone that is fused to supracleithrum and is jointed to basioccipital and exoccipital.

UBERON:2001685.name: lateral ethmoid-ectopterygoid ligament
UBERON:2001685.def: lateral ethmoid-ectopterygoid ligament is a ligament that connects the lateral ethmoid to the ectopterygoid.

UBERON:2001686.name: bony shelf above orbit
UBERON:2001686.def: the bony shelf above orbit is an anatomical cluster formed by the dorsolateral portions of the lateral ethmoid, frontal and sphenotic bones that forms the dorsal margin of the orbit.

UBERON:2001687.name: interopercular-mandibular ligament
UBERON:2001687.def: interopercular-mandibular ligament is a ligament that connects the interopercle to an element of the lower jaw, typically the retroarticular.

UBERON:2001688.name: palatine cartilage
UBERON:2001688.def: cartilage that is separate from and anterior to the pterygoquadrate cartilage.

UBERON:2001689.name: pterygoquadrate cartilage
UBERON:2001689.def: pterygoquadrate cartilage - cartilage that is separate from and posterior to the palatine cartilage.

UBERON:2001690.name: anterior cartilage of palatine
UBERON:2001690.def: anterior cartilage of palatine - cartilage that caps the anterior end of the autopalatine bone. it is typically present in adults.

UBERON:2001691.name: posterior cartilage of palatine
UBERON:2001691.def: posterior cartilage of palatine - cartilage that caps the posterior end of the autopalatine bone. it is typically present in adults.

UBERON:2001692.name: median premaxilla
UBERON:2001692.def: dermal bone that is located in the middle of the upper jaw, independently formed by fusion of tooth bases attached to soft tissue in the middle portion of the upper lip. the median premaxilla bears teeth in adults.

UBERON:2001693.name: protractor operculi
UBERON:2001693.def: muscle located in the lateral region of the cheek, linking the lateral surface of opercle with the posterolateral margin of the suspensorium (usually the preopercle).

UBERON:2001694.name: humerovertebral ligament
UBERON:2001694.def: ligament that links the tip of the postcleithral process of the cleithrum with either the vertebral column (at the vertebral parapophysis or rib of the sixth vertebra) or with the soft tissue around the postcleithral region.

UBERON:2001695.name: mediopharyngobranchial
UBERON:2001695.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage, elongate and usually bifurcated posteriorly, located anteriorly on the upper branchial arches, attached to the anterior tips of the first infrapharyngobranchials. it supports rows of gill rakers on each side and is not homologous to other structures in the teleost gill-arch skeleton. one or two mediopharyngobranchials may be present.

UBERON:2001696.name: gongyloid cartilage
UBERON:2001696.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage present on the dorsal surface of the middle portion of the upper branchial arches, dorsal to the point of contact between the second and third infrapharyngobranchials. it is round or cylyndrical in shape. not homologous to the mediopharyngobranchial.

UBERON:2001697.name: transverse radial
UBERON:2001697.def: endochondral bone, which may be ossified or not in adults, located immediately anteriorly to the pterygiophore series of the anal fin. the structure is usually cylindrical, and its plane of symmetry is transverse to that of pterygiophores and fin rays.

UBERON:2001698.name: anal-fin stay
UBERON:2001698.def: endochondral bone located posterior to the last anal fin pterygiophore. the anal fin stay is a median bone.

UBERON:2001699.name: dorsal-fin stay
UBERON:2001699.def: endochondral bone located posterior to the last dorsal fin pterygiophore. the dorsal fin stay is a median bone.

UBERON:2001700.name: caudal-fin stay
UBERON:2001700.def: dermal bone that is located anterior to the caudal fin procurrent rays. caudal fin stays are unpaired median bones.

UBERON:2001701.name: basibranchial 5 bone
UBERON:2001701.def: basibranchial bone that is ventral, median, and associated with branchial arch 5 (pharyngeal arch 7). develops in posterior copula cartilage or basibranchial 5 cartilage.

UBERON:2001702.name: infraorbital 7
UBERON:2001702.def: infraorbital that is the seventh bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001703.name: infraorbital 8
UBERON:2001703.def: infraorbital that is the eighth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001704.name: infraorbital 9
UBERON:2001704.def: infraorbital that is the ninth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001705.name: infraorbital 10
UBERON:2001705.def: infraorbital that is the tenth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001706.name: infraorbital 11
UBERON:2001706.def: infraorbital that is the eleventh bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001707.name: infraorbital 12
UBERON:2001707.def: infraorbital that is the twelfth bone of the infraorbital series.

UBERON:2001708.name: dermosphenotic
UBERON:2001708.def: infraorbital that is the last bone of the infraorbital series, carrying the infraorbital canal, and sometimes also the supraorbital, temporal, and/or preopercular canals. the dermosphenotic is sometimes sutured or fused completely to the skull, e.g. to the autosphenotic.

UBERON:2001709.name: infraorbital series
UBERON:2001709.def: anatomical cluster that is the series of dermal bones surrounding the orbit and associated with the infraorbital sensory canal.

UBERON:2001710.name: opercle-interopercle joint
UBERON:2001710.def: joint that articulates the opercle and interopercle. opercle-interopercle joint is paired.

UBERON:2001711.name: frontal-pterotic joint
UBERON:2001711.def: joint that articulates the frontal and pterotic. frontal-pterotic joint is paired.

UBERON:2001713.name: caudal principal ray 1
UBERON:2001713.def: caudal principal ray that is the dorsalmost caudal principal ray of the caudal fin.

UBERON:2001714.name: caudal principal ray 2
UBERON:2001714.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 1.

UBERON:2001715.name: caudal principal ray 3
UBERON:2001715.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 2.

UBERON:2001716.name: caudal principal ray 4
UBERON:2001716.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 3.

UBERON:2001717.name: caudal principal ray 5
UBERON:2001717.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 4.

UBERON:2001718.name: caudal principal ray 6
UBERON:2001718.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 5.

UBERON:2001719.name: caudal principal ray 7
UBERON:2001719.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 6.

UBERON:2001720.name: caudal principal ray 8
UBERON:2001720.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 7.

UBERON:2001721.name: caudal principal ray 9
UBERON:2001721.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 8.

UBERON:2001722.name: caudal principal ray 10
UBERON:2001722.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 9.

UBERON:2001723.name: caudal principal ray 11
UBERON:2001723.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 10.

UBERON:2001724.name: caudal principal ray 12
UBERON:2001724.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 11.

UBERON:2001725.name: caudal principal ray 13
UBERON:2001725.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 12.

UBERON:2001726.name: caudal principal ray 14
UBERON:2001726.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 13.

UBERON:2001727.name: caudal principal ray 15
UBERON:2001727.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 14.

UBERON:2001728.name: caudal principal ray 16
UBERON:2001728.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 15.

UBERON:2001729.name: caudal principal ray 17
UBERON:2001729.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 16.

UBERON:2001730.name: caudal principal ray 18
UBERON:2001730.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 17.

UBERON:2001731.name: caudal principal ray 19
UBERON:2001731.def: caudal principal ray that is ventrally adjacent to caudal principal ray 18.

UBERON:2001732.name: vertebral element 5
UBERON:2001732.def: vertebra that is posteriorly adjacent to vertebra 4.

UBERON:2001733.name: mesethmoid ventral diverging lamella
UBERON:2001733.def: bony projection that is the posterolaterally oriented projection on the ventral region of the mesethmoid. mesethmoid ventral diverging lamellae are paired and posteriorly contact the lateral ethmoid bones.

UBERON:2001734.name: posterior process of basipterygium
UBERON:2001734.def: process that is the posteriorly oriented, paired projection of the basipterygium.

UBERON:2001735.name: scapular foramen
UBERON:2001735.def: foramen that is located in the scapula. the scapular foramen is paired and formed by a ring of bone.

UBERON:2001737.name: coracoid foramen
UBERON:2001737.def: foramen that is located in the coracoid.

UBERON:2001739.name: anterior cranial fontanel
UBERON:2001739.def: fontanel that is located between the contralateral frontals and anterior to the epiphyseal bar.

UBERON:2001740.name: posterior cranial fontanel
UBERON:2001740.def: fontanel that is located posterior to the epiphyseal bar, and typically located between the contralateral frontals and parietals (if present) and bordered posteriorly by the supraoccipital.

UBERON:2001741.name: trigeminofacial foramen
UBERON:2001741.def: foramen through which branches of cranial nerves v (trigeminal) and vii (facial) exit.

UBERON:2001742.name: auditory foramen
UBERON:2001742.def: foramen through which cranial nerve viii (auditory) exits.

UBERON:2001744.name: replacement tooth trench
UBERON:2001744.def: anatomical space within a bone in which teeth develop.

UBERON:2001745.name: premaxilla replacement tooth trench
UBERON:2001745.def: replacement tooth trench that is located in the premaxilla.

UBERON:2001746.name: dentary replacement tooth trench
UBERON:2001746.def: replacement tooth trench that is located in the dentary.

UBERON:2001747.name: lateral mesethmoid wing
UBERON:2001747.def: bony projection located on the anteroventral region of the mesethmoid which articulates with the premaxilla.

UBERON:2001748.name: superficial ophthalmic nerve foramen
UBERON:2001748.def: foramen through which the superficial ophthalmic nerve passes.

UBERON:2001749.name: dentary-anguloarticular joint
UBERON:2001749.def: joint that articulates the dentary and anguloarticular. dentary-anguloarticular joint is paired.

UBERON:2001750.name: rib of vertebra 6
UBERON:2001750.def: rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the sixth centrum.

UBERON:2001751.name: rib of vertebra 5
UBERON:2001751.def: rib that articulates with the parapophysis of the fifth centrum.

UBERON:2001752.name: pre-narial cartilage
UBERON:2001752.def: the pre-narial cartilage is a cartilage that is located anterior to the anterior naris.

UBERON:2001753.name: posttemporal fossa
UBERON:2001753.def: fossa where the exoccipital forms the medial portion and the epioccipital forms the lateral margin. the posttemporal fossa in most species has two openings separated by the epioccipital bridge.

UBERON:2001761.name: pectoral fin ray 1
UBERON:2001761.def: pectoral fin lepidotrichium 1 is the leading or marginal ray of the fin and articulates with the scapula. lepidotrichium 1 is commonly segmented but unbranched but occasionally may be a massive strong unsegmented element (e.g., spine).

UBERON:2001762.name: pectoral fin ray 2
