UBERON:2005230.def: a bifurcate interneuron where the axon projects ventrally, crossing the spinal cord ventral to the mauthner axons before bifurcating and extending dorsally.

UBERON:2005233.name: obsolete cid
UBERON:2005233.def: an interneuron of the spinal cord with an ipsilateral axon that extends ventral to the mauthner axon then turns dorsally and caudally and sometimes has a minor ascending branch.

UBERON:2005234.name: obsolete cola
UBERON:2005234.def: a spinal interneuron with a dorsal dendrite that extends caudally. cola also has midlateral process that extend rostrally and caudally, the axon crosses the cord dorsal to the mauthner cell and ascends, extending dorsally. axon has minor descending branch.

UBERON:2005240.name: obsolete kolmer-agduhr neuron
UBERON:2005240.def: kolmer-agduhr neurons are ciliated gabaergic neurons that contact the central canal of the spinal cord and have ipsilateral ascending axons.

UBERON:2005245.name: inter-parietal joint
UBERON:2005245.def: fibrous joint connecting the parietal bones.

UBERON:2005246.name: obsolete regeneration fibroblast
UBERON:2005246.def: is a fibroblast that differentiates from the de-differentiated cells of the blastema.

UBERON:2005247.name: obsolete cia
UBERON:2005247.def: interneurons of the spinal cord that arise from the v1 proliferation domain. the cia neurons inhibit motoneurons, other ventral interneurons and also inhibit dorsal sensory neurons involved in sensory gating,. cia have ipsilateral axonal projections in both motor and sensory regions of spinal cord.

UBERON:2005256.name: intervillus pockets
UBERON:2005256.def: a portion of tissue formed between the base of the intestinal villi that is part of the intestinal epithelium where intestinal stem cells are located. in the intestine no crypts are present, but, the regions between the villi, the intervillus pockets, have a crypt-like function. cells are produced in the intervillus pockets and shed from the villus tips.

UBERON:2005259.name: continuous capillary
UBERON:2005259.def: capillary that has endothelial cells that provide an uninterrupted lining, and only allow small molecules, like water and ions to diffuse through tight junctions which leave gaps of unjoined membrane which are called intercellular clefts.

UBERON:2005260.name: fenestrated capillary
UBERON:2005260.def: capillary that has pores in the endothelial cells (60-80 nm in diameter) that are spanned by a diaphragm of radially oriented fibrils and allow small molecules and limited amounts of protein to diffuse.

UBERON:2005265.name: hyomandibula-opercle joint
UBERON:2005265.def: synovial joint that articulates the hyomandibula and the opercle.

UBERON:2005266.name: pterotic fossa
UBERON:2005266.def: fossa on the pterotic where the hyomandibula articulates.

UBERON:2005267.name: erector muscle
UBERON:2005267.def: muscle that moves parts of the body in a superior direction to an erect position. antagonistic to depressor muscle.

UBERON:2005268.name: preopercle horizontal limb-symplectic joint
UBERON:2005268.def: joint that articulates the posterior edge of the preopercle horizontal limb with the symplectic.

UBERON:2005269.name: hypophyseal fenestra
UBERON:2005269.def: space enclosed by the trabeculae cranii. the anterior tip of the notochord extends into the posterior region of the hypophyseal fenestra.

UBERON:2005270.name: depressor muscle
UBERON:2005270.def: a muscle that moves body parts into an inferior direction or lowered position. antagonistic to erector muscle.

UBERON:2005272.name: immature gonad
UBERON:2005272.def: immature reproductive tissue that has not undergone final maturation into either testis or ovary. during gonadal development, the gonad may be transiently intersexual where there is a parallel presence of both oocytes and spermatocytes.

UBERON:2005273.name: intestinal mucosal muscle
UBERON:2005273.def: a thin layer of smooth muscle immediately beneath the base of the villi which permits the intestinal mucosa to dynamically move and fold.

UBERON:2005275.name: hyomandibular foramen
UBERON:2005275.def: foramen in the hyomandibula that allows passage of the anterior lateral line nerve and the facial nerve (cranial nerve vii).

UBERON:2005278.name: preopercle vertical limb-hyomandibula joint
UBERON:2005278.def: joint that articulates the anterior edge of the preopercle vertical limb and the hyomandibula.

UBERON:2005279.name: enteric circular muscle
UBERON:2005279.def: smooth muscle of the enteric muscle system in which the cells are aligned perpendicular to the lumen of the gut.

UBERON:2005292.name: distal late tubule
UBERON:2005292.def: portion of the renal tubule which is just posterior to the distal early tubule.

UBERON:2005311.name: pronephric glomerular capsule epithelium
UBERON:2005311.def: simple squamous epithelium that lines the capsule of the pronephric glomerulus.

UBERON:2005316.name: fin fold pectoral fin bud
UBERON:2005316.def: fin fold of the pectoral fin bud, resulting from mesenchyme migration into the apical fold.

UBERON:2005317.name: pectoral fin fold
UBERON:2005317.def: the functional webs of the paired fins. they arise as a consequence of apical fold (aer) expansion and of migration of the distal mesenchyme. the fin folds are delimited by a dorsal and a ventral striated epidermis. the cells of the epidermal basal stratum are positioned on a basement membrane. directly beneath the basement membrane of each side there is an array of actinotrichs, fibers of the extracellular matrix which act as supportive elements of the larval fin folds.

UBERON:2005325.name: obsolete integument ionocyte
UBERON:2005325.def: ionocyte located in the integument during embryonic and larval stages.

UBERON:2005327.name: obsolete vh ionocyte
UBERON:2005327.def: integument ionocyte rich in vacuolar-type h+ atpase and carbonic anhydrase.

UBERON:2005338.name: posterior recess
UBERON:2005338.def: posterior protrusion of the third ventricle.

UBERON:2005343.name: endohypothalamic tract
UBERON:2005343.def: cns white matter, axonal tract interconnecting catecholaminergic cell groups in the posterior tuberculum and hypothalamus.

UBERON:2005346.name: extrapancreatic duct
UBERON:2005346.def: portion of the pancreatic duct, external to the pancreas body that connects the pancreas with the hepatopancreatic ampulla.

UBERON:2005372.name: dorsal fin distal radial bone 1
UBERON:2005372.def: dorsal fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005373.name: dorsal fin distal radial bone 2
UBERON:2005373.def: dorsal fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005374.name: dorsal fin distal radial bone 3
UBERON:2005374.def: dorsal fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005375.name: dorsal fin distal radial bone 4
UBERON:2005375.def: dorsal fin distal radial 4 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005376.name: dorsal fin distal radial bone 5
UBERON:2005376.def: dorsal fin distal radial 5 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005377.name: dorsal fin distal radial bone 6
UBERON:2005377.def: dorsal fin distal radial 6 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005378.name: dorsal fin distal radial bone 7
UBERON:2005378.def: dorsal fin distal radial 7 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005379.name: dorsal fin distal radial bone 8
UBERON:2005379.def: dorsal fin distal radial 8 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005380.name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 3
UBERON:2005380.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 3 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005381.name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 4
UBERON:2005381.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 4 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005382.name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 5
UBERON:2005382.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 5 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005383.name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 6
UBERON:2005383.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 6 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005384.name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 7
UBERON:2005384.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 7 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005385.name: dorsal fin proximal radial bone 8
UBERON:2005385.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 8 element that is composed of bone tissue.

UBERON:2005409.name: pars superior ear
UBERON:2005409.def: the dorsal part of the ear. comprises the three semicircular canals, which connect to the utricle.

UBERON:2005410.name: pars inferior ear
UBERON:2005410.def: the ventral portion of the ear. it contains the saccule and the laguena which are the primary auditory organs.

UBERON:2005412.name: transverse canal
UBERON:2005412.def: duct that crosses the midline connecting the sacculi.

UBERON:2007001.name: dorso-rostral cluster
UBERON:2007001.def: early-forming telencephalic neural cluster. neurons of the dorso-rostral cluster (drc) extend axons to form the supra-optic tract (sot) and the anterior commissure (ac). ross et al., 1992.

UBERON:2007002.name: ventro-rostral cluster
UBERON:2007002.def: early-forming neural cluster located in the rostral diencephalon. at 19 h, axons arising from the vrc grow caudally to pioneer the tract of the postoptic commissure (tpoc). ross et al., 1992.

UBERON:2007003.name: ventro-caudal cluster
UBERON:2007003.def: early-forming neural cluster of the ventral midbrain. at 16 h, axons of the vcc grow caudally to pioneer the medial longitudinal fasciculus (mlf), which is part of the larger ventral longitudinal tract (vlt). later, neurons from this cluster project axons rostrally into the tract of the post-optic commissure (tpoc). ross et al., 1992.

UBERON:2007004.name: epiphysial cluster
UBERON:2007004.def: early-developing neuronal cluster of the epiphysis. by 24 hpf the pioneer axon of the dorsoventral diencephalic tract (dvdt) has arisen from the ec and grown ventrally. as this axon encounters axons of the tpoc, it makes a near-90 rostral turn and grows rostrally among axons of the tpoc growing in the opposite direction. ross et al., 1992.

UBERON:2007005.name: hemal prezygapophysis
UBERON:2007005.def: hemal prezygapophyses are paired, anteromedially directed processes arising from the bases of hemal arches, ligamentously joined to the hemal postzygapophyses of the preceding vertebra. posterior caudal vertebrae close to the caudal fin lack hemal prezygopophyses.

UBERON:2007010.name: obsolete eminentia thalami
UBERON:2007010.def: part of the forebrain that is ventral to the ventral thalamus and dorsal to the preoptic area. see page 44 of the atlas of early zebrafish brain development.

UBERON:2007013.name: preplacodal ectoderm
UBERON:2007013.def: non neural ectoderm that surrounds the presumptive neural plate and gives rise to neurogenic placodes.

UBERON:2007052.name: hyohyoideus
UBERON:2007052.def: is a hyoid muscle that inserts at the most anterior basibranchial and also at the posterior ends of the ceratohyals and functions in jaw closure.

UBERON:2007053.name: dorsal adductor hyomandibulae
UBERON:2007053.def: is a hyoid muscle that attaches to the dorsomedial faces of the hyosymplectics.

UBERON:2007054.name: pillar of the anterior semicircular canal

UBERON:2007055.name: pillar of the lateral semicircular canal
UBERON:2007055.synonym: ventral piller of the semicircular canal

UBERON:2100268.name: anal fin proximal radial element
UBERON:2100268.def: rod-like internal median skeletal support elememts of the anal fin, which articulate with the distal radial elements.

UBERON:2100271.name: radial element
UBERON:2100271.def: radial elements are the internal skeletal supports of the median and paired fins.

UBERON:2100508.name: pelvic fin radial element
UBERON:2100508.def: pelvic fin radial elements are internal skeletal supports of the pelvic fin.

UBERON:2100623.name: basipterygium element
UBERON:2100623.def: endochondral element that is paired and supports the pelvic fin. the basipterygium has a posteromedial process called the ischiac process (wietzman 1962).

UBERON:2100646.name: anal fin distal radial element
UBERON:2100646.def: rod-like internal median skeletal support elements of the anal fin, which articulate with the lepidotrichia distally.

UBERON:2100936.name: dorsal fin distal radial element
UBERON:2100936.def: rod-like internal median skeletal support elements of the dorsal fin, which articulate with the lepidotrichia distally.

UBERON:2100947.name: dorsal fin proximal radial element
UBERON:2100947.def: rod-like internal median skeletal support elements of the dorsal fin, which articulate with the distal radial elements.

UBERON:2101586.name: pectoral fin radial element
UBERON:2101586.def: pectoral fin radial elements are the internal skeletal supports of the pectoral fin which develop from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, supports the pectoral lepidotrichia or fin rays and connects the lepidotrichia with the primary pectoral girdle.

UBERON:2101587.name: pectoral fin proximal radial element
UBERON:2101587.def: pectoral fin radial element which develops from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, supports a few pectoral lepidotrichia or fin rays and connects the lepidotrichia and distal radial elements with the primary pectoral girdle (scapula and coracoid).

UBERON:2101588.name: pectoral fin distal radial element
UBERON:2101588.def: pectoral fin radial element that sometimes ossifies, develops from the pectoral fin endoskeletal disc, and is located at the proximal region of a lepidotrichium, between its hemitrichia. pectoral fin distal radial element is paired.

UBERON:2101613.name: dorsal fin middle radial element
UBERON:2101613.def: dorsal fin radial element that is the rod-like internal median skeletal support element of the dorsal fin located between the dorsal fin proximal radial element and dorsal fin distal radial element.

UBERON:2101614.name: anal fin middle radial element
UBERON:2101614.def: anal fin radial element that is the rod-like internal median skeletal support element of the anal fin located between the anal fin proximal radial element and anal fin distal radial element.

UBERON:2101671.name: anal fin radial element
UBERON:2101671.def: anal fin radial elements are internal skeletal supports of the anal fin.

UBERON:2101672.name: dorsal fin radial element
UBERON:2101672.def: dorsal fin radial elements are internal skeletal supports of the dorsal fin.

UBERON:2102026.name: pectoral fin proximal radial element 1
UBERON:2102026.def: pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

UBERON:2102027.name: pectoral fin proximal radial element 2
UBERON:2102027.def: pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the second most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

UBERON:2102028.name: pectoral fin proximal radial element 3
UBERON:2102028.def: pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the third most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

UBERON:2102029.name: pectoral fin proximal radial element 4
UBERON:2102029.def: pectoral fin proximal radial element that is the fourth most anterior or dorsal pectoral fin radial element.

UBERON:2105225.name: median fin radial element
UBERON:2105225.def: radial element that is part of a median fin.

UBERON:2200268.name: anal fin proximal radial cartilage
UBERON:2200268.def: anal fin proximal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2200271.name: radial cartilage
UBERON:2200271.def: radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2200508.name: obsolete pelvic fin radial cartilage
UBERON:2200508.def: pelvic fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2200623.name: obsolete basipterygium cartilage
UBERON:2200623.def: basipterygium element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2200646.name: anal fin distal radial cartilage
UBERON:2200646.def: anal fin distal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2200936.name: dorsal fin distal radial cartilage
UBERON:2200936.def: dorsal fin distal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2200947.name: dorsal fin proximal radial cartilage
UBERON:2200947.def: dorsal fin proximal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.
UBERON:2200947.synonym: basal radial cartilage of dorsal fin

UBERON:2201415.def: pelvic fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201416.def: pelvic fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201417.name: pelvic fin distal radial cartilage 1
UBERON:2201417.def: pelvic fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201586.def: pectoral fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201587.name: pectoral fin proximal radial cartilage
UBERON:2201587.def: pectoral fin proximal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201588.name: pectoral fin distal radial cartilage
UBERON:2201588.def: pectoral fin distal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201613.def: dorsal fin middle radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201614.def: anal fin middle radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201671.def: anal fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201672.def: dorsal fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201818.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 1 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2201819.name: dorsal fin proximal radial cartilage 2
UBERON:2201819.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 2 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2202029.def: pectoral fin proximal radial 4 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2202279.def: pectoral fin distal radial 2 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2202280.def: pectoral fin distal radial 3 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2205225.def: median fin radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2205226.def: median fin proximal radial element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2205372.def: dorsal fin distal radial 1 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:2205385.def: dorsal fin proximal radial 8 element that is composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:3000002.name: alary cartilage
UBERON:3000002.def: paired, cup-shaped cartilage that are dorsal to the septomaxillae and anterior to the oblique cartilage. the anterior, convex face of each alary cartilage is synchondrotically fused to the superior prenasal cartilage and the ventral edge is fused to the superior margin of the crista intermedia.

UBERON:3000003.name: alary process of premaxilla
UBERON:3000003.def: dorsal process that extends toward the nasal bone. the posterior (inner) face of each alary process is concave and is invested dorsomedially by the superior prenasal cartilage and ventromedially by the inferior prenasal cartilage.

UBERON:3000006.name: alveolar foramen
UBERON:3000006.def: foramen for the r. alveolaris of nerve vii and the alveolar artery.

UBERON:3000012.name: angulosplenial coronoid process
UBERON:3000012.def: point of insertion of the adductor mandibulae musculature.

UBERON:3000015.name: anterior maxillary process
UBERON:3000015.def: process that extends anteriorly from the planum triangulare and invests the medial face of the pars facialis of the maxilla.

UBERON:3000016.name: anterior nasal wall
UBERON:3000016.def: paired, vertical, and relatively straight plates that form the anterior limit of the nasal capsule.

UBERON:3000017.name: anterior process of pars palatina of maxilla

UBERON:3000018.name: anterior ramus of pterygoid
UBERON:3000018.def: in a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends anteriorly towards the maxilla.

UBERON:3000036.name: basal process of palatoquadrate
UBERON:3000036.def: process that extends medially from the ventromedial corner of the palatoquadrate cartilage and articulates or fuses to the anterior wall of the otic capsule via the basitrabecular process.

UBERON:3000041.name: bidder's organ
UBERON:3000041.def: anatomical structure which forms from an enlargement of the anterior portion of each gonad in all male bufonid larvae and consists of ovarian tissues.

UBERON:3000044.name: obsolete blastomere
UBERON:3000044.def: undifferentiated cell that is produced by early cleavages of the fertilized egg (zygote).

UBERON:3000050.name: braincase and auditory apparatus
UBERON:3000050.def: the part of the skull that encloses the brain and surrounds the inner ear.

UBERON:3000059.name: capsular process
UBERON:3000059.def: narrow process of the skeletal support that projects forward.

UBERON:3000061.name: obsolete cartilage bridge of nasal skeleton

UBERON:3000068.name: cartilago ectochoanalis
UBERON:3000068.def: lateral cartilaginous border of the fenestra endochoanalis.

UBERON:3000074.name: cartilago orbitalis
UBERON:3000074.def: lateral wall of chondrocranial braincase between lamina orbitonasalis and pila metoptica.

UBERON:3000085.name: cavum inferius
UBERON:3000085.def: accessory cavity located ventral to the cavum principale and cavum medius.

UBERON:3000087.name: cavum medius
UBERON:3000087.def: small accessory cavity located between the cavum principale and cavum inferius.

UBERON:3000089.name: cavum principale
UBERON:3000089.def: the largest part of the nasal cavity, containing the olfactory epithelium.

UBERON:3000101.name: hyale
UBERON:3000101.def: anterior-lateral projections from the corpus of the hyoid apparatus.

UBERON:3000110.name: crista contacta
UBERON:3000110.def: thin, horizontal ridge that extends medially from the corpus of the septomaxilla; it lays on the lamina inferior.

UBERON:3000113.name: crista intermedia
UBERON:3000113.def: paired, oblique plates of cartilage located ventral to the alary cartilages. the dorsomedial margin of each crista intermedia is fused to the transitional zone between the septum nasi and the tectum nasi, whereas the ventrolateral margin bears two laminae, the lamina superior and the lamina inferior.

UBERON:3000117.name: crista subnasalis
UBERON:3000117.def: ventral crest of the paries nasi.

UBERON:3000118.name: crista supraorbitalis
UBERON:3000118.def: short and blunt process that extends posteriorly from the posteromedial margin of the postnasal wall, on the anterodorsal corner of the orbit above the medial orbitonasal foramen.

UBERON:3000121.name: obsolete dense connective tissue
UBERON:3000121.def: also known as fibrous connective tissue. forms ligaments and tendons and is characterized by densely packed collagen fibers that have great tensile strength.

UBERON:3000131.name: dilatatio alaris
UBERON:3000131.def: flange that extends ventrally from about the middle portion of the margo mandibularis.
UBERON:3000131.synonym: ventral flange of anterior ramus of pterygoid

UBERON:3000155.name: extremitas anterior
UBERON:3000155.def: large anterior outgrowth of the septomaxilla that is directed into the space between the alary cartilage and the lamina inferior.

UBERON:3000161.name: fenestra endochoanalis
UBERON:3000161.def: opening on the ventral aspect of the nasal capsule. it contains the apertura nasalis interna.

UBERON:3000162.name: fenestra endonarina communis
UBERON:3000162.def: opening on the anterolateral aspect of the nasal capsule. it contains the apertura nasalis externa.

UBERON:3000164.name: fenestra lateralis nasi
UBERON:3000164.def: opening on the lateral side of the nasal capsule.

UBERON:3000166.name: fenestra nasobasalis
UBERON:3000166.def: small opening at the anterior tip of the nasal capsule, on the floor of the cavum inferius. it is located medially to the base of the inferior prenasal cartilage and serves for the passage of the ramus medialis narium and arteria orbitonasalis.

UBERON:3000167.name: fenestra nasolateralis
UBERON:3000167.def: elongated opening located on the lateral side of the nasal capsule.

UBERON:3000171.name: fenestra prechoanalis
UBERON:3000171.def: large opening of the nasal floor anterior to the fenestra endochoanalis.

UBERON:3000178.name: footplate of pars media plectri
UBERON:3000178.def: independent, horizontal bar of cartilage located on the anterior part of the fenestra ovalis in front of the pars interna plectri.

UBERON:3000226.name: hyolaryngeal complex
UBERON:3000226.def: complex formed by two units, the hyoid and laryngeal apparatuses, which are both derived from the larval hyobranchial skeleton.

UBERON:3000234.name: inferior prenasal cartilage
UBERON:3000234.def: elongate cartilage that extends anteroventrally from the solum nasi to abut the ventral portion of the posterior aspect of the alary process of the premaxilla. it was first described by wiedersheim in 1876.

UBERON:3000237.name: infrarostral cartilage
UBERON:3000237.def: larval lower jaw lies anterior to meckels cartilage.

UBERON:3000259.name: lamina inferior
UBERON:3000259.def: lateral expansion of the crista intermedia that serves as the floor of the cavum medium.

UBERON:3000260.name: lamina nariochoanalis
UBERON:3000260.def: free, dorsal margin of the lamina inferior.

UBERON:3000264.name: lamina superior
UBERON:3000264.def: lateral expansion of the crista intermedia that serves as the roof of the cavum medium.

UBERON:3000265.name: obsolete larval structure
UBERON:3000265.def: anatomical structure that is part of the larva.

UBERON:3000280.name: margo mandibularis of pterygoid
UBERON:3000280.def: ventrally directed margin that connects the anterior and posterior rami of the pterygoid.

UBERON:3000281.name: margo orbitalis of maxilla
UBERON:3000281.def: dorsal margin of the maxilla between the frontal and zygomatico-maxillary processes.

UBERON:3000282.name: margo orbitalis of pterygoid
UBERON:3000282.def: margin that connects the anterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

UBERON:3000283.name: margo orbitalis of squamosal
UBERON:3000283.def: anterior margin of the squamosal that takes part in the formation of the orbit.

UBERON:3000284.name: margo tympanicus of pterygoid
UBERON:3000284.def: margin that connects the posterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

UBERON:3000288.name: maxillopalatine
UBERON:3000288.def: a compound bone consisting of maxilla and palatine, can also contain a prefrontal and/or lacrimal; present in adult gymnophiona.

UBERON:3000291.name: medial orbitonasal foramen
UBERON:3000291.def: opening on the postnasal wall for the medial branch (= ramus medialis nasi) of the ophthalmicus nerve.

UBERON:3000292.name: medial ramus of pterygoid
UBERON:3000292.def: in a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends medially towards the otic capsule.

UBERON:3000294.name: median prenasal process
UBERON:3000294.def: anterior projection of the septum nasi that protrudes through the anterior nasal wall.

UBERON:3000323.name: nasopremaxilla
UBERON:3000323.def: a compound bone consisting of premaxilla, nasal and sometimes septomaxilla in adult members of caeciliidae and typhlonectidae.

UBERON:3000329.name: oblique cartilage
UBERON:3000329.def: semi-circular cartilaginous sheet that lies lateral to the side of the septum nasi.

UBERON:3000344.name: orbitonasal foramen
UBERON:3000344.def: foramen that forms a passage for one of the branches of the trigeminal nerve into the nasal region.

UBERON:3000347.name: obsolete os articulare
UBERON:3000347.def: ossified posterior articular portion of meckel's cartilage.

UBERON:3000348.name: os basale
UBERON:3000348.def: a bone that forms both the floor of the braincase and the posterior part of the skull.

UBERON:3000364.name: otic plate of pterygoid
UBERON:3000364.def: osseous expansion of the posterior and medial rami of the pterygoid.

UBERON:3000367.name: otic ramus of squamosal
UBERON:3000367.def: ramus (process) that extends medially toward the otic capsule.

UBERON:3000372.name: obsolete palatine
UBERON:3000372.def: sliver of bone that invest part of or all the posterior aspect of each antorbital plane.

UBERON:3000374.name: obsolete palatine process of pars palatina of premaxilla

UBERON:3000375.name: palatine process of the pars facialis of the maxilla

UBERON:3000381.name: paranasal commissure
UBERON:3000381.def: cartilaginous bridge that extends posteriorly to the anterolateral corner of the posterior nasal wall.

UBERON:3000386.name: cultriform process
UBERON:3000386.def: process that extends anteriorly from the orbitotemporal region.

UBERON:3000387.name: subotic alae
UBERON:3000387.def: paired processes extending lateraly from the posterior body of the parasphenoid that, when present, support the otic capsules ventrally.

UBERON:3000389.name: paries nasi
UBERON:3000389.def: paired, elongate, ventrolaterally-orieted cartilaginous structures that extend to the premaxilla-maxilla articulation.

UBERON:3000394.name: pars articularis of mandibular arch
UBERON:3000394.def: posterior end of meckel's cartilage that forms the articular head of the mandibular arch.

UBERON:3000406.name: pars interna plectri
UBERON:3000406.def: plate-like structure that lies in the fenestra ovalis. it arises within the membrana opercularis in the posterior part of the fenestra.

UBERON:3000413.name: obsolete pars palatina of maxilla
UBERON:3000413.def: lingual ledge on the inner surface of the maxilla.

UBERON:3000414.name: obsolete pars palatina of premaxilla
UBERON:3000414.def: lingual ledge on the inner surface of the premaxilla.

UBERON:3000428.name: perilymphatic system
UBERON:3000428.def: consists of enlarged cistern against which the operculum and footplate of the columella rest in the oval window. together with the endolymphatic systems comprises the membranous labryinth of the inner ear. duellman and trueb 1994.

UBERON:3000431.name: pila antoptica
UBERON:3000431.def: a strut of cartilage  extending dorsally from the basal plate and with other similar cartilages forming the sides of the brain case. the pila antoptica is posterior to pila metoptica together with which it may enclose the foramen for the ocular motor nerve and opthalmica magna artery.

UBERON:3000432.name: pila metoptica
UBERON:3000432.def: a strut of cartilage  extending dorsally from the basal plate and with other similar cartilages forming the sides of the brain case. the pila metoptica is anterior to pila antoptica together with which it may enclose the foramen for the ocular motor nerve and opthalmica magna artery. anterior to the pila antoptica is the pila preoptica (another pillar of cartilage) between these two cartilages emerges the optic and trochlear nerves.

UBERON:3000440.name: planum terminale
UBERON:3000440.def: vertical plate of cartilage that is fused posterodorsally to the oblique cartilage and anteriorly to the lamina inferior.

UBERON:3000441.name: planum triangulare
UBERON:3000441.def: cartilaginous, distal expansion of the lamina orbitonasalis that invests the pars facialis of the maxilla medially.

UBERON:3000448.name: posterior maxillary process
UBERON:3000448.def: process that extends posteriorly from the planum triangulare and invests the maxilla laterally and the anterior ramus of the pterygoid medially.

UBERON:3000451.name: posterior ramus of pterygoid
UBERON:3000451.def: in a triradiate pterygoid, the process that extends posterolaterally towards the jaw articulation.

UBERON:3000454.name: postnasal wall
UBERON:3000454.def: paired, anteriorly concave structures that form the posterior limit of nasal capsule. it consists of two parts: a ventral piece, the lamina orbitonasalis, and a dorsal plate that is part of the tectum nasi.

UBERON:3000459.name: prearticular coronoid process
UBERON:3000459.def: point of insertion of the masticatory musculature.

UBERON:3000467.name: preorbital process of the pars facialis of the maxilla

UBERON:3000486.name: processus ascendens plectri
UBERON:3000486.def: cartilaginous or ligamentous connection between the pars externa plectri and the crista parotica.

UBERON:3000492.name: processus infrafenestralis
UBERON:3000492.def: posterior part of the corpus of the septomaxilla; the posterior surface of the processus infrafenestralis is in contact with the oblique cartilage.

UBERON:3000494.name: processus lingualis of pterygoid
UBERON:3000494.def: dorsolateral process of the of the medial ramus of the pterygoid.

UBERON:3000500.name: processus posterior of maxilla
UBERON:3000500.def: posterior, toothless portion of the maxilla by which it usually comes in contact with the quadratojugal.

UBERON:3000505.name: processus pterygoideus of maxilla
UBERON:3000505.def: posterior end of the pars palatina of the maxilla that is in contact with the anterior ramus of the pterygoid.

UBERON:3000512.name: processus zygomatico-maxillaris
UBERON:3000512.def: posterodorsal extension of the maxilla by which it establishes contact with the squamosal.

UBERON:3000518.name: pseudodentary
UBERON:3000518.def: compound bone of adult gymnophiona, consisting of dentary, coronoid and mentomeckelian.

UBERON:3000521.name: obsolete pterygoid
UBERON:3000521.def: palatal bones of intramembranous origin that lie anterior to the otic capsules, lateral to the orbits, and medial to the maxillae.

UBERON:3000523.name: pterygoid process of palatoquadrate
UBERON:3000523.def: process that extends anteriorly from the anterolateral margin of the palatoquadrate and articulates or synchondrotically fuses to the posterior end of the posterior maxillary process.

UBERON:3000539.name: recessus marsupiatus of premaxilla
UBERON:3000539.def: is a recess on the surface of the premaxilla near to the base of the pars facialis.

UBERON:3000540.name: recessus vaginiformis
UBERON:3000540.def: is a space on the interior surface of the pars facialis of the maxilla.

UBERON:3000543.name: retroarticular process
UBERON:3000543.def: bony process that is part of the articular and is the point of insertion of the m. interhuoideus posterior.

UBERON:3000547.name: rostral process
UBERON:3000547.def: is a process of the nasal bone directed anteriorly towards the rostrum.

UBERON:3000560.name: septum semicircularium anterior
UBERON:3000560.def: the anterior connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

UBERON:3000561.name: septum semicircularium laterale
UBERON:3000561.def: the lateral connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

UBERON:3000562.name: septum semircularium posterior
UBERON:3000562.def: the posterior connective tissue partition between walls of otic capsule around which the membranous semicircular canals pass.

UBERON:3000565.name: skeletal support for eminentia olfactoria
UBERON:3000565.def: elevation of the dorsal surface of the solum nasi medial to the fenestra endochoanalis that provides support for the eminentia olfactoria.

UBERON:3000569.name: solum nasi
UBERON:3000569.def: unpaired, horizontal plate that forms the floor of the nasal capsule.

UBERON:3000572.name: sphenethmoid
UBERON:3000572.def: endochondral bone that forms the anterior portion of the braincase and forms from one ossification center on each side of the orbital cartilage.

UBERON:3000581.name: sulcus dentalis of maxilla
UBERON:3000581.def: groove located between the pars dentalis and the bases of the maxillary teeth.

UBERON:3000582.name: sulcus dentalis of premaxilla
UBERON:3000582.def: groove located between the pars dentalis and the bases of the premaxillary teeth.

UBERON:3000583.name: sulcus for meckels cartilage
UBERON:3000583.def: a groove on the palatoquadrate that is occupied by the meckel's cartilage.

UBERON:3000586.name: superior prenasal cartilage
UBERON:3000586.def: paired, elongate cartilages that extend anteroventrally to abut the dorsomedial margin of the posterior face of the alary process of the premaxilla. the function of these cartilages is to transmit the movement of the premaxilla to the alary cartilages during the closure of the apertura nasalis externa.

UBERON:3000587.name: obsolete supraangular
UBERON:3000587.def: the suprangular or surangular is a jaw bone found in most land vertebrates, except mammals. it's usually in the back of the jaw, on the upper edge, and is connected to all other jaw bones: dentary, angular, splenial and articular. it is often a muscle attachment site.

UBERON:3000588.name: obsolete supraoccipital
UBERON:3000588.def: median, unpaired bone that can form the dorsal margin of the foramen magnum.

UBERON:3000591.name: suprasphenoid
UBERON:3000591.def: endochondral ossification of the dorsomedial portion of the braincase.

UBERON:3000599.name: taenia tecti marginalis
UBERON:3000599.def: cartilaginous connection between the orbital cartilage and otic capsules.

UBERON:3000601.name: tectum nasi
UBERON:3000601.def: roof of the nasal capsule, confluent with lamina orbitonasalis posteriorly and united to septum nasi.

UBERON:3000619.name: tympanosquamosal
UBERON:3000619.def: central, funnel-shaped, ossified portion of the tympanic annulus fused to the squamosal bone.

UBERON:3000628.name: ventral ramus of squamosal
UBERON:3000628.def: longest of the three squamosal rami; it invests the dorsolateral margin of the palatoquadrate. the distal end of the ventral ramus invests the quadrate and articulates with the quadratojugal.

UBERON:3000639.name: zygomatic ramus of squamosal
UBERON:3000639.def: ramus (process) that projects anteriorly from the dorsal body of the squamosal and forms part of the posterior margin of the orbit.

UBERON:3000640.name: arcus praeoccipitalis
UBERON:3000640.def: skeletal structure that separates the inferior and superior perilymphatic foramina.

UBERON:3000644.name: processus lingularis of nasal skeleton
UBERON:3000644.def: rod-shaped process that extends caudally from the inferior edge of the planum terminale.

UBERON:3000646.name: margo libera
UBERON:3000646.def: anterior, rounded portion of the corpus of the septomaxilla.

UBERON:3000647.name: crista interna
UBERON:3000647.def: sharp ridge that extends medially from the basal part of the processus infrafenestralis; it separates the diverticulum proncipale from the diverticulum medium.

UBERON:3000648.name: crista praeopercularis
UBERON:3000648.def: synchondrotic or synostotic connection between the footplate of the pars media plectri and the ventral margin of the fenestra ovalis.

UBERON:3000649.name: anterior process of vomer
UBERON:3000649.def: process that extends anterolaterally toward the maxilla-premaxilla articulation.

UBERON:3000650.name: processus frontalis of maxilla
UBERON:3000650.def: anterio portion of the maxilla that may contact the nasal and take part in the formation of a groove for the nasolacrimal duct.
UBERON:3000650.synonym: processus praeorbitalis of the pars facialis

UBERON:3000651.name: lamina anterior of maxilla
UBERON:3000651.def: most anterior part of the maxilla, which is in contact with the premaxilla.

UBERON:3000652.name: fossa maxillaris
UBERON:3000652.def: depression lacated on the inner surface of the maxilla between the palatine process and the pars palatina.

UBERON:3000653.name: pars glenoidalis of quadratojugal
UBERON:3000653.def: portion of the quadratojugal that makes contact dorsally with the distal portion of the squamosal.

UBERON:3000654.name: pars jugalis
UBERON:3000654.def: anterior part of the quadratojugal that is in contact with the processus posterior of the maxilla.

UBERON:3000655.name: processus dorsalis of lamella alaris
UBERON:3000655.def: dorsal process of the lamella alaris located at the anterior end of the margo orbitalis; a narrow ligament that runs from the frontoparietal is attached to it.

UBERON:3000656.name: processus posterodorsalis of lamella alaris
UBERON:3000656.def: posterior process of the lamella alaris.

UBERON:3000658.name: prechoanal process
UBERON:3000658.def: process that extends laterally from the anterior process; its bifurcation from the postchoanal process occurs at the level of the dentigerous process.

UBERON:3000659.name: postchoanal process
UBERON:3000659.def: process that extends laterally from the anterior process; its bifurcation from the prechoanal process occurs at the level of the dentigerous process.

UBERON:3000660.name: margo choanalis
UBERON:3000660.def: margin between the prechoanal and postchoanal process. it bounds the fenestra endochoanalis.

UBERON:3000661.name: crista vomeri
UBERON:3000661.def: ridge on the dorsal surface of the vomer that runs from the anterior to the postchoanal processes of the vomer; it takes part in the fixation of the bone to the lateral margin of the solum nasi.

UBERON:3000662.name: processus posterior of parasphenoid
UBERON:3000662.def: posterior projection of the median part of the parsphenoid, which may extend over the posterior margins of the subotic alae.

UBERON:3000664.name: hyoid plate
UBERON:3000664.def: azygous or paired bone that occurs on the ventral surface of the hyoid plate.

UBERON:3000667.name: pars reuniens
UBERON:3000667.def: area of fusion of the ceratohyals.

UBERON:3000668.name: hyoglossal sinus
UBERON:3000668.def: is the space along the anterior edge of the hyoid plate between the hyale and through which passes the hyoglossus muscle as it passes dorsally into the tongue.

UBERON:3000671.name: anterolateral process of hyoid plate
UBERON:3000671.def: processes that flank the hyales laterally and extend anterolaterally from the anterolateral margin of the hyoid plate. they are formed as a result of new cartilaginous growth lateral to the basibranchial.

UBERON:3000672.name: posterolateral process
UBERON:3000672.def: paired processes that extend posterolaterally from the posterolateral margin of the hyoid plate. these processes are formed as a result of new cartilaginous growth lateral to the basibranchial and hypobranchial plate.

UBERON:3000673.name: posteromedial process
UBERON:3000673.def: cartilaginous, paired processes that extend posterolaterally from the posterior margin of the hyoid plate. these processes invest the laryngeal apparatus and are ossified in the adult.

UBERON:3000676.name: bronchial process
UBERON:3000676.def: paired processes that extend posteroventrally from the anterolateral margins of the cricoid ring.

UBERON:3000678.name: esophageal process
UBERON:3000678.def: median process located on the posterior end of the cricoid cartilage.

UBERON:3000683.name: sinus nervi hypoglossi
UBERON:3000683.def: depression that houses the hypoglossus nerve and is located between the anterolateral process and the proximal part of the hyale.

UBERON:3000685.name: foramen nervi hypoglossi
UBERON:3000685.def: foramen that houses the hypoglossus nerve and is located between the anterolateral process and the proximal part of the hyale.

UBERON:3000687.name: processus confluens
UBERON:3000687.def: strip of cartilage that forms the lateral margin of the foramen nervi hypoglossi.

UBERON:3000688.name: prominentia apicalis dorsalis
UBERON:3000688.def: anterior end of the arytenoid cartilage.

UBERON:3000689.name: prominentia apicalis ventralis
UBERON:3000689.def: posterior (cardiac) end of the arytenoid cartilage.

UBERON:3000692.name: pedicel
UBERON:3000692.def: paired stalks located dorsolateral to the vertebral centrum that provide support to the lateral margins of the neural arch laminae.

UBERON:3000694.name: atlantal cotyle
UBERON:3000694.def: anterior, single or paired concave facets for articulation with the condyle(s) of the urostyle.

UBERON:3000696.name: posterior intervertebral notch
UBERON:3000696.def: indentation on the anterior margin of the pedicel. when two vertebrae articulate, the anterior notch of one vertebra and the posterior notch of the other create a bilateral intervertebral space.

UBERON:3000701.name: intervertebral space
UBERON:3000701.def: space formed by the anterior and posterior intervertebral notches. the intervertebral spaces accommodate the spinal nerves as they emerge from the spinal canal.

UBERON:3000704.name: anterior intervertebral notch
UBERON:3000704.def: indentation on the posterior margin of the pedicel. when two vertebrae articulate, the anterior notch of one vertebra and the posterior notch of the other create a bilateral intervertebral space.

UBERON:3000707.name: pleurapophysis
UBERON:3000707.def: paired processes that represent the rib attachments to the vertebra plus the ribs.

UBERON:3000711.name: procoelous
UBERON:3000711.def: holochordal vertebral centra that are concave anteriorly and convex posteriorly; they bear a condyle on the posterior end for the articulation with the posterior adjacent vertebral centrum, forming a ball-and-socket joint that allows extensive motion in most directions.

UBERON:3000712.name: opisthocoelous
UBERON:3000712.def: ectochordal or stegochordal vertebral centra that are convex anteriorly and concave posteriorly; they bear a condyle on the anterior end for the articulation with the posterior adjacent vertebral centrum, forming a ball-and-socket joint that allows extensive motion in most directions.

UBERON:3000713.name: epichordal
UBERON:3000713.def: vertebral centrum that originates from ossification of the dorsal portion of the perichordal tube; the resulting element tends to be depressed in cross section.

UBERON:3000714.name: perichordal
UBERON:3000714.def: vertebral centrum that originates from ossification of the entire perichordal tube; the resulting element is cylindrical in cross section and may have an open (notochord retained) or solid center.

UBERON:3000715.name: heterocoelous
UBERON:3000715.def: vertebral centrum that bears saddle-shaped articular surfaces at both ends, having a convexity in the right-left axis and a concavity in the dorsoventral axis. this morphology allows great lateral and vertical flexion.

UBERON:3000716.name: acoelous
UBERON:3000716.def: vertebral centrum with flat ends. between successive vertebrae there is a fibrocartilaginous intervertebral body with a gel-like core, the nucleus pulposus, which is derived from the embryonic notochord. acoelous vertebrae seem especially suited to receive and distribute compressive forces within the vertebral column.

UBERON:3000717.name: amphicoelous
UBERON:3000717.def: ectochordal, biconcave or terminally flat vertebral centrum. this design seems to allow limited motion in most directions. an intervertebral body (which may or may not be independent from the adjacent centra) fills the cavity between successive centra. the intervertebral body usually is formed by soft material that may be derived, at least in part, from the embryonic notochord.

UBERON:3000718.name: ectochordal
UBERON:3000718.def: spool-shaped vertebral centrum with an open center in which the notochord lies.

UBERON:3000719.name: holochordal
UBERON:3000719.def: spool-shaped vertebral centrum with a solid center. all traces of the notochord dissapear.

UBERON:3000720.name: stegochordal
UBERON:3000720.def: vertebral centrum that is depressed dorsoventrally and solid. all traces of the notochord dissapear.

UBERON:3000727.name: haemal arch lamina
UBERON:3000727.def: paired plates that form the haemal arch. the lateral margin of each lamina is firmly attached to the ventral surface of the caudal vertebral centrum and the medial end fuses to the medial end of the opposite lamina.

UBERON:3000728.name: nucal keel
UBERON:3000728.def: longitudinal process found in all cervical vertebrae, except the atlas, for the attachment of dorsal head musculature.

UBERON:3000730.name: foramen nutritium
UBERON:3000730.def: opening on the lateral side of the vertebra for the passage of blood vessels.

UBERON:3000735.name: mid-dorsal keel
UBERON:3000735.def: ridge-shaped structure present on the dorsomedial surface of the neural arch lamina; this structure is produced at the point of junction of the contralateral sides of each neural arch.

UBERON:3000736.name: obsolete deltopectoral crest
UBERON:3000736.def: ridge on the ventral aspect of the humeral shaft. it serves for the attachment of the mm pectoralis and shoulder musculature used primarily for limb adduction.

UBERON:3000743.name: sacral condyle
UBERON:3000743.def: anterior, paired convex facets for articulation with the cotyle(s) of the urostyle.

UBERON:3000744.name: urostyle cotyle
UBERON:3000744.def: anterior, single or paired concave facets for articulation with the sacral condyle(s).

UBERON:3000745.name: webbing of bone in vertebral column
UBERON:3000745.def: in anurans, pair of bony plates that connect the posteromedial margins of the sacral diapophyses with the lateral margins of the anterior portion of the urostyle.

UBERON:3000746.name: urostyle ridge
UBERON:3000746.def: longitudinal crest on the dorsal side of the urostyle formed by the caudal neural arches.

UBERON:3000748.name: suprascapula
UBERON:3000748.def: paired, cartilaginous elements located in the dorsolateral shoulder region. each suprascapula is a flat broad blade that extends medially.

UBERON:3000752.name: pars acromialis
UBERON:3000752.def: prominent structure (anteromedial head) that forms the anterior section of the ventral margin of the scapula.

UBERON:3000753.name: pars glenoidalis of scapula
UBERON:3000753.def: concave structure (posteromedial head) that forms the posterior head of the ventral margin of the scapula. the pars glenoidalis articulates with the humerus, and comprises the dorsal portion of the glenoid fossa.

UBERON:3000756.name: crista dorsalis humeri
UBERON:3000756.def: small hooked process on the dorsal aspect of the humeral shaft; it does not extend on to the glenoid head. the m subscapularis is inserted on it.

UBERON:3000757.name: zonal area
UBERON:3000757.def: all those parts of the pectoral girdle ventral and medial to the glenoid fossa.

UBERON:3000759.name: omosternum
UBERON:3000759.def: proximal portion of the prezonal element of the pectoral girdle. it may be a flat, midventral cartilaginous structure or a calcified or bony element elaborated into a stylum.

UBERON:3000762.name: epicoracoid
UBERON:3000762.def: paired, flat cartilaginous arches that compose the central portion of the zonal area, unites the clavicle and coracoid of each half of the pectoral girdle, and form the medial margins of the pectoral fenestrae.

UBERON:3000763.name: epicoracoid bridge
UBERON:3000763.def: a pair of cartilaginous expansions (one from each epicoracoid cartilage) that project anteriorly. they articulate anteriorly with the omosternum.

UBERON:3000771.name: acetabular depression
UBERON:3000771.def: the central, most concave portion of the acetabulum, which remains open.

UBERON:3000773.name: ilial ridge
UBERON:3000773.def: longitudinal crest on the dorsal side of the shaft of the ilium.

UBERON:3000774.name: ilial shaft
UBERON:3000774.def: anterior rod that articulates with the sacrum.

UBERON:3000775.name: obsolete ilial corpus
UBERON:3000775.def: posterior body of the ilium that forms the anterior half of the acetabulum.

UBERON:3000777.name: epicoracoid horn
UBERON:3000777.def: a pair of cartilaginous expansions (one from each epicoracoid cartilage) that project posteriorly. they articulate with the sternum by means of grooves, pouches or fossae in the dorsal surface of the sternum and provide a site for the insertion of a pair of muscles derived from the m. rectus abdominis.

UBERON:3000778.name: supracoracoid foramen
UBERON:3000778.def: opening on the scapulocoracoid bone through which passes the n. supracoracoideus and the corresponding artery and vein.

UBERON:3000779.name: pectoral fenestra
UBERON:3000779.def: ovoid space on the pectoral girdle limited anteriorly by the procoracoid, medially by the epicoracoid, and posteriorly by the coracoid.

UBERON:3000780.name: incisura coracoidea
UBERON:3000780.def: notch that separates the cartilaginous regions of the procoracoid and coracoid.

UBERON:3000783.name: fovea capitis of humerus
UBERON:3000783.def: ovoid roughened pit, which is situated a little below and behind the center of the head, and serves as a site of attachment for ligaments.

UBERON:3000784.name: ulnar condyle
UBERON:3000784.def: semi-elliptical ball located at the lower end of the humerus, adjacent to the humeral ball.

UBERON:3000785.name: trochlear groove of humerus
UBERON:3000785.def: furrow between the humeral head and the ulnar condyle.

UBERON:3000786.name: fossa cubitalis ventralis
UBERON:3000786.def: depresion on the distal end of the humerus, just anterior to the humeral head, in which the end of the radius fits when the forelimb is flexed.

UBERON:3000787.name: collum antibrachii
UBERON:3000787.def: in a fused radio-ulna, the proximal portion of the compound bone (where the sulcus longitudinalis is barely evident or absent) is a cylindrical pillar.

UBERON:3000792.name: anterior ramus of cleithrum
UBERON:3000792.def: subdivision of the cleithrum that extends along the anterior edge of the suprascapula.

UBERON:3000793.name: anomocoelous
UBERON:3000793.def: stegochordal slightly biconcave or flat terminally vertebral centrum. each intervertebral cartilage is subdivided anteriorly and posteriorly, producing a free intervertebral element between adjacent vertebrae. this element subsequently ossifies and remains free.

UBERON:3000794.name: displasiocoelous
UBERON:3000794.def: vertebral column in which the first seven vertebrae have holochordal centra and the intervertebral cartilages are posteriorly subdivided in the procoelous manner. the eighth presacral vertebra has a holochordal centrum and the intervertebral cartilage is subdivided in the opisthocoelous manner. thus, the first seven presacral vertebrae are concave anteriorly and convex posteriorly, whereas the eighth is biconcave.

UBERON:3000796.name: imbricate neural arch
UBERON:3000796.def: overlapping neural arches that obscure the spinal cord dorsally.

UBERON:3000797.name: non-imbricate neural arch
UBERON:3000797.def: neural arches that do not overlap, thus exposing the spinal cord dorsally.

UBERON:3000798.name: presacral shield
UBERON:3000798.def: dorsal, dermal plate of bone that overlies the presacral vertebrae. such shield usually has irregular, sculptured surfaces, frequently is broadly expanded, and may be composed of several separate plates.

UBERON:3000799.name: cartilago paraglenoidalis
UBERON:3000799.def: strip of cartilage that separates the coracoid from the scapula.

UBERON:3000801.name: caput glenoidale
UBERON:3000801.def: convex articular facet of the vertebral centrum for the articulation with the adjacent centrum.

UBERON:3000802.name: fossa glenoidalis
UBERON:3000802.def: concave articular facet of the vertebral centrum for the articulation with the adjacent centrum.

UBERON:3000803.name: sulcus articularis lateralis
UBERON:3000803.def: in a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the lateral canal between the carina distalis and the carina medialis.

UBERON:3000804.name: sulcus articularis medialis
UBERON:3000804.def: in a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the medial canal between the carina medialis and the carina proximalis.

UBERON:3000805.name: carina proximalis
UBERON:3000805.def: in a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the proximal ridge.

UBERON:3000806.name: carina medialis
UBERON:3000806.def: in a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the medial ridge.

UBERON:3000807.name: carina distalis
UBERON:3000807.def: in a zygapophysis that has ridges and sulci, the distal ridge.

UBERON:3000808.name: parasagittal processes
UBERON:3000808.def: paired, posteriorly directed process at the posterior margin of each neural arch lamina.

UBERON:3000809.name: accessory articulation
UBERON:3000809.def: paired, additional vertebral articulations located medial to the intervertebral space, adjacent to the vertebral centrum.

UBERON:3000810.name: fissura sagittalis
UBERON:3000810.def: medial groove in the longitudinal ridge of the urostyle formed by the incomplete dorsal fusion of the caudal neural arches.

UBERON:3000811.name: glenoid end of clavicle
UBERON:3000811.def: lateral end of the clavicle, which usually lies in close proximity to the pars acromialis of the scapula, and occassionally may fuse to it.

UBERON:3000813.name: sulcus pro cartilagine praecoracoidealis
UBERON:3000813.def: canal on the posterior aspect of the clavicle that accomodates the anterior margin of the procoracoid cartilage.

UBERON:3000814.name: glenoid head of coracoid
UBERON:3000814.def: lateral end of the coracoid, which forms the medial portion of the glenoid fossa.

UBERON:3000815.name: sternal head of coracoid
UBERON:3000815.def: medial end of the coracoid, which is synchondrotically fused to the epicoracoid cartilage.

UBERON:3000816.name: margo fenestralis
UBERON:3000816.def: anterior margin of the coracoid, which forms the posterior edge of the pectoral fenestra.

UBERON:3000819.name: margo clavicularis
UBERON:3000819.def: inferior margin of the pars acromialis of the scapula, which articulates with the clavicule.

UBERON:3000821.name: margo suprascapularis
UBERON:3000821.def: superior margin of the scapula, which articulates with the suprascapula.

UBERON:3000822.name: pars suprascapularis
UBERON:3000822.def: superior portion of the scapula, which is thinner than the rest of the shaft.

UBERON:3000823.name: sinus interglenoidalis
UBERON:3000823.def: notch or indentation between the pars glenoidalis and pars acromialis of the scapula.

UBERON:3000824.name: tenuitas cristaeformis
UBERON:3000824.def: leading (anterior) portion of the scapula, which is thinner than the rest of the shaft.

UBERON:3000825.name: crista longitudinalis scapula
UBERON:3000825.def: longitudinal ridge on the medial (inner) face of the scapula.

UBERON:3000827.name: margo anterior of cleithrum
UBERON:3000827.def: anterior margin of the anterior ramus of the cleithrum.

UBERON:3000828.name: margo posterior of cleithrum
UBERON:3000828.def: posterior margin of the posterior ramus of the cleithrum.

UBERON:3000829.name: margo scapularis
UBERON:3000829.def: lateral margin of the suprascapula, which articulates with the scapula.

UBERON:3000830.name: margo vertebralis
UBERON:3000830.def: medial margin of the suprascapula, which lies dorsal to the vertebral column.

UBERON:3000831.name: spina acromioidea
UBERON:3000831.def: small process of the lamina recurvata that extends laterally toward the scapular-suprascapular articulation.

UBERON:3000832.name: anterior lamina recurvata
UBERON:3000832.def: portion of the anterior ramus of the cleithrum that invest the anterior margin of the suprascapula, extending onto its dorsal surface.

UBERON:3000833.name: sinus dorsalis
UBERON:3000833.def: notch or indentation between the anterior and posterior rami of the cleithrum.

UBERON:3000834.name: posterior lamina recurvata
UBERON:3000834.def: portion of the posterior ramus of the cleithrum that invests the posterior margin of the suprascapula, extending onto its dorsal surface.

UBERON:3000836.name: crista lateralis humeri
UBERON:3000836.def: ridge on the lateral aspect of the humeral shaft located just anterior to the radial (lateral) epicondyle.

UBERON:3000837.name: crista medialis humeri
UBERON:3000837.def: ridge on the medial aspect of the humeral shaft that extends from the level of the middle portion of the shaft to ulnar (medial) epicondyle.

UBERON:3000839.name: crista radii
UBERON:3000839.def: small ridge on the lateral aspect of the radial shaft, located at the level of the collum antibrachii.

UBERON:3000840.name: capitulum of radius
UBERON:3000840.def: lateral portion of the proximal (upper) articular surface of the radius that consists of an eminence with a rounded apex.

UBERON:3000841.name: obsolete capitulum radii
UBERON:3000841.def: small eminence on the distal articular head of the radius.

UBERON:3000842.name: capitulum ulnae
UBERON:3000842.def: small eminence on the distal articular head of the ulna.

UBERON:3000844.name: sulcus longitudinalis
UBERON:3000844.def: in a fused radio-ulna, longitudinal furrow that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements. this sulcus is deep in the distal portion of the compound bone, but barely evident or absent at the proximal end.

UBERON:3000846.name: element y of fore mesopodium
UBERON:3000846.def: oval carpal element that is located on the anteromedial side of the radiale and the anterolateral side of the ulnare. anteriorly, it articulates with carpals 1 through 4 (or 2 through 5 according to some authors). it is also recognized as centrale by some authors. this element originates from one, two, or three condensation centers. occasionally it may fuse to carpal 2(1), carpal 3(2), the ulnare, or other elements.

UBERON:3000856.name: intercalary element of fore digit
UBERON:3000856.def: small elements present in all digits of the manus, when present in a taxon. each intercalary element articulates with the anteroventral end of the penultimate phalanx proximally and the distal phalanx distally.

UBERON:3000859.name: foramen perforans carpi
UBERON:3000859.def: opening for the passage of the perforans carpi artery from the ventral to the dorsal side. it perforates the compound ulnare + intermedium.

UBERON:3000862.name: pubo-ischium
UBERON:3000862.def: composite element formed by the fusion of the ischium and pubis.

UBERON:3000865.name: epileon
UBERON:3000865.def: dorsal extremity of the ilial shaft, which remains cartilaginous.

UBERON:3000866.name: agger limitans anterior of ilium
UBERON:3000866.def: shelf-like expansion of the ilial corpus that forms the anterior border of the acetabulum.

UBERON:3000867.name: agger limitans anterior of ischium
UBERON:3000867.def: shelf-like expansion of the ischium that forms the posterior border of the acetabulum.

UBERON:3000868.name: obsolete supra-acetabular expansion
UBERON:3000868.def: dorsal portion of the ilial corpus, located above the acetabulum.

UBERON:3000869.name: ilial protuberance
UBERON:3000869.def: small, dorsolaterally projecting knob located just anterior to the supra-acetabular expansion and about the level of the anterior border of the acetabulum.

UBERON:3000870.name: preacetabular expansion
UBERON:3000870.def: ventral portion of the ilial corpus, located anteroventral to the acetabulum.

UBERON:3000871.name: fossula tuberis superioris
UBERON:3000871.def: small depression dorsal to the proximal portion of the collum ilei and ventral to the ilial protuberance.

UBERON:3000872.name: collum ilei
UBERON:3000872.def: cyllindrical pillar that originates anterior to the acetabulum and extends to the ilial shaft.

UBERON:3000873.name: pars cylindriformis ilei
UBERON:3000873.def: elongate, cylindrical structure on the ventral side of the shaft of the ilium that extends through its entire length.

UBERON:3000874.name: crista ischii
UBERON:3000874.def: crest on the posterior side of the ischium, which may also extend to the posteroventral aspect of pubis.

UBERON:3000875.name: spina pelvis posterior
UBERON:3000875.def: small, rounded process on the anterodorsal margin of the ischium, just posterior to the area of articulation with the ilium.

UBERON:3000876.name: spina pelvis anterior
UBERON:3000876.def: small, rounded process on the anteroventral margin of the preacetabular expansion of the ilial corpus.

UBERON:3000877.name: intumescentia bilateralis inferior
UBERON:3000877.def: small protuberance on the ischium, located close to its posteroventral margin.

UBERON:3000878.name: intumescentia bilateralis superior
UBERON:3000878.def: small protuberance on the ischium, located at the level of the superior margin of the acetabulum and close to its posterior margin.

UBERON:3000879.name: incisura terminalis
UBERON:3000879.def: small indentation on the posterior margin of the ischium, ventral to the intumescentia bilateralis superior.

UBERON:3000880.name: crista hypertrophica ischium
UBERON:3000880.def: large protuberance on the dorsal aspect of the ischium that extends from the ischio-ilium articulation to the spina pelvis posterior.

UBERON:3000882.name: interilial region
UBERON:3000882.def: area of convergence of the ilial shafts. when the preacetabular ilium is narrow, the interilial configuration is v-shaped or narrowly rounded, whereas when the interilial region is broadly expanded the interilial configuration is u-shaped.

UBERON:3000883.name: recessus coccygealis
UBERON:3000883.def: area dorsal to the pelvic girdle symphysis, between the dorsal portions of the ilial corpora, where lies the posterior terminus of the urostyle.

UBERON:3000884.name: epipubis
UBERON:3000884.def: small prepubic element formed by a plate of cartilage (which may calcify in the adult) that is synchondrotically united with the pubis.

UBERON:3000885.name: obsolete nobelian bone
UBERON:3000885.def: paired cartilaginous rods that lie within the copulatory organ (or so-called tail) and are attached to the posteroventral part of the pelvic girdle.

UBERON:3000886.name: ypsiloid cartilage
UBERON:3000886.def: y-shaped cartilage lying in the middle line, anterior to the pubo-ischium with which it articulates. it lies dorsal to the rectus abdominis muscle with which it articulates.

UBERON:3000894.name: femoral ridge
UBERON:3000894.def: low crest that arises just behind the acetabular head and extends distally for about one-third the length of the femoral shaft.

UBERON:3000895.name: obsolete trochlear groove of femur
UBERON:3000895.def: canal on the posteroventral surface of the femoral head, which articulates with the ischial process on the rim of the acetabulum.

UBERON:3000896.name: foveal depression
UBERON:3000896.def: ovoid roughened pit situated on the dorsal and anteroventral surface of the acetabular head wherein the ligaments attaching the bone to the acetabulum are inserted.

UBERON:3000898.name: trochanteric crest
UBERON:3000898.def: paired ridges on the ventral surface of the femoral shaft that run toward the femoral trochanter; the posterior crest is less developed.

UBERON:3000903.name: tibial crest
UBERON:3000903.def: ridge that arises from the dorso-masial side of the extensor surface of the tibia. it receives the insertion of the tendon of the extensor ilio-tibialis muscle.

UBERON:3000904.name: apophysis distalis of tibiofibula
UBERON:3000904.def: swelling on the extensor surface of the distal head of the tibiofibula.

UBERON:3000905.name: caput ossis cruris
UBERON:3000905.def: proximal head of the tibiofibula that articulates with the distal head of the femur.

UBERON:3000906.name: sulcus pro musculo extensori cruris brevis
UBERON:3000906.def: small canal on the proximal head of to the tibiofibula, lateral to the apophysis distalis, for the insertion of the cruris brevis muscle.

UBERON:3000907.name: eminentia arcuata
UBERON:3000907.def: small crest on the extensor surface of the proximal head of the tibiofibula (tibial side).

UBERON:3000908.name: sulcus distalis ossis cruris
UBERON:3000908.def: in a fused tibiofibula, longitudinal furrow in the distal portion of the compound bone that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements.

UBERON:3000909.name: sulcus proximalis ossis cruris
UBERON:3000909.def: in a fused tibiofibula, longitudinal furrow in the proximal portion of the compound bone that demarcates the area of fusion of both elements.

UBERON:3000911.name: foramen nutritium exterius
UBERON:3000911.def: foramen for the tibial artery and vein and the deep peroneal nerve; it pierces through the midpoint of the shaft of the tibiofibula.

UBERON:3000915.name: spatium intertarsale
UBERON:3000915.def: separation of the tibiale and fibulare along their longitudinal axia.

UBERON:3000916.name: apophysis proximalis
UBERON:3000916.def: swelling on the extensor surface of the proximal compound head of the tibiale and fibulare.

UBERON:3000917.name: apophysis distalis of tibiale fibulare
UBERON:3000917.def: swelling on the extensor surface of the distal compound head of the tibiale and fibulare.

UBERON:3000921.name: element y of hind mesopodium
UBERON:3000921.def: oval tarsal element that is located on the anteromedial side of the tibiale. anteriorly, it articulates with the proximal prehallux, tarsals 1, 2, and 3.

UBERON:3000922.name: prehallux skeleton
UBERON:3000922.def: one to three or four elements located ventral and medial to the metatarsal of digit i. when more than one elements are present, they are smaller than the proximal prehallux.

UBERON:3000931.name: intercalary element of hind digit
UBERON:3000931.def: small elements present in all digits of the pes, when present in a taxon. each intercalary element articulates with the anteroventral end of the penultimate phalanx proximally and the distal phalanx distally.

UBERON:3000934.name: foramen perforans tarsi
UBERON:3000934.def: small opening between the centrale and fibulare that allows the perforans tarsi artery to pass from the ventral to the dorsal side of the ankle.

UBERON:3000935.name: obsolete scapular area
UBERON:3000935.def: dorso-lateral portion of the pectoral girdle.

UBERON:3000936.name: zonal element
UBERON:3000936.def: all those parts of the pectoral girdle in the central region of the zonal area.

UBERON:3000937.name: prezonal element
UBERON:3000937.def: all those parts of the pectoral girdle that lie anterior to the zonal area.

UBERON:3000938.name: postzonal element
UBERON:3000938.def: all those parts of the pectoral girdle that lies posterior to the zonal area.

UBERON:3000941.name: arciferal girdle
UBERON:3000941.def: pectoral girdle in which the epicoracoid cartilages are elaborated into posteriorly directed epicoracoid horns. most arciferal pectoral girdles are characterized by fusion of the epicoracoid cartilages in the interclavicle region. posterior to the clavicles, the epicoracoids usually are free and overlapping.

UBERON:3000942.name: firmisternal girdle
UBERON:3000942.def: pectoral girdle that lacks epicoracoid horns. the sternum is fused to the pectoral arch, and the epicoracoid cartilages of each half of the girdle are fused to one another. the midzonal length of the girdle is shorter than that of an arciferal girdle, but pre- and postzonal elements tend to be longer.

UBERON:3000943.name: pseudofirmisternal girdle
UBERON:3000943.def: modified arciferal pectoral girdle in which the fusion of the epicoracoid cartilages in the interclavicle region is extended posteriorly. thus, the cartilages no longer overlap freely, and functionally a partially firmisternal condition is created.

UBERON:3000944.name: pseudoarciferal girdle
UBERON:3000944.def: modified firmisternal pectoral girdle in which the epicoracoid cartilages are partly free and overlapping; however, the epicoracoids are fused to one another and the sternum postermodially.

UBERON:3000945.name: inscriptional rib
UBERON:3000945.def: three pairs of cartilaginous elements posterior to the sternum that lie in the myosepta of the ventral trunk musculature.

UBERON:3000948.name: articular process
UBERON:3000948.def: paired processes located on the anterior end of the cricoid cartilage.

UBERON:3000949.name: posterior ramus of cleithrum
UBERON:3000949.def: laminar subdivision of the cleithrum that extends along the ventral (lateral) midbody of the suprascapula.

UBERON:3000950.name: os triangulare
UBERON:3000950.def: small, broadly triangular bar of bone lying across the ventral side of the pharynx at the junction of the m. genio-hyoideus and the m. rectus cervicis superficialis.

UBERON:3000951.name: anterior radial
UBERON:3000951.def: paired, horn-like processes of basibranchial i that protrude in an antero-dorso-lateral direction, being more or less embedded in the tongue musculature. these elements contitute the hypohyals.

UBERON:3000952.name: posterior radial
UBERON:3000952.def: paired, horn-like processes of basibranchial i that protrude in an antero-dorso-lateral direction, being more or less embedded in the tongue musculature. they arise secondarily during metamorphosis, and are therefore not strictly part of the visceral skeleton.

UBERON:3000953.name: ceratobranchials ii--iv
UBERON:3000953.def: paired bars that articulate with hypobranchial ii. reduction of loss of these elements is common in salamanders.

UBERON:3000954.name: hypobranchial i
UBERON:3000954.def: paired bar that articulates with basibranchial i. it forms the anterior portion of the posterior cornu of the hyoid.

UBERON:3000955.name: ceratobranchial i
UBERON:3000955.def: paired bar that articulates with, or is fused to, hypobranchial i. it forms the posterior portion of the posterior cornu of the hyoid.

UBERON:3000956.name: hypobranchial ii
UBERON:3000956.def: paired bar that articulates anteriorly with basibranchial i and posteriorly with ceratobranchials ii--iv.

UBERON:3000957.name: obsolete basihyal
UBERON:3000957.def: paired, anterior element that articulates medially with basibranchial i and posterolaterally with the paired hypohyals.

UBERON:3000961.name: external integument structure
UBERON:3000961.def: structures of the dermis, epidermis, glands and pigment cells recognizable on the external surfaces of the integument.

UBERON:3000966.name: angulosplenial
UBERON:3000966.def: dermal bone of anuran lower jaw investing lingual and ventral surfaces of meckel's cartilage; forming coronoid process and articulating with palatoquadrate posteriorly.

UBERON:3000972.name: head external integument structure
UBERON:3000972.def: dermal, epidermal, glandular and pigment structures of the external head integument.

UBERON:3000977.name: body external integument structure
UBERON:3000977.def: dermal, epidermal, glandular and pigment structures of the body integument.

UBERON:3000981.name: limb external integument structure
UBERON:3000981.def: dermal, epidermal, glandular and pigment structures of the limb integument.

UBERON:3000982.name: tail external integument structure
UBERON:3000982.def: dermal, epidermal, glandular and pigment structures of the tail integument.

UBERON:3000992.name: obsolete principal cavity
UBERON:3000992.def: the largest part of the nasal cavity, containing the olfactory epithelium.

UBERON:3000998.name: suprarostral cartilage
UBERON:3000998.def: larval upper jaws articulate with trabecular horns.

UBERON:3010007.name: pit organ
UBERON:3010007.def: mechanoreceptive organ of the lateral line, smaller than neuromasts, they are located on the surface of the epidermis. these receptors receive afferent and efferent innervation.

UBERON:3010018.name: m. glutaeus magnus
UBERON:3010018.def: originates from the superior process of the ilium and inserts on the aponeuronis of the m. cruralis.

UBERON:3010022.name: m. tensor fasciae latae
UBERON:3010022.def: originates on the ventro-lateral aspect of the ala ossis ilei and the ventral surface of the iliacus externus. inserts on the lateral surface of the cruralis, the dorso-lateral surface of the gluteus magnus, and on the aponeurosis of the cruralis.

UBERON:3010027.name: m. sartorius
UBERON:3010027.def: originates on the ventral pelvic rim, the pubic region, and the ventral surface of the adductor longus. the insertion bifurcates distally; the ventral portion attaches to the aponeurosis of the cruralis and the dorsal part attaches to the distal attachment of the gracilis major, the semitendinosus, and to the aponeurosis of the cruralis.

UBERON:3010029.name: obsolete gonochoristic organism
UBERON:3010029.def: multi-cellular organism that has male and female sexes.

UBERON:3010032.name: m. semitendinosus
UBERON:3010032.def: originates by two tendons: one on the postero-ventral aspect of the pelvic rim, the other, a dorsal tendon from the postero-dorsal pelvic rim under the ventral edge of m. semimembranosus. inserts on the ventral surface of the tibiofibula.

UBERON:3010039.name: protandrous hermaphroditic organism
UBERON:3010039.def: sequential hermaphroditic organism that produces gametes first of the male sex, and then later of the female sex.

UBERON:3010042.name: protogynous hermaphroditic organism
UBERON:3010042.def: sequential hermaphroditic organism that produces gametes first of the female sex, and then later of the male sex.

UBERON:3010045.name: centrale 1
UBERON:3010045.def: distal-most centrale when two are present.

UBERON:3010047.name: m. quadratus femoris
UBERON:3010047.def: originates on the ventro-lateral border of the ischium and inserts on the ventro-medial surface of the femur at the base of caput femoris.

UBERON:3010049.name: m. gemellus
UBERON:3010049.def: originates from the dorso-lateral margin of the ischium and inserts on the medial surface of the femur.

UBERON:3010058.name: dermal annular fold
UBERON:3010058.def: a dermal fold surrounding the body reflecting body segmentation. found in caecilians.

UBERON:3010060.name: centrale (fore)
UBERON:3010060.def: rectangular cartilage or bone between the distal basal commune and the proximal intermedium.

UBERON:3010061.name: anterior quadratocranial commissure
UBERON:3010061.def: cartilage that bridges palatoquadrate to ethmoid region.

UBERON:3010065.name: m. gracilis major
UBERON:3010065.def: originates by a broad tendon from the postero-ventral surface of the pelvic rim and inserts by two tendons. one broad tendon inserts on the knee aponeurosis, and in part on the ventro-medial surface of the tibiofibula. the other long tendon inserts on the posterior surface of the tibiofibula just below the proximal head.

UBERON:3010067.name: m. gracilis minor
UBERON:3010067.def: originates from the pelvic rim just ventral to the anus and merges with m. gracilis major. m. gracilis minor also attaches to the skin.

UBERON:3010068.name: m. semimembranosus
UBERON:3010068.def: originates on the ventro-lateral surface of the ischium below the anus and inserts on the ventro-medial aspect of the femur and the head of the tibiofibula by a stout tendon, which is formed by the ventral origin of the plantaris longus.

UBERON:3010069.name: intermedium (fore)
UBERON:3010069.def: quadrangular cartilage or bone lying between the preaxial radiale and the postaxial ulnare in the proximal level of the mesopodium.

UBERON:3010070.name: m. ileo-fibularis
UBERON:3010070.def: originates from the ventral border of the ala ossis ilei just posterior to the origin of m. glutaeus maximus. insterts in the aponeurosis covering the knee joint.

UBERON:3010072.name: m. pyriformis
UBERON:3010072.def: originates on the dorso-lateral border of the distal urostyle and inserts on the dorsal surface of the crista femoris. this muscle inserts between the m. ilio-fibularis/m. glutaeus magnus and m. semimembranosus.

UBERON:3010073.name: centrale 2
UBERON:3010073.def: the proximal-most rectangular cartilage or bone when two centralelia are present.

UBERON:3010074.name: m. ileo-femoralis
UBERON:3010074.def: originates from the postero-ventral surface of the ala ossis ilei and from the insertion tendon of m. ileo-fibularis. inserts along the dorso-medial border of the femur.

UBERON:3010076.name: m. iliacus internus
UBERON:3010076.def: muscle originates on the ventral border of the ala ossis ilei to insert on the dorso-medial surface of the femur.

UBERON:3010078.name: m. iliacus externus
UBERON:3010078.def: originates on the ventral and lateral surfaces of the ala ossis ilei and inserts on the postero-dorsal face of the caput femoris.

UBERON:3010082.name: m. pulmonum proprius
UBERON:3010082.def: originates along the connective tissue covering the dorsal surface of the lung and inserts on the dorsal surface of the femur. muscle found only in pipa.

UBERON:3010084.name: m. tibialis posticus
UBERON:3010084.def: originates on the entire medial surface of the shaft of the tibiofibula. inserts on the tibiale by a long tendon proximo-lateral to the insertion of the medial belly of m. tibialis anticus longus.

UBERON:3010087.name: m. tibialis anticus longus
