UBERON:3010087.def: originates on the ventro-lateral surface of the medial condyle of the femur. its tendon extends in a groove over the knee in the lateral surface of the tibiofibular head, and penetrates the m. peroneus tendon. insertion is by a lateral and medial head on the dorso-lateral surface of the fibulare and the medial border of the proximal end of the tibiale respectively.

UBERON:3010089.name: m. extensor cruris brevis
UBERON:3010089.def: originates by a slender tendon from the ventral surface of the medial condyle of the femur and passes over the knee to insert as a fleshy belly on the ventro-lateral surface of the tibiofibula.

UBERON:3010090.name: m. tibialis anticus brevis
UBERON:3010090.def: originates from the dorso-lateral surface of the tibiofibula and inserts on the proximo-medial surface of the tibiale dorsal to the medial head of m. tibialis anticus longus.

UBERON:3010092.name: basitrabecular process
UBERON:3010092.def: a process of the otic capsule that will bridge to the palatoquadrate basal process.

UBERON:3010093.name: villosities
UBERON:3010093.def: small hair or nipple like projection on the integument.

UBERON:3010094.name: quadratoethmoid process
UBERON:3010094.def: process that projects from anterior margin of commissure as site of attachment for quadratoethmoid ligament.

UBERON:3010097.name: m. tarsalis posticus
UBERON:3010097.def: originates on the medial border of the ligamentum calcanei and inserts along the ventral surface of the tibiale.

UBERON:3010098.name: m. plantaris profundus
UBERON:3010098.def: originates on the medial half of the ligamentum calcanei and inserts along the dorsal surface of the aponeurosis plantaris and extends to the level of the base of the prehallux.

UBERON:3010099.name: obsolete musculus rectus superior
UBERON:3010099.def: cranial nerve iii innervated; dorsal in the rectus group.

UBERON:3010101.name: obsolete musculus rectus inferior
UBERON:3010101.def: cranial nerve iii innervated; ventral in the rectus group.

UBERON:3010105.name: anterodorsal lateral line nerve (adlln)
UBERON:3010105.def: sensory nerve of the anterior lateral line component. it develops from the preotic anterodorsal placode. adlln branches into two rami innervating orbital lines of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010109.name: anteroventral lateral line nerve (avlln)
UBERON:3010109.def: sensory nerve of the anterior lateral line component. it develops from preotic anteroventral placode. avlln innervates lower jaw lines of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010113.name: obsolete musculus rectus medialis
UBERON:3010113.def: cranial nerve iii innervated; medial in the rectus group.

UBERON:3010115.name: posterior lateral line nerve (plln)
UBERON:3010115.def: sensory nerve of the posterior lateral line component. it develops from de postotic posterior placode. plln innervates the trunk lines of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010117.name: obsolete musculus obliquus inferior
UBERON:3010117.def: cranial nerve iii innverated; ventral in the obliquus group.

UBERON:3010118.name: quadrato-orbital commissure
UBERON:3010118.def: cartilage that bridges palatoquadrate muscular process to dorsal orbitonasal plate.

UBERON:3010125.name: musculus levator bulbi
UBERON:3010125.def: cranial nerve v innervated; ventral to the eye.

UBERON:3010126.name: middle lateral line nerve (mlln)
UBERON:3010126.def: sensory nerve of the posterior lateral line component. it develops from the postotic middle placode. mlln innervates neuromasts located over the otic capsule and the suprabranchial line of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010127.name: fringe on postaxial edge of finger iv

UBERON:3010128.name: taeniae tecti marginalis
UBERON:3010128.def: compose lateral rim of frontoparietal fenestra, ventrally confluent with orbital cartilages, posteriorly confluent with tectum synoticum.

UBERON:3010130.name: taenia tecti transversalis
UBERON:3010130.def: cartilaginous connection that partitions frontoparietal fenestra into anterior and posterior regions. often persists form larva into adults.

UBERON:3010131.name: orbital cartilages
UBERON:3010131.def: forms lateral walls of braincase, confluent posteriorly with otic capsules via taenia tecti marginalis and anteriorly with lamina orbitonasalis via sphenethmoid commissure.

UBERON:3010132.name: taenia tecti medialis
UBERON:3010132.def: cartilaginous connection between the taenia tecti transversalis to the tectum synoticum, and subdividing the parietal fenestra into left and right fenestrae. often persist from larva to adult.

UBERON:3010136.name: m. cruralis
UBERON:3010136.def: originates from the anterior surface of the hip joint capsule between the iliacus internus and the pectineus. inserts by an aponeurosis attaching to the condyles of the femur and on the head of the cruris. this continues over the cruris to cover the tibialis anticus longus and peroneus to insert on the dorsal surface of those muscles.

UBERON:3010137.name: obsolete trabecular plate
UBERON:3010137.def: ventral plate anterior to and confluent with ethmoid plate.

UBERON:3010142.name: occipital arch
UBERON:3010142.def: posterior chondrocranium forming ventral and lateral margins of foramen magnum, medial to otic capsules.

UBERON:3010144.name: odontoids
UBERON:3010144.def: toothlike processes found on the mandible of some anurans; can be formed by dentary or dentary + mentomeckelian bones; odontoids lack enamel and dentine present in true teeth.

UBERON:3010145.name: obsolete otic operculum
UBERON:3010145.def: plate of cartilage occluding fenestra ovalis.

UBERON:3010146.name: lacrimal
UBERON:3010146.def: investing bone in non-teleosts associated with nasolacrimal duct and lying between pars facialis of maxilla and prefrontal and sometimes nasal.

UBERON:3010166.name: fringe on postaxial edge of toe v

UBERON:3010172.name: subarticular tubercles
UBERON:3010172.def: is a integumentary structure located on the ventral surface of the hand and/or foot. found at the junction between, in the hand, the metacarpal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges, and in the foot between the metatarsal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges.

UBERON:3010194.name: mediale
UBERON:3010194.def: a recurrent variant of salamanders; a rhomboidal cartilage lying immediately postaxial from the centrale or centrale 1.

UBERON:3010195.name: lateral appendix
UBERON:3010195.def: a small lateral diverticulum of the nasal cavity found in anuran larvae.

UBERON:3010197.name: lateral recess
UBERON:3010197.def: a part of the inferior cavity of the olfactory organ, found in anurans.

UBERON:3010205.name: postminimus
UBERON:3010205.def: a rounded  cartilage lying in the postaxial margin of the mesopodium, adjacent to the distal end of the fibulare.

UBERON:3010217.name: obsolete carotid
UBERON:3010217.def: either of two arteries which carry blood to the head.

UBERON:3010218.name: obsolete external carotid
UBERON:3010218.def: an artery which supplies blood to the muscles of the tongue and floor of the mouth via four major branches.

UBERON:3010219.name: obsolete internal carotid
UBERON:3010219.def: an artery which supplies the upper jaw and cranium.

UBERON:3010220.name: obsolete orbital region
UBERON:3010220.def: an anatomical cluster that is part of the cranium and structurally supports the eye.

UBERON:3010240.name: nobelian rod
UBERON:3010240.def: either of a pair of cartilaginous rods that support the intromittent organ of male ascaphus, and are attached to the posteroventral part of the pelvic girdle.

UBERON:3010259.name: phallodeum
UBERON:3010259.def: eversible phalloid portion of the cloaca that is inserted in the female's vent during copulation. found in male caecillians.

UBERON:3010260.name: intromittent organ (ascaphus type)
UBERON:3010260.def: a tail like posterior extension of the cloaca supported by a pair of nobelian rods.

UBERON:3010272.name: obsolete asexual organism
UBERON:3010272.def: multi-cellular organism that does not produce gametes.

UBERON:3010273.name: obsolete cell space
UBERON:3010273.def: anatomical space that is part of a cell.

UBERON:3010274.name: obsolete epithelial cell
UBERON:3010274.def: cell which has as its part a cytoskeleton that allows for tight cell to cell contact and which has apical-basal cell polarity.

UBERON:3010275.name: obsolete obsolete single cell organism
UBERON:3010275.def: cell that is an individual member of a species.

UBERON:3010277.name: obsolete tip
UBERON:3010277.def: anatomical point that is the apex of a projection or anything long and tapered; can be bony or cartilage.

UBERON:3010283.name: obsolete animal blastomere
UBERON:3010283.def: pigmented, smaller blastomere of the animal (upper) hemisphere of the cleaving embryo.

UBERON:3010284.name: obsolete vegetal blastomere
UBERON:3010284.def: unpigmented, larger blastomere of the vegetal (lower) hemisphere of the cleaving embryo.

UBERON:3010285.name: obsolete bottle cell
UBERON:3010285.def: cell type that is first to migrate inwards at the blastopore during gastrulation.

UBERON:3010286.name: obsolete chondrocyte
UBERON:3010286.def: polymorphic cell type that forms cartilage.

UBERON:3010288.name: obsolete fibroblast
UBERON:3010288.def: a connective tissue cell that secretes an extracellular matrix rich in collagen and other macromolecules.

UBERON:3010293.name: obsolete primordial germ cell
UBERON:3010293.def: primitive cell type that is involved in the reproduction of the organism beginning with the sexual differentiation of the gonads at nf stage 52. in males specifically, it migrates from the genital ridge cortical region into the medullary tissue, where it forms spermatogonia. in females it is embedded in the cortical region and multiplies as oogonia.

UBERON:3010295.name: obsolete spermatozoon
UBERON:3010295.def: a mature male germ cell that develops from a spermatid.

UBERON:3010297.name: obsolete primary oogonium
UBERON:3010297.def: a germ cell that is a primordial oocyte in a female and that develops into secondary oogonia by mitotic division.

UBERON:3010298.name: obsolete primary spermatogonium
UBERON:3010298.def: a germ cell that is a primordial spermatocyte in a male and that develops into secondary spermatogonia by mitotic division.

UBERON:3010299.name: obsolete secondary oogonium
UBERON:3010299.def: a type of germ cell that results from the mitotic division of a primary oogonium.

UBERON:3010300.name: obsolete secondary spermatogonium
UBERON:3010300.def: a type of germ cell that results from the mitotic division of a primary spermatogonium.

UBERON:3010306.name: obsolete mitochondrial aggregate
UBERON:3010306.def: a large distinctive organelle aggregate comprised of mitochondria found in developing oocytes of many species. from pepling et al. 2007.

UBERON:3010308.name: obsolete lymphocyte
UBERON:3010308.def: a cell of the b cell, t cell, or natural killer cell lineage.

UBERON:3010309.name: obsolete b cell
UBERON:3010309.def: a lymphocyte of b lineage with the phenotype cd19-positive and surface immunoglobulin-positive.

UBERON:3010310.name: obsolete natural killer cell
UBERON:3010310.def: a lymphocyte that can spontaneously kill a variety of target cells without prior antigenic activation via germline encoded activation receptors and also regulate immune responses via cytokine release and direct contact with other cells.

UBERON:3010311.name: obsolete t cell
UBERON:3010311.def: a type of lymphocyte whose defining characteristic is the expression of a t cell receptor complex.

UBERON:3010312.name: obsolete thymocyte
UBERON:3010312.def: an immature t cell located in the thymus.

UBERON:3010313.name: obsolete myoblast
UBERON:3010313.def: embryonic (precursor) cell of the myogenic lineage that develops from the mesoderm.

UBERON:3010314.name: obsolete abdominal myoblast
UBERON:3010314.def: the myoblast that forms the muscles of the anterior abdominal walls.

UBERON:3010315.name: obsolete neuron
UBERON:3010315.def: cell that is the basic unit of nervous tissue, each consisting of a body, an axon, and dendrites, and the purpose of which is to receive, conduct, and transmit impulses in the nervous system.

UBERON:3010317.name: obsolete pigment cell
UBERON:3010317.def: cell type that contains a deposition of coloring matter.

UBERON:3010318.name: obsolete iridophore
UBERON:3010318.def: a pigment cell derived from the neural crest. the cell contains flat light-reflecting platelets, probably of guanine, in stacks called reflecting platets or iridisomes. the color-generating components produce a silver, gold, or iridescent color.

UBERON:3010319.name: obsolete melanocyte
UBERON:3010319.def: a pigment cell derived from the neural crest. contains melanin-filled pigment granules, which gives a brown to black appearance.

UBERON:3010320.name: obsolete xanthophore
UBERON:3010320.def: a pigment cell derived from the neural crest. contains cartenoid pigments in structures called pterinosomes or xanthosomes. this gives an appearance ranging from a golden yellow to orange and red.

UBERON:3010321.name: obsolete podocyte
UBERON:3010321.def: cell type that is a component of the glomus.

UBERON:3010322.name: obsolete stem cell
UBERON:3010322.def: a relatively undifferentiated cell that retains the ability to divide and proliferate throughout life to provide progenitor cells that can differentiate into specialized cells.

UBERON:3010323.name: obsolete hematopoietic stem cell
UBERON:3010323.def: a stem cell from which all cells of the lymphoid and myeloid lineages develop, including blood cells and cells of the immune system.

UBERON:3010324.name: obsolete zygote
UBERON:3010324.def: diploid cell produced by the fusion of sperm cell nucleus and egg cell.

UBERON:3010326.name: obsolete blastocoel anlage
UBERON:3010326.def: the first appearance of the antomical space that will become the blastocoel.

UBERON:3010369.name: obsolete branchial arch skeleton
UBERON:3010369.def: skeletal and cartilaginous elements of the branchial arches; the last five of the set of seven pharyngeal arches; the numbering system can be confusing; generally branchial arch #1 is the first branchial arch, or the third pharyngeal arch, but some authors do not follow this convention.

UBERON:3010379.name: inner fin tissue
UBERON:3010379.def: part of the fin consisting of a supporting core of mesenchyme and extracellular matrix.

UBERON:3010380.name: outer fin tissue
UBERON:3010380.def: part of the fin consisting of flattened epidermal cells elevated into a keel-like structure.

UBERON:3010393.name: mesonephric late distal segment
UBERON:3010393.def: the site of bicarbonate resorption in the adult kidney. it is equivalent to the convoluted distal segment of metanephric nephrons.

UBERON:3010404.name: capillary system of liver
UBERON:3010404.def: the smallest of the blood vessels, parts of the microcirculation, of the liver.

UBERON:3010447.name: m. extensor digitorum communis longus
UBERON:3010447.def: it arises on the lateral epicondyle of the humerus by two heads: the lateral one arises by a thin tendon in common with the m.extensor carpi ulnaris with fibers proximally fused. the internal one arises by a short tendon in common with proximally fused fibers of the m. extensor carpi radialis. it divides distally in two heads: the external head inserts with a long and thin tendon on the metacarpal v, at the same point of insertion of the m. abductor brevis dorsalis digiti v; the internal one inserts by a thin tendon on the proximal region of the metacarpal iv, between the m. extensor brevis superficialis digiti iv and the m. extensor brevis medius digiti iv (pristimantis bogotensis).

UBERON:3010449.name: dorsal marginal zone
UBERON:3010449.def: marginal zone that is a key embryonic tissue region of the early gastrula stage embryo and that houses the spemann-mangold organizer.

UBERON:3010489.name: muscular artery
UBERON:3010489.def: part of the external carotid which delivers blood to the mm rectus cervicis and interhyoideus posterior.

UBERON:3010494.name: lateral pretrosal artery
UBERON:3010494.def: part of the internal carotid which supplies blood to the ear and branches to two additional arteries.

UBERON:3010496.name: mandibular artery
UBERON:3010496.def: part of lateral pretrosal artery which supplies blood to the roof of the mouth.

UBERON:3010498.name: cutaneus artery
UBERON:3010498.def: artery which supplies blood to the thymus and parotoid region.

UBERON:3010499.name: coeliaco-mesenteric artery
UBERON:3010499.def: this artery has many branches which supply blood to various organs in the viscus.

UBERON:3010500.name: gastrico-linealis
UBERON:3010500.def: major branch which supplies blood to the spleen and dorsal wall of the stomach.

UBERON:3010501.name: duodeno-pancreatic artery
UBERON:3010501.def: major branch which supplies blood to pancreas and duodenum.

UBERON:3010502.name: duodeno-hepatic artery
UBERON:3010502.def: major branch supplying blood via many smaller branches to the liver, duodenum, ventral wall of the stomach, and gall bladder.

UBERON:3010503.name: oviduct artery
UBERON:3010503.def: one of three arteries which are part of the renal artery supplying blood to the anterior, middle, and posterior parts of the oviduct.

UBERON:3010506.name: postcaval vein
UBERON:3010506.def: one of three major veins which enter the sinus venosus.

UBERON:3010507.name: precaval vein
UBERON:3010507.def: either of a pair of veins which enter on either side of the sinus venosus.

UBERON:3010515.name: lateral vein
UBERON:3010515.def: either of the veins which collect blood from the trunk and skin and drain into the subclavian vein.

UBERON:3010516.name: cutaneus magnus
UBERON:3010516.def: anterior part of the lateral vein.

UBERON:3010517.name: ventral abdominal vein
UBERON:3010517.def: a vein formed by the combination of veins in the pelvic region which collects blood from the liver, stomach, intestines, and gall bladder.

UBERON:3010519.name: jacobson's vein
UBERON:3010519.def: either of a pair of veins which receives many small vesicles from the kidney and collects blood from the oviducal vein.

UBERON:3010520.name: oviducal vein
UBERON:3010520.def: vein which collects blood from the oviduct.

UBERON:3010523.name: m. plantaris longus
UBERON:3010523.def: originates by two heads, one from the dorso-distal border of the aponeurosis covering the knee and the other from two tendinous branches along the medial border of the knee joint. inserts by a thick, broad tendon to form the aponeurosis plantaris.

UBERON:3010524.name: bronchial tube
UBERON:3010524.def: either of the short tubes which bifurcate posteriorly from the trachea and lead into the lungs.

UBERON:3010529.name: ovisac
UBERON:3010529.def: part of the ovary consisting of a thin sheath of connective tissue enclosing the ovarian follicles.

UBERON:3010530.name: obsolete mesorchium
UBERON:3010530.def: a thin membrane which attaches the testes to the kidneys and supports the efferent ductules from the testes to the kidneys.

UBERON:3010538.name: obsolete pars nervosa
UBERON:3010538.def: region of the neurohypophysis which secretes neurohypophyseal hormones, regulating water loss and salt balance.

UBERON:3010541.name: median pars intermedia
UBERON:3010541.def: region of the adenohypophysis which secretes melanophore-stimulating hormone, affecting the integumentary chromatophores.

UBERON:3010552.name: obsolete gastrula cell
UBERON:3010552.def: a cell of the embryo in the early stage following the blastula, characterized by morphogenetic cell movements, cell differentiation, and the formation of the three germ layers.

UBERON:3010553.name: obsolete blastoderm cell
UBERON:3010553.def: an undifferentiated cell produced by early cleavages of the fertilized egg (zygote).

UBERON:3010554.name: obsolete ectodermal cell
UBERON:3010554.def: a cell of the outer of the three germ layers of the embryo.

UBERON:3010555.name: obsolete endodermal cell
UBERON:3010555.def: a cell of the inner of the three germ layers of the embryo.

UBERON:3010556.name: obsolete mesodermal cell
UBERON:3010556.def: a cell of the middle germ layer of the embryo.

UBERON:3010565.name: pila preoptica
UBERON:3010565.def: a strut of cartilage  extending dorsally from the basal plate and with other similar cartilages forming the sides of the brain case. posterior to the pila preoptica is the pila antoptica between these two cartilages emerges the optic and trochlear nerves.

UBERON:3010576.name: prenasal (amphibians)
UBERON:3010576.def: a dermal bone that forms anterior to the premaxillae between the maxillae and articulates with the nasals posteriorly.

UBERON:3010583.name: basibranchial i
UBERON:3010583.def: bilaterally unpaired ventral element with which articulates with lateral paired elements.

UBERON:3010584.name: mandibular arch neural crest
UBERON:3010584.def: anterior most migratory stream of cranial neural crest.

UBERON:3010585.name: basibranchial ii
UBERON:3010585.def: unpaired medial element that articulates with the anterior basibrachial i (if present).

UBERON:3010586.name: vasa efferentia
UBERON:3010586.def: sperm travel through these 4 or 5 fine ducts which pass through the mesorchium from the testis to the sexual kidney.

UBERON:3010587.name: hyoid arch neural crest
UBERON:3010587.def: population of cranial neural crest that give rise to hyoid arch elements.

UBERON:3010589.name: cloacal papilla
UBERON:3010589.def: a small, ridge-like projection from the antero-ventral wall of the cloacal chamber.

UBERON:3010590.name: amphibian cloacal gland
UBERON:3010590.def: a structure that surrounds the cloacal opening, consisting of a mass of coarse tubules.

UBERON:3010602.name: granular gland
UBERON:3010602.def: a gland that contains toxic secretions within the lumen. in frogs and salamanders, this is the larger of the two types of gland, the other being the mucuous gland[kardong].

UBERON:3010613.name: laryngo-tracheal chamber
UBERON:3010613.def: muscular vestibule between the pharynx and lungs, lying between the posterior cornua of the hyoid.

UBERON:3010614.name: cartilago lateralis of aryngo-tracheal chamber
UBERON:3010614.def: a series of semicircular cartilages on the side of the laryngo-tracheal chamber.

UBERON:3010618.name: constrictor laryngis externus
UBERON:3010618.def: involved in the movement of the arytenoid cartilages; see also dilatator laryngis and constrictor laryngis anterior.

UBERON:3010620.name: dilatator laryngis
UBERON:3010620.def: involved in the movement of the arytenoid cartilages; see also constrictor laryngis externus and constrictor laryngis anterior.

UBERON:3010621.name: constrictor laryngis anterior
UBERON:3010621.def: involved in the movement of the arytenoid cartilages; see also constrictor laryngis externus and dilatator laryngis.

UBERON:3010624.name: subarticular sesamoid
UBERON:3010624.def: is an endochondral structure located on the ventral to the junction between, in the hand, the metacarpal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges, and in the foot between the metatarsal and most proximal phalanx of the digit and between phalanges. typically subarticular sesamoids are found with the subarticular tubercles.

UBERON:3010625.name: obsolete embryonic hypochord
UBERON:3010625.def: a transient rod-like structure ventral to the notochord in salamander embryos. derived from endoderm.

UBERON:3010627.name: obsolete leydig cells
UBERON:3010627.def: a type of mucus and/or fluid secreting cell in larvae.

UBERON:3010628.name: obsolete dorsal ramus of occulomotor nerve
UBERON:3010628.def: innervates m. rectus superior (m. dorsal rectus).

UBERON:3010631.name: obsolete stiftchenzellen
UBERON:3010631.def: possibly chemoreceptor cells in anuran larvae.

UBERON:3010632.name: obsolete ventral ramus of occulomotor nerve
UBERON:3010632.def: innervates m. rectus medialis, m. rectus inferior, m. obliquus inferior.

UBERON:3010633.name: obsolete flask cell
UBERON:3010633.def: type of cell that appears in epidermis during metamorphosis and is rich in mitochondria.

UBERON:3010635.name: obsolete goblet cell
UBERON:3010635.def: a mucous surface cell type known in tadpoles of xenopus.

UBERON:3010636.name: egg capsule
UBERON:3010636.def: protective membranes that surround amphibian embryos.

UBERON:3010637.name: obsolete mucous surface cell
UBERON:3010637.def: type of mucous-producing cell that appears in early larval stages and persists after metamorphosis.

UBERON:3010638.name: obsolete ciliary cell
UBERON:3010638.def: a type of cell that develops in embryos and functions in embryonic movements.

UBERON:3010651.name: levator bulbi
UBERON:3010651.def: one of the principal muscles used in swallowing.

UBERON:3010652.name: ramus nasalis lateralis
UBERON:3010652.def: ramule of ophthalmic nerve (see also ramus nasalis medialis). the first branch of ophthalmic nerve gives rise to two ramules that border the naris and innervate the surrounding tissue.

UBERON:3010653.name: ramus nasalis medialis
UBERON:3010653.def: ramule of ophthalmic nerve (see also ramus nasalis lateralis). first branch gives rise to two ramules that border the naris and innervate the surrounding tissue.

UBERON:3010654.name: rectus cervicis
UBERON:3010654.def: retracts the hyoid and, therefore, the tongue.

UBERON:3010657.name: subhyoideus
UBERON:3010657.def: hyobranchial muscle that is a deep, visceral muscle associated with tongue movement.

UBERON:3010659.name: subarcualis rectus i
UBERON:3010659.def: deep, visceral muscle associated with tongue movement.

UBERON:3010661.name: ramus nasalis internus
UBERON:3010661.def: distal part of the opthalmicus profundus gives rise to 2 ramules: palatinus and cutaneous.

UBERON:3010664.name: m. intertransversarius capitus superior
UBERON:3010664.def: muscle of the neck involved in the movement of the head, see also m. intertransversarius capitis inferior.

UBERON:3010665.name: ramule palatinus
UBERON:3010665.def: ramules that descends towards the buccal roof and give rise to several short branches that anastomose with palatine ramus of the facial nerve.

UBERON:3010667.name: m. intertransversarius capitis inferior
UBERON:3010667.def: muscle of the neck involved in the movement of the head, see also m. intertransversarius capitis superior.

UBERON:3010668.name: ramules cutaneous
UBERON:3010668.def: many branches of the maxillary ramus that terminate in the integument of the maxillary region.

UBERON:3010669.name: trunk maxillary-mandibularis
UBERON:3010669.def: portion of the trigeminal nerve where the maxillary and mandibular rami run together prior to bifurcating.

UBERON:3010671.name: ramule palatonasalis
UBERON:3010671.def: descends and branches to the buccal roof where it anastomoses with the palatine ramus of the facial nerve.

UBERON:3010673.name: m. rhomboideus anterior
UBERON:3010673.def: muscle which originates on the posterior surface of the frontoparietal and the anterior part of the dorsal fascia. inserts on the ventral surface of the anteromedial corner of the suprascapula.

UBERON:3010675.name: bony nodule of terminal phalanx of hind digit
UBERON:3010675.def: endochondral element distal to terminal phalanx of hind digit.

UBERON:3010690.name: fetal tooth
UBERON:3010690.def: type of deciduous dentition found in foetuses and altricial juveniles of some caecilians.

UBERON:3010691.name: m. opercularis
UBERON:3010691.def: muscle which arises from the dorsal m. levator scapulae and extends between the operculum and suprascapula.

UBERON:3010692.name: m. cucullaris
UBERON:3010692.def: muscle which originates on the prootic and the otic ramus of the squamosal and inserts on the anterior border of the suprascapula.

UBERON:3010693.name: ramus posterior profundus of v3
UBERON:3010693.def: in the adult anuran, this innervates the muscles levator mandibulare internus and longus.

UBERON:3010694.name: m. rhomboideus posterior
UBERON:3010694.def: muscle which originates from the transverse process of presacral vertebrae iv and insert on the dorso-medial surface of the suprascapula.

UBERON:3010695.name: m. serratus superior
UBERON:3010695.def: muscle which originates from the transverse process of presacral vertebrae iv and inserts on the dorso-medial surface of the suprascapula beneath the insertion m. rhomboideus posterior.

UBERON:3010698.name: m. serratus medius
UBERON:3010698.def: muscle which originates from the transverse process of presacral vertebrae iii and inserts on the central and medial surface of the suprascapula.

UBERON:3010699.name: m. serratus inferior
UBERON:3010699.def: muscle which originates as a posterior and anterior head. the posterior head originates from the transverse process and cartilaginous epiphysis of presacral vertebra iv. the anterior head originates on the same parts of presacral vertebrae iii. both insert on the medial surface of the suprascapula near its postero-ventral edge.

UBERON:3010700.name: levator mandibulae externus
UBERON:3010700.def: jaw muscle responsible for the closing of the jaw, and innervated by the mandibular nerve.

UBERON:3010701.name: m. latissimus dorsi
UBERON:3010701.def: muscle which originates from the ventral surface of the dorsal fascia and inserts on the deltoid crest of the humerus.

UBERON:3010704.name: levator mandibulae longus
UBERON:3010704.def: jaw muscle responsible for the closing of the jaw, and innvervated by ramus posterior profundus of v3.

UBERON:3010707.name: m. dorsalis scapulae
UBERON:3010707.def: muscle which originates on the lateral surface of the suprascapulae and inserts on the deltoid crest of the humerus.

UBERON:3010708.name: levator mandibulae articularis
UBERON:3010708.def: muscle which is responsible for the closing of the jaw, and is innervated by mandibular nerve.

UBERON:3010709.name: levator mandibulae lateralis
UBERON:3010709.def: responsible for the closing of the jaw, and innvervated by the mandibular nerve.

UBERON:3010710.name: m. interscapularis
UBERON:3010710.def: muscle which originates from the ventro-medial surface of the suprascapula and inserts on the ventral surface of the scapula.

UBERON:3010711.name: levator mandibulae externus superficialis
UBERON:3010711.def: responsible for the closing of the jaw.

UBERON:3010712.name: levator mandibulae externus profundus
UBERON:3010712.def: jaw muscle which is responsible for the closing of the jaw.

UBERON:3010713.name: m. sternoepicoracoideus
UBERON:3010713.def: muscle which originates on the anterior border of the distal part of the sternal horn and inserts antero-medially on the postero-dorsal surface of the epicoracoid cartilage.

UBERON:3010719.name: dilated medial process of metacarpal iv

UBERON:3010720.name: ramus hyomandibularis
UBERON:3010720.def: the posttrematic branch of the facial nerve, both motor and sensory in function.

UBERON:3010722.name: ramus palatinus
UBERON:3010722.def: sensory branch of facial nerve from palatal region.

UBERON:3010724.name: levator quadrati
UBERON:3010724.def: responsible for the closing of the jaw, and innervated by the trigeminal nerve.

UBERON:3010725.name: m. coracoradialis
UBERON:3010725.def: muscle which originates from the omosternum and epicoracoid cartilage and inserts on the proximal radioulna.

UBERON:3010726.name: ramus muscularis of glossopharyngeus nerve
UBERON:3010726.def: branchiomotor branch of the glossopharyngeus nerve innervating the m. subarcuales rectus i.

UBERON:3010728.name: otic opercular element
UBERON:3010728.def: round, flat bone or cartilage that lies in the fenestra ovalis and articulates with the columella.

UBERON:3010729.name: m. coracobrachialis longus
UBERON:3010729.def: muscle which originates as a long belly from the dorsal coracoid near the sternum and inserts on the shaft of the humerus.

UBERON:3010731.name: m. coracobrachialis brevis
UBERON:3010731.def: muscle which originates on the dorsal surface of the coracoid and scapula and inserts on the deltoid crest of the humerus.

UBERON:3010734.name: m. flexor carpi ulnaris
UBERON:3010734.def: muscle which originates from the medial condyle of the humerus and inserts on the carpus.

UBERON:3010735.name: ramus anterior of cn viii
UBERON:3010735.def: formed by fibers from the anterior semicircular canal and sacculus.

UBERON:3010736.name: ramus posterior of cn viii
UBERON:3010736.def: composed of two rami: a short ventral ramus innervating the cochlea (lagena and papille basilar), and a long dorsal ramus innervating the posterior semicircular canal.

UBERON:3010737.name: m. palmaris longus
UBERON:3010737.def: originates from the medial epicondyle of the humerus and inserts on the palmar aponeurosis.

UBERON:3010738.name: m. palmaris profundis
UBERON:3010738.def: originates on the ulnar aspect of the radioulna and inserts on the palmar aponeurosis.

UBERON:3010739.name: m. flexor antibrachii medialis
UBERON:3010739.def: originates on the medial epicondyle of the humerus and inserts on the radial aspect of the radioulna.

UBERON:3010740.name: ramus auricularis of the vagus nerve
UBERON:3010740.def: an afferent branch of the vagus nerve.

UBERON:3010741.name: m. ulnocarpalis
UBERON:3010741.def: originates along distal third of the ulna and inserts on the ulnare.

UBERON:3010743.name: m. flexor antibrachii lateralis superficialis
UBERON:3010743.def: originates as a superior and inferior head. the superior head originates on the outer edge of the humerus and the inferior head originates on the lateral epicondyle of the humerus. both bellies converge to form a tendon, which inserts on the carpus and the extensor tendon of digit i.

UBERON:3010744.name: m. flexor antibrachii lateralis profundus
UBERON:3010744.def: originates on the lateral epicondyle of the humerus and inserts on the lower ridge of the radioulna.

UBERON:3010745.name: m. coccygeosacralis
UBERON:3010745.def: originates on the lateral surface of the urostyle and inserts on the neural arch of the sacrum or on the sacral diapophysis.

UBERON:3010748.name: m. coccygeoiliacus
UBERON:3010748.def: originates on the lateral surface of the urostyle and passes ventral to the sacral diapophysis to insert on the anterior and medial surfaces of the ilial shaft.

UBERON:3010749.name: m. iliolumbaris
UBERON:3010749.def: originates on the anterior and lateral aspect of the ilial shaft and inserts on the transverse processes of presacral vertebrae iv-vii.

UBERON:3010750.name: descending branch of the vagus nerve
UBERON:3010750.def: major branch of the vagus supplying parasympathetic innervation to viscera.

UBERON:3010751.name: ramus muscularis of vagus nerve
UBERON:3010751.def: motor nervous branch of the vagus innervating m. subarcualis rectus i.

UBERON:3010754.name: ramus recurrens
UBERON:3010754.def: branch of the vagus nerve that separates from the vagus well postcranially, then continues anteriorly to innervate the larynx.

UBERON:3010757.name: ramus superficial ophthalmic
UBERON:3010757.def: dorsal branch of adlln that innervates supraorbital line of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010758.name: m. coccygeocutaneus
UBERON:3010758.def: originates from the posterior tip of the urostyle and inserts on the cloacal musculature and the overlying skin.

UBERON:3010759.name: ramus buccal
UBERON:3010759.def: ventral ramus of the adlln that innervates the infraorbital line of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010764.name: laryngeus ventralis
UBERON:3010764.def: a branch of the vagus nerve innervating heart, stomach, and lung muscle.

UBERON:3010765.name: ramus mandibularis externus
UBERON:3010765.def: runs together with motor fibers of the hyomandibular trunk of vii. the mandibularis externus of avlln branches into three ramules .

UBERON:3010772.name: m. dorsalis trunci
UBERON:3010772.def: originates on the postero-dorsal edge of the postzygopophyses and insert on the dorsal surface of the neural arch of the posterior, adjacent vertebra.

UBERON:3010778.name: jugal ramule
UBERON:3010778.def: this ramule innervates the jugal line of neuromasts and is the dorsal branch of the ramus mandibularis externus.

UBERON:3010783.name: m. oblique externus
UBERON:3010783.def: originates on the posterior margin of the suprascapula and the epaxial fascia and inserts ventrally on the lateral fascia of the m. rectus abdominus and the ilial shaft.

UBERON:3010784.name: m. oblique internus
UBERON:3010784.def: a muscular sheet in which the fibers run in right angles to those of the m. oblique externus, slanting downward anteriorly. this is one of three sheets composing the flank musculature.

UBERON:3010790.name: muscle rectus abdominis superficialis
UBERON:3010790.def: a component of the rectus abdominal muscle that is some taxa.

UBERON:3010792.name: musculus rectus abdominis profundus
UBERON:3010792.def: a component of the rectus abdominal muscle that is some taxa (see comment) forms a disctinct and separate muscle.

UBERON:3010793.name: m. ypsiloideus anterior
UBERON:3010793.def: hypaxial muscle in which contraction elevates the ypsiloid cartilage; originates from the anterior edge of the lateral process of the ypsiloid cartilage and insert on the anteriorly adjacent inscription.

UBERON:3010794.name: oral ramule
UBERON:3010794.def: medial branch of the ramus mandibularis externus. this ramule innervates the oral and angular lines of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010795.name: preopercular ramule
UBERON:3010795.def: ventral branch of the ramus mandibularis externus. this ramule have a superior and an inferior division, both innervating the preopercular line of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010796.name: ramus supraotic
UBERON:3010796.def: small ramus of the mlln that innervates neuromasts located at the posterior margin of the otic capsule.

UBERON:3010797.name: m. ypsiloideus posterior
UBERON:3010797.def: contraction depresses the ypsiloid cartilage; arises from the anterodorsal edge of the pubis deep to the m. rectus abdominis profundus and spreads anteriorly in a fan shape to insert on the lateral edges of the shaft and the posterior edges of the lateral processes of the ypsiloid cartilage .

UBERON:3010798.name: ramulus suprabranchialis anterior
UBERON:3010798.def: ramulus that innervates the suprabranchial line of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010799.name: ramulus suprabranchialis posterior
UBERON:3010799.def: ramulus innervating the suprabranchial line of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010801.name: ramus lateral
UBERON:3010801.def: ventral division of the trunk of the plln, this prominent ramus extends over the lateral trunk and caudal musculature innervating the lateral line of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010804.name: ramus ventral
UBERON:3010804.def: this ramus leaves the postotic ganglionic complex together with the third branchial ramus of x. this ramule innervates the ventral line of neuromasts.

UBERON:3010815.name: m. flexor indicis superficialis proprius
UBERON:3010815.def: originates on the internal border of the distal carpal 5-4-3 and inserts on the distal end of phalynx i.

UBERON:3010819.name: gastrointestinal peritoneum
UBERON:3010819.def: peritoneum that surrounds the stomach and intestines.

UBERON:3010821.name: hyoquadrate process
UBERON:3010821.def: a projection on the suboccular arch, ventral to the muscular process, that serves as the articulation point for the lateral process of the ceratohyal of the hyobranchial skeleton.

UBERON:3010831.name: occipito-petrosal
UBERON:3010831.def: fusion of the occipital segment or occipital ring and otic capsule (francis, 1934).

UBERON:3010832.name: occipital segment
UBERON:3010832.def: metameric segment forming the back of the skull.

UBERON:3010836.name: posterolateral supplementary element
UBERON:3010836.def: a muscle slip arising from the ventral surface of the mandible by means of the ligament near the site of mandibular articulation. the fibers pass anteromedially and attach upon the ventral surfaces of the principal element of the m. intermandibularis (tyler, 1971).

UBERON:3010837.name: apical supplementary element
UBERON:3010837.def: a muscle slip arising from the lingual surface of the mandible on each side of the m. submentalis. the fibers pass posteromedially and attach upon the median raphe of the principal element (tyler, 1971).

UBERON:3010838.name: anterolateral supplementary element
UBERON:3010838.def: a muscle slip arising from the lingual surface of the mandible on the anterior portion of the bone. the fibers pass anteriorly, parallel to the mandible, and attach upon the ventral surface of the m. submentalis (tyler, 1971).

UBERON:3010840.name: obsolete portion of cell substance
UBERON:3010840.def: portion of organism substance located within a cell.

UBERON:3011048.name: obsolete genital system
UBERON:3011048.def: obsolete anatomical system that has as its parts the organs concerned with reproduction, especially the external genital organs.

UBERON:4000002.name: obsolete mode of ossification
UBERON:4000002.def: the formation of bone or of a bony substance, or the conversion of fibrous tissue or of cartilage into bone or a bony substance.

UBERON:4000003.name: permanent cartilage
UBERON:4000003.def: chondrogenic element that is composed of cartilage that is not replaced.

UBERON:4000004.name: obsolete opercle bone
UBERON:4000004.def: dermal bone that forms the postero-dorsal part of the opercular series. the opercle articulates with the hyomandibula antero-dorsally and with the subopercle ventrally. the opercle is a paired bone.

UBERON:4000007.name: obsolete basihyal bone
UBERON:4000007.def: endochondral bone that is median and is the anterior-most bone of the ventral hyoid arch.

UBERON:4000009.name: obsolete notochordal cell
UBERON:4000009.def: cell of the notochord, often vacuolated or resembles a chondrocyte.

UBERON:4000012.name: obsolete skeletogenic cell
UBERON:4000012.def: cell that has the potential to form a skeletal cell type (e.g., cells in periosteum, cells in marrow) and produce extracellular matrix (often mineralized) and skeletal tissue (often mineralized).

UBERON:4000014.name: obsolete basihyal cartilage
UBERON:4000014.def: pharyngeal arch cartilage that is median and is the anterior-most cartilage of the ventral hyoid arch.

UBERON:4000019.name: obsolete chordablast
UBERON:4000019.def: epithelial cell that is large, vacuolated, and part of the notochord.

UBERON:4000021.name: obsolete proteinaceous extracellular matrix
UBERON:4000021.def: a layer consisting mainly of proteins (especially collagen) and glycosaminoglycans (mostly as proteoglycans) that forms a sheet underlying or overlying cells such as endothelial and epithelial cells. the proteins are secreted by cells in the vicinity. an example of this component is found in mus musculus. [goc:mtg_sensu, isbn:0198547684].

UBERON:4000022.name: obsolete extracellular matrix
UBERON:4000022.def: combination of protein fibers, ground substance and tissue fluid; typically has embedded cells.

UBERON:4000024.name: obsolete intercalar
UBERON:4000024.def: small membrane bone homologous with a cartilage bone in more basal fishes (patterson, 1977). situated between the exoccipital and the pterotic at point of attachment of short ligament that originates on the ventral arm of the posttemporal.

UBERON:4000028.name: integumentary papilla
UBERON:4000028.def: odontogenic papilla that is located in the integument.

UBERON:4000030.name: oropharyngeal papilla
UBERON:4000030.def: odontogenic papilla located along the jaws or pharyngeal skeleton.

UBERON:4000038.name: obsolete preameloblast
UBERON:4000038.def: skeletogenic cell that has the potential to develop into an ameloblast.

UBERON:4000039.name: obsolete chordoblast
UBERON:4000039.def: skeletogenic cell that is derived from the notochordal mesoderm and produces notochordal tissue (and cartilage tissue in some taxa).

UBERON:4000041.name: obsolete preodontoblast
UBERON:4000041.def: skeletogenic cell that has the potential to form an odontoblast, deposits predentine, and arises from a neural crest cell.

UBERON:4000043.name: obsolete precementoblast
UBERON:4000043.def: skeletogenic cell that has the potential to develop into a cementoblast.

UBERON:4000044.name: obsolete prechondroblast
UBERON:4000044.def: skeletogenic cell that has the potential to develop into a chondroblast; and arises from neural crest, meseosdermal and notochordal and connective tissue cells.

UBERON:4000045.name: obsolete preosteoblast
UBERON:4000045.def: skeletogenic cell that has the potential to transform into an osteoblast, and develops from neural crest or mesodermal cells.

UBERON:4000051.name: lepidosteoid scale
UBERON:4000051.def: multi-layer ganoid scale composed of ganoine and cellular bone.

UBERON:4000052.name: ganoid scale
UBERON:4000052.def: thick, rhomboid-shaped integumentary skeletal element composed of multiple tissues including ganoine and bone.

UBERON:4000053.name: vacuolated notochordal tissue
UBERON:4000053.def: connective tissue that is matrix-poor with large number of vacuolated cells.

UBERON:4000055.name: polypteroid scale
UBERON:4000055.def: multi-tissue structure composed of ganoine, dentine, elasmodine and cellular bone.

UBERON:4000059.name: avascular gag-rich matrix
UBERON:4000059.def: proteinaceous extracellular matrix that is avascular and consists primarily of glycosaminoglycans.

UBERON:4000070.name: elasmoid scale
UBERON:4000070.def: multi-tissue integumentary element composed dentine, elasmodine, and hypermineralized tissue.

UBERON:4000074.name: palaeoniscoid scale
UBERON:4000074.def: multi-tissue structure composed of ganoine, dentine and bone; not known in extant taxa.

UBERON:4000078.name: chondroid tissue
UBERON:4000078.def: skeletal tissue that is mineralized, has large chondrocyte-like cells, sparse extracellular matrix, and minimal perichondrium; develops from non-mineralized chondroid tissue.

UBERON:4000080.name: keratin-based scale
UBERON:4000080.def: fold or elevation of the epidermis rich in keratin proteins; possibly calcified but does not contain skeletal elements.

UBERON:4000081.name: cosmoid scale
UBERON:4000081.def: multi-tissue integumentary element composed of enamel or enameloid, dentine and lamellar bone, and characterized by pore-canal system.

UBERON:4000086.name: secondary cartilage tissue
UBERON:4000086.def: cartilage tissue that is part of the exoskeleton, deposited adjacent to bone after bone formation.

UBERON:4000090.name: integumentary skeleton
UBERON:4000090.def: skeletal subdivision that is part of the extra-oral dermal skeletal system that develops and remains invested within the integument, primarily the dermis.

UBERON:4000095.name: obsolete non-terminally differentiated odontoblast
UBERON:4000095.def: odontoblast that non-terminally differentiated, located in the odontogenic papilla and dentine tissue, and transforms from a odontoblast cell.

UBERON:4000096.name: obsolete terminally differentiated odontoblast
UBERON:4000096.def: odontoblast that is terminally differentiated and derived from an odontogenic papilla and associated with dentine.

UBERON:4000097.name: orthodentine
UBERON:4000097.def: odontoid tissue that typically contains tubules and is acellular.

UBERON:4000104.name: ganoine
UBERON:4000104.def: odontogenic tissue that is hypermineralized acellular, noncollagenous, covered by an epidermis and often deposited in multiple layers.

UBERON:4000105.name: limiting layer of elasmoid scale
UBERON:4000105.def: hypermineralized tissue lacking collagen (except sharpey's fibres), developing in close proximity to the basal cells of the overlying epithelium.

UBERON:4000106.name: vasodentine
UBERON:4000106.def: dentine tissue that lacks dentine tubules and that is penetrated by blood capillaries.

UBERON:4000107.name: elasmodine
UBERON:4000107.def: odontogenic tissue that consists of multiple layers of collagen fibers organized in orthogonal or twisted arrangements.

UBERON:4000108.name: non-mineralized hyaline cartilage tissue
UBERON:4000108.def: hyaline cartilage tissue that is not mineralized.

UBERON:4000109.name: mineralized hyaline cartilage tissue
UBERON:4000109.def: hyaline cartilage tissue that is mineralized.

UBERON:4000116.name: obsolete terminally differentiated osteoblast
UBERON:4000116.def: osteoblast that is terminally differentiated, located adjacent to acellular or cellular bone tissue within periosteum, and is capable of mineralizing the matrix.

UBERON:4000117.name: obsolete non-terminally differentiated osteoblast
UBERON:4000117.def: osteoblast that is non-terminally differentiated and located in cellular bone tissue or under the periosteum in acellular bone.

UBERON:4000118.name: cellular bone tissue
UBERON:4000118.def: mineralized bone tissue that always includes non-terminally differentiated osteoblasts and osteocytes.

UBERON:4000119.name: non-mineralized avascular gag-rich matrix
UBERON:4000119.def: avascular gag-rich matrix that is not mineralized.

UBERON:4000120.name: mineralized avascular gag-rich matrix
UBERON:4000120.def: avascular gag-rich matrix that is mineralized.

UBERON:4000122.name: acellular bone tissue
UBERON:4000122.def: mineralized bone tissue that has terminally differentiated osteoblasts but lacks osteocytes.

UBERON:4000123.name: odontode tissue
UBERON:4000123.def: skeletal tissue that is avascular tubular mineralized matrix, primarily made of dentine that is deposited by odontoblasts that are excluded from the matrix; develops from pre-dentine tissue.

UBERON:4000134.name: ossified tendon
UBERON:4000134.def: sesamoid that develops within a tendon, distal to an articulation or joint.

UBERON:4000136.name: obsolete direct ossification
UBERON:4000136.def: ossification that does not require the replacement of pre-existing tissues, most often a cartilaginous model.

UBERON:4000138.name: ligamentous replacement element
UBERON:4000138.def: replacement element that forms as a replacement of a ligament.

UBERON:4000140.name: obsolete replacement ossification
UBERON:4000140.def: ossification that requires the replacement of a pre-existing tissue prior to bone tissue formation.

UBERON:4000141.name: obsolete intramembranous ossification
UBERON:4000141.def: direct ossification that occurs within mesenchyme with the formation of an osteogenic condensation not associated with a perichondrium.

UBERON:4000142.name: obsolete metaplastic ossification
UBERON:4000142.def: direct ossification in which transformation of the pre-existing tissue occurs without dedifferentiation of cells or reinitiation of cell division; direct transformation of a non-bone tissue into a bone tissue.

UBERON:4000143.name: obsolete endochondral ossification
UBERON:4000143.def: replacement ossification wherein bone tissue replaces cartilage.

UBERON:4000144.name: obsolete perichondral ossification
UBERON:4000144.def: intramembranous ossification on the surface of a cartilage element as the perichondrium becomes a periosteum, without replacement of cartilage.

UBERON:4000146.name: transient cartilaginous element
UBERON:4000146.def: chondrogenic element that is composed of cartilage during development and has the potential to become replaced by another tissue.

UBERON:4000159.name: ossified ligament
UBERON:4000159.def: sesamoid that develops within a ligament, distal to an articulation or joint.

UBERON:4000160.name: anocleithrum
UBERON:4000160.def: dermal bone of pectoral girdle that is dorsal to and articulates with the cleithrum.

UBERON:4000162.name: median fin
UBERON:4000162.def: fin that is an unpaired fin located in the sagittal plane of the organism.

UBERON:4000163.name: anal fin
UBERON:4000163.def: median fin that is located posterior to the anus.

UBERON:4000164.name: caudal fin
UBERON:4000164.def: the caudal fin is the most posterior median fin. it is composed of a complex of modified centra and modified neural and hemal arches and spines.

UBERON:4000166.name: anal fin skeleton
UBERON:4000166.def: median fin skeleton that is located posterior to the anus.

UBERON:4000167.name: caudal fin skeleton
UBERON:4000167.def: median fin skeleton supporting the caudal fin.

UBERON:4000168.name: dorsal fin skeleton
UBERON:4000168.def: median fin skeleton located on the dorsal surface of the organism.

UBERON:4000170.name: median fin skeleton
UBERON:4000170.def: postcranial axial skeleton that is unpaired and located on the sagittal plane of the organism.

UBERON:4000171.name: scapular complex
UBERON:4000171.def: skeletal subdivision of dermal bones that may include the anterolateral plate (al), the spinal process (sp), and anteroventral plate (av) and other dermal bones that are part of the pectoral girdle.

UBERON:4000172.name: lepidotrichium
UBERON:4000172.def: dermal bone that is rod-like, formed and usually contained in a fin membrane, and jointed to or adjacent to distal radials. lepidotrichia are formed from paired hemitrichia surrounding actinotrichia. there are usually two more lepidotrichia than distal radials.

UBERON:4000173.name: pelvic fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:4000173.def: lepidotrichium that is part of the pelvic fin skeleton.

UBERON:4000174.name: caudal fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:4000174.def: lepidotrichium that is part of the caudal fin skeleton.

UBERON:4000175.name: pectoral fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:4000175.def: lepidotrichium that is part of the pectoral fin skeleton.

UBERON:4000176.name: anal fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:4000176.def: lepidotrichium that is part of the anal fin skeleton.

UBERON:4000177.name: dorsal fin lepidotrichium
UBERON:4000177.def: lepidotrichium that is part of the dorsal fin skeleton.

UBERON:4000182.name: suprabranchial fin
UBERON:4000182.def: paired fin that is a bilaterally paired anterior outgrowth located high on the side of the animal, not far behind the orbit, with the posterior extremity corresponding with the expected posterior end of the branchial region.

UBERON:4100000.name: skeletal element projection
UBERON:4100000.def: anatomical projection that is composed of bone or cartilage tissue.

UBERON:4100001.name: obsolete astragalus-calcaneum unit
UBERON:4100001.def: anatomical cluster that is an osteological unit consisting of the astragalus and calcaneum.

UBERON:4100002.name: obsolete ectepicondylar flange
UBERON:4100002.def: flange on the dorsal part of the humerus, associated with extensor musculature of the forelimb (manus. carpus).

UBERON:4100003.name: articular surface
UBERON:4100003.def: anatomical surface that is part of a skeletal element and articulates with another skeletal element.

UBERON:4100004.name: ischial peduncle
UBERON:4100004.def: bony projection (peduncle) that is located on the posterior portion of the ilium, posterior to the acetabulum.

UBERON:4100005.name: second phalanx
UBERON:4100005.def: second most proximal phalanx in manual or pedal digits.

UBERON:4100006.name: parasternal process
UBERON:4100006.def: posterior projection of the interclavicle that extends betwen and sometimes beyond the clavicles.

UBERON:4100007.name: pectoral articular facet
UBERON:4100007.def: facet of scapulocoracoid with which the pectoral fin radial(s) articulates. facet of scapulocoracoid with which the pectoral fin radial(s) articulates. based on goujet and young (1995).

UBERON:4100010.name: post-glenoid process
UBERON:4100010.def: distinct notch ventral to the glenoid.

UBERON:4100011.name: postacetabular buttress
UBERON:4100011.def: a bony process at the distal margin of the acetabulum formed by the ischium and/or the ischial peduncle of the ilium.

UBERON:4100012.name: postacetabular zone
UBERON:4100012.def: region of the ilium posterior and dorsal to the acetabulum.

UBERON:4100013.name: postcoracoid
UBERON:4100013.def: the posterior of the two coracoid elements found in basal tetrapods. corresponds directly to the 'coracoid' of synapsids.

UBERON:4100014.name: posterior dorsal fin
UBERON:4100014.def: dorsal fin located posterior to the anterior dorsal fin.

UBERON:4100015.name: obsolete posterior iliac process
UBERON:4100015.def: posterior most of the two 'double heads' of the blade of the ilium in some take. distinct and separate for the dorsal iliac process.

UBERON:4100016.name: posterior process of ilium
UBERON:4100016.def: a posteriorly directed bony projection from the ilium that is the attachment site of the iliofibularis muscle (see sumida, 1997).

UBERON:4100111.name: hemipenal sheath
UBERON:4100111.def: soft tissue sheath covering the hemipenis.

UBERON:4100112.name: radial facet
UBERON:4100112.def: facet to accommodate the radius on the distal end of the humerus.

UBERON:4100113.name: dermal intracranial joint
UBERON:4100113.def: hinge in the skull skeleton to allow for kinetic movement of different parts.

UBERON:4100114.name: anterior distal condyle of femur
UBERON:4100114.def: anatomical projection in the distal region of the femur.

UBERON:4100115.name: spiracular notch
UBERON:4100115.def: soft tissue notch/opening lying on a spiracle.

UBERON:4100116.name: posterior distal condyle of femur
UBERON:4100116.def: anatomical projection in the posterior/distal region of the femur.

UBERON:4100117.name: presacral rib
UBERON:4100117.def: rib located anterior to the sacral region.

UBERON:4100118.name: trunk rib
UBERON:4100118.def: rib located in the trunk (ribcage) area (i.e. excluding cervical and caudal axial series.

UBERON:4100119.name: extratemporal bone
UBERON:4100119.def: extratemporal bone: skull bone in the posterior half of the cranium, bordering the squamosal and opercular.

UBERON:4100120.name: obsolete prezygapophyses
UBERON:4100120.def: anteriorly projecting processes allowing de facto contact between consecutive vertebrae (some soft tissues are also present) via articular facets.

UBERON:4100121.name: thagomizer
UBERON:4100121.def: the distinctive arrangement of four to ten spikes on the tails of stegosaurid dinosaurs. these spikes are believed to have been a defensive measure against predators.

UBERON:4200000.name: medial blade of ilium
UBERON:4200000.def: the medial surface of the iliac blade. origin site of the iliofemoralis internus muscle and its homologues.

UBERON:4200001.name: postpubis
UBERON:4200001.def: the region of the pubis posterior to the acetabulum.

UBERON:4200002.name: coracoid plate
UBERON:4200002.def: broad, convex expansion of the coracoid bone below the level of the glenoid. based on romer 1956.

UBERON:4200003.name: archipterygial fin
UBERON:4200003.def: a type of pectoral fin in which the endoskeletal elements have a main axis that runs through the center of the fin. this creates a bilaterally symmetrical fin. (modified from kardong 2012).

UBERON:4200004.name: intertrochanteric fossa
UBERON:4200004.def: depression on the ventreal side of the femoral head. associated with the pubioischiofemoralis externus muscle.

UBERON:4200005.name: obsolete postbranchial lamina
UBERON:4200005.def: medial facing projection or surface on the anterior ( cranial) region of the cleithrum that is often textured or denticled. this process has two primary functions: 1) its shape enhances the vertical strength of the cleithrum and 2) it forms the edge of the gill chamber and helps to direct water after it has passed over the gills (modified from clack 2012).

UBERON:4200006.name: infraglenoid buttress
UBERON:4200006.def: an anatomical projection ventral to the glenoid fossa on the scapulocoracoid that abuts on the cliethrum (if present).

UBERON:4200007.name: transverse pelvic ridge
UBERON:4200007.def: the transverse pelvic ridge is a short crest directly anterior to, and not extending posterior to, the prominent supra-acetabular buttress  from pawley and warren 2006.

UBERON:4200008.name: inter-clavicle joint
UBERON:4200008.def: joint that articulates left and right clavicles.

UBERON:4200009.name: hypochordal lepidotrichium
UBERON:4200009.def: caudal fin lepidotrichium located ventral to the notochord.

UBERON:4200010.name: ventral humeral ridge
UBERON:4200010.def: a distinct bony ridge on ventralsurface of the humeral shaft that corresponds to the attachment site of the pectoralis muscle.

UBERON:4200011.name: pedal centrale
UBERON:4200011.def: a centrale found in the pes.

UBERON:4200012.name: ectepicondylar flange
UBERON:4200012.def: flange present of the distal region of the humerus, associated with extensor musculature of forelimb.

UBERON:4200013.name: flexor surface
UBERON:4200013.def: surface of a long bone that possess the flexor muscle attachment sites.

UBERON:4200014.name: lateral tuber of ulna
UBERON:4200014.def: projection on the lateral side of proximal part of the ulna.

UBERON:4200015.name: inner digits of foot
UBERON:4200015.def: the medial most digits of the pes.

UBERON:4200016.name: postbranchial lamina
UBERON:4200016.def: medial facing projection or surface on the anterior ( cranial) region of the cleithrum that is often textured or denticled. this process has two primary functions: 1) its shape enhances the vertical strength of the cleithrum and 2) it forms the edge of the gill chamber and helps to direct water after it has passed over the gills (modified from clack 2012).

UBERON:4200017.name: obsolete infraglenoid buttress
UBERON:4200017.def: an anatomical projection venteral to the glenoid fossa on the scapulocoracoid that abuts on the cliethrum.

UBERON:4200018.name: calcaneal tuber
UBERON:4200018.def: an enlargement of the distal region of the calcaneum that corresponds to the attachment site for the foot extensor muscles.

UBERON:4200019.name: preacetabular process
UBERON:4200019.def: process on ilium located anteriorly to acetabulum.

UBERON:4200020.name: suprascapular fossa
UBERON:4200020.def: fossa on the medial surface on the scapula above the glenoid.

UBERON:4200021.name: astragalus-calcaneum unit
UBERON:4200021.def: osteological unit consisting of the astragalus and calcaneum.

UBERON:4200022.name: extracleithrum
UBERON:4200022.def: narrow bone that lies ventral to the level of insertion of the pectoral fin and is sutured to the posterior edges of both the clavicle and cleithrum. based on forey 1998.

UBERON:4200023.name: anterior dorsal fin
UBERON:4200023.def: a dorsal fin located anterior to posterior dorsal fin.

UBERON:4200024.name: obsolete suprascapular fossa
UBERON:4200024.def: fossa located on the medial surface of the scapula above the glenoid.

UBERON:4200025.name: ascending process of the astragalus
UBERON:4200025.def: flattened process of the dorsl surface of the astragalus which contacts the tibia anteriorly.

UBERON:4200027.name: supraglenoid buttress
UBERON:4200027.def: a bony projection dorsal to the glenoid articulation on the scapulocoracoid.

UBERON:4200028.name: adductor blade
UBERON:4200028.def: a prominent ridge in basal tetrapods on the ventral side of the femur that includes the fourth trochater, internal trochanter and the adductor crest (based on coates, 1996).

UBERON:4200029.name: adductor crest
UBERON:4200029.def: a bony crest on venteral side of femur that is the attachment site for the adductor muscles.

UBERON:4200030.name: antitrochanter
UBERON:4200030.def: raised surface at the posterior portion of the acetabulum (see nesbitt, 2011).

UBERON:4200031.name: caudalipuboischiotibialis
UBERON:4200031.def: muscle that is associated with tail flexion. orginates on one of the first post sacral vertebrae posteriorly and inserts on the posterior edge of the m.puboischiotibialis. (modified from duellman and trueb 1994).

UBERON:4200032.name: clavicle blade
UBERON:4200032.def: expanded and flattened ventral region of clavicle bone.

UBERON:4200033.name: cleithrum head
UBERON:4200033.def: expanded dorsal region of the cleithrum.

UBERON:4200034.name: cnemial crest
UBERON:4200034.def: longitudnal bony ridge on tibia, attachment site of the major extensor muscle of the hind limb.

UBERON:4200036.name: internal trochanter
UBERON:4200036.def: a boney projection on the internal diaphysis of the femur anterior or medial to the intertrochanteric fossa, below the femoral head. muscle attachment site for ventral muscle mass notably the puboischiofemoralis externus. modified from romer 1956.

UBERON:4200037.name: supinator process
UBERON:4200037.def: a bony process that corresponds to the attachment site for the forelimb supinator muscles in tetrapods, distal to the deltopectoral crest and anterior to the radial condyle.

UBERON:4200038.name: subscapular fossa
UBERON:4200038.def: a marked depression on the medial side of the scapula blade, often opposite the glenoid region.

UBERON:4200039.name: supraacetabular buttress
UBERON:4200039.def: a bony protuberance dorsal to the acetabulum on the ilium, confluent with the supraacetabular crest (when present). acts as a bone brace to prevent excessive femoral abduction and the origin site for part of the m. iliofemoralis.

UBERON:4200040.name: acrocoracoid process
UBERON:4200040.def: anatomical process located in the proximal region of the coracoid in avian theropods, that is hook-shaped.

UBERON:4200041.name: aponeurosis palmaris
UBERON:4200041.def: the palmar aponeurosis is a fibrotendinous complex that functions as the tendinous extension of the palmaris longus, when present, and as a strong stabilizing structure for the palmar skin of the hand. it has five longitudinal slips that project into the base of each digit and a deeper transverse portion that crosses the palm at the proximal end of the metacarpals bones (from wikipedia).

UBERON:4200042.name: brevis shelf
UBERON:4200042.def: anatomical projection on the ilium, anchoring caudal muscles.

UBERON:4200043.name: brevis fossa
UBERON:4200043.def: fossa located on the brevis shelf.

UBERON:4200044.name: articular surface for the calcaneum on the astragalus
UBERON:4200044.def: contact surface between the calcaneum and the astragalus located on the astragalus.

UBERON:4200045.name: articular surface for the astragalus on the calcaneum
UBERON:4200045.def: contact surface between the calcaneum and the astragalus located on the calcaneum.

UBERON:4200046.name: astragalo-calcaneal canal
UBERON:4200046.def: the astragalo-calcaneal canal forms a foramen between the articulated astragalus and calcaneum when the canal is ossified (nesbitt, 2011).

UBERON:4200047.name: attachment site
UBERON:4200047.def: morphological structure denoting the extent of an attachment site for a soft tissue on a skeletal element.

UBERON:4200048.name: bicipital crest
UBERON:4200048.def: anatomical projection that is an expansion on the proximal region of the humerus.

UBERON:4200049.name: cartilago sesamoides
UBERON:4200049.def: a sesamoid found in the found in the ligamentum calcanei of a wide variety of frogs. (based on nussbaum, r. a. 1982.

UBERON:4200050.name: cotyla
UBERON:4200050.def: a cup shaped articular surface on a bone.

UBERON:4200051.name: cotyloid notch
UBERON:4200051.def: a notch or opening in the ventral part of the acetabular rim.

UBERON:4200052.name: crista tibiofibularis
UBERON:4200052.def: tuberosity on the posterior surface of the lateral femoral condyle.

UBERON:4200053.name: diphycercal tail
UBERON:4200053.def: an internally and externally symmetrical tail (caudal) fin.

UBERON:4200054.name: heterocercal tail
UBERON:4200054.def: type of tail (caudal) fin in which the vertebral column turns upwards into the upper lobe which is longer than the lower. asymmetrical externally as well as internally.

UBERON:4200055.name: homocercal tail
UBERON:4200055.def: type of tail fin in which the vertebrae generally turn upward at the hind end of the column, but which is externally symmetrical. the fin rays of the caudal are supported by hypaxial elements.

UBERON:4200056.name: hypocercal tail
UBERON:4200056.def: type of tail fin where the lower lobe is the longer and is supported by the vertebral column. asymmetrical externally as well as internally.

UBERON:4200060.name: ectepicondylar foramen
UBERON:4200060.def: formen present on the ectepicondyle of the humerus.

UBERON:4200061.name: epicercal tail
UBERON:4200061.def: tail fin in which the the caudal part of the notochord tapers posterodorsally. based on pradel et al. 2007.

UBERON:4200062.name: epichordal lepidotrichium
UBERON:4200062.def: caudal fin lepidotrichium located upon or above the notochord.

UBERON:4200063.name: ectocondylar tubercle
UBERON:4200063.def: posteriorly projecting bony tubercle that is located proximal to the lateral condyle of the femur.

UBERON:4200068.name: prepubic element
UBERON:4200068.def: a small plate of cartilage synchondrotically united with the pubis. modified from baez and harrison 2005.

UBERON:4200069.name: sternal keel
UBERON:4200069.def: the vertical plate of bone or cartilage attached to the median line of the sternum. modified from baumel et al. 1993.

UBERON:4200070.name: median fin spine
UBERON:4200070.def: fin spine that is part of a median fin.

UBERON:4200075.name: fin spine
UBERON:4200075.def: a spine that is part of some fin.

UBERON:4200076.name: trunk armor pectoral fenestra
UBERON:4200076.def: an opening in the dermal armour of basal gnathostomes that encloses the pectoral fins. (modified from young 2010).

UBERON:4200077.name: obsolete posterior iliac process
UBERON:4200077.def: distinct posterior most of the two 'double heads' of the blade of the ilium.

UBERON:4200078.name: clavicular facet
UBERON:4200078.def: a notch for the articulation of the clavicle on other girdle elements.

UBERON:4200080.name: fibular crest
UBERON:4200080.def: a bony projection on the lateral side of the tibia, allowing contact between the later and the fibula.

UBERON:4200081.name: hypocleideum
UBERON:4200081.def: zone of bone organ located on the flat ventral side of the distal region of the furcula, serving as attachment region for pectoral muscles.

UBERON:4200083.name: postaxial centrale
UBERON:4200083.def: centrale in the postaxial region of the mesopodium.

UBERON:4200084.name: preaxial centrale
UBERON:4200084.def: centrale in the preaxial side of the mesopodium.

UBERON:4200085.name: obsolete glenoid head of scapula
UBERON:4200085.def: the scapula's contribution to the glenoid fossa.

UBERON:4200086.name: iliac neck
UBERON:4200086.def: a constricted region of the ilium which is dorsal to the acetabulular region. prior to the expansion of the iliac blade.

UBERON:4200087.name: iliac peduncle
UBERON:4200087.def: bony projection that is part of the dorsal surface of the ischim, where it articulates with the ilium.

UBERON:4200088.name: iliac peduncle of the pubis
UBERON:4200088.def: bony projection that is part of the dorsal surface of the pubis where it meets the ilium.

UBERON:4200089.name: fibular facet of the calcaneum
UBERON:4200089.def: articular surface on calcaneum for the fibula.

UBERON:4200090.name: fibular facet of the astragalus
UBERON:4200090.def: articular surface on the astragalus for the fibula.

UBERON:4200091.name: ethomosphenoid region
UBERON:4200091.def: region consisitng of the ethmoid and sphenoid bones.

UBERON:4200092.name: flexor tubercle of ungual
UBERON:4200092.def: eminence on the proximo-dorsal surface of the ungual, for attachment of flexor muscles.

UBERON:4200094.name: inner digits of hand
UBERON:4200094.def: the medial most digit of the manus skeleton.

UBERON:4200095.name: infraspinous process
UBERON:4200095.def: process on infraspinous (region below the spine) of scapula.

UBERON:4200096.name: intercondylar fossa
UBERON:4200096.def: the deep fossa between the femoral condyles in which the cruciate ligaments are attached. from medilexicon.com.

UBERON:4200097.name: intermediate spine
UBERON:4200097.def: spine ventrally located on the body and not part of the pectoral, pelvic or anal fins.

UBERON:4200098.name: ischial foot
UBERON:4200098.def: expansion of the distal region of the ischium.

UBERON:4200099.name: lateral extrascapular
UBERON:4200099.def: the most lateral of the paired series of extrascapular bones and is the bone where the intersection of the otic, postotic and extrascapular or supratemporal canals occur.

UBERON:4200100.name: latissimus dorsi process
UBERON:4200100.def: a bony process on the dorsal side of the proximal region of the humerus which corresponds to the insertion site of the latissimus dorsi muscle.

UBERON:4200101.name: m.scapulotriceps
UBERON:4200101.def: muscle that represents one branch of the larger triceps brachii, origination site near the glenoid fossa on the scapula.

UBERON:4200102.name: median dorsal plate
UBERON:4200102.def: dermal armour plate that is situated behind the head and constitute the dorsal most portion of the dermal shoulder girdle. modified from brazeau 2009, young 2010.

UBERON:4200103.name: median extrascapular
UBERON:4200103.def: the medial of the the paired series of extrascapular bones which carries the extrascapular or supratemporal canal.

UBERON:4200104.name: metacarpal extensor pit
UBERON:4200104.def: pits located on the proximodorsal part of metacarpals denoting the attachemnt sites for ligaments.

UBERON:4200105.name: nerve foramen
UBERON:4200105.def: opening and/or passageway for nerve(s) in bone.

UBERON:4200106.name: muscle scar
UBERON:4200106.def: a distinct region on a skeletal element that demarcates the attachment area of a muscle or tendon. often associated with rugosity or tubercles.

UBERON:4200107.name: obturator process of ischium
UBERON:4200107.def: process located on the ventral shaft of the ischium that denotes the attachment site of the pubio-ischio-femoralis externus.

UBERON:4200108.name: outer digit of hand
UBERON:4200108.def: the flanking digit of the manus.

UBERON:4200109.name: outer digits of pes
UBERON:4200109.def: the flanking digit of the pes.

UBERON:4200110.name: prepectoral spine
UBERON:4200110.def: spine located anterior to the pectoral fin.

UBERON:4200111.name: prepelvic fin spine
UBERON:4200111.def: spine located anterior to the pelvic fin and posterior to the pectoral fin.

UBERON:4200112.name: prepectoral space
UBERON:4200112.def: a triangular, anteroventrally facing area developed between the preaxial margin of the humerus and the proximal limb of the ventral humeral ridge. based on callier et al. 2009 .

UBERON:4200114.name: prepubic process
UBERON:4200114.def: elongate process forming the anteriormost part of the pubis.

UBERON:4200115.name: presupracleithrum
UBERON:4200115.def: an skeletal element of the upper pectoral girdle overlapped by the opercular and posttemporal bones.

UBERON:4200116.name: pteroid
UBERON:4200116.def: slender bone connected to the carpus in pterosaurs. the bone, which may have pointed forward, supports the propatagium, a membrane located between the carpus and pectoral region.

UBERON:4200117.name: pubic boot
UBERON:4200117.def: anteroposterior expansion of the distal region of the pubis.

UBERON:4200118.name: pubic peduncle
UBERON:4200118.def: bony projection on the anterior portion of the ilium, anterior to the acetabulum that articulates with the pubis.

UBERON:4200119.name: pubis-ischium contact
UBERON:4200119.def: contact zone between the pubis and the ischium.

UBERON:4200120.name: puboischiadic plate
UBERON:4200120.def: a broad expnase of bone incorperating both the pubis and the ischium. origin site for ventral limb muscle including the pubioishciofemoralis externus. modified from romer 1956 .

UBERON:4200121.name: puboischiotibialis muscle
UBERON:4200121.def: a muscle that originates from the puboischaidic plate and inserts on the tibia. acts to adduct the hindlimb. is anterior to cloacal gland in males. modified from de luliis and pulera.

UBERON:4200122.name: pubotibialis
UBERON:4200122.def: originates in on the pubic cartillage and inserts on the tibia, acts to adduct the hindlimb. modified from de luliis and pulera.

UBERON:4200123.name: scapular process
UBERON:4200123.def: the dorsal extension of the scapulocoracoid above the level of the glenoid region in basal gnathostomes. modified from brazeau 2009.

UBERON:4200124.name: sternal trabecula
UBERON:4200124.def: anatomical projections that are  elongate processes in the mid and posterior regions of the sternum.

UBERON:4200125.name: supraacetabular crest
UBERON:4200125.def: anatomical projection (crest) located dorsaly to the acetabulum.

UBERON:4200126.name: supraacetabular rim
UBERON:4200126.def: bony rim that is part of the supraacetabular region.

UBERON:4200127.name: suprascapula foramen
UBERON:4200127.def: the route through which structures pass between the base of the neck and the posterior scapular region. it is formed by the suprascapular notch of the scapula and the superior transverse scapular ligament. from http://medical-dictionary.thefreedictionary.com/suprascapular+foramen.

UBERON:4200128.name: synarcual region of vertebral column
UBERON:4200128.def: series of fused cervical vertebrae or vertebral elements. based on jeffrey c. carrier. biology of sharks and their relatives, 2012. crc press.

UBERON:4200129.name: synarcual region
UBERON:4200129.def: axial subdivision that includes a series of fused cervical vertebrae or vertebral elements. based on jeffrey c. carrier. biology of sharks and their relatives, 2012. crc press.

UBERON:4200130.name: tibial facet of astragalus
UBERON:4200130.def: facet for the articulation of the tibia on the astragalus (talus).

UBERON:4200131.name: trochanteric shelf
UBERON:4200131.def: anatomical projection on the anterolateral region of the proximal end of the femur.

UBERON:4200132.name: obsolete tuber
UBERON:4200132.def: obsolete eminence or swelling on anatomical surface.

UBERON:4200133.name: crest
UBERON:4200133.def: a ridge or similar projection rising above the surface of an anatomical structure.

UBERON:4200134.name: antimere
UBERON:4200134.def: a part in the body of an organism that corresponds to an opposite symmetrical part.

UBERON:4200135.name: puboischiadic bar
UBERON:4200135.def: a transverse flattened or cylindrical plate in the posterior body wall opposite the anterior ends of the pelvic fins, in front of the vent and at the posterior end of the body cavity, that supports a few anterior pelvic radials and a basal cartilage, the basipterygium.  from  leonard j. v. compagno. 2001. sharks of the world: an annotated and illustrated catalogue of shark species known to date. volume 2.

UBERON:4200136.name: triphycercal tail
UBERON:4200136.def: a caudal fin with three lobes.

UBERON:4200139.name: palatoquadrate element
UBERON:4200139.def: endochondral element that is part of the suspensorium sometimes ossifying distally as the quadrate bone and linking the basal section of the braincase to the lower jaw.

UBERON:4200140.name: prepollical element
UBERON:4200140.def: is a endochondral element that is part of the mesopodial skeleton and is contained within the prepollex which in some taxa appears as a pre-axial digit-like projection anterior to the first digit of the hand.

UBERON:4200141.name: prehallical element
UBERON:4200141.def: is a endochondral element that is part of the mesopodial skeleton and is contained within the prehallux which in some taxa appears as a pre-axial digit-like projection anterior to the first digit of the foot.

UBERON:4200150.name: accessory foramen
UBERON:4200150.def: foramen found on the humerus of tetrapodomorphs beyond the entepicondyle and ectepicondyle foramen. often denoted as foramen 'c' and 'd' after jarvik 1996.

UBERON:4200152.name: intertarsale sesamoid
UBERON:4200152.def: sesamoid bone in the tarsal region.

UBERON:4200159.name: ventral ridge system
UBERON:4200159.def: a collection of attached ridges on the ventrl surface of the femur consisting of the internal and fourth trochanters plus the adductor blade and crest. most notible in early amniotes (based on romer 1956).

UBERON:4200160.name: mesomere (fin)
UBERON:4200160.def: the median series of bones supporting the pectoral fin of sarcopterygian fish. see dipnomorpha. in the pectoral fin, the first mesomere is the humerus, the second the ulna, and the third probably the intermedium. the radius is the first preaxial radial. all other homologies are suspect. from http://palaeos.com/vertebrates/glossary.

UBERON:4200165.name: basal scute
