UBERON:7500068.synonym: ridge of medial condyle of astragalus

UBERON:7500069.name: ridge of lateral condyle of talus
UBERON:7500069.def: the crest of the lateral condyle of a talus.
UBERON:7500069.synonym: ridge of lateral condyle of astragalus

UBERON:7500070.name: sulcus tali
UBERON:7500070.def: a depression that runs between the two facets of a talus that interact with a calcaneum.
UBERON:7500070.synonym: sulcus for flexor hallucis longus tendon

UBERON:7500071.name: rostrum
UBERON:7500071.def: an anatomical structure that protrudes from the head region. in vertebrates, this includes the part of the cranium (skull) in front of the zygomatic arches that also holds the teeth, palat, and nasal cavity. in invertebrates it is the forward extension of the carapace and/or the piercing mouthparts.

UBERON:7500073.name: left nasal bone
UBERON:7500073.def: nasal bone on the left side of an organism when in anatomical position.

UBERON:7500074.name: right nasal bone
UBERON:7500074.def: nasal bone on the right side of an organism when in anatomical position.

UBERON:7500075.name: left zygomatic arch
UBERON:7500075.def: zygomatic arch on the left side of an organism when in anatomical position.

UBERON:7500076.name: right zygomatic arch
UBERON:7500076.def: zygomatic arch on the right side of an organism when in anatomical position.

UBERON:7500077.name: obsolete trochlea of femur
UBERON:7500077.def: a trochlea on the distal end of a femur that interacts with the patella.

UBERON:7500078.name: styloid process of radius
UBERON:7500078.def: a condyle on the distal end and lateral side of a radius.

UBERON:7500079.name: ulnar notch of radius
UBERON:7500079.def: a condyle on the distal end and medial side of a radius that interacts with the ulna.

UBERON:7500080.name: articular surface for carpals
UBERON:7500080.def: the articular surface on the distal end of a radius that interacts with carpals.

UBERON:7500081.name: articular surface for the tibia on the talus
UBERON:7500081.def: contact surface between the tibia and the talus located on the talus.

UBERON:7500083.name: greater palatine foramen
UBERON:7500083.def: a foramen of the skull found at either posterior angle of the hard palate, for the transmission of the descending palatine vessels and greater palatine nerve.

UBERON:7500084.name: lesser palatine foramen
UBERON:7500084.def: a foramen of the skull found at either posterior angle of the hard palate behind the greater palatine foramen. one or more lesser palatine foramina perforate the pyramidal process of the palatine bone and carry the lesser palatine nerve.

UBERON:7500085.name: endodontium
UBERON:7500085.def: a pulp-dentin complex or endodont that is part of a calcareous tooth.

UBERON:7500088.name: obsolete distal articular surface of radius

UBERON:7500089.name: posterior articular facet for talus of calcaneus
UBERON:7500089.def: posterior-most facet on the proximal surface of the calcaneus for the articulation of the talus bone.

UBERON:7500091.name: middle articular facet for talus of calcaneus
UBERON:7500091.def: middle facet on the proximal surface of the calcaneus for the articulation of the talus bone.

UBERON:7500092.name: anterior articular facet for talus of calcaneus
UBERON:7500092.def: anterior-most facet on the proximal surface of the calcaneus for the articulation of the talus bone.

UBERON:7500093.name: calcaneal body
UBERON:7500093.def: the calcaneus body is the part of the bone not used for articulation with other bones.

UBERON:7500094.name: tubercle of calcaneus
UBERON:7500094.def: a raised projection on the calcaneus.

UBERON:7500095.name: lateral tubercle of calcaneus
UBERON:7500095.def: a raised projection on the lateral side of a calcaneus.

UBERON:7500096.name: medial tubercle of calcaneus
UBERON:7500096.def: a raised projection on the medial side of a calcaneus.

UBERON:7500101.name: antorbital notch
UBERON:7500101.def: the antorbital notch is a prominence of bone located anterolaterally of the antorbital fenestra.

UBERON:7500102.name: preorbital bone region
UBERON:7500102.def: part of the orbital plate formed by the jugal (part of the zygomatic), lacrimal (which is sometimes fused), sometimes nasal (typically in species with elongated rostra), and maxilla bones anterior to the orbit.

UBERON:7500103.name: preorbital fossa
UBERON:7500103.def: a hollow (fossa) in the preorbital region, typically lying on the maxillary bone, although sometimes can touch nasal bones (e.g., modern equus).

UBERON:7500105.name: coracoid process of calcaneus
UBERON:7500105.def: at the dorsal part of the base of the calcaneal tuberoisty is a pointed process called the coracoid process.

UBERON:7500106.name: hormion
UBERON:7500106.def: a craniometric point at the junction of the posterior midline border of the vomer with the sphenoid bone on the sphenovomerine suture.

UBERON:7500107.name: sphenovomerine suture
UBERON:7500107.def: a suture joining a sphenoid bone with the alae of a vomer to form a schindylesis type of joint.

UBERON:7500108.name: cheek tooth
UBERON:7500108.def: any of the post-canine teeth, which are the multicuspidate molars or premolars used for shearing and grinding food in mammals.

UBERON:7500109.name: basion
UBERON:7500109.def: an anatomical point on the antero-ventral margin of foramen magnum in the median plane.

UBERON:7500110.name: synsphenion
UBERON:7500110.def: a craniometric point on the ventral surface of the intersphenoid suture, along the midline of the skull.

UBERON:7500111.name: intersphenoid suture
UBERON:7500111.def: a suture joining the basisphenoid bone and the presphenoid bone of a sphenoid bone.

UBERON:7500112.name: prosthion
UBERON:7500112.def: a craniometric point that is the most anterior point in the midline on the alveolar process of the maxilla between the incisors (premaxilla bone).

UBERON:7500113.name: akrokranion
UBERON:7500113.def: the most dorsoanterior point on the supraoccipital crest in the medial plane.

UBERON:7500114.name: cheek tooth row
UBERON:7500114.def: an anatomical row consisting of adjacent cheek teeth.

UBERON:7500115.name: sagittal crest
UBERON:7500115.def: a ridge or similar projection rising above the surface of an anatomical strucuture along the sagittal (midline) plane.

UBERON:7500117.name: opisthocranion
UBERON:7500117.def: a craniometric point which is the furthest point from the glabella along the midline.

UBERON:7500118.name: opisthion
UBERON:7500118.def: a craniometric point at the posterior margin of the foramen magnum along the midline.

UBERON:7500119.name: ectorbitale
UBERON:7500119.def: an anatomical point on the most lateral point of the frontal bone of tetrapods on the occipital side of the orbit.

UBERON:7500120.name: zygion
UBERON:7500120.def: the most lateral anatomical point of the zygomatic arch.

UBERON:7500121.name: paroccipital process
UBERON:7500121.def: a process of bone extending downward from the jugular process of the occipital bone.

UBERON:7500123.name: incisor tooth 3
UBERON:7500123.def: the incisor tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 3.

UBERON:7500124.name: incisor tooth 4
UBERON:7500124.def: the incisor tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 4.

UBERON:7500125.name: incisor tooth 5
UBERON:7500125.def: the incisor tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 5.

UBERON:7500126.name: molar tooth 5
UBERON:7500126.def: the molar tooth of the upper or lower jaw that is phylogenetically number 5.

UBERON:7500127.name: otion
UBERON:7500127.def: the most lateral anatomical point on the mastoid process of temporal bone.

UBERON:7500128.name: cranial temporal crest
UBERON:7500128.def: a ridge or similar projection connected to the temporal lines and nuchal crest on the squamous part of the occipital bone. it bounds the posteroventral part of the temporal fossa.

UBERON:8000000.name: first instar larva stage
UBERON:8000000.def: the first stage of instar larva stage.

UBERON:8000001.name: second instar larva stage
UBERON:8000001.def: the second stage of instar larva stage.

UBERON:8000002.name: third instar larva stage
UBERON:8000002.def: the third stage of instar larva stage.

UBERON:8000003.name: fourth instar larva stage
UBERON:8000003.def: the fourth stage of instar larva stage.

UBERON:8000004.name: central retina
UBERON:8000004.def: region of retina around the fovea that extends approximately for 6 mm. central retina is considerably thick due to increased density of photoreceptors, particularly cones and their associated bipolar and ganglion cells.

UBERON:8000005.name: henle's fiber layer
UBERON:8000005.def: this layer contains bundles of unmyelinated cone and rod photoreceptor axons terminating in the pedicles and spherules that synapse in the retinal outer plexiform layer (opl).

UBERON:8000006.name: left side of back
UBERON:8000006.def: left part of the organism dorsal to a horizontal plane and bounded on one side by the same transverse plane.

UBERON:8000007.name: right side of back
UBERON:8000007.def: right part of the organism dorsal to a horizontal plane and bounded on one side by the same transverse plane.

UBERON:8000008.name: cementocyte lacuna
UBERON:8000008.def: the small cavity within the cellular cementum that is occupied by a cementocyte cell body.

UBERON:8000009.name: purkinje fiber network
UBERON:8000009.def: a collection of purkinje fibers that receives signals from the right and left bundle branches and innervates the ventricular cardiac muscle. the purkinje fiber network creates synchronized contractions of the heart ventricles.

UBERON:8200002.name: copepodite stage 1
UBERON:8200002.def: a development stage of copepods which immediately follows the nauplius stage. it is characterized by the presence of 2 swimming legs.

UBERON:8200003.name: copepodite stage 2
UBERON:8200003.def: a development stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 1. it is characterized by the presence of 3 swimming legs.

UBERON:8200004.name: copepodite stage 3
UBERON:8200004.def: a development stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 2. it is characterized by the presence of 4 swimming legs.

UBERON:8200005.name: copepodite stage 4
UBERON:8200005.def: a development stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 3. it is characterized by the presence of 5 swimming legs.

UBERON:8200006.name: copepodite stage 5
UBERON:8200006.def: a pre-adult stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 4. it is characterized by enlargement of the urosome and development of sexual organs.

UBERON:8200007.name: copepodite stage 6
UBERON:8200007.def: a fully formed stage of copepods which immediately follows copepodite stage 5. it is characterized by the complete development of the fifth swimming leg.

UBERON:8300000.name: skin of scalp
UBERON:8300000.def: a zone of skin that is part of a scalp.

UBERON:8300001.name: right forelimb
UBERON:8300001.def: a forelimb that is on the right side of a pectoral complex.

UBERON:8300002.name: left forelimb
UBERON:8300002.def: a forelimb that is on the left side of a pectoral complex.

UBERON:8300003.name: right hindlimb
UBERON:8300003.def: a hindlimb that is on the right side of a pelvic complex.

UBERON:8300004.name: left hindlimb
UBERON:8300004.def: a hindlimb that is on the left side of a pelvic complex.

UBERON:8400001.name: hepatic acinus zone 1
UBERON:8400001.def: the region of the hepatic acinus that is closest to the arterial blood supply and has the highest oxygen concentration. zone 1 is located in the periportal region of the liver lobule, closest to the portal triad. hepatocytes in this region are primarily involved in oxidative energy metabolism.

UBERON:8400002.name: hepatic acinus zone 3
UBERON:8400002.def: the region of the hepatic acinus immediately surrounding the central veins. this region has the lowest oxygen concentration in the acinus. zone 3 is located in the centrilobular region of the liver lobule, closest to the central vein. hepatocytes in this region are the primary location for the biotransformation of drugs.

UBERON:8400003.name: hepatic acinus zone 2
UBERON:8400003.def: the region of the hepatic acinus in between zones 1 and 3. blood in this region has an intermediate oxygen concentration relative to the other two zones of the hepatic acinus. zone 2 is located in the midzonal region of the liver lobule. hepatocytes in this region have mixed functionality in comparison with those in zones 1 and 3.

UBERON:8400005.name: metabolic zone of liver
UBERON:8400005.def: any of the metabolic zones found in the liver. liver tissue is heterogenous at the level of morphometry and histochemistry. this heterogeneity is linked to the position of a cell within the functional unit of the tissue, which, in turn, is related to the blood supply: cells located in the upstream zone differ from those in the downstream zone with respect to subcellular structures, key enzymes, translocators, and receptors and, therefore, have different metabolic capacities. this is the basis for 'metabolic zonation', a concept first proposed in mammals for carbohydrate metabolism and later expanded to include amino acid and ammonia metabolism, xenobiotic metabolism, protective metabolism, and formation of plasma proteins.

UBERON:8400006.name: liver lobule periportal region
UBERON:8400006.def: the region of the liver lobule that is closest to the portal triad. the functionally-defined hepatic acinus zone 1 is generally found in this region.

UBERON:8400007.name: liver lobule centrilobular region
UBERON:8400007.def: the region of the liver lobule that is closest to the central vein. the functionally-defined hepatic acinus zone 3 is generally found in this region.

UBERON:8400008.name: liver lobule midzonal region
UBERON:8400008.def: the region of the liver lobule that is between the periportal and centrilobular regions. the functionally-defined hepatic acinus zone 2 is generally found in this region.

UBERON:8400021.name: liver serosa
UBERON:8400021.def: hepatic serous coat; peritoneal covering of the liver, enclosing almost all except for a triangular area on its posterior surface (the 'bare area of the liver') and a smaller area where the liver and gallbladder are in direct contact.

UBERON:8400023.name: liver subserosa
UBERON:8400023.def: subserosal tissue of liver. a zone of areolar connective tissue lying beneath the serous coat of the liver and distinguished with difficulty from the fibrous capsule of glisson.

UBERON:8400024.name: subcapsular region of liver
UBERON:8400024.def: region of liver parenchyma immediately below the capsule. this region is frequently specified in pathology diagnoses.

UBERON:8410000.name: duodeno-jejunal junction
UBERON:8410000.def: the anatomical junction between the duodenum and the jejunum.

UBERON:8410001.name: small intestine venule
UBERON:8410001.def: venule of villus of small intestine.

UBERON:8410002.name: small intestine lymphatic vessel
UBERON:8410002.def: a lymphatic vessel that supplies the small intestine.

UBERON:8410003.name: ductal plate
UBERON:8410003.def: in human, ductal plate is a double-layered cylindrical structure of bile duct epithelium that surrounds the portal ramifications by the eighth gestational week. after approximately the 12th gestational week, remodelling of ductal plate begins, and maturity is attained by the end of gestation or early postnatal period.

UBERON:8410004.name: small intestine arteriole
UBERON:8410004.def: arteriole of villus of small intestine.

UBERON:8410005.name: transitional glandular epithelium of anorectum
UBERON:8410005.def: glandular epithelium of the anal transition zone. the anal transition zone is defined loosely as the tissue interposed between the uninterrupted squamous epithelium of the anoderm and the uninterrupted mucosal epithelium of the anal canal in the anorectum.
UBERON:8410005.synonym: glandular epithelium of the anal transition zone

UBERON:8410006.name: submucous nerve plexus of anorectum
UBERON:8410006.def: submucous nerve plexus that is located in the anorectum.

UBERON:8410007.name: myenteric nerve plexus of anorectum
UBERON:8410007.def: myenteric nerve plexus that is located in the anorectum.

UBERON:8410008.name: venule of anorectum
UBERON:8410008.def: a venule that is located in the anorectum.

UBERON:8410009.name: arteriole of anorectum
UBERON:8410009.def: an arteriole that is located in the anorectum.

UBERON:8410010.name: fimbria of uterine tube
UBERON:8410010.def: a fringe of tissue around the ostium of the fallopian tube, in the direction of the ovary.

UBERON:8410011.name: myenteric nerve plexus of appendix
UBERON:8410011.def: myenteric nerve plexus that is located in the vermiform appendix.
UBERON:8410011.synonym: myenteric nerve plexus of vermiform appendix

UBERON:8410012.name: submucous nerve plexus of appendix
UBERON:8410012.def: submucous nerve plexus that is located in the vermiform appendix.
UBERON:8410012.synonym: submucous nerve plexus of vermiform appendix

UBERON:8410013.name: afferent lymphatic vessel valve
UBERON:8410013.def: a valve in an afferent lymphatic vessel. it manages the flow of lymphatic fluid into the lymph node carrying immune cells and is essential for the correct flow of fluid through the lymphatic system.

UBERON:8410014.name: efferent lymphatic vessel valve
UBERON:8410014.def: a valve in an efferent lymphatic vessel. it manages the flow of lymphatic fluid out of the lymph node carrying immune cells and is essential for the correct flow of fluid through the lymphatic system.

UBERON:8410015.name: arteriole of colon
UBERON:8410015.def: an arteriole located in the colon.

UBERON:8410016.name: descending sigmoid junction
UBERON:8410016.def: the anatomical junction between the descending colon and the sigmoid colon.

UBERON:8410017.name: left colic vein
UBERON:8410017.def: a portal vein that drains the descending colon. it is a tributary of the inferior mesenteric vein, and follows the path of its corresponding artery, the left colic artery.

UBERON:8410018.name: right colic vein
UBERON:8410018.def: a portal vein that drains the ascending colon. it is a tributary of the superior mesenteric vein, and travels with its corresponding artery, the right colic artery.

UBERON:8410019.name: jejuno-ileal junction
UBERON:8410019.def: the area where the jejunum ends and the ileum part of the intestine begins. although there is no clear distinct section, the ileum is narrower and has smaller villi than the jejunum.

UBERON:8410020.name: venule of appendix
UBERON:8410020.def: a venule located in the vermiform appendix.

UBERON:8410021.name: inguinal region skin
UBERON:8410021.def: the skin covering the inguinal region between the abdomen and the thigh on either side of the pubic bone.
UBERON:8410021.synonym: zone of skin of inguinal region

UBERON:8410022.name: left colic artery
UBERON:8410022.def: the first branch of the inferior mesenteric artery (ima) is the left colic artery. the left colic artery supplies blood flow to the distal third of the transverse colon and the entirety of the descending colon. once diverging from the ima, the left colic artery runs anterior to the left ureter, left internal spermatic vessels (males), and psoas major before branching into its ascending and descending segments.

UBERON:8410023.name: right colic artery
UBERON:8410023.def: the right colic artery may arise directly from the superior mesenteric artery (sma) but often arises from a common trunk with the ileocolic artery or middle colic artery. it supplies the ascending colon.

UBERON:8410024.name: intestinal junction
UBERON:8410024.def: an anatomical junction between two parts of the intestine.

UBERON:8410025.name: transition zone of prostate
UBERON:8410025.def: the region of the prostate gland anterior to the central and peripheral zones, surrounding the proximal urethra. it is the zone of the human prostate gland that grows the most throughout life, and is responsible for benign prostatic hypertrophy.

UBERON:8410026.name: peripheral zone of prostate
UBERON:8410026.def: the region of the prostate that is located posterior to the central and transition zones, surrounding the distal urethra. it is the zone of origin for the vast majority of human prostatic cancers.

UBERON:8410027.name: central zone of prostate
UBERON:8410027.def: the region of the prostate gland that is located between the peripheral and transition zones, surrounding the ejaculatory ducts. it gives rise to a very small percentage of human prostate cancers, often aggressive and invading the seminal vesicles.

UBERON:8410028.name: arteriole of appendix
UBERON:8410028.def: an arteriole located in the vermiform appendix.

UBERON:8410029.name: lymphatic capillary of appendix
UBERON:8410029.def: a lymphatic capillary that is located in the vermiform appendix.

UBERON:8410030.name: lymphatic vessel of appendix
UBERON:8410030.def: a lymphatic vessel located in the vermiform appendix.

UBERON:8410031.name: muscularis mucosae of appendix
UBERON:8410031.def: a muscularis mucosa that is part of a vermiform appendix.

UBERON:8410032.name: trabecular sinus of lymph node
UBERON:8410032.def: the trabecular sinus is the lymph-filled space outside the trabeculae between lobules of the lymph node. this is a continuation of the subcapsular sinus which receives the afferent vessels and is present beneath the capsule. this space is traversed by both reticular fibers and cells in the lymph.

UBERON:8410033.name: lymph node vein
UBERON:8410033.def: a vein where lymph node venules condense and which exits at the lymph node hilum. it is also called hilar vein.

UBERON:8410034.name: lymph node artery
UBERON:8410034.def: an artery that enters the lymph node at the hilum and branches into smaller arterioles.

UBERON:8410035.name: medullary arteriole of lymph node
UBERON:8410035.def: an arteriole that arises from the hilar artery of a lymph node and radiates centrifugally, branching in the medulla.
UBERON:8410035.synonym: arteriole of medulla of lymph node

UBERON:8410036.name: medullary venule of lymph node
UBERON:8410036.def: medullary venules are a continuation of high endothelial venules which condense repeatedly in the interfollicular cortex and peripheral deep cortical unit and then transition to medullary venules at the corticomedullary junction. the medullary venules condense and return centripetally to the hilar vein.
UBERON:8410036.synonym: venule of medulla of lymph node

UBERON:8410037.name: high endothelial venule
UBERON:8410037.def: high endothelial venules are specialized blood vessels adapted for lymphocyte trafficking. they form a spatially organized network, which controls both the type of lymphocyte and the site of entry into lymphoid tissues. uniquely, high endothelial venules express vascular addressins that regulate lymphocyte entry into lymphoid organs. they perform this function in all lymphoid organs except the spleen.

UBERON:8410038.name: high endothelial venule of lymph node
UBERON:8410038.def: a high endothelial venule that is part of a of lymph node.

UBERON:8410039.name: high endothelial venule of appendix
UBERON:8410039.def: a high endothelial venule that is located in the vermiform appendix.
UBERON:8410039.synonym: high endothelial venule of vermiform appendix

UBERON:8410040.name: high endothelial venule of small intestine peyer's patch
UBERON:8410040.def: a high endothelial venule that is located in a peyer's patch in the small intestine.
UBERON:8410040.synonym: high endothelial venule of peyer's patch of small intestine

UBERON:8410041.name: venule of lymph node
UBERON:8410041.def: a venule that is part of a lymph node.

UBERON:8410042.name: arteriole of lymph node
UBERON:8410042.def: an arteriole that is part of a lymph node.

UBERON:8410043.name: bronchus submucosal gland
UBERON:8410043.def: a submucosal gland located in a bronchus.

UBERON:8410044.name: vein of appendix
UBERON:8410044.def: a vein that is part of a vermiform appendix.

UBERON:8410045.name: artery of appendix
UBERON:8410045.def: an artery that is part of a vermiform appendix.

UBERON:8410046.name: appendix smooth muscle circular layer
UBERON:8410046.def: a circular muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a vermiform appendix smooth muscle.
UBERON:8410046.synonym: smooth muscle circular layer of vermiform appendix

UBERON:8410047.name: appendix smooth muscle longitudinal layer
UBERON:8410047.def: a longitudinal muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a vermiform appendix smooth muscle.
UBERON:8410047.synonym: smooth muscle longitudinal layer of vermiform appendix

UBERON:8410048.name: venule of colon
UBERON:8410048.def: a venule located in the colon.

UBERON:8410049.name: serosal nerve fiber of appendix
UBERON:8410049.def: a nerve fiber that is located in the serosa of vermiform appendix.
UBERON:8410049.synonym: serosal nerve fibre of vermiform appendix

UBERON:8410050.name: anorectum
UBERON:8410050.def: a subdivision of the digestive tract in humans that includes the rectum, the anal canal and the anus.

UBERON:8410051.name: lymphatic vessel of colon
UBERON:8410051.def: a lymphatic vessel located in the colon.

UBERON:8410052.name: lymph node germinal center light zone
UBERON:8410052.def: lymph node germinal centers contain two microenvironments: the light zone and the dark zone. the light zone is sparsely populated with b cells and includes additional cell types such as follicular dendritic cells, lymph node tingible macrophages and t follicular helper cells.
UBERON:8410052.synonym: light zone of lymph node germinal center

UBERON:8410053.name: lymph node germinal center dark zone
UBERON:8410053.def: lymph node germinal centers contain two microenvironments: the light zone and the dark zone. the dark zone is densely populated with b cell blasts and reticular cells.

UBERON:8410054.name: lymphatic capillary of colon
UBERON:8410054.def: a lymphatic capillary located in the colon.

UBERON:8410055.name: lymphatic capillary of anorectum
UBERON:8410055.def: a lymphatic capillary located in the anorectum.

UBERON:8410056.name: capillary of anorectum
UBERON:8410056.def: a capillary that is part of the anorectum.

UBERON:8410057.name: capillary of colon
UBERON:8410057.def: a capillary that is part of the colon.

UBERON:8410058.name: myenteric nerve plexus of colon
UBERON:8410058.def: myenteric nerve plexus that is located in the colon.

UBERON:8410059.name: submucous nerve plexus of colon
UBERON:8410059.def: submucous nerve plexus that is located in the colon.

UBERON:8410060.name: colon smooth muscle circular layer
UBERON:8410060.def: a circular muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a colon smooth muscle.
UBERON:8410060.synonym: smooth muscle circular layer of colon

UBERON:8410061.name: colon smooth muscle longitudinal layer
UBERON:8410061.def: a longitudinal muscle layer of muscular coat that is part of a colon smooth muscle.
UBERON:8410061.synonym: smooth muscle longitudinal layer of colon

UBERON:8410062.name: parasympathetic cholinergic nerve
UBERON:8410062.def: a parasympathetic nerve that releases acetylcholine.

UBERON:8410063.name: myenteric nerve plexus of small intestine
UBERON:8410063.def: myenteric nerve plexus that is part of the small intestine.

UBERON:8410064.name: submucous nerve plexus of small intestine
UBERON:8410064.def: submucous nerve plexus that is located in the small intestine.

UBERON:8410065.name: lymph node follicle marginal zone
UBERON:8410065.def: histologically, the marginal zone pattern of the lymph node is characterized by lymphoid follicles with three distinct layers. the inner layer is composed of follicular center zones, the middle layer of darkly stained mantle zones, and the outer layer of marginal zones. however, the marginal zone pattern is rarely seen in reactive lymph nodes except for mesenteric lymph nodes. lymph node marginal zones are populated by marginal zone b cells which express cd19 and cd20 and have the phenotypic features of memory b cells.
UBERON:8410065.synonym: marginal zone of lymph node follicle

UBERON:8410066.name: lymph node paracortex
UBERON:8410066.def: the lymph node paracortex is the middle layer of the lymph node and is mostly populated by t cells and dendritic cells. the paracortex also contains specialised blood vessels called high endothelial venules which allow lymphocytes to enter the node.

UBERON:8410067.name: lymph node interfollicular cortex
UBERON:8410067.def: follicules in the lymph node are surrounded and separated by the interfollicular cortex. together with the lymph node follicle, the interfollicular cortex of the lymph node lobule make up the superficial cortex of the lymph node. capillaries empty into the high endothelial venules located in the interfollicular cortex. the interfollicular cortex also serves as transit corriders for lymphocytes migrating between the b and t cell areas.

UBERON:8410068.name: capillary of small intestine
UBERON:8410068.def: a capillary that is part of a small intestine.

UBERON:8410069.name: lymphoid nodule
UBERON:8410069.def: lymphoid tissue found in some birds and similar, but not identical, to mammalian lymph nodes.

UBERON:8410070.name: levator costarum
UBERON:8410070.def: a chest muscle with a role in forceful inspiration. in human, there are twelve levatores costarum on either side of the chest; they are small tendinous and fleshy bundles arising from the ends of the transverse processes of the seventh cervical and upper eleven thoracic vertebrae. they pass obliquely downward and laterally, like the fibers of the intercostales externi, and each is inserted into the outer surface of the rib immediately below the vertebra from which it takes origin, between the tubercle and the angle (levatores costarum breves). each of the four lower muscles divides into two fasciculi, one of which is inserted as above described; the other passes down to the second rib below its origin (levatores costarum longi).

UBERON:8410071.name: subcapsular sinus ceiling
UBERON:8410071.def: the section of the lymph node capsule that faces the subcapsular sinus. in human, it's characterized by specific protein markers.
UBERON:8410071.synonym: subcapsular sinus of lymph node ceiling

UBERON:8410072.name: subcapsular sinus floor
UBERON:8410072.def: the section of the lymph node cortex that faces the subcapsular sinus. in human, it's characterized by specific protein markers.
UBERON:8410072.synonym: subcapsular sinus of lymph node floor

UBERON:8410073.name: medullary region of kidney
UBERON:8410073.def: a part of the kidney that comprises kidney pyramids and renal columns.

UBERON:8410074.name: lymph node paracortical sinus
UBERON:8410074.def: a lymph node sinus intimately associated with paracortical cords that originate in the interfollicular cortex and extend into the medullary cords.

UBERON:8410075.name: lymph node paracortical cord
UBERON:8410075.def: lymph node paracortical parenchyma containing dense networks of t cells, b cells, fibroblastic reticular cells, and dendritic cells.

UBERON:8410076.name: glomus coccygeum
UBERON:8410076.def: a glomus-like dermal microanatomical structure found in human and placed in front of, or immediately below, the tip of the coccyx. each glomus consists of one or more arterial segments that branch into a number of glomic arterioles surrounded by rows of round, uniform, epithelioid contractile cells, that drain into a collecting venous plexus.

UBERON:8410077.name: airway submucosal gland
UBERON:8410077.def: a submucosal gland found in a respiratory tract.

UBERON:8410078.name: right lymphatic duct
UBERON:8410078.def: a great lymphatic vessel that empties lymph into one of the subclavian veins. in humans, there are two lymph ducts in the body: the right lymphatic duct and the thoracic duct. the right lymphatic duct drains lymph from the right upper limb, right side of thorax and right halves of head and neck. the thoracic duct drains lymph into the circulatory system at the left brachiocephalic vein between the left subclavian and left internal jugular veins.

UBERON:8410079.name: red bone marrow of iliac crest
UBERON:8410079.def: red bone marrow located in an iliac crest.

UBERON:8410080.name: red bone marrow of sternum
UBERON:8410080.def: red bone marrow located in the sternum.

UBERON:8410081.name: blood microvessel
UBERON:8410081.def: any of the smallest blood vessels where blood circulates within organ tissues. microvessels include terminal arterioles, metarterioles, capillaries, and venules (but exclude lymphatic capillaries). arterioles carry oxygenated blood to the capillaries, and blood flows out of the capillaries through venules into veins.

UBERON:8420000.name: hair of scalp
UBERON:8420000.def: hair that grows on the scalp.

UBERON:8440000.name: cortical layer ii/iii
UBERON:8440000.def: a laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of a part of layer ii and a part of layer iii.

UBERON:8440001.name: cortical layer iv/v
UBERON:8440001.def: a laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of a part of layer iv and a part of layer v.

UBERON:8440002.name: cortical layer v/vi
UBERON:8440002.def: a laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of a part of layer v and a part of layer vi.

UBERON:8440003.name: cortical layer vib
UBERON:8440003.def: the deepest layer of the neocortex. while layer 6b is considered part of layer 6, it is distinct morphologically, genetically, and developmentally from the rest of layer 6. neurons in l6b project to cortical targets and higher-order thalamus and develop from a precursor population that arises from the subplate.

UBERON:8440004.name: laminar subdivision of the cortex
UBERON:8440004.def: one or a subset of adjacent layers of the neocortex.

UBERON:8440005.name: rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle
UBERON:8440005.def: a functional anatomical construct containing the key estrogen-regulated inputs to gonadotropin-releasing hormone expressing (gnrh) neurons necessary for estrogen positive feedback. the rostral periventricular region of the third ventricle contains a population of neurons, scattered through the nuclei of the anteroventral periventricular (avpv), periventricular preoptic (pvpo), and median preoptic (mepo), that project directly to gnrh neurons and express er-alpha.

UBERON:8440007.name: periventricular hypothalamic nucleus, anterior part
UBERON:8440007.def: the anterior part of the periventricular hypothalamic nucleus.

UBERON:8440008.name: periventricular hypothalamic nucleus, intermediate part
UBERON:8440008.def: the intermediate part of the periventricular hypothalamic nucleus.

UBERON:8440010.name: brodmann (1909) area 17
UBERON:8440010.def: a subdivision of the cytoarchitecturally defined occipital region of cerebral cortex in the human. defined by the band of gennari, which gives it the name striate (furrowed) area, it occupies the banks of the calcarine sulcus which are located in the cuneus and the lingual gyrus of the occipital lobe. cytoarchitecturally it is bounded by the area 18 of brodmann (human) which surrounds it ( brodmann-1909 ). in the mouse ( paxinos-2001 ) and the rat ( swanson-1998 ) it is located on the dorsolateral surface of the cerebral hemisphere[braininfo].

UBERON:8440011.name: cortical visual area
UBERON:8440011.def: the part of the cortex that is responsible for processing visual information.

UBERON:8440012.name: cerebral nuclei
UBERON:8440012.def: one of three components of the cerebrum that is a composite structure of the endbrain defined on the basis of origin from the ventricular ridge of the embryonic encephalon. it consists of the extended striatum and the extended pallidum.

UBERON:8440013.name: fasciola cinerea
UBERON:8440013.def: a small paired band that passes around the splenium of the corpus callosum from the lateral longitudinal stria to the dentate gyrus. the fc exhibits clear anatomical borders with the distalmost region of the ca1.

UBERON:8440014.name: ventrolateral preoptic nucleus
UBERON:8440014.def: a small cluster of neurons situated in the anterior hypothalamus, sitting just above and to the side of the optic chiasm in the brain of humans and other animals.

UBERON:8440015.name: noradrenergic cell groups
UBERON:8440015.def: collections of neurons in the central nervous system that have been demonstrated by histochemical fluorescence to contain the neurotransmitter norepinephrine (noradrenalin).

UBERON:8440016.name: noradrenergic cell group a1
UBERON:8440016.def: a group of cells in the vicinity of the lateral reticular nucleus of the medullary reticular formation that label for norepinephrine in primates.

UBERON:8440017.name: noradrenergiccell group a2
UBERON:8440017.def: a group of cells in the vicinity of the dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus nerve in the medulla that label for norepinephrine in primates and rodents.

UBERON:8440018.name: noradrenergic cell group a4
UBERON:8440018.def: a group of cells exhibiting noradrenergic fluorescence that, in the rat, are located in the tegmen ventriculi quarti (roof of the fourth ventricle) ventral to the cerebellar nuclei, and in the macaque, are found at the edge of the lateral recess of the fourth ventricle caudally, extending to beneath the floor of the ventricle where they merge with the noradrenergic group a6, the locus ceruleus.

UBERON:8440019.name: noradrenergic cell group a5
UBERON:8440019.def: a group of cells in the vicinity of the superior olivary complex in the pontine tegmentum that label for norepinephine in primates, rodents, and other mammals.

UBERON:8440021.name: noradrenergic cell group a7
UBERON:8440021.def: a group of cells fluorescent for norepinephrine that is located in the pontine reticular formation ventral to the superior cerebellar peduncle of the pons in rodents and in primates.

UBERON:8440022.name: noradrenergic cell group a6sc
UBERON:8440022.def: a group of cells fluorescent for norepinephrine that are scattered in the nucleus subceruleus of the macaque.

UBERON:8440023.name: noradrenergic cell group acg
UBERON:8440023.def: a group of cells fluorescent for norepinephrine that are located in the central gray of the midbrain at the level of the trochlear nucleus in the squirrel monkey (saimiri) and to a lesser degree in the macaque.

UBERON:8440024.name: visceral area
UBERON:8440024.def: a cortical area between the agranular insular cortex and the supplemental somatosensory area in rats and mice. the visc is the architectonically equivalent structure granular insula in humans.

UBERON:8440025.name: parapyramidal nucleus
UBERON:8440025.def: a small group of cells located lateral to the pyramid of the medulla in the rat and the mouse that functionally it belongs to the reticular formation of the subcortical motor system.

UBERON:8440026.name: parapyramidal nucleus, deep part
UBERON:8440026.def: the part of the parapyramidal nucleus that is closely adjacent to the inner surface of the pyramidal tract.

UBERON:8440027.name: parapyramidal nucleus, superficial part
UBERON:8440027.def: the part of the parapyramidal nucleus that is located on the ventral surface of the medulla lateral to the pyramidal tract.

UBERON:8440028.name: perihypoglossal nuclei
UBERON:8440028.def: a group of neurons in the floor of the fourth ventricle, in close proximity to the nucleus of the hypoglossal nerve in the gray substance of the medulla oblongata, all of which contain cells with characteristics suggestive of reticular connections.

UBERON:8440029.name: rubroreticular tract
UBERON:8440029.def: nerve fibers that originate in the magnocellular red nucleus, cross to the other side of the midbrain, and descend in the lateral part of the brainstem tegmentum in the midbrain, and travel through the lateral funiculus of the spinal cord, coursing adjacent to the lateral corticospinal tract.

UBERON:8440030.name: striatum-like amygdalar nuclei
UBERON:8440030.def: a part of the striatum which is primarilly composed of amygdalar areas. the samy is composed of the anterior amygdalar area, central amygdalar nucleus, intercalated amygdalar nucleus, medial amygdalar nucleus, and the bed nucleus of the accessory olfactory tract.

UBERON:8440031.name: medial corticohypothalmic tract
UBERON:8440031.def: the main route taken by fibers from the ventral subiculum to the hypothalamus, where they innervate the medial preoptic area, “shell” of the ventromedial nucleus, dorsomedial nucleus, ventral premammillary  nucleus, and cell-poor zone around the medial mammillary nucleus.

UBERON:8440032.name: prelimbic area
UBERON:8440032.def: a region in the medial prefrontal cortex that is dorsal to the infralimbic area important in expression of conditioned reward and fear behaviour.

UBERON:8440033.name: infralimbic area
UBERON:8440033.def: a region in the medial prefrontal cortex that is ventral to the prelimbic area important in supression of conditioned reward and fear behaviour.

UBERON:8440034.name: bulbocerebellar tract
UBERON:8440034.def: a subdivision of inferior cerebellar peduncle that connects the medulla to the cerebellum.

UBERON:8440035.name: sublaterodorsal nucleus
UBERON:8440035.def: a region in the dorsal pons that plays a central role in inducing motor suppression during rem sleep.

UBERON:8440036.name: supratrigeminal nucleus
UBERON:8440036.def: a premotoneuron pool in the trigeminal reflex arc that is a key structure of jaw movement control.

UBERON:8440037.name: accessory facial motor nucleus
UBERON:8440037.def: a small cluster of neurons dorsal to the facial motor nucleus in the pontine tegmentum.

UBERON:8440038.name: efferent vestibular nucleus
UBERON:8440038.def: a small region of neurons in the brainstem, dorsolateral to the genu of facial nerve, that have efferents to the vestibular periphery.

UBERON:8440039.name: piriform-amygdalar area
UBERON:8440039.def: the cortical region between the cortical amygdalar area and the piriform area.

UBERON:8440040.name: dorsal peduncular area
UBERON:8440040.def: a cytoarchitectonic area on the medial surface of the cerebral hemisphere rostral to the septum, ventral to the infralimbic area and dorsal to the tenia tecta in the mouse and rat.

UBERON:8440041.name: tuberal nucleus (sensu rodentia)
UBERON:8440041.def: a hypothalamic region in rodents that is homologous to the lateral tuberal nucleus in humans and higher primates and is involved in energy homeostasis.

UBERON:8440042.name: nucleus lateralis tuberis system (sensu teleostei)
UBERON:8440042.def: a prominent nucleus located in the ventral tuberal area of teleostei that is anatomically homologous to the hypothalamic arcuate (infundibular)-median eminence (me) system of tetrpods.

UBERON:8440043.name: superior paraolivary nucleus
UBERON:8440043.def: a structure embedded in the superior olivary complex that is driven by input pathways from the octopus cells in the cochlear nucleus and the neurons of the medial nucleus of the trapezoid body.

UBERON:8440044.name: upper layers of the cortex
UBERON:8440044.def: a laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of the more surface layers, commonly layers two through four.

UBERON:8440045.name: second visual cortical area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440045.def: a visual area in the ferret that is rostral to area 17, caudal to area 19 and also abuts ppc and area 20a.

UBERON:8440046.name: third visual cortical area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440046.def: a visual area in the ferret located rostral to area 18 and caudal to area 21.

UBERON:8440047.name: fourth visual cortical area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440047.def: a visual area in the ferret that is caudal to the suprasylvian visual areas and rostral to area 19.

UBERON:8440048.name: temporal visual area a (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440048.def: a visual area in the ferret that is posterior to area 20b and lies lateral to areas 17, 18, and 19.

UBERON:8440049.name: temporal visual area b (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440049.def: a visual area in the ferret that is posterior to area ps and anterior to 20a.

UBERON:8440050.name: posterior parietal rostral cortical area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440050.def: a multimodal area of the ferret involved in vision and somatosensation that lies between the medial wall of the hemisphere and the medial lip of the suprasylvian sulcus and is posterior to caudal somatosensory cortex (siii) and anterior to ppc.

UBERON:8440051.name: lower layers of the cortex
UBERON:8440051.def: a laminar subdivision of the neocortex that is comprised of the deeper layers, commonly layers five and six, however, could also consist part of layer four.

UBERON:8440052.name: posterior parietal caudal cortical area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440052.def: a visual area in the ferret that  lies between the medial wall of the hemisphere and the medial lip of the suprasylvian sulcus and is posterior to ppr and anterior to area 18 (on the lateral gyrus) and area 21 (on the suprasylvian gyrus).

UBERON:8440054.name: anteromedial lateral suprasylvian visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440054.def: a visual area in the ferret that lies medial to the fundus in the suprasylvian sulcus, posterior to the mrss and anterior to the pmls.

UBERON:8440055.name: anterolateral lateral suprasylvian visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440055.def: a visual area in the ferret that lies on the lateral bank of the suprasylvian sulcus, posterior to siii, anterior to area plls and medial to a1.

UBERON:8440056.name: posteromedial lateral suprasylvian visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440056.def: a visual area in the ferret that is located in the posterior bank of the suprasylvian sulcus.
UBERON:8440056.synonym: suprasylvian sulcal visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)

UBERON:8440059.name: posterolateral lateral suprasylvian visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440059.def: a visual area in the ferret located in the lateral bank of the suprasylvian sulcus posterior to alls, anteriomedial to dls and lateral to pmls.

UBERON:8440060.name: dorsal lateral suprasylvian visual cortical area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440060.def: a visual area in the ferret located in the lateral bank of the suprasylvian sulcus anterior to vls and posterior to plls.

UBERON:8440061.name: ventral lateral suprasylvian visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440061.def: a visual area in the ferret located in the medial bank of the suprasylvian sulvus lateral to area pmls.

UBERON:8440062.name: posterior suprasylvian visual cortical area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440062.def: a visual area in the ferret that is lateral to the occipital visual areas (area 17, 18, 19 and 21), medial to perirhinal cortex and anterior to area 20b.

UBERON:8440063.name: anterior ectosylvian visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440063.def: a multimodal area in the ferret responsive to visual, somatic, and auditory stimuli. the anterior border of aev is coincident with the anterior portion of the ectosylvian gyrus containing higher order somatosensory cortical areas and the posterior border abuts higher order auditory cortical areas.

UBERON:8440064.name: spenial visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440064.def: a visual area in the ferret located on the dorsal bank of the splenial sulcus between the medial border of area 17 and the lateral borter of cva.

UBERON:8440066.name: cingulate visual area (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440066.def: a visual area of the ferret located in the fundus of the splenial sulcus medial to sva.

UBERON:8440067.name: a lamina of the lateral geniculate nucleus (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440067.def: a major laminae of the lateral geniculate nucleus of the ferret receiving crossed retinal inputs, located medial to the c laminae and lateral to the a1 and p laminae.

UBERON:8440068.name: a1 lamina of the lateral geniculate nucleus (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440068.def: a major laminae of the lateral geniculate nucleus of the ferret receiving uncrossed retinal inputs, located medial to the c and a laminae (linden, guillery & cucchiaro, 1981)

UBERON:8440069.name: c lamina of the lateral geniculate nucleus (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440069.def: the most lateral laminae of the lgn of the ferret. the c laminae includes the c lamina, which is the innermost layer, followed by c1, c2, and c3 being the outermost lamina.

UBERON:8440070.name: perigeniculate lamina of the lateral geniculate nucleus (sensu mustela putorius furo)
UBERON:8440070.def: a lamina of the lgn in the ferret located medial to the a lamina in the rostral regions of the visual thalamus ((linden, guillery & cucchiaro, 1981; dell, innocenti, hilgetag, & manger, 2019).

UBERON:8440072.name: lateral tegmental nucleus
UBERON:8440072.def: a nucleus of the brain that is embedded in the pontine tegmentum, it is defined on the basis of inputs from the lateral hypothalamic area and central amygdalar nucleus, it is located ventral to the locus ceruleus, dorsal to barrington's nucleus, lateral to the laterodorsal tegmental nucleus, and medial to the midbrain trigeminal nucleus.

UBERON:8440073.name: magnocellular reticular nucleus
UBERON:8440073.def: a nucleus of the brain that is the most ventral portion of the gigantocellular nucleus in the medullary reticular formation, between the lateral paragigantocellular nucleus and the midline or nucleus raphe magnus. functionally it belongs to the reticular formation (functional) of the subcortical motor system.

UBERON:8440074.name: interstitial nucleus of the vestibular nerve
UBERON:8440074.def: a cluster of large nerve cells distributed in the vestibular component of vestibulocochlear nerve fibers that functionally belong to the vestibulomotor regions of the behavioral control column.

UBERON:8440075.name: gustatory cortex
UBERON:8440075.def: the part of the cerebral cortex that is responsible for the perception of taste.

UBERON:8440076.name: somatomotor area
UBERON:8440076.def: a part of the cerebral cortex that comprises of the primary motor cortex and the premotor cortex.

UBERON:8440077.name: rhinal incisure
UBERON:8440077.def: a fissure in the cerebral cortex that separates the tenia tecta rostrally from the orbital gyri and caudally from the infralimbic cortex

UBERON:8450001.name: egg follicle
UBERON:8450001.def: an individual reproductive unit containing a single oocyte and one or several layers of support cells (armstrong et al., 2020).

UBERON:8450002.name: excretory system
UBERON:8450002.def: an anatomical system that eliminates waste products that arise as a result of metabolic activity.

UBERON:8470001.name: sublumbar lymph node
UBERON:8470001.def: a lymph node with a lymph center located within the caudal abdomen and pelvis, on the ventral side of the lumbar region. includes the medial iliac, internal iliac (previously termed hypogastric) and sacral lymph nodes.

UBERON:8470002.name: moderator band
UBERON:8470002.def: a muscular trabecula in the right ventricle of the heart that connects the interventricular septum to the anterior wall and to the base of the anterior papillary muscle of the right ventricle.

UBERON:8480000.name: iliac vein smooth muscle tissue
UBERON:8480000.def: a portion of smooth muscle tissue that is part of an iliac vein.

UBERON:8480001.name: capillary of brain
UBERON:8480001.def: a capillary that is part of the brain.

UBERON:8480002.name: thoracic aorta smooth muscle tissue
UBERON:8480002.def: a portion of smooth muscle tissue that is part of the thoracic aorta.

UBERON:8480003.name: iliac artery smooth muscle tissue
UBERON:8480003.def: a portion of smooth muscle tissue that is part of an iliac artery.

UBERON:8480004.name: iliac vein endothelium
UBERON:8480004.def: an endothelium that is part of an iliac vein.

UBERON:8480005.name: placental artery endothelium
UBERON:8480005.def: an endothelium that is part of the placental artery.

UBERON:8480006.name: mesenteric lymphatic vessel
UBERON:8480006.def: lymphatic vessel that is part of the mesentery.

UBERON:8480007.name: placental artery
UBERON:8480007.def: an artery that is part of the placenta.

UBERON:8480008.name: placental vein
UBERON:8480008.def: a vein that is part of the placenta.

UBERON:8480009.name: tendon of semitendinosus
UBERON:8480009.def: a tendon that attaches to a semitendinosus.

UBERON:8480010.name: perianal space
UBERON:8480010.def: an anatomical space located at the level of the anal orifice that is continuous with the ischioanal space laterally and superiorly and extends into the space between the external and internal sphincters.

UBERON:8480011.name: deep post-anal space
UBERON:8480011.def: an anatomical space found at the front of the apex of the coccyx that is limited superiorly by the plate of the levator ani muscle and inferiorly by the anococcygeal raphe.

UBERON:8480012.name: intersphincteric space
UBERON:8480012.def: an anatomical space located between the internal and external anal sphincters that continues inferiorly into the perianal space and superiorly into the rectum wall.

UBERON:8480013.name: ischiorectal space
UBERON:8480013.def: an anatomical space that extends from the levator ani muscle to the perineum lateral to the anal canal.

UBERON:8480014.name: skin of buttock
UBERON:8480014.def: a zone of skin that is part of the buttock.

UBERON:8480015.name: supra levator space
UBERON:8480015.def: an anatomical space limited superiorly by the peritoneum, laterally by the pelvic wall, medially by the rectal wall, and inferiorly by the levator ani muscle.

UBERON:8480016.name: perirenal space
UBERON:8480016.def: a retroperitoneal space that lies between the anterior and posterior renal fascia; it is a paired inverted cone shaped of tissue containing the kidney, the proximal portion of the collecting system, renal and perirenal vasculature, perirenal lymphatics, adrenal glands and variable amount of fat.

UBERON:8480017.name: anterior pararenal space
UBERON:8480017.def: a space that is bounded anteriorly by the posterior parietal peritoneum, laterally by the lateroconal fascia and posteriorly by the anterior renal fascia; it contains the pancreatic gland, retroperitoneal segments of the duodenum, ascending and descending colon and the mesenteric root, as well as adipose tissue.

UBERON:8480018.name: posterior pararenal space
UBERON:8480018.def: a space that is bound anteriorly by the posterior renal fascia and posteriorly by the transversalis fascia, and it only contains adipose tissue, lymphatics and blood vessels.

UBERON:8480019.name: perirectal space
UBERON:8480019.def: an extraperitoneal space bounded laterally by the perirectal fascia, posteriorly by the posterior pelvic fascia, and anteriorly by the rectovesical fascia in the male and the rectovaginal fascia in the female.

UBERON:8480020.name: perivesical space
UBERON:8480020.def: an extraperitoneal space circumscribed by the umbilicovesical fascia anterior and laterally, and rectovaginal (in females) or rectovesical (in males) septum posteriorly, it encounters the urachus, obliterated umbilical vessels, urinary bladder and the lower uterine segment or seminal vesicles.

UBERON:8480021.name: prevesical space
UBERON:8480021.def: an extraperitoneal space anterior and lateral to the umbilicovesical fascia, and posterior to the trasversalis fascia. prevesical space laterally communicates with the properitoneal space of the abdominal wall and flanks; posteroinferiorly it surrounds the lateral walls of the urinary bladder, and anteroinferiorly it forms the retropubic space (the space of retzius).

UBERON:8480022.name: piriform sinus
UBERON:8480022.def: a recess on either side of the laryngeal orifice, which is bounded medially by the aryepiglottic fold, laterally by the thyroid cartilage and thyrohyoid membrane. the pyriform sinus is involved in speech.

UBERON:8480023.name: skin of lateral lumbar region of abdomen
UBERON:8480023.def: a zone of skin that is part of the lateral lumbar region of abdomen.

UBERON:8480024.name: skin of sacral region
UBERON:8480024.def: a zone of skin that is part of the sacral region.

UBERON:8480025.name: skin of clavicle region
UBERON:8480025.def: a zone of skin that is above the clavicle zone in the pectoral girdle region.

UBERON:8480026.name: skin of iliac crest region
UBERON:8480026.def: a zone of skin that is above the iliac crest in the pelvic girdle bone/zone.
UBERON:8480026.synonym: skin of posterior iliac crest region

UBERON:8480027.name: temple
UBERON:8480027.def: the region where the frontal, parietal, temporal, and sphenoid bones fuse.

UBERON:8480028.name: skin of temple
UBERON:8480028.def: a zone of skin that is part of the temple.

UBERON:8480029.name: skin of external genitalia
UBERON:8480029.def: a zone of skin that is part of the external genitalia.

UBERON:8480030.name: skin of breast
UBERON:8480030.def: a zone of skin that is part of the breast.

UBERON:8480033.name: interlobular stroma of mammary gland
UBERON:8480033.def: the interlobular stroma of the mammary gland lobule separates the lobules and intralobular stroma from any substantial direct contact with the adipose tissue. it is more compact than the intralobular stroma.

UBERON:8480034.name: intralobular stroma of mammary gland
UBERON:8480034.def: the intralobular stroma of the mammary gland lobule contains loosely connected fibroblasts. it is surrounded by the more compact interlobular stroma.

UBERON:8480035.name: cervical transformation zone epithelium
UBERON:8480035.def: the area of epithelium that lies between the native and unaffected columnar epithelium of the endocervical canal and the native squamous epithelium deriving from the vaginal and ectocervical squamous epithelium.

UBERON:8480036.name: posterior wall of the glottis
UBERON:8480036.def: part of the glottis most closely associated with the pharynx represented anatomically by the posterior union of the developing cricoid cartilage.

UBERON:8480037.name: subserosa of uterine tube
UBERON:8480037.def: subserosa that is part of the uterine tube. it contains loose connective tissue, blood vessels and lymphatic tissue.

UBERON:8480038.name: meningeal myeloid tissue
UBERON:8480038.def: lymphomyeloid tissue that consists mainly in granulopoietic cells but that also contains erythroid and lymphoid cells in different stages of maturation.

UBERON:8480039.name: oka organ
UBERON:8480039.def: organ involved in immune defense against foreign material.

UBERON:8480040.name: ovarian fluid
UBERON:8480040.def: fish ovary secretion released with eggs.

UBERON:8480041.name: testicular sheath
UBERON:8480041.def: bilayer sheath that covers both the insect male mature gonad and a portion of genital disc-derived structures. it is composed of an outer pigment cell layer, an inner muscle cell layer, and their respective basal laminae.

UBERON:8480042.name: menstrual fluid
UBERON:8480042.def: fluid that consists of necrotic and shed endometrial tissue and blood from mucosal vessels discharged during the reproductive years approximately once a month.

UBERON:8480043.name: pelvic wall
UBERON:8480043.def: the tissues that surround the organs that are present within the pelvic region of the trunk. the walls of the pelvis are formed by bones and ligaments that are partly lined with muscles covered with fascia and parietal peritoneum.

UBERON:8480044.name: long bone cartilage element
UBERON:8480044.def: a skeletal element that is part of a long bone and composed of cartilage tissue.

UBERON:8480045.name: subiliac lymph node
UBERON:8480045.def: a lymph node located inferior to the ilium.

UBERON:8480046.name: mucosa of rumen
UBERON:8480046.def: the mucosa of rumen is composed of a keratinised stratified squamous epithelium, is rich in mucopolysaccharides and is characterized by the presence of parakeratotis.

UBERON:8480047.name: retroauricular region
UBERON:8480047.def: the retroauricular region is the area located behind the auricle of the outer ear.

UBERON:8480048.name: calf
UBERON:8480048.def: the posterior aspect of the lower extremity that extends from the knee to the foot.

UBERON:8480049.name: front hindlimb zeugopod
UBERON:8480049.def: the frontal aspect of the lower extremity that extends from the knee to the foot.

UBERON:8480050.name: skin of calf
UBERON:8480050.def: skin of the back of the lower leg.
UBERON:8480050.synonym: skin of posterior part of leg

UBERON:8480051.name: thoracolumbar junction
UBERON:8480051.def: area of transition between the posterior curvature of the thoracic spine and the anterior curvature of the lumbar spine.

UBERON:8480052.name: skin of thoracolumbar junction
UBERON:8480052.def: a zone of skin that is part of the thoracolumbar junction.

UBERON:8480053.name: skin of umbilical area
UBERON:8480053.def: a zone of skin that is part of the umbilicus and the periumbilical region.

UBERON:8480054.name: ileocecal lymph node
UBERON:8480054.def: mesenteric lymph node embedded in the ileocecal fold at both sides of the concavity of the cecum. it drains the terminal ileum.

UBERON:8480055.name: subcarinal lymph node
UBERON:8480055.def: superior mediastinal lymph node located in the thoracic cavity between the lungs. it is bordered by the carina of the trachea, the lower lobe bronchus on the left and the intermediate bronchus on the right.

UBERON:8480056.name: left supraclavicular lymph node
UBERON:8480056.def: supraclavicular lymph node located on the left side of a entire appendicular skeleton. the left supraclavicular lymph node drains the kidney, cervix, testis, and pancreas into the thoracic duct.

UBERON:8480057.name: right supraclavicular lymph node
UBERON:8480057.def: supraclavicular lymph node located on the right side of a entire appendicular skeleton. the right supraclavicular lymph node drains the breast, lung and upper esophagus into the right lymphatic duct.

UBERON:8480058.name: virchow's lymph node
UBERON:8480058.def: lymph node that is the most proximal of the left supraclavicular lymph nodes. it receives afferent lymphatic drainage from the left head, neck, chest, abdomen, pelvis, and bilateral lower extremities, and drains into the jugulo-subclavian venous junction via the thoracic duct.

UBERON:8480059.name: perigastric lymph node
UBERON:8480059.def: lymph node located in the perigastric region.

UBERON:8480060.name: paraspinal region
UBERON:8480060.def: the region of the body adjacent to the vertebral column.

UBERON:8480061.name: pericardial region
UBERON:8480061.def: the region of the body adjacent to the pericardium and heart.

UBERON:8480062.name: femoral head cartilage
UBERON:8480062.def: a hyaline articular cartilage that covers the head of femur. provides cushioning, softness and low friction for the hip joint.

UBERON:8480063.name: dorsal iris
UBERON:8480063.def: the dorsal part of the iris. in urodeles (newts and salamanders) the dorsal iris is involved in lens regeneration in a process named wolffian lens regeneration.

UBERON:8480065.name: labial gland
UBERON:8480065.def: the labial gland is one of the minor salivary glands, located mainly under the mucosal epithelium of the upper and lower lip and within the orbicularis oris muscle fibers. the labial gland secrete mucous and serous substances to maintain oral health. in particular, the inferior labial gland not only promotes moisturization in the oral cavity but also secretes substances with antibacterial effects.

UBERON:8480066.name: interscapular region
UBERON:8480066.def: the region in the upper part of the back between the shoulder blades.

UBERON:8480067.name: bone marrow microvessel
UBERON:8480067.def: microvessel located in the bone marrow, including arterioles and sinusoids.

UBERON:8490000.def: a upper third secondary molar tooth that is in the right side of the upper jaw region.

UBERON:8500000.name: cranial temporal line
UBERON:8500000.def: a dorsally concave, laterally-directed line on either side of the skull that runs along the temporal fossa, starting from above the zygomatico-frontal suture. it bounds the anterodorsal part of the temporal fossa and its the attachment site to the temporalis muscle.

UBERON:8500001.name: euryon
UBERON:8500001.def: an anatomical point on the most lateral point of the neurocranium.

UBERON:8500002.name: supraorbital foramen
UBERON:8500002.def: a bony elongated opening located above the orbit and under the forehead.

UBERON:8500003.name: supraorbitale
UBERON:8500003.def: an anatomical point on the median point of the line joining the aboral borders of the supraorbital foramen.

UBERON:8500004.name: entorbitale
UBERON:8500004.def: an anatomical point on the naso-medial indentation of the orbit that corresponds with the inner angle of the eye in the living animal.

UBERON:8600000.name: lobular bronchiole
UBERON:8600000.def: a conductive airway that branches into terminal bronchioles.

UBERON:8600001.name: epithelium of lobular bronchiole
UBERON:8600001.def: an epithelium of the lobular bronchiole.

UBERON:8600002.name: mucosa of lobular bronchiole
UBERON:8600002.def: a mucosa that is part of a lobular bronchiole.

UBERON:8600003.name: smooth muscle tissue of lobular bronchiole
UBERON:8600003.def: a smooth muscle tissue that is part of a lobular bronchiole.

UBERON:8600004.name: visceral muscle tissue
UBERON:8600004.def: a muscle tissue that is associated with soft internal organs (viscera).

UBERON:8600005.name: visceral smooth muscle tissue
UBERON:8600005.def: a smooth muscle tissue that is associated with soft internal organs (viscera).

UBERON:8600006.name: visceral striated muscle tissue
UBERON:8600006.def: a striated muscle tissue that is associated with soft internal organs (viscera).

UBERON:8600007.name: visceral transversely striated muscle tissue
UBERON:8600007.def: a striated visceral muscle tissue that has a transverse striation.

UBERON:8600008.name: visceral obliquely striated muscle tissue
UBERON:8600008.def: a striated visceral muscle tissue that has an oblique striation.

UBERON:8600009.name: subsegmental bronchus
UBERON:8600009.def: branch of conducting airway between a segmental bronchus and a preterminal bronchiole.

UBERON:8600010.name: bronchial submucosal gland ciliated duct
UBERON:8600010.def: a ciliated duct part of a bronchial submucosal gland.

UBERON:8600011.name: tracheal submucosal gland ciliated duct
UBERON:8600011.def: a ciliated duct part of a tracheal submucosal gland.

UBERON:8600012.name: submucosal gland acinus
UBERON:8600012.def: a spherical or tubular structure in a submucosal gland that produces and secretes mucus and other substances into the ducts leading to the surface epithelium.

UBERON:8600013.name: submucosal gland collecting duct
UBERON:8600013.def: a non-secretory tubular structure in the submucosal gland where secretions are collected before flowing towards the surface epithelium.

UBERON:8600014.name: submucosal gland ciliated duct
UBERON:8600014.def: a ciliated tubular structure in a submucosal gland connecting the submucosal gland collecting duct with the surface epithelium.

UBERON:8600015.name: posterior sector of right lobe of liver
UBERON:8600015.def: the posterior sector of the right lobe of the liver.

UBERON:8600016.name: anterior sector of right lobe of liver
UBERON:8600016.def: the anterior sector of the right lobe of the liver.

UBERON:8600017.name: bronchopulmonary segment
UBERON:8600017.def: a discrete anatomical unit of the lung that is composed of a segmental bronchus and the lung tissue supplied by that bronchus. a bronchopulmonary segment exhibits a pyramidal shape, with its apex pointing towards the center of the lung and its base toward the pleural surface.

MONDO:0000001.name: disease
MONDO:0000001.def: a disease is a disposition to undergo pathological processes that exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

MONDO:0000004.name: adrenocortical insufficiency
MONDO:0000004.def: an endocrine or hormonal disorder that occurs when the adrenal cortex does not produce enough of the hormone cortisol and in some cases, the hormone aldosterone. it may be due to a disorder of the adrenal cortex (addison's disease or primary adrenal insufficiency) or to inadequate secretion of acth by the pituitary gland (secondary adrenal insufficiency).

MONDO:0000015.name: classic complement early component deficiency
MONDO:0000015.def: a genetic deficiency of any early component of the classical pathway (c1q, c1r/s, c2, c4, and c3) that is associated with autoimmune diseases due to the failure of clearance of immune complexes (ic) and apoptotic materials, and the impairment of normal humoral response.
MONDO:0000015.synonym: genetic deficiency of early component of the classical complement pathway

MONDO:0000041.name: obsolete hyperphosphatasia with mental retardation syndrome

MONDO:0000044.name: hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets
MONDO:0000044.def: hypophosphatemic rickets is a group of genetic diseases characterized by hypophosphatemia, rickets, and normal serum levels of calcium.

MONDO:0000049.name: obsolete invasive pneumococcal disease, recurrent isolated

MONDO:0000062.name: isolated microphthalmia
MONDO:0000062.def: a microphthalmia that is not part of a larger syndrome.

MONDO:0000074.name: obsolete neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation

MONDO:0000076.name: obsolete neuropathy, hereditary sensory and autonomic

MONDO:0000078.name: acrocephalopolysyndactyly
MONDO:0000078.def: a common presentation of craniosynostosis and polysyndactyly.

MONDO:0000082.name: pelvic organ prolapse
MONDO:0000082.def: abnormal descent of a pelvic organ resulting in the protrusion of the organ beyond its normal anatomical confines. symptoms often include vaginal discomfort, dyspareunia; urinary stress incontinence; and fecal incontinence.

MONDO:0000087.name: polymicrogyria
MONDO:0000087.def: a developmental brain abnormality characterized by an excessive amount of small convolutions on the surface of the brain and cognitive dysfunction.

MONDO:0000090.name: progressive external ophthalmoplegia with mitochondrial dna deletions
MONDO:0000090.synonym: progressive external ophthalmoplegia with mtdna deletions

MONDO:0000104.name: anemia, hypochromic microcytic with iron overload
MONDO:0000104.synonym: anemia, hypochromic microcytic, with iron overload

MONDO:0000107.name: auriculocondylar syndrome
MONDO:0000107.def: auriculo-condylar syndrome (acs) presents with bilateral external ear malformations ('question mark' ears), mandibular condyle hypoplasia, microstomia, micrognathia, microglossia and facial asymmetry. additional manifestations include hypotonia, ptosis, cleft palate, puffy cheeks, developmental delay, impaired hearing and respiratory distress.

MONDO:0000110.name: bifid nose
MONDO:0000110.def: bifid nose is a rare congenital malformation of presumed autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance characterized by clefting of the nose ranging from a minimally noticeable groove in the columella to complete clefting of the underlying bones and cartilage (resulting in two half noses) with a usually adequate airway. bifid nose may be seen in frontonasal dysplasia while other malformations such as hypertelorbitism and midline clefts of the lip may also be associated.

MONDO:0000113.name: obsolete cerebellar ataxia, mental retardation, and dysequilibrium syndrome

MONDO:0000115.name: chiari malformation
MONDO:0000115.def: a rare genetic brain malformation characterized by displacement of the brain stem and cerebellum through the foramen magnum. it may result in hydrocephalus.

MONDO:0000116.name: obsolete cortical dysplasia, complex, with other brain malformations

MONDO:0000123.name: obsolete factor v and factor viii, combined deficiency of

MONDO:0000127.name: geleophysic dysplasia
MONDO:0000127.def: geleophysic dysplasia is a rare skeletal dysplasia characterized by short stature, prominent abnormalities in hands and feet, and a characteristic facial appearance (described as \"happy'').

MONDO:0000128.name: giant axonal neuropathy
MONDO:0000128.def: a rare inherited disorder affecting the neurofilaments. it is caused by mutations in the gan gene. it is characterized by the presence of abnormally large nerve cell axons. signs and symptoms include difficulty walking, sensory disturbances, lack of motor coordination and abnormal reflexes in the limbs.

MONDO:0000130.name: obsolete hypercarotenemia and vitamin a deficiency

MONDO:0000133.name: immunodeficiency-centromeric instability-facial anomalies syndrome
MONDO:0000133.def: the immunodeficiency, centromeric region instability, facial anomalies syndrome (icf) is a rare autosomal recessive disease characterized by immunodeficiency, although b cells are present, and by characteristic rearrangements in the vicinity of the centromeres (the juxtacentromeric heterochromatin) of chromosomes 1 and 16 and sometimes 9.

MONDO:0000134.name: obsolete inclusion body myopathy with early-onset paget disease with or without frontotemporal dementia

MONDO:0000136.name: keratosis follicularis spinulosa decalvans
MONDO:0000136.def: keratosis follicularis spinulosa decalvans is a rare genodermatosis occurring during infancy or childhood, predominantly affecting males, and characterized by diffuse follicular hyperkeratosis associated with progressive cicatricial alopecia of the scalp, eyebrows and eyelashes. additional findings can include photophobia, corneal dystrophy, facial erythema, and/or palmoplantar keratoderma.

MONDO:0000141.name: mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome
MONDO:0000141.def: mosaic variegated aneuploidy (mva) syndrome is a chromosomal anomaly characterized by multiple mosaic aneuploidies that leads to a variety of phenotypic abnormalities and cancer predisposition.

MONDO:0000148.name: pulmonary fibrosis and/or bone marrow failure, telomere-related

MONDO:0000153.name: transposition of the great arteries
MONDO:0000153.def: a congenital cardiac defect in which two heart vessels are reversed (transposed).

MONDO:0000155.name: triglyceride storage disease
MONDO:0000155.def: an inherited metabolic disease that is has its basis in the disruption of sequestering of triglyceride.
MONDO:0000155.synonym: rare inborn error of sequestering of triglyceride

MONDO:0000158.name: developmental dysplasia of the hip
MONDO:0000158.def: a spectrum of hip abnormalities commonly presenting in infancy involving the relationship between the femoral head and the acetabulum and that includes subluxation or dislocation at rest or upon provocation.

MONDO:0000163.name: obsolete breast-ovarian cancer, familial, susceptibility to

MONDO:0000167.name: huntington disease and related disorders
MONDO:0000167.def: a grouping for huntington disease and similar diseases.

MONDO:0000170.name: microphthalmia, isolated, with coloboma
MONDO:0000170.def: a developmental disorder of the eye characterized by unilateral or bilateral microphthalmia associated with ocular coloboma.

MONDO:0000174.name: obsolete split-hand/foot malformation with long bone deficiency

MONDO:0000178.name: obsolete breasts and/or nipples, aplasia or hypoplasia of

MONDO:0000179.name: neu-laxova syndrome
MONDO:0000179.def: neu-laxova syndrome (nls) is a rare, multiple malformation syndrome characterized by severe intrauterine growth retardation (iugr), severe microcephaly with a sloping forehead, severe ichthyosis (collodion baby type), and facial dysmorphism.

MONDO:0000180.name: obsolete inflammatory skin and bowel disease, neonatal

MONDO:0000182.name: congenital myasthenic syndrome with tubular aggregates
MONDO:0000182.def: a congenital myasthenic syndrome with a finding of tubular aggregates in myofibers.
MONDO:0000182.synonym: myasthenic syndrome, congenital, with tubular aggregates

MONDO:0000184.name: obsolete congenital vitamin k-dependent coagulation factors combined deficiency

MONDO:0000186.name: obsolete spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia with joint laxity

MONDO:0000187.name: obsolete ectrodactyly, ectodermal dysplasia, and cleft lip/palate syndrome

MONDO:0000188.name: glut1 deficiency syndrome
MONDO:0000188.def: an epileptic encephalopathy resulting from impaired glucose transport into the brain.

MONDO:0000190.name: ventricular fibrillation
MONDO:0000190.def: a disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of a rapid grossly irregular ventricular rhythm with marked variability in qrs cycle length, morphology, and amplitude. the rate is typically greater than 300 bpm. (cdisc)

MONDO:0000193.name: cortisone reductase deficiency
MONDO:0000193.def: a disorder in which there is a failure to regenerate the active glucocorticoid cortisol from cortisone via 11beta-hsd1. the resulting lack of cortisol regeneration stimulates acth-mediated adrenal hyperandrogenism, with males manifesting in childhood with precocious pseudopuberty and females presenting in adolescence and early adulthood with hirsutism, oligoamenorrhea, and infertility.
MONDO:0000193.synonym: hyperandrogenism due to cortisone reductase deficiency

MONDO:0000198.name: obsolete linear skin defects with multiple congenital anomalies

MONDO:0000200.name: zimmermann-laband syndrome
MONDO:0000200.def: zimmermann-laband syndrome (zls) is a rare disorder characterized by gingival fibromatosis, coarse facial appearance, and absence or hypoplasia of nails or terminal phalanges of hands and feet.

MONDO:0000204.name: obsolete skin creases, congenital symmetric circumferential

MONDO:0000205.name: obsolete radioulnar synostosis with amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia

MONDO:0000206.name: obsolete cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal dominant, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy
MONDO:0000206.synonym: obsolete cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal dominant, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy; cadasil

MONDO:0000207.name: obsolete hypotonia, infantile, with psychomotor retardation and characteristic facies

MONDO:0000208.name: microcephaly, short stature, and impaired glucose metabolism 1

MONDO:0000209.name: prenatal-onset spinal muscular atrophy with congenital bone fractures
MONDO:0000209.synonym: spinal muscular atrophy with congenital bone fractures

MONDO:0000211.name: striatal degeneration, autosomal dominant
MONDO:0000211.def: an adult-onset movement disorder characterized by bradykinesia, dysarthria and muscle rigidity.

MONDO:0000212.name: hypercalcemia, infantile
MONDO:0000212.def: a hypercalcemia disease that occurs between 28 days to one year of life.

MONDO:0000215.name: obsolete epilepsy, familial focal, with variable foci

MONDO:0000216.name: obsolete congenital bilateral aplasia of vas deferens

MONDO:0000221.name: obsolete cerebroretinal microangiopathy with calcifications and cysts

MONDO:0000222.name: seminal vesicle acute gonorrhea
MONDO:0000222.def: acute form of gonococcal seminal vesiculitis.

MONDO:0000224.name: acquired carbohydrate metabolism disease
MONDO:0000224.def: an acquired metabolic disease that is has its basis in the disruption of carbohydrate metabolism.

MONDO:0000225.name: human monocytic ehrlichiosis
MONDO:0000225.def: a form of ehrlichiosis associated with ehrlichia chaffeensis, an obligate intracellular pathogen affecting monocytes and macrophages.
MONDO:0000225.synonym: human ehrlichiosis due to ehrlichia chaffeensis

MONDO:0000229.name: indian tick typhus
MONDO:0000229.def: an infectious disease caused by infection with rickettsia conorii subsp. coronorii.

MONDO:0000230.name: israeli tick typhus
MONDO:0000230.def: an infectious disease caused by infection with rickettsia conorii subsp. israelensis.

MONDO:0000232.name: flinders island spotted fever
