MONDO:0000797.name: obsolete goat milk allergy
MONDO:0000797.def: obsolete. a allergy involving goat milk.
MONDO:0000797.synonym: goat dairy food product allergic disease

MONDO:0000798.name: obsolete mollusc allergy
MONDO:0000798.def: obsolete. a allergic disease involving a mollusc food product.

MONDO:0000799.name: obsolete crustacean allergy
MONDO:0000799.def: obsolete. a allergic disease involving a crustacean food product.

MONDO:0000800.name: obsolete brown shrimp allergy
MONDO:0000800.def: obsolete. a allergic disease involving a brown shrimp.

MONDO:0000801.name: obsolete green mud crab allergy
MONDO:0000801.def: obsolete. a allergic disease involving a green mud crab.

MONDO:0000802.name: obsolete indian prawn allergy
MONDO:0000802.def: obsolete. a allergic disease involving a indian prawn.

MONDO:0000803.name: obsolete tiger prawn allergy
MONDO:0000803.def: obsolete. a allergy involving a penaeus monodon.

MONDO:0000804.name: obsolete white shrimp allergy
MONDO:0000804.def: obsolete. a allergy involving a litopenaeus schmitti.

MONDO:0000805.name: obsolete snail allergy
MONDO:0000805.def: obsolete. a allergic disease involving a snail food product.

MONDO:0000806.name: obsolete horned turban snail allergy
MONDO:0000806.def: obsolete. a allergy involving a turbo cornutus.

MONDO:0000807.name: latex allergy
MONDO:0000807.def: allergic reaction to products containing processed natural rubber latex such as rubber gloves, condoms, catheters, dental dams, balloons, and sporting equipment. both t-cell mediated (hypersensitivity, delayed) and ige antibody-mediated (hypersensitivity, immediate) allergic responses are possible. delayed hypersensitivity results from exposure to antioxidants present in the rubber; immediate hypersensitivity results from exposure to a latex protein.

MONDO:0000809.name: purpura fulminans
MONDO:0000809.def: a severe, rapidly fatal reaction occurring most commonly in children following an infectious illness. it is characterized by large, rapidly spreading skin hemorrhages, fever, or shock. purpura fulminans often accompanies or is triggered by disseminated intravascular coagulation.

MONDO:0000810.name: obsolete dmd-related dilated cardiomyopathy
MONDO:0000810.def: obsolete. a dilated cardiomyopathy that has material basis in mutations in the dmd gene.

MONDO:0000811.name: anomalous left coronary artery from the pulmonary artery
MONDO:0000811.def: a congenital coronary vessel anomaly in which the left main coronary artery originates from the pulmonary artery instead of from aorta. the congenital heart defect typically results in coronary artery fistula; left-sided heart failure and mitral valve insufficiency during the first months of life.

MONDO:0000812.name: vertebral column disorder
MONDO:0000812.def: a disease involving the vertebral column.

MONDO:0000813.name: cardiac tuberculosis
MONDO:0000813.def: pathological conditions of the cardiovascular system caused by infection of mycobacterium tuberculosis. tuberculosis involvement may include the heart; the blood vessels; or the pericardium.

MONDO:0000814.name: b-cell adult acute lymphocytic leukemia
MONDO:0000814.def: an acute b-lymphoblastic leukemia occurring in adults.
MONDO:0000814.synonym: b-cell childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia of adults

MONDO:0000815.name: fetal nicotine spectrum disorder
MONDO:0000815.def: a specific developmental disorder that is characterized by physical, behavioral and learning birth defects resulting from maternal ingestion of nicotine during pregnancy.

MONDO:0000819.name: anencephaly
MONDO:0000819.def: a rare neural tube defect during pregnancy, resulting in the absence of a large portion of the brain and skull in the fetus.

MONDO:0000820.name: cerebral cavernous malformation
MONDO:0000820.def: a disorder characterized by malformations in the structure of the capillaries in the brain. it is caused by mutations in the ccm2, krit1 and pdcd10 genes. the capillaries fill with blood and stretch, thereby creating cavernous spaces. some patients experience headaches, seizures, or visual and hearing disturbances. cerebral hemorrhage may also occur.

MONDO:0000826.name: obsolete syndromic x-linked intellectual disability cabezas type

MONDO:0000827.name: salmonellosis
MONDO:0000827.def: infections with bacteria of the genus salmonella.

MONDO:0000831.name: thrombotic disease
MONDO:0000831.def: the formation of a blood clot in the lumen of a vessel or heart chamber; causes include coagulation disorders and vascular endothelial injury.

MONDO:0000833.name: bone remodeling disease
MONDO:0000833.def: a bone disease that results in formation or resorption abnormalities located in bone.

MONDO:0000834.name: obsolete bone deterioration disease
MONDO:0000834.def: obsolete. a bone structure disease that results in change or damage of structure located in bone.

MONDO:0000837.name: bone resorption disease
MONDO:0000837.def: a disease that has its basis in the disruption of bone resorption. bone resorption is a process in which specialized cells known as osteoclasts degrade the organic and inorganic portions of bone, and endocytose and transport the degradation products.

MONDO:0000839.name: obsolete congenital abnormality
MONDO:0000839.def: obsolete. any abnormality, anatomical or biochemical, evident at birth or during the neonatal period.

MONDO:0000840.name: dysbaric osteonecrosis
MONDO:0000840.def: a form of avascular necrosis where there is death of a portion of the bone that is thought to be caused by nitrogen embolism.

MONDO:0000845.name: fibrous dysplasia
MONDO:0000845.def: a genetic, non-inheritable disorder caused by osteoblastic differentiation defects that result in the replacement of bone marrow and trabecular bone by fibrous stroma and immature bone. it usually affects a single bone and less frequently multiple bones. skull, femur, tibia, and humerus are the most frequently affected bones. it manifests with pain, deformities, and fractures.

MONDO:0000849.name: fibrogenesis imperfecta ossium
MONDO:0000849.def: a syndrome that involves abnormality of collagen synthesis in lamellar bones, with manifestations limited to the skeleton. the initial symptom is frequently spontaneous fractures.

MONDO:0000857.name: obsolete charcot-marie-tooth disease type 7
MONDO:0000857.def: obsolete. a charcot-marie-tooth disease that is characterized by optic atrophy followed by retinitis pigmentosa.

MONDO:0000859.name: spina bifida occulta
MONDO:0000859.def: the mildest form of spina bifida, characterized by any of several neural tube defects which may go undetected until an x-ray is performed. treatment is symptomatic.

MONDO:0000863.name: myopathy, lactic acidosis, and sideroblastic anemia
MONDO:0000863.def: mitochondrial myopathy and sideroblastic anemia belongs to the heterogeneous family of metabolic myopathies. it is characterized by progressive exercise intolerance manifesting in childhood, onset of sideroblastic anemia around adolescence, lactic acidaemia, and mitochondrial myopathy.

MONDO:0000869.name: obsolete congenital fibrosis of the extraocular muscles

MONDO:0000870.name: childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia
MONDO:0000870.def: an acute lymphoblastic leukemia occurring during childhood. the majority of cases are b-acute lymphoblastic leukemias. approximately 15% of the cases are t-acute lymphoblastic leukemias.

MONDO:0000871.name: t-cell childhood acute lymphocytic leukemia
MONDO:0000871.def: an acute lymphoblastic leukemia of t-cell origin occurring in children.

MONDO:0000872.name: b-cell childhood acute lymphoblastic leukemia
MONDO:0000872.def: an acute b-lymphoblastic leukemia occurring in children.

MONDO:0000873.name: lymphoblastic lymphoma
MONDO:0000873.def: a lymphoma composed of immature small to medium-sized precursor lymphoid cells (lymphoblasts). it includes the b- and t-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma.

MONDO:0000874.name: t-cell childhood lymphoblastic lymphoma
MONDO:0000874.def: a t lymphoblastic lymphoma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0000875.name: adult acute monocytic leukemia
MONDO:0000875.def: a acute monocytic leukemia that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0000878.name: cytomegalovirus retinitis
MONDO:0000878.def: infection of the retina by cytomegalovirus characterized by retinal necrosis, hemorrhage, vessel sheathing, and retinal edema. cytomegalovirus retinitis is a major opportunistic infection in aids patients and can cause blindness.

MONDO:0000879.name: cutaneous candidiasis
MONDO:0000879.def: candidiasis of the skin manifested as eczema-like lesions of the interdigital spaces, perleche, or chronic paronychia. (dorland, 27th ed)

MONDO:0000881.name: obsolete myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms with eosinophilia and abnormalities of pdgfra, pdgfrb, and fgfr1

MONDO:0000882.name: obsolete myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms associated with pdgfra rearrangement

MONDO:0000883.name: obsolete myeloid neoplasms associated with pdgfrb rearrangement

MONDO:0000884.name: myeloid and lymphoid neoplasms associated with fgfr1 abnormalities

MONDO:0000888.name: gastrointestinal mucositis
MONDO:0000888.def: inflammation of the mucous membranes lining the gastrointestinal tract.

MONDO:0000889.name: haemophilus meningitis
MONDO:0000889.def: infections of the nervous system caused by bacteria of the genus haemophilus, and marked by prominent inflammation of the meninges. haemophilus influenzae type b is the most common causative organism. the condition primarily affects children under 6 years of age but may occur in adults.

MONDO:0000890.name: zika virus congenital syndrome
MONDO:0000890.def: a congenital birth syndrome that arises from materal zika infection.

MONDO:0000891.name: mixed fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma
MONDO:0000891.def: a fibrolamellar carcinoma that is characterized by the presence of both pure fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma and and conventional hepatocellular carcinoma components.

MONDO:0000892.name: colon medullary carcinoma
MONDO:0000892.def: a rare, invasive colon adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of sheets of malignant epithelial cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. it usually has a favorable prognosis.

MONDO:0000893.name: mixed mucinous and nonmucinous bronchioloalveolar adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0000893.def: a rare morphologic variant of bronchiolo-alveolar lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of both mucin and non-mucin producing cells.
MONDO:0000893.synonym: mixed mucinous and non-mucinous bronchoalveolar lung carcinoma

MONDO:0000894.name: mucinous bronchioloalveolar adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0000894.def: a bronchiolo-alveolar adenocarcinoma that is characterized by a tumor cells containing abundant mucin in their cytoplasm and composed of tall columnar cells growing along alveolar walls without stromal invasion.

MONDO:0000895.name: nonmucinous bronchioloalveolar adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0000895.def: a bronchiolo-alveolar adenocarcinoma that is characterized by cells with cuboidal or columnar morphology with eosinophilic or clear cytoplasm and shows clara cell or type 2 pneumocyte differentiation.

MONDO:0000901.name: relapsed/refractory diffuse large b-cell lymphoma
MONDO:0000901.def: a diffuse large b-cell lymphoma characterized by less than 50 percent decrease in lesion size with induction therapy or the appearance of new lesions or the appearance of new lesions after attainment of complete remission.

MONDO:0000902.name: agenesis of the corpus callosum with peripheral neuropathy
MONDO:0000902.def: corpus callosum agenesis-neuropathy is a neurodegenerative disorder characterized by severe progressive sensorimotor neuropathy beginning in infancy with resulting hypotonia, areflexia, amyotrophy and variable degrees of dysgenesis of the corpus callosum. additional features include mild-to-severe intellectual and developmental delays, and psychiatric manifestations that include paranoid delusions, depression, hallucinations, and \"autistic-like\
MONDO:0000902.synonym: polyneuropathy, sensorimotor, with or without agenesis of the corpus callosum

MONDO:0000903.name: myoclonus-dystonia syndrome
MONDO:0000903.def: myoclonus-dystonia syndrome (mds) is a rare movement disorder characterized by mild to moderate dystonia along with 'lightning-like' myoclonic jerks.

MONDO:0000904.name: complex cortical dysplasia with other brain malformations
MONDO:0000904.synonym: cortical dysplasia, complex, with other brain malformations

MONDO:0000908.name: arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia 13
MONDO:0000908.def: any arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ctnna3 gene.

MONDO:0000909.name: bartter disease type 4b
MONDO:0000909.def: a bartter disease that has material basis in simultaneous mutation in both the clcnka and clcnkb genes.
MONDO:0000909.synonym: neonatal bartter syndrome type 4b with sensorineural deafness

MONDO:0000910.name: retinitis pigmentosa 6
MONDO:0000910.def: a retinitis pigmentosa that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region xp21.3-p21.2.

MONDO:0000911.name: obsolete dilated cardiomyopathy 1t
MONDO:0000911.def: obsolete. any familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tmpo gene.

MONDO:0000912.name: autosomal recessive nonsyndromic hearing loss 5
MONDO:0000912.def: an autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 14q12.

MONDO:0000913.name: hereditary spherocytosis type 2
MONDO:0000913.def: any hereditary spherocytosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the sptb gene.

MONDO:0000914.name: cerebral arteriopathy, autosomal dominant, with subcortical infarcts and leukoencephalopathy, type 1
MONDO:0000914.def: a cadasil characterized by migraine, strokes, and white matter lesions that has material basis in heterozygous mutation in the notch3 gene on chromosome 19p13.

MONDO:0000916.name: intestinal infectious disease
MONDO:0000916.def: an infectious disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the intestinal mucosa.

MONDO:0000918.name: endometritis
MONDO:0000918.def: an acute or chronic, usually bacterial infectious process affecting the endometrium. it may extend to the myometrium and parametrial tissues. symptoms include lower abdominal pain, vaginal discharge, and vaginal bleeding.

MONDO:0000919.name: ampulla of vater cancer
MONDO:0000919.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the ampulla of vater.
MONDO:0000919.synonym: malignant tumour of the ampulla of vater

MONDO:0000920.name: duodenum cancer
MONDO:0000920.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the duodenum. representative examples include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

MONDO:0000921.name: ampulla of vater neoplasm
MONDO:0000921.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm involving the ampulla of vater.
MONDO:0000921.synonym: tumour of the ampulla of vater

MONDO:0000922.name: pelvic inflammatory disease
MONDO:0000922.def: pelvic inflammatory disease (pid) is an acute or chronic inflammation in the pelvic cavity. it is most commonly caused by sexually transmitted diseases, including chlamydia and gonorrhea that have ascended into the uterus, fallopian tubes, or ovaries as a result of intercourse or childbirth, or of surgical procedures, including insertion of iuds or abortion. pid may be either symptomatic or asymptomatic. it may cause infertility and it may raise the risk of ectopic pregnancy. pid is a disease associated with hiv infection.

MONDO:0000923.name: interstitial emphysema
MONDO:0000923.def: pathologic accumulation of air in the interstitium of the lungs, which is caused by the rupture of alveoli and terminal bronchioles, and is most often seen in premature infants that need mechanical ventilation for respiratory distress syndrome.

MONDO:0000925.name: hyperlucent lung
MONDO:0000925.def: a lung with reduced markings on its chest radiograph and increased areas of transradiancy (hyperlucency). a hyperlucent lung is usually associated with pulmonary emphysema or pneumothorax.

MONDO:0000926.name: eye accommodation disease
MONDO:0000926.def: disease that disrupts the process by which the vertebrate eye changes optical power to maintain a clear image or focus on an object as its distance varies.

MONDO:0000928.name: eyelid melanoma
MONDO:0000928.def: a melanoma that arises from the upper or lower eyelid.

MONDO:0000929.name: balloon cell malignant melanoma
MONDO:0000929.def: a rare variant of melanoma with a vertical growth phase. it presents as a nodular or polypoid skin lesion. it is characterized by the presence of nodules which contain large melanoma cells with clear, foamy or finely vacuolated cytoplasm. the prognosis is similar to that of other melanomas matched for depth of invasion.

MONDO:0000930.name: nodular malignant melanoma
MONDO:0000930.def: an aggressive form of melanoma, frequently metastasizing to the lymph nodes. it presents as a papular or nodular raised skin lesion. it comprises approximately 10-15% of melanomas. morphologically, it often displays an epithelioid appearance.

MONDO:0000931.name: endometrial disorder
MONDO:0000931.def: a non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the endometrium. representative examples include endometritis, endometrial hyperplasia, and endometrial carcinoma.

MONDO:0000933.name: subglottis neoplasm
MONDO:0000933.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the subglottic area of the larynx.

MONDO:0000934.name: laryngeal leiomyoma
MONDO:0000934.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the larynx. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0000935.name: larynx squamous papilloma
MONDO:0000935.def: a benign exophytic neoplasm that arises from the larynx, usually the true vocal cords. it is related to human papillomavirus infection and may arise as a single or multiple lesions. it is characterized by the presence of a connective tissue core covered by stratified squamous epithelium. hoarseness is the presenting symptom. transformation to carcinoma is rare.

MONDO:0000936.name: syphilitic meningitis
MONDO:0000936.def: an infectious meningitis caused by infection with treponema.

MONDO:0000937.name: syphilitic encephalitis
MONDO:0000937.def: an encephalitis caused by infection with treponema.

MONDO:0000938.name: gastric leiomyoma
MONDO:0000938.def: a rare benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the wall of the stomach. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern. unlike gastrointestinal stromal tumors, gastric leiomyomas are by definition negative for cd34 and cd117 (c-kit).

MONDO:0000939.name: intracranial abscess
MONDO:0000939.def: an abscess that is located in the intracranial space.

MONDO:0000940.name: trypanosomiasis
MONDO:0000940.def: infection with protozoa of the genus trypanosoma.

MONDO:0000941.name: eyelid degenerative disorder
MONDO:0000941.def: a neurodegenerative disease that involves the eyelid.

MONDO:0000942.name: corneal disorder
MONDO:0000942.def: a non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the cornea. representative examples include keratitis, bullous keratopathy, and squamous cell carcinoma.

MONDO:0000945.name: venous insufficiency
MONDO:0000945.def: impaired venous blood flow or venous return (venous stasis), usually caused by inadequate venous valves. venous insufficiency often occurs in the legs, and is associated with edema and sometimes with venous stasis ulcers at the ankle.

MONDO:0000946.name: psychologic vaginismus
MONDO:0000946.def: involuntary spasm of the outer muscles of the vagina during penetration that results from a psychological cause.

MONDO:0000948.name: xerophthalmia
MONDO:0000948.def: dryness of the eye due to inadequate production of tears. causes include vitamin a deficiency, sjogren syndrome, rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and scleroderma.

MONDO:0000950.name: asthenopia
MONDO:0000950.def: term generally used to describe complaints related to refractive error, ocular muscle imbalance, including pain or aching around the eyes, burning and itchiness of the eyelids, ocular fatigue, and headaches.

MONDO:0000951.name: thymus lymphoma
MONDO:0000951.def: a lymphoma that arises from the thymus. representative examples include mediastinal (thymic) large b-cell lymphoma and hodgkin lymphoma.

MONDO:0000952.name: cancer of long bone of lower limb
MONDO:0000952.def: a cancer that involves the hindlimb long bone.
MONDO:0000952.synonym: malignant neoplasm of long bones of leg

MONDO:0000953.name: cancer of short bone of lower limb
MONDO:0000953.synonym: malignant neoplasm of short bones of leg

MONDO:0000954.name: meckel diverticulum cancer
MONDO:0000954.def: a cancer involving a meckel's diverticulum.

MONDO:0000955.name: ileum cancer
MONDO:0000955.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the ileum

MONDO:0000956.name: small intestine cancer
MONDO:0000956.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the small intestine.

MONDO:0000958.name: neuroretinitis
MONDO:0000958.def: neuroretinitis is an inflammation of the neural retina and optic nerve. pathology: direct invasion or autoimmune activation against the optic nerve may cause optic nerve vascular inflammation with secondary inflammation and edema in the nerve fiber layer of the retina.

MONDO:0000960.name: diabetic peripheral angiopathy
MONDO:0000960.def: diabetic angiopathy is a form of angiopathy associated with diabetic complications.

MONDO:0000961.name: endobronchial lipoma
MONDO:0000961.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm located within the lumen of a bronchus. it is predominantly found in males and usually originates within the fatty tissue between bronchial cartilage. may cause irreversible pulmonary damage distally. two-thirds of the tumors occur on the right side and most are located on the first three subdivisions of the tracheobronchial tree.

MONDO:0000962.name: spindle cell lipoma
MONDO:0000962.def: a benign circumscribed tumor composed of spindled cells, adipocytes, and collagen bundles. there is no evidence of nuclear hyperchromasia or mitotic activity.

MONDO:0000963.name: esophageal lipoma
MONDO:0000963.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the esophagus. clinical presentation includes obstruction, dysphagia, regurgitation, vomiting and reflux. it may be associated with aspiration and consecutive respiratory infections.

MONDO:0000964.name: skin lipoma
MONDO:0000964.def: a benign or malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the skin.

MONDO:0000965.name: liver lipoma
MONDO:0000965.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the liver.

MONDO:0000966.name: pleomorphic lipoma
MONDO:0000966.def: a benign circumscribed tumor characterized by small spindle cells, rounded hyperchromatic cells and multinucleated giant cells with radially arranged nuclei.

MONDO:0000967.name: conventional lipoma
MONDO:0000967.def: a benign well-circumscribed tumor, composed of lobules of mature adipocytes, that arises within subcutaneous tissue, deep soft tissues or on the surface of bones.

MONDO:0000968.name: kidney lipoma
MONDO:0000968.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the kidney. it predominantly affects middle-aged females. it may originate from renal parenchymal fat or fat cells within the renal capsule. clinical presentation includes hematuria and pain.

MONDO:0000969.name: pleural lipoma
MONDO:0000969.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the pleural cavity. it may be purely intra-thoracic or extend to the chest wall.

MONDO:0000970.name: breast lipoma
MONDO:0000970.def: a benign, mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the breast. it is surrounded by a thin capsule and composed of mature adipose tissue cells. atypia is absent.

MONDO:0000971.name: chest wall lipoma
MONDO:0000971.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the chest wall.

MONDO:0000972.name: gallbladder lipoma
MONDO:0000972.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm involving the gallbladder wall.

MONDO:0000973.name: external ear lipoma
MONDO:0000973.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the external ear.

MONDO:0000974.name: axillary lipoma
MONDO:0000974.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the axilla.

MONDO:0000975.name: lipoma of spermatic cord
MONDO:0000975.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the spermatic cord. this is the most common tumor amongst the benign paratesticular lesions.

MONDO:0000976.name: paratesticular lipoma
MONDO:0000976.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the paratesticular tissues. it is incidentally discovered and presents as a non-tender scrotal mass. it affects patients over a wide age range.

MONDO:0000977.name: chondroid lipoma
MONDO:0000977.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm characterized by nests and cord of abundant univacuolated and multivacuolated lipoblasts and mature adipocytes in a prominent myxoid to hyalinized chondroid matrix admix. it predominantly affects females.

MONDO:0000978.name: extrahepatic bile duct lipoma
MONDO:0000978.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the extrahepatic bile duct.
MONDO:0000978.synonym: lipoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

MONDO:0000979.name: pinta disease
MONDO:0000979.def: an endemic bacterial infection caused by treponema carateum. it is manifested with chronic cutaneous lesions. the early lesions consist of papules and erythematous plaques. the late lesions consist of hypochromic, achromic, hyperpigmented and atrophic lesions. the late skin lesions may cause destruction of bones and cartilage and produce disfiguring changes.

MONDO:0000980.name: aortic atherosclerosis
MONDO:0000980.def: a atherosclerosis that involves the aorta.

MONDO:0000981.name: histoplasma pericarditis
MONDO:0000981.def: an pericarditis (disease) caused by infection with histoplasma.

MONDO:0000983.name: exhibitionism
MONDO:0000983.def: a disorder characterized by recurrent sexual urges, fantasies, or behaviors involving the exposure of one's genitals to an unsuspecting stranger.

MONDO:0000984.name: thalassemia
MONDO:0000984.def: an inherited blood disorder characterized by a decreased synthesis of one of the polypeptide chains that form hemoglobin. anemia results from this abnormal hemoglobin formation.

MONDO:0000986.name: pleurisy
MONDO:0000986.def: inflammation of the pleura. it is usually caused by infections. chest pain while breathing or coughing is the presenting symptom.

MONDO:0000987.name: cholesterolosis of gallbladder
MONDO:0000987.def: a disorder characterized by a change in the gallbladder wall due to excess cholesterol.

MONDO:0000988.name: discharging ear
MONDO:0000988.def: discharge or drainage of fluid from the ear.

MONDO:0000989.name: mumps infectious disease
MONDO:0000989.def: a contagious viral infection caused by the mumps virus. symptoms include swollen and tender parotid glands, fever, muscle aches and fatigue. due to vaccination programs, mumps has become a rare disease.

MONDO:0000990.name: acute subendocardial myocardial infarction
MONDO:0000990.def: acute form of subendocardial myocardial infarction.

MONDO:0000991.name: obsolete left bundle branch block
MONDO:0000991.def: obsolete. a bundle branch block in which the activation of the left ventricle is delayed.

MONDO:0000992.name: heart conduction disease
MONDO:0000992.def: a disease that has its basis in the disruption of the heart's electrical conduction system.

MONDO:0000993.name: prostate squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0000993.def: an invasive prostate carcinoma characterized by the presence of squamous differentiation of the malignant cellular infiltrate. there is no evidence of glandular differentiation.
MONDO:0000993.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the prostate

MONDO:0000994.name: malignant prostate phyllodes tumor
MONDO:0000994.def: an unusual malignant tumor that arises from the prostate gland. it is characterized by the presence of glandular elements and a cellular stroma that exhibits mitotic activity and nuclear atypia.

MONDO:0000995.name: familial periodic paralysis
MONDO:0000995.def: a group of genetic neurological disorders caused by mutations in genes involved in the sodium and calcium channels in nerve cells. it is characterized by episodes of muscle paralysis in which the affected muscles become flaccid and the deep tendon reflexes disappear. between the episodes the affected muscles usually work normally.

MONDO:0000996.name: prostate lymphoma
MONDO:0000996.def: a rare non-hodgkin or hodgkin lymphoma that arises from the prostate gland.

MONDO:0000997.name: monocular esotropia
MONDO:0000997.def: a form of ocular misalignment characterized by an excessive convergence of the visual axes, resulting in a 'cross-eye' appearance. an example of this condition occurs when paralysis of the lateral rectus muscle causes an abnormal inward deviation of one eye on attempted gaze.

MONDO:0001000.name: mixed mineral dust pneumoconiosis
MONDO:0001000.def: pneumoconiosis caused by the inhalation of mixed mineral dust particles.

MONDO:0001001.name: baritosis
MONDO:0001001.def: a rare type of pneumoconiosis caused by long standing exposure to barium dust. it is characterized by the formation of fine dense lesions in the lung parenchyma. the lesions do not affect the lung function and disappear without treatment after the exposure to barium dust stops.

MONDO:0001003.name: pneumoconiosis due to talc
MONDO:0001003.def: pneumoconiosis caused by exposure to talc. it is characterized by fibrosis and granulomatous changes in the lung parenchyma. chest x-rays reveal diffuse lung opacities and pleural abnormalities.

MONDO:0001004.name: slate pneumoconiosis
MONDO:0001004.def: pneumoconiosis caused by exposure to slate dust.

MONDO:0001005.name: kaolin pneumoconiosis
MONDO:0001005.def: pneumoconiosis caused by inhalation of kaolin dust.

MONDO:0001008.name: blepharophimosis
MONDO:0001008.def: the abnormal narrowness of the palpebral fissure in the horizontal direction caused by the lateral displacement of the medial canthi of the eyelids. (dorland, 27th ed)

MONDO:0001009.name: solitary cyst of breast
MONDO:0001009.def: a single, fluid-filled cyst in the breast parenchyma.

MONDO:0001011.name: breast cyst
MONDO:0001011.def: a cystic lesion located in breast tissue.

MONDO:0001014.name: chronic leukemia
MONDO:0001014.def: a slowly progressing leukemia characterized by a clonal (malignant) proliferation of maturing and mature myeloid cells or mature lymphocytes. when the clonal cellular population is composed of myeloid cells, the process is called chronic myelogenous leukemia. when the clonal cellular population is composed of lymphocytes, it is classified as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, hairy cell leukemia, or t-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemia.

MONDO:0001015.name: eosinophilic meningitis
MONDO:0001015.def: meningitis in which eosinophils predominate in the cerebrospinal fluid.

MONDO:0001016.name: epididymis cancer
MONDO:0001016.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the epididymis. representative examples include primary epididymal adenocarcinoma and metastatic carcinoma to the epididymis arising from another anatomic site.

MONDO:0001017.name: epididymal adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0001017.def: a rare adenocarcinoma that arises from the epididymis. it usually presents as a scrotal mass and may be associated with testicular pain.

MONDO:0001019.name: suppression amblyopia
MONDO:0001019.def: a nonspecific term referring to impaired vision. major subcategories include stimulus deprivation-induced amblyopia and toxic amblyopia. stimulus deprivation-induced amblyopia is a developmental disorder of the visual cortex. a discrepancy between visual information received by the visual cortex from each eye results in abnormal cortical development. strabismus and refractive errors may cause this condition. toxic amblyopia is a disorder of the optic nerve which is associated with alcoholism, tobacco smoking, and other toxins and as an adverse effect of the use of some medications.

MONDO:0001020.name: amblyopia
MONDO:0001020.def: decreased vision that results from abnormal visual development.

MONDO:0001023.name: prolymphocytic leukemia
MONDO:0001023.def: a mature b- or t- cell leukemia with progressive clinical course. it is characterized by the presence of medium-sized lymphocytes with visible nucleoli (prolymphocytes) in the peripheral blood, bone marrow, and spleen.

MONDO:0001024.name: pneumonic plague
MONDO:0001024.def: a plague in which the bacteria have infected the lungs.

MONDO:0001025.name: seminal vesicle chronic gonorrhea
MONDO:0001025.def: chronic form of gonococcal seminal vesiculitis.

MONDO:0001026.name: obsolete bacterial infectious disease
MONDO:0001026.def: obsolete. a infectious disease involving the bacteria.

MONDO:0001027.name: gonococcal seminal vesiculitis
MONDO:0001027.def: a gonorrhea that involves the seminal vesicle.

MONDO:0001028.name: acute pericementitis
MONDO:0001028.def: an acute inflammatory process that affects the tissues that surround and support the teeth.

MONDO:0001029.name: klippel-feil syndrome
MONDO:0001029.def: a congenital, musculoskeletal condition characterized by the fusion of at least two vertebrae of the neck. common symptoms include a short neck, low hairline at the back of the head, and restricted mobility of the upper spine. this syndrome can cause chronic headaches as well as pain in both the neck and the back.other features may involve various other body parts or systems. sometimes, kfs occurs as a feature of another disorder or syndrome, such as wildervanck syndrome or hemifacial microsomia. in these cases, people have the features of both kfs and the additional disorder. kfs may be caused by mutations in the gdf6 or gdf3 gene and inherited in an autosomal dominant manner; or, it may be caused by mutations in the meox1 gene and inherited in an autosomal recessive manner. treatment is symptomatic and may include medications, surgery, and/or physical therapy.

MONDO:0001031.name: purulent acute otitis media
MONDO:0001031.def: acute form of suppurative otitis media.

MONDO:0001036.name: hypopyon
MONDO:0001036.def: an accumulation of pus in the anterior chamber of the eye.

MONDO:0001040.name: nasopharyngitis
MONDO:0001040.def: an inflammatory process that affects the nasopharynx.

MONDO:0001041.name: dentin caries
MONDO:0001041.def: a dental caries that involves the dentine.

MONDO:0001042.name: patellar tendinitis
MONDO:0001042.def: a tendinitis that involves the patella.

MONDO:0001044.name: esophageal atresia
MONDO:0001044.def: a congenital abnormality of the esophagus in which the upper esophagus ends as a blind pouch and does not connect with the lower esophagus; it is often accompanied by a tracheoesophageal fistula. signs and symptoms in a newborn with this abnormality include excessive salivation, choking, coughing, and the development of cyanosis and respiratory distress when fed.

MONDO:0001045.name: intestinal atresia
MONDO:0001045.def: a congenital malformation characterized by the absence of a normal opening in a part of the intestine. it can occur either in the small or the large intestine.

MONDO:0001046.name: imperforate anus
MONDO:0001046.def: a congenital birth defect characterized by the absence of a normal anal opening. it may be associated with other congenital abnormalities.

MONDO:0001048.name: orbital granuloma
MONDO:0001048.def: a granuloma located on the orbit of the eye.

MONDO:0001049.name: dressler syndrome
MONDO:0001049.def: a pericarditis characterized by inflammation, occurring after injury, located in pericardium.

MONDO:0001050.name: malignant otitis externa
MONDO:0001050.def: an otitis externa which involves infection of the external ear that has spread to involve the skull bone containing part of the ear canal, the middle ear, and the inner ear. it is caused by the bacteria pseudomonas. this is common in people with weakened immune systems and in older people with diabetes.

MONDO:0001053.name: acute infection of pinna
MONDO:0001053.def: an otitis externa which involves bacterial infections often related to underlying comorbidities as well as trauma. common sources of trauma include ear piercing, boxing, blunt trauma, burns, bite wounds and iatrogenic insults. the common bacterial pathogens are staphylococcal and streptococcal species.

MONDO:0001056.name: gastric cancer
MONDO:0001056.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the stomach.

MONDO:0001057.name: malignant gastric granular cell tumor
MONDO:0001057.def: a metastasizing granular cell tumor that arises from the stomach.
MONDO:0001057.synonym: malignant granular cell tumour of the stomach

MONDO:0001059.name: gastric lymphoma
MONDO:0001059.def: an extranodal lymphoma that arises from the stomach with the bulk of the mass located in the stomach. the vast majority of cases are diffuse large b-cell lymphomas and b-cell lymphomas of the mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue.

MONDO:0001060.name: microinvasive gastric cancer
MONDO:0001060.def: an invasive adenocarcinoma confined to the mucosa or mucosa and submucosa of the gastric wall. the regional lymph nodes may or may not be involved. it usually occurs in the lesser curvature. the 5-year survival rate following resection is between 80 percent and 95 percent, and remains high even when lymph node metastases are present.

MONDO:0001061.name: pylorus cancer
MONDO:0001061.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the pylorus.

MONDO:0001062.name: pyloric antrum cancer
MONDO:0001062.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the pyloric antrum.

MONDO:0001063.name: cardia cancer
MONDO:0001063.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the cardia of stomach.
MONDO:0001063.synonym: malignant neoplasm of cardia of stomach

MONDO:0001065.name: supine hypotensive syndrome
MONDO:0001065.def: a vascular disease that is characterized by severe supine hypotension in late pregnancy, whose clinical presentation ranges from minimal cardiovascular alterations to severe shock, resulting from inferior vena cava compression by gravid uterus.

MONDO:0001066.name: late yaws
MONDO:0001066.def: late yaws is the tertiary, non-contagious stage of yaws, endemic tropical treponemal nonvenereal infection. late yaws is characterized by destructive and deforming lesions of the skin, bones, and joints.

MONDO:0001067.name: early yaws
MONDO:0001067.def: early yaws includes primary and secondary stages of yaws, endemic tropical treponemal nonvenereal infection: development of initial lesion at inoculation site followed by widespread dissemination of treponemes and generalized secondary granulomatous lesions that may relapse repeatedly.

MONDO:0001068.name: osteomalacia
MONDO:0001068.def: a metabolic bone disease that results from either a deficiency in vitamin d, or an abnormality in the metabolism of vitamin d, or a deficiency of calcium in the diet. the most common symptoms are bone pain and muscle weakness. when it occurs in children it is commonly referred to as rickets. (diagnostic surgical pathology, 3rd ed.) --2003

MONDO:0001071.name: intellectual disability
MONDO:0001071.def: a broad category of disorders characterized by an impairment to the intelligence an individual possesses. these impairments can result from trauma, birth, or disease and are not restricted to any particular age group.

MONDO:0001072.name: mild pre-eclampsia
MONDO:0001072.def: a pre-eclampsia characterized by the presence of hypertension without evidence of end-organ damage, in a woman who was normotensive before 20 weeks' gestation.

MONDO:0001074.name: chronic tic disorder
MONDO:0001074.def: a neurological disorder presenting in childhood that is characterized by either motor or phonic tics, but not both, that occur daily or nearly daily for at least a year and are not attributed to an identifiable cause.

MONDO:0001075.name: steatorrhea
MONDO:0001075.def: a finding of an excessive amount of fat in the stool.

MONDO:0001076.name: glucose intolerance
MONDO:0001076.def: the inability to regulate blood glucose levels resulting in hyperglycemia.

MONDO:0001078.name: tropical sprue
MONDO:0001078.def: a rare disorder of the digestive tract characterized by malabsorption and anemia. it is likely caused by infection leading to small intestinal mucosal injury, bacterial overgrowth and inflammatory changes. it is most prevalent in residents and visitors to tropical and subtropical climates. clinical signs include anorexia, abdominal bloating, diarrhea and weight loss. clinical course may progress to deficiencies of folate, vitamin b12 and iron. prognosis is favorable with nutrient replacement and antibiotic therapy, however relapses are common.

MONDO:0001081.name: acute cervicitis
MONDO:0001081.def: acute inflammation of the cervix. clinical manifestations include mucopurulent vaginal discharge and burning sensation.

MONDO:0001082.name: lymph node cancer
MONDO:0001082.def: a primary or metastatic malignant tumor involving the lymph node. lymphomas and metastatic carcinomas are representative examples. -- 2004

MONDO:0001083.name: fanconi renotubular syndrome
MONDO:0001083.def: a genetic or acquired disorder characterized by impairment of the function of the proximal tubules of the kidney. it results in decreased reabsorption of electrolytes, glucose, amino acids, and other nutrients.

MONDO:0001085.name: interstitial nephritis
MONDO:0001085.def: inflammation of the renal tubules and supporting tissues of the kidney.

MONDO:0001087.name: schizotypal personality disorder
MONDO:0001087.def: a disorder characterized by an enduring pattern of inability to establish close relationships coupled with cognitive or perceptual distortions, odd beliefs and speech, and eccentric behavior and appearance.

MONDO:0001088.name: acute inferoposterior infarction
MONDO:0001088.synonym: acute myocardial infarction of inferoposterior wall

MONDO:0001089.name: acute inferolateral myocardial infarction
MONDO:0001089.synonym: acute myocardial infarction of inferolateral wall

MONDO:0001090.name: acute anterolateral myocardial infarction
MONDO:0001090.def: acute form of anterolateral myocardial infarction.

MONDO:0001091.name: lipoma of colon
MONDO:0001091.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm originating in the colon. it is the second most common benign lesion of the colon after benign adenomatous polyps. older patients are more likely to be affected, and most lesions are located at the right side of large bowel. colon lipomas may lead to intestinal obstruction.

MONDO:0001092.name: colon leiomyoma
MONDO:0001092.def: a well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the colon. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0001093.name: colonic lymphangioma
MONDO:0001093.def: a lymphangioma arising from the colon.

MONDO:0001094.name: residual stage of open angle glaucoma
MONDO:0001094.synonym: residual stage of open angle glaucoma

MONDO:0001095.name: mediastinum neuroblastoma
MONDO:0001095.def: a neuroblastoma arising from the mediastinum.

MONDO:0001096.name: mediastinum ganglioneuroblastoma
MONDO:0001096.def: a ganglioneuroblastoma arising from the mediastinum.

MONDO:0001098.name: separation anxiety disorder
MONDO:0001098.def: an anxiety disorder characterized by recurrent excessive distress due to fear of separation from the home or from major attachment figures; the distress is developmentally inappropriate and causes impairment in social, academic, or other areas of functioning.

MONDO:0001099.name: lactocele
MONDO:0001099.def: single or multiple, milk-containing nodules in the breast. it is caused by obstruction of the breast ducts during lactation. needle aspiration of the milk is the treatment of choice.

MONDO:0001100.name: hypertrophy of breast
MONDO:0001100.def: excessive enlargement of one or both breasts. causes include pregnancy, obesity, and penicillamine therapy. it may result in neck, back, and shoulder pain.

MONDO:0001101.name: fat necrosis of breast
MONDO:0001101.def: localized necrosis of the adipose tissue in the breast. clinically, it may present as a mass. causes include injury, surgical procedures, and radiation treatment.

MONDO:0001103.name: giardiasis
MONDO:0001103.def: an infection of the small intestine caused by the flagellated protozoan giardia lamblia. it is spread via contaminated food and water and by direct person-to-person contact.

MONDO:0001105.name: renal hypertension
MONDO:0001105.def: hypertension caused by the kidney's hormonal response to narrowing or occlusion of the renal arteries.

MONDO:0001106.name: kidney failure
MONDO:0001106.def: an acute or chronic condition that is characterized by the inability of the kidneys to adequately filter the blood.

MONDO:0001108.name: broad ligament malignant neoplasm
MONDO:0001108.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the broad ligament of uterus.
MONDO:0001108.synonym: malignant neoplasm of broad ligament of uterus

MONDO:0001109.name: petrositis
MONDO:0001109.synonym: petrous part of temporal bone inflammation

MONDO:0001112.name: bubonic plague
MONDO:0001112.def: a plague in which the bacteria have infected the lymphatic system.

MONDO:0001114.name: bacterial myocarditis
MONDO:0001114.def: myocarditis that is caused by an infection with a bacterial agent.

MONDO:0001115.name: familial polycythemia
MONDO:0001115.def: polycythemia that occurs in groups of related individuals.

MONDO:0001116.name: mesenteric lymphadenitis
MONDO:0001116.def: inflammation of the mesenteric lymph nodes.

MONDO:0001117.name: methemoglobinemia
MONDO:0001117.def: an inherited or acquired condition characterized by abnormally increased levels of methemoglobin in the blood.

MONDO:0001118.name: queensland tick typhus
MONDO:0001118.def: a spotted fever that has material basis in rickettsia australis, which is transmitted by ticks (ixodes holocyclus). the infection has symptom fever, has symptom headache, has symptom myalgia, has symptom maculopapular rash, and has symptom lymphadenopathy.

MONDO:0001119.name: premature menopause
MONDO:0001119.def: cessation of menstruation before the age of 40. symptoms include hot flashes, night sweats, mood swings, and decreased sex drive.

MONDO:0001120.name: chronic frontal sinusitis
MONDO:0001120.def: inflammation of the frontal sinus that typically lasts beyond eight weeks. it is caused by infections, allergies, and the presence of sinus polyps or a deviated septum. signs and symptoms include headache, nasal discharge, swelling in the face, dizziness, and breathing difficulties.

MONDO:0001121.name: frontal sinusitis
MONDO:0001121.def: an acute or chronic inflammatory process affecting the mucous membrane of the frontal sinus.

MONDO:0001122.name: chronic maxillary sinusitis
MONDO:0001122.def: inflammation of the maxillary sinus that typically lasts beyond eight weeks. it is caused by infections, allergies, and the presence of sinus polyps or a deviated septum. signs and symptoms include headache, nasal discharge, swelling in the face, dizziness, and breathing difficulties.

MONDO:0001123.name: chronic sphenoidal sinusitis
MONDO:0001123.def: inflammation of the sphenoid sinus that typically lasts beyond eight weeks. it is caused by infections, allergies, and the presence of sinus polyps or a deviated septum. signs and symptoms include headache, nasal discharge, swelling in the face, dizziness, and breathing difficulties.

MONDO:0001126.name: gastric ulcer
MONDO:0001126.def: an ulcerated lesion in the mucosal surface of the stomach. it may progress to involve the deeper layers of the gastric wall.

MONDO:0001127.name: tibialis tendinitis
MONDO:0001127.def: a tendinitis that involves the tibialis.

MONDO:0001128.name: nasal cavity cancer
MONDO:0001128.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the nasal cavity

MONDO:0001129.name: nasal cavity olfactory neuroblastoma
MONDO:0001129.def: an olfactory neuroblastoma arising in the nasal cavity.
MONDO:0001129.synonym: olfactory neuroblastoma of the nasal cavity

MONDO:0001130.name: nasal cavity lymphoma
MONDO:0001130.def: a primary lymphoma that affects the nasal cavity and the bulk of the tumor is in this anatomic area.

MONDO:0001132.name: sexual sadism disorder
MONDO:0001132.def: a disorder characterized by recurrent sexual urges, fantasies, or behaviors involving acts (real, not simulated) in which the psychological or physical suffering of a victim is sexually exciting to the individual.

MONDO:0001133.name: malignant essential hypertension
MONDO:0001133.def: essential hypertension with rapid progression to severe high blood pressure, papilledema, and renal failure.

MONDO:0001134.name: essential hypertension
MONDO:0001134.def: hypertension that presents without an identifiable cause.

MONDO:0001135.name: voyeurism
MONDO:0001135.def: a disorder characterized by recurrent sexual urges, fantasies, or behaviors involving observing an unsuspecting person who is naked, disrobing, or engaging in sexual activity.

MONDO:0001137.name: murray valley encephalitis
MONDO:0001137.def: an disease caused by infection with murray valley encephalitis virus.
MONDO:0001137.synonym: murray valley encephalitis virus infectious disease

MONDO:0001138.name: angiodysplasia of intestine
MONDO:0001138.def: a angiodysplasia that involves the intestine.

MONDO:0001139.name: sexual masochism disorder
MONDO:0001139.def: a disorder characterized by recurrent sexual urges, fantasies, or behaviors involving the act (real, not simulated) of being humiliated, beaten, bound, or otherwise made to suffer.

MONDO:0001141.name: middle ear cholesterol granuloma
MONDO:0001141.def: as accumulation of granulation tissue in the middle ear that results from the degeneration of blood and a chronic inflammatory response.

MONDO:0001142.name: salivary gland disorder
MONDO:0001142.def: a disease involving the saliva-secreting gland.

MONDO:0001144.name: partial third-nerve palsy
MONDO:0001144.synonym: third or oculomotor nerve palsy, partial

MONDO:0001146.name: fourth cranial nerve palsy
MONDO:0001146.def: a cranial nerve palsy that involves the trochlear nerve.

MONDO:0001147.name: meningocele
MONDO:0001147.def: a congenital abnormality in which the meninges protrude through a defect in the spinal column or the cranium.

MONDO:0001148.name: iliac vein thrombophlebitis
MONDO:0001148.def: a thrombophlebitis that involves the iliac vein.

MONDO:0001149.name: microcephaly
MONDO:0001149.def: a congenital or acquired developmental disorder in which the circumference of the head is smaller than normal for the person's age and sex.

MONDO:0001150.name: hydrocephalus
MONDO:0001150.def: a disorder characterized by an abnormal increase of cerebrospinal fluid in the ventricles of the brain.

MONDO:0001151.name: benign essential hypertension
MONDO:0001151.def: a condition of mild to moderate high blood pressure that has no identifiable cause.

MONDO:0001152.name: amnestic disorder
MONDO:0001152.def: systematic and extensive loss of memory caused by organic or psychological factors. the loss may be temporary or permanent, and may involve old or recent memories.

MONDO:0001153.name: obsolete gender dysphoria
MONDO:0001153.def: obsolete. a marked difference between the individual's expressed/experienced gender and the gender others would assign him or her, and it must continue for at least six months. (from dsm-5)

MONDO:0001154.name: siberian tick typhus
MONDO:0001154.def: a spotted fever that has material basis in rickettsia sibirica, which is transmitted by ticks (dermacentor nuttalli, dermacentor marginatus and haemaphysalis concinna). the infection has symptom fever, has symptom eschar, has symptom regional adenopathy, and has symptom maculopapular rash.

MONDO:0001155.name: gastrojejunal ulcer
MONDO:0001155.synonym: chronic gastrojejunal ulcer without mention of hemorrhage or perforation, without mention of obstruction

MONDO:0001156.name: borderline personality disorder
MONDO:0001156.def: a disorder characterized by an enduring pattern of unstable self-image and mood together with volatile interpersonal relationships, self-damaging impulsivity, recurrent suicidal threats or gestures and/or self-mutilating behavior.

MONDO:0001157.name: dependent personality disorder
MONDO:0001157.def: a disorder characterized by an enduring pattern of an extreme need to be taken care of together with fear of separation that lead the individual to urgently seek out and submit to another person and allow that person to make decisions that impact all areas of the individual's life.

MONDO:0001158.name: obsessive-compulsive personality disorder
MONDO:0001158.def: a disorder characterized by an enduring pattern of inflexibility, extreme orderliness, and perfectionism which interfere with efficiency and which may manifest in many different contexts, including work and leisure activities, financial matters, and issues of morality or ethics.

MONDO:0001159.name: multiple personality disorder
MONDO:0001159.def: a disorder characterized by the presence of two or more identities with distinct patterns of perception and personality which recurrently take control of the person's behavior; this is accompanied by a retrospective gap in memory of important personal information that far exceeds ordinary forgetfulness. the changes in identity are not due to substance use or to a general medical condition.

MONDO:0001160.name: dissociative disorder
MONDO:0001160.def: a category of psychiatric disorders which are characterized by a disruption in the usually integrated functions of consciousness, memory, identity, and/or perception of the environment.

MONDO:0001161.name: schizoid personality disorder
MONDO:0001161.def: a disorder characterized by an enduring pattern of extreme social detachment and lack of involvement in interpersonal activities, coupled with emotional coldness.

MONDO:0001162.name: impulse control disorder
MONDO:0001162.def: a category of behaviors that can be loosely defined as the failure to resist an impulsive act or behavior that may be harmful to self or others.

MONDO:0001163.name: paranoid personality disorder
MONDO:0001163.def: a disorder characterized by an enduring pattern of behavior based on the pervasive belief that the motives of others are malevolent and that they should not be trusted.

MONDO:0001164.name: antisocial personality disorder
MONDO:0001164.def: a disorder characterized by a pervasive pattern of disregard for and violation of the rights of others that is manifested in childhood or early adolescence. (adapted from dsm-iv)

MONDO:0001167.name: spastic diplegia
MONDO:0001167.def: a type of cerebral palsy characterized by spasticity and hypertonia of the lower extremities bilaterally, particularly the legs, hips, and pelvis; this is the most common (70%) form of cerebral palsy.

MONDO:0001168.name: spastic hemiplegia
MONDO:0001168.def: a type of spastic cerebral palsy characterized by increased muscle tone of the arm and leg on the same side of the body.

MONDO:0001169.name: spastic monoplegia
MONDO:0001169.def: a spastic cerebral palsy that affects only one limb.

MONDO:0001170.name: hemiplegia
MONDO:0001170.def: severe or complete loss of motor function on one side of the body. this condition is usually caused by brain diseases that are localized to the cerebral hemisphere opposite to the side of weakness. less frequently, brain stem lesions; cervical spinal cord diseases; peripheral nervous system diseases; and other conditions may manifest as hemiplegia. the term hemiparesis (see paresis) refers to mild to moderate weakness involving one side of the body.

MONDO:0001173.name: acute salpingitis
MONDO:0001173.def: acute inflammation of the fallopian tube. it is most often caused by neisseria gonorrhoeae and chlamydia trachomatis infections. the infections usually originate in the vagina and ascend to the fallopian tube. symptoms include abdominal, pelvic, and lower back pain, pain during ovulation and sexual intercourse, fever, nausea, and vomiting. complications include infertility and ectopic pregnancy.

MONDO:0001174.name: conjunctival vascular disorder
MONDO:0001174.def: a disorder of the vasculature of the cornea.

MONDO:0001175.name: immature cataract
MONDO:0001175.def: a cataract disease in which the cataract contains some transparent protein

MONDO:0001176.name: lens disorder
MONDO:0001176.def: a disease involving the lens of camera-type eye.
MONDO:0001176.synonym: lens of camera-type eye disease or disorder

MONDO:0001179.name: pinguecula
MONDO:0001179.def: a yellowish thickened lesion on the conjunctiva near the cornea representing a benign degenerative change in the conjunctiva caused by the leakage and deposition of certain blood proteins through the permeable capillaries near the limbus.

MONDO:0001180.name: bullous keratopathy
MONDO:0001180.def: keratopathy that is characterized by the presence of epithelial bullae.

MONDO:0001184.name: chronic rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0001184.def: chronic form of rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis.

MONDO:0001185.name: dissociative amnesia
MONDO:0001185.def: a disorder characterized by a retrospective gap in memory of important personal information, usually of a traumatic or stressful nature; the memory loss far exceeds ordinary forgetfulness and is not the result of substance use or the consequence of a medical condition.

MONDO:0001186.name: depersonalization disorder
MONDO:0001186.def: a disorder characterized by persistent or recurrent episodes of feeling detached from one's self (either one's body or one's mental processes), although the sufferer remains aware that this is only a feeling and does not represent reality.

MONDO:0001187.name: urinary bladder cancer
MONDO:0001187.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the bladder.

MONDO:0001188.name: esophagus lymphoma
MONDO:0001188.def: an extranodal lymphoma that arises from the esophagus with the bulk of the mass located in the esophagus. dysphagia may be the presenting symptom. the vast majority of cases are diffuse large b-cell lymphomas and b-cell lymphomas of the mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue.

MONDO:0001190.name: brucella suis brucellosis
MONDO:0001190.def: an disease or disorder caused by infection with brucella suis.

MONDO:0001191.name: hirudiniasis
MONDO:0001191.def: an disease or disorder caused by infection with hirudinea.

MONDO:0001192.name: esophageal melanoma
MONDO:0001192.def: a melanoma affecting the esophageal wall. melanoma in the esophagus is more commonly metastatic than primary. primary melanomas of the esophagus are polypoid and clinically aggressive. (who, 2000)

MONDO:0001195.name: spotted fever
MONDO:0001195.def: a type of tick-borne disease which presents on the skin caused by bacteria of the genus rickettsia.

MONDO:0001198.name: acquired thrombocytopenia
MONDO:0001198.def: an instance of thrombocytopenia that is acquired during the lifetime of the individual.

MONDO:0001199.name: dislocation of ear ossicle
MONDO:0001199.def: ossicular chain dislocation is a separation of the middle ear bones. it results in a hearing loss due to sound not being transmitted properly (conductive hearing loss). ossicular chain dislocation is also called ossicular chain discontinuity.

MONDO:0001200.name: secondary hypertension
MONDO:0001200.def: high blood pressure caused by an underlying medical condition.

MONDO:0001204.name: esophagus sarcoma
MONDO:0001204.def: a malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the esophagus. representative examples include kaposi sarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and synovial sarcoma.

MONDO:0001208.name: acute respiratory failure
MONDO:0001208.def: life-threatening respiratory failure that develops rapidly. causes include injury, sepsis, drug overdose, and pancreatitis. it manifests with dyspnea and cyanosis and may lead to cardiovascular shock.

MONDO:0001209.name: common wart
MONDO:0001209.def: a wart caused by human papillomavirus. it can appear anywhere on the skin.

MONDO:0001210.name: enophthalmos
MONDO:0001210.def: abnormal recession of the eyeball within the eye socket.

MONDO:0001212.name: non-suppurative otitis media
MONDO:0001212.def: a otitis media which involves transudation of fluid in the middle ear without pus formation.

MONDO:0001213.name: serous glue ear
MONDO:0001213.def: chronic form of serous otitis media.

MONDO:0001215.name: allescheriosis
MONDO:0001215.def: a primary systemic mycosis that results in systemic fungal infection, has material basis in pseudallescheria boydii, which results in formation of abscesses.

MONDO:0001216.name: pulp degeneration
MONDO:0001216.def: deterioration of the normal pulp tissue.

MONDO:0001217.name: pseudomembranous conjunctivitis
MONDO:0001217.def: conjunctivitis that is characterized by formation of a pseudomembrane.

MONDO:0001218.name: acute laryngopharyngitis
MONDO:0001218.def: an upper respiratory tract disease which involves inflammation of both larynx and pharynx.

MONDO:0001220.name: hypoparathyroidism
MONDO:0001220.def: hypoparathyroidism is is an endocrine disorder in which the parathyroid glands in the neck do not produce enough parathyroid hormone (pth). common signs and symptoms includeabdominal pain, brittle nails, cataracts, dry hair and skin,muscle cramps,tetany, pain in the face, legs, and feet, seizures, tingling sensation,and weakened tooth enamel (in children). it may be caused byinjury to the parathyroid glands (e.g., during surgery). other causes, include low blood magnesium levels, a side effect of radioactive iodine treatment for hyperthyroidism, metabolic alkalosis, digeorge syndrome, and type i polyglandular autoimmune syndrome. the goal of treatment is to restore the calcium and mineral balance in the body.

MONDO:0001221.name: esophageal varices
MONDO:0001221.def: abnormally dilated veins of the esophagus.

MONDO:0001222.name: congenital t-cell immunodeficiency
MONDO:0001222.def: a broad classification of inherited disorders presenting at birth that affect the cell-mediated aspect of the immune response. circulating numbers of t lymphocytes are decreased or ineffective.

MONDO:0001223.name: parathyroid gland disorder
MONDO:0001223.def: a disease involving the parathyroid gland.

MONDO:0001224.name: angelucci syndrome
MONDO:0001224.def: atopic conjunctivitis that is of relatively short duration and that has a rapid onset.

MONDO:0001225.name: opioid abuse
MONDO:0001225.def: a substance abuse that involves the recurring use of opioid drugs despite negative consequences.

MONDO:0001226.name: acute contagious conjunctivitis
MONDO:0001226.def: acute inflammation of the conjunctiva characterized by pink or red color in the eyes.

MONDO:0001229.name: small intestine diverticulitis
MONDO:0001229.def: a diverticulitis that involves the small intestine.

MONDO:0001234.name: adhesive otitis media
MONDO:0001234.def: an auditory system disease that is characterized by a thin retracted ear drum becomes sucked into the middle-ear space and stuck (i.e., adherent) to the ossicles and other bones of the middle ear.

MONDO:0001235.name: appendix cancer
MONDO:0001235.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the vermiform appendix

MONDO:0001236.name: appendiceal neoplasm
MONDO:0001236.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm involving the appendix.

MONDO:0001237.name: appendix lymphoma
MONDO:0001237.def: a lymphoma arising from the appendix. the majority of lymphomas affecting the appendix represent disease extension from the intestinal wall; primary lymphomas of the appendix are rare.

MONDO:0001238.name: polycythemia neonatorum
MONDO:0001238.def: a condition in which the red blood cell level is greater than established reference ranges in a newborn.

MONDO:0001239.name: anemia of prematurity
MONDO:0001239.def: a blood disorder characterized by low hemoglobin levels in premature neonates that usually spontaneously resolves within 3-6 months post birth. a combination of factors including the transition from the liver to the bone marrow for erythropoiesis in a neonate, blood loss experienced during delivery, the shortened life span of fetal blood cells, and an acclimation to a relatively hyperoxic environment outside the womb can predispose a neonate to this condition.

MONDO:0001240.name: neonatal anemia
MONDO:0001240.def: the mildest form of erythroblastosis fetalis in which anemia is the chief manifestation.

MONDO:0001242.name: disseminated intravascular coagulation in newborn
MONDO:0001242.def: a clotting condition characterized as a disruption in the homeostatic balance of the coagulation and fibrinolytic systems presenting as a pathological activation of coagulation mechanisms leading to the formation of small clots inside the blood vessels throughout the body of the newborn.

MONDO:0001243.name: disseminated intravascular coagulation
MONDO:0001243.def: a pathological process where the blood starts to coagulate throughout the whole body. this depletes the body of its platelets and coagulation factors, and there is an increased risk of hemorrhage.

MONDO:0001244.name: vitamin k deficiency hemorrhagic disease
MONDO:0001244.def: deficiency of vitamin k. it may lead to bleeding, manifested with ecchymoses, petechiae, and hematomas. in infants it may cause hemorrhagic disease of newborn with intracranial and retroperitoneal bleeding.

MONDO:0001245.name: microcytic anemia
MONDO:0001245.def: anemia in which the red blood cell volume is decreased.

MONDO:0001246.name: typhus
MONDO:0001246.def: a group of infectious diseases that include epidemic typhus, scrub typhus and murine typhus.

MONDO:0001247.name: social phobia
MONDO:0001247.def: an anxiety disorder characterized by an intense, irrational fear of one or more social or performance situations in which the individual believes that he or she will be scrutinized by others. exposure to social situations immediately provokes an anxiety response. in adults, the social phobia is recognized as excessive or unreasonable.

MONDO:0001249.name: trachoma
MONDO:0001249.def: a chronic infection of the conjunctiva and cornea caused by chlamydia trachomatis.

MONDO:0001250.name: keratomalacia
MONDO:0001250.def: an eye disorder that results from vitamin a deficiency, with basis in disruption of maintenance of the specialized epithelial surfaces, leading to atrophic changes in the normal mucosal surface, with loss of goblet cells, and replacement of the normal epithelium by an inappropriate keratinized stratified squamous epithelium. in addition, the substantia propria of the cornea breaks down and liquefies, resulting in keratomalacia.

MONDO:0001252.name: plummer disease
MONDO:0001252.def: nodular enlargement of the thyroid gland associated with hyperthyroidism.

MONDO:0001255.name: ventilation pneumonitis
MONDO:0001255.def: an extrinsic allergic alveolitis caused by inhalation of antigens from thermophilic actinomycetes species growing in air conditioners and humidifiers. fungi like aureobasidium sp and candida albicans that survive in the contaminated water in humidifiers and air conditioners are also known to cause the disease.

MONDO:0001256.name: arteriovenous hemangioma/malformation
MONDO:0001256.def: a benign vascular lesion characterized by the presence of a complex network of communicating arterial and venous vascular structures.

MONDO:0001259.name: pituitary gland infarction
MONDO:0001259.def: ischemic necrosis of the pituitary gland.

MONDO:0001260.name: cercarial dermatitis
MONDO:0001260.def: an unusual presentation of schistosomiasis characterized by a pruritic papular rash in the perigenital or periumbilical area due to an allergic reaction to schistosoma eggs deposited in the skin.

MONDO:0001261.name: mobitz type ii atrioventricular block
MONDO:0001261.def: a disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of intermittent failure of atrial electrical impulse conduction to the ventricles, characterized by a relatively constant pr interval prior to the block of an atrial impulse. (cdisc)
MONDO:0001261.synonym: type ii second degree av block

MONDO:0001262.name: african histoplasmosis
MONDO:0001262.def: an disease or disorder caused by infection with histoplasma capsulatum var. duboisii.

MONDO:0001263.name: histoplasmosis retinitis
MONDO:0001263.def: an retinitis caused by infection with histoplasma capsulatum.

MONDO:0001265.name: schizophreniform disorder
MONDO:0001265.def: a disorder that differs from schizophrenia specifically in total duration (schizophreniform disorder lasts at least 1 month but less than 6 months whereas schizophrenia lasts at least 6 months); schizophreniform disorder also typically causes less impairment in the individual's social and occupational functioning.

MONDO:0001266.name: erysipelas
MONDO:0001266.def: an infection of the upper layers of the skin caused by species of streptococcus. erysipelas results in a fiery red rash with raised edges that can easily be distinguished from the skin around it. the affected skin may be warm to the touch.

MONDO:0001268.name: gingival recession
MONDO:0001268.def: a loss of gum tissue resulting in an exposure of the roots of the teeth.

MONDO:0001269.name: scleral disorder
MONDO:0001269.def: a disorder affecting the sclera. examples include inflammatory processes (e.g., scleritis and episcleritis), and degenerative processes. primary tumors of the sclera are extremely rare.

MONDO:0001271.name: lens subluxation
MONDO:0001271.def: a partial dislocation of the lens of the eye.

MONDO:0001273.name: megacolon
MONDO:0001273.def: an abnormal dilation of the colon not due to obstruction.

MONDO:0001275.name: spinal meningioma
MONDO:0001275.def: spinal meningioma isa rare type of spinal cord cancer. the spinal cord is part of the central nervous system. this tumor often affects middle-aged women. tumors of the spinal cord can be either primary or arise from other primary tumors (metastatic), and are typically slow growing. the initial signs and symptoms include headacheand recent onset of seizures. other features are motor deficits, sensory deficits, pain, and sphincter dysfunction. the thoracic spine (middle back) is the most common site, followed by the cervical spine (neck). these tumors are rarely seen in the lumbar region (lower back). t he only proven risk factor in the development of meningioma is exposure to ionizing radiation. also, patients with neurofibromatosis type 2 are at increased risk of developing meningioma. surgery is the treatment of choice and complete tumor removal is reached in the vast majority of patients. the prognosis after surgical resection is excellent.

MONDO:0001276.name: expressive language disorder
MONDO:0001276.def: a disorder characterized by an impairment in the development of an individual's expressive language which is in contrast to his/her nonverbal intellect and receptive language development. the impairment may be acquired (i.e., due to a brain lesion or head trauma) or developmental (i.e., no known neurological insult).

MONDO:0001277.name: cerebral arteritis
MONDO:0001277.def: an inflammatory disease involving a pathogenic inflammatory response in the cerebral artery.

MONDO:0001278.name: obsolete adult respiratory distress syndrome
MONDO:0001278.def: obsolete. a syndrome characterized by progressive life-threatening respiratory insufficiency in the absence of known lung diseases, usually following a systemic insult such as surgery or major trauma.

MONDO:0001279.name: intraspinal meningioma
MONDO:0001279.def: a meningioma that arises from the spinal meninges.
MONDO:0001279.synonym: spinal canal and spinal cord meningioma

MONDO:0001280.name: choroiditis
MONDO:0001280.def: an inflammatory process that affects the choroid.

MONDO:0001281.name: alternating exotropia
MONDO:0001281.def: a form of ocular misalignment where the visual axes diverge inappropriately. for example, medial rectus muscle weakness may produce this condition as the affected eye will deviate laterally upon attempted forward gaze. an exotropia occurs due to the relatively unopposed force exerted on the eye by the lateral rectus muscle, which pulls the eye in an outward direction.

MONDO:0001282.name: fallopian tube endometriosis
MONDO:0001282.def: endometriosis that affects the fallopian tube. symptoms include infertility, pelvic pain, painful menstruation, and painful intercourse.

MONDO:0001283.name: endosalpingiosis
MONDO:0001283.def: a benign pathologic process characterized by the transformation of the mesothelium into fallopian tube epithelium. it occurs in the peritoneum and may affect the serosa surface of the uterus and the adnexa. it may be asymptomatic or present as pelvic pain.

MONDO:0001286.name: exotropia
MONDO:0001286.def: a form of strabismus in which the eyes are deviated laterally.

MONDO:0001288.name: endometriosis of rectovaginal septum and vagina
MONDO:0001288.def: endometriosis that affects the vagina. it is characterized by the presence of endometrial stroma with or without endometrial-type glands in the vagina.

MONDO:0001290.name: allergic cutaneous vasculitis
MONDO:0001290.def: inflammation of the small vessels of the skin that is mediated by the immune system.

MONDO:0001292.name: autonomic nervous system disorder
MONDO:0001292.def: a disease involving the autonomic nervous system.

MONDO:0001293.name: subglottis cancer
MONDO:0001293.def: a malignant neoplasm that affects the subglottic area of the larynx. the vast majority of cases are squamous cell carcinomas.

MONDO:0001294.name: horner syndrome
MONDO:0001294.def: horner's syndrome is a rare condition characterized by miosis (constriction of thepupil), ptosis (drooping of the upper eyelid), and anhidrosis (absence of sweating of the face). it iscaused by damage to the sympathetic nerves of the face. the underlying causes of horner's syndrome vary greatly and may include a tumor, stroke, or other damage to a part of the brain called the brain stem ; injury to the carotid artery ;and trauma to the brachial plexus. in rare cases, horner's syndrome is congenital (present from birth) and associated with a lack of pigmentation of the iris (colored part of the eye). treatment of horner's syndrome depends on the underlying cause.

MONDO:0001296.name: acquired night blindness
MONDO:0001296.def: an instance of night blindness that is acquired during the lifetime of the individual.

MONDO:0001297.name: cardiac tamponade
MONDO:0001297.def: acute compression of the heart caused by increased intrapericardial pressure due to the collection of blood or fluid in the pericardium from rupture of the heart, penetrating trauma, or progressive effusion.

MONDO:0001298.name: congenital mitral valve insufficiency
MONDO:0001298.def: dysfunction of the mitral valve characterized by incomplete valve closure.

MONDO:0001299.name: diabetic autonomic neuropathy
MONDO:0001299.def: autonomic neuropathy that is caused by diabetes mellitus.

MONDO:0001300.name: autonomic neuropathy
MONDO:0001300.def: an inherited or acquired peripheral neuropathy affecting the autonomic nervous system. it results in disruption of the involuntary body functions. inherited causes include fabry disease and porphyrias. acquired causes include diabetes, uremia, hepatic disorders, vitamin deficiencies, toxins, and drug toxicities.
MONDO:0001300.synonym: peripheral neuropathy of autonomic nervous system

MONDO:0001301.name: rumination disorder
MONDO:0001301.def: rumination disorder is the backward flow of recently eaten food from the stomach to the mouth. the food is then re-chewed and swallowed or spat out. a non-purposeful contraction of stomach muscles is involved in rumination. it may be initially triggered by a viral illness, emotional distress, or physical injury. in many cases, no underlying trigger is identified. behavioral therapy is the mainstay of treatment.

MONDO:0001302.name: hypertensive heart disease
MONDO:0001302.def: abnormal enlargement of the heart resulting from long-standing hypertension.

MONDO:0001304.name: benign hypertensive renal disease
MONDO:0001304.synonym: hypertensive renal disease, benign, without mention of renal failure

MONDO:0001310.name: bowman's membrane folds or rupture
MONDO:0001310.synonym: folds and/or rupture of bowman's membrane

MONDO:0001312.name: acute serous otitis media
MONDO:0001312.def: a acute transudative otitis media with thin, watery and sterile effusion.

MONDO:0001313.name: acute allergic serous otitis media
MONDO:0001313.def: a acute serous otitis media caused by an allergen.

MONDO:0001314.name: chondrocalcinosis
MONDO:0001314.def: an acute episode of pain, swelling, and redness, sometimes associated with fever. it is caused by the deposition of calcium pyrophosphate crystals in the joints.

MONDO:0001315.name: neurocirculatory asthenia
MONDO:0001315.def: a clinical syndrome characterized by palpitation, shortness of breath, labored breathing, subjective complaints of effort and discomfort, all following slight physical exertion. other symptoms may be dizziness, tremulousness, sweating, and insomnia. neurocirculatory asthenia is most typically seen as a form of anxiety disorder.

MONDO:0001316.name: streptococcal meningitis
MONDO:0001316.def: an infectious meningitis caused by infection with streptococcus.

MONDO:0001319.name: bladder lateral wall cancer
MONDO:0001319.synonym: malignant neoplasm of lateral wall of urinary bladder

MONDO:0001322.name: pericardium cancer
MONDO:0001322.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the pericardium.

MONDO:0001323.name: infant gynecomastia
MONDO:0001323.def: transient bilateral swelling of breast tissue in a neonate that results from the waning influence of maternal estrogen.

MONDO:0001324.name: obsolete hyperandrogenism
MONDO:0001324.def: obsolete. a condition caused by the excessive secretion of androgens from the adrenal cortex; the ovaries; or the testes. the clinical significance in males is negligible. in women, the common manifestations are hirsutism and virilism as seen in patients with polycystic ovary syndrome and adrenocortical hyperfunction.

MONDO:0001325.name: penile cancer
MONDO:0001325.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the penis. representative examples include penile carcinoma and penile sarcoma.

MONDO:0001326.name: dental pulp necrosis
MONDO:0001326.def: death of pulp tissue with or without bacterial invasion. when the necrosis is due to ischemia with superimposed bacterial infection, it is referred to as pulp gangrene. when the necrosis is non-bacterial in origin, it is called pulp mummification.

MONDO:0001328.name: thyroid hormone resistance syndrome
MONDO:0001328.def: an inherited autosomal recessive trait, characterized by peripheral resistance to thyroid hormones and the resulting elevation in serum levels of thyroxine and triiodothyronine.

MONDO:0001330.name: presbyopia
MONDO:0001330.def: the normal decreasing elasticity of the crystalline lens that leads to loss of accommodation.

MONDO:0001332.name: palindromic rheumatism
MONDO:0001332.def: a syndrome that involves sudden and rapidly developing attacks of arthritis with a remission period that results in no joint damage or symptoms.

MONDO:0001334.name: hypertrichosis of eyelid
MONDO:0001334.def: a hypertrichosis (disease) that involves the eyelid.

MONDO:0001335.name: hypotrichosis of eyelid
MONDO:0001335.def: a hypotrichosis that involves the eyelid.

MONDO:0001336.name: familial hyperlipidemia
MONDO:0001336.def: an instance of hyperlipidemia (disease) that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

MONDO:0001338.name: acute apical periodontitis
MONDO:0001338.synonym: acute apical periodontitis of pulpal origin

MONDO:0001339.name: portal vein thrombosis
MONDO:0001339.def: the formation of a blood clot (thrombus) in the portal vein.
