MONDO:0002767.def: obsolete. a rare thrombophilia disorder characterized by deficiency of protein c. it results in venous thromboembolism.

MONDO:0002768.name: true hermaphroditism
MONDO:0002768.def: a rare condition characterized by the unequivocal presence of both testicular and ovarian tissues in an individual. it is usually manifested with ambiguous external genitalia.

MONDO:0002769.name: leukorrhea
MONDO:0002769.def: whitish or yellowish mucosal vaginal discharge.

MONDO:0002770.name: vaginal discharge
MONDO:0002770.def: normal or abnormal secretions from the vagina. mucus produced by the cervical glands is discharged from the vagina naturally, especially during the childbearing years. causes of abnormal vaginal discharge include infectious agents (e.g., neisseria gonorrhea, chlamydia trachomatis, trichomonas, and candida albicans), the presence of foreign bodies, and cervical or vaginal cancer.

MONDO:0002771.name: pulmonary fibrosis
MONDO:0002771.def: chronic progressive interstitial lung disorder characterized by the replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue, leading to progressive dyspnea, respiratory failure, or right heart failure. causes include chronic inflammatory processes, exposure to environmental irritants, radiation therapy, autoimmune disorders, certain drugs, or it may be idiopathic (no identifiable cause).

MONDO:0002772.name: intraventricular meningioma
MONDO:0002772.def: a meningioma that affects the ventricles of the brain.

MONDO:0002776.name: external ear disorder
MONDO:0002776.def: a disease involving the external ear.

MONDO:0002778.name: epidural spinal canal meningioma
MONDO:0002778.def: a meningioma that arises in the epidural spinal canal space.
MONDO:0002778.synonym: meningioma of the epidural spinal canal

MONDO:0002779.name: central nervous system chondroma
MONDO:0002779.def: an extraskeletal chondroma usually arising from the dura.

MONDO:0002782.name: cranial nerve palsy
MONDO:0002782.def: injury to any of the cranial nerves or their nuclei in the brain resulting in muscle weakness.

MONDO:0002783.name: shwartzman phenomenon
MONDO:0002783.def: hemorrhagic necrosis that was first demonstrated in rabbits with a two-step reaction, an initial local (intradermal) or general (intravenous) injection of a priming endotoxin (endotoxins) followed by a second intravenous endotoxin injection (provoking agent) 24 h later. the acute inflammation damages the small blood vessels. the following intravascular coagulation leads to capillary and venous thrombosis and necrosis. shwartzman phenomenon can also occur in other species with a single injection of a provoking agent, and during infections or pregnancy. its susceptibility depends on the status of immune system, coagulation, fibrinolysis, and blood flow.

MONDO:0002785.name: skull base neoplasm
MONDO:0002785.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the skull base.

MONDO:0002787.name: adamantinous craniopharyngioma
MONDO:0002787.def: a craniopharyngioma consisting of broad strands, cords and bridges of a multistratified squamous epithelium with peripheral palisading of nuclei. diagnostic features include nodules of compact 'wet' keratin and dystrophic calcification. (adapted from who)

MONDO:0002788.name: papillary craniopharyngioma
MONDO:0002788.def: a craniopharyngioma composed of sheets of squamous epithelium which separate to form pseudopapillae. this variant typically lacks nuclear palisading, wet keratin, calcification, and cholesterol deposits. clinically, endocrine deficiencies are more often associated with papillary craniopharyngioma than with the adamantinomatous type. (adapted from who)

MONDO:0002789.name: hemangiopericytic tumor
MONDO:0002789.def: a term that refers to vascular neoplasms with a prominent hemangiopericytic growth pattern.

MONDO:0002790.name: seminal vesicle tumor
MONDO:0002790.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the seminal vesicle. representative examples include cystadenoma and adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0002791.name: large cell medulloblastoma
MONDO:0002791.def: a medulloblastoma composed of large cells with prominent nucleoli and a larger amount of cytoplasm in contrast with the cells of the classic medulloblastoma.

MONDO:0002792.name: cerebellar vermis medulloblastoma
MONDO:0002792.def: a medulloblastoma arising from the vermis of the cerebellum.

MONDO:0002794.name: adult medulloblastoma
MONDO:0002794.def: a medulloblastoma arising from the brain, occurring in adults.

MONDO:0002795.name: adult central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm
MONDO:0002795.def: a central nervous system embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified that occurs in adults.
MONDO:0002795.synonym: central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm of adults

MONDO:0002796.name: melanotic medulloblastoma
MONDO:0002796.def: a rare malignant embryonal neoplasm characterized by the presence of small cells which resemble the cells of classic medulloblastoma and a minor population of melanin-forming neuroepithelial cells. it usually has an unfavorable clinical course.

MONDO:0002798.name: childhood central nervous system primitive neuroectodermal neoplasm
MONDO:0002798.def: a central nervous system embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified that occurs in childhood.

MONDO:0002799.name: nodular medulloblastoma
MONDO:0002799.def: a medulloblastoma characterized by nodularity and neuronal differentiation.

MONDO:0002800.name: thrombophlebitis
MONDO:0002800.def: inflammation of the veins associated with the presence of a thrombus.
MONDO:0002800.synonym: thrombophlebitis of superficial veins of lower extremity

MONDO:0002801.name: colonic pseudo-obstruction
MONDO:0002801.def: functional obstruction of the colon leading to megacolon in the absence of obvious colonic diseases or mechanical obstruction. when this condition is acquired, acute, and coexisting with another medical condition (trauma, surgery, serious injuries or illness, or medication), it is called ogilvie's syndrome.

MONDO:0002802.name: functional colonic disease
MONDO:0002802.def: chronic or recurrent colonic disorders without an identifiable structural or biochemical explanation. the widely recognized irritable bowel syndrome falls into this category.

MONDO:0002803.name: intestinal pseudo-obstruction
MONDO:0002803.def: intestinal pseudo-obstruction is a digestive disorder in whichthe intestinal walls are unable to contract normally (called hypomotility); the conditionresembles a true obstruction, but no actual blockage exists. signs and symptoms may include abdominal pain; vomiting; diarrhea; constipation; malabsorption of nutrients leading to weight loss and/or failure to thrive ; and other symptoms. it may be classified as neuropathic (from lack of nerve function)or myopathic (from lack of muscle function), depending on the source of the abnormality. the condition is sometimes inherited (in an x-linked recessive or autosomal dominant manner)and may be caused by mutations in the flna gene; it may also be acquired after certain illnesses. the goal of treatment is to provide relief from symptoms andensure that nutritional support is adequate.

MONDO:0002804.name: apocrine adenoma
MONDO:0002804.def: a benign epithelial neoplasm arising from the apocrine sweat glands. representative examples include tubular apocrine adenoma and external auditory canal ceruminous adenoma.

MONDO:0002805.name: hidradenoma
MONDO:0002805.def: a benign epithelial neoplasm arising from the sweat glands. variants include the clear cell and nodular hidradenoma.

MONDO:0002806.name: bronchogenic carcinoma
MONDO:0002806.def: a lung carcinoma arising from the bronchial epithelium.

MONDO:0002807.name: bronchial neoplasm
MONDO:0002807.def: tumors or cancer of the bronchi.

MONDO:0002808.name: pancreatic serous cystadenoma
MONDO:0002808.def: a benign, non-metastasizing cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. it is composed of glycogen-rich epithelial cells which produce a watery fluid. signs and symptoms include abdominal mass, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and weight loss.

MONDO:0002809.name: pancreatic cystadenoma
MONDO:0002809.def: a non-metastasizing cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas.

MONDO:0002810.name: pancreatic serous cystic neoplasm
MONDO:0002810.def: a benign or malignant epithelial neoplasm that is usually cystic and arises from the exocrine pancreas. it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that produce fluid similar to serum. representative examples include serous cystadenoma and serous cystadenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0002811.name: main bronchus cancer
MONDO:0002811.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the main bronchus.

MONDO:0002812.name: infectious otitis interna
MONDO:0002812.def: inflammation of the anatomical structures of the inner ear secondary to an infectious process. symptoms include severe vertigo, nausea, vomiting, anxiety, and pain. viral etiology is most common, and recent history of an upper respiratory infection is common. in rare cases an infection of the middle ear can spread to the inner ear, resulting in a bacterial or fungal etiology.

MONDO:0002813.name: lipomatous cancer
MONDO:0002813.def: a malignant mesenchymal neoplasm arising from adipocytes.
MONDO:0002813.synonym: malignant tumour of the adipose tissue

MONDO:0002814.name: adrenal carcinoma
MONDO:0002814.def: a carcinoma involving a adrenal gland.

MONDO:0002815.name: acute myocarditis
MONDO:0002815.def: the sudden onset of inflammation of heart muscle with myocellular necrosis; this is generally secondary to an infectious cause, and patients often have a recent history of a flu-like illness.

MONDO:0002816.name: adrenal cortex disorder
MONDO:0002816.def: a disease involving the adrenal cortex.

MONDO:0002817.name: adrenal gland cancer
MONDO:0002817.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the adrenal gland

MONDO:0002822.name: trabecular adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0002822.def: a malignant epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of a trabecular glandular architectural pattern.

MONDO:0002824.name: extrinsic cardiomyopathy
MONDO:0002824.def: a cardiomyopathy that is not due to abnormalities in heart muscle cells.

MONDO:0002828.name: bartholin gland transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002828.def: a rare carcinoma that arises from the bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant urothelial-type epithelial cells.
MONDO:0002828.synonym: major vestibular gland transitional cell carcinoma

MONDO:0002829.name: bartholin gland carcinoma
MONDO:0002829.def: a carcinoma that arises from the bartholin gland. it usually affects women over fifty and presents with enlargement of the bartholin gland. various histologic subtypes have been identified and include adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, adenoid cystic carcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma, transitional cell carcinoma, and small cell carcinoma.

MONDO:0002831.name: non-keratinizing sinonasal squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002831.def: a squamous cell carcinoma of the sinonasal tract characterized by a plexiform or ribbon-like growth pattern, cytological atypia, and lack of histological evidence of keratinization.

MONDO:0002832.name: endometrial transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002832.def: a rare primary carcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells resembling urothelial transitional cells. the malignant transitional cells constitute at least 90% of the tumor cells.

MONDO:0002833.name: fallopian tube transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002833.def: a rare transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the fallopian tube.

MONDO:0002834.name: primary prostate urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0002834.def: an urothelial carcinoma that arises from the urothelial lining of the prostatic ducts or the prostatic urethra.
MONDO:0002834.synonym: transitional cell carcinoma of the prostate

MONDO:0002836.name: urethra transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002836.def: a transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the male or female urethra.

MONDO:0002837.name: sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002837.def: a poorly differentiated transitional cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells with spindle cell morphologic features.

MONDO:0002839.name: leather-bottle stomach
MONDO:0002839.def: a cancer-related condition in which the gastric wall becomes thickened and rubbery (leather-bottle stomach). it is most often associated with diffuse gastric adenocarcinomas.

MONDO:0002840.name: eosinophilic gastritis
MONDO:0002840.def: an eosinophilic gastroenteritis that is characterized by inflammation of the stomach.

MONDO:0002845.name: necrotizing gastritis
MONDO:0002845.def: a variant of phlegmonous gastritis, typically progressing to gastric gangrene.

MONDO:0002846.name: granulomatous gastritis
MONDO:0002846.def: gastritis that is associated with the presence of granulomas.

MONDO:0002847.name: skeletal muscle cancer
MONDO:0002847.def: a malignant neoplasm arising from skeletal muscle.

MONDO:0002848.name: skeletal muscle neoplasm
MONDO:0002848.def: a benign or malignant mesenchymal neoplasm arising from skeletal muscle.

MONDO:0002849.name: liver rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002849.def: a malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the liver.

MONDO:0002850.name: central nervous system rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002850.def: a malignant mesenchymal neoplasm with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the central nervous system.

MONDO:0002851.name: mediastinum rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002851.def: a malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the mediastinum.

MONDO:0002852.name: mediastinum sarcoma
MONDO:0002852.def: a rare sarcoma that arises from the mediastinum. examples include liposarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, and angiosarcoma.

MONDO:0002853.name: rectum rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002853.def: a malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the rectum.

MONDO:0002854.name: prostate sarcoma
MONDO:0002854.def: a rare malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the prostate gland. representative examples include leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and stromal sarcoma.

MONDO:0002855.name: ectomesenchymoma
MONDO:0002855.def: an aggressive malignant mesenchymal neoplasm of the nervous system or soft tissues. it is characterized by the presence of a sarcomatous component (most often rhabdomyosarcoma) and a ganglionic or a neuroectodermal component.
MONDO:0002855.synonym: sarcoma with ganglionic or neuroectodermal differentiation

MONDO:0002856.name: gallbladder rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002856.def: a rhabdomyosarcoma that is located in the gallbladder.

MONDO:0002857.name: gallbladder sarcoma
MONDO:0002857.def: a malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the gallbladder. representative examples include kaposi sarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, and rhabdomyosarcoma.

MONDO:0002858.name: ovary rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002858.def: a malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the ovaries.

MONDO:0002859.name: breast rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002859.def: a malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the breast.

MONDO:0002860.name: testis rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002860.def: a malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the testis.

MONDO:0002861.name: testis sarcoma
MONDO:0002861.def: a sarcoma that arises from the testis. the majority of cases arise from teratomas or spermatocytic seminomas.

MONDO:0002862.name: bile duct sarcoma
MONDO:0002862.def: a sarcoma that involves the bile duct.

MONDO:0002863.name: rhabdomyosarcoma with mixed embryonal and alveolar features
MONDO:0002863.def: a rhabdomyosarcoma composed of embryonic and alveolar components. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with myoblastic differentiation, a myxoid stroma, and fibrous septa. these tumors were previously considered variants of alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma. the lack of pax3-foxo1 fusions in most of these tumors suggests that are biologically and clinically related to embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma.
MONDO:0002863.synonym: rhabdomyosarcoma with mixed embryonal and alveolar features

MONDO:0002864.name: anus rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002864.def: a malignant mesenchymal tumor with skeletal muscle differentiation affecting the anus.

MONDO:0002865.name: anus sarcoma
MONDO:0002865.def: a malignant soft tissue neoplasm arising from the anus. representative examples include leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and kaposi sarcoma.

MONDO:0002866.name: duodenal disorder
MONDO:0002866.def: pathological conditions in the duodenum region of the small intestine (intestine, small).

MONDO:0002867.name: pancreatic cystadenocarcinoma
MONDO:0002867.def: a cystic adenocarcinoma that arises from the pancreas. it includes the acinar cell and serous cystadenocarcinoma subtypes.

MONDO:0002868.name: bile duct mucinous cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
MONDO:0002868.def: a mucinous cystic neoplasm that arises from the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts and it is associated with an invasive carcinomatous component.

MONDO:0002869.name: heart valve disorder
MONDO:0002869.def: a disease involving the cardial valve.

MONDO:0002870.name: tricuspid valve insufficiency
MONDO:0002870.def: the backflow of blood from the right ventricle into the right atrium, owning to imperfect functioning/insufficiency of the tricuspid valve.

MONDO:0002871.name: testicular trophoblastic tumor
MONDO:0002871.def: a tumor that arises from the testis and is composed of neoplastic trophoblastic cells. the vast majority of cases are choriocarcinomas.

MONDO:0002872.name: trophoblastic neoplasm
MONDO:0002872.def: a gestational or non-gestational neoplasm composed of neoplastic trophoblastic cells. representative examples include hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma.

MONDO:0002873.name: obsolete testicular germ cell tumor non-seminomatous

MONDO:0002874.name: testicular pure germ cell tumor
MONDO:0002874.def: a germ cell tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of one histologic component. this category includes seminoma, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and trophoblastic tumor.

MONDO:0002875.name: parasitic ectoparasitic infectious disease
MONDO:0002875.def: infestations by parasites which live on, or burrow into, the surface of their host's epidermis. most ectoparasites are arthropods.

MONDO:0002876.name: cervical adenosarcoma
MONDO:0002876.def: a rare malignant mixed epithelial and mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of malignant mesenchymal elements and benign epithelial elements.

MONDO:0002877.name: cervical carcinosarcoma
MONDO:0002877.def: a mixed epithelial and mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the cervix and is characterized by the presence of malignant mesenchymal elements and benign or malignant epithelial elements. this category includes adenosarcoma and carcinosarcoma.

MONDO:0002878.name: uterine corpus adenosarcoma
MONDO:0002878.def: a primary polypoid malignant neoplasm of the uterine corpus characterized by the presence of a sarcomatous mesenchymal component and a benign epithelial component. patients usually present with abnormal vaginal bleeding. it is considered a low grade malignant neoplasm and may recur following resection.

MONDO:0002879.name: uterine body mixed cancer
MONDO:0002879.def: a primary malignant neoplasm of the uterine corpus characterized by the presence of an epithelial and a mesenchymal component. this category includes carcinosarcoma, carcinofibroma, and adenosarcoma.

MONDO:0002880.name: ovarian adenosarcoma
MONDO:0002880.def: a biphasic neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of mullerian-type epithelial tissue in a mesenchymal sarcomatous stroma. the presence of a high grade sarcomatous component is associated with recurrences and metastases.

MONDO:0002881.name: vaginal adenosarcoma
MONDO:0002881.def: a malignant mixed epithelial and mesenchymal neoplasm that arises from the vagina and is characterized by the presence of a malignant mesenchymal component and a benign or atypical mullerian-type epithelial component.

MONDO:0002882.name: colon neuroendocrine neoplasm
MONDO:0002882.def: a neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the colon. it includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

MONDO:0002883.name: intestinal neuroendocrine neoplasm
MONDO:0002883.def: a neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the small or large intestine. it includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

MONDO:0002885.name: erythrasma
MONDO:0002885.def: a chronic bacterial infection of major folds of the skin, caused by corynebacterium minutissimum.

MONDO:0002886.name: common bile duct disorder
MONDO:0002886.def: a disease involving the common bile duct.

MONDO:0002887.name: bile duct disorder
MONDO:0002887.def: a disease involving the bile duct.

MONDO:0002888.name: intraorbital meningioma
MONDO:0002888.def: a meningioma that affects the intraorbital structures.

MONDO:0002889.name: orbital cancer
MONDO:0002889.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the orbit.

MONDO:0002892.name: skull base chordoma
MONDO:0002892.def: a slow-growing malignant bone tumor arising from the remnants of the notochord and occurring in the base of the skull. it is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, myxoid stroma formation, and the presence of physaliphorous cells..

MONDO:0002894.name: spinal chordoma
MONDO:0002894.def: a slow-growing malignant bone tumor arising from the remnants of the notochord and occurring in the spine. it is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, myxoid stroma formation, and the presence of physaliphorous cells.

MONDO:0002896.name: primary syphilis
MONDO:0002896.def: the subclinical or symptomatic stage of syphilis, occurring at an average of three weeks after contact with an infected individual. it manifests with one or more painless, indurated ulcers (chancres) of the skin or mucous membranes at the site of inoculation. these lesions heal spontaneously within a few weeks.

MONDO:0002897.name: secondary syphilis
MONDO:0002897.def: the secondary stage of syphilis typically that is characterized by generalized rash (including palms and soles), mucocutaneous lesions, and lymphadenopathy. it usually begins one to two months after the primary stage.
MONDO:0002897.synonym: secondary syphilis of viscera or bone

MONDO:0002898.name: skin cancer
MONDO:0002898.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the zone of skin

MONDO:0002899.name: differentiating neuroblastoma
MONDO:0002899.def: a neuroblastoma in which the differentiating neuroblasts constitute more than five-percent of the tumor cells.

MONDO:0002900.name: cerebral neuroblastoma
MONDO:0002900.def: a neuroblastoma arising from the cerebral hemispheres.

MONDO:0002903.name: articulation disorder
MONDO:0002903.def: a disorder characterized by the failure to use developmentally expected speech sounds that are appropriate for the individual's age (i.e., the individual makes errors in sound production or use or omits sounds such as final consonants).

MONDO:0002904.name: echolalia
MONDO:0002904.def: a symptom of neurologic or psychiatric dysfunction in which the individual involuntarily and meaninglessly repeats a recently heard word, series of words, or a song.

MONDO:0002905.name: mutism
MONDO:0002905.def: the inability to generate oral-verbal expression, despite normal comprehension of speech. this may be associated with brain diseases or mental disorders. organic mutism may be associated with damage to the frontal lobe; brain stem; thalamus; and cerebellum. selective mutism is a psychological condition that usually affects children characterized by continuous refusal to speak in social situations by a child who is able and willing to speak to selected persons. kussmal aphasia refers to mutism in psychosis.

MONDO:0002907.name: intracranial thrombosis
MONDO:0002907.def: formation or presence of a blood clot (thrombus) in a blood vessel within the skull. intracranial thrombosis can lead to thrombotic occlusions and brain infarction. the majority of the thrombotic occlusions are associated with atherosclerosis.

MONDO:0002908.name: glucose metabolism disease
MONDO:0002908.def: a metabolic disorder characterized by abnormal blood glucose levels.

MONDO:0002909.name: hyperglycemia
MONDO:0002909.def: abnormally high level of glucose in the blood.

MONDO:0002910.name: peroneal neuropathy
MONDO:0002910.def: disease involving the common peroneal nerve or its branches, the deep and superficial peroneal nerves. lesions of the deep peroneal nerve are associated with paralysis of dorsiflexion of the ankle and toes and loss of sensation from the web space between the first and second toe. lesions of the superficial peroneal nerve result in weakness or paralysis of the peroneal muscles (which evert the foot) and loss of sensation over the dorsal and lateral surface of the leg. traumatic injury to the common peroneal nerve near the head of the fibula is a relatively common cause of this condition. (from joynt, clinical neurology, 1995, ch51, p31)

MONDO:0002911.name: brain stem glioma
MONDO:0002911.def: a neuroglial tumor that arises from the brain stem.

MONDO:0002912.name: brainstem cancer
MONDO:0002912.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the brain stem.

MONDO:0002913.name: cerebellar neoplasm
MONDO:0002913.def: a benign or malignant (primary or metastatic) tumor involving the cerebellum. -- 2003

MONDO:0002914.name: childhood brain stem neoplasm
MONDO:0002914.def: a neoplasm that affects the brain stem and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0002915.name: childhood infratentorial neoplasm
MONDO:0002915.def: a neoplasm that affects the infratentorial region of the brain and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0002916.name: brainstem intraparenchymal clear cell meningioma
MONDO:0002916.def: a morphologic variant of meningioma arising from the brain stem. it is characterized by the presence of clear glycogen-rich polygonal cells.
MONDO:0002916.synonym: intraparenchymal clear cell meningioma of the brainstem

MONDO:0002917.name: disorder of pilosebaceous unit
MONDO:0002917.def: a disease that involves the pilosebaceous unit.

MONDO:0002918.name: clear cell meningioma
MONDO:0002918.def: a who grade ii morphologic variant of meningioma characterized by the presence of clear glycogen-rich polygonal cells.

MONDO:0002919.name: posterior cranial fossa meningioma
MONDO:0002919.def: a meningioma that affects the posterior cranial fossa.

MONDO:0002920.name: malignant ovarian brenner tumor
MONDO:0002920.def: a malignant neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of an invasive malignant transitional cell component and nests of benign transitional cells in a fibrotic stroma. when the neoplasm is confined to the ovary, the prognosis is good.

MONDO:0002921.name: congenital structural myopathy
MONDO:0002921.def: a group of rare genetic muscle disorders characterized by hypotonia, muscle weakness, and delayed development of motor skills.

MONDO:0002922.name: pyoderma
MONDO:0002922.def: any skin disease that is pyegenic.

MONDO:0002923.name: uterine corpus endometrial stromal sarcoma
MONDO:0002923.def: a uterine corpus sarcoma originating from the endometrial stroma. it is further subdivided into low grade and high grade endometrial stromal sarcoma.

MONDO:0002924.name: smooth muscle cancer
MONDO:0002924.def: a malignant neoplasm arising from smooth muscle.

MONDO:0002926.name: clear cell sarcoma
MONDO:0002926.def: a rare malignant neoplasm with melanocytic differentiation characterized by the presence of polygonal or spindle shaped clear cells. this sarcoma usually affects the tendons and aponeuroses and is associated with a poor prognosis due to recurrences and metastases.

MONDO:0002927.name: spindle cell sarcoma
MONDO:0002927.def: a malignant mesenchymal neoplasm composed of spindle-shaped cells. this is a morphologic term which can be applied to a wide range of sarcomas.

MONDO:0002928.name: carcinosarcoma
MONDO:0002928.def: a malignant tumor composed of a mixture of carcinomatous and sarcomatous elements.

MONDO:0002934.name: intravascular angioleiomyoma
MONDO:0002934.def: a morphologic variant of angioleiomyoma characterized by the adherence of neoplastic smooth muscle cells to the walls of vascular channels.

MONDO:0002935.name: penis basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002935.def: a basal cell carcinoma of the penis with an indolent clinical course. it is usually superficial and arises from the shaft and rarely the glans.
MONDO:0002935.synonym: skin of penis skin basal cell carcinoma

MONDO:0002936.name: scrotum basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002936.def: a scrotal carcinoma that involves the basal cell.
MONDO:0002936.synonym: skin basal cell carcinoma of scrotum

MONDO:0002937.name: nodular basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002937.def: a basal cell carcinoma of the skin that often appears as elevated nodules which may become ulcerated.

MONDO:0002938.name: metatypical basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002938.def: a skin carcinoma displaying cytological characteristics intermediate to nodular basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma.

MONDO:0002939.name: skin pigmented basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002939.def: a basal cell carcinoma that contains large amounts of melanin. the melanin is produced by symbiotic nontumoral proliferating melanocytes. - 2002.

MONDO:0002940.name: anal margin basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002940.def: a basal cell carcinoma arising from the perianal skin. local excision is the treatment of choice. metastases are extremely rare.
MONDO:0002940.synonym: skin basal cell carcinoma of perianal skin

MONDO:0002941.name: anal margin carcinoma
MONDO:0002941.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the perianal skin

MONDO:0002943.name: external ear basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002943.def: a basal cell carcinoma that arises from the skin of the external ear.
MONDO:0002943.synonym: skin basal cell carcinoma of external ear

MONDO:0002944.name: external ear carcinoma
MONDO:0002944.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the external ear

MONDO:0002945.name: micronodular basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002945.def: a basal cell carcinoma of the skin characterized by the presence of small nodules that permeate the dermis. it presents as an elevated or flat infiltrating tumor, usually in the back.

MONDO:0002946.name: gynatresia
MONDO:0002946.def: a congenital or acquired occlusion of an opening in any part of the female genital tract.

MONDO:0002948.name: skin fibroepithelial basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002948.def: a variant of basal cell carcinoma presenting as an elevated or erythematous nodular lesion usually in the back. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of cords of basaloid cells extending from the epidermis into the dermis, creating a fenestrating pattern. it follows an indolent course.

MONDO:0002949.name: morpheaform basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002949.def: a histologic variant of basal cell carcinoma of the skin characterized by the presence of strands and nests of malignant cells that are embedded in a dense fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0002950.name: skin clear cell basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002950.def: a morphologic variant of basal cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of clear cells.
MONDO:0002950.synonym: skin clear cell basal cell carcinoma

MONDO:0002951.name: skin adenoid basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002951.def: a variant of basal cell carcinoma morphologically characterized by the presence of thin strands of basaloid cells forming a reticulate pattern.

MONDO:0002953.name: skin infiltrative basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002953.def: a variant of basal cell carcinoma presenting as a pale, indurated plaque, usually in the upper trunk or face. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of strands, cords, and columns of basaloid cells infiltrating the dermis. perineural invasion may be present and the basaloid cell infiltrate may extend into deeper tissues.

MONDO:0002954.name: superficial multifocal basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002954.def: a superficial basal cell carcinoma of the skin characterized by the presence of lobules of basaloid cells which are separated by large distances and represent multifocal discrete tumors.

MONDO:0002955.name: vulva basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002955.def: a slow growing, locally infiltrating carcinoma that arises from the vulva. it is characterized by the presence of malignant cells that resemble the basal cells that are present in the epidermis.

MONDO:0002958.name: signet ring basal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0002958.synonym: skin signet ring cell basal cell carcinoma

MONDO:0002959.name: radiculopathy
MONDO:0002959.def: disease involving a spinal nerve root (see spinal nerve roots) which may result from compression related to intervertebral disk displacement; spinal cord injuries; spinal diseases; and other conditions. clinical manifestations include radicular pain, weakness, and sensory loss referable to structures innervated by the involved nerve root.

MONDO:0002960.name: polyradiculopathy
MONDO:0002960.def: a radiculopathy that is present in more than one nerve.

MONDO:0002962.name: epidermolytic acanthoma
MONDO:0002962.def: a benign epithelial verrucous lesion of the skin. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of epidermolytic hyperkeratosis and papillomatosis.

MONDO:0002963.name: acantholytic acanthoma
MONDO:0002963.def: a benign epithelial neoplasm of the skin. it presents as a papular or nodular lesion. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of hyperkeratosis, acanthosis, papillomatosis, and prominent acantholysis.

MONDO:0002965.name: parovarian cyst
MONDO:0002965.def: a cyst (cysts) near the ovary, derived from anomalies of the fallopian tubes or the broad ligament. the paramesonephric type consists of ciliated cells similar to the oviduct epithelium. the mesonephric type consisted of an epithelium with minimally surface structures. they can be found on the thin oviduct (paratubal cysts) or near its fimbriated end (hydatid of morgagni).

MONDO:0002966.name: splenic manifestation of prolymphocytic leukemia
MONDO:0002966.def: a prolymphocytic leukemia that involves the spleen.

MONDO:0002967.name: dermatophytosis of scalp or beard
MONDO:0002967.def: dermatophytosis involving the stratum corneum of the skin of the scalp and beard area.

MONDO:0002968.name: lymphocele
MONDO:0002968.def: a cystic lesion containing lymph. it usually results from injury, gynecologic surgery, or urologic surgery.

MONDO:0002969.name: ciliary body cancer
MONDO:0002969.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the ciliary body.

MONDO:0002970.name: ciliary body disorder
MONDO:0002970.def: a disease involving the ciliary body.

MONDO:0002971.name: amelanotic melanoma
MONDO:0002971.def: a melanoma characterized by the complete absence of melanin pigment in the melanoma cells. it occurs more frequently on the face and it is often associated with desmoplastic reaction.

MONDO:0002972.name: posterior mediastinum cancer
MONDO:0002972.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the posterior mediastinum.

MONDO:0002973.name: epithelioid cell melanoma
MONDO:0002973.def: a melanoma characterized by the presence of malignant large epithelioid melanocytes.

MONDO:0002974.name: cervical cancer
MONDO:0002974.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm involving the cervix.

MONDO:0002975.name: malignant breast melanoma
MONDO:0002975.def: a melanoma that arises usually from the breast skin and less often from the breast glandular tissue. primary breast melanomas are rare.

MONDO:0002976.name: stomach diverticulosis
MONDO:0002976.def: a pathological condition characterized by the presence of a number of gastric diverticula in the stomach.

MONDO:0002977.name: autoimmune disorder of the nervous system
MONDO:0002977.def: a disorder characterized by the degeneration of the nervous system due to autoimmunity. representative examples include multiple sclerosis, guillain-barre syndrome, and myasthenia gravis.

MONDO:0002978.name: orbit alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0002978.def: a malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that arises in the orbit. it is characterized by the presence of round cells with myoblastic differentiation and a fibrovascular stroma.

MONDO:0002979.name: papillary squamous carcinoma
MONDO:0002979.def: a well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma characterized by a papillary, exophytic growth pattern and hyperkeratosis. the most commonly affected anatomic sites are the larynx, penis, cervix, vagina, and vulva.

MONDO:0002981.name: peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor of bone
MONDO:0002981.def: a small round cell tumor with neural differentiation arising from the bone. it may be associated with pain.
MONDO:0002981.synonym: peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumour of bone tissue

MONDO:0002982.name: peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor of soft tissues
MONDO:0002982.def: a small round cell tumor with neural differentiation arising from the soft tissues.

MONDO:0002984.name: reticulohistiocytic granuloma
MONDO:0002984.def: a rare cutaneous lesion composed of eosinophilic histiocytes, which are often multinucleated. the lesions are yellow-brown papules affecting any part of the body. patients are usually adult men. the prognosis is excellent. -- 2003

MONDO:0002985.name: obsolete pustulosis of palm and sole

MONDO:0002987.name: spongiotic dermatitis
MONDO:0002987.def: a chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by itchiness and a rash in the chest and abdominal areas. it affects males more than females and is usually contracted at a relatively young age. it is thought to be caused by an allergic reaction to food, insect bites, or medication.

MONDO:0002988.name: cervix melanoma
MONDO:0002988.def: an aggressive malignant tumor of melanocytic origin that arises from the cervix.
MONDO:0002988.synonym: primary malignant melanoma of the uterine cervix

MONDO:0002989.name: benign fibrous histiocytoma
MONDO:0002989.def: a benign neoplasm composed of fibroblastic spindle cells in a whorled storiform pattern. it is characterized by the presence of foam cells, inflammatory cells, hemosiderin deposition and stromal hemorrhage.

MONDO:0002990.name: benign deep fibrous histiocytoma
MONDO:0002990.def: a rare, well-circumscribed, pseudo-encapsulated benign fibrous histiocytoma that arises entirely within the subcutaneous tissue or deep soft tissue. it usually affects the extremities or the head and neck region. it recurs locally in a minority of cases.

MONDO:0002991.name: adenocarcinofibroma
MONDO:0002991.def: a carcinoma arising from the ovary. it is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma. histologic variants include clear cell, serous, mucinous, and endometrioid adenocarcinofibroma.

MONDO:0002993.name: pancreatic somatostatinoma
MONDO:0002993.def: a neuroendocrine tumor arising from the delta cells of the pancreas. it is characterized by inappropriate secretion of somatostatin and associated with diabetes mellitus, hypochlorhydria, gallbladder disease, diarrhea, steatorrhea, anemia, and weight loss.

MONDO:0002994.name: pancreatic delta cell neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0002994.def: a usually malignant neuroendocrine tumor arising from the delta cells of the pancreas. it may be associated with inappropriate secretion of somatostatin and an associated clinical syndrome, or it may be hormonally inactive (non-functioning).

MONDO:0002995.name: small intestine neuroendocrine tumor, well differentiated, low or intermediate grade
MONDO:0002995.def: a well differentiated, low or intermediate grade tumor with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the small intestine.

MONDO:0002996.name: cavernous sinus meningioma
MONDO:0002996.def: a meningioma that affects the cavernous sinus.

MONDO:0002997.name: anterior cranial fossa meningioma
MONDO:0002997.def: a meningioma that affects the anterior cranial fossa.

MONDO:0002998.name: skull base meningioma
MONDO:0002998.def: a meningioma that arises from the skull base.

MONDO:0002999.name: central nervous system germinoma
MONDO:0002999.def: a malignant germ cell tumor arising from the central nervous system. it is composed of uniform cells resembling primitive germ cells. these cells have large, vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and a clear, glycogen-rich cytoplasm. additional features are lymphoid or lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates and, less frequently, scattered syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells. (adapted from who)

MONDO:0003000.name: central nervous system germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003000.def: a unique group of rare tumors of the central nervous system that affect mainly children and adolescents. their morphologic and biologic profile corresponds to that of homologous germ cell tumors that arise in the gonads and in other extragonadal sites. representative examples include: germinoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma.
MONDO:0003000.synonym: germ cell tumour of the cns

MONDO:0003001.name: seminoma
MONDO:0003001.def: a radiosensitive malignant germ cell tumor found in the testis (especially undescended), and extragonadal sites (anterior mediastinum and pineal gland). it is characterized by the presence of uniform cells with clear or dense cytoplasm which contains glycogen, and by a large nucleus which contains one or more nucleoli. the neoplastic germ cells form aggregates separated by fibrous septa. the fibrous septa contain chronic inflammatory cells, mainly lymphocytes.

MONDO:0003002.name: dysgerminoma
MONDO:0003002.def: a malignant germ cell tumor characterized by the presence of a monotonous primitive germ cell population. the neoplastic cells form aggregates and have an abundant pale cytoplasm and uniform nuclei. the aggregates of the germ cells are separated by fibrous septa which contain inflammatory cells, mostly t-lymphocytes. it arises primarily in the ovaries, but can occur both primarily and secondarily at other sites, particularly the central nervous system. it responds to chemotherapy and radiotherapy. its prognosis is related to the tumor stage.

MONDO:0003003.name: cervical alveolar soft part sarcoma
MONDO:0003003.def: an alveolar soft part sarcoma arising from the cervix.

MONDO:0003004.name: macular degeneration
MONDO:0003004.def: loss of vision in the central portion of the retina (macula), secondary to retinal degeneration.

MONDO:0003005.name: macular retinal edema
MONDO:0003005.def: accumulation of intraretinal fluid and protein in the macula, which may result in swelling and decreased central vision.

MONDO:0003007.name: childhood kidney cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003007.def: a renal cell carcinoma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003008.name: hereditary renal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003008.def: an instance of renal cell carcinoma (disease) that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

MONDO:0003009.name: hyperaldosteronism
MONDO:0003009.def: overproduction of aldosterone by the adrenal glands, which may lead to hypokalemia and/or hypernatremia.

MONDO:0003010.name: multilocular clear cell renal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003010.def: a rare type of renal cell carcinoma. it is a well-circumscribed multicystic mass without solid areas. the inner lining of the cystic structures is composed of clear cells.

MONDO:0003011.name: mucinous tubular and spindle renal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003011.def: a low grade carcinoma of the kidney characterized by the presence of tubules which are separated by mucinous stroma. often the tubular structures have a spindle cell appearance. patients are usually asymptomatic and occasionally they may present with hematuria or flank pain.
MONDO:0003011.synonym: renal mucinous tubular spindle cell carcinoma

MONDO:0003012.name: sarcomatoid renal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003012.def: a high grade carcinoma of the kidney. it is not a distinct clinicopathological entity and includes a diverse group of renal cell carcinomas which have been transformed from a lower to a higher grade.

MONDO:0003014.name: rhinitis
MONDO:0003014.def: an inflammation of the mucous membrane lining the nose, usually associated with nasal discharge.

MONDO:0003017.name: malignant peritoneal solitary fibrous tumor
MONDO:0003017.def: a malignant form of peritoneal solitary fibrous tumor.
MONDO:0003017.synonym: pleural and peritoneal solitary fibrous tumour

MONDO:0003019.name: potassium deficiency disease
MONDO:0003019.def: any disorder caused by an insufficient amount or availability of potassium, which generally manifests with myalgia, tetany, hypotension, polyuria, and polydipsia.

MONDO:0003021.name: central nervous system angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003021.def: a malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the brain, spinal cord or meninges.

MONDO:0003023.name: aorta angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003023.def: a malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the aorta.

MONDO:0003024.name: breast angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003024.def: a malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the breast.

MONDO:0003025.name: conventional angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003025.def: an angiosarcoma characterized by the presence of malignant spindle endothelial cells.

MONDO:0003026.name: gallbladder angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003026.def: an angiosarcoma that is located in the gallbladder.

MONDO:0003027.name: thyroid gland angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003027.def: a usually aggressive malignant vascular tumor primarily involving the thyroid gland. it is often associated with longstanding nodular goiter.

MONDO:0003028.name: thyroid sarcoma
MONDO:0003028.def: a malignant soft tissue neoplasm primarily involving the thyroid gland.

MONDO:0003029.name: skin angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003029.def: a malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the skin.

MONDO:0003030.name: endometrioid stromal sarcoma of the cervix
MONDO:0003030.def: a rare sarcoma that arises from the cervix. this category includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated endocervical sarcoma.

MONDO:0003031.name: endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms of the cervix
MONDO:0003031.def: a category of rare neoplasms that arise from the cervix. it includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated endocervical sarcoma.
MONDO:0003031.synonym: endometrioid stromal and related tumours of the cervix

MONDO:0003032.name: superior vena cava angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003032.def: a malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the superior vena cava.

MONDO:0003033.name: prostate angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003033.def: a malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the prostate.

MONDO:0003034.name: mediastinum angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003034.def: a malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the mediastinum.

MONDO:0003035.name: ovarian angiosarcoma
MONDO:0003035.def: a malignant vascular neoplasm arising from the ovary.

MONDO:0003036.name: mucoepidermoid carcinoma
MONDO:0003036.def: a carcinoma morphologically characterized the presence of cuboidal mucous cells, goblet-like mucous cells, squamoid cells, cystic changes, and a fibrotic stromal formation. it can occur in several anatomic sites, including parotid gland, oral cavity, paranasal sinus, skin, breast, lung, larynx, and lacrimal ducts. it is classified as low or high grade.

MONDO:0003037.name: hypotrichosis
MONDO:0003037.def: a congenital condition, usually due to genetic aberrations, that is characterized by a lack of hair growth on the head and/or body.

MONDO:0003038.name: dysgraphia
MONDO:0003038.def: loss or impairment of the ability to write (letters, syllables, words, or phrases) due to an injury to a specific cerebral area or occasionally due to emotional factors. this condition rarely occurs in isolation, and often accompanies aphasia. (from adams et al., principles of neurology, 6th ed, p485; apa, thesaurus of psychological index terms, 1994)

MONDO:0003039.name: nominal aphasia
MONDO:0003039.def: impaired ability to retrieve words; in particular, an inability to recall the names of objects and people.

MONDO:0003040.name: retrograde amnesia
MONDO:0003040.def: the loss of access to memories that were previously encoded; this disorder is most commonly preceded by trauma, including physical brain injury, stroke, or seizure, but may also be psychogenic in origin. memory loss may be temporary or permanent, but the ability to encode new memories or skills is not generally affected.

MONDO:0003041.name: pediatric mesenchymal chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003041.def: a mesenchymal chondrosarcoma occurring in children.

MONDO:0003042.name: adult mesenchymal chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003042.def: a mesenchymal chondrosarcoma occurring in adults.

MONDO:0003043.name: obsolete extraskeletal mesenchymal chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003043.def: obsolete. a rare malignant tumor of soft tissue characterized by a bimorphic pattern composed of undifferentiated small round cells and islands of well differentiated hyaline cartilage.

MONDO:0003044.name: obsolete extraosseous chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003044.def: obsolete. a chondrosarcoma that is located in exclusively soft tissue.

MONDO:0003045.name: anal gland neoplasm
MONDO:0003045.def: tumors or cancer of the anal gland.
MONDO:0003045.synonym: tumour of gland of anal canal

MONDO:0003046.name: anus neoplasm
MONDO:0003046.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the anal canal or anal margin. representative examples of benign neoplasms include squamous papilloma and papillary hidradenoma. representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, lymphoma, and melanoma.

MONDO:0003047.name: thymic large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0003047.def: an aggressive, non-small cell, poorly differentiated thymic neuroendocrine carcinoma, characterized by the presence of a high mitotic rate and, almost always, necrosis.

MONDO:0003049.name: ovarian large-cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0003049.def: a carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells exhibiting neuroendocrine differentiation. the prognosis is poor.

MONDO:0003050.name: lung large cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003050.def: a poorly differentiated non-small cell lung carcinoma composed of large polygonal cells without evidence of glandular or squamous differentiation. there is a male predilection.

MONDO:0003051.name: non specific chronic endometritis
MONDO:0003051.def: chronic endometritis characterized by the presence of plasmacytic infiltrates in the endometrium. there are no granulomas present.

MONDO:0003052.name: granulomatous endometritis
MONDO:0003052.def: chronic inflammation of the endometrium characterized by the presence of epithelioid granulomas. causes include tuberculosis, fungal infections, parasitic infections, and sarcoidosis.

MONDO:0003053.name: choroid plexus meningioma
MONDO:0003053.def: a meningioma that affects the choroid plexus.

MONDO:0003054.name: benign meningioma
MONDO:0003054.def: a grade i, slowly growing meningioma. only a minority of tumors recur following complete resection.

MONDO:0003055.name: secretory meningioma
MONDO:0003055.def: a who grade i meningioma characterized by the presence of epithelial differentiation and numerous intracellular pas positive bodies that are rich in glycogen.

MONDO:0003056.name: lymphoplasmacyte-rich meningioma
MONDO:0003056.def: a who grade i meningioma characterized by the presence of prominent chronic inflammatory infiltrates that predominate over the meningioma cells.

MONDO:0003057.name: pediatric meningioma
MONDO:0003057.def: a meningioma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003058.name: microcystic meningioma
MONDO:0003058.def: a who grade i meningioma characterized by the presence of intercellular microcystic spaces that contain mucinous fluid.

MONDO:0003059.name: bile duct cancer
MONDO:0003059.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the bile duct
MONDO:0003059.synonym: malignant neoplasm of the extrahepatic bile duct

MONDO:0003060.name: biliary tract cancer
MONDO:0003060.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the biliary tree

MONDO:0003061.name: benign muscle neoplasm
MONDO:0003061.def: a benign mesenchymal neoplasm arising from smooth, skeletal, or cardiac muscle tissue.

MONDO:0003062.name: intestinal benign neoplasm
MONDO:0003062.def: a benign neoplasm that involves the intestine.

MONDO:0003064.name: inverted transitional cell papilloma
MONDO:0003064.def: a benign papillary neoplasm composed of transitional cells and characterized by an endophytic growth pattern.

MONDO:0003065.name: nasal cavity inverting papilloma
MONDO:0003065.def: a benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the nasal cavity. it results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma. clinical manifestations include nasal obstruction, epistaxis, and anosmia. it has the tendency to recur and extend to adjacent structures. inverted papillomas are occasionally associated with the development or presence of carcinomas, usually squamous cell carcinomas.
MONDO:0003065.synonym: nasal cavity schneiderian papilloma, inverted type

MONDO:0003066.name: submandibular adenitis
MONDO:0003066.def: inflammation of the submandibular lymph nodes.

MONDO:0003067.name: cervical lymphadenitis
MONDO:0003067.def: inflammation of the cervical lymph nodes.

MONDO:0003068.name: postauricular lymphadenitis
MONDO:0003068.def: inflammation of the postauricular lymph nodes.

MONDO:0003069.name: suppurative lymphadenitis
MONDO:0003069.def: a form of lymphadenitis that is characterized by formation of pus; it is most often caused by staphylococcal or streptococcal bacteria.

MONDO:0003070.name: axillary lymphadenitis
MONDO:0003070.def: an infection of the lymph nodes in the axilla.

MONDO:0003072.name: retinal cancer
MONDO:0003072.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the retina.

MONDO:0003073.name: trilateral retinoblastoma
MONDO:0003073.def: trilateral retinoblastoma refers to bilateral (or less often unilateral) retinoblastoma associated with an intracranial primitive neuroectodermal tumor in the pineal or suprasellar region. this syndrome is often associated with a increased familial incidence of retinoblastoma. (from cancer 86(1): 135-141, 1999).

MONDO:0003075.name: bilateral retinoblastoma
MONDO:0003075.def: retinoblastoma involving both eyes. this occurs in the majority of patients with the inherited variant. a minority of patient with bilateral retinoblastoma were found to have involvement of the pineal gland as well.

MONDO:0003076.name: unilateral retinoblastoma
MONDO:0003076.def: a retinoblastoma that only involves a single eye.

MONDO:0003078.name: extraocular retinoblastoma
MONDO:0003078.def: retinoblastoma that has spread beyond the eye e.g. to brain, soft tissue/bone, bone marrow.

MONDO:0003079.name: mastocytoma
MONDO:0003079.def: a localized tumor composed of sheets of mast cells without atypia. it includes the cutaneous mastocytoma which involves the dermis and subcutaneous tissue, and the extracutaneous mastocytoma. most cases of extracutaneous mastocytoma have been reported in the lung.

MONDO:0003081.name: thalamic disorder
MONDO:0003081.def: a disorder of the thalamus. causes include brain neoplasms, cerebrovascular disorders, brain trauma, brain hypoxia, infections, and brain hemorrhage. signs and symptoms include movement and sensory abnormalities, visual abnormalities, ataxia, and coma.
MONDO:0003081.synonym: dorsal plus ventral thalamus disease or disorder

MONDO:0003083.name: venous hemangioma
MONDO:0003083.def: a rare slow growing benign tumor of aberrant and ectatic venous connections.

MONDO:0003085.name: keratitis
MONDO:0003085.def: a corneal disease that is characterized by inflammation of the cornea.

MONDO:0003086.name: thymic mucoepidermoid carcinoma
MONDO:0003086.def: a rare primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of squamous cells, intermediate type cells, and mucus-producing cells. published information on clinical course is limited to single-case reports.

MONDO:0003087.name: mucoepidermoid breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003087.def: a carcinoma of the breast characterized by pools of mucin and islands of malignant squamous cells. mucoepidermoid carcinomas of the breast are extremely rare.

MONDO:0003088.name: intramuscular hemangioma
MONDO:0003088.def: a hemangioma arising from skeletal muscle.

MONDO:0003089.name: extrahepatic bile duct mucoepidermoid carcinoma
MONDO:0003089.def: a mucoepidermoid carcinoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts.
MONDO:0003089.synonym: mucoepidermoid carcinoma of the bile duct

MONDO:0003090.name: extrahepatic bile duct carcinoma
MONDO:0003090.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the extrahepatic bile duct.

MONDO:0003091.name: cutaneous mucoepidermoid carcinoma
MONDO:0003091.def: a mucoepidermoid carcinoma that involves the zone of skin.

MONDO:0003092.name: lacrimal gland mucoepidermoid carcinoma
MONDO:0003092.def: an extremely rare carcinoma that arises from the lacrimal gland. it is characterized by the presence of infiltrating nests of epidermoid cells and mucus producing cells.
MONDO:0003092.synonym: mucoepidermoid carcinoma of the lacrimal gland

MONDO:0003093.name: mucoepidermoid esophageal carcinoma
MONDO:0003093.def: a rare carcinoma of the esophagus which contains squamous cells, mucus secreting cells, and cells of an intermediate type. (who)

MONDO:0003095.name: laryngeal mucoepidermoid carcinoma
MONDO:0003095.def: a rare mucoepidermoid carcinoma of the larynx. it usually arises from the supraglottic area. hoarseness and dysphagia are the presenting symptoms.

MONDO:0003096.name: deep hemangioma
MONDO:0003096.def: a hemangioma arising from the deep soft tissues.

MONDO:0003097.name: childhood mediastinal neurogenic neoplasm
MONDO:0003097.synonym: pediatric neurogenic tumor of the mediastinum

MONDO:0003098.name: mediastinal neural neoplasm
MONDO:0003098.def: a neurogenic tumor that arises from the mediastinum. neural tumors are the most common tumors that arise from the posterior mediastinum. representative examples include schwannoma, neurofibroma, and neuroblastoma.

MONDO:0003100.name: nerve plexus neoplasm
MONDO:0003100.def: a neoplasm (disease) that involves the nerve plexus.

MONDO:0003103.name: nerve root neoplasm
MONDO:0003103.def: benign and malignant neoplasms arising from one or more of the cervical, thoracic, lumbar, sacral, or coccygeal nerve roots. the majority of these tumors are benign. clinical manifestations may include pain, weakness and loss of sensation along the course of the involved nerve root. large tumors may cause spinal cord compression.

MONDO:0003104.name: epicardium cancer
MONDO:0003104.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the epicardium.

MONDO:0003105.name: prostate disorder
MONDO:0003105.def: a disease involving the prostate gland.

MONDO:0003107.name: infratentorial cancer
MONDO:0003107.def: malignant neoplasms which arise or occur within the intracranial cavity below the tentorium cerebelli. this includes neoplasms within the brain and/or surrounding spaces.

MONDO:0003109.name: foramen magnum meningioma
MONDO:0003109.def: a meningioma that affects the foramen magnum.

MONDO:0003110.name: skin hemangioma
MONDO:0003110.def: a hemangioma arising from the skin.

MONDO:0003111.name: gastric neuroendocrine neoplasm
MONDO:0003111.def: a neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the stomach. it includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

MONDO:0003112.name: malignant gastric germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003112.def: a malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the stomach. it includes choriocarcinoma and immature teratoma.
MONDO:0003112.synonym: malignant germ cell tumour of the stomach

MONDO:0003113.name: extragonadal germ cell cancer
MONDO:0003113.def: a malignant germ cell tumor that develops as a primary tumor in an anatomic site other than the testis or ovary.

MONDO:0003115.name: subglottic hemangioma
MONDO:0003115.def: a hemangioma arising from the subglottic area.

MONDO:0003117.name: somatoform disorder
MONDO:0003117.def: a category of psychiatric disorders which are characterized by the presence of physical symptoms that suggest a medical condition but are not fully explained by any known medical reasons.

MONDO:0003118.name: testicular brenner tumor
MONDO:0003118.def: an uncommon usually benign neoplasm that arises from the testis. it is characterized by the presence of cysts lined by transitional cells and solid nests of transitional cells in a spindle cell stroma.

MONDO:0003120.name: mixed testicular germ cell cancer
MONDO:0003120.def: a malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of more than one histologic component. representative examples include mixed choriocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma, mixed embryonal carcinoma and seminoma, and mixed yolk sac tumor and teratoma.

MONDO:0003121.name: middle cranial fossa meningioma
MONDO:0003121.def: a meningioma that affects the middle cranial fossa.

MONDO:0003122.name: striatonigral degeneration
MONDO:0003122.def: a progressive neurodegenerative disorder caused by a disruption in the connection between the striatum and the substantia nigra. it is a type of multiple system atrophy (msa). signs and symptoms include rigidity, instability, impaired speech, and slow movements.

MONDO:0003124.name: testicular leydig cell tumor
MONDO:0003124.def: a sex cord-stromal tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of cells that resemble the successive stages of development of leydig cells. it usually presents as a painless testicular mass. gynecomastia is present in approximately thirty percent of the cases. libido may be decreased. in children, precocious puberty may be present. a minority of cases exhibit malignant characteristics.

MONDO:0003125.name: testicular sex cord-stromal neoplasm
MONDO:0003125.def: a benign or malignant tumor that arises from the testis. it is composed of granulosa cells, leydig cells, sertoli cells, and fibroblasts. each of these cell types may constitute the only cellular component that is present in the tumor or it may be mixed with other cell types in various combinations. the prognosis can not always be predicted on histologic grounds alone. approximately, ten percent of these tumors may metastasize. representative examples include granulosa cell tumor, leydig cell tumor, sertoli cell tumor, and tumors of the thecoma-fibroma group.

MONDO:0003126.name: breast hemangioma
MONDO:0003126.def: a capillary or cavernous hemangioma arising from the breast.

MONDO:0003128.name: classic pulmonary blastoma
MONDO:0003128.def: a pulmonary blastoma composed of a mixture of irregular tubular structures and mesenchymal elements.

MONDO:0003129.name: epithelial predominant pulmonary blastoma
MONDO:0003129.def: a non-encapsulated, well defined pulmonary blastoma, composed of irregular tubular structures. it affects mostly middle-aged adults and it is rare in children. the prognosis is better compared to the biphasic pulmonary blastoma.

MONDO:0003130.name: mesoblastic nephroma
MONDO:0003130.def: a solid, unencapsulated tumor of the kidney composed of spindle mesenchymal cells that resemble fibroblasts or muscle cells. the homogeneous mass typically extends into the renal parenchyma and replaces most of the kidney. in most cases, mesoblastic nephroma is benign and occurs in the fetus or newborn, and rarely in the older child or the adult.

MONDO:0003133.name: exudative glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0003133.def: inflammation of the glomeruli with infiltration by polymorphonuclear leukocytes.

MONDO:0003134.name: proliferative glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0003134.def: a constellation of renal disorders characterized by an increase number of cells in the glomerulus; these disorders generally present with nephrotic syndrome, and generally progress to end stage renal failure over a matter of weeks to years, depending on the etiology. examples include iga nephropathy, membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis, and rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis.

MONDO:0003135.name: focal embolic glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0003135.def: inflammation of a specific segment of glomeruli, which is associated with subacute bacterial endocarditis, and frequently produces microscopic hematuria without azotemia.

MONDO:0003136.name: anti-basement membrane glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0003136.def: inflammation of the glomeruli secondary to presence of autoantibodies directed at specific antigenic targets within the glomerular basement membrane, causing hematuria, proteinuria, and impaired renal function.

MONDO:0003137.name: diffuse glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0003137.def: inflammation of the glomeruli, in which all glomeruli are affected, resulting in renal failure.

MONDO:0003138.name: subacute glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0003138.def: a term that refers to glomerular damage resulting in hematuria, proteinuria, and azotemia. the histopathologic changes include rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis and membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis.

MONDO:0003139.name: mesangial proliferative glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0003139.def: mesangial proliferative glomerulonephritis (mpgn) is a condition that affects the kidneys. many experts consider it a variant of minimal change disease, but some experts believe it is a separate condition. it may present with nephrotic syndrome, which is a group of symptoms that include protein in the urine (proteinuria), low blood protein levels, high cholesterol levels, high triglyceride levels, and swelling. it can also present with blood in the urine (hematuria). mpgn is characterized by an increased number of mesangial cells in the glomeruli in the kidneys and damage to the glomeruli. glomeruli are the structures that help filter wastes and fluids. mpgn may occur in several renal diseases such as iga nephropathy (commonly), igm nephropathy, lupus nephritis, and c1q nephropathy.however, in some cases, the underlying cause of mpgn remains unclear. treatment may depend on the cause (if known) and may include steroids, mycophenolate mofetil, and/or cyclophosphamide, and other therapies to treat specific symptoms. most people with mpgn have a good prognosis, but some may develop chronic kidney disease, which can progress to end stage renal failure.

MONDO:0003140.name: immune-complex glomerulonephritis
MONDO:0003140.def: inflammation of the glomeruli characterized by the accumulation of antibody-antigen immune complexes, resulting in glomerular damage and impaired kidney function.

MONDO:0003141.name: cerebellopontine angle embryonal tumor
MONDO:0003141.def: a central nervous system embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified arising from the cerebellopontine angle of the infratentorial brain.
MONDO:0003141.synonym: primitive neuroectodermal tumour of the cerebellopontine angle

MONDO:0003142.name: intracranial primitive neuroectodermal tumor
MONDO:0003142.def: a primitive neuroectodermal tumor that involves the brain.

MONDO:0003143.name: angiokeratoma
MONDO:0003143.def: a vascular lesion in the papillary dermis resulting from ectasia of pre-existing vessels. it is associated with secondary proliferative changes in the overlying epidermis (hyperkeratosis). it can present with widespread lesions (angiokeratoma corporis diffusum, often associated with inborn errors of metabolism) or as a localized lesion (angiokeratoma of fordyce, angiokeratoma circumscriptum, and angiokeratoma of mibelli).

MONDO:0003144.name: medulloepithelioma
MONDO:0003144.def: a rare, usually aggressive malignant embryonal neoplasm of the central nervous system occurring in children. it is characterized by the presence of neuroepithelial cells which form papillary, trabecular, or tubular structures and absence of c19mc amplification. symptoms include headache, nausea, and vomiting.

MONDO:0003145.name: supratentorial primitive neuroectodermal tumor
MONDO:0003145.def: a central nervous system embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified arising from the supratentorial region.

MONDO:0003147.name: space motion sickness
MONDO:0003147.def: disorder characterized by nausea, vomiting, and dizziness, possibly in response to vestibular disorientation or fluid shifts associated with space flight. (from webster's new world dictionary)

MONDO:0003150.name: male reproductive system disorder
MONDO:0003150.def: a disease involving the male reproductive system.

MONDO:0003153.name: adult brainstem glioma
MONDO:0003153.def: a brain stem glioma that occurs in an adult.
MONDO:0003153.synonym: glioma of the adult brain stem

MONDO:0003154.name: hemangioma of peripheral nerve
MONDO:0003154.def: a hemangioma arising from the peripheral nerves.

MONDO:0003155.name: cavernous hemangioma
MONDO:0003155.def: a hemangioma characterized by the presence of cavernous vascular spaces.

MONDO:0003157.name: disappearing bone disease
MONDO:0003157.def: syndromes of bone destruction where the cause is not obvious such as neoplasia, infection, or trauma. the destruction follows various patterns: massive (gorham disease), multicentric (hajdu-cheney syndrome), or carpal/tarsal.

MONDO:0003158.name: malignant myoepithelioma
MONDO:0003158.def: an infiltrating malignant tumor characterized by the presence of atypical cells with myoepithelial differentiation. representative examples include malignant breast myoepithelioma and salivary gland myoepithelial carcinoma.

MONDO:0003159.name: vascular hemostatic disease
MONDO:0003159.def: pathological processes involving the integrity of blood circulation. hemostasis depends on the integrity of blood vessels, blood fluidity, and blood coagulation. majority of the hemostatic disorders are caused by disruption of the normal interaction between the vascular endothelium, the plasma proteins (including blood coagulation factors), and platelets.

MONDO:0003160.name: obsolete sebaceous carcinoma
MONDO:0003160.def: obsolete. an adenocarcinoma with sebaceous differentiation. it presents as a painless mass and it may be multifocal. it grows in the ocular adnexae and in the skin of head and neck, trunk, genitals, and extremities. it is characterized by the presence of malignant cells with multivesicular and clear cytoplasm. it may recur and metastasize.

MONDO:0003164.name: cauda equina neoplasm
MONDO:0003164.def: a neoplasm involving a cauda equina.

MONDO:0003165.name: cerebellar astrocytoma
MONDO:0003165.def: benign and malignant neoplasms of the cerebellum that arise from astrocytes. during childhood the majority are benign pilocytic astrocytomas. in adults both benign and relatively higher grade forms may occur. the most common presenting symptoms are headache, nausea, vomiting, ataxia of gait or limb, paresis, diplopia, and dizziness. objective signs include weakness, long tract signs, dysmetria, gait ataxia, papilledema, and nystagmus. surgical resection is often curative.

MONDO:0003168.name: cerebellar pilocytic astrocytoma
MONDO:0003168.def: a who grade 1 astrocytoma which arises in the cerebellum. the tumor is composed of spindle shaped cells with numerous collections of reddish astrocytic fibers called rosenthal fibers. over 80% or the cerebellar astrocytomas of childhood are pilocytic. pilocytic astrocytomas may rarely occur in adults. they are usually treated by surgical resection and in most cases have a favorable prognosis.

MONDO:0003169.name: diencephalic astrocytomas
MONDO:0003169.def: a astrocytoma that involves the diencephalon.

MONDO:0003170.name: gliofibroma
MONDO:0003170.def: an astrocytic tumor affecting young people. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of collagenous tissue surrounding neoplastic astrocytes. in some cases the collagen is produced by the tumor cells (desmoplastic astrocytoma), whereas in others it is produced by mesenchymal cells (mixed glioma/fibroma).

MONDO:0003171.name: pineal gland astrocytoma
MONDO:0003171.def: a astrocytoma that involves the pineal body.

MONDO:0003173.name: brain stem astrocytic neoplasm
MONDO:0003173.def: an astrocytoma that arises from the brain stem.

MONDO:0003174.name: spinal cord astrocytoma
MONDO:0003174.def: a low or high grade astrocytoma that arises in the spinal cord.

MONDO:0003175.name: salivary gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
MONDO:0003175.def: an adenoid cystic carcinoma arising from the salivary gland. it is characterized by the presence of epithelial and myoepithelial cells forming tubular, cribriform, and solid patterns. it usually presents as a slow growing mass. patients may experience pain because of the tumor propensity for perineural invasion. the tumor may follow an aggressive clinical course with recurrences and mestastases to distant sites including lungs, bones, brain, and liver.

MONDO:0003177.name: prostate adenoid cystic carcinoma
MONDO:0003177.def: an adenoid cystic carcinoma that arises from the prostate gland.

MONDO:0003179.name: obsolete lacrimal gland adenoid cystic carcinoma

MONDO:0003180.name: cutaneous adenocystic carcinoma
MONDO:0003180.def: a adenoid cystic carcinoma that involves the skin of body.
MONDO:0003180.synonym: skin of body adenoid cystic carcinoma

MONDO:0003181.name: lung adenoid cystic carcinoma
MONDO:0003181.def: a rare usually indolent lung carcinoma characterized by a cribiform and tubular pattern and the presence of glandular epithelial cells. clinical symptoms include shortness of breath, cough, wheeze, hemopytsis and chest pain.

MONDO:0003182.name: anterior horn disorder
MONDO:0003182.def: anterior horn disease is one of a number of medical disorders affecting the anterior horn of the spinal cord. anterior horn diseases include spinal muscular atrophy, poliomyelitis and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
MONDO:0003182.synonym: ventral horn of spinal cord disease or disorder

MONDO:0003184.name: trachea carcinoma
MONDO:0003184.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the trachea.

MONDO:0003185.name: adenoid cystic breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003185.def: an adenoid cystic carcinoma primarily involving the breast. three morphologic patterns are seen: cribriform, trabecular, and solid. the prognosis is excellent.

MONDO:0003186.name: esophageal adenoid cystic carcinoma
MONDO:0003186.def: an infrequent esophageal carcinoma arising from esophageal glands. (who)

MONDO:0003187.name: bartholin gland adenoid cystic carcinoma
MONDO:0003187.def: a carcinoma that arises from the bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of islands of uniform malignant cells forming cribriform patterns.
MONDO:0003187.synonym: major vestibular gland adenoid cystic carcinoma

MONDO:0003189.name: middle ear adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003189.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the middle ear

MONDO:0003190.name: middle ear carcinoma
MONDO:0003190.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the middle ear

MONDO:0003191.name: rete ovarii adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003191.def: an exceptionally rare adenocarcinoma that arises from the rete ovarii.

MONDO:0003192.name: rete ovarii neoplasm
MONDO:0003192.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from the rete ovarii which is located in the ovarian hilus. it includes adenoma, cystadenoma, cystadenofibroma, and adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0003193.name: bile duct adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003193.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the bile duct

MONDO:0003194.name: hemangioma of lung
MONDO:0003194.def: a hemangioma that involves the lung.

MONDO:0003195.name: peritoneal serous adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003195.def: a rare, serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the lining of the peritoneum. it affects females. the clinical behavior and pathologic characteristics are similar to the serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary.

MONDO:0003196.name: appendix carcinoma
MONDO:0003196.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the vermiform appendix

MONDO:0003197.name: granular cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003197.def: an adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with granular cytoplasm.

MONDO:0003198.name: small intestine adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003198.def: an adenocarcinoma that arises from the small intestine. histologic variants include mucinous adenocarcinoma and signet ring cell carcinoma.

MONDO:0003199.name: anal carcinoma
MONDO:0003199.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the anus

MONDO:0003200.name: urethra adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003200.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the urethra

MONDO:0003204.name: villous adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003204.def: an adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of a villous architectural pattern. it may arise from a villous adenoma.

MONDO:0003205.name: renal pelvis adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003205.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the renal pelvis

MONDO:0003206.name: acquired hemangioma
MONDO:0003206.def: a hemangioma that is not present at birth but develops later in life.

MONDO:0003208.name: breast secretory carcinoma
MONDO:0003208.def: a rare, low grade invasive adenocarcinoma of the breast characterized by the presence of cells that secrete milk-like material. morphologically, it usually appears as a circumscribed lesion, composed of cystic spaces, tubular structures, and solid areas.

MONDO:0003209.name: thymus gland adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003209.def: a rare primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of carcinoma cells with glandular differentiation.

MONDO:0003210.name: intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
MONDO:0003210.def: a carcinoma that arises from the intrahepatic bile duct epithelium in any site of the intrahepatic biliary tree. grossly, the malignant lesions are solid, nodular, and grayish. morphologically, the vast majority of cases are adenocarcinomas. signs and symptoms include malaise, weight loss, right upper quadrant abdominal pain, and night sweats. early detection is difficult and the prognosis is generally poor.

MONDO:0003211.name: nasal cavity adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003211.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the nasal cavity

MONDO:0003212.name: nasal cavity carcinoma
MONDO:0003212.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the nasal cavity

MONDO:0003214.name: apocrine adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003214.def: a carcinoma with apocrine differentiation arising from the sweat glands. it presents as single or multiple nodular lesions which may be ulcerated or hemorrhagic and is usually in the axilla and less often in the anogenital region. it grows in the dermis and infiltrates subcutaneous tissues. it is characterized by the presence of large cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and large often vesicular nuclei. most cases are slow growing tumors and have a prolonged course.

MONDO:0003215.name: apocrine sweat gland cancer
MONDO:0003215.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the apocrine sweat gland.
MONDO:0003215.synonym: malignant neoplasm of apocrine sweat gland

MONDO:0003216.name: ureter adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003216.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the ureter

MONDO:0003218.name: adenocarcinoma in situ
MONDO:0003218.def: a lesion in which the normally situated glands are partially or completely replaced by atypical cells with malignant characteristics.

MONDO:0003219.name: gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003219.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the esophagogastric junction.
