MONDO:0003220.name: gallbladder carcinoma
MONDO:0003220.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the gall bladder

MONDO:0003222.name: central nervous system melanocytic neoplasm
MONDO:0003222.def: a primary tumor of the central nervous system that arises from leptomeningeal melanocytes. it may present as a diffuse proliferative leptomeningeal process (often as a component of the neurocutaneous melanosis complex) or as a distinct mass lesion.
MONDO:0003222.synonym: primary melanocytic lesions of the cns

MONDO:0003223.name: meninges hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0003223.def: a solitary fibrous tumor/hemangiopericytoma that arises from the meninges.

MONDO:0003225.name: bone marrow disorder
MONDO:0003225.def: any disease of the bone marrow.

MONDO:0003227.name: prosopagnosia
MONDO:0003227.def: impaired ability to recognize other human faces in the absence of a vision disorder. it may be a congenital disorder or the result of brain injury.

MONDO:0003230.name: obsolete extraosseous ewings sarcoma-primitive neuroepithelial tumor

MONDO:0003231.name: acute nonparalytic poliomyelitis
MONDO:0003231.def: a poliomyelitis that does not exhibit paralysis.

MONDO:0003232.name: alcoholic pancreatitis
MONDO:0003232.def: acute or chronic inflammation of the pancreas due to excessive alcohol drinking. alcoholic pancreatitis usually presents as an acute episode but it is a chronic progressive disease in alcoholics.

MONDO:0003233.name: essential tremor
MONDO:0003233.def: a relatively common disorder characterized by a fairly specific pattern of tremors which are most prominent in the upper extremities and neck, inducing titubations of the head. the tremor is usually mild, but when severe may be disabling. an autosomal dominant pattern of inheritance may occur in some families (i.e., familial tremor). (mov disord 1988;13(1):5-10)

MONDO:0003234.name: optic nerve astrocytoma
MONDO:0003234.def: a astrocytoma (excluding glioblastoma) that involves the cranial nerve ii.

MONDO:0003235.name: optic nerve glioma
MONDO:0003235.def: a glioma that affects the optic nerve. this condition can be seen in association with neurofibromatosis 1. it is most commonly seen in the pediatric age group.

MONDO:0003236.name: atypical polypoid adenomyoma
MONDO:0003236.def: an adenomyoma characterized by the presence of marked glandular architectural complexity.

MONDO:0003237.name: adenomyoma of uterine corpus
MONDO:0003237.def: a usually polypoid, benign neoplasm that arises from the uterine corpus. it is characterized by the presence of benign epithelial glands embedded in benign fibromyomatous tissue.

MONDO:0003238.name: cervical adenomyoma
MONDO:0003238.def: a rare, benign, usually polypoid neoplasm that arises from the cervix. it is characterized by the presence of a glandular component and a smooth muscle cell component. variants include the endocervical type, endometrial type, and atypical polypoid adenomyoma.

MONDO:0003240.name: thyroid gland disorder
MONDO:0003240.def: a disease involving the thyroid gland.

MONDO:0003241.name: central nervous system hemangioma
MONDO:0003241.def: a hemangioma arising from the brain and spinal cord.

MONDO:0003243.name: hepatocellular clear cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003243.def: a morphologic variant of hepatocellular carcinoma characterized by the presence of clear cells.

MONDO:0003244.name: central nervous system mesenchymal non-meningothelial tumor
MONDO:0003244.def: a benign or malignant mesenchymal neoplasm originating in the central nervous system or the meninges and showing fibrous, fibrohistiocytic, adipose, myoid, endothelial, chondroid or osseous, but not meningothelial differentiation. depending on the histological features and clinical behavior of these neoplasms, their grade ranges from benign (who grade i) to highly malignant (who grade iv). (adapted from who)
MONDO:0003244.synonym: soft tissue tumour of the cns

MONDO:0003245.name: aflatoxin-related hepatocellular carcinoma
MONDO:0003245.def: a hepatocellular carcinoma that develops following exposure to aflatoxin.

MONDO:0003246.name: sclerosing hepatic carcinoma
MONDO:0003246.def: an uncommon type of hepatocelluar carcinoma, morphologically characterized by significant fibrosis around the sinusoid-like spaces and atrophy of the tumor trabeculae.

MONDO:0003247.name: obsolete pineal parenchymal tumor of intermediate differentiation

MONDO:0003248.name: adult pineal parenchymal tumor
MONDO:0003248.def: a pineal parenchymal cell neoplasm (pineocytoma or pineoblastoma) occurring in adults.

MONDO:0003249.name: pineal gland cancer
MONDO:0003249.def: abnormal malignant growth of the cells that comprise the pineal parenchyma.

MONDO:0003250.name: benign granular cell tumor
MONDO:0003250.def: a granular cell tumor that is confined to the site of origin, without metastatic potential.

MONDO:0003251.name: esophageal granular cell tumor
MONDO:0003251.def: a tumor that usually presents with small nodules or small sessile polyps, predominantly in the distal esophagus. histologically, it is composed of sheets of oval to polygonal cells with a small central nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm. this is usually a benign tumor. (who, 2000) -- 2003

MONDO:0003252.name: granular cell cancer
MONDO:0003252.def: an uncommon granular cell tumor which may metastasize to other anatomic sites. morphologic characteristics include the presence of spindling neoplastic cells, necrosis, extensive pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, and increased mitiotic activity.

MONDO:0003253.name: vulvar granular cell tumor
MONDO:0003253.def: a usually benign granular cell tumor that arises from the vulva.

MONDO:0003254.name: cardiac granular cell neoplasm
MONDO:0003254.def: a very rare granular cell tumor that arises from the heart.

MONDO:0003255.name: mediastinal granular cell myoblastoma
MONDO:0003255.def: an exceptionally rare, generally benign, granular cell tumor that arises from the mediastinum. all the reported cases were located in the posterior mediastinum.

MONDO:0003256.name: neurohypophysis granular cell tumor
MONDO:0003256.def: a generally benign intrasellar and/or suprasellar mass arising from the neurohypophysis or infundibulum. it is composed of nests of large cells with granular, eosinophilic cytoplasm due to abundant intracytoplasmic lysosomes. it generally has a slow progression and lacks invasive growth. (adapted from who)

MONDO:0003257.name: posterior pituitary gland neoplasm
MONDO:0003257.def: a low-grade neoplasm that arises from the neurohypophysis. it includes the granular cell tumor of the neurohypophysis and pituicytoma.

MONDO:0003258.name: hobnail hemangioma
MONDO:0003258.def: a hemangioma characterized by the presence of hobnail endothelial cells.

MONDO:0003260.name: adult cerebellar neoplasm
MONDO:0003260.def: a cerebellar neoplasm that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0003261.name: papillary meningioma of the cerebellum
MONDO:0003261.def: a papillary meningioma that affects the cerebellum.

MONDO:0003262.name: rhabdoid meningioma
MONDO:0003262.def: a who grade iii meningioma characterized by the predominant presence of rhabdoid cells forming sheets.

MONDO:0003263.name: childhood cerebellar neoplasm
MONDO:0003263.def: a neoplasm that affects the cerebellum and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003264.name: basosquamous carcinoma
MONDO:0003264.def: a basal cell carcinoma which displays squamous differentiation. the neoplastic cells have more abundant cytoplasm with more marked keratinization than typical basal cell carcinomas. it usually has a more aggressive clinical course compared to typical basal cell carcinoma, and it may produce regional or widespread metastases.
MONDO:0003264.synonym: skin mixed basal and squamous cell carcinoma

MONDO:0003265.name: adjustment disorder
MONDO:0003265.def: a category of psychiatric disorders which are characterized by emotional or behavioral symptoms that develop within 3 months of a stressor and do not persist for more than an additional 6 months after the stressor is no longer present.

MONDO:0003266.name: ependymal tumor
MONDO:0003266.def: a group of neoplasms which arise from the ependymal lining of the cerebral ventricles and from the remnants of the central canal of the spinal cord. ependymal tumors occur predominantly in children and young adults with varied morphological features and biological behavior. there are 4 types: ependymoma, anaplastic ependymoma, myxopapillary ependymoma and subependymoma. (who)

MONDO:0003268.name: mixed glioma
MONDO:0003268.def: a tumor composed of two or more glial cell types (astrocytes, ependymal cells, and oligodendrocytes).

MONDO:0003273.name: sternum cancer
MONDO:0003273.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the sternum

MONDO:0003274.name: thoracic cancer
MONDO:0003274.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm affecting the tissues of the thorax.

MONDO:0003275.name: middle ear cancer
MONDO:0003275.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the middle ear

MONDO:0003276.name: middle ear disorder
MONDO:0003276.def: a disease involving the middle ear.

MONDO:0003277.name: malignant ear neoplasm
MONDO:0003277.def: a malignant neoplasm that affects the ear. representative examples include ceruminous adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma of the external ear and adenocarcinoma of the middle ear.

MONDO:0003278.name: inner ear cancer
MONDO:0003278.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the internal ear.

MONDO:0003279.name: testicular infarct
MONDO:0003279.def: ischemic necrosis of the testis usually caused by torsion of the spermatic cord, trauma, or severe epididymo-orchitis.

MONDO:0003280.name: swayback
MONDO:0003280.def: congenital locomotor ataxia of lambs, thought to be associated with copper deficiency. it is characterized clinically by progressive incoordination of the hind limbs and pathologically by disruption of neuron and myelin development in the central nervous system. it is caused by a deficiency of metabolizable copper in the ewe during the last half of her pregnancy. (dorland, 28th ed; stedman, 26th ed)

MONDO:0003281.name: ovarian cystic teratoma
MONDO:0003281.def: a teratoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of cystic structures. representative example is the dermoid cyst.

MONDO:0003283.name: epididymal neoplasm
MONDO:0003283.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the epididymis. representative examples include epididymal adenomatoid tumor and epididymal adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0003284.name: mediastinum leiomyoma
MONDO:0003284.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the mediastium. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003285.name: fallopian tube leiomyoma
MONDO:0003285.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the fallopian tube. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003286.name: extrahepatic bile duct leiomyoma
MONDO:0003286.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from an extrahepatic bile duct. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.
MONDO:0003286.synonym: leiomyoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

MONDO:0003287.name: central nervous system leiomyoma
MONDO:0003287.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the central nervous system. it is characterized by the presence of intersecting fascicles composed of spindle cells that often lack mitotic activity.

MONDO:0003288.name: bizarre leiomyoma
MONDO:0003288.def: a morphologic variant of leiomyoma characterized by the presence of pleomorphic muscle cells with bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm.

MONDO:0003289.name: deep leiomyoma
MONDO:0003289.def: a rare benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from deep tissue. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003291.name: leiomyoma cutis
MONDO:0003291.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the arrector pili muscle, tunica media of blood vessels, and dartos muscle of the genitalia. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003292.name: anus leiomyoma
MONDO:0003292.def: a well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the anus. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003293.name: lung leiomyoma
MONDO:0003293.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the lung. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003294.name: pericardium leiomyoma
MONDO:0003294.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the pericardium. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003295.name: leiomyomatosis
MONDO:0003295.def: a condition characterized by the presence of numerous small benign smooth muscle neoplasms located throughout the body.

MONDO:0003296.name: cellular leiomyoma
MONDO:0003296.def: a morphologic variant of classic leiomyoma characterized by a dense cellular infiltrate composed of spindle or round cells with scant cytoplasm and a less obvious interlacing fascicle pattern.

MONDO:0003297.name: gallbladder leiomyoma
MONDO:0003297.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the gallbladder. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003298.name: vulvar leiomyoma
MONDO:0003298.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the vulva. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003299.name: colorectal leiomyoma
MONDO:0003299.def: a well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the colorectal area. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003300.name: appendix leiomyoma
MONDO:0003300.def: a well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the appendix. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003301.name: dartoic leiomyoma
MONDO:0003301.def: a cutaneous leiomyoma arising from the dartos muscle of the scrotum or labia majora.

MONDO:0003302.name: epithelioid neurofibroma
MONDO:0003302.def: a rare neurofibroma with epithelioid morphology.

MONDO:0003303.name: neurofibroma of gallbladder
MONDO:0003303.def: a non-metastasizing encapsulated neoplasm arising from nerves in the gallbladder. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of fibroblasts and schwann cells.

MONDO:0003304.name: plexiform neurofibroma
MONDO:0003304.def: an elongated and multinodular neurofibroma, formed when the tumor involves either multiple trunks of a plexus or multiple fascicles of a large nerve, such as the sciatic. some plexiform neurofibromas resemble a bag of worms, others produce a massive ropy enlargement of the nerve. (adapted from who.)

MONDO:0003305.name: cellular neurofibroma
MONDO:0003305.def: a neurofibroma characterized by the presence of areas with increased cellularity.

MONDO:0003306.name: atypical neurofibroma
MONDO:0003306.def: a neurofibroma characterized by the presence of cellular pleomorphism.

MONDO:0003308.name: pleural mesothelioma
MONDO:0003308.def: a neoplasm that arises from the mesothelial cells of the pleura. the primary cause is exposure to asbestos. the major histologic variants are the epithelioid malignant mesothelioma, desmoplastic malignant mesothelioma, and sarcomatoid malignant mesothelioma. patients present with persistent cough and shortness of breath.

MONDO:0003310.name: monckeberg arteriosclerosis
MONDO:0003310.def: a type of arteriosclerosis in which calcification of the tunica media is the predominant feature.

MONDO:0003311.name: endometrial stromal tumor
MONDO:0003311.def: neoplasms of the endometrial stroma that sometimes involve the myometrium. these tumors contain cells that may closely or remotely resemble the normal stromal cells. endometrial stromal neoplasms are divided into three categories: (1) benign stromal nodules; (2) low-grade stromal sarcoma, or endolymphatic stromal myosis; and (3) malignant endometrial stromal sarcoma (sarcoma, endometrial stromal).

MONDO:0003312.name: ovarian endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms
MONDO:0003312.def: a category of rare neoplasms that arise from the ovary. it includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated sarcoma.
MONDO:0003312.synonym: ovary endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms

MONDO:0003313.name: endometrioid stromal sarcoma of the vagina
MONDO:0003313.def: a rare sarcoma that arises from the vagina. this category includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated vaginal sarcoma.

MONDO:0003314.name: endometrioid stromal and related neoplasms of the vagina
MONDO:0003314.def: a category of rare neoplasms that arise from the vagina. it includes low grade endometrioid stromal sarcoma and undifferentiated sarcoma.

MONDO:0003315.name: endometrium carcinoma in situ
MONDO:0003315.def: a carcinoma in situ involving a endometrium.

MONDO:0003316.name: nonanaplastic kidney wilms tumor
MONDO:0003316.def: wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the absence of nuclear anaplasia.

MONDO:0003317.name: metachronous kidney wilms' tumor
MONDO:0003317.def: wilms tumor arising in the remaining kidney following treatment of the original wilms tumor.

MONDO:0003318.name: mixed cell type kidney wilms' tumor
MONDO:0003318.def: wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the presence of blastema, epithelial, and mesenchymal components (triphasic pattern) or a combination of two of them (biphasic pattern).

MONDO:0003319.name: scrotum neoplasm
MONDO:0003319.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the scrotum.

MONDO:0003320.name: blastema predominant kidney wilms tumor
MONDO:0003320.def: wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the predominance of the blastema component.

MONDO:0003321.name: hereditary wilms tumor
MONDO:0003321.def: familial embryonal neoplasm derived from nephrogenic blastemal cells. several lines of differentiation, including blastemal, stromal and epithelial, are usually expressed. comprises approximately 1% of wilms tumors. (afip fascicle version 2.0)

MONDO:0003322.name: epithelial predominant wilms' tumor
MONDO:0003322.def: wilms tumor of the kidney characterized by the predominance of the epithelial component. the epithelial cells may form papillary and tubular patterns and pseudorosettes.

MONDO:0003324.name: obsolete stromal predominant kidney wilms' tumor

MONDO:0003325.name: nodular ganglioneuroblastoma
MONDO:0003325.def: a ganglioneuroblastoma characterized by the presence of neuroblastic cells in a schwannian stroma, and the formation of hemorrhagic neuroblastic nodules.

MONDO:0003326.name: intermixed schwannian stroma-rich ganglioneuroblastoma
MONDO:0003326.def: a ganglioneuroblastoma characterized by the presence of neuroblastic cells in a schwannian stroma, without the presence of hemorrhagic neuroblastic nodules.

MONDO:0003327.name: peripheral ganglioneuroblastoma
MONDO:0003327.def: a ganglioneuroblastoma arising from the peripheral nervous system.

MONDO:0003328.name: fallopian tube adenomatoid tumor
MONDO:0003328.def: a benign neoplasm that arises from the fallopian tube and originates from mesothelial cells. it is characterized by the presence of gland-like structures that are lined by flat or cuboidal cells. it is usually discovered as an incidental finding.

MONDO:0003329.name: ureteral obstruction
MONDO:0003329.def: blockage in any part of the ureter causing obstruction of urine flow from the kidney to the urinary bladder. the obstruction may be congenital, acquired, unilateral, bilateral, complete, partial, acute, or chronic. depending on the degree and duration of the obstruction, clinical features vary greatly such as hydronephrosis and obstructive nephropathy.

MONDO:0003330.name: urinary tract obstruction
MONDO:0003330.def: blockage of the normal flow of contents of the urinary tract.

MONDO:0003331.name: ovarian monodermal teratoma
MONDO:0003331.def: a teratoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of tissues derived exclusively from one embryonic germ cell layer.

MONDO:0003332.name: malignant struma ovarii
MONDO:0003332.def: an ovarian mature teratoma characterized by the presence of aberrant thyroid tissue with morphologic changes identical to thyroid carcinoma. patients may present with abdominal mass and unusual symptoms due to thyrotoxicosis, or with meigs syndrome (ascites and pleural effusion).

MONDO:0003333.name: benign struma ovarii
MONDO:0003333.def: a mature monodermal teratoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of benign, thyroid-type tissues.

MONDO:0003334.name: demyelinating polyneuropathy
MONDO:0003334.def: polyneuropathy that is characterized by demyelination of axons.

MONDO:0003335.name: chronic polyneuropathy
MONDO:0003335.def: polyneuropathy that is persistent or long-standing in nature.

MONDO:0003336.name: acute necrotizing encephalitis
MONDO:0003336.def: a fulminant and often fatal demyelinating disease of the brain which primarily affects young adults and children. clinical features include the rapid onset of weakness, seizures, and coma. it may follow a viral illness or mycoplasma pneumoniae infections but in most instances there is no precipitating event. pathologic examination reveals marked perivascular demyelination and necrosis of white matter with microhemorrhages. (adams et al., principles of neurology, 6th ed, pp924-5)

MONDO:0003337.name: acute hemorrhagic encephalitis
MONDO:0003337.def: acute encephalitis that is characterized by bleeding.

MONDO:0003340.name: malignant glomus tumor
MONDO:0003340.def: a very rare morphologic variant of glomus tumor with a size greater than 2 cm. the tumor arises in subfascial or visceral tissues. it is characterized by the presence of atypical mitotic figures, or marked nuclear atypia, or the combination of both. it has an aggressive clinical course.

MONDO:0003341.name: subungual glomus tumor
MONDO:0003341.def: a glomus tumor arising in the finger and usually associated with pain.

MONDO:0003342.name: benign perivascular tumor
MONDO:0003342.def: a benign mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the perivascular cells of the connective and soft tissues. it is characterized by the presence of pericytes that grow in a circumferential pattern around vessels.

MONDO:0003343.name: retinal hemangioblastoma
MONDO:0003343.def: a hemangioblastoma that arises from the retina. it is typically a sign of von hippel-lindau disease. it may also be seen as an isolated entity without systemic involvement.

MONDO:0003345.name: hilar cholangiocarcinoma
MONDO:0003345.def: a cholangiocarcinoma that arises from the junction, or adjacent to the junction, of the right and left hepatic ducts.

MONDO:0003346.name: central nervous system vasculitis
MONDO:0003346.def: vasculitis affecting the blood vessels of the brain and/or spinal cord.

MONDO:0003347.name: inflammatory leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003347.def: a morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of an inflammatory infiltrate admixed with malignant spindle cells.

MONDO:0003348.name: conventional leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003348.def: an uncommon, aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm. it is characterized by the presence of atypical large spindle or round cells, nuclear palisading, tumor cell necrosis, mitotic figures and may be associated with vascular invasion.

MONDO:0003349.name: central nervous system leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003349.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the central nervous system. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003350.name: granular cell leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003350.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm. it is characterized by the presence of malignant smooth muscle cells with granular cytoplasmic changes.

MONDO:0003351.name: colon leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003351.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm that arises from the colon. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003352.name: colon sarcoma
MONDO:0003352.def: a malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the colon. representative examples include angiosarcoma, kaposi sarcoma, and leiomyosarcoma.

MONDO:0003353.name: heart leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003353.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the heart. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003354.name: heart sarcoma
MONDO:0003354.def: a malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the heart. the majority of cases are angiosarcomas.

MONDO:0003355.name: ovary leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003355.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the ovary. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003356.name: epithelioid leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003356.def: a morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of epithelioid round cells with eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm.

MONDO:0003357.name: lung leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003357.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the lung. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003358.name: anus leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003358.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the anus. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003359.name: myxoid leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003359.def: a morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma characterized by the presence of cellular pleomorphism, malignant cells with large nuclei, and a myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003360.name: small intestine leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003360.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the small intestine. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003361.name: small intestinal sarcoma
MONDO:0003361.def: a malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the small intestine. representative examples include leiomyosarcoma, angiosarcoma, and kaposi sarcoma.

MONDO:0003362.name: cutaneous leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003362.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the skin. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003363.name: malignant dermis tumor
MONDO:0003363.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the dermis.

MONDO:0003364.name: gallbladder leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003364.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the gallbladder. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003365.name: esophagus leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003365.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the esophagus. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003366.name: hydrarthrosis
MONDO:0003366.def: accumulation of watery fluid in the cavity of a joint. (dorland, 27th ed)

MONDO:0003367.name: gastric leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003367.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the stomach. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003368.name: prostate leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003368.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the prostate. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003369.name: vagina leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003369.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the vagina. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003370.name: retroperitoneal leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003370.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the retroperitoneum. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003371.name: breast leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003371.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the breast. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003372.name: vulvar leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003372.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the vulva. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003373.name: kidney leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003373.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the kidney. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003374.name: laryngeal leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003374.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the larynx. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003376.name: mediastinum leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003376.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the mediastinum. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003377.name: extrahepatic bile duct leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003377.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from an extrahepatic bile duct. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.
MONDO:0003377.synonym: leiomyosarcoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

MONDO:0003378.name: liver leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003378.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the liver. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003379.name: rectum leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003379.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm that arises from the rectum. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0003381.name: pituitary gland disorder
MONDO:0003381.def: a disease involving the pituitary gland.

MONDO:0003383.name: fallopian tube clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003383.def: a rare adenocarcinoma of the fallopian tube composed of malignant glandular epithelium containing clear cells.

MONDO:0003384.name: uterine ligament clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003384.def: a clear cell adenocarcinoma of the uterine ligament composed mainly of clear or hobnob cells. the clear cells are large, bizarre, and multinucleated.

MONDO:0003386.name: bladder clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003386.def: a rare morphologic variant of bladder adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and clear cells distributed in a tubulo-cystic, papillary, or diffuse pattern. there is a female predilection. clinical presentation includes hematuria and dysuria.

MONDO:0003387.name: urethra clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003387.def: a morphologic variant of urethral adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of tubulocystic or papillary structures lined with clear cuboidal or hobnail cells.

MONDO:0003388.name: ampulla of vater clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003388.def: a carcinoma with glandular differentiation arising from the ampulla of vater. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of glycogen-rich cells with hyperchromatic nuclei.

MONDO:0003389.name: epithelial-myoepithelial carcinoma
MONDO:0003389.def: a malignant neoplasm which occurs mostly in the major salivary glands (most frequently in the parotid gland), but also in the minor salivary glands of the oral mucosa and the tracheobronchial tree. it is characterized by the presence of ductal structures which are lined by an inner layer of cuboidal epithelial-type cells and an outer layer of myoepithelial cells with clear or eosinophilic cytoplasm.

MONDO:0003390.name: glycogen-rich clear cell breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003390.def: an uncommon, usually aggressive adenocarcinoma of the breast characterized by the presence of clear cells that contain glycogen.

MONDO:0003391.name: vulvar alveolar soft part sarcoma
MONDO:0003391.def: an alveolar soft part sarcoma arising from the vulva.

MONDO:0003392.name: fallopian tube germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003392.def: a rare germ cell tumor that affects the fallopian tube. the vast majority of cases are teratomas.

MONDO:0003393.name: thymus gland disorder
MONDO:0003393.def: a non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the thymus. representative examples include thymic hyperplasia, thymoma, and thymic carcinoma.

MONDO:0003394.name: dental pulp disorder
MONDO:0003394.def: a disease involving the dental pulp.

MONDO:0003395.name: testicular granulosa cell tumor
MONDO:0003395.def: a rare sex cord-stromal tumor that arises from the testis. it is characterized by the presence of granulosa-like cells and call-exner bodies. there are two variants described, the adult and the juvenile.

MONDO:0003396.name: epulis
MONDO:0003396.def: a non-neoplastic nodular lesion that arises from the gingiva.

MONDO:0003397.name: gingival hypertrophy
MONDO:0003397.def: abnormal enlargement or overgrowth of the gingivae brought about by enlargement of existing cells.

MONDO:0003398.name: anterograde amnesia
MONDO:0003398.def: loss of the ability to form new memories beyond a certain point in time. this condition may be organic or psychogenic in origin. organically induced anterograde amnesia may follow craniocerebral trauma; seizures; anoxia; and other conditions which adversely affect neural structures associated with memory formation (e.g., the hippocampus; fornix (brain); mammillary bodies; and anterior thalamic nuclei). (from memory 1997 jan-mar;5(1-2):49-71)

MONDO:0003399.name: pineal region yolk sac tumor
MONDO:0003399.def: a yolk sac tumor that involves the pineal body.
MONDO:0003399.synonym: yolk sac tumour of the pineal region

MONDO:0003400.name: childhood endodermal sinus tumor
MONDO:0003400.def: a yolk sac tumor that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003401.name: central nervous system endodermal sinus tumor
MONDO:0003401.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.
MONDO:0003401.synonym: yolk sac tumour of the cns

MONDO:0003402.name: testicular yolk sac tumor
MONDO:0003402.def: a non-seminomatous malignant germ cell tumor arising from the testis. it affects infants, young children, and postpubertal males. it is the most frequently seen testicular neoplasm during childhood. the vast majority of patients present with an asymptomatic scrotal mass. the tumor mimics the yolk sac of the embryo and produces alpha-fetoprotein (afp). it metastasizes to distant anatomic sites. prognostic factors relate to the clinical stage and the degree of afp elevation.
MONDO:0003402.synonym: yolk sac tumour of the testis

MONDO:0003403.name: testicular non-seminomatous germ cell cancer
MONDO:0003403.def: a classification of testicular cancers that arise in specialized sex cells called germ cells. nonseminomas include embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, choriocarcinoma, and yolk sac tumor.
MONDO:0003403.synonym: testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, nos

MONDO:0003404.name: adult yolk sac tumor
MONDO:0003404.def: a yolk sac tumor that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0003405.name: adult central nervous system germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003405.def: a germ cell tumor of the central nervous system occurring in adults.
MONDO:0003405.synonym: germ cell tumour of the adult cns

MONDO:0003406.name: sleep-wake disorder
MONDO:0003406.def: abnormal sleep-wake schedule or pattern associated with the circadian rhythm which affect the length, timing, and/or rigidity of the sleep-wake cycle relative to the day-night cycle.

MONDO:0003408.name: ovarian primitive germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003408.def: a malignant tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of malignant germ cell components but lacks a teratoma component.

MONDO:0003409.name: colonic disorder
MONDO:0003409.def: pathological processes in the colon region of the large intestine (intestine, large).

MONDO:0003410.name: wolffian duct adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003410.def: a cervical adenocarcinoma that arises from mesonephric remnants. it is usually characterized by the presence of tubular glands lined by cuboidal epithelial cells.

MONDO:0003411.name: breast hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0003411.def: a hemangiopericytoma arising from the breast.

MONDO:0003412.name: retroperitoneal hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0003412.def: a benign or malignant hemangiopericytoma arising from the retroperitoneum.

MONDO:0003413.name: hair follicle neoplasm
MONDO:0003413.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the hair follicle.

MONDO:0003414.name: skin pilomatrix carcinoma
MONDO:0003414.def: a very rare, locally aggressive, malignant neoplasm of the hair follicle. the majority of the cases arise de novo, however malignant transformation from a pre-existing pilomatricoma has been reported. it usually presents as a solitary nodule in the head and neck, upper extremities, or buttocks. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of aggregates of basaloid cells infiltrating the dermis. masses of ghost cells are present in the cellular aggregates. complete surgical excision is the treatment of choice. if it is not completely removed, it usually recurs, but it rarely metastasizes to distant anatomic sites.

MONDO:0003419.name: bartholin gland adenoma
MONDO:0003419.def: a rare, benign neoplasm that arises from the bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of clustered glands and tubules lined by mucin-secreting epithelial cells.

MONDO:0003420.name: bile duct cystadenoma
MONDO:0003420.def: an epithelial, usually multiloculated neoplasm arising from the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts. it occurs predominantly in females. signs and symptoms include abdominal mass, abdominal pain, and jaundice. morphologically, the cystic spaces are lined by columnar epithelium and contain mucinous or serous fluid.

MONDO:0003421.name: mixed cell adenoma
MONDO:0003421.def: an adenoma characterized by the presence of a mixed epithelial cell population.

MONDO:0003422.name: lung adenoma
MONDO:0003422.def: a benign, well circumscribed epithelial neoplasm that arises from the bronchus or the lung parenchyma. representative examples include alveolar adenoma, papillary adenoma, and mucus gland adenoma.

MONDO:0003423.name: middle ear adenoma
MONDO:0003423.def: a benign, well-circumscribed glandular neoplasm that arises from the middle ear and may exhibit neuroendocrine differentiation. it usually presents with conductive hearing loss.

MONDO:0003424.name: oncocytic adenoma
MONDO:0003424.def: a benign neoplasm composed of large cells with abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm. representative examples include oncocytic adenomas of the thyroid gland, parathyroid gland, and pituitary gland.

MONDO:0003425.name: ophthalmoplegia
MONDO:0003425.def: weakness or paralysis of at least one of the muscles controlling the movement of the eye. it results from degeneration of the muscles or the neural pathways involved in the eye movement. representative disorders causing ophthalmoplegia include ocular myopathies and multiple sclerosis.

MONDO:0003426.name: clear cell adenoma
MONDO:0003426.def: a benign neoplasm composed of glands containing epithelial clear cells.

MONDO:0003427.name: bronchus adenoma
MONDO:0003427.def: a benign lung neoplasm characterized by the presence of a fibrovascular stroma lined by cuboidal to columnar cells. patients are usually asymptomatic and it is incidentally discovered as a pulmonary nodule during chest x-ray examination. surgical excision is curative.

MONDO:0003428.name: brain hemangioma
MONDO:0003428.def: a hemangioma arising from the brain.

MONDO:0003429.name: functioning pituitary gland adenoma
MONDO:0003429.def: a hormone producing pituitary gland adenoma, associated with a hormonal syndrome.

MONDO:0003430.name: prolactin producing pituitary tumor
MONDO:0003430.def: an adenoma or carcinoma of the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland that produces prolactin.

MONDO:0003431.name: lipoadenoma
MONDO:0003431.def: an adenoma in which the neoplastic epithelial cells are admixed with adipose tissue cells.

MONDO:0003432.name: strabismus
MONDO:0003432.def: strabismus is the intermittent or constant misalignment of an eye so that its line of vision is not pointed at the same object as the other eye. strabismus is caused by an imbalance in the extraocular muscles which control the positioning of the eyes. strabismus is normal in newborns but should resolve by the time the baby is 6 months old. in older children with strabismus, the brain may learn to ignore the input from one eye, and this may lead to amblyopia, a potentially permanent decrease in vision in that eye if not corrected.

MONDO:0003433.name: water-clear cell adenoma
MONDO:0003433.def: a rare parathyroid gland adenoma composed of neoplastic cells with abundant cytoplasm. the cytoplasm of the neoplastic cells is usually not entirely clear, and is often variably vacuolated, foamy, and granular.

MONDO:0003434.name: vaginal adenoma
MONDO:0003434.def: a glandular epithelial neoplasm that arises from the vagina and shows intestinal differentiation.

MONDO:0003435.name: microcystic adenoma
MONDO:0003435.def: a benign epithelial neoplasm characterized by a microcystic pattern. the cystic spaces are lined by small cuboidal cells without evidence of significant cytologic atypia.

MONDO:0003437.name: occult small cell lung carcinoma
MONDO:0003437.def: a small cell lung carcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. the primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

MONDO:0003438.name: combined small cell lung carcinoma
MONDO:0003438.def: a morphologic variant of small cell lung carcinoma in combination with a non-small cell carcinoma.
MONDO:0003438.synonym: small cell and large cell lung carcinoma

MONDO:0003439.name: urinary bladder villous adenoma
MONDO:0003439.def: an exophytic glandular neoplasm of the bladder, morphologically similar to its intestinal counterpart. it often coexists with in situ or infiltrating bladder adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0003441.name: dystonic disorder
MONDO:0003441.def: a movement disorder characterized by sustained or intermittent muscle contractions, resulting in abnormal movements and/or postures.

MONDO:0003442.name: bladder papillary urothelial neoplasm
MONDO:0003442.def: a papillary epithelial neoplasm that involves the urinary bladder urothelium.
MONDO:0003442.synonym: urinary bladder urothelium papillary epithelial neoplasm

MONDO:0003443.name: papillary urothelial neoplasm
MONDO:0003443.def: a neoplastic lesion of the urinary tract transitional cell epithelium characterized by papillary formations. -- 2003

MONDO:0003444.name: intrahepatic bile duct adenoma
MONDO:0003444.def: a rare adenoma that arises from the intrahepatic biliary tree.

MONDO:0003445.name: extrahepatic bile duct adenoma
MONDO:0003445.def: an adenoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. it is classified as papillary, tubular, or tubulopapillary.

MONDO:0003446.name: papillary hidradenoma
MONDO:0003446.def: a benign neoplasm arising from the sweat glands. it presents as a slow growing cystic nodular lesion most often in the skin of the vulva and the perianal region. it is characterized by the presence of cystic and large papillary structures. the papillary structures contain connective tissue and are covered by two layers of epithelium. complete excision is curative.

MONDO:0003447.name: clear cell hidradenoma
MONDO:0003447.def: an uncommon benign neoplasm of the sweat glands characterized by the presence of clear cells.

MONDO:0003448.name: benign spiradenoma
MONDO:0003448.def: a benign epithelial neoplasm with eccrine or apocrine differentiation, arising from the sweat glands. it usually presents as a solitary, well circumscribed, firm nodule in the face and upper trunk. it is characterized by the presence of basaloid cells forming nodules in the dermis. cases of carcinoma arising from long standing spiradenomas have been reported.

MONDO:0003450.name: eccrine papillary adenoma
MONDO:0003450.def: a benign neoplasm arising from the sweat glands. it is characterized by the presence of eccrine ducts in the dermis containing intraluminal papillary projections.

MONDO:0003452.name: cochlear disorder
MONDO:0003452.def: pathological processes of the snail-like structure (cochlea) of the inner ear (labyrinth) which can involve its nervous tissue, blood vessels, or fluid (endolymph).

MONDO:0003454.name: conjunctival cancer
MONDO:0003454.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the conjunctiva.

MONDO:0003455.name: bile duct papillary neoplasm
MONDO:0003455.def: a non-invasive, papillary epithelial neoplasm that arises from the epithelium of the intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts.

MONDO:0003456.name: obsolete bile duct mucinous cystic neoplasm

MONDO:0003458.name: uterine corpus adenofibroma
MONDO:0003458.def: a usually polypoid, benign neoplasm that arises from the endometrial cavity. it is characterized by the presence of a mesenchymal core component and an epithelial component that forms a lining on the mesenchymal core.

MONDO:0003459.name: cervical adenofibroma
MONDO:0003459.def: a benign, polypoid neoplasm that arises from the cervix. it is characterized by the presence of epithelial and mesenchymal elements.

MONDO:0003460.name: clear cell adenofibroma
MONDO:0003460.def: a benign neoplasm characterized by the presence of glandular structures which contain clear cells and a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0003461.name: fallopian tube serous adenofibroma
MONDO:0003461.def: a rare, benign, asymptomatic neoplasm that arises from the fallopian tube. the majority of cases are incidental findings during operation for an unrelated gynecologic disorder. the tumors are round and solitary and contain connective tissue and papillary or tubular structures lined by serous-type epithelium.

MONDO:0003462.name: papillary adenofibroma
MONDO:0003462.def: a biphasic polypoid neoplasm characterized by the presence of papillary projections that are lined by epithelial cells and fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0003463.name: ovarian endometrioid adenofibroma
MONDO:0003463.def: a benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of glandular structures with endometrial-type well-differentiated cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0003464.name: cystadenofibroma
MONDO:0003464.def: a benign or borderline neoplasm that arises from the ovaries and the fallopian tubes. it is characterized by the presence of cystic glandular structures and fibrous tissue.

MONDO:0003466.name: spindle cell synovial sarcoma
MONDO:0003466.def: a synovial sarcoma characterized by the presence of a spindle cell component only.

MONDO:0003467.name: mediastinum synovial sarcoma
MONDO:0003467.def: a synovial sarcoma arising from the mediastinum.

MONDO:0003468.name: biphasic synovial sarcoma
MONDO:0003468.def: a synovial sarcoma characterized by the presence of both an epithelial and a spindle cell component.

MONDO:0003469.name: epithelioid cell synovial sarcoma
MONDO:0003469.def: a synovial sarcoma characterized by the presence of an epithelial cell component only. the epithelial cells are arranged in glandular or papillary structures.

MONDO:0003470.name: cellular ependymoma
MONDO:0003470.def: an ependymoma which shows conspicuous cellularity without a significant increase in mitotic rate. (adapted from who)

MONDO:0003471.name: pediculus humanus capitis infestation
MONDO:0003471.def: a infectious disease involving pediculus humanus capitis.

MONDO:0003472.name: lice infestation
MONDO:0003472.def: a contagious infestation of parasitic insects found on the head (pediculus humanus capitis), body (pediculus humanus corporis), or pubic area (pthirus pubis) that typically cause itching and rash.

MONDO:0003473.name: spinal cord ependymoma
MONDO:0003473.def: an ependymoma that arises from the spinal cord.

MONDO:0003474.name: tanycytic ependymoma
MONDO:0003474.def: a variant of ependymoma, often found in the spinal cord, with tumor cells arranged in fascicles of variable width and cell density. ependymal rosettes are generally absent, so this lesion must be distinguished from astrocytic neoplasms, but its em characteristics are ependymal. (adapted from who.)

MONDO:0003475.name: papillary ependymoma
MONDO:0003475.def: a rare variant of ependymoma characterized by well formed papillae. tumor cell processes abutting capillaries are usually gfap-positive. differential diagnoses include choroid plexus papilloma, papillary meningioma and metastatic papillary carcinoma. (adapted from who)

MONDO:0003476.name: clear cell ependymoma
MONDO:0003476.def: an ependymoma, often supratentorial in location, characterized by the presence of ependymal cells with a perinuclear halo.

MONDO:0003477.name: brain stem ependymoma
MONDO:0003477.def: an ependymoma that arises from the brain stem.

MONDO:0003478.name: childhood ependymoma
MONDO:0003478.def: an ependymoma that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003479.name: toxic pneumonitis
MONDO:0003479.def: a pneumonia that is an acute inflammation of the lungs induced by inhalation of metal fumes or toxic gasses and vapors. it is a sentinel health event (occupational) associated with exposure to ammonia (refrigeration, fertilizer, and oil refining industries), chlorine (alkali and bleach industries), nitrogen oxides (silo fillers, arc welders, and nitric acid industry), sulfur dioxide (paper, refrigeration, and oil refining industries), cadmium (processors and cadmium smelters), trimellitic anhydride (plastics and organic chemical synthesis), and vanadium pentoxide (boilermakers). the two types of pulmonary agents are central and peripheral. central pulmonary agents, for example, ammonia, are water soluble irritants that injure the upper airways. peripheral pulmonary agents, for example, phosgene, nox, and pfib, are slightly water soluble irritants that injure the alveolar-capillary membranes. chlorine has both central and peripheral effects.

MONDO:0003480.name: pineal region dysgerminoma
MONDO:0003480.def: a dysgerminoma (disease) that involves the pineal body.

MONDO:0003481.name: dysgerminoma of ovary
MONDO:0003481.def: a malignant germ cell tumor arising from the ovary. morphologically, it is identical to seminoma and consists of a monotonous population of germ cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and uniform nuclei. the stroma invariably contains chronic inflammatory cells, mostly t-lymphocytes. it responds to chemotherapy or radiotherapy and the prognosis relates to the tumor stage.

MONDO:0003482.name: pediculus humanus corporis infestation
MONDO:0003482.def: a infectious disease involving the pediculus humanus corporis.

MONDO:0003486.name: basaloid squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003486.def: a squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of cells with hyperchromatic nuclei, scant amount of cytoplasm, and peripheral nuclear palisading.

MONDO:0003487.name: pseudoglandular squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003487.def: a squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the formation of gland-like structures.

MONDO:0003489.name: obsolete middle ear squamous cell carcinoma

MONDO:0003490.name: ampulla of vater squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003490.def: a carcinoma with squamous differentiation arising from the ampulla of vater. signs and symptoms include jaundice, abdominal pain, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, and weight loss.

MONDO:0003492.name: lacrimal gland squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003492.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that involves the lacrimal gland.
MONDO:0003492.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the lacrimal gland

MONDO:0003493.name: thymus squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003493.def: a rare primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of keratinizing or non-keratinizing malignant squamous cells. approximately 10-20% of cases occur in combination with thymoma. the prognosis depends on the tumor stage and the degree of cellular differentiation.

MONDO:0003494.name: ovarian squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003494.def: a usually high grade squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is not associated with a germ cell tumor. the prognosis is poor.

MONDO:0003495.name: ovarian squamous cell neoplasm
MONDO:0003495.def: a squamous cell tumor that arises from the ovary and is not associated with a germ cell tumor.

MONDO:0003497.name: renal pelvis squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003497.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that involves the renal pelvis.
MONDO:0003497.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis

MONDO:0003499.name: sarcomatoid squamous cell skin carcinoma
MONDO:0003499.def: a squamous cell carcinoma of the skin with a prominent spindle cell component.

MONDO:0003500.name: squamous cell bile duct carcinoma
MONDO:0003500.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that involves the bile duct.

MONDO:0003501.name: external ear squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003501.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the skin of the external ear.
MONDO:0003501.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the external ear

MONDO:0003502.name: ureter squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003502.def: a rare squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the ureter.

MONDO:0003503.name: fallopian tube squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003503.def: a rare squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the fallopian tube.
MONDO:0003503.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the fallopian tube

MONDO:0003504.name: anal canal neuroendocrine neoplasm
MONDO:0003504.def: a neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the anal canal. it includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

MONDO:0003506.name: pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma
MONDO:0003506.def: a rare choriocarcinoma that arises from a pulmonary artery.

MONDO:0003507.name: choriocarcinoma of ovary
MONDO:0003507.def: a choriocarcinoma arising from the ovary. when it appears before puberty is of germ cell origin. in children and young adults signs and symptoms include precocious pseudopuberty and vaginal bleeding. serum human chorionic gonadotropin is elevated. germ cell derived ovarian choriocarcinoma should be differentiated from primary or metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma affecting the ovary. the prognosis of germ cell derived choriocarcinoma is less favorable and requires more aggressive chemotherapy treatment regimens compared to gestational choriocarcinoma.

MONDO:0003508.name: choriocarcinoma of testis
MONDO:0003508.def: a malignant germ cell tumor arising from the testis. it represents the rarest of the testicular germ cell tumors. histologically it is characterized by the presence of syncytiotrophoblasts and cytotrophoblasts.

MONDO:0003509.name: pineal region choriocarcinoma
MONDO:0003509.def: a choriocarcinoma (disease) that involves the pineal body.

MONDO:0003510.name: malignant testicular germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003510.def: a malignant tumor predominantly affecting young men and often associated with cryptorchidism. seminoma is the most frequently seen malignant testicular germ cell tumor, followed by embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor.

MONDO:0003512.name: mediastinal mesenchymal tumor
MONDO:0003512.def: a benign or malignant soft tissue neoplasm of the mediastinum. representative examples of benign mediastinal soft tissue neoplasms include chondroma, leiomyoma, lipoma, and rhabdomyoma. representative examples of malignant mediastinal soft tissue neoplasms include angiosarcoma, leiomyosarcoma, liposarcoma, osteosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and synovial sarcoma.
MONDO:0003512.synonym: soft tissue tumour of the mediastinum

MONDO:0003513.name: gastric teratoma
MONDO:0003513.def: a mature or immature teratoma that arises from the stomach.

MONDO:0003515.name: fallopian tube teratoma
MONDO:0003515.def: a teratoma that arises from the fallopian tube. it is a rare tumor, often found incidentally.

MONDO:0003516.name: adult teratoma
MONDO:0003516.def: a teratoma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0003517.name: mature teratoma
MONDO:0003517.def: a teratoma which may be cystic; it is composed entirely of well differentiated, adult-type tissues, without evidence of fetal-type tissues.

MONDO:0003518.name: mediastinum teratoma
MONDO:0003518.def: a teratoma that involves the mediastinum.

MONDO:0003522.name: male orgasm disorder
MONDO:0003522.def: persistent delay or absence in orgasm not accounted for by a medical reason.

MONDO:0003523.name: gastrin-producing neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0003523.def: a gastrin-producing neuroendocrine tumor. it is usually located in the pancreas but it is also found at other anatomic sites, including the stomach and small intestine.

MONDO:0003524.name: gastric gastrin-producing neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0003524.def: a well differentiated neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the stomach. it produces gastrin and it may be associated with zollinger-ellison syndrome.

MONDO:0003525.name: pancreatic gastrin-producing neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0003525.def: a usually malignant gastrin-producing neuroendocrine tumor arising from the pancreas. it may or may not be associated with inappropriate secretion of gastrin and an associated clinical syndrome.

MONDO:0003527.name: obsolete ferguson-smith tumor
MONDO:0003527.def: obsolete. a rare genetic neoplastic disorder with an autosomal dominant pattern of inheritance characterized by multiple, recurrent skin cancers that spontaneously resolve. it has been described almost exclusively in families of scottish origin. it is caused by a mutation in the tumor-suppressing gene, tgfbr1, on chromosome 9. clinical presentation is usually rapidly growing squamous cell carcinomas or keratoacanthomas that primarily localize to sun-exposed areas. appearance of the neoplasms occurs over several weeks before receding over the course of several months if untreated. the regression of the lesions leaves pitting cicatrices but no other known sequelae.

MONDO:0003528.name: volkmann contracture
MONDO:0003528.def: an ischemic contracture of the forearm that most often occurs secondary to trauma.

MONDO:0003532.name: breast papillary carcinoma
MONDO:0003532.def: a breast carcinoma characterized by the formation of irregular, finger-like projections of fibrous stroma covered with neoplastic epithelial cells.
MONDO:0003532.synonym: solid papillary carcinoma of the breast

MONDO:0003534.name: papillary thymic adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003534.def: a rare primary thymic adenocarcinoma, characterized by a papillary growth pattern. there are only a few published cases, and no good data regarding prognosis.

MONDO:0003535.name: fallopian tube papillary adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003535.def: an adenocarcinoma that arises from the fallopian tube and is characterized by a papillary architectural pattern.
MONDO:0003535.synonym: papillary adenocarcinoma of the fallopian tube

MONDO:0003537.name: precursor t-lymphoblastic lymphoma/leukemia
MONDO:0003537.def: a neoplasm of lymphoblasts committed to the t-cell lineage, typically composed of small to medium-sized blast cells. when the neoplasm involves predominantly the bone marrow and the peripheral blood, it is called t acute lymphoblastic leukemia. when it involves nodal or extranodal sites it is called t lymphoblastic lymphoma. (who, 2001)

MONDO:0003538.name: precursor lymphoblastic lymphoma/leukemia
MONDO:0003538.def: a neoplasm of immature malignant lymphocytes (lymphoblasts) committed to the b-cell or t-cell lineage. neoplasms involving the bone marrow and the peripheral blood are called precursor lymphoblastic leukemias or acute lymphoblastic leukemias. neoplasms involving primarily lymph nodes or extranodal sites are called lymphoblastic lymphomas. -- 2003

MONDO:0003539.name: t-cell adult acute lymphocytic leukemia
MONDO:0003539.def: an acute t-lymphoblastic leukemia occurring in adults.

MONDO:0003541.name: adult acute lymphoblastic leukemia
MONDO:0003541.def: an acute lymphoblastic leukemia occurring during adulthood.

MONDO:0003543.name: trigeminal nerve disorder
MONDO:0003543.def: a disease involving the trigeminal nerve.

MONDO:0003544.name: spinal cord cancer
MONDO:0003544.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm affecting the spinal cord. representative examples include lymphoma, melanoma, and sarcoma.

MONDO:0003545.name: intradural extramedullary spinal canal neoplasm
MONDO:0003545.def: a neoplasm that occurs within the spinal canal in the space between the spinal cord and the dura mater. representative examples include meningioma, neurofibroma, and sarcoma. signs and symptoms include local and radicular pain, weakness and spinal cord compression.

MONDO:0003546.name: third cranial nerve disorder
MONDO:0003546.def: a disease involving the oculomotor nerve.

MONDO:0003547.name: obsolete histiocytic and dendritic cell cancer

MONDO:0003548.name: adenosquamous breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003548.def: an invasive breast carcinoma characterized by the presence of tubular and glandular neoplastic cell structures, admixed with islands of neoplastic cells showing squamous differentiation.

MONDO:0003549.name: adenosquamous bile duct carcinoma
MONDO:0003549.def: an adenosquamous carcinoma that arises from the bile ducts.

MONDO:0003550.name: esophageal adenosquamous carcinoma
MONDO:0003550.def: an esophageal carcinoma characterized by the presence of distinguishable squamous and glandular carcinomatous components.

MONDO:0003551.name: thymic adenosquamous carcinoma
MONDO:0003551.def: a rare carcinoma that arises from the thymus and is characterized by the presence of glandular and squamous carcinomatous components.

MONDO:0003553.name: ampulla of vater adenosquamous carcinoma
MONDO:0003553.def: a carcinoma with glandular and squamous differentiation arising from the ampulla of vater. signs and symptoms include jaundice, abdominal pain, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, and weight loss.

MONDO:0003554.name: adenosquamous colon carcinoma
MONDO:0003554.def: an unusual colon carcinoma characterized by the presence of glandular and squamous carcinomatous components. the two carcinomatous components may be admixed within the tumor, or the two may appear separately in different areas.

MONDO:0003555.name: bartholin gland adenosquamous carcinoma
MONDO:0003555.def: a carcinoma that arises from the bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and malignant squamous epithelial cells.

MONDO:0003556.name: endometrial adenosquamous carcinoma
MONDO:0003556.def: a rare endometrial carcinoma characterized by the presence of both malignant glandular and malignant squamous cellular components.

MONDO:0003557.name: optic nerve sheath meningioma
MONDO:0003557.def: a meningioma that affects the sheath of the optic nerve.

MONDO:0003558.name: adenosquamous prostate carcinoma
MONDO:0003558.def: an infrequent invasive carcinoma of the prostate gland characterized by the presence of both glandular and squamous neoplastic components. it is more often located in the transitional zone of the prostate gland and it tends to rapidly metastasize to the bones.

MONDO:0003561.name: malignant giant cell tumor of soft parts
MONDO:0003561.def: an undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma characterized by the presence of osteoclast-like giant cells and cellular pleomorphism.
MONDO:0003561.synonym: undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma with osteoclast-like giant cells

MONDO:0003562.name: rete testis neoplasm
MONDO:0003562.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the rete testis. representative examples include adenoma and adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0003563.name: diffuse pulmonary fibrosis
MONDO:0003563.def: diffuse replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue.

MONDO:0003564.name: localized pulmonary fibrosis
MONDO:0003564.def: replacement of the lung tissue by connective tissue in a specific area of the lung.

MONDO:0003565.name: urethral villous adenoma
MONDO:0003565.def: an epithelial neoplasm of the urethra, which is morphologically characterized by the presence of a villous architectural pattern.

MONDO:0003568.name: disorder of optic chiasm
MONDO:0003568.def: a disease that involves the optic chiasma.

MONDO:0003569.name: cranial nerve neuropathy
MONDO:0003569.def: a neoplastic or non-neoplastic disorder that affects one of the cranial nerves.
MONDO:0003569.synonym: disorder of cranial neuron projection bundle

MONDO:0003570.name: lipid-rich carcinoma
MONDO:0003570.def: a carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with clear cytoplasm which contains neutral lipids. a representative example is the lipid-rich breast carcinoma.

MONDO:0003572.name: nasopharyngeal type undifferentiated carcinoma
MONDO:0003572.def: a nonkeratinizing carcinoma which occurs predominantly in the nasopharynx but also in the tonsils and rarely in other anatomic sites. it is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli, syncytial growth pattern, and a lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate.

MONDO:0003573.name: pleomorphic carcinoma
MONDO:0003573.def: a usually aggressive malignant epithelial neoplasm composed of cells with significant cytologic atypia and nuclear pleomorphism.

MONDO:0003574.name: external ear cancer
MONDO:0003574.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the external ear.
MONDO:0003574.synonym: malignant tumour of the external ear

MONDO:0003575.name: comedocarcinoma
MONDO:0003575.def: a high grade carcinoma characterized by the presence of comedo-type of tumor cell necrosis in which the necrotic areas are surrounded by a solid proliferation of malignant pleomorphic cells.

MONDO:0003578.name: extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003578.def: a malignant non-seminomatous germ cell tumor that develops as a primary tumor in an anatomic site other than the testis or ovary.

MONDO:0003579.name: retinal nerve fiber layer disorder
MONDO:0003579.def: a disease that involves the nerve fiber layer of retina.

MONDO:0003581.name: ovarian embryonal carcinoma
MONDO:0003581.def: an embryonal carcinoma arising from the ovary. signs and symptoms include the presence of an abdominal mass and abdominal pain.

MONDO:0003582.name: hereditary breast ovarian cancer syndrome
MONDO:0003582.def: an autosomal dominant inherited syndrome caused by mutations in the brca1 or brca2 genes. patients are at high risk of developing breast cancer, particularly before the age of fifty, high risk of developing a second primary breast cancer, and high risk of developing both breast and ovarian cancer.

MONDO:0003584.name: visual cortex disorder
MONDO:0003584.def: a disease involving the visual cortex.

MONDO:0003585.name: adult liposarcoma
MONDO:0003585.def: a malignant neoplasm arising from adipocytes, that occurs in adults. the tumor maybe one of several histologic types including well-differentiated, dedifferentiated, myxoid/round cell, and pleomorphic liposarcoma.

MONDO:0003586.name: esophagus liposarcoma
MONDO:0003586.def: a malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the esophagus, characterized by multivacuolated lipoblasts with hyperchromatic nuclei, a solid pattern of growth, and a rich vascular network. it arises from the mucosal and submucosal layers of the lower esophagus. clinical presentation includes progressive dysphagia, nausea, throat discomfort, and foreign body sensation.

MONDO:0003587.name: pediatric liposarcoma
MONDO:0003587.def: a rare malignant neoplasm arising from adipocytes, that occurs in children. the tumor maybe one of several histologic types including well-differentiated, dedifferentiated, myxoid/round cell, and pleomorphic liposarcoma.

MONDO:0003588.name: larynx liposarcoma
MONDO:0003588.def: a rare malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the larynx. it predominantly affects males. clinical presentation includes dysphonia, dysphagia and respiratory symptoms. the supraglottis is the most common site of involvement.

MONDO:0003589.name: liposarcoma of the ovary
MONDO:0003589.def: a malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the ovary.

MONDO:0003590.name: fibroblastic liposarcoma
MONDO:0003590.def: a liposarcoma characterized by the presence of a fibroblastic component.

MONDO:0003591.name: kidney liposarcoma
MONDO:0003591.def: a rare malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the fat cells surrounding the kidney, usually of the well-differentiated or myxoid type. it may be associated with tuberous sclerosis.

MONDO:0003592.name: gastric liposarcoma
MONDO:0003592.def: a malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the stomach.

MONDO:0003593.name: breast liposarcoma
MONDO:0003593.def: a malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the breast.

MONDO:0003594.name: mixed liposarcoma
MONDO:0003594.def: a malignant neoplasm characterized by the presence of a combination of liposarcomatous morphologic subtypes: myxoid/round cell and well differentiated/dedifferentiated liposarcoma or myxoid/round cell and pleomorphic liposarcoma.

MONDO:0003595.name: sclerosing liposarcoma
MONDO:0003595.def: a morphologic variant of well differentiated liposarcoma occurring most often in the retroperitoneum and paratesticular area. it is characterized by the presence of bizarre hyperchromatic stromal cells and rare multivacuolated lipoblasts within a fibrous stroma.

MONDO:0003596.name: spindle cell liposarcoma
MONDO:0003596.def: a morphologic variant of well differentiated liposarcoma characterized by the presence of bland spindle cells and lipoblasts within a myxoid or fibrous stroma.

MONDO:0003598.name: median nerve neuropathy
MONDO:0003598.def: disease involving the median nerve, from its origin at the brachial plexus to its termination in the hand. clinical features include weakness of wrist and finger flexion, forearm pronation, thenar abduction, and loss of sensation over the lateral palm, first three fingers, and radial half of the ring finger. common sites of injury include the elbow, where the nerve passes through the two heads of the pronator teres muscle (pronator syndrome) and in the carpal tunnel (carpal tunnel syndrome).

MONDO:0003599.name: vulvar liposarcoma
MONDO:0003599.def: a rare malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the vulva.

MONDO:0003600.name: cutaneous liposarcoma
MONDO:0003600.def: a malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the skin.

MONDO:0003601.name: mediastinum liposarcoma
MONDO:0003601.def: a malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the anterior, middle or posterior mediastinum.

MONDO:0003602.name: intracranial liposarcoma
MONDO:0003602.def: a malignant adipose tissue neoplasm of the intracranial region.

MONDO:0003603.name: non-functioning pituitary gland neoplasm
MONDO:0003603.def: a hormone producing or non-producing pituitary gland adenoma or carcinoma, not associated with a hormonal syndrome.

MONDO:0003604.name: functioning pituitary gland neoplasm
MONDO:0003604.def: a hormone producing pituitary gland tumor, associated with a hormonal syndrome.

MONDO:0003605.name: obsolete adrenal neuroblastoma
MONDO:0003605.def: obsolete. a neuroblastoma arising from the adrenal gland.

MONDO:0003606.name: adrenal medulla cancer
MONDO:0003606.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the adrenal medulla
MONDO:0003606.synonym: malignant tumour of the adrenal medulla

MONDO:0003607.name: neuritis of upper limb
MONDO:0003607.def: a neuritis that involves the forelimb.

MONDO:0003608.name: optic atrophy
MONDO:0003608.def: a disorder characterized by loss of optic nerve fibers. it may be inherited or acquired. acquired causes include ischemia, optic nerve neuropathy, glaucoma, trauma, radiation, brain tumors, and multiple sclerosis. it leads to vision disturbances.

MONDO:0003609.name: seminal vesicle cystadenoma
MONDO:0003609.def: a rare benign cystadenoma that arises from the seminal vesicle.

MONDO:0003610.name: rete ovarii cystadenoma
MONDO:0003610.def: an exceptionally rare cystadenoma that arises from the rete ovarii.

MONDO:0003611.name: uterine ligament papillary cystadenoma associated with von hippel-lindau disease
MONDO:0003611.def: a benign mesonephric neoplasm that arises from the uterine ligament and occurs in women with von hippel-lindau disease. it is a cystic lesion characterized by the presence of multiple papillary excrescences.
MONDO:0003611.synonym: uterine ligament papillary cystadenoma associated with von hippel-lindau disease

MONDO:0003612.name: uterine ligament cancer
MONDO:0003612.def: a primary or metastatic malignant neoplasm that affects the uterine ligament.

MONDO:0003614.name: intravenous leiomyomatosis
MONDO:0003614.def: a rare benign neoplasm characterized by the presence of smooth muscle cells growing within veins.

MONDO:0003615.name: nerve compression syndrome
MONDO:0003615.def: any nerve disorder caused by the entrapment and compression of a nerve.

MONDO:0003616.name: salpingitis isthmica nodosa
MONDO:0003616.def: formation of nodules in the isthmus of the fallopian tube due to fallopian tube diverticulosis. it may cause infertility or ectopic pregnancy.

MONDO:0003617.name: chronic salpingitis
MONDO:0003617.def: chronic inflammation of the fallopian tube. it usually follows an acute inflammatory attack.

MONDO:0003618.name: pyosalpinx
MONDO:0003618.def: the presence of pus in the fallopian tube. it is usually caused by acute salpingitis. the fallopian tube is distended and filled with pus. histologic examination reveals edema and acute and chronic inflammation. symptoms include fever, vaginal discharge, and pelvic pain.

MONDO:0003619.name: salpingitis
MONDO:0003619.def: acute or chronic inflammation of the fallopian tube. it is most often caused by neisseria gonorrhoeae and chlamydia trachomatis infections. the infections usually originate in the vagina and ascend to the fallopian tube. symptoms include abdominal, pelvic, and lower back pain, pain during ovulation and sexual intercourse, fever, nausea, and vomiting. complications include infertility and ectopic pregnancy.

MONDO:0003620.name: peripheral nervous system disorder
MONDO:0003620.def: a disease involving the peripheral nervous system.

MONDO:0003621.name: small intestinal vasoactive intestinal peptide producing tumor
MONDO:0003621.def: a neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the small intestine and produces vasoactive intestinal peptide.

MONDO:0003622.name: pancreatic vasoactive intestinal peptide producing tumor
MONDO:0003622.def: a usually malignant pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor producing vasoactive intestinal peptide (vip). it may or may not be associated with inappropriate secretion of vip and an associated clinical syndrome.

MONDO:0003624.name: acinic cell breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003624.def: a breast adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of serous (acinic cell) differentiation.

MONDO:0003626.name: uterine ligament serous adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003626.def: a rare serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

MONDO:0003627.name: rheumatic pulmonary valve disease
MONDO:0003627.def: a rheumatologic disorder that involves the pulmonary valve.

MONDO:0003628.name: pulmonary valve disorder
MONDO:0003628.def: a disease involving the pulmonary valve.

MONDO:0003629.name: uterine corpus serous adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003629.def: a serous adenocarcinoma that involves the uterine corpus.
MONDO:0003629.synonym: uterine serous carcinoma/uterine papillary serous carcinoma

MONDO:0003630.name: pancreatic serous cystadenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003630.def: a metastasizing, slow-growing malignant epithelial neoplasm that arises from the exocrine pancreas. it is characterized by the presence of cysts and is composed of glycogen-rich malignant epithelial cells which produce a watery fluid. signs and symptoms include upper gastrointestinal bleeding, weight loss, jaundice, and abdominal pain.

MONDO:0003631.name: cervical serous adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003631.def: a rare adenocarcinoma that arises from the cervix. it is characterized by the presence of papillary patterns and cellular budding. psammoma bodies are often seen.

MONDO:0003633.name: malignant mesenchymoma
MONDO:0003633.def: a term describing a malignant soft tissue tumor which consists of two or more mesenchymal lines of differentiation, excluding a fibroblastic line of differentiation.

MONDO:0003634.name: proteinuria
MONDO:0003634.def: the presence of abnormal amounts of protein in the urine.

MONDO:0003635.name: sebaceous breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003635.def: a very rare breast adenocarcinoma with sebaceous differentiation.

MONDO:0003636.name: vulvar sebaceous carcinoma
MONDO:0003636.def: a carcinoma that arises from the vulva. it is characterized by the presence of malignant basaloid glandular epithelial cells that resemble sebaceous epithelium and are arranged in cords and nests.

MONDO:0003637.name: clear cell-sugar-tumor of the lung
MONDO:0003637.def: a rare benign lung tumor with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation. it is composed of round or oval cells with abundant clear or eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders. the vast majority of patients are asymptomatic and the tumors are discovered incidentally. excision is curative.

MONDO:0003638.name: lung meningioma
MONDO:0003638.def: a primary or metastatic meningioma that is present in the lung. the lung is the most frequent site of metastasis of meningiomas.

MONDO:0003639.name: lung hilum neoplasm
MONDO:0003639.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from the hilar region of the lung.

MONDO:0003640.name: verruciform xanthoma of skin
MONDO:0003640.def: a rare, benign wart-like skin lesion of unknown etiology that is usually found in the genital or perianal area and consists of hyperkeratosis and aggregates of foam cell macrophages.

MONDO:0003641.name: central nervous system hematopoietic neoplasm
MONDO:0003641.def: a primary or metastatic neoplasm of hematopoietic origin that affects the brain, meninges, or spinal cord. representative examples include hodgkin and non-hodgkin lymphomas, histiocytic tumors, and leukemias.
MONDO:0003641.synonym: lymphomas and hemopoietic neoplasms of the cns

MONDO:0003643.name: giant hemangioma
MONDO:0003643.def: a cavernous hemangioma characterized by the presence of hylanized vascular channels and is often associated with the presence of calcifications, fibrosis, and hemorrhage.

MONDO:0003644.name: cavernous hemangioma of colon
MONDO:0003644.def: a cavernous hemangioma arising from the colon.

MONDO:0003645.name: cavernous hemangioma of face
MONDO:0003645.def: a cavernous hemangioma arising from the face.

MONDO:0003646.name: rectum neuroendocrine neoplasm
MONDO:0003646.def: a neoplasm with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the rectum. it includes well differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (low and intermediate grade) and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (high grade).

MONDO:0003648.name: tympanic membrane disorder
MONDO:0003648.def: a disease involving the tympanic membrane.

MONDO:0003649.name: esophageal neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0003649.def: a well differentiated, low or intermediate grade tumor with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the esophagus.

MONDO:0003650.name: mixed hepatoblastoma
MONDO:0003650.def: a hepatoblastoma characterized by the presence of fetal and embryonal epithelial components and a mesenchymal component.

MONDO:0003651.name: macrotrabecular hepatoblastoma
MONDO:0003651.def: a pure fetal or fetal and embryonal epithelial hepatoblastoma characterized by the presence of broad trabeculae.

MONDO:0003652.name: acute urate nephropathy
MONDO:0003652.def: urolithiasis in which the composition of the stones is predominantly urate.
