MONDO:0003654.name: childhood parosteal osteosarcoma
MONDO:0003654.def: a low grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm arising from the surface of the bone. it occurs in childhood and usually affects the distal posterior femur, the proximal tibia, and proximal humerus. painless swelling is the usual clinical sign. the prognosis is usually excellent.

MONDO:0003655.name: cerebral lymphoma
MONDO:0003655.def: a non-hodgkin or hodgkin lymphoma that arises in the cerebral hemispheres as a primary lesion.

MONDO:0003656.name: hemoglobinuria
MONDO:0003656.def: a laboratory test result which indicates free hemoglobin in the urine.

MONDO:0003658.name: b-cell lymphoma, unclassifiable, with features intermediate between diffuse large b-cell lymphoma and classical hodgkin lymphoma
MONDO:0003658.def: a group of lymphomas displaying molecular, morphologic, immunophenotypic, and clinical overlap between classical hodgkin lymphoma and diffuse large b-cell lymphoma. this term particularly applies to mediastinal lymphomas with overlapping features of mediastinal (thymic) large b-cell lymphoma and classical hodgkin lymphoma.
MONDO:0003658.synonym: large b-cell lymphoma with hodgkin features

MONDO:0003659.name: pediatric lymphoma
MONDO:0003659.def: a hodgkin or non-hodgkin lymphoma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003660.name: adult lymphoma
MONDO:0003660.def: a lymphoma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0003661.name: breast lymphoma
MONDO:0003661.def: a lymphoma that arises from the breast. there is no history of extramammary breast lymphoma and ipsilateral axillary lymph node involvement does not exclude the diagnosis of primary breast lymphoma. most patients present with a painless breast lump. the vast majority of cases are b-cell non-hodgkin lymphomas. diffuse large b-cell lymphoma, follicular lymphoma, and extranodal marginal zone b-cell lymphoma of mucosa associated lymphoid tissue are the most common types of primary non-hodgkin lymphoma of the breast. primary hodgkin lymphoma of the breast is rare.

MONDO:0003663.name: uterine ligament endometrioid adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003663.def: a rare endometrioid adenocarcinoma that arises from the uterine ligament. some of the reported cases were associated with endometriosis.

MONDO:0003664.name: hemolytic anemia
MONDO:0003664.def: anemia resulting from the premature destruction of the peripheral blood red cells. it may be congenital or it may be caused by infections, medications, or malignancies.

MONDO:0003665.name: cervical endometrioid adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003665.def: a cervical adenocarcinoma with the histologic characteristics of the endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium.

MONDO:0003666.name: fallopian tube endometrioid adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003666.def: an adenocarcinoma that arises from the fallopian tube and resembles the endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the uterus. it usually has a favorable prognosis.

MONDO:0003669.name: testicular seminoma
MONDO:0003669.def: a malignant germ cell tumor arising from the testis. it is believed that it is derived from the sexually undifferentiated embryonic gonad. treatment with radiotherapy is highly successful when the tumor is diagnosed in localized stages, which represents the majority of presentations of seminoma.

MONDO:0003670.name: posteroinferior myocardial infarction
MONDO:0003670.def: an electrocardiographic finding of an injury in leads corresponding to the anatomic region of the posteroinferior wall of the heart.
MONDO:0003670.synonym: posteroinferior myocardial infarction by ekg finding

MONDO:0003671.name: septal myocardial infarction
MONDO:0003671.def: a myocardial infarction (disease) that involves the cardiac septum.

MONDO:0003673.name: apical myocardial infarction
MONDO:0003673.def: an electrocardiographic finding of an injury in leads corresponding to the anatomic region of the apex of the heart.

MONDO:0003674.name: subendocardial myocardial infarction
MONDO:0003674.def: an electrocardiographic finding of an injury in leads corresponding to the anatomic region of the subendocardial layer of the wall of the heart.

MONDO:0003675.name: posterolateral myocardial infarction
MONDO:0003675.def: an electrocardiographic finding of an injury in leads corresponding to the anatomic region of the posterolateral wall of the heart.

MONDO:0003676.name: inferolateral myocardial infarct
MONDO:0003676.def: an electrocardiographic finding of an injury in leads corresponding to the anatomic region of the inferolateral wall of the heart.

MONDO:0003678.name: silent myocardial infarction
MONDO:0003678.def: a history of myocardial infarction in the absence of clinical symptoms and positive electrocardiographic findings.

MONDO:0003680.name: periosteal chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003680.def: a chondrosarcoma arising from the surface of bone. it is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, high mitotic activity, myxoid stroma formation, and necrotic changes. it occurs in adults. clinical presentation includes pain, and sometimes swelling.

MONDO:0003681.name: myxoid chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003681.def: a chondrosarcoma characterized by the presence of myxoid changes.

MONDO:0003682.name: localized chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003682.def: a non-disseminated skeletal or extraskeletal chondrosarcoma.

MONDO:0003684.name: clear cell chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003684.def: a rare, usually low grade chondrosarcoma characterized by the presence of tumor cells with clear cytoplasm. it usually arises in the epiphyseal ends of long bones.

MONDO:0003685.name: retroperitoneal germ cell neoplasm
MONDO:0003685.def: a germ cell tumor that involves the retroperitoneal space.

MONDO:0003686.name: apocrine sweat gland neoplasm
MONDO:0003686.def: a benign or malignant sweat gland neoplasm with apocrine differentiation. representative examples include apocrine adenoma, ceruminous adenocarcinoma, and apocrine breast carcinoma.

MONDO:0003687.name: endocardium cancer
MONDO:0003687.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the endocardium.

MONDO:0003688.name: well differentiated papillary mesothelioma
MONDO:0003688.def: a localized or multifocal mesothelioma arising from the peritoneum and less often the pleura. cases arising from the peritoneum predominantly occur in women. it is characterized by the formation of papillae, covered by a single layer of blunt mesothelial cells. mitotic figures are not present. there is no evidence of severe cytologic atypia. it has a relatively favorable clinical outcome, compared to malignant mesothelioma.
MONDO:0003688.synonym: well-differentiated papillary tumour of the mesothelium

MONDO:0003689.name: familial hemolytic anemia
MONDO:0003689.def: a congenital hemolytic anemia caused by defects of the erythrocyte membrane, enzyme deficiencies, or hemoglobinopathies.

MONDO:0003690.name: adult anaplastic ependymoma
MONDO:0003690.def: an anaplastic ependymoma occurring in adults.

MONDO:0003691.name: childhood malignant mesenchymoma
MONDO:0003691.def: a malignant mesenchymoma occurring in children.

MONDO:0003692.name: adult malignant mesenchymoma
MONDO:0003692.def: a malignant mesenchymoma occurring in adults.

MONDO:0003693.name: clear cell cystadenofibroma
MONDO:0003693.def: a benign neoplasm characterized by the presence of cystic glandular and fibrous tissues and clear cells.

MONDO:0003694.name: ovarian clear cell cystadenofibroma
MONDO:0003694.def: a benign neoplasm of glandular epithelium characterized by the presence of clear or hobnail cells within a dense fibrous stroma and cystic structures.

MONDO:0003695.name: ovarian clear cell adenofibroma
MONDO:0003695.def: an uncommon benign neoplasm of glandular epithelium characterized by the presence of clear or hobnail cells within a dense fibrous stroma.

MONDO:0003697.name: non-invasive verrucous carcinoma of the penis

MONDO:0003698.name: penis verrucous carcinoma
MONDO:0003698.def: a slow growing, locally recurring, very well differentiated papillary squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis. it is characterized by the presence of acanthosis and hyperkeratosis. the neoplastic infiltrate extends into the underlying stroma with a pushing border. koilocytotic atypia is not present.
MONDO:0003698.synonym: verrucous squamous carcinoma of the penis

MONDO:0003699.name: phobic disorder
MONDO:0003699.def: an anxiety disorder characterized by an intense, irrational fear of an object, activity, or situation. the individual seeks to avoid the object, activity, or situation. in adults, the individual recognizes that the fear is excessive or unreasonable.

MONDO:0003700.name: brachial plexus neoplasm
MONDO:0003700.def: a neoplasm (disease) that involves the brachial nerve plexus.

MONDO:0003701.name: thyroid gland diffuse sclerosing papillary carcinoma
MONDO:0003701.def: a morphologic variant of papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland that more often affects young patients and commonly metastasizing to the lungs. it is characterized by a diffuse infiltration of the thyroid gland by malignant follicular cells, squamous metaplasia, stromal fibrosis, and lymphocytic infiltration.
MONDO:0003701.synonym: thyroid gland diffuse sclerosing papillary carcinoma

MONDO:0003702.name: uterus intravascular leiomyomatosis
MONDO:0003702.def: a rare benign neoplasm characterized by the presence of smooth muscle cells growing within the veins of the uterine corpus. the intravascular neoplasm growth occurs outside the confines of an adjacent leiomyoma.

MONDO:0003704.name: uterine corpus diffuse leiomyomatosis
MONDO:0003704.def: an unusual condition characterized by the presence of numerous small benign smooth muscle neoplasms located throughout the body of the uterus.

MONDO:0003707.name: distal biliary tract carcinoma
MONDO:0003707.def: a carcinoma that arises from the common bile duct distal to the insertion of the cystic duct.

MONDO:0003708.name: extrahepatic bile duct small cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003708.def: an aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. it is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells.
MONDO:0003708.synonym: small cell extrahepatic bile duct neuroendocrine carcinoma

MONDO:0003709.name: agoraphobia
MONDO:0003709.def: an anxiety disorder characterized by an intense, irrational fear of venturing out into open places or situations in which help (or escape) might not be available should excessive anxiety or panic symptoms develop.

MONDO:0003710.name: ovarian mixed germ cell neoplasm
MONDO:0003710.def: an ovarian malignant germ cell tumor characterized by the presence of at least two different germ cell components. at least one of the germ cell components is primitive. the most common combination of germ cell elements is dysgerminoma and yolk sac tumor.

MONDO:0003711.name: obsolete malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor

MONDO:0003715.name: bladder urachal carcinoma
MONDO:0003715.def: urachal cancer is a type of bladder cancer, making up less than 1% of all bladder cancers. the urachus is a structure normally only present during development in the womb that connects the bellybutton and the bladder. this connection normally disappears before birth, but in some people remains. urachalcancers are usually diagnosed in adults in their 50's and 60's and may develop at the dome or anterior wall of the bladder, along the midline of the body (including the belly button), and between the pubis symphasis and the bladder.most urachal cancersare adenocarcinomas (cancers that develop from gland cells).others may besarcomas (which develop from connective tissue -such as leiomyosarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and malignant fibrous histiocytoma), small cell carcinomas, transitional cell cancer, and mixed neoplasias. most individuals with urachal cancer have symptoms of with hematuria (blood in urine). other symptoms may include abdominal pain, a palpable abdominal mass, mucinuria, and bacteriuria. treatment usually involved surgery to remove the cancer.

MONDO:0003716.name: renal pelvis papillary urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0003716.def: a papillary transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the renal pelvis.

MONDO:0003717.name: renal pelvis papillary tumor
MONDO:0003717.def: a papillary tumor originating in the renal pelvis.

MONDO:0003718.name: occlusion precerebral artery
MONDO:0003718.synonym: occlusion and stenosis of precerebral artery

MONDO:0003719.name: renal pelvis neoplasm
MONDO:0003719.def: a neoplasm (disease) that involves the renal pelvis.

MONDO:0003720.name: kidney fibrosarcoma
MONDO:0003720.def: a usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the kidney. it is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

MONDO:0003721.name: kidney osteogenic sarcoma
MONDO:0003721.def: an osteosarcoma arising from the kidney.

MONDO:0003722.name: internal auditory canal meningioma
MONDO:0003722.def: a meningioma that affects the internal auditory canal.
MONDO:0003722.synonym: meningioma of the internal auditory canal

MONDO:0003723.name: blunt duct adenosis of breast
MONDO:0003723.def: breast adenosis characterized by the presence of ducts with distended lumen and columnar cell metaplasia.

MONDO:0003724.name: non-proliferative fibrocystic change of the breast
MONDO:0003724.def: breast fibrocystic change characterized by the absence of epithelial cell hyperplasia.

MONDO:0003725.name: breast adenosis
MONDO:0003725.def: a non-neoplastic disorder characterized by epithelial and/or myoepithelial tissue growth in the breast lobules. it may be associated with apocrine changes or sclerosis.

MONDO:0003726.name: apocrine adenosis of breast
MONDO:0003726.def: breast adenosis characterized by the presence of extensive apocrine metaplasia.

MONDO:0003727.name: animal phobia
MONDO:0003727.def: an overwhelming, irrational, and persistent fear of animals.

MONDO:0003728.name: breast fibrosarcoma
MONDO:0003728.def: a usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the breast. it is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

MONDO:0003729.name: aleukemic leukemia cutis
MONDO:0003729.def: infiltration of the skin and subcutaneous tissue by leukemic cells without evidence of leukemia in the bone marrow and peripheral blood. it results in clinically identifiable skin lesions. it may be the first manifestation of acute leukemia, preceding the involvement of the bone marrow and peripheral blood by the leukemic process.

MONDO:0003730.name: aleukemic leukemia
MONDO:0003730.def: a leukemia characterized by the absence of leukemic cells in the peripheral blood.

MONDO:0003731.name: adult central nervous system teratoma
MONDO:0003731.def: a mature or immature teratoma affecting the central nervous system and occurring in adults.

MONDO:0003732.name: adult central nervous system mature teratoma
MONDO:0003732.def: a central nervous system mature teratoma that occurs in an adult.
MONDO:0003732.synonym: central nervous system mature teratoma of adults

MONDO:0003733.name: central nervous system mature teratoma
MONDO:0003733.def: a teratoma composed exclusively of fully differentiated, 'adult-type' tissue elements that are sometimes arranged in a pattern resembling normal tissue relationships. mitotic activity is low or absent. the more common ectodermal components present in a mature teratoma include skin, brain and choroid plexus. the more common mesodermal components include cartilage, bone, fat and muscle (both smooth and striated). and the most common endodermal components are cysts lined by epithelia of respiratory or enteric type and in some cases pancreatic or hepatic tissue. (adapted from who)

MONDO:0003734.name: adult central nervous system immature teratoma
MONDO:0003734.synonym: adult central nervous system immature teratoma

MONDO:0003735.name: central nervous system immature teratoma
MONDO:0003735.def: a variant of teratoma composed of incompletely differentiated components resembling fetal tissues. even if the immature component is only a minor element of an otherwise differentiated teratoma, the tumor is still classified as immature. (adapted from who)

MONDO:0003736.name: cancerophobia
MONDO:0003736.def: an overwhelming, irrational, and persistent fear of being diagnosed with cancer.

MONDO:0003737.name: malignant testicular leydig cell tumor
MONDO:0003737.def: a leydig cell tumor characterized by a large size, cellular atypia, high mitotic activity, vascular invasion and necrotic changes. the prognosis is usually poor.

MONDO:0003738.name: selective ige deficiency disease
MONDO:0003738.def: a rare dysgammaglobulinemia characterized by low or undetectable serum levels of immunoglobulin class e (ige). it is an uncommon primary antibody deficiency. it is most likely an inherited immunodeficiency. it may be caused by decreased or inefficient class-switching from progenitor b cells without any corresponding decreases in the other isotypes. most affected persons appear asymptomatic but may show a predisposition to autoimmune and respiratory diseases.

MONDO:0003739.name: selective immunoglobulin deficiency disease
MONDO:0003739.def: a broad classification of dysgammaglobulinemias characterized by low or undetectable serum levels of one of the five immunoglobulin classes. deficiencies of immunoglobulins present variably according to isotype. selective deficiencies may be caused by decreased or inefficient production from progenitor b cells without any corresponding decreases in the other isotypes. the clinical course and prognosis is dependent upon the severity of the selective deficiency and associated morbidity.

MONDO:0003740.name: aids phobia
MONDO:0003740.def: an overwhelming, irrational, and persistent fear of contracting acquired immune deficiency syndrome.

MONDO:0003741.name: juvenile type testicular granulosa cell tumor
MONDO:0003741.def: a rare sex cord-stromal tumor that arises from the testis. it is the most frequent congenital testicular neoplasm and is usually diagnosed during the perinatal period. it usually presents as an asymptomatic scrotal or abdominal mass. morphologically it is characterized by the presence of cysts that are lined by cells resembling granulosa and theca cells.

MONDO:0003742.name: heart fibrosarcoma
MONDO:0003742.def: a usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the heart. it is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

MONDO:0003743.name: heart malignant hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0003743.def: a malignant hemangiopericytoma arising in the heart.

MONDO:0003744.name: spindle cell intraocular melanoma
MONDO:0003744.def: a melanoma arising from the choroid, ciliary body, or the iris. it is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped melanocytes.

MONDO:0003745.name: choroid spindle cell melanoma
MONDO:0003745.def: a spindle cell melanoma that involves the optic choroid.
MONDO:0003745.synonym: spindle cell melanoma of the choroid

MONDO:0003746.name: ciliary body spindle cell melanoma
MONDO:0003746.def: a spindle cell melanoma that involves the ciliary body.
MONDO:0003746.synonym: spindle cell melanoma of the ciliary body

MONDO:0003747.name: telangiectatic glomangioma
MONDO:0003747.def: a glomus tumor characterized by huge vascular channel formations.

MONDO:0003748.name: flying phobia
MONDO:0003748.def: an overwhelming, irrational, and persistent fear of traveling in an aircraft.

MONDO:0003749.name: esophageal disorder
MONDO:0003749.def: a non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the esophagus. representative examples of non-neoplastic disorders include esophagitis and esophageal ulcer. representative examples of neoplastic disorders include carcinomas, lymphomas, and melanomas.

MONDO:0003750.name: childhood central nervous system germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003750.def: a germ cell tumor of the central nervous system occurring in children.
MONDO:0003750.synonym: pediatric germ cell tumor of the cns

MONDO:0003751.name: childhood germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003751.def: a germ cell tumor that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003752.name: frontal sinus schneiderian papilloma
MONDO:0003752.def: a papilloma that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the frontal sinus. it is classified as inverted papilloma and oncocytic papilloma.
MONDO:0003752.synonym: schneiderian papilloma of the frontal sinus

MONDO:0003753.name: nasal vestibule squamous papilloma
MONDO:0003753.def: a benign exophytic squamous cell neoplasm with papillary growth that arises from the nasal vestibule.
MONDO:0003753.synonym: squamous papilloma of the nasal vestibule

MONDO:0003754.name: brown-sequard syndrome
MONDO:0003754.def: brown-sequard syndrome is a rare neurological condition that results from an injury or damage to one side of the spinal cord. this condition results in weakness or paralysis on one side of the body (hemiparaplegia) and a loss of sensation on the opposite side (hemianesthesia). brown-sequard syndrome most commonly occurs in the the thoracic spine (upper and middle back). there are several causes of brown-sequard syndrome, including: a spinal cord tumor, trauma (such as a puncture wound to the neck or back), infectious or inflammatory diseases (tuberculosis or multiple sclerosis), and disk herniation. treatment for this condition varies depending on the underlying cause.

MONDO:0003755.name: urinary tract non-invasive transitional cell neoplasm

MONDO:0003756.name: ovarian mucinous neoplasm
MONDO:0003756.def: a benign, borderline, or malignant epithelial tumor of the ovary characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that contain intracytoplasmic mucin and may resemble the epithelial cells of the endocervix or gastrointestinal tract.

MONDO:0003757.name: paraplegia
MONDO:0003757.def: complete paralysis of the lower half of the body including both legs, often caused by damage to the spinal cord.
MONDO:0003757.synonym: severe or complete loss of motor function in the lower extremities and lower portions of the trunk

MONDO:0003758.name: childhood testicular germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003758.def: a germ cell tumor that arises from the testis during childhood.
MONDO:0003758.synonym: testicular germ cell tumour of childhood

MONDO:0003759.name: childhood ovarian yolk sac tumor
MONDO:0003759.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0003760.name: pediatric ovarian germ cell tumor
MONDO:0003760.def: a germ cell tumor that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0003761.name: leptomeningeal melanoma
MONDO:0003761.def: a melanoma that arises from leptomeningeal melanocytes.

MONDO:0003762.name: malignant leptomeningeal tumor
MONDO:0003762.def: a primary or metastatic malignant tumor involving the leptomeninges.

MONDO:0003763.name: acute stress disorder
MONDO:0003763.def: an anxiety disorder precipitated by an experience of intense fear or horror while exposed to a traumatic (especially life-threatening) event. the disorder is characterized by dissociative symptoms; vivid recollections of the traumatic event; avoidance of stimuli associated with the traumatic event; and a constant state of hyperarousal for no more than one month.

MONDO:0003764.name: pediatric leptomeningeal melanoma
MONDO:0003764.def: a melanoma that arises from leptomeningeal melanocytes and occurs in childhood.

MONDO:0003765.name: adult leptomeningeal melanoma
MONDO:0003765.def: a melanoma that arises from leptomeningeal melanocytes and occurs in adulthood.

MONDO:0003766.name: thalamic cancer
MONDO:0003766.def: a cancer involving a dorsal plus ventral thalamus.

MONDO:0003767.name: mitral valve disorder
MONDO:0003767.def: a disease involving the mitral valve.

MONDO:0003768.name: signet ring cell variant cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003768.def: a rare cervical mucinous adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of signet ring cells.

MONDO:0003770.name: thoracic spinal canal and spinal cord meningioma
MONDO:0003770.def: a meningioma that arises from the meninges of the thoracic region of the spinal cord.

MONDO:0003771.name: jugular foramen meningioma
MONDO:0003771.def: a meningioma that affects the jugular foramen.

MONDO:0003772.name: cerebral meningioma
MONDO:0003772.def: a meningioma that affects the cerebral hemispheres.

MONDO:0003773.name: intracerebral cystic meningioma
MONDO:0003773.def: a cystic meningioma that grows within the cerebral hemispheres.

MONDO:0003774.name: cerebral convexity meningioma
MONDO:0003774.def: a meningioma that affects the cerebral sulcus.

MONDO:0003775.name: lateral ventricle meningioma
MONDO:0003775.def: a meningioma that affects the lateral ventricle of the brain.

MONDO:0003776.name: renal pelvis inverted papilloma
MONDO:0003776.def: a neoplasm of the renal pelvis in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue.

MONDO:0003777.name: renal pelvis urothelial papilloma
MONDO:0003777.def: a benign neoplasm of the renal pelvis that involves the transitional epithelium projecting above the surrounding epithelial surface and consisting of villous or arborescent outgrowths of fibrovascular stroma.

MONDO:0003778.name: inborn error of immunity
MONDO:0003778.def: a disorder in which the immune system is unable to mount an adequate immune response.

MONDO:0003780.name: t-cell immunodeficiency
MONDO:0003780.def: a broad classification of disorders that affect the cell-mediated aspect of the immune response. circulating numbers of t lymphocytes are decreased or ineffective.

MONDO:0003781.name: bronchitis
MONDO:0003781.def: an acute or chronic inflammatory process affecting the bronchi.

MONDO:0003782.name: uterine corpus epithelioid leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003782.def: a morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma arising from the uterine corpus. it is characterized by the presence of epithelioid round cells with eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm.

MONDO:0003783.name: lymphopenia
MONDO:0003783.def: reduction in the number of lymphocytes.

MONDO:0003784.name: nasal cavity carcinoma in situ
MONDO:0003784.def: a in situ carcinoma that involves the nasal cavity.
MONDO:0003784.synonym: stage 0 nasal cavity carcinoma ajcc v8

MONDO:0003785.name: leukopenia
MONDO:0003785.def: a laboratory test result indicating a decreased number of white blood cells in the peripheral blood.

MONDO:0003786.name: childhood testicular choriocarcinoma
MONDO:0003786.def: a choriocarcinoma that arises from the testis during childhood.

MONDO:0003787.name: childhood testicular mixed germ cell cancer
MONDO:0003787.def: a malignant mixed germ cell neoplasm that arises from the testis during childhood.
MONDO:0003787.synonym: pediatric testicular mixed germ cell tumor

MONDO:0003788.name: childhood embryonal testis carcinoma
MONDO:0003788.def: an embryonal carcinoma that arises from the testis during childhood.

MONDO:0003789.name: hereditary papillary renal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003789.def: a familial carcinoma inherited in an autosomal dominant trait. it is characterized by the development of multiple, bilateral papillary renal cell carcinomas. the carcinomas range from microscopic lesions to clinically symptomatic tumors. it is associated with activating mutations of the met oncogene.
MONDO:0003789.synonym: renal cell carcinoma, papillary, 1, familial and somatic

MONDO:0003790.name: prostatic urethra urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0003790.def: an urothelial carcinoma that arises from the urothelial lining of the prostatic urethra.

MONDO:0003791.name: prostatic urethral cancer
MONDO:0003791.def: a male urethral cancer that involves the prostatic urethra.

MONDO:0003792.name: ovarian carcinosarcoma
MONDO:0003792.def: a highly aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the ovary. morphologically, it is a high grade tumor, composed of carcinomatous and sarcomatous elements.

MONDO:0003795.name: ovarian small cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003795.def: a carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of small malignant cells. it includes small cell carcinoma, hypercalcemic type and small cell carcinoma, pulmonary type.

MONDO:0003796.name: rectum kaposi sarcoma
MONDO:0003796.def: a kaposi sarcoma arising from the rectum.

MONDO:0003799.name: conjunctivitis
MONDO:0003799.def: inflammation of the conjunctiva of the eye.

MONDO:0003800.name: conventional malignant hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0003800.def: a malignant hemangiopericytoma characterized by the presence of necrotic changes and in some cases high mitotic activity.

MONDO:0003801.name: corneal intraepithelial neoplasm
MONDO:0003801.def: a squamous cell intraepithelial neoplasia that involves the cornea.

MONDO:0003802.name: cornea cancer
MONDO:0003802.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the cornea.

MONDO:0003803.name: aortic valve disorder
MONDO:0003803.def: a disease involving the aortic valve.

MONDO:0003805.name: malignant pericardial mesothelioma
MONDO:0003805.def: a rare neoplasm of mesothelial origin that arises from the pericardium.

MONDO:0003806.name: thyroid hyalinizing trabecular adenoma
MONDO:0003806.def: a rare, circumscribed or encapsulated tumor arising from the follicular cells of the thyroid gland. it is characterized by a trabecular growth pattern and hyalinized stroma formation. the vast majority of cases have a benign clinical course.

MONDO:0003808.name: mediastinal extraskeletal osteosarcoma
MONDO:0003808.def: an osteosarcoma arising from the mediastinum.

MONDO:0003809.name: malignant mediastinum hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0003809.def: a malignant hemangiopericytoma arising in the mediastinum.

MONDO:0003810.name: bladder diffuse clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003810.def: a rare morphologic variant of bladder adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and clear cells forming a diffuse pattern.

MONDO:0003811.name: ovarian seromucinous tumor
MONDO:0003811.def: a benign, borderline, or malignant mixed epithelial tumor of the ovary. it is characterized by the presence of more than one epithelial cell type, most often serous and endocervical-type mucinous.

MONDO:0003812.name: ovarian endometrial cancer
MONDO:0003812.def: a benign, borderline, or malignant epithelial tumor of the ovary characterized by the presence of glands and/or cysts lined by neoplastic cells that resemble endometrial cells.

MONDO:0003813.name: ovarian papillary tumor
MONDO:0003813.def: a benign, borderline, or malignant epithelial tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of papillary proliferations. representative examples include surface papilloma, borderline serous surface papillary tumor, and serous surface papillary adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0003816.name: articular cartilage disorder
MONDO:0003816.def: a disease involving the articular cartilage of joint.
MONDO:0003816.synonym: disorder of articular cartilage of joint

MONDO:0003818.name: childhood mature teratoma of the ovary
MONDO:0003818.def: a mature teratoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0003819.name: childhood teratoma of the ovary
MONDO:0003819.def: a mature or immature teratoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0003820.name: mature ovarian teratoma
MONDO:0003820.def: an ovarian teratoma which may be cystic, composed entirely of well differentiated, adult-type tissues, without evidence of fetal-type tissues.

MONDO:0003821.name: ovarian biphasic or triphasic teratoma
MONDO:0003821.def: a germ cell tumor that arises from the ovary and is composed of tissues that originate from two or three of the following germ layers, endoderm, ectoderm, or mesoderm.

MONDO:0003822.name: non-invasive bladder papillary urothelial neoplasm
MONDO:0003822.def: a papillary neoplasm of the urinary bladder in which the transitional cells form papillae. the papillary structures exhibit minimal architectural distortion and minimal atypia. mitoses are infrequent. patients are at an increased risk of developing new papillary lesions. occasionally, the new lesions are urothelial carcinomas.
MONDO:0003822.synonym: papillary urothelial neoplasm of low malignant potential

MONDO:0003824.name: hereditary kidney oncocytoma
MONDO:0003824.def: an inherited condition characterized by the development of kidney oncocytomas which are often bilateral and multifocal. this condition may be connected to birt-hogg-dube syndrome.

MONDO:0003825.name: kidney oncocytoma
MONDO:0003825.def: a benign tumor of the kidney, characterized by the presence of large cells with abundant eosinophilic granular cytoplasm. the majority of these tumors are discovered incidentally, during work-up of other conditions.

MONDO:0003826.name: mediastinum seminoma
MONDO:0003826.def: an extragonadal malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the mediastinum. it is characterized by the presence of uniform cells with clear or eosinophilic cytoplasm, round nucleus with one or more nucleoli, and distinct cellular borders. it usually arises from the anterior mediastinum. it may present with respiratory distress, chest pain, or superior vena cava syndrome or it may be asymptomatic, with the tumor detected on routine chest x-ray. the prognosis of mediastinal pure seminomas is favorable compared to the mediastinal non-seminomatous malignant germ cell tumors.

MONDO:0003827.name: transient hypogammaglobulinemia
MONDO:0003827.def: a broad classification for humoral immunodeficiencies. these disorders may be caused by inadequate activation of progenitor b cells, defective class-switching or the effects of medications. despite the potential for increased susceptibility to infection, these disorders are self-limited with eventual normalization of serum antibody levels.

MONDO:0003828.name: growth hormone-producing pituitary gland carcinoma
MONDO:0003828.def: a rare, hormonally functioning or non-functioning pituitary gland adenocarcinoma that produces growth hormone. it may be associated with acromegaly.
MONDO:0003828.synonym: malignant somatotropinoma of the pituitary gland

MONDO:0003829.name: chromophil adenoma of the kidney
MONDO:0003829.def: a controversial term, used for renal papillary lesions which measure 1cm or less in diameter and contain small, regular nuclei.

MONDO:0003830.name: type 1 papillary adenoma of the kidney

MONDO:0003831.name: type 2 papillary adenoma of the kidney

MONDO:0003832.name: complement deficiency
MONDO:0003832.def: a genetic deficiency of any of the component of the complement system (including the classical, alternative, and terminal pathway components), that can either be acquired or inherited.
MONDO:0003832.synonym: immunodeficiency due to a complement cascade component deficiency

MONDO:0003834.name: gastric cardia carcinoma
MONDO:0003834.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the cardia of stomach.

MONDO:0003835.name: gastric cardia adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003835.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the cardia of stomach.

MONDO:0003836.name: malignant thyroid stimulating hormone producing neoplasm of pituitary gland
MONDO:0003836.def: a rare, hormonally functioning or non-functioning pituitary gland adenocarcinoma that produces thyrotropin.

MONDO:0003837.name: tsh producing pituitary tumor
MONDO:0003837.def: an adenoma or carcinoma of the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland that produces thyrotropin.

MONDO:0003838.name: obsolete malignant acth producing neoplasm of pituitary gland

MONDO:0003839.name: ovarian mucinous adenocarcinofibroma
MONDO:0003839.def: a malignant neoplasm of the ovary with an invasive epithelial component and a fibrotic stroma. the epithelial component is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with intracytoplasmic mucin. cystic spaces are also present which contain mucoid material.

MONDO:0003840.name: epicardium lipoma
MONDO:0003840.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the epicardium of the heart.

MONDO:0003841.name: heart lipoma
MONDO:0003841.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the heart usually originating in the epicardial or pericardial fatty tissue.

MONDO:0003842.name: childhood cerebellar astrocytic neoplasm
MONDO:0003842.def: benign and malignant astrocytomas that arise from astrocytes in the cerebellum. more than 80% of childhood cerebellar astrocytomas are pilocytic astrocytomas which have a favorable prognosis. the remainder are composed of diffuse or fibrillary subtypes with malignant astrocytomas occurring only rarely in the cerebellum during childhood.

MONDO:0003843.name: cerebral hemisphere lipoma
MONDO:0003843.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm within the cerebral hemisphere often associated with partial or complete agenesis of the corpus callosum.

MONDO:0003844.name: central nervous system lipoma
MONDO:0003844.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the central nervous system frequently found in midline locations such as the corpus callosum, the quadrigeminal plate, the hypothalamus, the spinal canal or the cauda equina. some contain schwann cells, bone, cartilage or hamartomatous blood vessels.

MONDO:0003845.name: corpus callosum lipoma
MONDO:0003845.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the corpus callosum.

MONDO:0003846.name: viral esophagitis
MONDO:0003846.def: viral infection of the esophagus. it often occurs in immunocompromised patients and it is caused by cytomegalovirus or herpes simplex virus. symptoms include pain on swallowing, fever, and retrosternal burning.

MONDO:0003847.name: hereditary disease
MONDO:0003847.def: a disease that is caused by genetic modifications where those modifications are inherited from a parent's genome.

MONDO:0003848.name: ectopic thymus
MONDO:0003848.def: a condition in which the thymus gland is abnomally located; this can be secondary to failure of descent during fetal development, or failure of involution.

MONDO:0003849.name: clivus chordoma
MONDO:0003849.def: a slow-growing malignant bone tumor arising from the remnants of the notochord and occurring in the clivus. it is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, myxoid stroma formation, and the presence of physaliphorous cells.

MONDO:0003850.name: clivus chondroid chordoma
MONDO:0003850.def: a slow-growing malignant bone tumor arising from the remnants of the notochord and occurring in the clivus. it is characterized by a lobulated growth pattern, myxoid stroma formation, the presence of physaliphorous cells and cartilage.
MONDO:0003850.synonym: clivus of occipital bone chondroid chordoma

MONDO:0003851.name: ovarian fetiform teratoma
MONDO:0003851.def: a rare type of teratoma that arises from the ovary and resembles a malformed fetus.

MONDO:0003852.name: ovarian solid teratoma
MONDO:0003852.def: a mature teratoma that arises from the ovary and presents as a large solid mass. it contains multiple cysts that vary in size. small foci of hemorrhage are also present.

MONDO:0003853.name: bartholin gland adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003853.def: a carcinoma that arises from glandular epithelial cells of the major vestibular gland.

MONDO:0003856.name: adult malignant hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0003856.def: a malignant hemangiopericytoma occurring in the adult population.

MONDO:0003857.name: adult intracranial malignant hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0003857.def: a solitary fibrous tumor/hemangiopericytoma, grade 3 that arises from the brain and occurs in the adult population.

MONDO:0003858.name: anterior optic tract meningioma
MONDO:0003858.def: a meningioma that affects the anterior visual pathway.

MONDO:0003859.name: bilateral meningioma of optic nerve
MONDO:0003859.def: meningiomas that affects both optic nerves.

MONDO:0003860.name: cerebellopontine angle meningioma
MONDO:0003860.def: a meningioma that affects the cerebellopontine angle.

MONDO:0003861.name: vulvar eccrine adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003861.def: an eccrine adenocarcinoma that arises from the sweat glands in the vulva.

MONDO:0003862.name: melanotic psammomatous malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor
MONDO:0003862.def: a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor characterized by the presence of malignant cells that contain melanin and formation of psammoma bodies.
MONDO:0003862.synonym: melanotic psammomatous malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor

MONDO:0003863.name: malignant melanocytic neoplasm of the peripheral nerve sheath
MONDO:0003863.def: a rare variant of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor. it is characterized by the presence of malignant cells that contain melanin.
MONDO:0003863.synonym: melanotic malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour (morphologic abnormality)

MONDO:0003864.name: chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma
MONDO:0003864.def: an indolent, mature b-cell neoplasm composed of small, round b-lymphocytes. when the bone marrow and peripheral blood are involved, the term chronic lymphocytic leukemia is used. the term small lymphocytic lymphoma is restricted to cases which do not show leukemic involvement of the bone marrow and peripheral blood.

MONDO:0003865.name: acral lentiginous melanoma
MONDO:0003865.def: a form of melanoma occurring most often on the plantar, palmar, subungual, and periungual skin. it presents as a pigmented macular lesion with irregular borders. morphologically, it consists of atypical spindled and dendritic melanocytes. the epidermis is often hyperplastic and there is pagetoid infiltration of the epidermis by anaplastic cells.

MONDO:0003866.name: liver extraskeletal osteosarcoma
MONDO:0003866.def: an osteosarcoma arising from the liver.

MONDO:0003867.name: diffuse meningeal melanocytosis
MONDO:0003867.def: a diffuse or multifocal proliferation of uniform nevoid polygonal cells in the leptomeninges. cells may spread into the virchow-robin spaces without frank invasion of the brain. diffuse melanocytosis carries a poor prognosis even in the absence of histologic malignancy. (who)

MONDO:0003868.name: anterior foramen magnum meningioma
MONDO:0003868.def: a meningioma that affects the anterior foramen magnum.
MONDO:0003868.synonym: meningioma of the anterior foramen magnum

MONDO:0003869.name: childhood brain stem glioma
MONDO:0003869.def: an abnormal growth of the cells that comprise the tissues of the brainstem. while the tumor may be histologically benign, it can produce great morbidity due to its location. it presents most commonly in the first two decades of life.

MONDO:0003870.name: childhood brainstem astrocytoma
MONDO:0003870.def: an astrocytoma that arises from the brain stem and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003872.name: ovarian papillary cystadenoma
MONDO:0003872.def: a serous cystadenoma of the ovary characterized by the presence of small papillary projections in the inner surface of the cysts.

MONDO:0003873.name: ovarian surface papilloma
MONDO:0003873.def: a benign serous neoplasm characterized by the presence of papillary proliferations on the surface of the ovary.

MONDO:0003874.name: ovarian serous surface papillary adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003874.def: a serous adenocarcinoma that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of a papillary architectural pattern.
MONDO:0003874.synonym: serous surface papillary carcinoma of the ovary

MONDO:0003875.name: childhood central nervous system mature teratoma
MONDO:0003875.def: a mature teratoma that arises from the central nervous system during childhood.
MONDO:0003875.synonym: pediatric central nervous system mature teratoma

MONDO:0003876.name: eyelid carcinoma
MONDO:0003876.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the eyelid.

MONDO:0003878.name: malignant choroid melanoma
MONDO:0003878.def: a uveal melanoma that arises from the choroid. it is the most common primary malignant intraocular tumor. it usually affects caucasians of northern european descent. it usually remains asymptomatic for a long period. when signs and symptoms occur, they include blurred vision, visual field loss, floaters, and ocular pain. tumor size is the most important factor that relates to prognosis.

MONDO:0003879.name: ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinofibroma
MONDO:0003879.def: a malignant neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells resembling endometrial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0003880.name: ceruminous carcinoma
MONDO:0003880.def: an infiltrating adenocarcinoma derived from ceruminous glands in the external auditory canal.

MONDO:0003881.name: vulvar apocrine adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003881.def: an apocrine adenocarcinoma that arises from the sweat glands in the vulva.

MONDO:0003882.name: central nervous system fibrosarcoma
MONDO:0003882.def: a usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the central nervous system. it is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

MONDO:0003884.name: lipoma of the rectum
MONDO:0003884.def: a benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the rectum.

MONDO:0003885.name: colorectal lipoma
MONDO:0003885.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm arising from the wall of the colon and rectum.

MONDO:0003886.name: mucinous cystadenofibroma
MONDO:0003886.def: a benign neoplasm characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by mucinous columnar epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0003887.name: ovarian mucinous adenofibroma
MONDO:0003887.def: a benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of glands with mucinous columnar epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0003888.name: childhood testicular mixed embryonal carcinoma and teratoma
MONDO:0003888.def: a malignant testicular mixed germ cell neoplasm that occurs during childhood. it is characterized by the presence of embryonal carcinoma and teratoma components.

MONDO:0003889.name: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, clear cell variant
MONDO:0003889.def: an invasive transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder characterized by the presence of clear cells.
MONDO:0003889.synonym: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, clear cell variant

MONDO:0003890.name: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0003890.def: an invasive transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the urinary bladder urothelium.
MONDO:0003890.synonym: invasive transitional cell carcinoma of the urinary bladder

MONDO:0003891.name: bladder signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003891.def: a signet ring cell carcinoma that involves the urinary bladder.
MONDO:0003891.synonym: urinary bladder signet ring cell carcinoma

MONDO:0003892.name: acinar lung adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003892.def: a morphologic variant of lung adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of acinar structures composed of columnar or cuboidal cells. (nci05)

MONDO:0003893.name: rete testis adenoma
MONDO:0003893.def: a benign epithelial neoplasm arising from the rete testis.

MONDO:0003894.name: mediastinal melanocytic neurilemmoma
MONDO:0003894.def: a melanotic schwannoma that affects the mediastinum.

MONDO:0003895.name: periosteal osteogenic sarcoma
MONDO:0003895.def: an intermediate grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm with chondroblastic differentiation. it arises from the surface of the bone and affects the diaphysis or diaphyseal- metaphyseal portion of the long bones. a painless mass or swelling is the most common clinical sign. it is associated with a better prognosis than conventional osteosarcoma.

MONDO:0003896.name: breast capillary hemangioma
MONDO:0003896.def: a capillary hemangioma arising from the breast.

MONDO:0003897.name: breast epithelioid hemangioma
MONDO:0003897.def: a hemangioma characterized by the presence of epithelioid endothelial cells, arising from the breast.

MONDO:0003898.name: pediatric myxoid chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003898.def: a myxoid chondrosarcoma occurring in children.

MONDO:0003899.name: adult myxoid chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0003899.def: a myxoid chondrosarcoma occurring in adults.

MONDO:0003900.name: connective tissue disorder
MONDO:0003900.def: a disease involving the connective tissue.

MONDO:0003901.name: cerebellar hemangioblastoma
MONDO:0003901.def: a histologically benign tumor, usually cystic with a vascular mural nodule, that is most often found in the cerebellum though it has been reported at other sites within the neuraxis. it is associated with von hippel-lindau disease (vhl gene located on chr 3p25-26).

MONDO:0003902.name: brain stem hemangioblastoma
MONDO:0003902.def: a hemangioblastoma that involves the brainstem.

MONDO:0003903.name: benign vaginal mixed tumor
MONDO:0003903.def: a non-metastasizing, well circumscribed neoplasm that arises from the vagina and is characterized by the presence of a predominant benign mesenchymal component and benign glandular or squamous epithelial cells.

MONDO:0003904.name: lung occult squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003904.def: a squamous cell lung carcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. the primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

MONDO:0003905.name: ovarian yolk sac tumor, glandular pattern
MONDO:0003905.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of extensive differentiation into endodermal type glandular structures.
MONDO:0003905.synonym: ovarian yolk sac tumor, glandular pattern

MONDO:0003906.name: ovarian yolk sac tumor, hepatoid pattern
MONDO:0003906.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of extensive differentiation into hepatic tissue.
MONDO:0003906.synonym: ovarian yolk sac tumor, hepatoid pattern

MONDO:0003907.name: ovarian yolk sac tumor, polyvesicular vitelline pattern
MONDO:0003907.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the ovary and is characterized by the presence of multiple dilated spaces lined by cells that resemble mesothelial cells. the dilated spaces coexist with columnar epithelial tissues.
MONDO:0003907.synonym: polyvesicular vitelline pattern ovarian yolk sac tumour

MONDO:0003908.name: clivus meningioma
MONDO:0003908.def: a meningioma that affects the clivus.

MONDO:0003909.name: bartholin gland adenomyoma
MONDO:0003909.def: a rare, benign neoplasm that arises from the bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of a fibromuscular stroma and glands lined by mucin-secreting epithelial cells, arranged in a lobular architecture.

MONDO:0003910.name: mixed cell uveal melanoma
MONDO:0003910.def: a melanoma arising from the choroid, ciliary body, or the iris. it is characterized by the presence of a mixture of spindle a melanoma cells, spindle b melanoma cells, and epithelioid melanoma cells.

MONDO:0003911.name: ciliary body mixed cell melanoma
MONDO:0003911.def: a mixed cell uveal melanoma that involves the ciliary body.
MONDO:0003911.synonym: mixed cell uveal melanoma of ciliary body

MONDO:0003912.name: malignant ciliary body melanoma
MONDO:0003912.def: a rare uveal melanoma that arises from the ciliary body. patients may present with blurred vision, visual field loss, floaters, and ocular pain. the prognosis is usually poor.

MONDO:0003913.name: choroid mixed cell melanoma
MONDO:0003913.def: a mixed cell uveal melanoma that involves the optic choroid.
MONDO:0003913.synonym: optic choroid mixed cell uveal melanoma

MONDO:0003915.name: cortical thymoma
MONDO:0003915.def: a thymic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of neoplastic large, polygonal epithelial cells with large vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. the neoplastic cells are arranged around perivascular spaces and along septa. immature t-lymphocytes are also present. it may be associated with myasthenia gravis, pure red cell aplasia, and hypogammaglobulinemia. it is a tumor of moderate malignancy. the majority of cases occur in the anterior mediastinum as masaoka stage i, stage ii, or stage iii tumors. metastatic, stage iv tumors occur less frequently.

MONDO:0003916.name: overnutrition
MONDO:0003916.def: an imbalanced nutritional status resulting from excessive intake of nutrients. generally, overnutrition generates an energy imbalance between food consumption and energy expenditure leading to disorders such as obesity.

MONDO:0003917.name: heart lymphoma
MONDO:0003917.def: an extranodal lymphoma that arises from the heart and/or the pericardium. the majority of the cases are diffuse large b-cell lymphomas. patients may present with chest pain, heart failure, pericardial effusion, arrhythmia, or syncope.

MONDO:0003918.name: angiomatous meningioma
MONDO:0003918.def: a who grade i meningioma characterized by the presence of small and medium sized vessels that predominate over the meningioma cells.

MONDO:0003921.name: posterior foramen magnum meningioma
MONDO:0003921.def: a meningioma that affects the posterior foramen magnum.
MONDO:0003921.synonym: meningioma of the posterior foramen magnum

MONDO:0003922.name: ovarian clear cell malignant adenofibroma
MONDO:0003922.def: a carcinoma arising from the ovary. it is characterized by the presence of malignant epithelial cells with clear cytoplasm in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0003923.name: ethmoid sinus schneiderian papilloma
MONDO:0003923.def: a papilloma that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the ethmoid sinus. it is classified as inverted papilloma and oncocytic papilloma.
MONDO:0003923.synonym: schneiderian papilloma of the ethmoid sinus

MONDO:0003924.name: adrenal cortex adenoma
MONDO:0003924.def: a benign neoplasm that can arise from any of the adrenal cortical layers. it can be associated with the overproduction of glucocorticoids (cushing's syndrome), androgenic or estrogenic steroids (adrenogenital syndrome), or mineralocorticoids (conn's syndrome). (sternberg diagnostic surgical pathology, 3rd ed.)

MONDO:0003925.name: ethmoid sinus inverted papilloma
MONDO:0003925.def: a benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the ethmoid sinus. it results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.
MONDO:0003925.synonym: inverted papilloma of the ethmoid sinus

MONDO:0003926.name: neurilemmoma of the pleura
MONDO:0003926.def: a schwannoma that involves the pleura.

MONDO:0003928.name: uterine corpus myxoid leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003928.def: a morphologic variant of leiomyosarcoma arising from the uterus corpus. it is characterized by the presence of cellular pleomorphism, malignant cells with large nuclei, and a myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003929.name: vestibular micropapillomatosis
MONDO:0003929.def: a benign neoplastic process characterized by the presence of multiple vestibular papillomas in the vulva.

MONDO:0003930.name: non-invasive bladder urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0003930.def: stage 0 includes: 0a (ta, n0, m0); 0is (tis, n0, m0). ta: noninvasive papillary carcinoma. tis: carcinoma in situ: \"flat tumor\". n0: no regional lymph node metastasis. m0: no distant metastasis. (ajcc 6th and 7th eds.)
MONDO:0003930.synonym: stage 0 urinary bladder transitional cell carcinoma

MONDO:0003931.name: childhood optic tract astrocytoma
MONDO:0003931.def: an astrocytoma that arises from the visual pathway and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0003932.name: childhood optic nerve glioma
MONDO:0003932.def: a glioma affecting the optic tract and occurring in childhood.

MONDO:0003933.name: chest wall bone cancer
MONDO:0003933.def: an uncommon malignant neoplasm that arises from the chest wall bones. representative examples include chondrosarcoma, osteosarcoma, and ewing sarcoma/peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumor.

MONDO:0003934.name: breast apocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0003934.def: an adenocarcinoma of the breast characterized by the presence of two intermingled cellular components: cells with abundant granular, eosinophilic cytoplasm, and cells with abundant cytoplasm containing fine empty vacuoles.

MONDO:0003935.name: oncocytic breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003935.def: a rare breast adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of neoplastic oncocytic cells. the oncocytic cells comprise more than 70 percent of the malignant cellular population.

MONDO:0003936.name: invasive tubular breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003936.def: an invasive adenocarcinoma of the breast with a favorable prognosis. it is composed of tubular structures lined by a single layer of epithelium.

MONDO:0003939.name: muscle tissue disorder
MONDO:0003939.def: a disease involving the muscle tissue.

MONDO:0003940.name: kummell disease
MONDO:0003940.def: a disease that presents as vertebral osteonecrosis typically affecting a thoracic vertebra with compression deformity, intravertebral vacuum cleft, and exaggerated kyphosis weeks to months after a minor traumatic injury.

MONDO:0003941.name: classic variant of chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003941.synonym: classic variant of chromophobe renal cell carcinoma

MONDO:0003942.name: eosinophilic variant of chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
MONDO:0003942.synonym: eosinophilic variant of chromophobe renal cell carcinoma

MONDO:0003943.name: central nervous system hibernoma
MONDO:0003943.def: a rare benign slow growing adipose tumor, characterized by the presence of polygonal brown fat cells with abundant cytoplasm, that arises within the nervous system.

MONDO:0003944.name: endobronchial leiomyoma
MONDO:0003944.def: a benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising endobronchially. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0003945.name: bone epithelioid hemangioma
MONDO:0003945.def: a locally aggressive hemangioma that arises from the bone. it is characterized by the presence of epithelioid endothelial cells.

MONDO:0003946.name: vaginal villous adenoma
MONDO:0003946.def: an adenoma that arises from the vagina and is characterized by a villous architectural pattern.

MONDO:0003947.name: hyper-igm syndrome
MONDO:0003947.def: a primary immune deficiency disorder characterized by defective cd40 signaling; via b cells affecting class switch recombination (csr) and somatic hypermutation.

MONDO:0003948.name: cerebral hemangioma
MONDO:0003948.def: a hemangioma arising from the cerebral hemisphere.

MONDO:0003950.name: nipple carcinoma
MONDO:0003950.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the nipple

MONDO:0003951.name: scrotal hemangioma
MONDO:0003951.def: a hemangioma arising from the skin of the scrotum.

MONDO:0003952.name: adult central nervous system choriocarcinoma
MONDO:0003952.def: a choriocarcinoma of the central nervous system that occurs in an adult.
MONDO:0003952.synonym: choriocarcinoma of the central nervous system of adults

MONDO:0003953.name: pediatric cns choriocarcinoma
MONDO:0003953.def: a choriocarcinoma that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.
MONDO:0003953.synonym: pediatric choriocarcinoma of the central nervous system

MONDO:0003954.name: angiokeratoma of fordyce
MONDO:0003954.def: an angiokeratoma that is located on the scrotum or vulva.

MONDO:0003955.name: juvenile breast papillomatosis
MONDO:0003955.def: a benign, usually solitary, well circumscribed multicystic neoplasm that arises from the breast and typically affects young females. the cysts are lined by papillary proliferations that contain epithelial and myoepithelial layers. in a minority of cases, atypia may be present.

MONDO:0003958.name: childhood central nervous system immature teratoma
MONDO:0003958.def: an immature teratoma that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.
MONDO:0003958.synonym: pediatric central nervous system immature teratoma

MONDO:0003959.name: breast large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0003959.def: a poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the breast. it is characterized by the presence of large neuroendocrine cells and high mitotic activity.
MONDO:0003959.synonym: large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of breast

MONDO:0003960.name: pulmonary large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0003960.def: a large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma that involves the lung(s).

MONDO:0003961.name: obsolete cervical large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma

MONDO:0003962.name: froelich syndrome
MONDO:0003962.def: froelich syndrome is characterized by obesity and hypogonadism due to a hypothalamic-pituitary disorder. the hypothalamus is a part of the brain where certain functions such as sleep cycles and body temperature are regulated. the pituitary is a gland that makes hormones that affect growth and the functions of other glands in the body. froehlich syndrome is acquired(i.e., not thought to be inherited or genetic). this syndrome appears to affect males more commonly. the term 'froelich syndrome' is rarely used today.

MONDO:0003963.name: diffuse infiltrative lymphocytosis syndrome
MONDO:0003963.def: this is usually an oligoclonal cd8+ lymphocytic infiltration of various organs.

MONDO:0003964.name: myositis ossificans
MONDO:0003964.def: a disorder characterized by non-neoplastic bone formation in soft tissues. it usually follows blunt trauma and bleeding in the deep soft tissues.

MONDO:0003965.name: capgras syndrome
MONDO:0003965.def: a rare neuropsychiatric disorder whose primary feature is the delusion that relatives or close acquaintances are not the persons that they are known to be. visual recognition appears intact but familiar persons are thought be imposters, that is, they appear similar or identical to known individuals but are not. most cases are seen in the context of a psychotic state. however, if manifested post-traumatically, the cause is most likely due to neurologic impairment. this disorder should be contrasted with prosopagnosia, in which an individual may not recognize a familiar person at all.

MONDO:0003966.name: testicular monophasic choriocarcinoma
MONDO:0003966.def: a choriocarcinoma that arises from the testis and is characterized by the predominance of cytotrophoblastic and intermediate trophoblastic cells. syncytiotrophoblastic cells are absent or not prominent.

MONDO:0003967.name: synchronous multifocal osteogenic sarcoma
MONDO:0003967.def: a bone osteosarcoma affecting multiple skeletal sites, with multifocal lesions discovered within 6 months of the appearance of the initial tumor. it has a poor prognosis.

MONDO:0003968.name: asynchronous multifocal osteogenic sarcoma
MONDO:0003968.def: a bone osteosarcoma affecting multiple skeletal sites, with multifocal lesions discovered between 6 and 24 months after the appearance of the initial tumor. patients with asynchronous tumors have a better prognosis than those with synchronous osteosarcomas.

MONDO:0003969.name: amphetamine abuse
MONDO:0003969.def: disorders related or resulting from use of amphetamines.

MONDO:0003970.name: gastric fundus carcinoma
MONDO:0003970.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the fundus of stomach.

MONDO:0003971.name: gastric pylorus carcinoma
MONDO:0003971.def: a carcinoma that arises from the pylorus.

MONDO:0003972.name: gastric body carcinoma
MONDO:0003972.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the body of stomach.

MONDO:0003973.name: tubular variant testicular seminoma
MONDO:0003973.def: a morphologic variant of testicular seminoma characterized by the presence of seminoma cells arranged in tubular patterns and few lymphocytes.

MONDO:0003975.name: littre gland carcinoma
MONDO:0003975.def: a carcinoma involving a male urethral gland.

MONDO:0003976.name: malignant type ab thymoma
MONDO:0003976.def: a type ab thymoma which is characterized by an aggressive clinical course (capsular invasion, infiltration of the surrounding tissues) and can metastasize.

MONDO:0003978.name: colon small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0003978.def: an aggressive, high-grade, and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the colon. it is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells.

MONDO:0003979.name: intrahepatic bile duct cystadenoma
MONDO:0003979.def: a mucinous cystic neoplasm that arises from the intrahepatic bile ducts.
MONDO:0003979.synonym: intrahepatic bile duct mucinous cystic neoplasm

MONDO:0003980.name: schwannoma of jugular foramen
MONDO:0003980.def: a rare intracranial schwannoma that affects the jugular foramen.

MONDO:0003982.name: bilateral breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003982.def: carcinoma that affects both breasts in a simultaneous or non-simultaneous manner.

MONDO:0003983.name: synchronous bilateral breast carcinoma
MONDO:0003983.def: carcinoma that is detected in one breast within two months from the diagnosis of carcinoma in the other breast.

MONDO:0003984.name: internal auditory canal lipoma
MONDO:0003984.def: a rare benign adipose tissue neoplasm of the internal auditory canal, often presenting as an acoustic tumor. it may be intermixed with the vestibulocochlear nerve and may adhere to adjacent structures.
MONDO:0003984.synonym: lipoma of the internal auditory canal

MONDO:0003985.name: chest wall lymphoma
MONDO:0003985.def: a lymphoma that affects the structures of the chest wall. the majority of cases are diffuse large b-cell lymphomas.

MONDO:0003987.name: lung lymphoma
MONDO:0003987.def: a rare non-hodgkin or hodgkin lymphoma that arises in and is confined to the lung at the time of diagnosis.

MONDO:0003988.name: sternum lymphoma
MONDO:0003988.def: a rare lymphoma that arises from the bone or soft tissue of the sternum.

MONDO:0003989.name: polyembryoma of the ovary
MONDO:0003989.def: a rare, malignant germ cell tumor arising from the ovary. it is characterized by the presence of embryoid bodies which resemble early embryos.

MONDO:0003990.name: malignant breast myoepithelioma
MONDO:0003990.def: an invasive malignant tumor that arises from the breast. it is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped myoepithelial cells. mitoses are present. rarely, local recurrences and distant metastases have been reported.

MONDO:0003991.name: villoglandular endometrial endometrioid adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0003991.def: a primary endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of numerous finger-like villi lined by neoplastic columnar cells.

MONDO:0003992.name: childhood botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003992.def: a morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in children. the tumor arises from organs with a mucosal epithelial surface. it is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules within an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003993.name: childhood vagina botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003993.def: a morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in female children. the neoplasm arises from the vagina. it is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003994.name: botryoid-type embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the vagina
MONDO:0003994.def: a morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma arising from the vagina. it is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules within an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003995.name: vulvar childhood botryoid-type embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0003995.def: a morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in female children. the neoplasm arises from the vulva. it is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0003996.name: basal ganglia disorder
MONDO:0003996.def: a disease involving the basal ganglia.
MONDO:0003996.synonym: disorder of collection of basal ganglia

MONDO:0003997.name: colon kaposi sarcoma
MONDO:0003997.def: a kaposi sarcoma arising from the colon.

MONDO:0003998.name: obsolete vaginal tubular adenoma
MONDO:0003998.def: obsolete. an adenoma that arises from the vagina and is characterized by a tubular architectural pattern.

MONDO:0003999.name: juvenile pilocytic astrocytoma
MONDO:0003999.def: a pilocytic astrocytoma that occurs during adolescence.

MONDO:0004000.name: childhood pilocytic astrocytoma
MONDO:0004000.def: a pilocytic astrocytoma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004001.name: compartment syndrome
MONDO:0004001.def: elevated pressure in a confined space enclosed by fascia or eschar, which may lead to vascular compromise and subsequent ischemic injury to the tissue within the space.

MONDO:0004004.name: motor nerve neuritis
MONDO:0004004.def: inflammation of the peripheral motor nerves.

MONDO:0004005.name: rete ovarii adenoma
MONDO:0004005.def: an adenoma that arises from the rete ovarii. it is composed of elongated tubules. the clinical course is benign.

MONDO:0004006.name: rete ovarii cystadenofibroma
MONDO:0004006.def: an exceptionally rare cystadenofibroma that arises from the rete ovarii.

MONDO:0004007.name: breast intraductal proliferative lesion
MONDO:0004007.def: a group of non-invasive epithelial proliferations that occur in the ductal system of the breast. the vast majority of cases arise in the terminal ductal lobular units. this category includes atypical ductal hyperplasia, usual ductal hyperplasia, flat epithelial atypia, and ductal carcinoma in situ. there is an increased risk for subsequent development of invasive breast carcinoma.

MONDO:0004008.name: flat ductal epithelial atypia
MONDO:0004008.def: a breast lesion characterized by the presence of dilated terminal ductal lobular units in which the epithelial lining has been replaced by a single layer of mildly atypical cells, or there is atypical, monotonous epithelial hyperplasia of three to five layers. this lesion relates to columnar cell change with atypia and columnar cell hyperplasia with atypia.
MONDO:0004008.synonym: flat epithelial atypia of the breast

MONDO:0004009.name: kidney pelvis sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004009.def: an infiltrating transitional cell carcinoma that arises from the renal pelvis and exhibits sarcomatoid features.
MONDO:0004009.synonym: sarcomatoid transitional cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis

MONDO:0004012.name: adult botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0004012.def: a morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in adults. the neoplasm arises from organs containing a mucosal epithelial surface. it is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0004013.name: adult vagina botryoid embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0004013.def: a morphologic variant of embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma arising from the vagina. it is characterized by the formation of a cambium layer in the affected tissue and polypoid nodules with an abundant myxoid stroma. it occurs in female adults.
MONDO:0004013.synonym: botryoid-type embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the vagina of adults

MONDO:0004014.name: ethmoid sinus ectopic meningioma
MONDO:0004014.def: an extremely rare meningioma that arises as a primary ectopic tumor in the ethmoid sinus.
MONDO:0004014.synonym: primary ectopic meningioma of the ethmoidal sinus

MONDO:0004015.name: pineal region teratoma
MONDO:0004015.def: a mature or immature teratoma that arises in the pineal region.

MONDO:0004018.name: obsolete liver carcinoma
MONDO:0004018.def: obsolete. a carcinoma that involves the liver.

MONDO:0004019.name: oxyphilic endometrial endometrioid adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004019.def: a primary endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of eosinophilic malignant glandular epithelial cells.

MONDO:0004020.name: mediastinal gray zone lymphoma
MONDO:0004020.def: a mediastinal lymphoma with molecular, morphologic, immunophenotypic, and clinical features of both mediastinal (thymic) large b-cell lymphoma and classical hodgkin lymphoma. the identification of this group of lymphomas, along with recent gene expression profiling results (pdl2 gene expression in both mediastinal (thymic) large b-cell lymphoma tissues and hodgkin lymphoma cell lines), further supports the hypothesis that mediastinal (thymic) large b-cell lymphomas and classical hodgkin lymphomas are related entities.

MONDO:0004021.name: mediastinal malignant lymphoma
MONDO:0004021.def: a lymphoma that arises from the mediastinum. representative examples include mediastinal (thymic) large b-cell lymphoma and hodgkin lymphoma.

MONDO:0004022.name: parasagittal meningioma
MONDO:0004022.def: a meningioma that affects the superior sagittal sinus and invades the parasagittal angle.

MONDO:0004024.name: spinal cord neuroblastoma
MONDO:0004024.def: a neuroblastoma that affects the spinal cord.

MONDO:0004025.name: obsolete spinal cord embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified

MONDO:0004026.name: skin tag
MONDO:0004026.def: a small, benign growth that arises from the skin. it is characterized by the presence of fibrovascular tissue lined by epidermis. it may be sessile or pendulous and usually occurs in sites where there is friction.

MONDO:0004028.name: small intestinal fibrosarcoma
MONDO:0004028.def: a usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the small intestine. it is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

MONDO:0004030.name: ureter transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004030.def: a carcinoma that arises from the transitional epithelium of the ureter. it is associated with tobacco use and usually presents with gross or microscopic hematuria.

MONDO:0004032.name: ovarian seromucinous carcinoma
MONDO:0004032.def: a malignant mixed epithelial neoplasm that arises from the ovary and is composed predominantly of serous and endocervical-type mucinous epithelium.

MONDO:0004034.name: eye lymphoma
MONDO:0004034.def: a lymphoma that involves the eye.

MONDO:0004035.name: glomangiomatosis
MONDO:0004035.def: a benign multifocal proliferation of glomus cells forming clusters around dilated vascular spaces.

MONDO:0004038.name: dental enamel hypoplasia
MONDO:0004038.def: deficiency in the enamel tissue that results in the formation of grooves, pits, or dents on the surface of the affected teeth.

MONDO:0004040.name: urinary bladder inverted papilloma
MONDO:0004040.def: a neoplasm of the bladder in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue, which often causes hematuria.

MONDO:0004041.name: urothelial papilloma
MONDO:0004041.def: a rare benign condition, characterized by a papillary growth in the urinary tract with a central fibrovascular core. the latter is lined by normal urothelium.

MONDO:0004042.name: urethra inverted papilloma
MONDO:0004042.def: a neoplasm of the urethra in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue.

MONDO:0004043.name: ureter inverted papilloma
MONDO:0004043.def: a neoplasm of the ureter in which the epithelial cells grow downward into the underlying supportive tissue, which often causes hematuria.

MONDO:0004044.name: ureter urothelial papilloma
MONDO:0004044.def: a benign epithelial neoplasm that produces visible warty projections from the epithelial surface of the ureter.

MONDO:0004045.name: pediatric intraocular retinoblastoma
MONDO:0004045.def: retinoblastoma during childhood that has not spread beyond the eye.

MONDO:0004046.name: childhood brain meningioma
MONDO:0004046.def: a brain meningioma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004047.name: sphenoidal sinus neoplasm
MONDO:0004047.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the sphenoid sinus. representative examples of benign neoplasms include schneiderian papilloma and salivary gland-type adenoma. representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma and lymphoma.

MONDO:0004048.name: immature gastric teratoma
MONDO:0004048.def: a malignant teratoma that arises from the stomach.

MONDO:0004049.name: combat disorder
MONDO:0004049.def: neurotic reactions to unusual, severe, or overwhelming military stress.

MONDO:0004050.name: telangiectatic osteogenic sarcoma
MONDO:0004050.def: an osteosarcoma usually arising from the metaphysis of long bones. it is characterized by the presence of a cystic architecture with blood-filled spaces. the prognosis is similar to that of conventional osteosarcoma.

MONDO:0004052.name: rectal cloacogenic carcinoma
MONDO:0004052.def: a carcinoma that arises from the transitional zone at the junction of the rectum and anus.
MONDO:0004052.synonym: transitional zone carcinoma of the rectum

MONDO:0004053.name: bartholin gland squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004053.def: a carcinoma that arises from the bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant squamous epithelial cells.
MONDO:0004053.synonym: major vestibular gland squamous cell carcinoma

MONDO:0004056.name: bladder papillary urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0004056.def: an invasive or non-invasive papillary transitional cell carcinoma of the urinary bladder. it is classified as low - or high-grade. -- 2003
MONDO:0004056.synonym: urothelial papillary carcinoma of the bladder

MONDO:0004057.name: micropapillary variant infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0004057.def: an infiltrating bladder transitional cell carcinoma exhibiting micropapillary growth pattern. -- 2003
MONDO:0004057.synonym: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, micropapillary variant

MONDO:0004058.name: pancreatic cholera
MONDO:0004058.def: a rare syndrome characterized by severe watery diarrhea, hypokalemia, and achlorhydria. it is caused by the oversecretion of vasoactive intestinal peptide from the pancreatic islet cells.

MONDO:0004059.name: dentin sensitivity
MONDO:0004059.def: pain or discomfort caused by exposure of the dentin layer of tooth to thermal, tactile, or other stimuli.

MONDO:0004060.name: peripheral epithelioid sarcoma
MONDO:0004060.def: an epithelioid sarcoma involving the extremities. it usually presents as nodular masses in the dermis and subcutaneous tissues or in the tendons and fascia. it frequently recurs and metastasizes to other anatomic sites. the most common sites of metastasis are the lungs, lymph nodes, bones, and brain.

MONDO:0004062.name: intermediate cell type uveal melanoma
MONDO:0004062.def: uveal melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.

MONDO:0004063.name: intermediate cell type iris melanoma
MONDO:0004063.def: iris melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.

MONDO:0004064.name: iris melanoma
MONDO:0004064.def: a uveal melanoma that arises from the iris. it is the most common primary malignant neoplasm of the iris. the majority arise in preexisting nevi.

MONDO:0004065.name: intermediate cell type choroid melanoma
MONDO:0004065.def: choroid melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.
MONDO:0004065.synonym: optic choroid intermediate cell type uveal melanoma

MONDO:0004066.name: intermediate cell type ciliary body melanoma
MONDO:0004066.def: ciliary body melanoma characterized by the presence of intermediate cells which are similar to but smaller than epithelioid cells.
MONDO:0004066.synonym: intermediate cell type uveal melanoma of ciliary body

MONDO:0004067.name: gallbladder mucinous adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004067.def: an adenocarcinoma that arises from the gallbladder. it is characterized by the presence of extracellular mucin that constitutes more than fifty-percent of the tumor.

MONDO:0004069.name: inborn mitochondrial metabolism disorder
