MONDO:0004069.def: diseases caused by abnormal function of the mitochondria. they may be caused by mutations, acquired or inherited, in mitochondrial dna or in nuclear genes that code for mitochondrial components. they may also be the result of acquired mitochondria dysfunction due to adverse effects of drugs, infections, or other environmental causes.

MONDO:0004071.name: childhood cerebral astrocytoma
MONDO:0004071.def: an astrocytoma, without designation of benign or malignant, that is found in the supratentorial region. the infratentorial location is more common in children.

MONDO:0004074.name: ovarian mucinous cystadenofibroma
MONDO:0004074.def: a benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by mucinous columnar epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0004075.name: infiltrating lipoma
MONDO:0004075.def: a benign tumor, composed of lobules of mature adipocytes, that penetrates the surrounding tissue from which it arises. there is usually a higher local recurrence rate when compared with non-infiltrating lipomas.

MONDO:0004076.name: tendon sheath lipoma
MONDO:0004076.def: a benign tumor, composed of mature adipocytes, that arises within the tendon sheath.

MONDO:0004077.name: lumbosacral lipoma
MONDO:0004077.def: a benign well-circumscribed tumor, composed of lobules of mature adipocytes, that arises within the lumbosacral tissue of the spine.
MONDO:0004077.synonym: sacral region of vertebral column lipoma

MONDO:0004078.name: mucinous intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
MONDO:0004078.def: an intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma that produces abundant mucin.

MONDO:0004079.name: lung mucous gland adenoma
MONDO:0004079.def: a benign adenomatous neoplasm that arises from the mucous glands in the bronchus.

MONDO:0004080.name: glottis squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004080.def: a squamous cell carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the glottic area. it may remain localized for a long period then in late disease stage, it may spread to the opposite true vocal cord, supraglottic and subglottic areas, and the soft tissues of the neck. hoarseness is the presenting symptom.
MONDO:0004080.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the glottis

MONDO:0004081.name: extrahepatic bile duct clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004081.def: a morphologic variant of extrahepatic bile duct adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelium composed of clear cells.
MONDO:0004081.synonym: extrahepatic bile duct clear cell adenocarcinoma

MONDO:0004082.name: childhood immature teratoma of ovary
MONDO:0004082.def: an immature teratoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004083.name: borst-jadassohn intraepidermal carcinoma
MONDO:0004083.def: a rare cutaneous lesion presenting as a scaly verrucous plaque. morphologically, the plaque contains nests of basaloid cells.

MONDO:0004085.name: choroid epithelioid cell melanoma
MONDO:0004085.def: a epithelioid cell melanoma that involves the optic choroid.

MONDO:0004086.name: ciliary body epithelioid cell melanoma
MONDO:0004086.def: a epithelioid cell melanoma that involves the ciliary body.
MONDO:0004086.synonym: epithelioid cell melanoma of the ciliary body

MONDO:0004087.name: basaloid large cell lung carcinoma
MONDO:0004087.def: a morphologic variant of large cell lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of a solid nodular or anastomotic trabecular growth pattern, peripheral palisading, and comedo type necrosis.

MONDO:0004088.name: cervical basaloid carcinoma
MONDO:0004088.def: an aggressive variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of nests of malignant basaloid squamous cells with scant amount of cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004089.name: basaloid carcinoma of the penis
MONDO:0004089.def: an aggressive, human papillomavirus-related squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis. it is characterized by the presence of nests of small malignant cells. the malignant cells tend to invade deeply into the adjacent tissues. comedo-type necrosis is often present.
MONDO:0004089.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the penis, basaloid type

MONDO:0004090.name: vulvar basaloid squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004090.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of nests of malignant basaloid cells with a scant amount of cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004091.name: skin basaloid carcinoma
MONDO:0004091.def: a basaloid squamous cell carcinoma that involves the zone of skin.
MONDO:0004091.synonym: zone of skin basaloid squamous cell carcinoma

MONDO:0004092.name: thymic basaloid carcinoma
MONDO:0004092.def: a rare primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by the presence of tumor cell lobules with peripheral palisading, and a basophilic staining pattern. more than half of reported cases were associated with the presence of a multilocular thymic cyst. metastases to lung and liver have been reported in approximately 30% of cases.

MONDO:0004093.name: esophageal basaloid carcinoma
MONDO:0004093.def: a rare morphologic variant of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. histologically, it is composed of closely packed cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and scant basophilic cytoplasm. it has a similar prognosis to the conventional squamous cell carcinoma of the esophagus. (who)

MONDO:0004094.name: multiple skull base meningioma
MONDO:0004094.def: multiple meningiomas that affect the skull base.

MONDO:0004095.name: b-cell neoplasm
MONDO:0004095.def: a group of heterogeneous lymphoid tumors generally expressing one or more b-cell antigens or representing malignant transformations of b-lymphocytes.

MONDO:0004096.name: spinal cord dermoid cyst
MONDO:0004096.def: a dermoid cyst that involves the spinal cord.

MONDO:0004098.name: malignant melanocytic peripheral nerve sheath tumor of mediastinum
MONDO:0004098.def: a rare variant of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor that arises from the mediastinum. it is characterized by the presence of malignant cells that contain melanin.
MONDO:0004098.synonym: mediastinum malignant melanocytic neoplasm of the peripheral nerve sheath

MONDO:0004099.name: adult cystic teratoma
MONDO:0004099.def: a cystic teratoma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004100.name: lung mixed small cell and squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004100.def: a lung carcinoma characterized by a combination of small cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma.
MONDO:0004100.synonym: small cell and squamous cell lung carcinoma

MONDO:0004101.name: multicentric papillary thyroid carcinoma
MONDO:0004101.def: a papillary carcinoma arising from the thyroid gland from multiple foci.

MONDO:0004102.name: columnar cell variant thyroid gland papillary carcinoma
MONDO:0004102.def: a morphologic variant of papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland characterized by the presence of pseudostratified malignant follicular cells.
MONDO:0004102.synonym: columnar cell variant thyroid gland papillary carcinoma

MONDO:0004103.name: tall cell variant thyroid gland papillary carcinoma
MONDO:0004103.def: a morphologic variant of papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland characterized by the presence of tall malignant follicular cells, arranged in papillary and trabecular patterns. necrotic changes and high mitotic activity are present.
MONDO:0004103.synonym: tall cell variant thyroid gland papillary carcinoma

MONDO:0004104.name: splenic manifestation of hairy cell leukemia
MONDO:0004104.def: a hairy cell leukemia that involves the spleen.
MONDO:0004104.synonym: splenic manifestation of hairy cell leukemia

MONDO:0004105.name: childhood epithelioid sarcoma
MONDO:0004105.def: an epithelioid sarcoma occurring in childhood.

MONDO:0004106.name: testicular yolk sac tumor, macrocystic pattern
MONDO:0004106.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of collections of thin-walled spaces.
MONDO:0004106.synonym: testicular yolk sac tumor, macrocystic pattern

MONDO:0004107.name: splenic manifestation of leukemia
MONDO:0004107.def: a leukemia (disease) that involves the spleen.

MONDO:0004108.name: diaphragma sellae meningioma
MONDO:0004108.def: a meningioma that affects the diaphragma sellae.

MONDO:0004109.name: epiglottis neoplasm
MONDO:0004109.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the epiglottis.

MONDO:0004110.name: refractory hairy cell leukemia
MONDO:0004110.def: hairy cell leukemia that is resistant to treatment.

MONDO:0004111.name: refractory hematologic cancer
MONDO:0004111.def: a hematologic malignancy that is resistant to treatment.

MONDO:0004112.name: radiation cystitis
MONDO:0004112.def: inflammation of the bladder due to irradiation.

MONDO:0004114.name: urinary bladder small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0004114.def: a highly aggressive carcinoma, histologically resembling small cell lung carcinoma. in most cases it is associated with carcinoma in situ.

MONDO:0004116.name: esophageal small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0004116.def: an aggressive, high-grade and poorly differentiated carcinoma with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the esophagus. it is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells.

MONDO:0004117.name: ampulla of vater small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0004117.def: an aggressive neuroendocrine carcinoma arising from the ampulla of vater and the periampullary region. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of small malignant cells, necrosis, and a high mitotic rate. signs and symptoms include jaundice, abdominal pain, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, and weight loss.
MONDO:0004117.synonym: small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma of the ampullary region

MONDO:0004118.name: cystitis cystica
MONDO:0004118.def: a reactive inflammatory disorder affecting the bladder. it is characterized by the development of small cysts in the bladder wall. the cysts are lined by urothelial cells.

MONDO:0004120.name: bartholin gland small cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004120.def: a rare neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the bartholin gland and is characterized by the presence of malignant small cells and high mitotic activity.
MONDO:0004120.synonym: small cell carcinoma of major vestibular gland

MONDO:0004122.name: thymus small cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004122.def: an aggressive, small cell, poorly differentiated thymic neuroendocrine carcinoma, characterized by the presence of a high mitotic rate and numerous apoptotic bodies.

MONDO:0004124.name: prostate stromal sarcoma
MONDO:0004124.def: a rare malignant neoplasm arising from specialized prostatic stroma. it is characterized by the presence of stromal overgrowth and hypercellularity, increased number of mitotic figures, and pleomorphism.

MONDO:0004125.name: rectum leiomyoma
MONDO:0004125.def: a well-circumscribed benign smooth muscle neoplasm arising from the rectum. it is characterized by the presence of spindle cells with cigar-shaped nuclei, interlacing fascicles, and a whorled pattern.

MONDO:0004126.name: thyroiditis
MONDO:0004126.def: inflammation of the thyroid gland. this category includes hashimoto thyroiditis, riedel thyroiditis, acute thyroiditis, subacute thyroiditis, and radiation-induced thyroiditis.

MONDO:0004127.name: lung occult adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004127.def: a lung adenocarcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. the primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

MONDO:0004128.name: lung occult large cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004128.def: a large cell lung carcinoma detectable by sputum cytology only. the primary tumor is undetectable radiographically or during bronchoscopy; therefore, it can not be assessed.

MONDO:0004129.name: cloacogenic carcinoma
MONDO:0004129.def: an anal carcinoma arising from the transitional zone of the anal canal.

MONDO:0004130.name: anus basaloid carcinoma
MONDO:0004130.def: an anal squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and peripheral nuclear palisading.

MONDO:0004131.name: anal verrucous carcinoma
MONDO:0004131.def: a large, well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with a cauliflower-like appearance, characterized by the presence of an exophytic and endophytic growth pattern. morphologically, there is papillomatosis and acanthosis present, however cytologically the neoplastic squamous cells have a benign appearance. dysplastic changes are minimal. it does not respond to conservative treatment and it is regarded by many authors as an intermediate lesion between condyloma acuminatum and squamous cell carcinoma.

MONDO:0004132.name: anal canal squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004132.def: a squamous cell carcinoma arising from the mucosa of the anal canal.
MONDO:0004132.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the anal canal

MONDO:0004133.name: pituitary gland mixed eosinophil-basophil adenoma
MONDO:0004133.def: an epithelial neoplasm of the anterior pituitary gland in which the neoplastic cells stain positive with acidic and basic dyes.

MONDO:0004135.name: subacute lymphocytic thyroiditis
MONDO:0004135.def: thyroiditis associated with painless enlargement of the thyroid gland. it occurs more frequently in females and is characterized by alterations between hyperthyroidism and hypothyroidism and the eventual return to normal thyroid gland function.

MONDO:0004136.name: ovarian endometrioid cystadenoma
MONDO:0004136.def: a benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by endometrial-type well-differentiated cells.

MONDO:0004138.name: obsolete maxillary sinus adenoid cystic carcinoma

MONDO:0004139.name: normocytic anemia
MONDO:0004139.def: anemia in which the red blood cell volume is normal.

MONDO:0004140.name: intermediate malignant teratoma
MONDO:0004140.def: an immature teratoma characterized by the presence of an intermediate amount of undifferentiated tissues.

MONDO:0004142.name: lung combined large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
MONDO:0004142.def: a subtype of large cell neuroendocrine lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of large neuroendocrine cells in combination with adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, giant cell carcinoma and/ or spindle cell carcinoma.
MONDO:0004142.synonym: pulmonary combined large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma

MONDO:0004143.name: psammomatous meningioma
MONDO:0004143.def: a who grade i meningioma characterized by the presence of psammoma bodies that predominate over the meningeal cells.

MONDO:0004144.name: fibrous meningioma
MONDO:0004144.def: a who grade i meningioma characterized by the presence of spindle cells that form bundles in a collagen matrix.

MONDO:0004145.name: meningothelial meningioma
MONDO:0004145.def: a who grade i meningioma characterized by the presence of tumor cells that form lobules. the tumor cells are generally uniform. whorls and psammoma bodies are usually not present.

MONDO:0004146.name: transitional meningioma
MONDO:0004146.def: a who grade i meningioma characterized by the coexistence of meningothelial cells and fibrous architectural patterns.

MONDO:0004147.name: noninvasive malignant thymoma
MONDO:0004147.def: a morphologically malignant thymoma that is entirely confined within the capsule.

MONDO:0004148.name: gallbladder papillary neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
MONDO:0004148.def: an intraluminal papillary neoplasm, usually with high grade intraepithelial neoplasia, that arises from the gallbladder. it is associated with the presence of an invasive carcinoma. the carcinomatous component is usually an adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0004149.name: gallbladder pleomorphic giant cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004149.synonym: pleomorphic giant cell adenocarcinoma of the gallbladder

MONDO:0004150.name: breast giant fibroadenoma
MONDO:0004150.def: a breast fibroadenoma characterized by a very large size. this term has also been used as a synonym for juvenile fibroadenoma by some authors. the latter is characterized by epithelial hyperplasia and an increased stromal cellularity.

MONDO:0004151.name: spinal meninges cancer
MONDO:0004151.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the meninx of spinal cord.

MONDO:0004152.name: chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma with immunoglobulin heavy chain variable-region gene somatic hypermutation
MONDO:0004152.def: a recently recognized variant of chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (cll/sll) expressing somatic hypermutations of the immunoglobulin heavy chain (igh) genes. the recognition of this variant alters the belief that cll/sll is always derived from a naive, pregerminal center b-cell. the presence of somatic hypermutations of igh genes occurs in approximately 50% of cll/sll cases and implies a postgerminal center, memory origin. patients with this variant of cll/sll have a favorable prognosis, with a reported median survival of more than 24 years.
MONDO:0004152.synonym: postgerminal centre chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma

MONDO:0004153.name: childhood central nervous system embryonal carcinoma
MONDO:0004153.def: an embryonal carcinoma that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.
MONDO:0004153.synonym: pediatric embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system

MONDO:0004154.name: obsolete central nervous system embryonal carcinoma

MONDO:0004155.name: adult central nervous system embryonal carcinoma
MONDO:0004155.def: a embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system that occurs in an adult.
MONDO:0004155.synonym: embryonal carcinoma of the central nervous system of adults

MONDO:0004156.name: pancreatic mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004156.def: a mucinous cystadenocarcinoma that involves the pancreas.

MONDO:0004158.name: pancreatic mucinous-cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
MONDO:0004158.def: a cystic epithelial neoplasm characterized by the presence of columnar mucin-producing epithelial cells, ovarian-type stroma formation, and a focal or extensive invasive carcinomatous component.
MONDO:0004158.synonym: pancreatic mucinous-cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma

MONDO:0004159.name: pancreatic non-invasive mucinous cystadenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004159.def: a non-invasive malignant cystic epithelial neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. it occurs almost exclusively in women. small tumors are usually found incidentally. larger tumors usually produce symptoms related to compression of the adjacent structures. it is characterized by the presence of columnar, mucin-producing epithelial cells which often form papillary projections with irregular branching and budding. there is cellular stratification, severe dysplasia, and high mitotic activity present. complete surgical removal is usually associated with an excellent prognosis.

MONDO:0004160.name: female stress incontinence
MONDO:0004160.def: the involuntary loss of urine in females secondary to insufficient strength of the pelvic floor muscles; this can result from physical changes following pregnancy and childbirth, or as a response to a decrease in estrogen during menopause.

MONDO:0004161.name: uterine corpus apoplectic leiomyoma
MONDO:0004161.def: a morphologic variant of uterine corpus leiomyoma characterized by zones of hemorrhagic infarction surrounded by hypercellular areas. it usually develops in women of childbearing years, particularly those that are pregnant, post-partum, or taking oral contraceptives.
MONDO:0004161.synonym: uterine corpus leiomyoma with apoplectic change

MONDO:0004162.name: uterine corpus cellular leiomyoma
MONDO:0004162.def: a morphologic variant of leiomyoma arising from the uterine corpus. it is characterized by a dense cellular infiltrate composed of spindle or round cells with scant cytoplasm and a less obvious interlacing fascicle pattern.

MONDO:0004163.name: bladder urachal urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0004163.def: a transitional cell carcinoma of the urinary bladder that arises from the urachal epithelium.

MONDO:0004164.name: lymphoepithelioma-like acinar prostate adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004164.def: a variant of prostate carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant cells forming syncytial patterns and dense lymphocytic infiltrates.

MONDO:0004165.name: selective igd deficiency disease
MONDO:0004165.def: a rare dysgammaglobulinemia characterized by low or undetectable serum levels of immunoglobulin class d (igd). it is an uncommon primary antibody deficiency. it is most likely an inherited immunodeficiency. it may be caused by decreased or inefficient production of igd from progenitor b cells without any corresponding decreases in the other isotypes. most affected persons are asymptomatic and do not appear to be at increased risk for infection.

MONDO:0004166.name: hereditary fallopian tube carcinoma
MONDO:0004166.def: fallopian tube carcinoma that has developed in relatives of patients that have a history of fallopian tube carcinoma.

MONDO:0004168.name: cribriform variant testicular seminoma
MONDO:0004168.def: a morphologic variant of testicular seminoma characterized by the presence of seminoma cells arranged in cribriform patterns and few lymphocytes.

MONDO:0004169.name: premenstrual tension
MONDO:0004169.def: a combination of distressing physical, psychologic, or behavioral changes that occur during the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle. symptoms of pms are diverse (such as pain, water-retention, anxiety, cravings, and depression) and they diminish markedly 2 or 3 days after the initiation of menses.

MONDO:0004172.name: uterine corpus adenocarcinofibroma
MONDO:0004172.def: a adenocarcinofibroma that involves the body of uterus.

MONDO:0004173.name: adenocarcinoma of skene gland origin
MONDO:0004173.def: a rare adenocarcinoma arising from skene gland. it presents as a periurethral or anterior vaginal submucosal mass. it is characterized by morphological features similar to prostate adenocarcinoma.

MONDO:0004174.name: secretory uterine corpus endometrioid adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004174.def: an endometrioid adenocarcinoma arising from the endometrium. morphologically it is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells containing glycogen vacuoles which are usually subnuclear and reminiscent of early secretory endometrium.

MONDO:0004176.name: childhood extraosseous osteosarcoma
MONDO:0004176.def: an osteosarcoma arising from the soft tissue, and occurring during childhood.

MONDO:0004177.name: benign urethral neoplasm
MONDO:0004177.def: abnormal growth of the cells of the urethra (lower urinary tract) without malignant characteristics.

MONDO:0004178.name: testicular yolk sac tumor, endodermal sinus pattern
MONDO:0004178.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of connective tissue stalks that contain a blood vessel and are lined by cells with clear cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli.
MONDO:0004178.synonym: testicular yolk sac tumor, endodermal sinus pattern

MONDO:0004180.name: benign urinary system neoplasm
MONDO:0004180.def: a non-metastasizing neoplasm that arises from the organs that comprise the urinary system. representative examples include renal oncocytoma, bladder inverted papilloma, and urothelial papilloma.

MONDO:0004181.name: breast adenomyoepithelial adenosis
MONDO:0004181.def: an uncommon variant of breast adenosis characterized by the presence of irregularly shaped glands, epithelial cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, and prominent myopepithelial cells. mild atypia may be present.

MONDO:0004182.name: stage ivb bladder cancer
MONDO:0004182.def: stage iv includes t4b, no,mo/any t ni, mo/ any t n2 mo,/ any t n3 mo/ any t any n m1 : t4b: tumor invades the pelvic wall, abdominal wall. n1: metastasis in a single lymph node, 2 cm or less in greatest dimension. n2: metastasis in a single lymph node, more than 2 cm but not more than 5 cm in greatest dimension; or multiple lymph nodes, none more than 5 cm in greatest dimension. n3: metastasis in a lymph node more than 5 cm in greatest dimension. m1: distant metastasis.

MONDO:0004183.name: axonal neuropathy
MONDO:0004183.def: any nerve disorder affecting the axon of a nerve.

MONDO:0004185.name: ovarian serous cystadenofibroma
MONDO:0004185.def: a benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by serous epithelial cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0004186.name: cranial nodular fasciitis
MONDO:0004186.def: a rare self-limiting, rapidly growing, non-encapsulated benign neoplasm that arises from the cranium. this is an osteolytic lesion. it is characterized by the presence of plump spindle-shaped fibroblasts, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, chronic inflammatory infiltrate, red blood cell extravasation, and high mitotic activity.

MONDO:0004187.name: nodular fasciitis
MONDO:0004187.def: a self-limiting, rapidly growing, non-encapsulated benign neoplasm that arises from the soft tissues. it is characterized by the presence of plump spindle-shaped fibroblasts, multinucleated osteoclast-like giant cells, chronic inflammatory infiltrate, red blood cell extravasation, and high mitotic activity.

MONDO:0004188.name: iris spindle cell melanoma
MONDO:0004188.def: a spindle cell melanoma that involves the iris.
MONDO:0004188.synonym: spindle cell melanoma of the iris

MONDO:0004189.name: esophageal tuberculosis
MONDO:0004189.def: a tuberculosis that involves the esophagus.

MONDO:0004190.name: nephrogenic adenoma of urinary bladder
MONDO:0004190.def: a metaplastic lesion of the urothelium found in the urinary bladder. it is characterized by the presence of aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells and represents a reaction of the urothelium to injury caused by instrumentation, surgery or calculi.

MONDO:0004191.name: nephrogenic adenoma
MONDO:0004191.def: so-called nephrogenic adenoma is a distinct metaplastic lesion of the urothelium characterized by aggregates of cuboidal or hobnail cells. these cells line thin papillary fronds on the surface or form tubular structures within the lamina propria.

MONDO:0004192.name: urethra cancer
MONDO:0004192.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the urethra

MONDO:0004193.name: pediatric ovarian dysgerminoma
MONDO:0004193.def: a dysgerminoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004194.name: ovarian stromal hyperthecosis
MONDO:0004194.def: a non-neoplastic disorder that usually affects postmenopausal women. it is characterized by the leuteinization of ovarian stromal cells. the ovaries are bilaterally involved and enlarged. when it affects women in reproductive age, it causes virilization, high blood pressure, and increased insulin levels.

MONDO:0004195.name: thymic dysplasia
MONDO:0004195.def: the developmental arrest and architectural distortion of the thymus that results in immunodeficiency.

MONDO:0004196.name: rectal sarcomatoid carcinoma
MONDO:0004196.def: a biphasic rectal carcinoma with a spindle cell, sarcomatoid component.

MONDO:0004197.name: male urethral cancer
MONDO:0004197.def: a cancer involving a male urethra.

MONDO:0004198.name: testicular yolk sac tumor, solid pattern
MONDO:0004198.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of aggregates of polygonal malignant cells with clear cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli.
MONDO:0004198.synonym: testicular yolk sac tumor, solid pattern

MONDO:0004199.name: vulvar keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004199.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the presence of keratin pearls.

MONDO:0004200.name: superficial urinary bladder carcinoma
MONDO:0004200.def: a term used by urologists to describe an infiltrating carcinoma of the bladder that has not invaded into the muscularis propria of the bladder wall regardless of histologic type or grade.

MONDO:0004201.name: pituitary hypoplasia
MONDO:0004201.def: incomplete development of the pituitary gland.

MONDO:0004202.name: adrenal medulla carcinoma
MONDO:0004202.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the adrenal medulla

MONDO:0004203.name: female urethral cancer
MONDO:0004203.def: a cancer that involves the female urethra.

MONDO:0004204.name: squamous cell skin papilloma
MONDO:0004204.def: a squamous papilloma that involves the zone of skin.

MONDO:0004206.name: pulmonary vein leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0004206.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the pulmonary vein. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004207.name: pulmonary artery leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0004207.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the pulmonary artery it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004208.name: superior vena cava leiomyosarcoma
MONDO:0004208.def: an aggressive malignant smooth muscle neoplasm, arising from the superior vena cava. it is characterized by a proliferation of neoplastic spindle cells.
MONDO:0004208.synonym: leiomyosarcoma of the superior vena cava

MONDO:0004209.name: cerebral primitive neuroectodermal tumor
MONDO:0004209.def: a central nervous system embryonal tumor, not otherwise specified arising from the cerebral hemispheres.
MONDO:0004209.synonym: primitive neuroectodermal tumour of the cerebrum

MONDO:0004210.name: colonic l-cell glucagon-like peptide producing tumor
MONDO:0004210.def: a neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the colon and produces glucagon-like peptides. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.
MONDO:0004210.synonym: l-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumour of colon

MONDO:0004211.name: l-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0004211.def: a neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the gastrointestinal tract and produces glucagon-like peptides. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.

MONDO:0004212.name: vulvar keratoacanthoma-like carcinoma
MONDO:0004212.def: a rapidly growing squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva. it is self-limited and is characterized by the presence of a central crater that contains squamous cells. the proliferating squamous cells infiltrate the dermis below and produce keratin masses that are pushed towards the surface of the tumor.
MONDO:0004212.synonym: vulvar squamous cell carcinoma, keratoacanthoma type

MONDO:0004213.name: vulvar non-keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004213.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the vulva and is characterized by the absence of keratin pearls.

MONDO:0004214.name: ovarian endometrioid cystadenofibroma
MONDO:0004214.def: a benign neoplasm of the ovary characterized by the presence of cystic structures lined by endometrial-type well-differentiated cells in a fibrotic stroma.

MONDO:0004215.name: cutaneous anthrax
MONDO:0004215.def: an anthrax disease that results in infection located in skin, has material basis in bacillus anthracis, which is transmitted by contact with infected animals or animal products. the infection has symptom skin lesion that eventually forms an ulcer with a black center.

MONDO:0004216.name: pineal region germinoma
MONDO:0004216.def: a germinoma that arises from the pineal gland.

MONDO:0004217.name: childhood brain germinoma
MONDO:0004217.def: a germinoma arising from the brain during childhood.

MONDO:0004218.name: childhood germ cell brain tumor
MONDO:0004218.def: a germ cell tumor arising from brain during childhood.

MONDO:0004219.name: polyvesicular vitelline pattern testicular yolk sac tumor
MONDO:0004219.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of collections of vesicles that are surrounded by connective tissue.
MONDO:0004219.synonym: testicular yolk sac tumor, polyvesicular vitelline pattern

MONDO:0004220.name: endometrial endometrioid adenocarcinoma with spindled epithelial cells
MONDO:0004220.def: a primary endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium characterized by the presence of spindled malignant epithelial cells.

MONDO:0004221.name: uterine corpus perivascular epithelioid cell tumor
MONDO:0004221.def: a neoplasm with perivascular epithelioid cell differentiation arising from the uterine corpus wall.

MONDO:0004222.name: ovarian clear cell cystadenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004222.def: a malignant glandular epithelial neoplasm arising from the ovary. it is characterized by the presence of clear and hobnail cells and cystic structures.

MONDO:0004223.name: polyp of middle ear
MONDO:0004223.def: a benign polypoid growth in the middle ear.

MONDO:0004225.name: monoclonal gammopathy of uncertain significance
MONDO:0004225.def: a condition characterized by the presence of a monoclonal gammopathy (mg) in which the clonal mass has not reached a predefined state in which the condition is considered malignant. up to 25% of cases of monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance (mgus) progress to a b-cell malignancy or myeloma. mgus may occur in conjunction with various carcinomas, chronic inflammatory and infectious conditions, and other diseases.

MONDO:0004227.name: epididymal adenomatoid tumor
MONDO:0004227.def: a benign, usually asymptomatic small mesothelial tumor that arises from the epididymis.

MONDO:0004229.name: acantholytic variant squamous cell breast carcinoma
MONDO:0004229.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by cellular discohesion resulting in a pseudoangiosarcomatous pattern.
MONDO:0004229.synonym: squamous cell breast carcinoma, acantholytic variant

MONDO:0004230.name: adenomatoid tumor
MONDO:0004230.def: a benign neoplasm arising from mesothelial cells. it is characterized by the formation of glandular and tubular patterns. it can occur in several anatomic sites including the pleura, peritoneum, and epididymis.

MONDO:0004231.name: spindle cell variant squamous cell breast carcinoma
MONDO:0004231.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped malignant cells.
MONDO:0004231.synonym: squamous cell breast carcinoma, spindle cell variant

MONDO:0004232.name: large cell keratinizing variant squamous cell breast carcinoma
MONDO:0004232.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the breast parenchyma and is characterized by the presence of large malignant cells that exhibit keratinization.
MONDO:0004232.synonym: squamous cell breast carcinoma, large cell keratinizing variant

MONDO:0004233.name: childhood pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0004233.def: a rare aggressive rhabdomyosarcoma occurring in children. the neoplasm is characterized by the presence of bizarre round, spindle, and polygonal cells.

MONDO:0004234.name: chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of nk-cells
MONDO:0004234.def: an epstein-barr virus negative disorder with a chronic clinical course affecting predominantly adults and characterized by the proliferation of large granular lymphocytes with natural killer cell immunophenotype. the t-cell receptor genes are not rearranged.
MONDO:0004234.synonym: nk-type lymphoproliferative disorder of granular lymphocytes

MONDO:0004235.name: diverticulitis
MONDO:0004235.def: an infection that develops in the diverticula of the intestinal tract. signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, fever, and leukocytosis.

MONDO:0004236.name: duodenal somatostatinoma
MONDO:0004236.def: a somatostatin-producing neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the duodenum. it is characterized by the presence of tubulo-glandular structures.

MONDO:0004237.name: large cell carcinoma with rhabdoid phenotype
MONDO:0004237.def: a rare poorly differentiated morphologic variant of large cell lung carcinoma characterized by the presence of rhabdoid cells.

MONDO:0004238.name: petrous apex meningioma
MONDO:0004238.def: a meningioma that affects the petrous apex.

MONDO:0004239.name: cervical keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004239.def: a variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of keratin pearls. intercellular bridges and cytoplasmic keratinization are usually present.

MONDO:0004240.name: posterior urethra cancer
MONDO:0004240.def: a malignant neoplasm that affects the portion of the urethra that is close to the bladder.

MONDO:0004241.name: osgood-schlatter disease
MONDO:0004241.def: osteochondrosis of the growth plate near the tibial tuberosity.

MONDO:0004243.name: vulvar proximal-type epithelioid sarcoma
MONDO:0004243.def: an epithelioid sarcoma of the proximal type involving the vulva.

MONDO:0004244.name: proximal-type epithelioid sarcoma
MONDO:0004244.def: an epithelioid sarcoma predominantly involving the pelvis, perineum, and genital organs. it tends to have a more aggressive clinical course as compared to the more frequently seen distal-type epithelioid sarcoma.

MONDO:0004245.name: ependymal tumor of brain
MONDO:0004245.def: a tumor arising from the ependymal lining of the ventricles.

MONDO:0004247.name: peptic ulcer disease
MONDO:0004247.def: a digestive system disease characterized by discontinuation in the inner lining of the gastrointestinal (gi) tract because of gastric acid secretion or pepsin.

MONDO:0004248.name: pediatric infratentorial ependymoma
MONDO:0004248.def: an ependymoma that arises from the infratentorial region of the brain and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004249.name: pediatric supratentorial ependymoma
MONDO:0004249.def: an ependymoma that arises from the supratentorial region of the brain and occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004250.name: extrahepatic bile duct papillary adenoma
MONDO:0004250.def: an adenoma that arises from the extrahepatic bile ducts. it is characterized by the presence of a papillary growth pattern.
MONDO:0004250.synonym: papillary adenoma of the extrahepatic bile duct

MONDO:0004251.name: small intestine neoplasm
MONDO:0004251.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the small intestine. representative examples of benign neoplasms include lipoma and leiomyoma. representative examples of malignant neoplasms include carcinoma, lymphoma, and sarcoma.

MONDO:0004252.name: small intestinal l-cell glucagon-like peptide producing tumor
MONDO:0004252.def: a neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the small intestine and produces glucagon-like peptides. morphologically, it is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells forming tubular or trabecular patterns.
MONDO:0004252.synonym: small intestine l-cell glucagon-like peptide-producing neuroendocrine tumour

MONDO:0004253.name: intraductal breast papillomatosis
MONDO:0004253.def: a benign breast neoplasm characterized by the proliferation of multiple papillomas within the lumen of the ducts.

MONDO:0004255.name: wolffian adnexal tumor
MONDO:0004255.def: a benign or malignant epithelial neoplasm of probable wolffian origin. it predominantly arises from the broad ligament and presents as a unilateral adnexal mass.

MONDO:0004256.name: lumbar spinal canal and spinal cord meningioma
MONDO:0004256.def: a meningioma that arises from the meninges of the lumbar region of the spinal cord.
MONDO:0004256.synonym: meningioma of the lumbar spinal canal and spinal cord

MONDO:0004257.name: childhood central nervous system mixed germ cell tumor
MONDO:0004257.def: a mixed germ cell tumor that arises from the central nervous system and occurs during childhood.
MONDO:0004257.synonym: pediatric mixed germ cell tumor of central nervous system

MONDO:0004258.name: female orgasmic disorder
MONDO:0004258.def: a sexual disorder in which a woman fails to achieve orgasm during sexual intercourse.

MONDO:0004259.name: endocervical carcinoma
MONDO:0004259.def: a carcinoma that arises from epithelial cells of the endocervix.

MONDO:0004260.name: peptic ulcer perforation
MONDO:0004260.def: penetration of a peptic ulcer through the wall of duodenum or stomach allowing the leakage of luminal contents into the peritoneal cavity.

MONDO:0004261.name: periductal breast myoepitheliosis
MONDO:0004261.def: a neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells around small breast ducts.

MONDO:0004262.name: breast myoepitheliosis
MONDO:0004262.def: a multifocal neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells within and/or around small breast ducts.

MONDO:0004263.name: pediatric infratentorial ependymoblastoma
MONDO:0004263.def: an embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, c19mc-altered that arises from the infratentorial region and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004265.name: acute endometritis
MONDO:0004265.def: an acute, usually bacterial infection affecting the endometrium. it is characterized by the presence of neutrophils or microabscesses in the endometrial glands. symptoms include fever, lower abdominal pain, and vaginal discharge.

MONDO:0004266.name: anal gland adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004266.def: an anal adenocarcinoma arising from the epithelium of the anal glands. the overlying anal mucosa does not show evidence of neoplastic changes.

MONDO:0004267.name: squamous papillomatosis
MONDO:0004267.def: a benign squamous neoplasm characterized by a papillary growth pattern, diffusely involving a specific anatomic site.

MONDO:0004269.name: breast cystic hypersecretory carcinoma
MONDO:0004269.synonym: cystic hypersecretory duct carcinoma of the breast

MONDO:0004270.name: breast ductal adenoma
MONDO:0004270.def: a benign, well circumscribed neoplasm that is located within the lumen of a duct in the breast parenchyma. it is characterized by the presence of glandular structures at the periphery and fibrous tissue at the center of the tumor.

MONDO:0004271.name: pregnancy adenoma
MONDO:0004271.def: a tubular type adenoma of the breast in which, during pregnancy and lactation, the epithelial cells show extensive secretory changes.

MONDO:0004272.name: urinary bladder tuberculosis
MONDO:0004272.def: a tuberculosis that involves the urinary bladder.

MONDO:0004273.name: breast apocrine adenoma
MONDO:0004273.def: a rare, benign and well circumscribed neoplasm that arises from the breast. it is characterized by the proliferation of epithelial cells with extensive apocrine metaplasia.

MONDO:0004274.name: mixed epithelial/mesenchymal metaplastic breast carcinoma
MONDO:0004274.def: an invasive breast carcinoma characterized by the presence of a mesenchymal cellular component. the mesenchymal cellular component ranges from cartilaginous and osseous, to purely sarcomatous.

MONDO:0004275.name: osteosarcoma arising in bone paget disease
MONDO:0004275.def: a sarcomatous transformation of pre-existing paget disease of the bone. osteosarcomas arising from paget disease of the bone are high grade lesions and usually have a poor prognosis.

MONDO:0004276.name: ceruminoma
MONDO:0004276.def: a benign epithelial neoplasm derived from ceruminous glands in the external auditory canal. it presents as a gray mass covered by skin. it is characterized by a proliferation of glands composed of cells with abundant eosinophilic and granular cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004277.name: gonorrhea
MONDO:0004277.def: a common sexually transmitted bacterial infection caused by neisseria gonorrhoeae. it is transmitted through vaginal, oral, or anal intercourse. infected individuals may be asymptomatic. symptoms in males include burning sensation during urination, discharge from the penis, and painful swelling of the testes. symptoms in females include painful urination, vaginal discharge, and vaginal bleeding between periods. if untreated, the infection may lead to pelvic inflammatory disease.

MONDO:0004278.name: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma sarcomatoid variant
MONDO:0004278.def: an invasive transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder that exhibits spindle cell sarcomatoid features.
MONDO:0004278.synonym: sarcomatoid carcinoma of the urinary bladder

MONDO:0004279.name: glossopharyngeal motor neuropathy
MONDO:0004279.def: diseases of the ninth cranial (glossopharyngeal) nerve or its nuclei in the medulla. the nerve may be injured by diseases affecting the lower brain stem, floor of the posterior fossa, jugular foramen, or the nerve's extracranial course. clinical manifestations include loss of sensation from the pharynx, decreased salivation, and syncope. glossopharyngeal neuralgia refers to a condition that features recurrent unilateral sharp pain in the tongue, angle of the jaw, external auditory meatus and throat that may be associated with syncope. episodes may be triggered by cough, sneeze, swallowing, or pressure on the tragus of the ear. (adams et al., principles of neurology, 6th ed, p1390)
MONDO:0004279.synonym: motor peripheral neuropathy of glossopharyngeal nerve

MONDO:0004281.name: vulvar eccrine porocarcinoma
MONDO:0004281.def: an eccrine porocarcinoma that arises from the sweat glands in the vulva.

MONDO:0004283.name: vulvar clear cell hidradenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004283.def: a vulvar sweat gland carcinoma characterized by the presence of clear cells.

MONDO:0004285.name: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous carcinoma
MONDO:0004285.def: a malignant glandular neoplasm arising from the exocrine pancreas. microscopically it is characterized by the presence of mucoid stroma formation, papillary patterns, and cystic changes. it has been associated with kras and tp53 gene mutations.

MONDO:0004286.name: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm
MONDO:0004286.def: a usually slow-growing epithelial neoplasm with ductal differentiation that arises from the exocrine pancreas and grows mostly within the pancreatic ducts. grossly, it is characterized by the presence of intraductal masses. morphologically, there is proliferation of mucin-producing cells within the pancreatic ducts, intraductal accumulation of mucin, and a papillary growth pattern. it may be associated with the presence of an invasive carcinoma. it usually occurs in older patients. signs and symptoms include epigastric pain, weight loss, jaundice, chronic pancreatitis, and diabetes mellitus.

MONDO:0004287.name: pancreatic foamy gland adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004287.def: a pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of adenocarcinoma cells with foamy cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004288.name: scirrhous breast carcinoma
MONDO:0004288.def: an infiltrating ductal breast carcinoma associated with stromal fibrosis.

MONDO:0004289.name: glottis verrucous carcinoma
MONDO:0004289.def: an exophytic, slow growing, well differentiated and non-metastasizing squamous cell carcinoma with pushing margins that arises from the glottic area of the larynx. it usually presents with hoarseness.

MONDO:0004290.name: subglottis verrucous carcinoma
MONDO:0004290.def: an exophytic, slow growing, well differentiated and non-metastasizing squamous cell carcinoma with pushing margins that arises from the subglottic area of the larynx.

MONDO:0004291.name: subglottis squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004291.def: a squamous cell carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the subglottic area. symptoms include dyspnea and stridor. it spreads to the hypopharynx, trachea, and thyroid gland.

MONDO:0004292.name: supraglottis verrucous carcinoma
MONDO:0004292.def: an exophytic, slow growing, well differentiated and non-metastasizing squamous cell carcinoma with pushing margins that arises from the supraglottic area of the larynx.

MONDO:0004293.name: supraglottis squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004293.def: a squamous cell carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the supraglottic area. signs and symptoms include dysphagia, a sensation of foreign body in the throat, and hemoptysis. it spreads to the space anterior to the epiglottis, pyriform sinus, and base of the tongue.

MONDO:0004294.name: gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma
MONDO:0004294.def: a rare malignant trophoblastic tumor that arises from the ovary as a result of ectopic ovarian pregnancy. there is no germ cell component present.

MONDO:0004295.name: asbestos-related lung carcinoma
MONDO:0004295.def: a carcinoma arising in the lung due to exposure to asbestos.

MONDO:0004296.name: cervical lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma
MONDO:0004296.def: a variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of islands of cells with uniform, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli and a dense lymphocytic infiltrate.

MONDO:0004297.name: lymphoepithelioma-like thymic carcinoma
MONDO:0004297.def: a rare, usually aggressive primary thymic carcinoma, characterized by a syncytial growth of undifferentiated carcinoma cells and the presence of a lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate. more than 40% of cases are associated with epstein-barr virus infection.

MONDO:0004301.name: fibrosarcomatous osteosarcoma
MONDO:0004301.def: a conventional osteosarcoma characterized by the presence of spindle shaped cells.

MONDO:0004302.name: chief cell adenoma
MONDO:0004302.def: a parathyroid gland adenoma composed predominantly of neoplastic chief cells. these cells have either slightly eosinophilic or vacuolated cytoplasm, and round nuclei.

MONDO:0004303.name: parathyroid gland clear cell adenoma
MONDO:0004303.def: a parathyroid gland adenoma composed predominantly of neoplastic cells with clear cytoplasm.
MONDO:0004303.synonym: transitional clear cell adenoma of the parathyroid gland

MONDO:0004304.name: mixed cell type adenoma of parathyroid
MONDO:0004304.def: a parathyroid gland adenoma that contains a mixture of neoplastic cells (chief cells, oncocytes, and clear cells).

MONDO:0004305.name: parathyroid oncocytic adenoma
MONDO:0004305.def: a parathyroid gland adenoma composed predominantly or entirely of neoplastic cells with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004306.name: childhood intracortical osteosarcoma
MONDO:0004306.def: a high grade malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm that produces osteoid and occurs in childhood. it arises from the medullary portion of the bone. it affects the long bones, and most commonly, the distal femur, proximal tibia, and proximal humerus. pain with or without a palpable mass is the most common clinical presentation. it usually has an aggressive growth and may metastasize through the hematogenous route. the lung is the most frequent site of metastasis.

MONDO:0004307.name: sarcomatosis of the meninges
MONDO:0004307.def: a rare condition characterized by diffuse spread of sarcoma cells throughout the meninges. the neoplastic cells are derived from meningeal connective tissue. clinically, this disorder may present as a fulminant pachymeningitis and/or encephalitis.

MONDO:0004308.name: meningeal sarcoma
MONDO:0004308.def: a rare sarcoma arising from the meninges.

MONDO:0004309.name: sarcomatosis
MONDO:0004309.def: the occurrence of several sarcomas in different anatomic locations.

MONDO:0004310.name: adult embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, c19mc-altered
MONDO:0004310.def: an embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, c19mc-altered, occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004311.name: carcinoma of cowper glands
MONDO:0004311.def: a carcinoma that involves the bulbo-urethral gland.

MONDO:0004312.name: suprasellar meningioma
MONDO:0004312.def: a meningioma that affects the suprasellar region.

MONDO:0004313.name: gasserian ganglion meningioma
MONDO:0004313.def: a meningioma that affects the trigeminal ganglion.

MONDO:0004314.name: malignant cutaneous granular cell skin tumor
MONDO:0004314.synonym: malignant granular cell tumour of the skin

MONDO:0004315.name: cholangiolocellular carcinoma
MONDO:0004315.def: an intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma that arises from the canals of hering.

MONDO:0004316.name: acantholytic squamous cell skin carcinoma
MONDO:0004316.def: a histologic variant of squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the skin. it is characterized by loosening of the intercellular bridges between the malignant cells which results in acantholysis.

MONDO:0004317.name: multiple spinal canal and spinal cord meningioma
MONDO:0004317.def: multiple meningiomas that arises from the spinal meninges.
MONDO:0004317.synonym: multiple spinal canal and spinal cord meningiomas

MONDO:0004318.name: pulmonary type ovarian small cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004318.def: an aggressive small cell neuroendocrine carcinoma that arises from the ovary. morphologically, it resembles the small cell carcinoma that arises from the lung.
MONDO:0004318.synonym: ovarian small cell carcinoma, pulmonary type

MONDO:0004319.name: hypercalcemic type ovarian small cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004319.def: an undifferentiated small cell carcinoma that arises from the ovary and is associated with hypercalcemia. electron microscopic studies show neurosecretory granules are either absent or, when present, are in small numbers.

MONDO:0004321.name: endometrial mixed adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004321.def: an adenocarcinoma that arises from the endometrium and is characterized by the presence of both type i and type ii endometrial adenocarcinoma components. the minor component constitutes at least 5% of the entire tumor.

MONDO:0004322.name: non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma
MONDO:0004322.def: a malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the ovary and is composed of cytotrophoblasts, syncytiotrophoblasts, and extravillous trophoblasts. the prognosis is less favorable than gestational choriocarcinoma.

MONDO:0004323.name: muscular atrophy
MONDO:0004323.def: the loss of muscle tissue due to inactivity or disease.

MONDO:0004324.name: testicular fibroma
MONDO:0004324.def: a benign neoplasm that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of fusiform cells and collagenization.

MONDO:0004325.name: testicular thecoma
MONDO:0004325.def: a rare benign tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of lipid-rich neoplastic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004326.name: sphenoid sinus inverted papilloma
MONDO:0004326.def: a benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the sphenoid sinus. it results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.

MONDO:0004327.name: sphenoid sinus schneiderian papilloma
MONDO:0004327.def: a papilloma that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the sphenoid sinus. it is classified as inverted papilloma and oncocytic papilloma.

MONDO:0004328.name: maxillary sinus adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004328.def: an adenocarcinoma that arises from the maxillary sinus. it is classified as intestinal-type or non-intestinal-type adenocarcinoma. nasal obstruction and epistaxis are the presenting signs.

MONDO:0004329.name: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with high grade dysplasia
MONDO:0004329.def: a non-invasive pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that exhibit loss of polarity, nuclear stratification, hyperchromasia, and pleomorphism. there is severe architectural atypia and frequent mitotic figures present.

MONDO:0004330.name: leptomeningeal sarcoma
MONDO:0004330.def: a sarcoma arising from the leptomeninges.

MONDO:0004331.name: bladder urachal adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004331.def: a adenocarcinoma that involves the urachus.

MONDO:0004332.name: lung hilum cancer
MONDO:0004332.def: a malignant neoplasm involving the lung hilus.
MONDO:0004332.synonym: primary malignant neoplasm of hilus of lung

MONDO:0004333.name: pancreatic acth-producing neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0004333.def: a malignant, ectopic acth secreting pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor, associated with cushing's syndrome. the prognosis is usually poor.

MONDO:0004334.name: non-functional pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0004334.def: a low or intermediate grade well differentiated tumor with neuroendocrine differentiation that arises from the pancreas. it is characterized by the absence of a hormone-related clinical syndrome.

MONDO:0004335.name: digestive system disorder
MONDO:0004335.def: a disease or disorder that involves the digestive system.

MONDO:0004336.name: rectal signet ring cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004336.def: an infiltrating adenocarcinoma arising from the rectum. it is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular cells with prominent intracytoplasmic mucin. these cells constitute more than 50% of the malignant cellular population.
MONDO:0004336.synonym: signet ring cell adenocarcinoma of the rectum

MONDO:0004337.name: perianal skin paget disease
MONDO:0004337.def: paget disease involving the perianal skin.

MONDO:0004339.name: tuberculum sellae meningioma
MONDO:0004339.def: a meningioma that affects the tuberculum sellae.

MONDO:0004340.name: mixed ductal-endocrine carcinoma of pancreas
MONDO:0004340.def: a carcinoma that arises from the pancreas showing a mixture of ductal and neuroendocrine malignant cells in both the primary tumor and in the metastatic sites.
MONDO:0004340.synonym: mixed ductal-neuroendocrine carcinoma of the pancreas

MONDO:0004341.name: colloid carcinoma of the pancreas
MONDO:0004341.def: an infiltrating pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, characterized by the presence of malignant cells floating in pools of mucin. it has a more favorable prognosis than the conventional infiltrating ductal adenocarcinoma. it often arises in association with intraductal pancreatic mucinous neoplasms and in some cases it may result in the development of pseudomyxoma peritonei.

MONDO:0004342.name: obsolete osteoclast-like giant cell neoplasm of the pancreas

MONDO:0004343.name: pancreatic acinar cell cystadenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004343.def: a cystic adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of relatively uniform neoplastic cells which produce pancreatic enzymes and are arranged in acinar patterns. signs and symptoms include abdominal pain, weight loss, nausea, and diarrhea. it usually has an aggressive clinical course.

MONDO:0004344.name: childhood malignant hemangiopericytoma
MONDO:0004344.def: a malignant hemangiopericytoma occurring in childhood.

MONDO:0004345.name: childhood malignant schwannoma
MONDO:0004345.def: a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor occurring in children.

MONDO:0004346.name: signet ring cell intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
MONDO:0004346.def: an intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma characterized by the presence of signet ring adenocarcinoma cells.

MONDO:0004349.name: retina lymphoma
MONDO:0004349.def: a lymphoma that involves the retina.

MONDO:0004350.name: pediatric extraocular retinoblastoma
MONDO:0004350.def: retinoblastoma during childhood that has spread beyond the eye.

MONDO:0004351.name: intraocular lymphoma
MONDO:0004351.def: a lymphoma that arises within the eye. signs and symptoms include decreased vision, uveitis, and vitreous floaters.

MONDO:0004352.name: adult brain ependymoma
MONDO:0004352.def: an ependymoma of the brain occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004353.name: extrahepatic biliary papillomatosis
MONDO:0004353.def: a non-invasive, papillary epithelial neoplasm that arises from the epithelium of the extrahepatic bile ducts.

MONDO:0004354.name: neonatal leukemia
MONDO:0004354.def: leukemia that occurs during the neonatal period.

MONDO:0004355.name: childhood leukemia
MONDO:0004355.def: an acute or chronic leukemia that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004356.name: childhood multilocular cystic kidney neoplasm
MONDO:0004356.def: a cystic neoplasm which arises from the kidney and occurs in children. it includes the cystic partially differentiated nephroblastoma and cases in which nephroblastomatous elements are not present.

MONDO:0004357.name: carcinoma of supraglottis
MONDO:0004357.def: a carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the supraglottic area.

MONDO:0004358.name: subglottis carcinoma
MONDO:0004358.def: a carcinoma of the larynx that arises from the subglottic area.

MONDO:0004359.name: delusional disorder
MONDO:0004359.def: a disorder characterized by the presence of one or more nonbizarre delusions that persist for at least 1 month; the delusion(s) are not due to schizophrenia or a mood disorder, and do not impair psychosocial functioning apart from the ramifications of the delusion(s).

MONDO:0004360.name: breast extraskeletal osteosarcoma
MONDO:0004360.def: an osteosarcoma arising from the breast tissue.

MONDO:0004361.name: adult spinal cord ependymoma
MONDO:0004361.def: an ependymoma of the spinal cord occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004363.name: adult spinal cord glioblastoma
MONDO:0004363.def: a rare spinal tumor which is highly malignant and tends to be locally invasive of surrounding neural tissue. the tumor also tends to spread throughout the neuroaxis and is often rapidly progressive. histologically the tumors are highly cellular with nuclear and cellular pleomorphism, endothelial proliferation, mitotic figures, and, often, necrosis. this tumor has a relatively poor prognosis. clinical features may include pain followed by rapidly progressive neurologic deficits such as extremity weakness, sensory changes, spasticity, and incontinence. (from innocenzi et al., clin neurol neurosurg 1997 feb;99(1):1-5)

MONDO:0004365.name: necrotic uveal melanoma
MONDO:0004365.def: a uveal melanoma characterized by the presence of tumor cell necrosis.

MONDO:0004366.name: mixed astrocytoma-ependymoma-oligodendroglioma
MONDO:0004366.def: a mixed glioma characterized by the presence of astrocytic, ependymal, and oligodendroglial neoplastic components.

MONDO:0004367.name: petroclival meningioma
MONDO:0004367.def: a meningioma that affects the petroclival region.

MONDO:0004368.name: sphenoorbital meningioma
MONDO:0004368.def: a meningioma that affects the sphenoorbital region.

MONDO:0004370.name: sphenocavernous meningioma
MONDO:0004370.def: a meningioma that affects the sphenocavernous region.

MONDO:0004371.name: spinal multifocal clear cell meningioma
MONDO:0004371.def: a clear cell meningioma arising in multiple areas of the spinal cord characterized by the presence of clear glycogen-rich polygonal cells.

MONDO:0004373.name: adult papillary meningioma
MONDO:0004373.def: a papillary meningioma occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004374.name: adult extraskeletal osteosarcoma
MONDO:0004374.def: an osteosarcoma arising from the soft tissue, and occurring in adults.

MONDO:0004375.name: end stage renal failure
MONDO:0004375.def: long-standing and persistent renal disease with glomerular filtration rate (gfr) less than 15 ml/min.

MONDO:0004376.name: infiltrating nipple syringomatous adenoma
MONDO:0004376.def: an invasive, non-metastasizing neoplasm with sweat duct differentiation that arises in the area of the nipple. local recurrences have been reported.

MONDO:0004377.name: pancreatic non-functioning delta cell tumor
MONDO:0004377.def: a usually malignant neuroendocrine tumor arising from the delta cells of the pancreas. it is not associated with a hormonal syndrome.
MONDO:0004377.synonym: nonfunctional pancreatic delta cell neuroendocrine tumour

MONDO:0004378.name: pediatric cerebral ependymoblastoma
MONDO:0004378.def: an embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes, c19mc-altered that arises from the cerebral hemispheres and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004379.name: female breast carcinoma
MONDO:0004379.def: a carcinoma that arises from the breast in females. it is the most common malignant tumor that affects females.
MONDO:0004379.synonym: mammary carcinoma of the female breast

MONDO:0004380.name: dendritic cell sarcoma
MONDO:0004380.def: a sarcoma that involves the dendritic cell.

MONDO:0004381.name: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with low grade dysplasia
MONDO:0004381.def: a non-invasive pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm characterized by the presence of neoplastic epithelial cells that form a single layer and are well polarized. the neoplastic cells exhibit small and uniform nuclei, mild pleomorphism, and rare mitotic figures.
MONDO:0004381.synonym: pancreatic intraductal papillary-mucinous neoplasm with low grade dysplasia

MONDO:0004382.name: laryngeal disorder
MONDO:0004382.def: a non-neoplastic or neoplastic disorder that affects the larynx. representative examples include laryngitis, vocal cord polyp, squamous papilloma, and carcinoma.

MONDO:0004383.name: adult central nervous system germinoma
MONDO:0004383.def: a central nervous system germinoma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004384.name: maxillary sinus inverted papilloma
MONDO:0004384.def: a benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the maxillary sinus. it results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.

MONDO:0004385.name: adult xanthogranuloma
MONDO:0004385.def: a xanthogranuloma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004386.name: uterine corpus atypical polypoid adenomyoma
MONDO:0004386.def: an adenomyoma that arises from the uterine corpus and is characterized by the presence of marked glandular architectural complexity. it may recur following excision.
MONDO:0004386.synonym: body of uterus atypical polypoid adenomyoma

MONDO:0004387.name: luteoma of pregnancy
MONDO:0004387.def: a non-neoplastic and self-limited condition that occurs during pregnancy. it is characterized by proliferation of luteinized stromal cells that replace the normal ovarian stromal cells. it is usually manifested with bilateral multinodular ovarian masses. treatment is not required.

MONDO:0004389.name: mite infestation
MONDO:0004389.def: infestations with arthropods of the subclass acari, superorder acariformes.

MONDO:0004390.name: ocular hypotension
MONDO:0004390.def: abnormally low intraocular pressure often related to chronic inflammation (uveitis).

MONDO:0004391.name: obsolete adult extraosseous chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0004391.def: obsolete. a extraosseous chondrosarcoma that occurs in an adult.

MONDO:0004392.name: intracranial extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0004392.def: an extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma arising from the structures within the cranium.

MONDO:0004393.name: mixed astrocytoma-ependymoma
MONDO:0004393.def: a tumor of mixed cell type with astrocytic components as well as ependymoma components.

MONDO:0004394.name: maxillary sinus squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004394.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the mucosal epithelial surface of the maxillary sinus. patients may present with nasal fullness, obstruction, and/or epistaxis.
MONDO:0004394.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the maxillofacial sinus

MONDO:0004396.name: cervical spinal canal and spinal cord meningioma
MONDO:0004396.def: a meningioma that arises from the meninges of the cervical region of the spinal cord.
MONDO:0004396.synonym: meningioma of the cervical spinal canal and spinal cord

MONDO:0004397.name: benign mediastinal psammomatous neurilemmoma
MONDO:0004397.def: a schwannoma that arises from the posterior mediastinum. it is characterized by the presence of psammoma bodies.
MONDO:0004397.synonym: benign psammomatous schwannoma of the mediastinum

MONDO:0004398.name: mediastinal schwannoma
MONDO:0004398.def: a schwannoma that arises from the posterior mediastinum. it is the most common neurogenic tumor of the mediastinum. excision is usually curative.

MONDO:0004400.name: malignant type a thymoma
MONDO:0004400.def: a type a thymoma which is characterized by an aggressive clinical course (capsular invasion, infiltration of the surrounding tissues) and can metastasize.

MONDO:0004401.name: testis refractory cancer
MONDO:0004401.def: malignant testicular germ cell tumor that is resistant to treatment.

MONDO:0004402.name: testicular yolk sac tumor, glandular-alveolar pattern
MONDO:0004402.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of gland-like spaces, irregular alveoli, and tubular structures.
MONDO:0004402.synonym: testicular yolk sac tumor, glandular-alveolar pattern

MONDO:0004403.name: childhood precursor t-lymphoblastic lymphoma/leukemia
MONDO:0004403.def: a t lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma that occurs during childhood.

MONDO:0004405.name: barrett adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004405.def: an adenocarcinoma arising from barrett metaplastic epithelium in the esophagus. there is evidence supporting the idea that the barrett adenocarcinomas develop through a stepwise progression through intestinal metaplastic epithelium to epithelial dysplasia to malignancy. adenocarcinomas arising in the setting of barrett esophagus are typically papillary and/or tubular. in terms of grading, they are well or moderately differentiated adenocarcinomas. -- 2002

MONDO:0004406.name: adult central nervous system mixed germ cell tumor
MONDO:0004406.def: a mixed germ cell tumor of central nervous system that occurs in an adult.
MONDO:0004406.synonym: mixed germ cell tumour of central nervous system of adults

MONDO:0004407.name: stroma-dominant and stroma-poor composite ganglioneuroblastoma
MONDO:0004407.def: a neuroblastic tumor characterized by the presence of a ganglioneuroblastoma component and the formation of schwannian stroma which is the predominant component of the tumor volume.

MONDO:0004408.name: schwannian stroma-rich and stroma-poor composite ganglioneuroblastoma
MONDO:0004408.def: a neuroblastic tumor characterized by the presence of a ganglioneuroblastoma component and the formation of schwannian stroma which constitutes more than fifty-percent of the tumor volume.
MONDO:0004408.synonym: composite ganglioneuroblastoma, schwannian stroma-rich and stroma-poor

MONDO:0004409.name: nipple duct carcinoma
MONDO:0004409.def: a carcinoma that develops in the ducts of the nipple.

MONDO:0004410.name: sarcomatoid penile squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004410.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis and is characterized by the presence of malignant spindle-shaped cells.
MONDO:0004410.synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the penis, sarcomatoid type

MONDO:0004411.name: duodenal gastrin-producing neuroendocrine tumor
MONDO:0004411.def: a gastrin-producing neuroendocrine tumor that arises from the duodenum. it is characterized by the presence of uniform cells that form pseudorosettes. the neoplastic cells have uniform nuclei and small amount of eosinophilic cytoplasm.

MONDO:0004412.name: malignant spiradenoma
MONDO:0004412.def: a very rare, aggressive carcinoma of the sweat glands arising from malignant transformation of a long standing spiradenoma. it usually grows in the upper extremities, lower extremities, trunk, and head and neck. it has the tendency to recur and metastasize most often to the lymph nodes, bones, and lungs.

MONDO:0004413.name: cervical non-keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004413.def: a variant of cervical squamous cell carcinoma characterized by the presence of polygonal squamous cells. intercellular bridges and cytoplasmic keratinization may be present, but keratin pearls are absent.

MONDO:0004414.name: tamoxifen-related endometrial lesion
MONDO:0004414.def: a spectrum of endometrial abnormalities that occur in women who use tamoxifen to treat or prevent the development of breast cancer. these abnormalities include endometrial polyps, endometrial hyperplasia, and endometrial carcinoma.

MONDO:0004415.name: lipid-cell variant infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0004415.synonym: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, lipid-cell variant

MONDO:0004416.name: plasmacytoid variant infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma

MONDO:0004417.name: nested variant infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0004417.synonym: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, nested variant

MONDO:0004418.name: microcystic variant infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0004418.synonym: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, microcystic variant

MONDO:0004419.name: lymphoma-like variant infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma
MONDO:0004419.synonym: infiltrating bladder urothelial carcinoma, lymphoma-like variant

MONDO:0004420.name: breast malignant eccrine spiradenoma
MONDO:0004420.def: a rare tumor characterized by malignant transformation of an eccrine spiradenoma of the breast.

MONDO:0004421.name: sclerosing breast papilloma
MONDO:0004421.def: a breast papilloma characterized by the presence of predominant sclerosing architectural features.

MONDO:0004422.name: cerebral falx meningioma
MONDO:0004422.def: a meningioma that affects the falx cerebri.
MONDO:0004422.synonym: meningioma of the falx of the cerebrum

MONDO:0004423.name: central nervous system extraskeletal osteosarcoma
MONDO:0004423.def: an osteosarcoma arising from the brain or spinal cord.
MONDO:0004423.synonym: osteosarcoma of the central nervous system

MONDO:0004425.name: hyperthyroidism
MONDO:0004425.def: overactivity of the thyroid gland resulting in overproduction of thyroid hormone and increased metabolic rate. causes include diffuse hyperplasia of the thyroid gland (graves' disease), single nodule in the thyroid gland, and thyroiditis. the symptoms are related to the increased metabolic rate and include weight loss, fatigue, heat intolerance, excessive sweating, diarrhea, tachycardia, insomnia, muscle weakness, and tremor.

MONDO:0004426.name: frontal convexity meningioma
MONDO:0004426.def: a meningioma that affects the frontal sulcus.

MONDO:0004427.name: supraglottis neoplasm
MONDO:0004427.def: a benign or malignant neoplasm that affects the supraglottic area of the larynx.

MONDO:0004428.name: alveoli adenoma
MONDO:0004428.def: a benign, well circumscribed lung neoplasm morphologically characterized by the presence of cystic spaces resembling alveoli, lined by a simple cuboidal epithelium. the cystic spaces are surrounded by a spindle cell stroma which may show myxoid changes. it is a solitary, usually peripheral lung lesion. patients are usually asymptomatic and its discovery is an incidental finding during chest x-ray examination. surgical excision is curative.

MONDO:0004429.name: skin meningioma
MONDO:0004429.def: a meningioma (disease) that involves the zone of skin.

MONDO:0004430.name: penis mixed squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0004430.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis and is characterized by a mixture of morphologic patterns (e.g., high grade squamous cell carcinoma and verrucous carcinoma or warty-basaloid carcinoma).
MONDO:0004430.synonym: mixed squamous cell carcinoma of the penis

MONDO:0004431.name: hemarthrosis
MONDO:0004431.def: bleeding into the joints. it may arise from trauma or spontaneously in patients with hemophilia.

MONDO:0004432.name: mature pericardial teratoma
MONDO:0004432.def: a benign teratoma that arises from the pericardium.

MONDO:0004433.name: papillary carcinoma of the penis
MONDO:0004433.def: a squamous cell carcinoma that arises from the penis and is characterized by the presence of a papillary growth pattern.
MONDO:0004433.synonym: squamous carcinoma of the penis, papillary type

MONDO:0004435.name: liver fibrosarcoma
MONDO:0004435.def: a usually aggressive malignant neoplasm arising from the liver. it is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped fibroblasts and collagenous stroma formation in a herringbone growth pattern.

MONDO:0004436.name: ovarian myxoid liposarcoma
MONDO:0004436.def: a liposarcoma that arises from the ovary and is composed of round to oval mesenchymal cells, small signet ring lipoblasts, and a rich network of capillaries in a myxoid stroma.

MONDO:0004437.name: obsolete gastric signet ring cell adenocarcinoma

MONDO:0004438.name: sporadic breast cancer
MONDO:0004438.def: a carcinoma that arises from the breast and is not caused by inherited genetic mutations.

MONDO:0004439.name: periocular meningioma
MONDO:0004439.def: a meningioma that affects the periocular region.

MONDO:0004440.name: pineal region meningioma
MONDO:0004440.def: a meningioma that affects the pineal gland.

MONDO:0004441.name: childhood ovarian embryonal carcinoma
MONDO:0004441.def: an embryonal carcinoma that arises from the ovary and occurs in children.

MONDO:0004442.name: testis polyembryoma
MONDO:0004442.def: a rare malignant germ cell tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of embryoid bodies.

MONDO:0004443.name: chest wall parachordoma
MONDO:0004443.def: a parachordoma arising from the chest wall.

MONDO:0004444.name: bladder tubulo-cystic clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004444.def: a rare morphologic variant of bladder carcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and clear cells forming a tubulo-cystic pattern.

MONDO:0004445.name: bladder papillary clear cell adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004445.def: a rare morphologic variant of bladder adenocarcinoma characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells and clear cells forming a papillary pattern.

MONDO:0004446.name: olfactory groove meningioma
MONDO:0004446.def: a meningioma that affects the olfactory sulcus.

MONDO:0004447.name: pituitary stalk meningioma
MONDO:0004447.def: a meningioma that affects the pituitary stalk.

MONDO:0004448.name: frontal sinus inverted papilloma
MONDO:0004448.def: a benign neoplasm that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the frontal sinus. it results from the invagination and proliferation of epithelial cells in the underlying stroma.
MONDO:0004448.synonym: inverted papilloma of the frontal sinus

MONDO:0004449.name: intraductal breast myoepitheliosis
MONDO:0004449.def: a neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells within small breast ducts.

MONDO:0004450.name: carotid artery occlusion
MONDO:0004450.def: a occlusion precerebral artery that involves the carotid artery segment.
MONDO:0004450.synonym: occlusion precerebral artery of carotid artery segment

MONDO:0004451.name: sarcomatous intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
MONDO:0004451.def: a rare, aggressive variant of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. it is characterized by the presence of adenocarcinoma cells that are intermingled with malignant pleomorphic spindle cells.

MONDO:0004452.name: childhood central nervous system germinoma
MONDO:0004452.def: a germinoma arising from the central nervous system during childhood.

MONDO:0004453.name: testicular yolk sac tumor, myxomatous pattern
MONDO:0004453.def: a yolk sac tumor that arises from the testis and is characterized by the presence of myxomatous tissue that contains collections of malignant cells with prominent nucleoli.
MONDO:0004453.synonym: testicular yolk sac tumor, myxomatous pattern

MONDO:0004454.name: cellular congenital mesoblastic nephroma
MONDO:0004454.def: a congenital mesoblastic nephroma characterized by increased cellularity, sheet-like proliferation of fibroblastic cells, and increased mitotic activity. necrotic changes are commonly present.

MONDO:0004455.name: classic congenital mesoblastic nephroma
MONDO:0004455.def: a congenital mesoblastic nephroma characterized by the presence of interlacing fascicles of fibroblastic cells, low mitotic activity, and collagen formation.

MONDO:0004456.name: cocaine abuse
MONDO:0004456.def: disorders related or resulting from use of cocaine.

MONDO:0004457.name: maxillary sinus schneiderian papilloma
MONDO:0004457.def: a papilloma that arises from the ciliated respiratory mucosa that lines the maxillary sinus. it is classified as inverted papilloma and oncocytic papilloma.
MONDO:0004457.synonym: schneiderian papilloma of the maxillary sinus

MONDO:0004459.name: bladder hepatoid adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0004459.def: a hepatoid adenocarcinoma that involves the urinary bladder.

MONDO:0004460.name: thyroid gland fetal adenoma
MONDO:0004460.def: a thyroid gland adenoma composed of microfollicular structures.

MONDO:0004461.name: vaginal tubulovillous adenoma
MONDO:0004461.def: an adenoma that arises from the vagina and is characterized by a tubulovillous architectural pattern.

MONDO:0004462.name: extrahepatic bile duct cystadenoma
