MONDO:0012648.name: isobutyryl-coa dehydrogenase deficiency
MONDO:0012648.def: an inborn error of valine metabolism. the prevalence is unknown. only one symptomatic patient (with anemia, failure to thrive, dilated cardiomyopathy and plasma carnitine deficiency) has been described so far, but several series of patients have been identified through newborn screening programs relying on detection of increased c(4)-carnitine levels by tandem mass spectrometry. the disorder is caused by mutations in the acad8 gene (11q25).

MONDO:0012650.name: cernunnos-xlf deficiency
MONDO:0012650.def: cernunnos-xlf deficiency is a rare form of combined immunodeficiency characterized by microcephaly, growth retardation, and t and b cell lymphopenia.
MONDO:0012650.synonym: severe combined immunodeficiency with sensitivity to ionizing radiation due to nhej1 deficiency

MONDO:0012651.name: spastic ataxia 2
MONDO:0012651.def: autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia type 58 is a rare, complex subtype of hereditary spastic paraplegia characterized by variable onset of slowly progressive lower limb spasticity and weakness and prominent cerebellar ataxia, associated with gait disturbances, dysarthria, increased deep tendon reflexes and extensor plantar responses. additional features may include involuntary movements (i.e. clonus, tremor, fasciculations, chorea), decreased vibration sense, oculomotor abnormalities (e.g. nystagmus) and distal amyotrophy in the upper and lower limbs.

MONDO:0012652.name: autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2l
MONDO:0012652.def: a form of limb-girdle muscular dystrophy most often characterized by an adult onset (but ranging from 11 to 51 years) of mainly proximal lower limb weakness, with difficulties standing on tiptoes being one of the initial signs. proximal upper limb and distal lower limb weakness is also common as well as atrophy of the quadriceps (most commonly), biceps brachii, and lower leg muscles. however, calf hypertrophy has also been reported in some cases. lgmd2l progresses slowly, with most patients remaining ambulatory until late adulthood.

MONDO:0012653.name: persistent hyperplastic primary vitreous, autosomal dominant

MONDO:0012654.name: atrial septal defect 4
MONDO:0012654.def: any atrial heart septal defect in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tbx20 gene.

MONDO:0012656.name: lethal congenital contracture syndrome 3
MONDO:0012656.def: lethal congenital contracture syndrome type 3 is a rare arthrogryposis syndrome characterized by clinical features identical to lethal congenital contracture syndrome type 2 (i.e. multiple congenital contactures (typically extended elbows and flexed knees), micrognathia, anterior horn cells degeneration, skeletal muscle atrophy (mainly in the lower limbs), in the absence of hydrops, pterygia or bone fractures), but without bladder enlargement.

MONDO:0012657.name: mungan syndrome
MONDO:0012657.synonym: visceral neuromyopathy, familial, with pseudoobstruction, megaduodenum, barrett esophagus, and cardiac abnormalities

MONDO:0012658.name: brachydactyly type b2
MONDO:0012658.def: brachydactyly type b2 is a rare, genetic congenital limb malformation disorder characterized by hypoplasia/aplasia of distal and/or middle phalanges in fingers and toes ii-v (frequently severe in fingers/toes iv-v, milder in fingers/toes ii-iii) in association with proximal, and occasionally distal, symphalangism, fusion of carpal/tarsal bones and partial cutaneous syndactyly. additional reported features include proximal placement of thumbs, sensorineural hearing loss and farsightedness.

MONDO:0012659.name: age related macular degeneration 9
MONDO:0012659.def: any age-related macular degeneration in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the c3 gene.

MONDO:0012662.name: usher syndrome type 2d
MONDO:0012662.def: any usher syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the whrn gene.

MONDO:0012663.name: obsolete plasmodium falciparum fever episodes quantitative trait locus 1
MONDO:0012663.synonym: plasmodium falciparum fever episodes quantitative trait locus type 1

MONDO:0012664.name: spastic ataxia 3
MONDO:0012664.def: any autosomal recessive spastic ataxia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the mars2 gene.

MONDO:0012665.name: cataract 33
MONDO:0012665.def: any early-onset non-syndromic cataract in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the bfsp1 gene.
MONDO:0012665.synonym: early-onset non-syndromic cataract caused by mutation in bfsp1

MONDO:0012667.name: dilated cardiomyopathy 1w
MONDO:0012667.def: any familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the vcl gene.

MONDO:0012669.name: legius syndrome
MONDO:0012669.def: legius syndrome, also known as nf1-like syndrome, is a rare, genetic skin pigmentation disorder characterized by multiple cafc)-au-lait macules with or without axillary or inguinal freckling.

MONDO:0012670.name: autosomal recessive nonsyndromic hearing loss 63
MONDO:0012670.def: any autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the lrtomt gene.

MONDO:0012672.name: cholelithiasis
MONDO:0012672.def: the presence of calculi in the gallbladder.

MONDO:0012674.name: age related macular degeneration 10
MONDO:0012674.def: any age-related macular degeneration in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tlr4 gene.

MONDO:0012675.name: corticosteroid-binding globulin deficiency
MONDO:0012675.def: corticosteroid-binding globulin deficiency is a genetic disorder characterized by extreme tiredness (fatigue), particularly after physical exertion, and low blood pressure (hypotension). corticosteroid-binding globulin (cbg) is a protein primarily produced in the liver that attaches to cortisol, a hormone with numerous functions, including maintaining blood sugar levels, protecting the body from stress, and suppressing inflammation.when cortisol is needed in the body, cbg delivers the cortisol where it is needed and releases it. signs and symptoms of cbg deficiency vary. while some individuals may experience no symptoms, others are found to have a fatty liver and chronic pain. some people with cbg deficiency also have chronic fatigue syndrome. cgb deficiency is caused by mutations in the serpina6 gene. the serpina6 gene is commonly also referred to as the cbg gene. both autosomal dominant and autosomal recessive inheritance have been reported.while there is still no cure, treatment options will depend on the type and severity of symptoms present and may involve several specialists.

MONDO:0012676.name: autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 4
MONDO:0012676.def: any autosomal recessive malignant osteopetrosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the clcn7 gene.

MONDO:0012677.name: atrial fibrillation, familial, 4
MONDO:0012677.def: any familial atrial fibrillation in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the kcne2 gene.

MONDO:0012679.name: autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 6
MONDO:0012679.def: any autosomal recessive malignant osteopetrosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the plekhm1 gene.

MONDO:0012680.name: nephronophthisis 7
MONDO:0012680.def: any nephronophthisis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the glis2 gene.

MONDO:0012682.name: immunodeficiency 35
MONDO:0012682.def: any hereditary predisposition to infections in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tyk2 gene.

MONDO:0012683.name: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 6
MONDO:0012683.def: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 6 (pch6) is a rare form of pontocerebellar hypoplasia characterized clinically at birth by hypotonia, clonus, epilepsy impaired swallowing and from infancy by progressive microencephaly, spasticity and lactic acidosis.

MONDO:0012684.name: arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia 12
MONDO:0012684.def: any familial isolated arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the jup gene.
MONDO:0012684.synonym: jup familial isolated arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia

MONDO:0012688.name: cataract 17 multiple types
MONDO:0012688.def: any early-onset non-syndromic cataract in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the crybb1 gene.
MONDO:0012688.synonym: early-onset non-syndromic cataract caused by mutation in crybb1

MONDO:0012689.name: premature ovarian failure 5
MONDO:0012689.def: any primary ovarian failure in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the nobox gene.
MONDO:0012689.synonym: primary ovarian failure caused by mutation in nobox

MONDO:0012690.name: noonan syndrome 5
MONDO:0012690.def: any noonan syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the raf1 gene.

MONDO:0012691.name: leopard syndrome 2
MONDO:0012691.def: any noonan syndrome with multiple lentigines in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the raf1 gene.

MONDO:0012692.name: renal tubular acidosis, distal, with nephrocalcinosis, short stature, intellectual disability, and distinctive facies
MONDO:0012692.synonym: renal tubular acidosis, distal, with nephrocalcinosis, short stature, mental retardation, and distinctive facies

MONDO:0012693.name: glycogen storage disease due to muscle and heart glycogen synthase deficiency
MONDO:0012693.def: a glycogen storage disease characterized by muscle and heart glycogen deficiency. it has been described in three siblings (two brothers and their younger sister). the older brother died at 10.5 years of age as a result of sudden cardiac arrest and the younger brother presented with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, abnormal heart rate and blood pressure during exercise, and muscle fatigability. the sister showed no symptoms but a lack of glycogen was identified through muscle biopsy. the syndrome is caused by homozygous missense mutations in the gene encoding muscle glycogen synthase.

MONDO:0012694.name: joubert syndrome 7
MONDO:0012694.def: any joubert syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the rpgrip1l gene.

MONDO:0012695.name: meckel syndrome, type 5
MONDO:0012695.def: any meckel syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the rpgrip1l gene.

MONDO:0012698.name: waardenburg syndrome type 2e
MONDO:0012698.def: any waardenburg syndrome type 2 in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the sox10 gene.
MONDO:0012698.synonym: ws2e, with or without neurologic involvement

MONDO:0012699.name: autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2m
MONDO:0012699.def: a form of limb-girdle muscular dystrophy characterized by an infantile onset of hypotonia, axial and proximal lower limb weakness (with severe weakness noted after febrile illnesses), cardiomyopathy and normal or reduced intelligence. hypertrophy of calves, thighs, and triceps have also been reported in some cases.

MONDO:0012700.name: renal tubular acidosis, distal, 4, with hemolytic anemia
MONDO:0012700.def: distal renal tubular acidosis (drta) with anemia is a very rare form of distal renal tubular acidosis (drta) characterized by a defect in renal acidification and hereditary hemolytic anemia.
MONDO:0012700.synonym: rta, distal, autosomal recessive, with hemolytic anemia

MONDO:0012701.name: cataract 12 multiple types
MONDO:0012701.def: a cataract that has material basis in heterozygous mutation in the gene encoding beaded filament structural protein-2 (bfsp2) on chromosome 3q22.

MONDO:0012703.name: lissencephaly due to tuba1a mutation
MONDO:0012703.def: lissencephaly (lis) due to tuba1a mutation is a congenital cortical development anomaly due to abnormal neuronal migration involving neocortical and hippocampal lamination, corpus callosum, cerebellum and brainstem. a large clinical spectrum can be observed, from children with severe epilepsy and intellectual and motor deficit to cases with severe cerebral dysgenesis in the antenatal period leading to pregnancy termination due to the severity of the prognosis.

MONDO:0012704.name: dilated cardiomyopathy 1x
MONDO:0012704.def: any familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the fktn gene.

MONDO:0012706.name: familial temporal lobe epilepsy 4
MONDO:0012706.def: a temporal lobe epilepsy characterized by autosomal dominant inheritance of occipitotemporal lobe epilepsy and migraine with visual aura and that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 9q21-q22.
MONDO:0012706.synonym: occipitotemporal lobe epilepsy and migraine with aura

MONDO:0012709.name: microphthalmia, isolated, with coloboma 5
MONDO:0012709.def: any microphthalmia, isolated, with coloboma in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the shh gene.

MONDO:0012715.name: migraine with or without aura, susceptibility to, 12
MONDO:0012715.synonym: migraine, with or without aura, susceptibility to, 12

MONDO:0012716.name: spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia, cantu type
MONDO:0012716.def: spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia, cantu type is an extremely rare type of spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia described in about 5 patients to date and characterized by clinical signs including short stature, peculiar facies with blepharophimosis, upward slanted eyes, abundant eyebrows and eyelashes, coarse voice, and short hands and feet (brachymetacarpalia, brachymetatarsalia and brachyphalangia).

MONDO:0012717.name: renal hypomagnesemia 4
MONDO:0012717.def: any primary hypomagnesemia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the egf gene.

MONDO:0012718.name: hypotonia with lactic acidemia and hyperammonemia
MONDO:0012718.def: this syndrome is characterized by severe hypotonia, lactic academia and congenital hyperammonaemia.

MONDO:0012719.name: combined psap deficiency
MONDO:0012719.def: encephalopathy due to prosaposin deficiency is a lysosomal storage disease belonging to the group of sphingolipidoses.

MONDO:0012720.name: krabbe disease due to saposin a deficiency

MONDO:0012721.name: progressive myoclonic epilepsy type 3
MONDO:0012721.def: any progressive myoclonic epilepsy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the kctd7 gene.

MONDO:0012722.name: dauwerse-peters syndrome
MONDO:0012722.synonym: short stature, facial dysmorphism, severe brachydactyly, and syndactyly

MONDO:0012723.name: leber congenital amaurosis 10
MONDO:0012723.def: any leber congenital amaurosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cep290 gene.

MONDO:0012724.name: familial cold autoinflammatory syndrome 2
MONDO:0012724.def: an autoinflammatory disease caused by mutations in the nlrp12 gene. it is characterized by periodic fevers beginning in the first year of life that are triggered by cold exposure. episodes occur more than once per month.

MONDO:0012726.name: autosomal dominant familial hematuria-retinal arteriolar tortuosity-contractures syndrome
MONDO:0012726.def: autosomal dominant familial hematuria-retinal arteriolar tortuosity-contractures syndrome is characterized by the association of hematuria (without proteinuria) with extrarenal manifestations: retinal arterial tortuosities responsible for retinal hemorrhages, cardiac arrhythmia, raynaud phenomena and congenital muscular contractures.

MONDO:0012727.name: mucocutaneous lymph node syndrome
MONDO:0012727.def: kawasaki disease (kd) is a febrile, systemic, self-limiting vasculitis affecting children and characterized by inflammation in the medium sized vessels associated with coronary arterial aneurysms (caa) that may be life threatening when untreated. kd is the most common cause of acquired heart disease in children in developed countries and is a risk factor for ischemic heart disease in adulthood.

MONDO:0012728.name: brugada syndrome 2
MONDO:0012728.def: any brugada syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the gpd1l gene.

MONDO:0012729.name: erythrocytosis, familial, 4
MONDO:0012729.def: any familial polycythemia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the epas1 gene.
MONDO:0012729.synonym: familial polycythemia caused by mutation in epas1

MONDO:0012730.name: aortic aneurysm, familial thoracic 6
MONDO:0012730.def: any familial thoracic aortic aneurysm and aortic dissection in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the acta2 gene.
MONDO:0012730.synonym: familial thoracic aortic aneurysm with livedo reticularis and iris flocculi

MONDO:0012731.name: elliptocytosis 1
MONDO:0012731.def: any hereditary elliptocytosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the epb41 gene.
MONDO:0012731.synonym: protein 4.1 of erythrocyte membrane, defect of

MONDO:0012732.name: tremor, hereditary essential, and idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus
MONDO:0012732.synonym: tremor, hereditary essential, and idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus

MONDO:0012733.name: autosomal recessive bestrophinopathy
MONDO:0012733.def: autosomal recessive bestrophinopathy (arb) is a retinal dystrophy, characterized by central visual loss in the first 2 decades of life, associated with an absent electrooculogram (eog) light rise and a reduced electroretinogram (erg).

MONDO:0012734.name: serkal syndrome
MONDO:0012734.def: serkal (sex reversion, kidneys, adrenal and lung dysgenesis) syndrome is characterized by female to male sex reversal and developmental anomalies of the kidneys, adrenal glands and lungs.
MONDO:0012734.synonym: sex reversion-kidneys, adrenal and lung dysgenesis syndrome

MONDO:0012735.name: temple-baraitser syndrome
MONDO:0012735.def: a rare developmental anomalies syndrome characterized by severe intellectual disability and distal hypoplasia of digits, particularly of thumbs and halluces, with nail aplasia or hypoplasia. facial dysmorphism with a pseudo-myopathic appearance has been reported, which may include high anterior hairline or low frontal hairline with central cowlick, flat forehead, ptosis, hypertelorism, downslanting palpebral fissures, epicanthal folds, ears with thick helices, broad depressed nasal bridge with anteverted nares, short columella, long philtrum, high-arched palate, broad mouth with thick vermilion border of the upper or the lower lip and downturned corners. marked hypotonia, seizures and global developmental delay have been reported, associated with autistic spectrum disorder manifestations in some patients.

MONDO:0012736.name: long qt syndrome 9
MONDO:0012736.def: any long qt syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cav3 gene.

MONDO:0012737.name: long qt syndrome 10
MONDO:0012737.def: any long qt syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the scn4b gene.

MONDO:0012738.name: long qt syndrome 11
MONDO:0012738.def: any long qt syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the akap9 gene.

MONDO:0012739.name: microtia-eye coloboma-imperforation of the nasolacrimal duct syndrome
MONDO:0012739.def: this syndrome is characterized by the association of microtia, eye coloboma, and imperforation of the nasolacrimal duct.
MONDO:0012739.synonym: microtia with nasolacrimal duct imperforation and eye coloboma

MONDO:0012740.name: chromosome 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, distal
MONDO:0012740.def: distal 22q11.2 microdeletion syndrome is a rare chromosomal anomaly syndrome resulting from the partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 22 with a highly variable phenotype characterized by prematurity, pre- and post-natal growth retardation, developmental delay (particularly speech), mild intellectual disability, variable cardiac defects, and minor skeletal anomalies (such as clinodactyly). dysmorphic features include prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, deep set eyes, narrow upslanting palpebral fissures, ear abnormalities, hypoplastic alae nasi, smooth philtrum, down-turned mouth, thin upper lip, retro/micrognatia and pointed chin. for certain very distal deletions, there is a risk of developing malignant rhabdoid tumors.

MONDO:0012741.name: prostate cancer, hereditary, 12
MONDO:0012741.def: any familial prostate cancer in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ehbp1 gene.

MONDO:0012742.name: brugada syndrome 3
MONDO:0012742.def: any brugada syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cacna1c gene.

MONDO:0012743.name: brugada syndrome 4
MONDO:0012743.def: any brugada syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cacnb2 gene.

MONDO:0012744.name: dilated cardiomyopathy 1y
MONDO:0012744.def: any familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tpm1 gene.

MONDO:0012745.name: dilated cardiomyopathy 1z
MONDO:0012745.def: any familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tnnc1 gene.

MONDO:0012746.name: dilated cardiomyopathy 2a
MONDO:0012746.def: a dilated cardiomyopathy that has material basis in mutation in the tnni3 gene on chromosome 19q13.

MONDO:0012747.name: glycogen storage disease due to aldolase a deficiency
MONDO:0012747.def: glycogen storage disease due to aldolase a deficiency is an extremely rare glycogen storage disease characterized by hemolytic anemia with or without myopathy or intellectual deficit. myopathy can be severe enough to result in fatal rhabdomyolysis in some patients. a family with episodic rhabdomyolysis (triggerd by fever) without hemolytic anemia has recently been reported.

MONDO:0012748.name: primary ciliary dyskinesia 7
MONDO:0012748.def: any primary ciliary dyskinesia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the dnah11 gene.

MONDO:0012750.name: lethal arthrogryposis-anterior horn cell disease syndrome

MONDO:0012753.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 9
MONDO:0012753.def: any amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ang gene.

MONDO:0012755.name: episodic ataxia type 7
MONDO:0012755.def: episodic ataxia type 7 (ea7) is an exceedingly rare form of hereditary episodic ataxia characterized by ataxia with weakness, vertigo, and dysarthria without interictal findings.

MONDO:0012756.name: proximal 16p11.2 microdeletion syndrome
MONDO:0012756.def: a chromosomal anomaly characterized by developmental and language delays, mild intellectual disability, social impairments (autism spectrum disorders), mild variable dysmorphism and predisposition to obesity.

MONDO:0012757.name: lung fibrosis-immunodeficiency-46,xx gonadal dysgenesis syndrome
MONDO:0012757.def: lung fibrosis-immunodeficiency-46,xx gonadal dysgenesis syndrome is characterized by immune deficiency, gonadal dysgenesis and fatal lung fibrosis. so far, it has been described in two sisters born to consanguineous parents. both karyotypes were normal female (46,xx). no genetic anomalies could be identified by comparative genome hybridization analysis of their genomes or by analysis of genes known to be associated with these types of anomalies.
MONDO:0012757.synonym: immunodeficiency, ovarian dysgenesis, and pulmonary fibrosis

MONDO:0012758.name: prostate cancer, hereditary, 13
MONDO:0012758.def: any familial prostate cancer in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the msmb gene.

MONDO:0012759.name: camptodactyly syndrome, guadalajara type 3
MONDO:0012759.def: camptodactyly syndrome, guadalajara type 3 is a rare, genetic bone development disorder characterized by hand camptodactyly associated with facial dysmorphism (flat face, hypertelorism, telecanthus, symblepharon, simplified ears, retrognathia) and neck anomalies (short neck with stricking pterygia, muscle sclerosis). additional features include spinal defects (e.g. cervical and dorso-lumbar spina bifida occulta), congenital shortness of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, flexed wrists and thin hands and feet. brain structural anomalies, multiple nevi, micropenis and mild intellectual disability are also observed. imaging reveals increased bone traveculae, cortical thickening of long bones and delayed bone age.

MONDO:0012760.name: epilepsy, idiopathic generalized, susceptibility to, 5
MONDO:0012760.synonym: epilepsy, idiopathic generalized, susceptibility to, locus on chromosome 10

MONDO:0012761.name: chromosome 3q29 microduplication syndrome
MONDO:0012761.def: 3q29 microduplication is a chromosomal abnormality associated with variable clinical findings including mild or moderate intellectual deficit and microcephaly.

MONDO:0012762.name: catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia 2
MONDO:0012762.def: any catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the casq2 gene.

MONDO:0012763.name: epilepsy, childhood absence, susceptibility to, 6
MONDO:0012763.def: an inherited susceptibility or predisposition to developing child absence epilepsy or idiopathic generalized epilepsy, in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cacna1h gene.

MONDO:0012764.name: riddle syndrome
MONDO:0012764.def: an autosomal recessive disease characterized by increased radiosensitivity, immunodeficiency, mild motor control and learning difficulties, facial dysmorphism, and short stature that has material basis in homozygous or compound heterozygous mutation in the rnf168 gene on chromosome 3q29.

MONDO:0012766.name: hereditary spastic paraplegia 37
MONDO:0012766.def: autosomal dominant spastic paraplegia type 37 is a pure form of hereditary spastic paraplegia characterized by a childhood- to adulthood-onset of slowly progressive spastic gait, extensor plantar responses, brisk tendon reflexes in arms and legs, decreased vibration sense at ankles and urinary dysfunction. ankle clonus is also reported in some patients.

MONDO:0012767.name: age related macular degeneration 11
MONDO:0012767.def: any age-related macular degeneration in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cst3 gene.

MONDO:0012771.name: asthma-related traits, susceptibility to, 7
MONDO:0012771.def: any inherited susceptibility to asthma in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the chi3l1 gene.
MONDO:0012771.synonym: inherited susceptibility to asthma caused by mutation in chi3l1

MONDO:0012774.name: chromosome 15q13.3 microdeletion syndrome
MONDO:0012774.def: 15q13.3 microdeletion (microdel15q13.3) syndrome is characterized by a wide spectrum of neurodevelopmental disorders with no or subtle dysmorphic features.

MONDO:0012775.name: thrombocytopenia 4
MONDO:0012775.def: any thrombocytopenia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cycs gene.

MONDO:0012783.name: rft1-congenital disorder of glycosylation
MONDO:0012783.def: rft1-cdg is a form of congenital disorders of n-linked glycosylation characterized by poorly coordinated suck resulting in difficulty feeding and failure to thrive; myoclonic jerks with hypotonia and brisk reflexes progressing to a seizure disorder; roving eyes; developmental delay; poor to absent visual contact; and sensorineural hearing loss. additional features that may be observed include coagulation factor abnormalities, inverted nipples and microcephaly. the disease is caused by mutations in the gene rft1 (3p21.1).

MONDO:0012784.name: autosomal recessive ataxia due to ubiquinone deficiency
MONDO:0012784.def: this syndrome is characterized by childhood-onset progressive ataxia and cerebellar atrophy.

MONDO:0012786.name: juvenile cataract-microcornea-renal glucosuria syndrome
MONDO:0012786.def: juvenile cataract - microcornea - renal glucosuria is an extremely rare autosomal dominant association reported in a single swiss family and characterized clinically by juvenile cataract associated with bilateral microcornea, and renal glucosuria without other renal tubular defects.

MONDO:0012787.name: hereditary spastic paraplegia 39
MONDO:0012787.def: this syndrome is characterized by progressive spastic paraplegia and distal muscle wasting.

MONDO:0012789.name: dystonia 16
MONDO:0012789.def: dystonia 16 (dyt16) is a very rare and newly discovered movement disorder which is characterized by early-onset progressive limb dystonia, laryngeal and oromandibular dystonia, and parkinsonism.

MONDO:0012790.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 10
MONDO:0012790.def: any amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tardbp gene.
MONDO:0012790.synonym: tardbp-related frontotemporal lobar degeneration with tdp43 inclusions

MONDO:0012791.name: mitochondrial dna depletion syndrome, encephalomyopathic form with methylmalonic aciduria
MONDO:0012791.def: mitochondrial dna depletion syndrome, encephalomyopathic form with methylmalonic aciduria is characterized by the association of a mitochondrial encephalomyopathy and an aminoacidopathy. it has been described in two brothers presenting with developmental delay, neurological signs, deafness, exercise intolerance, lactic acidosis and elevation of several plasmatic amino acids. mitochondria morphology was found to be abnormal on muscle biopsy. transmission is likely to be linked to maternal mitochondrial dna.

MONDO:0012792.name: mitochondrial dna depletion syndrome 8a
MONDO:0012792.def: any mitochondrial dna depletion syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the rrm2b gene.

MONDO:0012793.name: hypouricemia, renal, 2
MONDO:0012793.synonym: uric acid concentration, serum, quantitative trait locus 2

MONDO:0012794.name: ane syndrome
MONDO:0012794.def: ane syndrome is a rare, genetic, neuro-endocrino-cutaneous disorder characterized by highly variable degrees of alopecia, moderate to severe intellectual disability, progressive, late-onset motor deterioration and combined anterior pituitary hormone deficiency, manifesting with central hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, delayed or absent puberty, growth hormone deficiency (resulting in short stature), progressive central adrenal insufficiency and a hypoplastic anterior pituitary gland. additional features include hypodontia, flexural reticulate hyperpigmentation, gynecomastia, microcephaly and kyphoscoliosis.

MONDO:0012796.name: retinitis pigmentosa 41
MONDO:0012796.def: any retinitis pigmentosa in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the prom1 gene.

MONDO:0012798.name: deafness, unilateral, with delayed endolymphatic hydrops
MONDO:0012798.synonym: deafness, unilateral, with delayed endolymphatic hydrops

MONDO:0012799.name: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy 11
MONDO:0012799.def: any hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the actc1 gene.

MONDO:0012802.name: oculoauricular syndrome
MONDO:0012802.def: oculoauricular syndrome, schorderet type is a rare, genetic developmental defect during embryogenesis characterized by various ophthalmic anomalies (including congenital microphthalmia, microcornea, cataract, anterior segment dysgenesis, ocular coloboma and early onset rod-cone dystrophy), and abnormal external ears (low-set pinna with crumpled helix, narrow intertragic incisure, abnormal bridge connecting the crus of the helix and the anthelix, narrow external acoustic meatus, and lobule aplasia).

MONDO:0012803.name: diarrhea-vomiting due to trehalase deficiency
MONDO:0012803.def: this syndrome is characterized by diarrhea and vomiting after ingestion of trehalose, a disaccharide found mainly in mushrooms.

MONDO:0012804.name: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy 12
MONDO:0012804.def: any hypertrophic cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the csrp3 gene.

MONDO:0012805.name: childhood onset glut1 deficiency syndrome 2
MONDO:0012805.def: a form of paroxysmal dyskinesia, characterized by painless attacks of dystonia of the extremities triggered by prolonged physical activities.

MONDO:0012807.name: epidermolysis bullosa simplex 5c, with pyloric atresia
MONDO:0012807.def: a basal subtype of epidermolysis bullosa simplex (ebs) characterized by generalized severe blistering with widespread congenital absence of skin and pyloric atresia.
MONDO:0012807.synonym: epidermolysis bullosa simplex with pyloric atresia

MONDO:0012808.name: dilated cardiomyopathy 1aa
MONDO:0012808.def: any familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the actn2 gene.
MONDO:0012808.synonym: familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy caused by mutation in actn2

MONDO:0012809.name: histiocytoma, angiomatoid fibrous
MONDO:0012809.def: a low malignant potential soft tissue neoplasm of uncertain differentiation. it typically affects young patients, presenting as a slowly growing nodular or cystic tumor mass, most often in the subcutaneous tissues of the extremities. occasionally, patients have systemic symptoms (anemia, fever, and weight loss). this tumor has a relatively good prognosis. a minority of patients develop local recurrences. metastases are rare.

MONDO:0012812.name: developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 4
MONDO:0012812.def: early infantile epileptic encephalopathy 4 (eiee4) is a form of early infantile epileptic encephalopathy, which refers to a group of neurological conditions characterized by severe seizures beginning in infancy. eiee4, specifically, is often associated with partial complex or tonic-clonic seizures, although other seizure types have been reported. other signs and symptoms mayinclude intellectual disability, reduced muscle tone (hypotonia), hypsarrhythmia (an irregular pattern seen on eeg), dyskinesia (involuntary movement of the body), and spastic di- or quadriplegia. eiee4 is caused by changes (mutations) in the stxbp1 gene and is inherited in an autosomal dominant manner. treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person. for example, certain medications are often prescribed to help control seizures, although they are not always effective in all people with the condition.

MONDO:0012813.name: retinitis pigmentosa 29
MONDO:0012813.def: a retinitis pigmentosa that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 4q32-q34.

MONDO:0012814.name: diastasis recti and weakness of the linea alba
MONDO:0012814.synonym: diastasis recti and weakness of the linea alba

MONDO:0012815.name: coats plus syndrome
MONDO:0012815.def: coats plus syndrome is a pleiotropic multisystem disorder characterized by retinal telangiectasia and exudates, intracranial calcification with leukoencephalopathy and brain cysts, osteopenia with predisposition to fractures, bone marrow suppression, gastrointestinal bleeding and portal hypertension. it is transmitted as an autosomal recessive disease.

MONDO:0012816.name: atrial fibrillation, familial, 6
MONDO:0012816.def: any familial atrial fibrillation in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the nppa gene.

MONDO:0012817.name: ewing sarcoma
MONDO:0012817.def: a small round cell tumor that lacks morphologic, immunohistochemical, and electron microscopic evidence of neuroectodermal differentiation. it represents one of the two ends of the spectrum called ewing sarcoma/peripheral neuroectodermal tumor. it affects mostly males under age 20, and it can occur in soft tissue or bone. pain and the presence of a mass are the most common clinical symptoms.

MONDO:0012818.name: maturity-onset diabetes of the young type 9
MONDO:0012818.def: any maturity-onset diabetes of the young in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the pax4 gene.
MONDO:0012818.synonym: type 9 maturity-onset diabetes of the young

MONDO:0012819.name: diabetic ketoacidosis
MONDO:0012819.def: the metabolic condition resulted from uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, in which the shift of acid-base status of the body toward the acid side because of loss of base or retention of acids other than carbonic acid is accompanied by the accumulation of ketone bodies in body tissues and fluids.

MONDO:0012820.name: colorectal cancer, susceptibility to, 3
MONDO:0012820.def: any colorectal cancer in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the smad7 gene.

MONDO:0012824.name: hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 4
MONDO:0012824.def: any leukodystrophy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the hspd1 gene.
MONDO:0012824.synonym: pelizaeus-merzbacher-like disease due to hspd1 mutation

MONDO:0012825.name: extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
MONDO:0012825.def: a rare malignant soft tissue neoplasm of uncertain differentiation, characterized by the presence of chondroblast-like cells in a myxoid stroma and a multinodular growth pattern. the most common sites of involvement are the deep soft tissues of the extremities, particularly the thigh. it usually presents as an enlarging soft tissue mass. patients may have long survivals, but local recurrences and metastases occur in approximately half of the cases. the most common site of metastasis is the lungs.

MONDO:0012828.name: atrial fibrillation, familial, 7
MONDO:0012828.def: any familial atrial fibrillation in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the kcna5 gene.

MONDO:0012829.name: inflammatory bowel disease 12
MONDO:0012829.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 3p21.3

MONDO:0012830.name: chromosome 10q23 deletion syndrome
MONDO:0012830.def: 10q22.3q23.3 microdeletion syndrome is a rare partial autosomal monosomy characterized by a mild facial dysmorphism variably including macrocephaly, broad forehead, hypertelorism or hypotelorism, deep-set eyes, upslanting or downslanting palpebral fissures, low-set ears, flat nasal bridge, smooth philtrum, thin upper lip), cleft palate, cerebellar and cardiac malformations, psychomotor development delay, and behavioral abnormalities (attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, autism). other rare features may include congenital breast aplasia, arachnodactyly, joint hyperlaxity, club feet, feeding difficulties, failure to thrive.

MONDO:0012831.name: inflammatory bowel disease 13
MONDO:0012831.def: any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the abcb1 gene.

MONDO:0012832.name: inflammatory bowel disease 14
MONDO:0012832.def: any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the irf5 gene.

MONDO:0012833.name: crouzon syndrome-acanthosis nigricans syndrome
MONDO:0012833.def: crouzon syndrome with acanthosis nigricans (can) is a very rare, clinically heterogeneous form of faciocraniostenosis with crouzon-like features and premature synostosis of cranial sutures (crouzon disease), associated with acanthosis nigricans (an).

MONDO:0012834.name: systemic lupus erythematosus, susceptibility to, 10
MONDO:0012834.def: any systemic lupus erythematosus in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the irf5 gene.
MONDO:0012834.synonym: systemic lupus erythematosus, susceptibility to, type 10

MONDO:0012835.name: systemic lupus erythematosus, susceptibility to, 11
MONDO:0012835.def: any systemic lupus erythematosus in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the stat4 gene.
MONDO:0012835.synonym: systemic lupus erythematosus, susceptibility to, type 11

MONDO:0012837.name: inflammatory bowel disease 15
MONDO:0012837.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 10q21.

MONDO:0012838.name: inflammatory bowel disease 16
MONDO:0012838.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 9q32.

MONDO:0012839.name: pyogenic bacterial infections due to myd88 deficiency
MONDO:0012839.def: pyogenic bacterial infection due to myd88 deficiency is a primary immunodeficiency characterized by increased susceptibility to pyogenic bacterial infections, including invasive pneumococcal, invasive staphylococcal and pseudomonas disease.
MONDO:0012839.synonym: recurrent pyogenic bacterial infections due to myd88 deficiency

MONDO:0012840.name: inflammatory bowel disease 17
MONDO:0012840.def: any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the il23r gene.

MONDO:0012841.name: inflammatory bowel disease 18
MONDO:0012841.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 5p13.1.

MONDO:0012843.name: epilepsy, childhood absence, susceptibility to, 5
MONDO:0012843.def: any childhood absence epilepsy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the gabrb3 gene.

MONDO:0012844.name: primary ciliary dyskinesia 8
MONDO:0012844.def: a primary ciliary dyskinesia that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 15q24-q25.

MONDO:0012845.name: inflammatory bowel disease 19
MONDO:0012845.def: any inflammatory bowel disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the irgm gene.

MONDO:0012846.name: generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 6
MONDO:0012846.synonym: generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus, type 6

MONDO:0012847.name: autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 6
MONDO:0012847.def: any autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the nipal4 gene.

MONDO:0012848.name: meckel syndrome, type 6
MONDO:0012848.def: any meckel syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cc2d2a gene.

MONDO:0012849.name: joubert syndrome 9
MONDO:0012849.def: any joubert syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cc2d2a gene.

MONDO:0012852.name: inflammatory bowel disease 20
MONDO:0012852.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 10q23-q24.

MONDO:0012853.name: fontaine progeroid syndrome
MONDO:0012853.def: a rare premature aging syndrome characterized by pre-and postnatal growth retardation, a congenital premature-aged appearance with distinctive craniofacial dysmorphism (wide calvaria with large open anterior fontanel and wide metopic suture, broad forehead, small face, micrognathia), markedly diminished subcutaneous fat, cutis laxa and wrinkled skin, without delay in psychomotor development. scant, brittle hair, hypoplastic nails and delayed, abnormal dentition, as well as hypoplastic distal phalanges, umbilical hernia and eye abnormalities (myopia/hyperopia, strabismus), are also commonly associated.

MONDO:0012854.name: bilateral microtia-deafness-cleft palate syndrome
MONDO:0012854.def: this syndrome is characterized by the association of bilateral microtia with severe to profound hearing impairment, and cleft palate.
MONDO:0012854.synonym: microtia, hearing impairment, and cleft palate (ar)

MONDO:0012855.name: joubert syndrome 8
MONDO:0012855.def: any joubert syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the arl13b gene.

MONDO:0012856.name: birk-barel syndrome
MONDO:0012856.def: birk-barel syndrome is an inherited condition characterized by intellectual disability, hypotonia, hyperactivity, and unusual facial features. the condition is caused by mutations in the kcnk9 gene on chromosome 8. this condition demonstrates dominant inheritance with paternal imprinting, which means that a mutation in the maternal gene will result in disease, but a mutation in the paternal gene will have no effect (imprinted with paternal silencing).
MONDO:0012856.synonym: mental retardation with hypotonia and facial dysmorphism

MONDO:0012859.name: autosomal recessive osteopetrosis 7
MONDO:0012859.def: any autosomal recessive malignant osteopetrosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tnfrs11a gene.

MONDO:0012860.name: thrombophilia due to protein c deficiency, autosomal recessive
MONDO:0012860.synonym: thrombophilia due to protein c deficiency, autosomal recessive

MONDO:0012861.name: premature ovarian failure 6
MONDO:0012861.def: any primary ovarian failure in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the figla gene.
MONDO:0012861.synonym: primary ovarian failure caused by mutation in figla

MONDO:0012864.name: chromosome 2q32-q33 deletion syndrome
MONDO:0012864.def: 2q32q33 microdeletion syndrome is a recently described syndrome characterized by a variable phenotype involving moderate to severe intellectual deficit, significant speech delay, persistent feeding difficulties, growth retardation and dysmorphic features.

MONDO:0012866.name: hereditary spastic paraplegia 35
MONDO:0012866.def: autosomal recessive spastic paraplegia type 35 is a rare form of hereditary spastic paraplegia characterized by childhood (exceptionally adolescent) onset of a complex phenotype presenting with lower limb (followed by upper limb) spasticity with hyperreflexia and extensor plantar responses, with additional manifestations including progressive dysarthria, dystonia, mild cognitive decline, extrapyramidal features, optic atrophy and seizures. white matter abnormalities and brain iron accumulation have also been observed on brain magnetic resonance imaging.

MONDO:0012867.name: hereditary spastic paraplegia 38
MONDO:0012867.def: a hereditary spastic paraplegia that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 4p16-p15.

MONDO:0012868.name: thrombophilia due to protein s deficiency, autosomal dominant
MONDO:0012868.def: autosomal dominant form of hereditary thrombophilia due to congenital protein s deficiency.
MONDO:0012868.synonym: thrombophilia due to protein s deficiency, autosomal dominant

MONDO:0012869.name: intellectual disability, autosomal dominant 22
MONDO:0012869.def: any autosomal dominant non-syndromic intellectual disability in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the zbtb18 gene.
MONDO:0012869.synonym: zbtb18 autosomal dominant non-syndromic intellectual disability

MONDO:0012871.name: jervell and lange-nielsen syndrome 2
MONDO:0012871.def: any jervell and lange-nielsen syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the kcne1 gene.

MONDO:0012872.name: thrombophilia, familial, due to decreased release of tissue plasminogen activator
MONDO:0012872.synonym: thrombophilia, familial, due to decreased release of tissue plasminogen activator

MONDO:0012873.name: ehlers-danlos syndrome, spondylocheirodysplastic type
MONDO:0012873.def: ehlers-danlos syndrome, spondylocheirodysplastic type is a subtype of ehlers-danlos syndrome characterized by skeletal dysplasia comprising platyspondyly with moderate short stature, osteopenia and widened metaphyses, in addition to hyperextensible, thin, easily bruised skin, hypermobility of small joints with tendency to contractures, prominent eyes with bluish sclerae, wrinkled palms, atrophy of the thenar muscle and tapering fingers.

MONDO:0012875.name: inflammatory bowel disease 21
MONDO:0012875.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 18p11.

MONDO:0012876.name: heparin cofactor 2 deficiency
MONDO:0012876.synonym: thrombophilia due to heparin cofactor 2 deficiency

MONDO:0012878.name: cowden syndrome 2
MONDO:0012878.def: any cowden disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the sdhb gene.

MONDO:0012879.name: schizophrenia 14
MONDO:0012879.def: a schizophrenia that has material basis in a mutation on chromosome 2q32.1.

MONDO:0012880.name: hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 5 with or without anosmia
MONDO:0012880.def: any hypogonadotropic hypogonadism in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the chd7 gene.

MONDO:0012883.name: acute promyelocytic leukemia
MONDO:0012883.def: an aggressive form of acute myeloid leukemia (aml), characterized by arrest of leukocyte differentiation at the promyelocyte stage, due to a specific chromosomal translocation t(15;17) in myeloid cells. apl manifests with easy bruising, hemorrhagic diathesis and fatigue.

MONDO:0012885.name: srd5a3-congenital disorder of glycosylation
MONDO:0012885.def: a rare, non x-linked congenital disorder of gyclosylation due to steroid 5 alpha reductase type 3 deficiency characterized by a highly variable phenotype typically presenting with severe visual impairment, variable ocular anomalies (such as optic nerve hypoplasia/atrophy, iris and optic nerve coloboma, congenital cataract, glaucoma), intellectual disability, cerebellar abnormalities, nystagmus, hypotonia, ataxia, and/or ichthyosiform skin lesions. other reported manifestations include retinitis pigmentosa, kyphosis, congenital heart defects, hypertrichosis and abnormal coagulation.

MONDO:0012886.name: inflammatory bowel disease 22
MONDO:0012886.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 17q21.2.

MONDO:0012887.name: inflammatory bowel disease 23
MONDO:0012887.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 1q32.1.

MONDO:0012888.name: sarcoidosis, susceptibility to, 2
MONDO:0012888.def: any sarcoidosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the btnl2 gene.

MONDO:0012890.name: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2b
MONDO:0012890.def: any non-syndromic pontocerebellar hypoplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tsen2 gene.

MONDO:0012891.name: pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 2c
MONDO:0012891.def: any non-syndromic pontocerebellar hypoplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tsen34 gene.

MONDO:0012892.name: bone fragility with contractures, arterial rupture, and deafness
MONDO:0012892.def: a rare, genetic disease, caused by lack of lysyl hydrohylase 3 (lh3) activity, characterized by multiple tissue and organ involvement, including skeletal abnormalities (club foot, progressive scoliosis, osteopenia, pathologic fractures), ocular involvement (flat retinae, myopia, cataracts) and hair, nail and skin anomalies (coarse, abnormally distributed hair, skin blistering, reduced palmar creases, hypoplastic nails). patients also present intrauterine growth retardation, facial dysmorphism (flat facial profile, low-set ears, shallow orbits, short and upturned nose, downturned corners of mouth) and joint flexion contractures. growth and developmental delay, bilateral sensorineural deafness, friable diaphragm and later-onset spontaneous vascular ruptures are additional reported features.

MONDO:0012893.name: osteoarthritis susceptibility 5
MONDO:0012893.def: any osteoarthritis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the gdf5 gene.

MONDO:0012895.name: torsion dystonia 17
MONDO:0012895.def: a dystonia characterized by autosomal recessive inheritance of progressive dystonia, dysphonia, dysarthria and neck torticollis that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 20p11.2-q13.12.

MONDO:0012897.name: congenital factor xi deficiency
MONDO:0012897.def: congenital factor xi deficiency is an inherited bleeding disorder characterized by reduced levels and activity of factor xi (fxi) resulting in moderate bleeding symptoms, usually occurring after trauma or surgery.

MONDO:0012900.name: cardiomyopathy, familial restrictive, 3
MONDO:0012900.def: any familial isolated restrictive cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tnnt2 gene.

MONDO:0012901.name: inherited prekallikrein deficiency
MONDO:0012901.def: an instance of prekallikrein deficiency that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

MONDO:0012902.name: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 27
MONDO:0012902.def: an autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 4q12-q13.1.

MONDO:0012903.name: autosomal recessive nonsyndromic hearing loss 45
MONDO:0012903.def: an autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 1q43-q44.

MONDO:0012904.name: epilepsy, progressive myoclonic, 1b
MONDO:0012904.def: any progressive myoclonic epilepsy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the prickle1 gene.
MONDO:0012904.synonym: progressive myoclonic epilepsy caused by mutation in prickle1

MONDO:0012905.name: hypomyelinating leukodystrophy 6
MONDO:0012905.def: hypomyelination with atrophy of basal ganglia and cerebellum (h-abc) is characterized by slowly progressive spasticity, extrapyramidal movement disorders (dystonia, choreoathetosis and rigidity), cerebellar ataxia, moderate to severe cognitive deficit, and anarthria/dysarthria.
MONDO:0012905.synonym: leukodystrophy, hypomyelinating, with atrophy of the basal ganglia and cerebellum

MONDO:0012906.name: primary ciliary dyskinesia 9
MONDO:0012906.def: any primary ciliary dyskinesia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the dnai2 gene.

MONDO:0012907.name: blindness - scoliosis - arachnodactyly syndrome
MONDO:0012907.def: this syndrome associates progressive visual loss with scoliosis or kyphoscoliosis and arachnodactyly of the fingers and toes.

MONDO:0012908.name: complement component 6 deficiency
MONDO:0012908.def: any classic complement early component deficiency in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the c6 gene.

MONDO:0012909.name: skeletal defects, genital hypoplasia, and intellectual disability
MONDO:0012909.synonym: skeletal defects, genital hypoplasia, and mental retardation

MONDO:0012911.name: pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1c
MONDO:0012911.def: a rare type of pseudohypoparathyroidism (php) characterized by resistance to parathyroid hormone (pth) and other hormones, which manifests with hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia and elevated pth levels, a constellation of clinical features collectively termed albright's hereditary osteodystrophy (aho), but normal activity of the stimulatory protein g (gs alpha).

MONDO:0012912.name: pseudopseudohypoparathyroidism
MONDO:0012912.def: a disease characterized by a constellation of clinical features collectively termed albright hereditary osteodystrophy (aho) but no evidence of resistance to parathyroid hormone (pth), which is seen in other forms of pseudohypoparathyroidism (php).

MONDO:0012913.name: wilms tumor, aniridia, genitourinary anomalies, intellectual disability, and obesity syndrome
MONDO:0012913.def: a sub-phenotype of wagr that includes obesity, and is associated with mutation(s) in the bdnf gene.

MONDO:0012914.name: chromosome 1q21.1 deletion syndrome
MONDO:0012914.def: 1q21.1 microdeletion syndrome is a newly described recurrent deletion syndrome with variable clinical manifestations but without the clinical picture of thrombocytopenia - absent radius (tar) syndrome.

MONDO:0012915.name: chromosome 1q21.1 duplication syndrome
MONDO:0012915.def: chromosome 1q21.1 duplication syndrome is a rare condition caused by the presence of an extra copy of a small piece of chromosome 1 in the cells of the body. signs and symptoms can vary widely among affected individuals. some individuals have no symptoms, while others may have features such as a large head size (macrocephaly); mild to moderate developmental delay and learning difficulties; autism or autistic-like behavior; heart problems; seizures; and/or and distinctive facial features. this condition can occur sporadically as a de novo mutation (by chance) or can be inherited in an autosomal dominant manner from a parent. treatment depends on the signs and symptoms present in each individual.

MONDO:0012916.name: chromosome 2p16.1-p15 deletion syndrome
MONDO:0012916.def: 2p15p16.1 microdeletion syndrome is a recently described syndrome characterized by developmental delay and facial dysmorphism.

MONDO:0012918.name: primary ciliary dyskinesia 10
MONDO:0012918.def: any primary ciliary dyskinesia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the dnaaf2 gene.

MONDO:0012919.name: type 1 diabetes mellitus 20
MONDO:0012919.def: an inherited susceptibility or predisposition to developing type 1 diabetes mellitus in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the hnf1a gene.
MONDO:0012919.synonym: type 1 diabetes mellitus caused by mutation in hnf1a

MONDO:0012920.name: type 1 diabetes mellitus 21
MONDO:0012920.def: an inherited susceptibility or predisposition to developing type 1 diabetes mellitus that has material basis in mutation of the locus at chromosome 6q25.

MONDO:0012921.name: type 1 diabetes mellitus 22
MONDO:0012921.def: an inherited susceptibility or predisposition to developing type 1 diabetes mellitus in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ccr5 gene.
MONDO:0012921.synonym: type 1 diabetes mellitus caused by mutation in ccr5

MONDO:0012923.name: congenital generalized lipodystrophy type 3
MONDO:0012923.def: any congenital generalized lipodystrophy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cav1 gene.

MONDO:0012924.name: diamond-blackfan anemia 4
MONDO:0012924.def: any diamond-blackfan anemia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the rps17 gene.

MONDO:0012925.name: diamond-blackfan anemia 5
MONDO:0012925.def: any diamond-blackfan anemia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the rpl35a gene.

MONDO:0012926.name: amelogenesis imperfecta hypomaturation type 2a2
MONDO:0012926.def: any amelogenesis imperfecta in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the mmp20 gene.

MONDO:0012927.name: chromosome 1q41-q42 deletion syndrome
MONDO:0012927.def: 1q41q42 microdeletion syndrome is a chromosomal anomaly characterized by a severe developmental delay and/or intellectual disability, typical facial dysmorphic features, brain anomalies, seizures, cleft palate, clubfeet, nail hypoplasia and congenital heart disease.

MONDO:0012928.name: hereditary spastic paraplegia 42
MONDO:0012928.def: autosomal dominant spastic paraplegia type 42 is a pure form of hereditary spastic paraplegia characterized by slowly progressive spastic paraplegia of lower extremities with an age of onset ranging from childhood to adulthood and patients presenting with spastic gait, increased tendon reflexes in lower limbs, extensor plantar response, weakness and atrophy of lower limb muscles and, in rare cases, pes cavus. no abnormalities are noted on magnetic resonance imaging.

MONDO:0012930.name: autosomal recessive severe congenital neutropenia due to g6pc3 deficiency

MONDO:0012931.name: focal segmental glomerulosclerosis 4, susceptibility to

MONDO:0012933.name: breast-ovarian cancer, familial, susceptibility to, 2

MONDO:0012938.name: diamond-blackfan anemia 7

MONDO:0012943.name: retinitis pigmentosa 46

MONDO:0012948.name: chromosome 6pter-p24 deletion syndrome
MONDO:0012948.def: distal monosomy 6p is responsible for a distinct chromosome deletion syndrome with a recognizable clinical picture including intellectual deficit, ocular abnormalities, hearing loss, and facial dysmorphism.

MONDO:0012953.name: colorectal cancer, susceptibility to, 10
MONDO:0012953.def: any colorectal cancer in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the pold1 gene.

MONDO:0012960.name: intellectual disability, autosomal dominant 5
MONDO:0012960.def: any autosomal dominant non-syndromic intellectual disability in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the syngap1 gene.

MONDO:0012961.name: type 1 diabetes mellitus 23
MONDO:0012961.def: an inherited susceptibility or predisposition to developing type 1 diabetes mellitus that has material basis in mutation of the locus at chromosome 4q27.

MONDO:0012962.name: microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility to, 2
MONDO:0012962.def: any microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the epo gene.

MONDO:0012963.name: microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility to, 3
MONDO:0012963.def: any microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ace gene.

MONDO:0012964.name: chromosome 15q26-qter deletion syndrome
MONDO:0012964.def: distal monosomy 15q is a rare chromosomal anomaly syndrome characterized by pre- and postnatal growth restriction, developmental delay, variable degrees of intellectual disability, hand and foot anomalies (e.g. brachy-/clinodactyly, talipes equinovarus, nail hypoplasia, proximally placed digits) and mild craniofacial dysmorphism (incl. microcephaly, triangular face, broad nasal bridge, micrognathia). neonatal lymphedema, heart malformations, aplasia cutis congenita, aortic root dilatation, and autistic spectrum disorder have also been reported.

MONDO:0012966.name: microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility to, 4
MONDO:0012966.def: any microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the il1rn gene.

MONDO:0012967.name: hemolytic anemia due to adenylate kinase deficiency
MONDO:0012967.def: hemolytic anemia due to adenylate kinase deficiency is a rare hemolytic anemia due to an erythrocyte nucleotide metabolism disorder characterized by moderate to severe chronic nonspherocytic hemolytic anemia that may require regular blood transfusions and/or splenectomy and may be associated with psychomotor impairment.
MONDO:0012967.synonym: adenylate kinase deficiency, hemolytic anemia due to

MONDO:0012968.name: usher syndrome type 1h
MONDO:0012968.def: an usher syndrome type 1 that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 15q22-q23.

MONDO:0012969.name: microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility to, 5
MONDO:0012969.def: any microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the pon1 gene.

MONDO:0012970.name: microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility to, 6
MONDO:0012970.def: any microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the sod2 gene.
MONDO:0012970.synonym: sod2 microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility

MONDO:0012971.name: microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility to, 7
MONDO:0012971.def: any microvascular complications of diabetes, susceptibility in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the hfe gene.

MONDO:0012973.name: inflammatory bowel disease 26
MONDO:0012973.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 12q15.

MONDO:0012974.name: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 59
MONDO:0012974.def: an autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 11p14.2-q12.3.

MONDO:0012975.name: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 3b
MONDO:0012975.def: any autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the gjb6 gene.

MONDO:0012976.name: autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 2b
MONDO:0012976.def: any autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the gjb3 gene.

MONDO:0012977.name: autosomal recessive nonsyndromic hearing loss 1b
MONDO:0012977.def: any autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the gjb6 gene.

MONDO:0012978.name: primary ciliary dyskinesia 11
MONDO:0012978.def: any primary ciliary dyskinesia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the rsph4a gene.

MONDO:0012979.name: primary ciliary dyskinesia 12
MONDO:0012979.def: any primary ciliary dyskinesia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the rsph9 gene.

MONDO:0012980.name: endocrine-cerebro-osteodysplasia syndrome
MONDO:0012980.def: endocrine-cerebro-osteodysplasia (eco) syndrome is characterized by various anomalies of the endocrine, cerebral, and skeletal systems resulting in neonatal mortality.

MONDO:0012981.name: hereditary spherocytosis type 4
MONDO:0012981.def: any hereditary spherocytosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the slc4a1 gene.

MONDO:0012982.name: episodic ataxia type 6
MONDO:0012982.def: episodic ataxia type 6 (ea6) is an exceedingly rare form of hereditary episodic ataxia with varying degrees of ataxia and associated findings including slurred speech, headache, confusion and hemiplegia.

MONDO:0012983.name: cone-rod dystrophy 12
MONDO:0012983.def: any cone-rod dystrophy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the prom1 gene.

MONDO:0012984.name: pharc syndrome
MONDO:0012984.def: fiskerstrand type peripheral neuropathy is a slowly-progressive refsum-like disorder associating signs of peripheral neuropathy with late-onset hearing loss, cataract and pigmentary retinopathy that become evident during the third decade of life.
MONDO:0012984.synonym: polyneyropathy, hearing loss, ataxia, retinitis pigmentosa, and cataract

MONDO:0012985.name: hereditary spherocytosis type 5
MONDO:0012985.def: any hereditary spherocytosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the epb42 gene.

MONDO:0012987.name: agammaglobulinemia 6, autosomal recessive
MONDO:0012987.def: any autosomal agammaglobulinemia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the cd79b gene.

MONDO:0012988.name: hypogonadotropic hypogonadism 6 with or without anosmia
MONDO:0012988.def: any hypogonadotropic hypogonadism in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the fgf8 gene.

MONDO:0012989.name: microcephaly 7, primary, autosomal recessive
MONDO:0012989.def: any autosomal recessive primary microcephaly in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the stil gene.

MONDO:0012990.name: leber congenital amaurosis 13
MONDO:0012990.def: any leber congenital amaurosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the rdh12 gene.

MONDO:0012991.name: kahrizi syndrome
MONDO:0012991.def: an autosomal recessive disease that is characterized by mental retardation, cataracts, coloboma, kyphosis, and coarse facial features and has material basis in mutation in the srd5a3 gene.
MONDO:0012991.synonym: mental retardation, cataract, coloboma, and kyphosis, autosomal recessive

MONDO:0012992.name: pancreatic insufficiency-anemia-hyperostosis syndrome
MONDO:0012992.def: this syndrome is characterized by exocrine pancreatic insufficiency, dyserythropoietic anemia, and calvarial hyperostosis.
MONDO:0012992.synonym: pancreatic insufficiency, dyserythropoietic anemia, calvarial hyperostosis syndrome

MONDO:0012994.name: dopa-responsive dystonia due to sepiapterin reductase deficiency
MONDO:0012994.def: dopa responsive dystonia (drd) due to sepiapterin reductase deficiency (srd) is a very rare neurometabolic disorder characterized by dystonia with diurnal fluctuations, axial hypotonia, oculogyric crises, and delays in motor and cognitive development.

MONDO:0012996.name: agat deficiency
MONDO:0012996.def: l-arginine:glycine amidinotransferase (agat) deficiency is a very rare type of creatine deficiency sydrome characterized by global developmental delay, intellectual disability, and myopathy.

MONDO:0012997.name: cholestasis-pigmentary retinopathy-cleft palate syndrome
MONDO:0012997.def: cholestasis- pigmentary retinopathy- cleft palate is a syndrome of multiple congenital malformations, characterized by an association of cleft lip and palate, patchy pigmentary retinopathy (cat's paw), obstructive liver disease (cholestasis, portal hypertension etc.) and obstructive renal disease (ectopic ureteric insertion, obstruction, vesicouretral reflux and hydronephrosis). gastrointestinal tract involvement (malrotation, gastresophageal reflux etc.) and cardiac involvement (coarctation of aorta, pulmonary artery stenosis etc) have also been reported. an overlap with kabuki syndrome is debated.

MONDO:0012999.name: guanidinoacetate methyltransferase deficiency
MONDO:0012999.def: guanidinoacetate methyltransferase (gamt) deficiency is a creatine deficiency syndrome characterized by global developmental delay/intellectual disability (dd/id), prominent speech delay, autistic/hyperactive behavioral disorders, seizures, and various types of pyramidal and/or extra-pyramidal manifestations.

MONDO:0013000.name: porphyria due to ala dehydratase deficiency
MONDO:0013000.def: porphyria of doss or deficiency of delta-aminolevulinic acid dehydratase (dalad) is an extremely rare form of acute hepatic porphyria characterized by neuro-visceral attacks without cutaneous manifestations.

MONDO:0013002.name: cone-rod dystrophy 9
MONDO:0013002.def: any cone-rod dystrophy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the adam9 gene.

MONDO:0013003.name: isolated congenital hypoglossia/aglossia
MONDO:0013003.def: isolated aglossia and hypoglossia are terms covering the spectrum from partial to total absence of the tongue. these congenital malformations have been classified as part of the group of oromandibular-limb hypogenesis syndromes (olhs).

MONDO:0013005.name: east syndrome
MONDO:0013005.def: sesame syndrome is characterized by seizures, sensorineural deafness, ataxia, intellectual deficit, and electrolyte imbalance (hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis, and hypomagnesemia).

MONDO:0013006.name: isolated growth hormone deficiency type ib
MONDO:0013006.def: an isolated growth hormone deficiency characterized by autosomal recessive inheritance of low but detectable levels of gh, short stature, significantly retarded bone age, and a positive response and immunologic tolerance to growth hormone therapy that has material basis in mutation in the gh1 or ghrhr genes on chromosomes 17q23.3 and 7p14.3, respectively.
MONDO:0013006.synonym: isolated growth hormone deficiency, type ib

MONDO:0013007.name: combined immunodeficiency due to orai1 deficiency
MONDO:0013007.def: a form of combined immunodeficiency due to calcium release activated ca2+ (crac) channel dysfunction characterized by recurrent infections, congenital myopathy, ectodermal dysplasia and anhydrosis.

MONDO:0013008.name: combined immunodeficiency due to stim1 deficiency
MONDO:0013008.def: aform of combined immunodeficiency due to calcium release activated ca2+(crac) channel dysfunction characterized by recurrent infections, autoimmunity, congenital myopathy and ectodermal dysplasia.

MONDO:0013010.name: autosomal recessive nonsyndromic hearing loss 71
MONDO:0013010.def: an autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 8p22-p21.3.

MONDO:0013011.name: atrial septal defect 5
MONDO:0013011.def: any atrial heart septal defect in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the actc1 gene.

MONDO:0013012.name: inflammatory bowel disease 27
MONDO:0013012.def: an inflammatory bowel disease that has material basis in variation in the chromosome region 13q13.3

MONDO:0013014.name: spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia, aggrecan type
MONDO:0013014.def: a spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia characterized by severe short stature, facial dysmorphism and characteristic radiographic findings.

MONDO:0013015.name: brugada syndrome 5
MONDO:0013015.def: any brugada syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the scn1b gene.

MONDO:0013016.name: leukocyte adhesion deficiency 3
MONDO:0013016.def: leukocyte adhesion deficiency type iii (lad-iii) is a form of lad characterized by both severe bacterial infections and a severe bleeding disorder.

MONDO:0013017.name: hypotrichosis 5
MONDO:0013017.def: a hypotrichosis that has material basis in a mutation on chromosome 1p21.1-q21.3.

MONDO:0013018.name: keratosis follicularis spinulosa decalvans, autosomal dominant

MONDO:0013021.name: sterile multifocal osteomyelitis with periostitis and pustulosis
MONDO:0013021.def: an autoinflammatory disease caused by mutations in the il1rn gene, which encodes the il1 receptor antagonist. it presents in infancy, and is characterized by systemic inflammation, pustular rash, bone pain, sterile osteitis, and periostitis.
MONDO:0013021.synonym: osteomyelitis, sterile multifocal, with periostitis and pustulosis

MONDO:0013024.name: chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension
MONDO:0013024.def: chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (cteph) is characterized by the persistence of thromboemboli in the form of organized tissue obstructing the pulmonary arteries. the consequence is an increase in pulmonary vascular resistance (pvr) resulting in pulmonary hypertension (ph) and progressive right heart failure.
MONDO:0013024.synonym: pulmonary hypertension, chronic thromboembolic, without deep vein thrombosis, susceptibility to

MONDO:0013025.name: chromosome 6q24-q25 deletion syndrome
MONDO:0013025.def: 6q25 microdeletion syndrome is a recently described syndrome characterized by developmental delay, facial dysmorphism and hearing loss.

MONDO:0013026.name: subepithelial mucinous corneal dystrophy
MONDO:0013026.def: subepithelial mucinous corneal dystrophy (smcd) is a very rare form of superficial corneal dystrophy characterized by frequent recurrent corneal erosions in the first decade of life, with progressive loss of vision.

MONDO:0013027.name: posterior amorphous corneal dystrophy
MONDO:0013027.def: posterior amorphous corneal dystrophy (pacd) is a very rare form of stromal corneal dystrophy characterized by irregular amorphous sheet-like opacities in the posterior corneal stroma and in descemet membrane and mildly impaired vision.

MONDO:0013028.name: adenosine monophosphate deaminase deficiency
MONDO:0013028.def: adenosine monophosphate (amp) deaminase deficiency is a metabolic disorder for which two forms have been described. lack of activity of the erythrocyte isoform of amp deaminase has been described in subjects with low plasma uric acid levels without obvious clinical relevance and will not be described further. myoadenylate deaminase deficiency is an inherited disorder of muscular energy metabolism with a lack of amp deaminase activity in skeletal muscle. it is characterized by exercise-induced muscle pain, cramps and/or early fatigue.

MONDO:0013030.name: dilated cardiomyopathy 1bb
MONDO:0013030.def: any familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the dsg2 gene.
MONDO:0013030.synonym: familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy caused by mutation in dsg2

MONDO:0013032.name: epilepsy, idiopathic generalized, susceptibility to, 8
MONDO:0013032.def: any generalized epilepsy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the casr gene.

MONDO:0013033.name: cerebral palsy, spastic quadriplegic, 2
MONDO:0013033.def: any spastic quadriplegia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the kank1 gene.
MONDO:0013033.synonym: spastic quadriplegia caused by mutation in kank1

MONDO:0013034.name: keratosis palmoplantaris striata 2
MONDO:0013034.def: any striate palmoplantar keratoderma in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the dsp gene.
MONDO:0013034.synonym: striate palmoplantar keratoderma caused by mutation in dsp

MONDO:0013035.name: orofaciodigital syndrome xi
MONDO:0013035.def: orofaciodigital syndrome type 11 is an extremely rare, sporadic form of orofaciodigital syndrome (ofds) with only a few reported cases, and characterized by facial (blepharophimosis, bulbous nasal tip, broad nasal bridge, downslanting palpebral fissures and low set ears) and skeletal (post-axial polydactyly and fusion of vertebrae) malformations along with severe intellectual disability, deafness and congenital heart defects.

MONDO:0013037.name: giacheti syndrome
MONDO:0013037.synonym: marfanoid habitus and specific language and learning disabilities

MONDO:0013038.name: cloves syndrome
MONDO:0013038.def: a syndromic disease characterized by congenital lipomatous overgrowth, progressive, complex and mixed truncal vascular malformations, and epidermal nevi.
MONDO:0013038.synonym: congenital lipomatous overgrowth-vascular malformation-epidermal nevi-spinal anomaly syndrome

MONDO:0013039.name: 3m syndrome 2
MONDO:0013039.def: any 3-m syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the obsl1 gene.

MONDO:0013040.name: atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome with mcp/cd46 anomaly
MONDO:0013040.synonym: susceptibility to atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome 2

MONDO:0013041.name: atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome with i factor anomaly
MONDO:0013041.synonym: susceptibility to atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome 3

MONDO:0013042.name: atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome with b factor anomaly
MONDO:0013042.synonym: susceptibility to atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome 4

MONDO:0013043.name: atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome with c3 anomaly
MONDO:0013043.synonym: susceptibility to atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome 5

MONDO:0013044.name: atypical hemolytic-uremic syndrome with thrombomodulin anomaly
MONDO:0013044.synonym: susceptibility to atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome 6

MONDO:0013046.name: glycogen storage disease due to muscle beta-enolase deficiency
MONDO:0013046.def: muscle beta-enolase deficiency is a glycolysis disorder reported in one patient to date and characterized clinically by exercise intolerance and myalgia due to severe enolase deficiency in muscle.

MONDO:0013047.name: glycogen storage disease due to lactate dehydrogenase m-subunit deficiency
MONDO:0013047.def: a condition that affects how the body breaks down sugar to use as energy in muscle cells. people withthis conditionexperience fatigue, muscle pain, and cramps during exercise (exercise intolerance). in some people,high-intensity exercise or other strenuous activity leads to the breakdown of muscle tissue (rhabdomyolysis), which can lead to myoglobinuria (rust-colored urine indicating breakdown of muscle tissue) and kidney damage. a skin rash may also develop. the severity of the signs and symptoms varies greatly among affected individuals. lactate dehydrogenase a deficiency is caused by mutations in the ldha gene. this condition is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern.

MONDO:0013048.name: hereditary spastic paraplegia 50
MONDO:0013048.def: any hereditary spastic paraplegia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ap4m1 gene.

MONDO:0013049.name: dpm3-congenital disorder of glycosylation
MONDO:0013049.def: dpm3-cdg is an extremely rare form of cdg syndrome characterized clinically in the single reported case by muscle weakness, waddling gait and dilated cardiomyopathy.

MONDO:0013050.name: lethal polymalformative syndrome, boissel type
MONDO:0013050.synonym: growth retardation, developmental delay, facial dysmorphism

MONDO:0013051.name: autosomal recessive cutis laxa type 2b
MONDO:0013051.def: autosomal recessive cutis laxa type 2b is a rare, hereditary, developmental defect with connective tissue involvement characterized by cutis laxa of variable severity, in utero growth restriction, congenital hip dislocation and joint hyperlaxity, wrinkling of the skin, in particular the dorsum of hands and feet, and progeroid facial features. hypotonia, developmental delay, and intellectual disability are common. in addition, cataracts, corneal clouding, wormian bones, lipodystrophy and osteopenia have been reported.
MONDO:0013051.synonym: pycr1 autosomal recessive cutis laxa type 2

MONDO:0013052.name: retinitis pigmentosa 42
MONDO:0013052.def: any retinitis pigmentosa in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the klhl7 gene.

MONDO:0013053.name: microcephaly-facio-cardio-skeletal syndrome, hadziselimovic type
MONDO:0013053.def: microcephaly-facio-cardio-skeletal syndrome, hadziselimovic type is a rare syndrome with cardiac malformations, characterized by prenatal-onset growth retardation (low birth weight and short stature), hypotonia, developmental delay and intellectual disability associated with microcephaly and craniofacial (low anterior hairline, hypotelorism, thick lips with carp-shaped mouth, high-arched palate, low-set ears), cardiac (conotruncal heart malformations such as tetralogy of fallot) and skeletal (hypoplastic thumbs and first metacarpals) abnormalities.

MONDO:0013054.name: microcephaly, growth retardation, cataract, hearing loss, and unusual appearance
MONDO:0013054.synonym: microcephaly, growth retardation, cataract, hearing loss, and unusual appearance

MONDO:0013055.name: stargardt macular degeneration, absent or hypoplastic corpus callosum, intellectual disability, and dysmorphic features
MONDO:0013055.synonym: stargardt macular degeneration, absent or hypoplastic corpus callosum, mental retardation, and dysmorphic features

MONDO:0013056.name: developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, 39
