MONDO:0100510.def: an osteochondrodysplasia that results in abnormalities of bone growth in the vertebral column, epiphysis, and metaphysis.

MONDO:0100511.name: sudden cardiac arrest
MONDO:0100511.def: the sudden loss of all heart activity due to an irregular heart rhythm.

MONDO:0100512.name: mitochondrial dna depletion syndrome, hepatocerebral form

MONDO:0100513.name: traf3 haploinsufficiency
MONDO:0100513.def: any mendelian disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the traf3 gene. traf3 haploinsufficiency caused by heterozygous loss of function (null) variants presents as an immune dysregulation syndrome of recurrent bacterial infections, autoimmunity, systemic inflammation, b cell lymphoproliferation, and hypergammaglobulinemia.

MONDO:0100514.name: familial ovarian carcinoma
MONDO:0100514.def: ovarian carcinoma that has developed in relatives of patients that have a history of ovarian carcinoma.

MONDO:0100515.name: mirror movements 1 and/or agenesis of the corpus callosum
MONDO:0100515.def: a familial congenital mirror movement disorder where individuals with heterozygous variants in dcc have congenital mirror movements and/or agenesis of the corpus callosum (not with or without- some individuals do not demonstrate mirror movements and only have corpus callosum defects, even within the same family).

MONDO:0100516.name: complex neurodevelopmental disorder with motor features
MONDO:0100516.def: a complex neurodevelopmental disorder that involves more than one phenotype associated with the central nervous system, including but not limited to intellectual disability, autism, and seizures (epilepsy). additionally, the disorder features at least one phenotype associated with motor function, including but not limited to spasticity, hypo- or hypertonia, dyskinesia, choreo-athetosis, or ataxia.

MONDO:0100517.name: psap-related sphingolipidosis
MONDO:0100517.def: a sphingolipidosis caused by variants in the psap gene. clinical and biochemical features vary based on the location of variants within the gene and their molecular impact.

MONDO:0100518.name: hereditary attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder
MONDO:0100518.def: an instance of attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual.

MONDO:0100520.name: nkx2-1 related choreoathetosis and congenital hypothyroidism with or without pulmonary dysfunction
MONDO:0100520.def: the nkx2-1 gene is located on chromosome 14 at 14q13.3 and encodes the nk2 homeobox 1 protein, a transcription factor that binds and activates thyroid specific genes. nkx2-1 was first reported in relation to autosomal dominant nkx2-1 related choreoathetosis and congenital hypothyroidism with or without pulmonary dysfunction in 1998.

MONDO:0100521.name: nog-related symphalangism spectrum disorder
MONDO:0100521.def: an autosomal dominant condition caused by pathogenic variants of the nog gene, encoding the noggin protein. five overlapping clinical syndromes associated with nog mutations have been described; proximal symphalangism, multiple synostoses syndrome 1, tarsal-carpal coalition syndrome, stapes ankylosis with broad thumbs and toes, and brachydactyly type b2. nog-related symphalangism spectrum disorder is a new term initially proposed by potti et al., 2011 to encompass these disorders. nog-ssd is characterized by proximal symphalangism, conductive deafness caused by stapes ankylosis, ocular abnormality such as hyperopia and strabismus, and characteristic facial features including a broad, tubular-shaped nose and a thin upper vermilion.

MONDO:0100523.name: spast-related motor disorder
MONDO:0100523.def: heterozygous variants in spast have been reported in relation to pure spastic paraplegias (infantile, ascending), complicated or complex spastic paraplegia (with dementia, cerebellar ataxia, epilepsy, and/or peripheral neuropathy) and cerebral palsy. age of symptom onset ranges from neonatal to advanced age with varying symptom severity,

MONDO:0100524.name: asah1-related sphingolipidosis
MONDO:0100524.def: a spectrum of disorders that includes farber disease and spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy. both disorders are caused by mutations in the asah1 gene that encodes the lysosomal hydrolase that breaks down the bioactive lipid, ceramide.

MONDO:0100525.name: tcf7l2-related neurodevelopmental disorder
MONDO:0100525.def: a newly discovered disorder caused by a change (variant or mutation) in the tcf7l2 gene. this mutation may be responsible for developmental delays in childhood, intellectual disability, autism, myopia, adhd, abnormal physical features and other problems. there is a wide spectrum of severity for individuals affected with trnd. many of the symptoms of trnd overlap with other neurodevelopmental disorders. trnd must be diagnosed with a genetic test and cannot be diagnosed by symptoms alone.

MONDO:0200000.name: uterine ligament adenosarcoma
MONDO:0200000.def: an extremely rare adenosarcoma that arises from the uterine ligament.

MONDO:0300000.name: ssr3-cdg
MONDO:0300000.def: a congenital disorder of glycosylation with a ssr3 deficiency that affects the brain, lungs and gastrointestinal system, and presents with clinical phenotypes such as seizures, intellectual disability, developmental delay, microcephaly and abnormal brain structure.

MONDO:0400000.name: small intestinal bacterial overgrowth
MONDO:0400000.def: the presence of excessive bacteria in the small intestine that can result from result from failure of the gastric acid barrier, failure of small intestinal motility, anatomic alterations, or impairment of systemic and local immunity.

MONDO:0400002.name: calcium-alkali syndrome
MONDO:0400002.def: the ingestion of excessive calcium supplementation or calcium containing antacids, and alkali resulting in a triad of hypercalcemia, metabolic alkalosis, and renal insufficiency.

MONDO:0400003.name: skeletal fluorosis
MONDO:0400003.def: a condition that results from excessive fluoride ingestion leading to fluoride accumulation in the bone progressively over many years. the early symptoms of skeletal fluorosis, include stiffness and pain in the joints. in severe cases, the bone structure may change and ligaments may calcify, with resulting impairment of muscles and pain.

MONDO:0400004.name: phrynoderma
MONDO:0400004.def: phrynoderma is a form of follicular hyperkeratosis seen in young children and adolescents due to nutritional deficiencies. it is clinically characterized by discrete, follicular, skin-colored papules with keratotic plugs distributed over elbows, knees, extensor extremities, and buttocks.

MONDO:0400005.name: refeeding syndrome
MONDO:0400005.def: potentially fatal shifts in fluids and electrolytes that may occur in malnourished patients receiving artificial refeeding (whether enterally or parenterally).

MONDO:0400006.name: botryomycosis
MONDO:0400006.def: a rare chronic suppurative bacterial infection involving mostly subcutaneous tissues and less frequently other organs. botryomycosis is mostly caused by staphylococcus aureus, escherichia coli and pseudomonas aeruginosa but the exact pathogenesis remains uncertain. treatment often requires a combination of both surgical debridement and long-term antimicrobial therapy.

MONDO:0500000.name: episodic angioedema with eosinophilia
MONDO:0500000.def: a disorder characterized by episodes of swelling under the skin (angioedema) and an elevated number of the white blood cells known as eosinophils (eosinophilia). during these episodes, symptoms of hives (urticaria), fever, swelling, weight gain and eosinophilia may occur. symptoms usually appear every 3-4 weeks and resolve on their own within several days. other cells may be elevated during the episodes, such as neutrophils and lymphocytes. although the syndrome is often considered a subtype of the idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndromes, it does not typically have organ involvement or lead to other health concerns.

MONDO:0500018.name: acute fibrinous and organizing pneumonia
MONDO:0500018.def: a rare pulmonary disease with histological pattern of interstitial pneumonitis characterized by the deposit of intra-alveolar fibrin and diffuse organizing pneumonia within the alveolar ducts and bronchioles, with large etiological spectra.

MONDO:0550003.name: sec61b-related polycystic liver disease
MONDO:0550003.def: any autosomal dominant polycystic liver disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the sec61b gene.

MONDO:0600001.name: glutaminase deficiency
MONDO:0600001.def: glutaminase deficiency is characterized by refractory seizures, respiratory failure, brain abnormalities and death in the neonatal period, though milder cases with spastic ataxia-dysarthria have also been reported. this condition is caused by mutations in the glutaminase (gls) gene.

MONDO:0600002.name: hemorrhagic fever
MONDO:0600002.def: an infectious disease caused by certain viruses or bacteria that can damage the walls of tiny blood vessels, making them leak, and can hamper the blood's ability to clot and cause severe, life-threatening illness.

MONDO:0600003.name: bacterial hemorrhagic fever
MONDO:0600003.def: a hemorrhagic fever caused by bacteria. bacterial hemorrhagic disease is rare. one example of a bacterial hemorrhagic disease is scrub typhus.

MONDO:0600008.name: cytokine release syndrome
MONDO:0600008.def: a syndrome that occurs after therapeutic infusion of antibodies into the blood and is characterized by nausea, headache, tachycardia, hypotension, rash, and shortness of breath. it is caused by the release of cytokines from the cells that are targeted by the antibodies. most patients experience a mild to moderate reaction; however, the reaction may be severe and life-threatening.

MONDO:0600009.name: severe hypophosphatasia
MONDO:0600009.def: severe hypophosphatasia is a rare, severe form of hypophosphatasia characterized by infantile rickets without elevated serum alkaline phosphatase (alp) activity and a wide range of clinical manifestations due to hypomineralization. individuals often present with these features in infancy or in the perinatal period.

MONDO:0600010.name: moderate hypophosphatasia
MONDO:0600010.def: moderate hypophosphatasia is a rare, moderate form of hypophosphatasia characterized by defective mineralization of bone and/or teeth, premature loss of teeth with intact roots, and reduced serum alkaline phosphatase (alp) activity. individuals can present with this form of hypophosphatasia in infancy, childhood, or adulthood.

MONDO:0600011.name: mild hypophosphatasia
MONDO:0600011.def: mild hypophosphatasia is the most common form of hypophosphatasia characterized by low alkaline phosphatase, unspecific clinical signs, and typically presents in individuals in adulthood.

MONDO:0600014.name: alveolar capillary dysplasia without misalignment of pulmonary veins
MONDO:0600014.def: a rare form of interstitial and vascular lung disease that presents as severe pulmonary hypertension and refractory hypoxemia early in life that is characterized by a lack of misalignment of the pulmonary veins.

MONDO:0600016.name: acinar dysplasia
MONDO:0600016.def: a lethal, developmental lung malformation resulting in neonatal respiratory insufficiency. it is characterized by pulmonary hypoplasia and arrest in the pseudoglandular stage of development, resulting in the absence of functional gas exchange. it can be caused by mutations in fgf10, fgfr2 or tbx4.

MONDO:0600017.name: acinar dysplasia caused by mutation in fgf10
MONDO:0600017.def: any acinar dysplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the fgf10 gene.

MONDO:0600018.name: acinar dysplasia caused by mutation in fgfr2
MONDO:0600018.def: any acinar dysplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the fgfr2 gene.

MONDO:0600019.name: acinar dysplasia caused by mutation in tbx4
MONDO:0600019.def: any acinar dysplasia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the tbx4 gene.

MONDO:0600024.name: familial idiopathic inflammatory myopathy
MONDO:0600024.def: an instance of myositis that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual, and has an unknown cause.

MONDO:0600025.name: hydrosalpinx
MONDO:0600025.def: fluid accumulation and dilatation of the fallopian tube due to tubal blockage.

MONDO:0600026.name: vanishing lung syndrome
MONDO:0600026.def: a rare form of irreversible damage to the pulmonary parenchyma often due to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (copd). it is associated with a spectrum of clinical manifestations, including worsening dyspnea, cough, declining pulmonary function, and occasionally spontaneous pneumothorax due to ruptured bullae.

MONDO:0600027.name: congenital right-sided heart lesions
MONDO:0600027.def: serious heritable structural anomalies of the right side of the heart, including pulmonary atresia, tricuspid valve disease and ebstein's anomaly, and right ventricular outflow tract obstruction and/or pulmonary stenosis, that are present from birth.

MONDO:0600029.name: restrictive pulmonary disease
MONDO:0600029.def: decreased lung volume and inadequate ventilation due to parenchymal lung disorders (e.g., interstitial pulmonary fibrosis) or extrapulmonary disorders (e.g., scoliosis). patients present with shortness of breath and cough.

MONDO:0600030.name: b-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia with t(1;19)(q23;p13.3); e2a-pbx1 (tcf3-pbx1)
MONDO:0600030.def: a b-cell acute leukemia characterized by the presence of lymphoblasts that carry a translocation between the e2a gene on chromosome 19 and the pbx1 gene on chromosome 1. it occurs in children and less often in adults.

MONDO:0700000.name: alg9-associated autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease
MONDO:0700000.def: any autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the alg9 gene.
MONDO:0700000.synonym: autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease caused by mutation in alg9

MONDO:0700001.name: shrinking lung syndrome
MONDO:0700001.def: a rare pulmonary complication of an underlying autoimmune disorder that is reported in association with systemic lupus erythematosus (sle). reduced lung volumes result in restrictive ventilatory defect and a preserved carbon monoxide transfer coefficient.

MONDO:0700002.name: atp1a3-associated neurological disorder
MONDO:0700002.def: any neurological disorder in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the atp1a3.
MONDO:0700002.synonym: neurological disorder caused by mutation in atp1a3

MONDO:0700003.name: obstetric disorder
MONDO:0700003.def: disorder associated with pregnancy, childbirth, and puerperium.

MONDO:0700004.name: idiopathic vs non-idiopathic
MONDO:0700004.def: a disease characteristic in which the cause of the disease is known or unknown.

MONDO:0700005.name: idiopathic
MONDO:0700005.def: a disease characteristic in which the disease has an uncertain or unknown cause.

MONDO:0700006.name: non-idiopathic
MONDO:0700006.def: a disease characteristic in which the disease has a known cause.

MONDO:0700007.name: idiopathic disease
MONDO:0700007.def: a disease or disorder for which the cause is of uncertain or unknown.

MONDO:0700008.name: chromosome 1 disorder
MONDO:0700008.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 1 is affected.

MONDO:0700009.name: chromosome 2 disorder
MONDO:0700009.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 2 is affected.

MONDO:0700010.name: chromosome 3 disorder
MONDO:0700010.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 3 is affected.

MONDO:0700011.name: chromosome 4 disorder
MONDO:0700011.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 4 is affected.

MONDO:0700012.name: chromosome 5 disorder
MONDO:0700012.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 5 is affected.

MONDO:0700013.name: chromosome 6 disorder
MONDO:0700013.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 6 is affected.

MONDO:0700014.name: chromosome 7 disorder
MONDO:0700014.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 7 is affected.

MONDO:0700015.name: chromosome 8 disorder
MONDO:0700015.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 8 is affected.

MONDO:0700016.name: chromosome 9 disorder
MONDO:0700016.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 9 is affected.

MONDO:0700017.name: chromosome 10 disorder
MONDO:0700017.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 10 is affected.

MONDO:0700018.name: chromosome 11 disorder
MONDO:0700018.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 11 is affected.

MONDO:0700019.name: chromosome 12 disorder
MONDO:0700019.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 12 is affected.

MONDO:0700020.name: chromosome 13 disorder
MONDO:0700020.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 13 is affected.

MONDO:0700021.name: chromosome 14 disorder
MONDO:0700021.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 14 is affected.

MONDO:0700022.name: chromosome 15 disorder
MONDO:0700022.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 15 is affected.

MONDO:0700023.name: chromosome 16 disorder
MONDO:0700023.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 16 is affected.

MONDO:0700024.name: chromosome 19 disorder
MONDO:0700024.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 19 is affected.

MONDO:0700025.name: chromosome 20 disorder
MONDO:0700025.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 20 is affected.

MONDO:0700026.name: chromosome 22 disorder
MONDO:0700026.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 22 is affected.

MONDO:0700027.name: chromosome x disorder
MONDO:0700027.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome x is affected.

MONDO:0700028.name: chromosome y disorder
MONDO:0700028.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome y is affected.

MONDO:0700030.name: complete trisomy 21
MONDO:0700030.def: trisomy 21 characterized by the presence of an extra chromosome 21 in all the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700031.name: mosaic trisomy 18
MONDO:0700031.def: trisomy 18 in which the presence of an extra copy of chromosome 18 is present only in some of the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700032.name: complete trisomy 18
MONDO:0700032.def: trisomy 18 in which the presence of an extra copy of chromosome 18 is present in all the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700033.name: complete trisomy 13
MONDO:0700033.def: trisomy 13 in which the presence of an extra copy of chromosome 13 is present in all the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700034.name: mosaic trisomy 13
MONDO:0700034.def: trisomy 13 in which the presence of an extra copy of chromosome 13 is present only in some of the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700035.name: monosomy chromosome 8
MONDO:0700035.def: a chromosomal disorder consisting of the absence of one chromosome 8.

MONDO:0700036.name: fibrothecoma
MONDO:0700036.def: a sex cord-stromal tumor characterized by mixed features of both fibroma and thecoma.

MONDO:0700037.name: testicular fibrothecoma
MONDO:0700037.def: a rare testicular sex cord-stromal neoplasm characterized by mixed features of both fibroma and thecoma.

MONDO:0700038.name: tdp-43 proteinopathy
MONDO:0700038.def: disease characterized by the presence of abnormally phosphorylated, ubiquitinated, and cleaved dna-binding protein tdp-43 in affected brain and spinal cord. inclusions of the pathologic protein in neurons and glia, without the presence of amyloid, is the major feature of these conditions, thus making these proteinopathies distinct from most other neurogenerative disorders in which protein misfolding leads to brain amyloidosis. both frontotemporal lobar degeneration and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis exhibit this common method of pathogenesis and thus they may represent two extremes of a continuous clinicopathological spectrum of one disease.

MONDO:0700039.name: bladder exstrophy-epispadias-cloacal extrophy complex
MONDO:0700039.def: an anterior midline defect with variable expression involving the infraumbilical abdominal wall including the pelvis, urinary tract, and external genitalia.

MONDO:0700040.name: neonatal jaundice due to abo incompatibility
MONDO:0700040.def: jaundice that appears during the neonatal period due to high levels of unconjugated bilirubin that are a result of maternal-fetal abo incompatibility.

MONDO:0700042.name: x-linked mendelian susceptibility to mycobacterial diseases due to ikbkg deficiency
MONDO:0700042.def: a susceptibility or predisposition to mycobacterial infectious diseases in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ikbkg gene.
MONDO:0700042.synonym: x-linked msmd due to nemo deficiency

MONDO:0700043.name: syndrome caused by partial chromosomal duplication of the short arm of chromosome 9

MONDO:0700044.name: tubb2a-related tubulinopathy
MONDO:0700044.def: a tubulinopathy syndrome often associated with microtubule dysfunction, malformations of the corpus callosum, enlarged ventricles, dysgyria, abnormal basal ganglia, cerebellar vermis hypoplasia/dysplasia, and decreased white matter, due to heterozygous variants in tubb2a. individuals may present with variable combinations of malformations of the corpus callosum, enlarged ventricles, dysgyria, abnormal basal ganglia, cerebellar vermis hypoplasia/dysplasia, and decreased white matter. epilepsy, speech impairment, and motor impairment are also frequent features.

MONDO:0700045.name: protothecosis
MONDO:0700045.def: a disease caused by infection with achlorophyllic algae of the genus prototheca, the majority caused by the species p. wickerhamii. clinical manifestations of reported cases have included cutaneous lesions, olecranon bursitis, or systemic involvement.

MONDO:0700046.name: baclofen withdrawal syndrome
MONDO:0700046.def: withdrawal syndrome involving the abrupt discontinuation of baclofen therapy (intrathecal or oral). baclofen withdrawal syndrome can result in high fever, altered mental status (including agitation, insomnia, confusion, delusions, hallucinations, seizures, visual changes, or psychosis), and potentially profound muscular rigidity that sometimes progresses to fatal rhabdomyolysis.

MONDO:0700047.name: premenopausal osteoporosis
MONDO:0700047.def: osteoporosis occuring in premenopausal women with existing fragility fractures, diseases or treatments known to cause bone loss or fractures.

MONDO:0700048.name: hand-foot syndrome
MONDO:0700048.def: a condition characterized by redness, pain, swelling, and tingling in the palms of the hands or the soles of the feet. it may appear as a side effect to chemotherapy agents.

MONDO:0700049.name: infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700049.def: infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700050.name: bacterial infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700050.def: bacterial infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700051.name: liver abscess (disease)
MONDO:0700051.def: an abscess that involves the liver.

MONDO:0700052.name: intersphincteric abscess
MONDO:0700052.def: an abscess contained between the internal and external anal sphincters.

MONDO:0700053.name: viral infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700053.def: viral infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700054.name: microcephaly 6 with or without short stature
MONDO:0700054.def: disorder of fetal brain growth; individuals have small brains and almost always have mental retardation, although rare individuals with mild microcephaly (-3 sd) and normal intelligence have been reported. clinical features include the features of ‘microcephaly 6, primary, autosomal recessive’ and 'seckel syndrome', and may include short stature or mild seizures.

MONDO:0700055.name: kif1a related neurological disorder
MONDO:0700055.def: kif1a-associated neurological disorder (kand) encompasses a group of rare neurodegenerative conditions caused by variants in kif1a
MONDO:0700055.synonym: neurological disorder caused by variation in kif1a

MONDO:0700056.name: fungal infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700056.def: fungal infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700057.name: neurological pain disorder
MONDO:0700057.def: a nervous system disorder that has pain as a major feature.

MONDO:0700058.name: morton neuroma
MONDO:0700058.def: compressive neuropathy of the forefoot interdigital nerve chiefly due to compression and irritation at the plantar aspect of the transverse intermetatarsal ligament. it is not a true neuroma as the condition is degenerative rather than neoplastic. the most common location for morton neuroma is between the 2nd and 3rd metatarsals.

MONDO:0700059.name: actinobacillus infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700059.def: actinobacillus infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700061.name: mosaic vs complete
MONDO:0700061.def: a disease characteristic in which the cause of the disease is present in some of the cells of the organism, or in all the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700062.name: mosaic
MONDO:0700062.def: a disease characteristic in which the cause of the disease is present in some of the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700063.name: complete
MONDO:0700063.def: a disease characteristic in which the cause of the disease is present in all the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700064.name: aneuploidy
MONDO:0700064.def: chromosomal disorder consisting of the presence a chromosomal abnormality in which there is an addition or loss of chromosomes within a set.

MONDO:0700065.name: trisomy
MONDO:0700065.def: a chromosomal abnormality consisting of the presence of one chromosome in addition to the normal diploid number.

MONDO:0700066.name: myopathy caused by variation in fkrp
MONDO:0700066.def: any myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the fkrp gene.
MONDO:0700066.synonym: myopathy caused by mutation in fkrp

MONDO:0700067.name: myopathy caused by variation in fktn
MONDO:0700067.def: any myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the fktn gene.
MONDO:0700067.synonym: myopathy caused by mutation in fktn

MONDO:0700068.name: myopathy caused by variation in pomgnt1
MONDO:0700068.def: any myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the pomgnt1 gene.

MONDO:0700069.name: myopathy caused by variation in pomgnt2
MONDO:0700069.def: any myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the pomgnt2 gene.

MONDO:0700070.name: myopathy caused by variation in pomt1
MONDO:0700070.def: any myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the pomt1 gene.

MONDO:0700071.name: myopathy caused by variation in pomt2
MONDO:0700071.def: any myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the pomt2 gene.

MONDO:0700072.name: rhabdoviridae infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700072.def: rhabdoviridae infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700073.name: glutaric acidemia iia
MONDO:0700073.def: any multiple acyl-coa dehydrogenase deficiency in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the etfa gene.
MONDO:0700073.synonym: multiple acyl-coa dehydrogenase deficiency caused by mutation in etfa

MONDO:0700074.name: glutaric acidemia iib
MONDO:0700074.def: any multiple acyl-coa dehydrogenase deficiency in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the etfb gene.
MONDO:0700074.synonym: multiple acyl-coa dehydrogenase deficiency caused by mutation in etfb

MONDO:0700075.name: congenital muscular dystrophy caused by variation in pomgnt2
MONDO:0700075.def: any congenital muscular dystrophy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the pomgnt2 gene.

MONDO:0700076.name: glutaric acidemia iic
MONDO:0700076.def: any multiple acyl-coa dehydrogenase deficiency in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the etfdh gene.
MONDO:0700076.synonym: multiple acyl-coa dehydrogenase deficiency caused by mutation in etfdh

MONDO:0700078.name: triple-positive breast carcinoma
MONDO:0700078.def: a breast carcinoma which is positive for expression of estrogen receptor (er), progesterone receptor (pr), and human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (her2).

MONDO:0700079.name: hormone receptor-positive breast cancer
MONDO:0700079.def: a breast carcinoma which is positive for expression of estrogen receptor (er), progesterone receptor (pr), and is negative for expression of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (her2).

MONDO:0700080.name: ephb4-associated vascular malformation spectrum
MONDO:0700080.def: any vascular malformation in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the ephb4 gene.

MONDO:0700081.name: newborn respiratory distress syndrome
MONDO:0700081.def: a condition beginning in the first day of life that results from inadequate surfactant production, causing increased work of breathing and impaired gas exchange.

MONDO:0700082.name: robertsonian translocation down syndrome
MONDO:0700082.def: chromosomal disorder in which (part or full) chromosome 21 is attached to another chromosome, resulting in the presence of a third copy of part of full chromosome 21 genetic material. a robertsonian translocation is a structural chromosomal anomaly in which two acrocentric chromosomes break, resulting in the fusion of the nonhomologous chromosomes’ long arms to form a single, large chromosome.

MONDO:0700083.name: reciprocal translocation down syndrome
MONDO:0700083.def: chromosomal disorder in which (part or full) chromosome 21 has been exchange with another chromosome, resulting in the presence of a third copy of (part or full) chromosome 21 genetic material. a reciprocal translocation is a chromosome abnormality caused by exchange of parts between non-homologous chromosomes.

MONDO:0700084.name: myopathy caused by variation in gmppb
MONDO:0700084.def: any myopathy in which the cause of the disease is a variation in the gmppb gene.
MONDO:0700084.synonym: myopathy caused by mutation in gmppb

MONDO:0700085.name: pentasomy
MONDO:0700085.def: a chromosomal disorder consisting of the presence of three chromosomes of the same type in addition to the normal diploid number.

MONDO:0700086.name: uniparental disomy
MONDO:0700086.def: a condition characterized by the inheritance of a chromosome pair from one parent and no chromosomal copies from the other parent. it results in developmental abnormalities or rare recessive disorders.

MONDO:0700087.name: usher syndrome type 1b
MONDO:0700087.def: usher syndrome in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the myo7a gene

MONDO:0700088.name: paroxysmal nonkinesigenic dyskinesia
MONDO:0700088.def: paroxysmal non-kinesigenic dyskinesia (pnkd) is a form of paroxysmal dyskinesia, characterized by attacks of dystonic or choreathetotic movements precipitated by stress, fatigue, coffee or alcohol intake or menstruation.

MONDO:0700089.name: paroxysmal nonkinesigenic dyskinesia 1
MONDO:0700089.def: paroxysmal nonkinesigenic dyskinesia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the pnkd gene.

MONDO:0700090.name: epilepsy, familial temporal lobe, 1
MONDO:0700090.def: an autosomal dominant condition caused by mutation(s) in the lgi1 gene, encoding leucine-rich glioma-inactivated protein 1. it is characterized by partial seizures originating in the temporal lobe and often accompanied by auditory sensory manifestations.

MONDO:0700091.name: ring chromosome disorder
MONDO:0700091.def: chromosomal disorder in which the chromosomal anomaly consists of the presence of a ring chromosome. a ring chromosome is a chromosome whose arms have fused together to form a ring, often with the loss of the ends of the chromosome.

MONDO:0700092.name: neurodevelopmental disorder
MONDO:0700092.def: a behavioral and cognitive disorder with onset during the developmental period that involves impaired or aberrant development of intellectual, motor, or social functions.

MONDO:0700093.name: balanced robertsonian translocation down syndrome
MONDO:0700093.def: robertsonian translocation down syndrome in which translocation displacement of the end regions of chromosomes occured without loss of chromosomal material between the two nonhomologous chromosomes.

MONDO:0700094.name: unbalanced robertsonian translocation down syndrome
MONDO:0700094.def: robertsonian translocation down syndrome in which translocation displacement of the end regions of chromosomes occured with loss of chromosomal material between the two nonhomologous chromosomes.

MONDO:0700095.name: reoviridae infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700095.def: reoviridae infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700104.name: respiratory system disorder, non-human animal
MONDO:0700104.def: respiratory system disorder that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700105.name: difference of sexual differentiation, non-human animal

MONDO:0700106.name: immune system disorder, non-human animal
MONDO:0700106.def: immune system disorder that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700107.name: chromosome 19q13.11 deletion syndrome, distal
MONDO:0700107.def: chromosome 19q13.11 deletion syndrome in which the distal region was deleted.

MONDO:0700109.name: skin disease caused by bacterial infection, non-human animal

MONDO:0700112.name: heterotaxy, visceral, 5, autosomal
MONDO:0700112.def: any visceral hetetotaxy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the nodal gene.
MONDO:0700112.synonym: visceral heterotaxy caused by mutation in nodal

MONDO:0700113.name: anaplasmataceae infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700113.def: anaplasmataceae infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700114.name: vector-borne disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700114.def: vector-borne disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700115.name: proliferative vitreoretinopathy
MONDO:0700115.def: vitreoretinal membrane shrinkage or contraction secondary to the proliferation of primarily retinal pigment epithelial cells and glial cells, particularly fibrous astrocytes, followed by membrane formation. the formation of fibrillar collagen and cellular proliferation appear to be the basis for the contractile properties of the epiretinal and vitreous membranes.

MONDO:0700116.name: microcephaly with lissencephaly and/or hydranencephaly
MONDO:0700116.def: a brain disorder caused by biallelic variants in nde1 that is characterized by extreme microcephaly (typically head circumference of more than 10 standard deviations (sd) below the mean), profound motor and intellectual disability, spasticity, and incomplete cerebral formation. radiologic studies demonstrate overt microcephaly with cortical dysgenesis ranging from simplification to pachygyria/lissencephaly to hydranencephaly. agenesis of the corpus callosum as well as hypoplasia of the brainstem and cerebellum are typically present.

MONDO:0700117.name: slc6a3-related dopamine transporter deficiency syndrome
MONDO:0700117.def: a complex movement disorder characterized by tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia, chorea, reduced facial expression, and parkinsonism-dystonia. this disease is caused by loss of function variants in the slc6a3 gene, which impair the dopamine transporter protein. the onset of this disease ranges from infancy to adulthood.

MONDO:0700118.name: proximal chromosome 18q deletion syndrome
MONDO:0700118.def: chromosome abnormality that occurs when there is a missing (deleted) copy of genetic material from the part of the long (q) arm near the center of chromosome 18.

MONDO:0700119.name: distal chromosome 18q deletion syndrome
MONDO:0700119.def: distal chromosome 18q deletion syndrome is a chromosome abnormality that occurs when there is a missing (deleted) copy of genetic material at the end of the long arm (q) of chromosome 18.

MONDO:0700120.name: bafopathy
MONDO:0700120.def: disorder caused by mutations in the various subunits composing the baf complex.

MONDO:0700121.name: actl6a-related bafopathy
MONDO:0700121.def: any bafopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the actl6a gene.

MONDO:0700122.name: pbrm1-related bafopathy
MONDO:0700122.def: any bafopathy in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the pbrm1 gene.

MONDO:0700123.name: smarcc1-associated developmental dysgenesis syndrome
MONDO:0700123.def: variants in smarcc1 cause a novel human syndrome characterized by developmental delay, cerebral ventriculomegaly and aqueductal stenosis, and other associated structural brain and cardiac defects.

MONDO:0700124.name: chromosome 21 disorder
MONDO:0700124.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 21 is affected.

MONDO:0700125.name: chromosome 18 disorder
MONDO:0700125.def: chromosomal disorder in which chromosome 18 is affected.

MONDO:0700126.name: trisomy 21
MONDO:0700126.def: a chromosomal disorder consisting of the presence of an extra chromosome 21.

MONDO:0700127.name: mosaic trisomy 21
MONDO:0700127.def: trisomy 21 characterized by the presence of an extra chromosome 21 in some of the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700128.name: translocation down syndrome
MONDO:0700128.def: down syndrome in which the extra (partial or total) copy of chromosome 21 genetic material is attached to another chromosome.

MONDO:0700129.name: mosaic translocation down syndrome
MONDO:0700129.def: translocation down syndrome in which the extra (partial or total) copy of chromosome 21 attached to another chromosome is present in some of the cells of the organism.

MONDO:0700130.name: partial segmental duplication
MONDO:0700130.def: a chromosomal disorder consisting of the partial duplication of chromosome 21.

MONDO:0700131.name: sarcoma, non-human animal
MONDO:0700131.def: sarcoma that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700132.name: melanoma, non-human animal
MONDO:0700132.def: melanoma that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700133.name: adenoma, non-human
MONDO:0700133.def: adenoma that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700134.name: bovine neoplasm
MONDO:0700134.def: a neoplasm that occurs in cattle.

MONDO:0700135.name: bovine leukemia
MONDO:0700135.def: a malignant (clonal) hematologic disorder, involving hematopoietic stem cells and characterized by the presence of primitive or atypical myeloid or lymphoid cells in the bone marrow and the blood which occurs in cattle

MONDO:0700136.name: bovine protoporphyria
MONDO:0700136.def: a congenital metabolic disorder characterized by a deficiency in the enzyme ferrochelatase, which occurs in cattle.

MONDO:0700137.name: bovine lymphosarcoma
MONDO:0700137.def: lymphosarcoma that occurs in a cow.

MONDO:0700138.name: bovine rectal myxoma
MONDO:0700138.def: a myxoma that occurs in the rectum of a cow.

MONDO:0700139.name: canine neoplasm
MONDO:0700139.def: a neoplasm that occurs in dogs.

MONDO:0700140.name: canine osteosarcoma
MONDO:0700140.def: an osteosarcoma of mesenchymal origin in a dog. it is the most common bone cancer in dogs, most often developing in the limbs of large or giant breed dogs. the morphologic and biologic behavior of canine osteosarcomas is similar to that of human osteosarcomas.

MONDO:0700141.name: canine melanoma
MONDO:0700141.def: melanoma occurring in a dog. it is the most common malignant tumor found in the mouths of dogs and also occurs frequently on the digits. all canine melanomas are locally invasive and malignant canine melanomas show a high rate of metastasis. melanoma in dogs has been established as a relevant model for human melanoma.

MONDO:0700142.name: canine hemangiosarcoma
MONDO:0700142.def: hemangiosarcoma occurring in a dog. it is an incurable tumor of vascular endothelial cells and occurs more commonly in dogs beyond middle age, and is especially common in certain breeds. most hemangiosarcomas do not have a known cause.

MONDO:0700143.name: canine mammary carcinoma
MONDO:0700143.def: mammary carcinoma occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700144.name: canine leukemia
MONDO:0700144.def: an acute or chronic malignant (clonal) hematologic disorder, arising from hematopoietic stem cells in dogs. it is characterized by the presence of primitive or atypical myeloid or lymphoid cells in the bone marrow and the blood.

MONDO:0700145.name: canine lymphoma
MONDO:0700145.def: a malignant lymphoproliferative disorder that affects dogs. it is characterized by the clonal proliferation of b- or t-lymphocytes in the lymph nodes, bone marrow, and/or extranodal sites.

MONDO:0700146.name: canine prostate carcinoma
MONDO:0700146.def: a malignant epithelial neoplasm arising from the prostate gland of a dog.

MONDO:0700147.name: canine histiocytic sarcoma
MONDO:0700147.def: a malignant neoplasm that affects dogs, characterized by the presence of malignant cells with morphologic and immunophenotypic characteristics similar to those seen in mature histiocytes.

MONDO:0700148.name: canine transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0700148.def: a malignant neoplasm that affects dogs, arising from transitional epithelium.

MONDO:0700149.name: canine sarcoma
MONDO:0700149.def: a malignant mesenchymal neoplasm that affects dogs. it arises from muscle, fat, fibrous tissue, bone, cartilage, and blood vessels.

MONDO:0700150.name: canine mastocytoma
MONDO:0700150.def: a tumor composed of mast cells that occurs in dogs.

MONDO:0700151.name: canine glioma
MONDO:0700151.def: a brain or spinal cord tumor arising from glial cells that occurs in dogs.

MONDO:0700152.name: canine hepatocellular carcinoma
MONDO:0700152.def: a malignant tumor arising from hepatocytes that occurs in dogs.

MONDO:0700153.name: canine lung adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0700153.def: a carcinoma that arises from the lung in dogs and is characterized by the presence of malignant glandular epithelial cells.

MONDO:0700154.name: canine rhabdomyosarcoma
MONDO:0700154.def: a malignant mesenchymal neoplasm arising from skeletal muscle that occurs in dogs.

MONDO:0700155.name: canine thyroid adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0700155.def: adeonocarcinoma of the thyroid gland occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700156.name: canine soft tissue sarcoma
MONDO:0700156.def: soft tissue sarcoma occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700157.name: canine oral squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0700157.def: oral squamous cell carcinoma that occurs in a dog.

MONDO:0700158.name: canine pancreatic carcinoma
MONDO:0700158.def: pancreatic carcinoma that occurs in a dog.

MONDO:0700159.name: canine acanthomatous epulis
MONDO:0700159.def: a tumor arising from odontogenic epithelium and occurs in a dog.

MONDO:0700160.name: canine mammary adenoma
MONDO:0700160.def: an adenoma arising from the mammary gland of a dog.

MONDO:0700161.name: canine gastrointestinal stromal tumor
MONDO:0700161.def: a gastrointestinal stromal tumor occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700162.name: canine granular cell tumor
MONDO:0700162.def: a granular cell tumor occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700163.name: canine langerhans cell histiocytosis
MONDO:0700163.def: langerhans cell histiocytosis occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700164.name: canine nephroblastoma
MONDO:0700164.def: a nephroblastoma occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700165.name: canine thyroid gland medullary carcinoma
MONDO:0700165.def: thyroid gland medullary carcinoma occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700166.name: canine transmissible venereal tumor
MONDO:0700166.def: a sexually transmitted tumor arising from histiocytes and occurring in dogs.

MONDO:0700167.name: canine sebaceous gland epithelioma
MONDO:0700167.def: sebaceous epithelioma occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700168.name: canine oral melanoma
MONDO:0700168.def: a melanoma that affects the lip and/or oral cavity of a dog.

MONDO:0700169.name: canine cutaneous t-cell lymphoma
MONDO:0700169.def: cutaneous t-cell lymphoma occurring in a dog.

MONDO:0700170.name: equine neoplasm
MONDO:0700170.def: neoplasm that occurs in a horse.

MONDO:0700171.name: horse melanoma
MONDO:0700171.def: melanoma that occurs in a horse.

MONDO:0700172.name: horse lymphoma
MONDO:0700172.def: lymphoma that occurs in a horse.

MONDO:0700173.name: horse sarcoid
MONDO:0700173.def: a fibroblastic tumor that occurs in the skin of a horse.

MONDO:0700174.name: horse transitional cell carcinoma
MONDO:0700174.def: transitional cell carcinoma that occurs in a horse.

MONDO:0700175.name: feline neoplasm
MONDO:0700175.def: neoplasm that occurs in a cat.

MONDO:0700176.name: feline lymphoma
MONDO:0700176.def: a lymphoma that occurs in cats. it is associated with exposure to feline leukemia virus and feline immunodeficiency virus.

MONDO:0700177.name: feline mammary carcinoma
MONDO:0700177.def: mammary carcinoma occurring in a cat.

MONDO:0700178.name: feline oral squamous cell carcinoma
MONDO:0700178.def: oral squamous cell carcinoma that occurs in a cat.

MONDO:0700179.name: feline osteosarcoma
MONDO:0700179.def: osteosarcoma that occurs in a cat.

MONDO:0700180.name: feline bronchioloalveolar lung carcinoma
MONDO:0700180.def: bronchioloalveolar lung carcinoma that occurs in a cat.

MONDO:0700181.name: feline fibrosarcoma
MONDO:0700181.def: fibrosarcoma that occurs in a cat.

MONDO:0700182.name: feline erythroleukemia
MONDO:0700182.def: erythroleukemia that occurs in a cat.

MONDO:0700183.name: feline reticulum cell sarcoma
MONDO:0700183.def: reticulum cell sarcoma that occurs in a cat.

MONDO:0700184.name: feline large granular lymphocyte lymphoma
MONDO:0700184.def: a t-cell leukemia in which there is a persistent increase in the number of large granular lymphocytes in the peripheral blood and occurring in a cat.

MONDO:0700185.name: feline melanoma
MONDO:0700185.def: a malignant, usually aggressive tumor composed of atypical, neoplastic melanocytes that occurs in a cat.

MONDO:0700186.name: feline histiocytic sarcoma
MONDO:0700186.def: histiocytic sarcoma occurring in a cat.

MONDO:0700187.name: feline progressive histiocytosis
MONDO:0700187.def: a condition occurring in cats characterized by solitary or multiple cutaneous nodules and papules, which may metastasize late in the course of the disease. lesions consist of poorly circumscribed histiocytic infiltrates of the superficial and deep dermis, with variable extension into the subcutis.

MONDO:0700188.name: feline synovial cell sarcoma
MONDO:0700188.def: synovial cell sarcoma occurring in a cat.

MONDO:0700189.name: chicken neoplasm
MONDO:0700189.def: a neoplasm that occurs in a chicken.

MONDO:0700190.name: chicken bursal lymphoma
MONDO:0700190.def: a malignant lymphoma that arises in the bursa of fabricius in a chicken.

MONDO:0700191.name: chicken fibrosarcoma
MONDO:0700191.def: fibrosarcoma that occurs in a chicken.

MONDO:0700192.name: chicken hepatoma
MONDO:0700192.def: hepatoma that occurs in a chicken.

MONDO:0700193.name: chicken monocytic leukemia
MONDO:0700193.def: monocytic leukemia that occurs in a chicken.

MONDO:0700194.name: chicken lymphoma
MONDO:0700194.def: lymphoma that occurs in a chicken.

MONDO:0700195.name: rous sarcoma
MONDO:0700195.def: a fibrosarcoma, originally observed in a plymouth rock hen, now thought to be an expression of infection by certain viruses of the avian leukosis-sarcoma complex in the family

MONDO:0700196.name: fish melanoma
MONDO:0700196.def: melanoma that occurs in a fish.

MONDO:0700197.name: porcine leukemia
MONDO:0700197.def: leukemia that occurs in a pig.

MONDO:0700198.name: porcine lymphoma
MONDO:0700198.def: lymphoma that occurs in a pig.

MONDO:0700199.name: sheep lung adenocarcinoma
MONDO:0700199.def: adenocarcinoma arising from the lung of a sheep.

MONDO:0700200.name: atypical dopamine transporter deficiency syndrome
MONDO:0700200.def: a subset of slc6a3-related dtds cases which have later onset which ranges from late childhood to adulthood. this disorder is characterized by the presentation of parkinsonism-dystonia, rigidity, tremor, and bradykinesia after normal childhood development.

MONDO:0700201.name: tick-borne infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700201.def: tick-borne infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700202.name: bunyaviridae infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700202.def: bunyaviridae infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.

MONDO:0700203.name: pestivirus infectious disease, non-human animal
MONDO:0700203.def: pestivirus infectious disease that occurs in non-human animals.
